namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Core.Native
{
	public class PreloadProvider : IPreloadSupport
	{
		IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> IPreloadSupport.GetConfiguredTree()
		{
			GridControl gridControl = new GridControl();
			gridControl.BeginInit();
			((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)gridControl.Columns).Add(new GridColumn
			{
				FieldName = "Item"
			});
			gridControl.ItemsSource = new List<PreloadDataItem>
			{
				new PreloadDataItem
				{
					Item = "First"
				}
			};
			gridControl.EndInit();
			yield return gridControl;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Core.ConditionalFormattingManager
{
	public class GridManagerFactory : IGridManagerFactory
	{
		private const string AppliesToFieldname = "AppliesTo";

		private const string ApplyToRowFieldname = "ApplyToRow";

		private const string RowNameFieldName = "RowName";

		private const string ColumnNameFieldName = "ColumnName";

		private const string IsEnabledFieldname = "IsEnabled";

		UIElement IGridManagerFactory.CreateGrid()
		{
			GridControl gridControl = new GridControl();
			DesignerProperties.SetIsInDesignMode(gridControl, value: false);
			Setup(gridControl);
			return gridControl;
		}

		ContentControl IGridManagerFactory.CreatePreviewControl()
		{
			return new FormatPreviewControl();
		}

		private void Setup(GridControl grid)
		{
			TableView tableView = new TableView();
			SetupView(tableView);
			grid.View = tableView;
			SetupColumns(grid);
			SetupDefaultStyles(grid);
			grid.DataContextChanged += OnDataContextChanged;
			tableView.CellValueChanging += OnCellValueChanging;
			tableView.PreviewMouseDoubleClick += OnRowDoubleClick;
		}

		private void SetupColumns(GridControl grid)
		{

		private DataTemplate CreatePreviewTemplate()
		{
			string name = typeof(FormatPreviewControl).Name;
			string xamlText = "<DataTemplate xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation\" xmlns:dxg=\"http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/grid\"><Border Padding=\"0,3,8,3\"><dxg:" + name + " Content=\"{Binding Value}\"/></Border></DataTemplate>";
			return XamlReader.Parse(xamlText) as DataTemplate;
		}

		private DataTemplate CreateApplyToRowTemplate()
		{
			string name = typeof(CheckEdit).Name;
			string xamlText = "<DataTemplate xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation\" xmlns:dxe=\"http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/editors\"><dxe:" + name + " Name=\"PART_Editor\" IsEnabled=\"{Binding RowData.Row.CanApplyToRow}\"/></DataTemplate>";
			return XamlReader.Parse(xamlText) as DataTemplate;
		}

		private void SetupView(TableView view)
		{
			view.ShowGroupPanel = false;
			view.AllowResizing = false;
			view.AllowColumnFiltering = false;
			view.IsColumnMenuEnabled = false;
			view.AllowGrouping = false;
			view.AllowSorting = false;
			view.AutoWidth = true;
			view.AllowColumnMoving = false;
			view.ShowIndicator = false;
			view.ShowVerticalLines = false;
			view.AllowEditing = false;
			view.AllowPerPixelScrolling = true;
			view.RowMinHeight = 35.0;
			view.EditorButtonShowMode = EditorButtonShowMode.ShowAlways;
			view.NavigationStyle = GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell;
			view.ShowSearchPanelMode = ShowSearchPanelMode.Never;
		}

		private void SetupSource(GridControl grid, ManagerViewModel viewModel)
		{
			grid.SetBinding(DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Items")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			grid.SetBinding(DataControlBase.CurrentItemProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("SelectedItem")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)grid.Columns["AppliesTo"].EditSettings).SetBinding(LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemsSourceProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("FieldNames")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)grid.Columns["AppliesTo"]).SetBinding(BaseColumn.HeaderProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ApplyToFieldNameCaption")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)grid.Columns["RowName"]).SetBinding(BaseColumn.HeaderProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ApplyToPivotRowCaption")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)grid.Columns["ColumnName"]).SetBinding(BaseColumn.HeaderProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ApplyToPivotColumnCaption")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			if (viewModel == null || !viewModel.IsPivot)
			{
				grid.Columns["RowName"].Visible = false;
				grid.Columns["ColumnName"].Visible = false;
				return;
			}
			grid.Columns["ApplyToRow"].Visible = false;
			grid.Columns["RowName"].Visible = true;
			grid.Columns["ColumnName"].Visible = true;
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)grid.Columns["RowName"].EditSettings).SetBinding(LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemsSourceProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("PivotSpecialFieldNames")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)grid.Columns["ColumnName"].EditSettings).SetBinding(LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemsSourceProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("PivotSpecialFieldNames")
			{
				Source = viewModel
			});
		}

		private void SetupDefaultStyles(GridControl grid)
		{
			grid.Resources.Add(typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar), new Style
			{
				TargetType = typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar)
			});
		}

		private void OnDataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			GridControl grid = (GridControl)sender;
			object dataContext = grid.DataContext;
			((ManagerViewModel)((dataContext is ManagerViewModel) ? dataContext : null)).Do(delegate(ManagerViewModel x)
			{
				SetupSource(grid, x);
			});
		}

		private void OnRowDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			TableView tableView = sender as TableView;
			ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = tableView.CalcHitInfo(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
			if (tableViewHitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo.InRow)
			{
				object dataContext = tableView.DataContext;
				ManagerViewModel val = (ManagerViewModel)((dataContext is ManagerViewModel) ? dataContext : null);
				if (val != null && val.SelectedItem != null && e.ChangedButton == System.Windows.Input.MouseButton.Left)
				{
					val.ShowEditDialog(val.SelectedItem);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnCellValueChanging(object sender, CellValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Column.FieldName == "AppliesTo" || e.Column.FieldName == "ApplyToRow" || e.Column.FieldName == "ColumnName" || e.Column.FieldName == "RowName" || e.Column.FieldName == "IsEnabled")
			{
				((TableView)sender).PostEditor();
			}
		}

		private string GetLocalizedString(ConditionalFormattingStringId id)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ConditionalFormattingLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Core.DragDrop.Native
{
	internal class TreeListInternalDragValidator : GridInternalDragValidator<TreeListView>
	{
		private TreeListNode[] draggingNodes;

		private Dictionary<Type, Type> genericListParameterTypeCache = new Dictionary<Type, Type>();

		private bool IsHierarchicalMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DataControl.ItemsSource != null)
				{
					return base.View.TreeDerivationMode != TreeDerivationMode.Selfreference;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TreeListInternalDragValidator(TreeListView treeListView, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
			: base(treeListView, activeDragInfo)
		{
			UpdateNodeInfo();
		}

		private void UpdateNodeInfo()
		{
			draggingNodes = (from x in base.ActiveDragInfo.RowPointers
				select GetNode(x) into y
				where y != null
				select y).ToArray();
		}

		protected override MoveValidationState ValidateOverride(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)dropPointer.Position == 0)
			{
				if (dropPointer.RowPointer.Handle != int.MinValue)
				{
					return (MoveValidationState)0;
				}
				return (MoveValidationState)1;
			}
			TreeListNode targetNode = GetNode(dropPointer.RowPointer);
			if (targetNode != null)
			{
				if (draggingNodes.All((TreeListNode x) => CanMove(x, targetNode, dropPointer.Position)))
				{
					return (MoveValidationState)0;
				}
				return (MoveValidationState)1;
			}
			return (MoveValidationState)2;
		}

		private bool CanMove(TreeListNode sourceNode, TreeListNode targetNode, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!((TreeListNodeBase)targetNode).IsDescendantOf((TreeListNodeBase)(object)sourceNode))
			{
				if (IsHierarchicalMode)
				{
					return CanAddToCollection(GetNodeHierarchicalSource(targetNode, position), ((TreeListNodeBase)sourceNode).Content);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IList GetNodeHierarchicalSource(TreeListNode node, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)position != 3)
			{
				return node.GetParentNodeInternal().ItemsSource;
			}
			return node.ItemsSource;
		}

		private bool CanAddToCollection(IList collection, object newObject)
		{
			if (collection == null || newObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type collectionType = collection.GetType();
			Type orAdd = genericListParameterTypeCache.GetOrAdd(collectionType, () => GetGenericListParameterType(collectionType));
			if (orAdd != null)
			{
				return orAdd.IsAssignableFrom(newObject.GetType());
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Type GetGenericListParameterType(Type collectionType)
		{
			Type[] interfaces = collectionType.GetInterfaces();
			foreach (Type type in interfaces)
			{
				if (type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IList<>))
				{
					return type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TreeListNode GetNode(RowPointer pointer)
		{
			return base.View.GetNodeByRowHandle(pointer.Handle);
		}

		protected override bool IsDragRowToItselfCore(int draggingRowHandle, int draggingVisibleIndex, int droppingRowHandle, int droppingVisibleIndex, DropPosition dropPosition)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = droppingVisibleIndex - draggingVisibleIndex;
			if (num == 0 || (num == 1 && (int)dropPosition == 1))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num == -1 && (int)dropPosition == 2)
			{
				int num2 = droppingVisibleIndex - 1;
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				int rowLevelByVisibleIndex = base.View.TreeListDataProvider.GetRowLevelByVisibleIndex(num2);
				int rowLevelByControllerRow = base.View.TreeListDataProvider.GetRowLevelByControllerRow(droppingRowHandle);
				return rowLevelByVisibleIndex >= rowLevelByControllerRow;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class MasterDetailDragValidatorBase : IDropTargetValidator
	{
		private readonly TableView view;

		private GridDragValidatorBase<TableView> detailValidator;

		public MasterDetailDragValidatorBase(TableView view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			this.view = view;
		}

		public MoveValidationState Validate(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TableView tableView = MasterDetailPathHelper.GetDetail(view.DataControl, dropPointer.RowPointer.Path).With((DataControlBase dc) => dc.viewCore as TableView);
			if (tableView == null)
			{
				return (MoveValidationState)2;
			}
			if (detailValidator == null || detailValidator.View != tableView)
			{
				detailValidator = CreateDetailValidator(tableView);
			}
			return detailValidator.Validate(dropPointer);
		}

		protected abstract GridDragValidatorBase<TableView> CreateDetailValidator(TableView view);
	}
	internal class MasterDetailInternalDragValidator : MasterDetailDragValidatorBase
	{
		private readonly DragInfo activeDragInfo;

		protected DragInfo ActiveDragInfo => activeDragInfo;

		public MasterDetailInternalDragValidator(TableView view, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
			: base(view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)activeDragInfo, "activeDragInfo");
			this.activeDragInfo = activeDragInfo;
		}

	internal abstract class DataModifierBase<T> : IDataControlModifier, IDataModifier where T : DataViewBase
	{
		private const string NotSupportedSourceError = "A built-in drag-and-drop data modification cannot work correctly because the GridControl's data source cannot be converted to an IList object.";

		private readonly T rootView;

		private DataControlItemsSelector selector = new DataControlItemsSelector();

		private bool allowSortInfoSync = true;

		public T RootView => rootView;

		public DataControlItemsSelector Selector
		{
			get
			{
				return selector;
			}
			set
			{
				selector = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AllowSortInfoSync
		{
			get
			{
				return allowSortInfoSync;
			}
			set
			{
				allowSortInfoSync = value;
			}
		}

		public DataModifierBase(T view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			rootView = view;
			AllowSortInfoSync = true;
		}

		public virtual void Remove(RowPointer[] rowPointers)
		{
			Remove(rowPointers, new DataModifierActions());
		}

		protected void Remove(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			IList<IGrouping<DataControlBase, int>> list = GroupListIndexesByDataControl(rowPointers);
			if (!VerifyItemsSource(list))
			{
				return;
			}
			actions.BeginDataUpdate(RootView.DataControl, refreshData: false);
			foreach (IGrouping<DataControlBase, int> item in list)
			{
				actions.RemoveMultiple(GetItemsSource(item.Key), item.ToArray());
			}
			actions.EndDataUpdate(RootView.DataControl, refreshData: false);
		}

		public virtual void Move(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			Move(rowPointers, pointer, new DataModifierActions());
		}

		protected void Move(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DropPointer pointer, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataControlBase targetDataControl = GetDataControl(pointer.RowPointer);
			IList itemsSource = GetItemsSource(targetDataControl);
			if (!VerifyItemsSource(itemsSource))
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<IGrouping<DataControlBase, int>> list = GroupListIndexesByDataControl(rowPointers);
			if (!VerifyItemsSource(list))
			{
				return;
			}
			actions.BeginDataUpdate(RootView.DataControl, refreshData: false);
			int listIndexByRowHandle = GetListIndexByRowHandle(targetDataControl, pointer.RowPointer.Handle);
			int insertIndex = GetInsertIndex(targetDataControl, pointer.RowPointer.Handle, pointer.Position);
			IGrouping<DataControlBase, int> grouping = list.FirstOrDefault((IGrouping<DataControlBase, int> x) => x.Key == targetDataControl);
			if (grouping != null)
			{
				list.Remove(grouping);
				list.Insert(0, grouping);
				insertIndex -= grouping.Count((int i) => i < insertIndex);
			}
			IList<object[]> list2 = new List<object[]>();
			foreach (IGrouping<DataControlBase, int> item in list)
			{
				DataControlBase sourceDataControl = item.Key;
				IList itemsSource2 = GetItemsSource(sourceDataControl);
				int[] array = item.ToArray();
				SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(targetDataControl, array, listIndexByRowHandle, pointer.Position, actions);
				object[] array2 = array.Select((int index) => CloneDragRowIfNeeded(sourceDataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowByListIndex(index), sourceDataControl)).ToArray();
				actions.RemoveMultiple(itemsSource2, array);
				actions.AcceptChanges(RootView.DataControl);
				actions.InsertMultiple(itemsSource, array2, insertIndex);
				list2.Add(array2);
			}
			if (actions.EndDataUpdate(RootView.DataControl, refreshData: false))
			{
				Selector.EnqueueSelection(targetDataControl, list2.SelectMany((object[] x) => x).ToArray());
			}
		}

		public virtual void Insert(object[] objects, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			Insert(objects, pointer, new DataModifierActions());
		}

		protected void Insert(object[] objects, DropPointer pointer, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataControlBase dataControl = GetDataControl(pointer.RowPointer);
			IList itemsSource = GetItemsSource(dataControl);
			if (!VerifyItemsSource(itemsSource))
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] array = objects.Select((object row) => CloneDragRowIfNeeded(row, dataControl)).ToArray();
			actions.BeginDataUpdate(RootView.DataControl, refreshData: false);
			int insertIndex = GetInsertIndex(dataControl, pointer.RowPointer.Handle, pointer.Position);
			if (pointer.RowPointer.Handle != int.MinValue)
			{
				int num = GetListIndexByRowHandle(dataControl, pointer.RowPointer.Handle);
				if (num >= insertIndex)
				{
					num += array.Length;
				}
				actions.InsertMultiple(itemsSource, array, insertIndex);
				SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(dataControl, Enumerable.Range(insertIndex, array.Length).ToArray(), num, pointer.Position, actions);
			}
			else
			{
				actions.InsertMultiple(itemsSource, array, insertIndex);
			}
			if (actions.EndDataUpdate(RootView.DataControl, refreshData: false))
			{
				Selector.EnqueueSelection(dataControl, array);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(DataControlBase dataControl, int[] unsynchronizedItemsIndexes, int synchronizationTargetItemIndex, DropPosition position, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataModifierSortProcessor.CreateSyncSortInfoAction<int>(this, dataControl, position)(unsynchronizedItemsIndexes, (string fieldName) => GetCellValueByListIndex(dataControl, synchronizationTargetItemIndex, fieldName), delegate(int index, string fieldName, object fieldValue)
			{
				actions.SetCellValueByListIndex(dataControl, index, fieldName, fieldValue);
			}, (string sortFieldName) => dataControl.GetSortFieldName(sortFieldName) ?? sortFieldName);
		}

		private DataControlBase GetDataControl(RowPointer pointer)
		{
			return MasterDetailPathHelper.GetDetail(RootView.DataControl, pointer.Path);
		}

		private IList<IGrouping<DataControlBase, int>> GroupListIndexesByDataControl(RowPointer[] rowPointers)
		{
			return (from rp in rowPointers
				select new
				{
					DataControl = GetDataControl(rp),
					RowHandle = rp.Handle
				} into x
				orderby x.RowHandle
				group GetListIndexByRowHandle(x.DataControl, x.RowHandle) by x.DataControl).ToList();
		}

		private static int GetInsertIndex(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)position == 0)
			{
				return GetListSourceRowCount(dataControl);
			}
			return DataModifierSortProcessor.CoerceInsertIndex(GetListIndexByRowHandle(dataControl, rowHandle), dataControl, position);
		}

		private static int GetListIndexByRowHandle(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle)
		{
			return dataControl.DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		private static object CloneDragRowIfNeeded(object row, DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			DataRowView dataRowView = row as DataRowView;
			DataView dataView = dataControl.ItemsSource as DataView;
			if (dataRowView != null && dataView != null)
			{
				DataRow dataRow = dataView.Table.NewRow();
				dataRow.ItemArray = dataRowView.Row.ItemArray.Clone() as object[];
				return dataRow;
			}
			return row;
		}

		private static int GetListSourceRowCount(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return dataControl.DataProviderBase.ListSourceRowCount;
		}

		protected static object GetCellValueByListIndex(DataControlBase dataControl, int listIndex, string fieldName)
		{
			return dataControl.DataProviderBase.GetCellValueByListIndex(listIndex, fieldName);
		}

		private static IList GetItemsSource(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return dataControl.GetDragDropItemsSource();
		}

		private static bool VerifyItemsSource(IList<IGrouping<DataControlBase, int>> listIndexGroups)
		{
			return listIndexGroups.Select((IGrouping<DataControlBase, int> group) => GetItemsSource(group.Key)).All((IList itemsSource) => VerifyItemsSource(itemsSource));
		}

		private static bool VerifyItemsSource(IList itemsSource)
		{
			if (itemsSource == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("A built-in drag-and-drop data modification cannot work correctly because the GridControl's data source cannot be converted to an IList object.");
			}
			return !itemsSource.IsReadOnly;
		}
	}

	internal class DataControlItemsSelector
	{
		private class SelectionTask
		{
			public DataControlBase DataControl { get; private set; }

			public object[] Items { get; private set; }

			public SelectionTask(DataControlBase dataControl, object[] items)
			{
				DataControl = dataControl;
				Items = items;
			}
		}

		private bool isImmediate = true;

		private List<SelectionTask> selectionTasks = new List<SelectionTask>();

		public bool IsImmediate
		{
			get
			{
				return isImmediate;
			}
			set
			{
				isImmediate = value;
			}
		}

		public void EnqueueSelection(DataControlBase dataControl, object[] objects)
		{
			selectionTasks.Add(new SelectionTask(dataControl, objects));
			if (IsImmediate)
			{
				ProcessSelectionQueue();
			}
		}

		public void ProcessSelectionQueue()
		{
			foreach (IGrouping<DataControlBase, object[]> item in selectionTasks.GroupBy((SelectionTask x) => x.DataControl, (SelectionTask y) => y.Items))
			{
				DataControlBase key = item.Key;
				object[] array = item.SelectMany((object[] x) => x).ToArray();
				if (array.Any())
				{
					object obj = array.First();
					if (key.DataView.IsMultiRowSelection)
					{
						key.ResetSelectedItems(array);
					}
					else
					{
						key.SelectedItem = obj;
					}
					key.CurrentItem = obj;
				}
			}
			selectionTasks.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal class DataModifierSortProcessor
	{
		public static int CoerceInsertIndex(int insertIndex, DataControlBase dataControl, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)dataControl.SortInfoCore).FirstOrDefault().Return((GridSortInfo x) => x.SortOrder == ListSortDirection.Descending, () => false);
			if (!(((int)position == 2) ^ flag))
			{
				return insertIndex;
			}
			return insertIndex + 1;
		}

		public static Action<IEnumerable<T>, Func<string, object>, Action<T, string, object>, Func<string, string>> CreateSyncSortInfoAction<T>(IDataControlModifier modifier, DataControlBase dataControl, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!modifier.AllowSortInfoSync || ((int)position == 3 && !dataControl.IsGroupedCore))
			{
				return delegate
				{
				};
			}
			return delegate(IEnumerable<T> unsyncedObjectInfo, Func<string, object> getFieldValue, Action<T, string, object> setFieldValue, Func<string, string> getSortFieldName)
			{
				SyncSortInfo(dataControl.SortInfoCore, unsyncedObjectInfo, getFieldValue, setFieldValue, getSortFieldName);
			};
		}

		private static void SyncSortInfo<T>(SortInfoCollectionBase sortInfoCollection, IEnumerable<T> unsyncedObjectInfo, Func<string, object> getFieldValue, Action<T, string, object> setFieldValue, Func<string, string> getSortFieldName)
		{
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in (Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)sortInfoCollection)
			{
				string text = getSortFieldName(item.FieldName);
				object arg = getFieldValue(text);
				foreach (T item2 in unsyncedObjectInfo)
				{
					setFieldValue(item2, text, arg);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class MasterDetailPathHelper
	{
		public static DataControlBase GetDetail(DataControlBase root, int[] path)
		{
			if (path.Length == 0)
			{
				return root;
			}
			GridControl gridControl = (GridControl)root;
			for (int num = path.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				gridControl = (GridControl)gridControl.GetDetail(path[num], gridControl.GetVisibleDetailDescriptor(path[num]) as DataControlDetailDescriptor);
			}
			return gridControl;
		}

		public static int[] GetPath(DataControlBase root, DataControlBase detail)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (DataControlBase dataControlBase = detail; dataControlBase != root; dataControlBase = dataControlBase.GetMasterGridCore())
			{
				list.Add(dataControlBase.GetMasterRowHandleInternal());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static bool IsInMasterDetailTree(DataControlBase root, DataControlBase detail)
		{
			for (DataControlBase dataControlBase = detail; dataControlBase != null; dataControlBase = dataControlBase.GetMasterGridCore())
			{
				if (dataControlBase == root)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class TreeListViewSelfReferenceDataModifier : DataModifierBase<TreeListView>

		private string KeyFieldName => base.RootView.ActualKeyFieldName();

		public TreeListViewSelfReferenceDataModifier(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(DataControlBase grid, int[] unsynchronizedItemsIndexes, int synchronizationTargetItemIndex, DropPosition position, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			base.SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(grid, unsynchronizedItemsIndexes, synchronizationTargetItemIndex, position, actions);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ParentFieldName) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(KeyFieldName))
			{
				object cellValueByListIndex = DataModifierBase<TreeListView>.GetCellValueByListIndex(grid, synchronizationTargetItemIndex, ((int)position == 3) ? KeyFieldName : ParentFieldName);
				foreach (int listIndex in unsynchronizedItemsIndexes)

					actions.SetCellValueByListIndex(grid, listIndex, ParentFieldName, cellValueByListIndex);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class TreeListViewNodeDataModifier : IDataControlModifier, IDataModifier
	{
		private readonly TreeListView view;

		private readonly INodeSourceAdapter nodeAdapter;

		private DataControlItemsSelector selector = new DataControlItemsSelector();

		private bool allowSortInfoSync = true;

		protected TreeListView View => view;

		private DataControlBase DataControl => View.DataControl;

		private INodeSourceAdapter NodeAdapter => nodeAdapter;

		public DataControlItemsSelector Selector
		{
			get
			{
				return selector;
			}
			set
			{
				selector = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AllowSortInfoSync
		{
			get
			{
				return allowSortInfoSync;
			}
			set
			{
				allowSortInfoSync = value;
			}
		}

		public TreeListViewNodeDataModifier(TreeListView view, INodeSourceAdapter nodeAdapter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)nodeAdapter, "nodeAdapter");
			this.view = view;
			this.nodeAdapter = nodeAdapter;
		}

		public virtual void Insert(object[] objects, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			Insert(objects, pointer, new DataModifierActions());
		}

		protected void Insert(object[] objects, DropPointer pointer, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			actions.BeginDataUpdate(DataControl, refreshData: true);
			IList nodeSource = GetNodeSource(pointer);
			int insertIndex = GetInsertIndex(nodeSource, pointer);
			actions.InsertMultiple(nodeSource, objects.Select((object obj) => NodeAdapter.GetSourceItemFromData(obj, view)).ToArray(), insertIndex);
			if (actions.EndDataUpdate(DataControl, refreshData: true))
			{
				Selector.EnqueueSelection(DataControl, objects);
			}
		}

		private IList GetNodeSource(DropPointer pointer)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			DropPosition position = pointer.Position;
			switch ((int)position)
			{
			case 0:
				return NodeAdapter.ExtractSource(View);
			case 1:
			case 2:
			{
				TreeListNode node = GetNode(pointer);
				if (node == null)
				{
					return NodeAdapter.ExtractSource(View);
				}
				return NodeAdapter.ExtractSource(node.GetParentNodeInternal());
			}
			case 3:
				return NodeAdapter.ExtractSource(GetNode(pointer));
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		private int GetInsertIndex(IList source, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DropPosition position = pointer.Position;
			switch ((int)position)
			{
			case 0:
				return source.Count;
			case 1:
			case 2:
			{
				TreeListNode node = GetNode(pointer);
				if (node == null)
				{
					return source.Count;
				}
				object sourceItemFromNode = NodeAdapter.GetSourceItemFromNode(node);
				return DataModifierSortProcessor.CoerceInsertIndex(source.IndexOf(sourceItemFromNode), DataControl, pointer.Position);
			}
			case 3:
				return 0;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		public virtual void Move(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			Move(rowPointers, pointer, new DataModifierActions());
		}

		protected void Move(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DropPointer pointer, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			//IL_0161: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			actions.BeginDataUpdate(DataControl, refreshData: true);
			TreeListNode synchronizationTargetNode = GetSynchronizationTargetNode(pointer);
			IList source = GetNodeSource(pointer);
			int insertIndex = GetInsertIndex(source, pointer);
			object[] array = rowPointers.Select((RowPointer x) => x.Object).ToArray();
			IList<TreeListNode> list = array.Where((object x) => x != null).Select(view.GetNodeByContent).ToList();
			if (list.Count != rowPointers.Length)
			{
				list = MapRowPointersToNodes(rowPointers);
				array = list.Select((TreeListNode x) => ((TreeListNodeBase)x).Content).ToArray();
			}
			insertIndex -= (from node in list
				select NodeAdapter.GetSourceItemFromNode(node) into nodeSourceItem
				select source.IndexOf(nodeSourceItem) into sourceItemIndex
				where sourceItemIndex > -1 && sourceItemIndex < insertIndex
				select sourceItemIndex).Count();
			Remove(actions, list);
			actions.InsertMultiple(source, list.Select((TreeListNode node) => NodeAdapter.GetSourceItemFromNode(node)).ToArray(), insertIndex);
			SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(actions, array, synchronizationTargetNode, pointer.Position);
			if (actions.EndDataUpdate(DataControl, refreshData: true))
			{
				Selector.EnqueueSelection(DataControl, array);
			}
		}

		private IList<TreeListNode> MapRowPointersToNodes(RowPointer[] rowPointers)
		{
			return rowPointers.Select((RowPointer rowPointer) => GetNode(rowPointer)).ToList();
		}

		private TreeListNode GetSynchronizationTargetNode(DropPointer pointer)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)pointer.Position == 1 || (int)pointer.Position == 2)
			{
				return GetNode(pointer);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SyncItemsHierarchyProperties(DataModifierActions actions, object[] unsynchronizedObjects, TreeListNode synchronizationTargetNode, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (synchronizationTargetNode != null)
			{
				DataModifierSortProcessor.CreateSyncSortInfoAction<object>(this, DataControl, position)(unsynchronizedObjects, (string fieldName) => GetCellValueByNode(view, synchronizationTargetNode, fieldName), delegate(object obj, string fieldName, object fieldValue)
				{
					actions.SetCellValueByObject(view, obj, fieldName, fieldValue);
				}, (string sortFieldName) => DataControl.GetSortFieldName(sortFieldName) ?? sortFieldName);
			}
		}

		private static object GetCellValueByNode(TreeListView view, TreeListNode node, string fieldName)
		{
			return view.TreeListDataProvider.DataHelper.GetValue((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, fieldName);
		}

		public virtual void Remove(RowPointer[] rowPointers)
		{
			Remove(rowPointers, new DataModifierActions());
		}

		protected void Remove(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DataModifierActions actions)
		{
			actions.BeginDataUpdate(DataControl, refreshData: true);
			IList<TreeListNode> list = (from x in rowPointers
				select x.Object into x
				where x != null
				select x).Select(view.GetNodeByContent).ToList();
			if (list.Count != rowPointers.Length)
			{
				list = MapRowPointersToNodes(rowPointers);
			}
			Remove(actions, list);
			actions.EndDataUpdate(DataControl, refreshData: true);
		}

		private void Remove(DataModifierActions actions, IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode node in nodes)
			{
				actions.Remove(NodeAdapter.ExtractSource(node.GetParentNodeInternal()), NodeAdapter.GetSourceItemFromNode(node));
			}
		}

		private TreeListNode GetNode(RowPointer rowPointer)
		{
			return view.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowPointer.Handle);
		}

		private TreeListNode GetNode(DropPointer pointer)
		{
			return GetNode(pointer.RowPointer);
		}
	}
	internal enum DragDropTreeDerivationMode
	{
		SelfReference,
		Hierarchical,
		Unbound
	}
	internal class TreeListViewDataModifier : IDataControlModifier, IDataModifier
	{
		private readonly TreeListView view;

		private IDataControlModifier innerModifier;

		private DragDropTreeDerivationMode? derivationModeCore;

		private bool allowSortInfoSync = true;

		private DataControlItemsSelector selector = new DataControlItemsSelector();

		private DragDropTreeDerivationMode? DerivationMode
		{
			get
			{
				return derivationModeCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (derivationModeCore != value)
				{
					derivationModeCore = value;
					UpdateInnerModifier();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AllowSortInfoSync
		{
			get
			{
				return allowSortInfoSync;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowSortInfoSync != value)
				{
					allowSortInfoSync = value;
					UpdateInnerModifier();
				}
			}
		}

		public DataControlItemsSelector Selector
		{
			get
			{
				return selector;
			}
			set
			{
				selector = value;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInnerModifier()
		{
			if (DerivationMode.HasValue)
			{
				innerModifier = view.CreateDataModifier(DerivationMode.Value);
				innerModifier.Selector = Selector;
				innerModifier.AllowSortInfoSync = AllowSortInfoSync;
			}
			else
			{
				innerModifier = null;
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateDataModifierMode()
		{
			DerivationMode = GetDragDropTreeDerivationMode(view);
		}

		private static DragDropTreeDerivationMode GetDragDropTreeDerivationMode(TreeListView view)
		{
			if (view.DataControl.ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return DragDropTreeDerivationMode.Unbound;
			}
			if (view.TreeDerivationMode == TreeDerivationMode.Selfreference)
			{
				return DragDropTreeDerivationMode.SelfReference;
			}
			return DragDropTreeDerivationMode.Hierarchical;
		}

		public TreeListViewDataModifier(TreeListView view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			this.view = view;
			InvalidateDataModifierMode();
		}

		public void Insert(object[] objects, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			InvalidateDataModifierMode();
			((IDataModifier)innerModifier).Insert(objects, pointer);
		}

		public void Move(RowPointer[] rowPointers, DropPointer pointer)
		{
			InvalidateDataModifierMode();
			((IDataModifier)innerModifier).Move(rowPointers, pointer);
		}

		public void Remove(RowPointer[] rowPointers)
		{
			InvalidateDataModifierMode();
			((IDataModifier)innerModifier).Remove(rowPointers);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class DataViewDragDropInfoFactory<T> : IDragDropInfoFactory where T : class, IDataViewHitInfo
	{
		private readonly DataViewBase rootView;

		public DataViewDragDropInfoFactory(DataViewBase view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			rootView = view.RootView;
		}

		public DragInfo CreateDragInfo(object sender)
		{
			if (rootView.HasValidationError || rootView.IsEditing || rootView.FocusedView.IsEditing)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CalcHitInfo(sender).With((T x) => CreateDragInfo(x, sender));
		}

		protected virtual DragInfo CreateDragInfo(T hitInfo, object source)
		{
			//IL_0107: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!InsideDataRow(hitInfo) || rootView.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = rootView.DataControl.FindTargetView(source);
			if (dataViewBase == null || dataViewBase.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CheckIfGridIsInMasterDetailTree(dataViewBase.DataControl))
			{
				dataViewBase = rootView;
			}
			DataControlBase dataControl = dataViewBase.DataControl;
			int[] array = null;
			if (dataControl.viewCore.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.None)
			{
				array = new int[1] { hitInfo.RowHandle };
			}
			else
			{
				array = dataControl.GetRecursiveSelectedRowHandles();
				if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			object[] selectedItems = GetSelectedItems(dataControl, array);
			int[] detailData = GetDetailPath(dataControl);
			RowPointer[] array2 = (from x in array.Zip(selectedItems, (int h, object o) => new
				{
					RowHandle = h,
					Object = o
				})
				select new RowPointer(x.RowHandle, detailData, x.Object)).ToArray();
			DragDropInfoVisualSource val = CreateDragDropInfoVisualSource(dataViewBase.GetRowElementByRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle), source, dataViewBase);
			return new DragInfo(selectedItems, array2, val);
		}

		private bool InsideDataRow(T hitInfo)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.InRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowHandle = hitInfo.RowHandle;
			if (rowHandle != -2147483645 && rowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				return rowHandle != int.MinValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int[] GetDetailPath(DataControlBase detail)
		{
			return MasterDetailPathHelper.GetPath(rootView.DataControl, detail);
		}

		private bool CheckIfGridIsInMasterDetailTree(DataControlBase detail)
		{
			return MasterDetailPathHelper.IsInMasterDetailTree(rootView.DataControl, detail);
		}

		private object[] GetSelectedItems(DataControlBase dataControl, IEnumerable<int> selectedRowHandles)
		{
			return (from x in selectedRowHandles
				select dataControl.GetRow(x) into y
				where y != null
				select y).ToArray();
		}

		public DropInfo CreateDropInfo(object sender, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
		{
			return CalcHitInfo(sender).With((T x) => CreateDropInfo(x, sender, activeDragInfo));
		}

		protected virtual DropInfo CreateDropInfo(T hitInfo, object source, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
		{
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00df: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (hitInfo.IsDataArea)
			{
				if (activeDragInfo != null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CreateDataAreaDropInfo(source);
			}
			if (!InsideDataRow(hitInfo))
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = rootView.DataControl.FindTargetView(source);
			if (dataViewBase == null || dataViewBase.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (activeDragInfo == null && dataViewBase.DataControl.ActualSortInfo.Count > 0 && !dataViewBase.AllowSortedDataDragDrop)
			{
				return CreateDataAreaDropInfo(source);
			}
			int rowHandle = hitInfo.RowHandle;
			RowPointer val = new RowPointer(rowHandle, GetDetailPath(dataViewBase.DataControl));
			object obj = null;
			DropPosition? val2 = null;
			if (dataViewBase.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				val2 = (DropPosition)3;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = dataViewBase.GetRowValue(new RowHandle(rowHandle));
			}
			DragDropInfoVisualSource val3 = CreateDragDropInfoVisualSource(dataViewBase.GetRowElementByRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle), source, dataViewBase);
			return new DropInfo(val, obj, val3, val2);
		}

		protected DropInfo CreateDataAreaDropInfo(object source)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new DropInfo(CreateDragDropInfoVisualSource(rootView.ScrollContentPresenter, source, rootView));
		}

		private T CalcHitInfo(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DependencyObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CalcHitInfoOverride((DependencyObject)obj);
		}

		protected abstract T CalcHitInfoOverride(DependencyObject obj);

		protected DragDropInfoVisualSource CreateDragDropInfoVisualSource(FrameworkElement element, object originalSource, DataViewBase actualView)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new DragDropInfoVisualSource(element, originalSource, (object)actualView.DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl(), rootView?.ScrollContentPresenter);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class RowDragDropInfoFactory<T> : DataViewDragDropInfoFactory<T> where T : class, ITableViewHitInfo
	{

			: base(view.ViewBase)

			this.view = view;
		}

		protected override DragInfo CreateDragInfo(T hitInfo, object source)
		{
			if (InsideRowServiceArea(hitInfo))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.CreateDragInfo(hitInfo, source);
		}

		protected override DropInfo CreateDropInfo(T hitInfo, object source, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
		{
			if (InsideRowServiceArea(hitInfo))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.CreateDropInfo(hitInfo, source, activeDragInfo);
		}

		protected virtual bool InsideRowServiceArea(T hitInfo)
		{
			return hitInfo.IsRowIndicator;
		}
	}

	internal class TreeListViewDragDropInfoFactory : RowDragDropInfoFactory<TreeListViewHitInfo>
	{
		private readonly TreeListView view;

		public TreeListViewDragDropInfoFactory(TreeListView view)
			: base((ITableView)view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		protected override bool InsideRowServiceArea(TreeListViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.InNodeIndent && !hitInfo.InNodeCheckbox && !hitInfo.InNodeExpandButton)
			{
				return base.InsideRowServiceArea(hitInfo);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override TreeListViewHitInfo CalcHitInfoOverride(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return view.CalcTreeListHitInfo(obj);
		}

		protected override DropInfo CreateDropInfo(TreeListViewHitInfo hitInfo, object source, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo.IsDataArea)
			{
				return CreateDataAreaDropInfo(source);
			}
			return base.CreateDropInfo(hitInfo, source, activeDragInfo);
		}
	}
	internal class CardViewDragDropInfoFactory : DataViewDragDropInfoFactory<CardViewHitInfo>
	{
		private readonly CardView view;

		private IMouseHelper mouseHelperCore = (IMouseHelper)new MouseHelper();

		public IMouseHelper MouseHelper
		{
			get
			{
				return mouseHelperCore;
			}
			set
			{
				mouseHelperCore = value;
			}
		}

		public CardViewDragDropInfoFactory(CardView view)
			: base((DataViewBase)view)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.view = view;
		}

		protected override CardViewHitInfo CalcHitInfoOverride(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			CardViewHitInfo cardViewHitInfo = view.CalcHitInfo(obj);
			if (cardViewHitInfo.IsDataArea && obj is Visual visual)
			{
				System.Windows.Point absoluteMousePosition = MouseHelper.GetAbsoluteMousePosition();
				System.Windows.Point location = visual.PointFromScreen(absoluteMousePosition);
				GridCard gridCard = FindElementInRect<GridCard>(visual, new Rect(location, GetSizeOfSpaceBetweenCards()));
				if (gridCard != null)
				{
					return CalcHitInfoOverride(gridCard);
				}
			}
			return cardViewHitInfo;
		}

		private T FindElementInRect<T>(Visual root, Rect rect) where T : FrameworkElement
		{
			T result = null;
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(root, delegate(DependencyObject x)
			{
				if (x is T val)
				{
					if (val.IsVisible)
					{
						result = val;
						return HitTestFilterBehavior.Stop;
					}
					return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
				}
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
			}, (HitTestResult x) => HitTestResultBehavior.Continue, new GeometryHitTestParameters(new RectangleGeometry(rect)));
			return result;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetSizeOfSpaceBetweenCards()
		{
			Thickness cardMargin = view.CardMargin;
			double separatorThickness = view.SeparatorThickness;
			double num = cardMargin.Left + cardMargin.Right;
			double num2 = cardMargin.Top + cardMargin.Bottom;
			if (view.Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				num += separatorThickness;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 += separatorThickness;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}
	}

	public sealed class FilterEditorVariadicBehavior : Behavior<UIElement>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AddCommandProperty;

		public ICommand AddCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return (ICommand)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(AddCommandProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(AddCommandProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		static FilterEditorVariadicBehavior()
		{
			AddCommandProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AddCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeof(FilterEditorVariadicBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.KeyDown += OnKeyDown;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			base.AssociatedObject.KeyDown -= OnKeyDown;
		}

		private void OnKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			InplaceEditorCell navigatedCell = GetNavigatedCell();
			if (navigatedCell != null && navigatedCell.IsActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			Key key = e.Key;
			ModifierKeys keyboardModifiers = ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e);
			if (CommandButtonHelper.IsAddKey(key, keyboardModifiers))
			{
				AddCommand?.Execute(null);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (CommandButtonHelper.IsRemoveKey(key, keyboardModifiers))
			{
				ICommand command = (GetNavigatedCell()?.DataContext as FilterModelValueItem)?.RemoveCommand;
				if (command != null)
				{
					command.Execute(null);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private InplaceEditorCell GetNavigatedCell()
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)base.AssociatedObject).OfType<InplaceEditorCell>().FirstOrDefault(FilterEditorNavigation.GetIsFocused);
		}
	}

				{
					x.UpdateNodes();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FilterEditorControl>();
		}

		public FilterEditorControl()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Commands = new FilterEditorCommands(this);
			UpdateNavigation();
			immediateActionsManager = new ImmediateActionsManager((FrameworkElement)this);
			base.LayoutUpdated += delegate
			{
				immediateActionsManager.ExecuteActions();
			};
			inplaceEditorOwner = new InplaceEditorOwner(this, ProcessKeyDown, PerformNavigationOnLeftButtonDown, delegate(IAction action)
			{
				immediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction(action);
			});
			FilterEditorHelper.SetInplaceEditorOwner(this, (InplaceEditorOwnerBase)(object)inplaceEditorOwner);
			base.Loaded += delegate
			{
			};
		}

		private void OnContextChanged()
		{
			unsubscribeContext?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeContext = null;
			if (Context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool forceUpdate = true;
			FilteringContextListener listener = new FilteringContextListener(delegate
			{
				if (forceUpdate || RespondToContextFiltersChanges)
				{
					filterChanged = false;
					if (forceUpdate || !IsContextFilterEqualsCurrentFilter())
					{
						UpdateNodes();
					}
				}
				else if (!RespondToContextFiltersChanges && !IsContextFilterEqualsCurrentFilter())
				{
					filterChanged = true;
				}
			}, UpdateNodes, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
				UpdateNodes();
			}, UpdateNodes, delegate
			{
				UpdateNodes();
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
				UpdateNodes();
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate(EditFilterInfo editFilterInfo)
			{
				AllowEditFilter = editFilterInfo.AllowFilterByColumns;
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			});
			unsubscribeContext = Context.RegisterListener(listener);
			forceUpdate = false;
			AllowEditFilter = Context.GetAllowEditFilter();
		}

		private bool IsContextFilterEqualsCurrentFilter()
		{
			return ((object)GetCurrentFilter())?.ToString() == ((object)Context.Filter)?.ToString();
		}

		private void UpdateNodes()
		{
			if (base.IsInitialized)
			{
				FilterEditorNodeModelFactory filterEditorNodeModelFactory = new FilterEditorNodeModelFactory(CreateFactoryOptions(), CreateNodeTreeListener());
				RootNode = FilterEditorTreeBuilder.BuildRoot(Context, filterEditorNodeModelFactory.Factory, AddNewCriteriaToBottom);
				UpdateNavigation();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			UpdateNodes();
		}

		private FilterEditorNodeModelFactoryOptions CreateFactoryOptions()
		{
			return new FilterEditorNodeModelFactoryOptions(Context, ShowCounts, PropertySelectorMode, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, IList<FieldItem> columns)
			{
				QueryFieldsEventArgs e = new QueryFieldsEventArgs(filter, new FieldList(columns), PropertyName);
				this.QueryFields?.Invoke(this, e);
				return new NodeClientColumnsInfo(e.Fields, e.ShowSearchPanel, e.DefaultField);
			}, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, string name, Type type, FilterEditorCriteriaOperatorType operatorType)
			{
				QueryOperandsEventArgs e = new QueryOperandsEventArgs(filter, name, type, operatorType, AllowFieldOperand, SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsDateTime(type) && AllowDateTimeFunctionOperand);
				this.QueryOperands?.Invoke(this, e);
				if (!e.AllowValueOperand && !e.AllowPropertyOperand && !e.AllowParameterOperand && !e.AllowDateTimeFunctionOperand)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("All operand types cannot be disabled.");
				}
				return new NodeOperatorTypeInfo(e.AllowValueOperand, e.AllowPropertyOperand, e.AllowParameterOperand, e.AllowDateTimeFunctionOperand, e.DefaultOperand);
			}, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, string name, Type type, FilterEditorCriteriaOperatorType operatorType, IList<FieldItem> columns)
			{
				QueryOperandFieldsEventArgs e = new QueryOperandFieldsEventArgs(filter, name, type, operatorType, new FieldList(columns));
				this.QueryOperandFields?.Invoke(this, e);
				return new NodeClientColumnsInfo(e.OperandFields, e.ShowSearchPanel, e.DefaultOperandField);
			}, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, string name, Type type, FilterEditorCriteriaOperatorType operatorType)
			{
				QueryParametersEventArgs e = new QueryParametersEventArgs(filter, name, type, operatorType);
				this.QueryParameters?.Invoke(this, e);
				return new NodeClientParametersInfo(e.Parameters, e.DefaultParameter);
			}, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, string name, FilterEditorCriteriaOperatorType operatorType)
			{
				QueryDateTimeFunctionsEventArgs e = new QueryDateTimeFunctionsEventArgs(filter, name, operatorType);
				this.QueryDateTimeFunctions?.Invoke(this, e);
				return new NodeClientDateTimeFunctionsInfo(e.DateTimeFunctions, e.DefaultDateTimeFunction);
			}, delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter, string propertyName)
			{
				QueryConditionOperationsEventArgs e = new QueryConditionOperationsEventArgs(filter, propertyName);
				this.QueryConditionOperations?.Invoke(this, e);
				return e.AllowRemoveCondition;
			}, delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter)
			{
				QueryGroupTypesEventArgs e = new QueryGroupTypesEventArgs(filter, Context.GetAllowedGroupFilters());
				this.QueryGroupTypes?.Invoke(this, e);
				return e.GetActualAllowedGroupFilters();
			}, delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter)
			{
				QueryGroupOperationsEventArgs e = new QueryGroupOperationsEventArgs(filter, Context.AllowCustomExpressionInFilterEditor);
				this.QueryGroupOperations?.Invoke(this, e);
				return new GroupNodeModelChildMenuOptions(e.AllowAddCondition, e.AllowAddGroup, e.AllowAddCustomExpression);
			}, delegate(OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<FilterEditorOperatorItem> info, CriteriaOperator filter, string propertyName)
			{
				FilterEditorQueryOperatorsEventArgs e = new FilterEditorQueryOperatorsEventArgs(filter, propertyName)
				{
					Operators = new FilterEditorOperatorItemList(info.List),
					DefaultOperator = info.DefaultItem
				};
				this.QueryOperators?.Invoke(this, e);
				return new OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<FilterEditorOperatorItem>(e.Operators, e.DefaultOperator);
			}, FilterSelectorTemplatesHelper.GetFilterEditorTemplateSelector(this));
		}

		private NodeTreeListener CreateNodeTreeListener()
		{
			return new NodeTreeListener(delegate
			{
				filterChanged = true;
				RaiseFilterChangedEvent();
			}, delegate(NodeModelBase node)
			{
				if (Navigation.IsNavigated(node))
				{
					immediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
					{
						Navigation.MoveToLastIndex();
					});
				}
			}, delegate(NodeModelBase node)
			{
				if (Navigation.IsNavigated(node))
				{
					Navigation.MovePrevious();
				}
			}, delegate(NodeModelBase node)
			{
				if (Navigation.IsNavigated(node))
				{
					Navigation.MoveToNearestBranch();
				}
			}, delegate(NodeModelBase node)
			{
				immediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					Navigation.MoveToFirstIndex(node);
				});
			});
		}

		private void RaiseFilterChangedEvent()
		{
			propertyChangedCore?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Filter"));
			this.FilterChanged?.Invoke(this, new FilterChangedEventArgs(new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(GetCurrentFilter)));
		}

		public void ApplyFilter()
		{
			inplaceEditorOwner.CommitCurrentCellEditor();
			if (filterChanged && Context != null)
			{
				Context.Filter = GetCurrentFilter();
			}
			filterChanged = false;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetCurrentFilter()
		{
			return RootNode?.BuildEvaluableFilter();
		}

		private void UpdateNavigation()
		{
			NavigationNodeClient<NodeModelBase> client = new NavigationNodeClient<NodeModelBase>((NodeModelBase node) => (IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>)(((object)node.GetNavigationService()?.GetPaths()) ?? ((object)new NavigationPath[0])), (NodeModelBase node) => node.GetChildren().ToArray(), delegate(TreeNavigationState<NodeModelBase> state, bool isFocused)
			{
				state.Node.GetNavigationService().Do(delegate(INavigationService x)
				{
					x.SetIsFocused(state.Path, isFocused);
				});
			});
			Navigation = new TreeNavigation<NodeModelBase>(RootNode, client);
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)inplaceEditorOwner).ActiveEditor == null || !BaseEditHelper.GetIsChildElement(((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)inplaceEditorOwner).ActiveEditor, Keyboard.FocusedElement))
			{
				if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					Navigation.Restore();
				}
				else
				{
					inplaceEditorOwner.CommitCurrentCellEditor();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Key key = e.Key;
			ModifierKeys keyboardModifiers = ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e);
			if (ProcessNavigationKeyDownIgnoreActiveEditor(key, keyboardModifiers))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)inplaceEditorOwner).ActiveEditor == null && ProcessNavigationKeyDownWithInactiveEditorOnly(key, keyboardModifiers))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessNavigationKeyDownIgnoreActiveEditor(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Tab:
				MoveFocusHelper.MoveFocus((FrameworkElement)this, ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(modifiers));
				return true;
			case Key.Prior:
				return NavigatePage((NavigationPager<NodeModelBase> x) => x.Up);
			case Key.Next:
				return NavigatePage((NavigationPager<NodeModelBase> x) => x.Down);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessNavigationKeyDownWithInactiveEditorOnly(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (CommandButtonHelper.IsAddKey(key, modifiers))
			{
				(Navigation.State?.Node?.Match((GroupNodeModel g) => g, (NodeModelBase n) => n.GetParent(RootNode)))?.AddCommand.Execute(null);
				return true;
			}
			if (CommandButtonHelper.IsRemoveKey(key, modifiers))
			{
				Navigation.State?.Node?.RemoveCommand.Execute(null);
				return true;
			}
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Left:
				Navigation.MovePrevious();
				return true;
			case Key.Right:
				Navigation.MoveNext();
				return true;
			case Key.Up:
				Navigation.MoveUp();
				return true;
			case Key.Down:
				Navigation.MoveDown();
				return true;
			case Key.Home:
				Navigation.MoveToFirstIndex();
				return true;
			case Key.End:
				Navigation.MoveToLastIndex();
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool NavigatePage(Func<NavigationPager<NodeModelBase>, Func<NodeModelBase>> selectAction)
		{
			if (ScrollViewer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Func<NodeOffsetRecord<NodeModelBase>[]> getRecords = () => FilterEditorNodeOffsetCalculator.GetNodeOffsetRecords(this, ScrollViewer);
			NavigationPager<NodeModelBase> arg = FilterEditorNavigationPager<NodeModelBase>.Pager(Navigation.State?.Node, getRecords, ScrollViewer.ViewportHeight);
			NodeModelBase nodeModelBase = selectAction(arg)();
			if (nodeModelBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Navigation.MoveToFirstIndex(nodeModelBase);
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ScrollViewer = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollViewer") as ScrollViewer;
		}

		private bool PerformNavigationOnLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			return Navigate(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
		}

		internal bool Navigate(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			TreeNavigationState<NodeModelBase> treeNavigationState = FilterEditorNavigation.FindNavigationState(obj);
			if (treeNavigationState == null)
			{
				inplaceEditorOwner.CommitCurrentCellEditor();
				return false;
			}
			Navigation.State = treeNavigationState;
			return true;
		}
	}

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filterEditor");

	public sealed class FilterEditorContextMenuBehavior : Behavior<UIElement>
	{
		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.PreviewKeyDown += OnKeyDown;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			base.AssociatedObject.PreviewKeyDown -= OnKeyDown;
		}

		private void OnKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			ModifierKeys keyboardModifiers = ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e);
			Key key = BaseEditHelper.GetKey(e);
			if (PopupInputHelper.IsActivationKey(key) || (key == Key.Down && ModifierKeysHelper.IsAltPressed(keyboardModifiers)))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				IPopupControl dXContextMenu = BarManager.GetDXContextMenu(base.AssociatedObject);
				if (dXContextMenu != null)
				{
					dXContextMenu.ShowPopup(base.AssociatedObject);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private class FilterEditorLookUpEditVisualClientOwner : GridControlVisualClientOwner
		{
			public FilterEditorLookUpEditVisualClientOwner(PopupBaseEdit editor)
				: base(editor)
			{
			}

			protected override bool ProcessKeyDownInternal(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				if (((VisualClientOwner)this).Editor.IsPopupOpen)
				{
					return base.ProcessKeyDownInternal(e);
				}
				if (PopupInputHelper.IsActivationKey(e.Key))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
					((VisualClientOwner)this).Editor.ShowPopup();
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override object GetSelectedItem()
			{
				object selectedItem = base.GetSelectedItem();
				if (selectedItem is PropertySelectorColumnModel)
				{
					return selectedItem;
				}
				TreeListNode treeListNode = (base.Grid?.View as TreeListView)?.GetNodeByContent(selectedItem);
				if (treeListNode == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				TreeListNodeIterator source = new TreeListNodeIterator(treeListNode);
				TreeListNode treeListNode2 = source.FirstOrDefault((TreeListNode x) => ((TreeListNodeBase)x).Content is PropertySelectorColumnModel);
				if (treeListNode2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((TreeListNodeBase)treeListNode2).Content;
			}
		}

		protected override VisualClientOwner CreateVisualClient()
		{
			return (VisualClientOwner)(object)new FilterEditorLookUpEditVisualClientOwner((PopupBaseEdit)(object)this);
		}

		protected override TextInputSettingsBase CreateTextInputSettings()
		{
			return (TextInputSettingsBase)(object)new FilterEditorPropertySelectorInputSettings((TextEditBase)(object)this);
		}

	public static class FilterEditorNavigation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFocusedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NodeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IndexProperty;

		static FilterEditorNavigation()
		{
			IsFocusedProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsFocused", typeof(bool), typeof(FilterEditorNavigation), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			NodeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Node", typeof(NodeModelBase), typeof(FilterEditorNavigation), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnNodeChanged));
			IndexProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Index", typeof(int?), typeof(FilterEditorNavigation), new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		public static bool GetIsFocused(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(IsFocusedProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsFocused(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsFocusedProperty, value);
		}

		public static NodeModelBase GetNode(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (NodeModelBase)obj.GetValue(NodeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetNode(DependencyObject obj, NodeModelBase value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(NodeProperty, value);
		}

		public static int? GetIndex(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (int?)obj.GetValue(IndexProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIndex(DependencyObject obj, int? value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IndexProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnNodeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BehaviorCollection behaviors = Interaction.GetBehaviors(d);
			Behavior val = ((IEnumerable<Behavior>)behaviors).FirstOrDefault((Behavior x) => x is FilterEditorNavigationService);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)behaviors).Remove(val);
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)behaviors).Add((Behavior)(object)new FilterEditorNavigationService());
			}
		}

		internal static TreeNavigationState<NodeModelBase> FindNavigationState(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (d == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = d.Yield().Concat(LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents(d, (DependencyObject)null)).GetEnumerator();
			NodeModelBase nodeModelBase = null;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext() && nodeModelBase == null)
			{
				DependencyObject current = enumerator.Current;
				nodeModelBase = GetNode(current);
				int? index = GetIndex(current);
				if (index.HasValue)
				{
					list.Insert(0, index.Value);
				}
			}
			if (!list.Any() || nodeModelBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new TreeNavigationState<NodeModelBase>(nodeModelBase, new NavigationPath((IReadOnlyCollection<int>)(object)list.ToArray()));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class FilterEditorNavigationService : ServiceBase, INavigationService
	{
		protected override bool AllowAttachInDesignMode => true;

		public IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath> GetPaths()
		{
			return GetPaths(((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject, new NavigationPath());
		}

		private static IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath> GetPaths(UIElement current, NavigationPath parentPath)
		{
			if (current == null)
			{
				return (IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>)(object)new NavigationPath[0];
			}
			int? index = FilterEditorNavigation.GetIndex(current);
			NavigationPath currentLevelPath = (index.HasValue ? new NavigationPath((IReadOnlyCollection<int>)(object)parentPath.Value.Concat(index.Value.Yield()).ToArray()) : parentPath);
			NavigationPath[] array = GetChildren(current).SelectMany((UIElement child) => GetPaths(child, currentLevelPath)).ToArray();
			if (array.Any())
			{
				return (IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>)(object)array;
			}
			if (!index.HasValue || !current.Focusable)
			{
				return (IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>)(object)new NavigationPath[0];
			}
			return (IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>)(object)currentLevelPath.YieldToArray();
		}

		public void SetIsFocused(NavigationPath path, bool isFocused)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = FindElement(((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject, path.Value.ToImmutableStack());
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				FilterEditorNavigation.SetIsFocused(uIElement, isFocused);
				if (isFocused && !uIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					uIElement.Focus();
				}
			}
		}

		private static UIElement FindElement(UIElement current, IImmutableStack<int> indexesStack)
		{
			if (current == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int? index = FilterEditorNavigation.GetIndex(current);
			IImmutableStack<int> currentLevelIndexesStack = indexesStack;
			if (index.HasValue)
			{
				if (indexesStack.IsEmpty || indexesStack.Peek() != index.Value)
				{
					return null;
				}
				currentLevelIndexesStack = indexesStack.Pop();
				if (currentLevelIndexesStack.IsEmpty)
				{
					return current;
				}
			}
			return (from child in GetChildren(current)
				select FindElement(child, currentLevelIndexesStack)).FirstOrDefault((UIElement found) => found != null);
		}

		private static IEnumerable<UIElement> GetChildren(UIElement parent)
		{
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return (from visualChildIndex in Enumerable.Range(0, VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent))
					select VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, visualChildIndex)).OfType<UIElement>();
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<UIElement>();
		}
	}
	internal static class FilterEditorNodeOffsetCalculator
	{
		public static NodeOffsetRecord<NodeModelBase>[] GetNodeOffsetRecords(FrameworkElement currentRoot, Visual scrollHost)
		{
			if (currentRoot == null || scrollHost == null)
			{
				return new NodeOffsetRecord<NodeModelBase>[0];
			}
			return (from childIndex in Enumerable.Range(0, VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(currentRoot))
				select VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(currentRoot, childIndex)).OfType<FrameworkElement>().SelectMany(delegate(FrameworkElement element)
			{
				NodeModelBase node = FilterEditorNavigation.GetNode(element);
				return (node != null) ? new NodeOffsetRecord<NodeModelBase>(node, GetVerticalOffset(element, scrollHost)).Yield() : GetNodeOffsetRecords(element, scrollHost);
			}).ToArray();
		}

		private static double GetVerticalOffset(FrameworkElement element, Visual scrollHost)
		{
			return element.TransformToAncestor(scrollHost).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)).Y;
		}
	}

	public sealed class InplaceEditor : InplaceEditorBase

				add
				{
				}
				remove
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly IInplaceEditorColumn column;

		private readonly InplaceEditorOwnerBase inplaceEditorOwner;

		private readonly EditableDataObject dataObject;

		private readonly DataTemplate template;

		private IBaseEditContainer Container
		{
