			{
				return container;
			}
			set
			{
				if (container != value)
				{
					IBaseEditContainer oldValue = container;
					container = value;
					OnContainerChanged(oldValue, container);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override InplaceEditorOwnerBase Owner => inplaceEditorOwner;

		protected override IInplaceEditorColumn EditorColumn => column;

		protected override bool IsCellFocused => isCellFocusedCore;

		protected override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		protected override bool OverrideCellTemplate => false;

		internal event EventHandler<EventArgs> EditModeChanged;

		internal InplaceEditor(InplaceEditorOwnerBase inplaceEditorOwner, EditableDataObject dataObject, DataTemplate template)
		{
			column = (IInplaceEditorColumn)(object)new EmptyInplaceEditorColumn();
			this.inplaceEditorOwner = inplaceEditorOwner;
			this.dataObject = dataObject;
			this.template = template;
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnOwnerChanged((IInplaceEditorColumn)null);
		}

		internal void UpdateCellFocus(bool newIsCellFocusedValue)
		{
			if (isCellFocusedCore != newIsCellFocusedValue)
			{
				isCellFocusedCore = newIsCellFocusedValue;
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnIsFocusedCellChanged();
				if (!newIsCellFocusedValue)
				{
					inplaceEditorOwner.EditorWasClosed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEditModeChanged()
		{
			this.EditModeChanged?.Invoke(this, new EventArgs());
		}

		private void OnContainerChanged(IBaseEditContainer oldValue, IBaseEditContainer newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.EditorChanged -= OnInnerEditorChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.EditorChanged += OnInnerEditorChanged;
			}
			UpdateEditorFromContainer();
		}

		private void OnInnerEditorChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateEditorFromContainer();
		}

		private void UpdateEditorFromContainer()
		{
			IBaseEdit val = Container?.Editor;
			if (val != null)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).InitializeBaseEdit(val, (BaseEditSourceType)1);
			}
			else
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).SetEdit((IBaseEdit)null);
			}
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnIsFocusedCellChanged();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			Container = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_Editor") as IBaseEditContainer;
		}

		protected override void SetEdit(IBaseEdit value)
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).SetEdit(value);
			propertyChangeListener = PropertyChangeListener.Create((BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("EditMode")
			{
				Source = value
			}, (Action<object>)delegate
			{
				OnEditModeChanged();
			});
		}

		protected override object GetEditableValue()
		{
			EditableDataObject obj = dataObject;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return obj.Value;
		}

		protected override EditableDataObject GetEditorDataContext()
		{
			return dataObject;
		}

		protected override bool IsInactiveEditorButtonVisible()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool PostEditorCore()
		{
			dataObject.Value = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue;
			return true;
		}

		protected override void UpdateEditValueCore(IBaseEdit editor)
		{
			BaseEditHelper.SetEditValue(editor, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorDataContext.Value);
		}

		protected override DataTemplate SelectTemplate()
		{
			return template;
		}

		protected override void OnEditorPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(Container is FrameworkElement) || !((FrameworkElement)Container).IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnEditorPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(sender, e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e) == ModifierKeys.None && ((InplaceEditorBase)this).IsEditorVisible && TryProcessUpDown(e.Key))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		private bool TryProcessUpDown(Key key)
		{
			IBaseEdit editCore = base.editCore;
			TextEdit val = (TextEdit)(object)((editCore is TextEdit) ? editCore : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Up:
				val.SpinUp();
				return true;
			case Key.Down:
				val.SpinDown();
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class InplaceEditorCell : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FilterModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsActiveProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsActivePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EditorTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EditSettingsProperty;

		private InplaceEditorDataObject editableDataObjectCore;

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public FilterModelBase FilterModel
		{
			get
			{
				return (FilterModelBase)GetValue(FilterModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FilterModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsActive
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsActiveProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(IsActivePropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate EditorTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(EditorTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EditorTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public EditSettingsInfo EditSettings
		{
			get
			{
				return (EditSettingsInfo)GetValue(EditSettingsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EditSettingsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private InplaceEditorDataObject EditableDataObject
		{
			get
			{
				return editableDataObjectCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (editableDataObjectCore != value)
				{
					InplaceEditorDataObject oldValue = editableDataObjectCore;
					editableDataObjectCore = value;
					OnEditableDataObjectChanged(oldValue, editableDataObjectCore);
				}
			}
		}

		private InplaceEditor InplaceEditor { get; set; }

		static InplaceEditorCell()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<InplaceEditorCell>.New().Register<object>("Value", ref ValueProperty, (object)null, (Action<InplaceEditorCell>)delegate(InplaceEditorCell x)
			{
				x.OnExternalValueChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<FilterModelBase>("FilterModel", ref FilterModelProperty, (FilterModelBase)null, (Action<InplaceEditorCell>)delegate(InplaceEditorCell x)
			{
				x.UpdateInplaceEditor();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("EditorTemplate", ref EditorTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<InplaceEditorCell>)delegate(InplaceEditorCell x)
				{
					x.UpdateInplaceEditor();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<EditSettingsInfo>("EditSettings", ref EditSettingsProperty, (EditSettingsInfo)null, (Action<InplaceEditorCell>)delegate(InplaceEditorCell x)
				{
					x.UpdateInplaceEditor();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("IsActive", ref IsActivePropertyKey, ref IsActiveProperty, false, (Action<InplaceEditorCell>)delegate(InplaceEditorCell x)
				{
					x.OnIsActiveChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<InplaceEditorCell>();
		}

		public InplaceEditorCell()
		{
			base.RequestBringIntoView += OnRequestBringIntoView;
		}

		private void OnRequestBringIntoView(object sender, RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Source != this)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				BringIntoView();
			}
		}

		private void OnEditableDataObjectChanged(InplaceEditorDataObject oldValue, InplaceEditorDataObject newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				((DataObjectBase)oldValue).PropertyChanged -= OnEditableDataObjectPropertyChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				((DataObjectBase)newValue).PropertyChanged += OnEditableDataObjectPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditableDataObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "Value")
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, ((EditableDataObject)EditableDataObject).Value);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInplaceEditor()
		{
			if (FilterModel == null || EditorTemplate == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			InplaceEditorOwnerBase inplaceEditorOwner = FilterEditorHelper.GetInplaceEditorOwner(this);
			if (inplaceEditorOwner != null)
			{
				if (InplaceEditor != null)
				{
					InplaceEditor.EditModeChanged -= OnEditModeChanged;
				}
				EditableDataObject = new InplaceEditorDataObject(FilterModel, EditSettings, Value);
				InplaceEditor = new InplaceEditor(inplaceEditorOwner, (EditableDataObject)(object)EditableDataObject, EditorTemplate);
				InplaceEditor.EditModeChanged += OnEditModeChanged;
				UpdateInplaceEditorFocus();
				base.Content = InplaceEditor;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditModeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IsActive = InplaceEditor != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)InplaceEditor).IsEditorVisible;
		}

		private void OnExternalValueChanged()
		{
			if (EditableDataObject != null)
			{
				((EditableDataObject)EditableDataObject).Value = Value;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == FilterEditorNavigation.IsFocusedProperty)
			{
				UpdateInplaceEditorFocus();
			}
			else if (e.Property == FilterEditorHelper.InplaceEditorOwnerProperty)
			{
				UpdateInplaceEditor();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInplaceEditorFocus()
		{
			InplaceEditor.Do(delegate(InplaceEditor x)
			{
				x.UpdateCellFocus(FilterEditorNavigation.GetIsFocused(this));
			});
		}

		private void OnIsActiveChanged()
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				SetValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, base.ActualWidth);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
			}
		}
	}

	public class NodeModelTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector

	public class OperationModelTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ConstantTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate BinaryTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate TernaryTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate VariadicTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate FormatConditionsTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate PredefinedTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate DateTimeOperatorsTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate PredefinedFormatConditionTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item is ConstantFilterModel)
			{
				return ConstantTemplate;
			}
			if (item is BinaryFilterModel)
			{
				return BinaryTemplate;
			}
			if (item is TernaryFilterModel)
			{
				return TernaryTemplate;
			}
			if (item is VariadicFilterModel)
			{
				return VariadicTemplate;
			}
			if (item is FormatConditionFilterModel)
			{
				return FormatConditionsTemplate;
			}
			if (item is PredefinedFiltersModel)
			{
				return PredefinedTemplate;
			}
			if (item is DatePeriodsFilterModel)
			{
				return DateTimeOperatorsTemplate;
			}
			if (item is PredefinedFormatConditionFilterModel)
			{
				if (!PredefinedFormatConditionFilterModel.IsConstant(((PredefinedFormatConditionFilterModel)item).ConditionType))
				{
					return PredefinedFormatConditionTemplate;
				}
				return ConstantTemplate;
			}
			return base.SelectTemplate(item, container);
		}
	}
	internal static class FilterSelectorTemplatesHelper
	{
		internal static Func<FilterModelBase, DataTemplate> GetFilterEditorTemplateSelector(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			FilterEditorThemeKeyExtension obj = new FilterEditorThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = FilterEditorThemeKeys.OperatorTemplateSelector
			};
			((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = CommonThemeHelper.GetEditorThemeName((DependencyObject)owner);
			FilterEditorThemeKeyExtension key = obj;
			return GetTemplateSelector(owner, key);
		}

		internal static Func<FilterModelBase, DataTemplate> GetMultiElementTemplateSelector(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			FilteringUIThemeKeyExtension obj = new FilteringUIThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = FilteringUIThemeKeys.MultiFilterElementOperatorTemplateSelector
			};
			((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = CommonThemeHelper.GetEditorThemeName((DependencyObject)owner);
			FilteringUIThemeKeyExtension key = obj;
			return GetTemplateSelector(owner, key);
		}

		private static Func<FilterModelBase, DataTemplate> GetTemplateSelector(FrameworkElement owner, object key)
		{
			OperationModelTemplateSelector selector = owner.TryFindResource(key) as OperationModelTemplateSelector;
			if (selector == null)
			{
				return (FilterModelBase _) => (DataTemplate)null;
			}
			return (FilterModelBase model) => selector.SelectTemplate(model, null);
		}
	}
	public class OperandEditorTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ValueTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate PropertyTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate ParameterTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate LocalDateTimeFunctionTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (!(item is OperandMenuItem))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ValueDataKind valueDataKind = ((OperandMenuItem)item).ValueDataKind;
			return (int)valueDataKind switch
			{
				0 => ValueTemplate, 
				1 => PropertyTemplate, 
				3 => ParameterTemplate, 
				2 => LocalDateTimeFunctionTemplate, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal static class PopupInputHelper
	{
		public static bool IsActivationKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key != Key.Return)
			{
				return key == Key.Space;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal static class CommandButtonHelper
	{
		public static bool IsAddKey(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (key != Key.Insert || !IsShiftNone(modifiers))
			{
				if (key == Key.Add)
				{
					return IsNone(modifiers);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsRemoveKey(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (key != Key.Delete || !IsShiftNone(modifiers))
			{
				if (key == Key.Subtract)
				{
					return IsNone(modifiers);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsShiftNone(ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (!IsNone(modifiers))
			{
				return modifiers == ModifierKeys.Shift;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsNone(ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			return modifiers == ModifierKeys.None;
		}
	}

		{

	public class HierarchyFilterBehavior : Behavior<TreeListView>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LockUpdatesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LockUpdates", typeof(bool), typeof(HierarchyFilterBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((HierarchyFilterBehavior)(object)d).OnLockUpdatesChanged();
		}));

		public bool LockUpdates
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(LockUpdatesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(LockUpdatesProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomNodeFilter += AssociatedObject_CustomNodeFilter;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomColumnDisplayText += AssociatedObject_CustomColumnDisplayText;
			base.AssociatedObject.PreviewKeyDown += AssociatedObject_PreviewKeyDown;
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_CustomColumnDisplayText(object sender, TreeListCustomColumnDisplayTextEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Node.GetContent() is NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node)
			{
				e.DisplayText = node.GetDisplayText();
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_CustomNodeFilter(object sender, TreeListNodeFilterEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Node.GetContent() is NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> nodeBase)
			{
				e.Visible = nodeBase.IsVisible;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject.FocusedNode != null && base.AssociatedObject.FocusedNode == base.AssociatedObject.FocusedNode.RootNode && !base.AssociatedObject.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				Key key = e.Key;
				if (key == Key.Subtract || key == Key.OemMinus)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				else if (RightToLeftHelper.IsLeftKey(e.Key, base.AssociatedObject.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomNodeFilter -= AssociatedObject_CustomNodeFilter;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomColumnDisplayText -= AssociatedObject_CustomColumnDisplayText;
			base.AssociatedObject.PreviewKeyDown -= AssociatedObject_PreviewKeyDown;
		}

		private void OnLockUpdatesChanged()
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				if (LockUpdates)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.BeginDataUpdate(recreateNodesOnEndDataUpdateOnly: true);
				}
				else
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.EndDataUpdate();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class RowHandleToIntConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter

		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}

		internal event EventHandler<FilterValuesEventArgs> ProcessUniqueValuesForValuesTab;

		public event EventHandler<ExcelStyleFilterElementQueryOperatorsEventArgs> QueryOperators;

		static ExcelStyleFilterElement()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ExcelStyleFilterElement);
			AllowedFilterTypesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowedFilterTypes", typeof(AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.All, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ExcelStyleFilterElement)d).OnAllowedFilterTypesPropertyChanged();
			}));
			DefaultFilterTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DefaultFilterType", typeof(ExcelStyleFilterType), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(ExcelStyleFilterType.Values, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ExcelStyleFilterElement)d).OnDefaultFilterTypePropertyChanged();
			}));
			FilterRulesTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FilterRulesTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ExcelStyleFilterElement)d).UpdateTemplateSelector();
			}));
			FilterValuesTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FilterValuesTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ExcelStyleFilterElement)d).UpdateTemplateSelector();
			}));
			ActualTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualTemplateSelectorProperty = ActualTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ExcelStyleFilterElement>();
		}

		public ExcelStyleFilterElement()
			: base(typeof(ExcelStyleFilterModel))
		{
		}

		internal override FilterModelBase CreateFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
		{
			ExcelStyleFilterModel excelStyleFilterModel = new ExcelStyleFilterModel(client, GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab, GetOperatorsForRulesTab, FilterSelectorTemplatesHelper.GetMultiElementTemplateSelector(this));
			excelStyleFilterModel.AllowedFilterTypes = AllowedFilterTypes;
			excelStyleFilterModel.DefaultFilterType = DefaultFilterType;
			return excelStyleFilterModel;
		}

		private UniqueValues GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab(UniqueValues uniqueValues)
		{
			FilterValuesEventArgs e = new FilterValuesEventArgs(uniqueValues);
			this.ProcessUniqueValuesForValuesTab?.Invoke(this, e);
			return e.FilterValues;
		}

		private void OnAllowedFilterTypesPropertyChanged()
		{
			(base.FilterModel as ExcelStyleFilterModel).Do(delegate(ExcelStyleFilterModel x)
			{
				x.AllowedFilterTypes = AllowedFilterTypes;
			});
		}

		private void OnDefaultFilterTypePropertyChanged()
		{
			(base.FilterModel as ExcelStyleFilterModel).Do(delegate(ExcelStyleFilterModel x)
			{
				x.DefaultFilterType = DefaultFilterType;
			});
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateSelector()
		{
			ActualTemplateSelector = new ExcelStyleFilterElementTemplateSelector
			{
				FilterRulesTemplate = FilterRulesTemplate,
				FilterValuesTemplate = FilterValuesTemplate
			};
		}

		private OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem> GetOperatorsForRulesTab(OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem> info)
		{
			ExcelStyleFilterElementQueryOperatorsEventArgs e = new ExcelStyleFilterElementQueryOperatorsEventArgs(base.FieldName)
			{
				Operators = new ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItemList(info.List),
				DefaultOperator = info.DefaultItem
			};
			this.QueryOperators?.Invoke(this, e);
			return new OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem>(e.Operators, e.DefaultOperator);
		}
	}

	{

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item is MultiFilterModel)
			{
				return FilterRulesTemplate;
			}
			if (item is CheckedTreeListFilterModel)
			{
				return FilterValuesTemplate;
			}
			return base.SelectTemplate(item, container);
		}

		internal class ExcelColumnFilterPreventShowPopupBehavior : Behavior<ButtonEdit>
		{
			private readonly ComboBoxEdit UniqueValuesComboBox;

			public ExcelColumnFilterPreventShowPopupBehavior(ComboBoxEdit uniqueValuesComboBox)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)uniqueValuesComboBox, "uniqueValuesComboBox");
				UniqueValuesComboBox = uniqueValuesComboBox;
			}

			protected override void OnAttached()
			{
				//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0046: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
				((UIElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).PreviewKeyDown += AssociatedObject_PreviewKeyDown;
				if (base.AssociatedObject is PopupBaseEdit)
				{
					((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupOpening += new OpenPopupEventHandler(ExcelColumnFilterPreventShowPopupBehavior_PopupOpening);
				}
			}

			private void ExcelColumnFilterPreventShowPopupBehavior_PopupOpening(object sender, OpenPopupEventArgs e)
			{
				((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
				e.Cancel = true;
				((PopupBaseEdit)UniqueValuesComboBox).ShowPopup();
			}

			protected override void OnDetaching()
			{
				//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0046: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
				((UIElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).PreviewKeyDown -= AssociatedObject_PreviewKeyDown;
				if (base.AssociatedObject is PopupBaseEdit)
				{
					((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupOpening -= new OpenPopupEventHandler(ExcelColumnFilterPreventShowPopupBehavior_PopupOpening);
				}
			}

			private void AssociatedObject_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				if (IsShowPopupKey(BaseEditHelper.GetKey(e), ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
					((PopupBaseEdit)UniqueValuesComboBox).ShowPopup();
				}
			}

			private static bool IsShowPopupKey(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
			{
				if (key != Key.Down || !ModifierKeysHelper.IsAltPressed(modifiers))
				{
					if (key == Key.F4)
					{
						return ModifierKeysHelper.NoModifiers(modifiers);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class ExcelColumnFilterComboBoxFocusBehavior : Behavior<ComboBoxEdit>
		{
			private readonly ButtonEdit FilterEditor;

			public ExcelColumnFilterComboBoxFocusBehavior(ButtonEdit filterEditor)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)filterEditor, "filterEditor");
				FilterEditor = filterEditor;
			}

			protected override void OnAttached()
			{
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosed += new ClosePopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosed);
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupOpened += AssociatedObject_PopupOpened;
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosing += new ClosingPopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosing);
			}

			private void AssociatedObject_PopupOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				UIElement child = ((Popup)(object)PopupBaseEditHelper.GetPopup((PopupBaseEdit)(object)base.AssociatedObject)).Child;
				child.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged += Popup_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
			}

			private void Popup_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!(bool)e.NewValue && ((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).IsPopupOpen)
				{
					((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).CancelPopup();
				}
			}

			protected override void OnDetaching()
			{
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosed -= new ClosePopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosed);
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupOpened -= AssociatedObject_PopupOpened;
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosing -= new ClosingPopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosing);
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			}

			private void AssociatedObject_PopupClosing(object sender, ClosePopupEventArgs e)
			{
				PopupBaseEditHelper.GetPopup((PopupBaseEdit)(object)base.AssociatedObject).Do(delegate(EditorPopupBase x)
				{
					((Popup)(object)x).Child.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged -= Popup_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
				});
			}

			private void RestoreFocus()
			{
				((UIElement)(object)FilterEditor).Focus();
			}

			private void AssociatedObject_PopupClosed(object sender, ClosePopupEventArgs e)
			{
				RestoreFocus();
			}
		}

		private class ComboBoxEditItemTemplateSelectorWrapper : DataTemplateSelector
		{
			private readonly DataTemplate ItemTemplate;

			private readonly DataTemplateSelector ItemTemplateSelector;

			private readonly DataTemplate NullValueTemplate;

			private ComboBoxEditItemTemplateSelectorWrapper(DataTemplate ownerItemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector ownerItemTemplateSelector)
			{
				ItemTemplate = ownerItemTemplate;
				ItemTemplateSelector = ownerItemTemplateSelector;
				NullValueTemplate = CreateNullValueTemplate();
			}

			private static DataTemplate CreateNullValueTemplate()
			{
				DataTemplate dataTemplate = new DataTemplate();
				FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBlock));
				Func<DependencyProperty, System.Windows.Data.Binding> func = (DependencyProperty p) => new System.Windows.Data.Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("(0)." + p.Name, BaseEdit.OwnerEditProperty),
					RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.Self)
				};
				frameworkElementFactory.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, func(BaseEdit.NullTextProperty));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetBinding(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, func(TextEditBase.NullTextForegroundProperty));
				dataTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
				dataTemplate.Seal();
				return dataTemplate;
			}

			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					return NullValueTemplate;
				}
				DataTemplate dataTemplate = ItemTemplate;
				if (dataTemplate == null)
				{
					DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector = ItemTemplateSelector;
					if (itemTemplateSelector == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					dataTemplate = itemTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(item, container);
				}
				return dataTemplate;
			}

			public static void WrapComboBox(ComboBoxEdit comboBoxEdit)
			{
				((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).ItemTemplateSelector = new ComboBoxEditItemTemplateSelectorWrapper(((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).ItemTemplate, ((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).ItemTemplateSelector);
				((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).ItemTemplate = null;
			}
		}

			NullTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NullText", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, ScheduleRecreateEditor));
			PopupTopAreaTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PopupTopAreaTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(FilterValueEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, ScheduleRecreateEditor));
			DateCalendarButtonTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DateCalendarButtonTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(FilterValueEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, ScheduleRecreateEditor));
			EditSettingsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EditSettings", typeof(EditSettingsInfo), typeof(FilterValueEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, ScheduleRecreateEditor));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FilterValueEditor>();
		}

		private void UpdateEditor()
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Grid grid = null;
			container = new EditorsContainer(null);
			if (FilterModel != null)
			{
				if (EditSettings != null && EditSettings.Settings != null && EditSettings.IsUserDefined)
				{
					ref EditorsContainer reference = ref container;
					IBaseEdit obj = EditSettings.Settings.CreateEditor((EditorOptimizationMode)0);
					reference = new EditorsContainer((BaseEdit)(object)((obj is BaseEdit) ? obj : null));
				}
				else
				{
					container = CreateRulesEditors(EditSettings?.Settings);
				}
				BaseEdit editor = container.Editor;
				ComboBoxEdit uniqueValuesComboBox = container.UniqueValuesComboBox;
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ValueProperty.Name)
				{
					UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged,
					Source = this
				};
				grid = new System.Windows.Controls.Grid();
				if (uniqueValuesComboBox != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)uniqueValuesComboBox, BaseEdit.EditValueProperty, binding);
					grid.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)uniqueValuesComboBox);
				}
				BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)editor, BaseEdit.EditValueProperty, binding);
				grid.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)editor);
			}
			Child = grid;
			RaiseEditorChanged();
		}

		}

		private FilterModelClient GetFilterModelClient(FilterModelClient client)
		{
			Func<CountsIncludeMode, Task<UniqueValues>> getUniqueValues = client.GetUniqueValues;
			Func<string, CriteriaOperator, CountsIncludeMode, string, Task<UniqueValues>> getGroupUniqueValues = client.GetGroupUniqueValues;
			return client.Update(null, (CountsIncludeMode mode) => WrapGetUniqueValues(() => getUniqueValues(mode)), (string root, CriteriaOperator filter, CountsIncludeMode mode, string child) => WrapGetUniqueValues(() => getGroupUniqueValues(root, filter, mode, child)));
		}

		private async Task<UniqueValues> WrapGetUniqueValues(Func<Task<UniqueValues>> getUniqueValuesTask)
		{
			ProcessGetUniqueValues?.Invoke(this, new ProcessGetUniqueValuesEventArgs(GetUniqueValuesStatus.Start));
			UniqueValues result = await getUniqueValuesTask();
			ProcessGetUniqueValues?.Invoke(this, new ProcessGetUniqueValuesEventArgs(GetUniqueValuesStatus.End));
			return result;
		}

		internal abstract FilterModelBase CreateFilterModel(FilterModelClient client);

		private void OnFilterModelChanged(FilterModelBase oldFilterModel, FilterModelBase newFilterModel)
		{
			if (newFilterModel != null && newFilterModel.GetType() != FilterModelType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			SyncModel();
		}

		protected void SyncModel()
		{
			if (FilterModel != null)
			{
				SyncModelCore();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SyncModelCore()
		{
			FilterModel.FilterValuesSortMode = FilterValuesSortMode;
			FilterModel.ShowAllLookUpFilterValues = ShowAllLookUpFilterValues;
			FilterModel.ShowCounts = ShowCounts;
			FilterModel.AllowLiveDataShaping = AllowLiveDataShaping;
		}

		internal virtual void OnFilterElementContentPresenterApplyTemplate(Func<string, DependencyObject> getTemplateChild)
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if ((double.IsNaN(base.MaxHeight) || double.IsInfinity(base.MaxHeight)) && double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				constraint.Height = 750.0;
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

	public sealed class FilterSetBehavior : Behavior<UIElement>
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey FilterSetInfoPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("FilterSetInfo", typeof(FilterSetInfo), typeof(FilterSetBehavior), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FilterSetInfoProperty = FilterSetInfoPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private readonly FilterSetInfo info;

		public DelegateCommand ApplyFilterCommand { get; }

		public DelegateCommand CancelFilterCommand { get; }

		public DelegateCommand ClearFilterCommand { get; }

		private FilteringUIContext Context => FilterElement.GetContext(base.AssociatedObject);

		public static FilterSetInfo GetFilterSetInfo(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (FilterSetInfo)obj.GetValue(FilterSetInfoProperty);
		}

		private static void SetFilterSetInfo(DependencyObject obj, FilterSetInfo value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(FilterSetInfoPropertyKey, value);
		}

		public FilterSetBehavior()
		{
			info = new FilterSetInfo(UpdateCommandsStatus);
			Func<bool> canExecuteMethod = () => info.Filters.Any();
			ApplyFilterCommand = new DelegateCommand(ApplyFilter, canExecuteMethod, false);
			CancelFilterCommand = new DelegateCommand(CancelFilter, canExecuteMethod, false);
			ClearFilterCommand = new DelegateCommand(info.ClearFilter, CanClearFilter, false);
		}

		private void UpdateCommandsStatus()
		{
			ApplyFilterCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			CancelFilterCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			ClearFilterCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private bool CanClearFilter()
		{
			if (!info.IsFilterCleared)
			{
				if (!info.Filters.Any())
				{
					return info.Models.Any((FilterModelBase model) => Context.GetFilter(model.Column) != null);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CancelFilter()
		{
			foreach (FilterModelBase model in info.Models)
			{
				model.Update(Context.GetFilter(model.Column));
			}
			info.Reset();
		}

		private void ApplyFilter()
		{
			Context.ApplyFilters(info.Filters.Select((KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator> x) => new KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator>(x.Key, x.Value)));
			info.Reset();
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			SetFilterSetInfo(base.AssociatedObject, info);
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.ClearValue(FilterSetInfoPropertyKey);
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}
	}

		internal bool IsComplextField(FilterField field)
		{
			if (field.FieldName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (field.FieldName.Contains("."))
			{
				return ((DataControllerBase)DataController).Columns[field.FieldName] == null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceChanged()
		{
			IList extractedSource = GetExtractedSource();
			((BaseGridController)DataController).DataSource = extractedSource;
			FilteringContext.NotifyItemsSourceChanged();
			unsubscribeListChanged?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeListChanged = null;
			if (ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IBindingList bindingList = extractedSource as IBindingList;
			if (bindingList != null)
			{
				ListChangedEventHandler handler = delegate(object o, ListChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					FilteringContext.NotifyListChanged(e);
				};
				bindingList.ListChanged += handler;
				unsubscribeListChanged = delegate
				{
					bindingList.ListChanged -= handler;
				};
			}
		}

		private IList GetExtractedSource()
		{
			if (ItemsSource is Type)
			{
				return new TypedList(TypeDescriptor.GetProperties((Type)ItemsSource));
			}
			if (ItemsSource is PropertyDescriptorCollection)
			{
				return new TypedList((PropertyDescriptorCollection)ItemsSource);
			}
			if (!(ItemsSource is ICollectionView))
			{
				return DataBindingHelper.ExtractDataSource(ItemsSource, true, false, false);
			}
			return DataBindingHelper.ExtractDataSourceFromCollectionView((IEnumerable)(ICollectionView)ItemsSource, (ItemPropertyNotificationMode)1);
		}

		private void OnFilterCriteriaChanged()
		{
			FilteringContext.SetFilterAndNotifyFilterChanged();
			UpdateFilterDisplayText();
			syncFilterCriteriaAndFilterStringLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				FilterString = CriteriaOperator.ToString(FilterCriteria);
			});
			UpdateActualFilterCriteria();
		}

		internal void UpdateActualFilterCriteria()
		{
			ActualFilterCriteria = (IsFilterEnabled ? FilteringContext.SubstituteExternalFilters(FilterCriteria) : null);
		}

		private void OnActualFilterCriteriaChanged()
		{
			this.ActualFilterCriteriaChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnFilterStringChanged()
		{
			syncFilterCriteriaAndFilterStringLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				FilterCriteria = CriteriaOperator.Parse(FilterString, new object[0]);
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateFilterDisplayText()
		{
			DisplayCriteriaHelperClient client = CreateDisplayCriteriaHelperClient();
			FilterDisplayText = DisplayCriteriaHelper.GetFilterDisplayText(FilterCriteria, client, CompatibilitySettings.UseFriendlyDateRangePresentation, (CriteriaOperator x) => x);
		}

		private DisplayCriteriaHelperClient CreateDisplayCriteriaHelperClient()
		{
			return new DisplayCriteriaHelperClient(delegate(string name)
			{
				DataColumnInfo dataColumnInfo = ((DataControllerBase)DataController).Columns[name];
				FilterField field = Fields[name];
				BaseEditSettings actualEditSettings = GetActualEditSettingsProvider(dataColumnInfo, () => field)();
				return new DisplayCriteriaColumnTraits(field?.Caption, field?.FilterMode ?? ColumnFilterMode.Value, actualEditSettings, field?.RoundDateDisplayFormat, (object val) => GetDisplayText(val, actualEditSettings, name));
			}, () => this.CustomValueDisplayText != null, Enumerable.Empty<FormatConditionFilter>);
		}

		private string GetDisplayText(object val, BaseEditSettings actualEditSettings, string fieldName)
		{
			string displayTextFromEditor = actualEditSettings.GetDisplayTextFromEditor(val);
			CustomValueDisplayTextEventArgs e = new CustomValueDisplayTextEventArgs(val, displayTextFromEditor, fieldName);
			this.CustomValueDisplayText?.Invoke(this, e);
			return e.DisplayText;
		}

		private static Func<BaseEditSettings> GetActualEditSettingsProvider(DataColumnInfo dataColumnInfo, Func<FilterField> getField)
		{
			BaseEditSettings defaultSettings = GridColumnTypeHelper.CreateEditSettings(((dataColumnInfo != null) ? dataColumnInfo.Type : null) ?? typeof(object));
			return () => getField()?.EditSettings ?? defaultSettings;
		}

		private string GetDisplayText(FilterField field, object value)
		{
			return DisplayCriteriaHelper.GetColumnDisplayText(CreateDisplayCriteriaHelperClient(), field?.FieldName, field?.RoundDateTime ?? true, value);
		}

		private FilteringUIContext CreateContext()
		{
			Func<FilterField, HeaderAppearance> getHeaderAppearance = (FilterField field) => new HeaderAppearance(field.Caption ?? SplitStringHelper.SplitPascalCaseString(field.FieldName), (DataTemplateSelector)(object)field.CaptionTemplate.With((Func<DataTemplate, ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper>)((DataTemplate x) => new ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper((DataTemplateSelector)null, x))));
			Func<FilterField, Type> getFieldType = delegate(FilterField field)
			{
				DataColumnInfo obj = ((DataControllerBase)DataController).Columns[field.FieldName];
				return (obj == null) ? null : obj.Type;
			};
			Func<FilterField, VisualFilteringColumn> getVisualColumn = (FilterField field) => new VisualFilteringColumn(field.FieldName, getFieldType(field), () => getHeaderAppearance(field), (object x) => GetDisplayText(field, x));
			Func<string, FilteringColumn> getColumn = delegate(string name)
			{
				DataColumnInfo dataColumnInfo = ((DataControllerBase)DataController).Columns[name];
				if (dataColumnInfo == null)
				{
					return (FilteringColumn)null;
				}
				Func<FilterField> getField = () => Fields[name];
				Func<bool> getRoundDateTime = () => getField()?.RoundDateTime ?? true;
				Func<BaseEditSettings> actualEditSettingsProvider = GetActualEditSettingsProvider(dataColumnInfo, getField);
				ColumnFilterMode filterMode = getField()?.FilterMode ?? ColumnFilterMode.Value;
				return new FilteringColumn(name, dataColumnInfo.Type, dataColumnInfo.Index, filterMode, allowHierarchicalFilterTree: true, actualEditSettingsProvider, getRoundDateTime, (object value) => GetDisplayText(getField(), value), () => FilterRestrictions.All().Update(null, null, null, null, null, null, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.None), () => getField()?.GroupFields, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, bool forceIsColumnFiltered, CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode, FilterValuesThrottleMode throttleMode)
				{
					ColumnValuesArguments columnValuesArgs = ColumnValuesArgumentsHelper.GetColumnValuesArgs(FilteringContext.SubstituteExternalFilters(filter), includeFilteredOut: false, getRoundDateTime());
					CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs e = new CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs(name, filter);
					this.CustomUniqueValues?.Invoke(this, e);
					if (e.Values != null)
					{
						return Task.FromResult(UniqueValues.FromValues(e.Values));
					}
					if (e.CountedValues != null)
					{
						return Task.FromResult(UniqueValues.FromCountedValues(e.CountedValues.Select((CountedValue x) => new Counted<object>(x.Value, x.Count)).ToReadOnlyCollection()));
					}
					if (countsIncludeMode == CountsIncludeMode.Include)
					{
						ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>> uniqueColumnValuesWithCounts = FilterHelper.GetUniqueColumnValuesWithCounts(name, columnValuesArgs);
						return Task.FromResult(UniqueValues.FromCountedValues(uniqueColumnValuesWithCounts));
					}
					object[] uniqueColumnValues = ((FilterHelperBase)FilterHelper).GetUniqueColumnValues(dataColumnInfo, columnValuesArgs, (OperationCompleted)null);
					return Task.FromResult(UniqueValues.FromValues(uniqueColumnValues));
				}, () => getField()?.ShowAllFilterValues ?? ShowAllFilterValues, (SummaryFilterInfo[] summaries) => summaries.Select(delegate(SummaryFilterInfo x)
				{
					//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					ColumnValuesArguments columnValuesArgs = ColumnValuesArgumentsHelper.GetColumnValuesArgs(FilteringContext.SubstituteExternalFilters(x.Filter));
					return FilterHelper.GetSummaryValue(name, x.SummaryType, columnValuesArgs, x.IgnoreNulls);
				}).ToArray(), () => getField()?.PredefinedFilters);
			};
			FilteringUIContextClient client = new FilteringUIContextClient(() => FilterCriteria, delegate(CriteriaOperator filter)
			{
				FilterCriteria = filter;
			}, (CriteriaOperator filter) => FilteringContext.SubstituteExternalFilters(filter), getColumn, (string name) => Fields[name].With(getVisualColumn), (ColumnForestFilterMode _) => Fields.Select((FilterField field) => Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>.CreateLeaf(getVisualColumn(field))), () => AllowedGroupFilters.All, () => true, () => Enumerable.Empty<FormatConditionFilter>(), (FormatConditionFilterInfo filterInfo) => (CriteriaOperator)null, () => MRUFilterListCount, delegate
			{
				ShowFilterEditor(null);
			}, delegate
			{
				((DataController)DataController).FilterCriteria = null;
				FilterCriteria = null;
			}, () => (object)null, () => 0.0, delegate(bool isFilterEnabled)
			{
				IsFilterEnabled = isFilterEnabled;
			}, () => true, () => true, () => true);
			return new FilteringUIContext(client);
		}
	}

		private void OnPredefindeFiltersChanged()
		{
			PredefinedFilters?.Freeze();
			Owner?.UpdateActualFilterCriteria();
		}

		private void OnRoundDateTimeChanged()
		{
			Owner?.FilteringContext.NotifyRoundDateChanged(FieldName);
		}

		private void OnGroupFieldsChanged()
		{
			Owner?.FilteringContext.NotifyGroupFieldsChanged(FieldName);
		}

		private void OnEditSettingsChanged()
		{
			UpdateEditSettingsInheritance();
			UpdateEditSettingsSubscribtion();
			NotifyEditSettingsChanged();
		}

		private void OnUnboundChanged()
		{
			Owner?.OnColumnUnboundChanged();
		}

		private void OnCaptionChanged()
		{
			Owner?.UpdateFilterDisplayText();
		}

		private void NotifyEditSettingsChanged()
		{
			Owner?.FilteringContext.NotifyEditSettingsChanged(FieldName);
		}

		private void UpdateEditSettingsSubscribtion()
		{
			clearEditSettingsSubscribtion?.Invoke();
			clearEditSettingsSubscribtion = FilteringUIContextHelper.SubscribeSettings(EditSettings, delegate
			{
				NotifyEditSettingsChanged();
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateEditSettingsInheritance()
		{
			ClearEditSettingsInheritance();
			if (EditSettings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FilterBehavior owner = Owner;
			if (((owner != null) ? ((AttachableObjectBase)owner).AssociatedObject : null) != null)
			{
				LogicalTreeWrapper.SetRoot((DependencyObject)(object)EditSettings, (UIElement)(FrameworkElement)((AttachableObjectBase)Owner).AssociatedObject);
				BaseEditSettings closuredSettings = EditSettings;
				clearEditSettingsInheritance = delegate
				{
					LogicalTreeWrapper.SetRoot((DependencyObject)(object)closuredSettings, (UIElement)null);
				};
			}
		}

		internal void ClearEditSettingsInheritance()
		{
			clearEditSettingsInheritance?.Invoke();
			clearEditSettingsInheritance = null;
		}

		internal void SetOwner(FilterBehavior behavior)
		{
			Owner = behavior;
			UpdateEditSettingsInheritance();
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new FilterField();
		}
	}
	public class FilterFieldCollection : FreezableCollection<FilterField>
	{
		private readonly FilterBehavior behavior;

		private List<FilterField> copy = new List<FilterField>();

		private Locker addLocker = new Locker();

		private bool delayedColumnUnboundChanged;

		public FilterField this[string fieldName] => this.FirstOrDefault((FilterField x) => x.FieldName == fieldName);

		public FilterFieldCollection(FilterBehavior behavior)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((INotifyCollectionChanged)this).CollectionChanged += CollectionChanged;
			this.behavior = behavior;
		}

		private void CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				OnAdded(e);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				OnRemoved(e.OldItems);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				OnRemoved(e.OldItems);
				OnAdded(e);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				OnRemoved(copy);
			}
			copy = this.ToList();
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<FilterField> items)
		{
			Locker val = addLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				foreach (FilterField item in items)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (delayedColumnUnboundChanged)
			{
				behavior.OnColumnUnboundChanged();
			}
			delayedColumnUnboundChanged = false;
			behavior.UpdateFilterDisplayText();
		}

		private void OnAdded(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (FilterField newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				newItem.SetOwner(behavior);
				bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(newItem.UnboundExpression) || behavior.IsComplextField(newItem);
				NotifyFieldAddedRemoved(newItem);
				if (addLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						delayedColumnUnboundChanged = true;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					behavior.OnColumnUnboundChanged();
				}
				behavior.UpdateFilterDisplayText();
			}
		}

		private void OnRemoved(IList items)
		{
			foreach (FilterField item in items)
			{
				item.SetOwner(null);
				NotifyFieldAddedRemoved(item);
				behavior.UpdateFilterDisplayText();
			}
		}

		private void NotifyFieldAddedRemoved(FilterField item)
		{
			behavior.FilteringContext.NotifyColumnAddedRemoved(item.FieldName);
		}
	}

				.Register<bool>("IsExpanded", ref IsExpandedProperty, false, (Action<FilteringPanelControl>)delegate(FilteringPanelControl d)
				{
					d.OnIsExpandedChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowChangeExpandState", ref AllowChangeExpandStateProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowMRU", ref AllowMRUProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowEditFilter", ref AllowEditFilterProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowDisableFilter", ref AllowDisableFilterProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowClearFilter", ref AllowClearFilterProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowDeleteColumnFilters", ref AllowDeleteColumnFiltersProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<object>("Caption", ref CaptionPropertyKey, ref CaptionProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<ReadOnlyObservableCollection<CriteriaOperator>>("MRUFilters", ref MRUFiltersPropertyKey, ref MRUFiltersProperty, (ReadOnlyObservableCollection<CriteriaOperator>)null, (Action<FilteringPanelControl, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(FilteringPanelControl d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnMRUFiltersChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<ICommand>("ShowFilterEditorCommand", ref ShowFilterEditorCommandPropertyKey, ref ShowFilterEditorCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<ICommand>("ClearFilterCommand", ref ClearFilterCommandPropertyKey, ref ClearFilterCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<ICommand>("ExpandCommand", ref ExpandCommandPropertyKey, ref ExpandCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<ICommand>("CollapseCommand", ref CollapseCommandPropertyKey, ref CollapseCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsFilterEnabled", ref IsFilterEnabledProperty, true, (Action<FilteringPanelControl>)delegate(FilteringPanelControl d)
				{
					d.Context?.IsFilterEnabled(d.IsFilterEnabled);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("IsMRUListEmpty", ref IsMRUListEmptyPropertyKey, ref IsMRUListEmptyProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<double>("Indent", ref IndentPropertyKey, ref IndentProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public FilteringPanelControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.SetAndMeasure<FilteringPanelControl>(this);
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptor(this, new FilterPanelTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
		}

		private void OnContextChanged()
		{
			unregisterContextListener?.Invoke();
			FilteringUIContext context = Context;
			MRUFilters = context?.MRUFilters;
			IsMRUListEmpty = MRUFilters == null || MRUFilters.Count == 0;
			ShowFilterEditorCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				context?.ShowFilterEditor();
			}, useCommandManager: false);
			ClearFilterCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				ClearFilter();
			}, useCommandManager: false);
			ExpandCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				IsExpanded = true;
			}, useCommandManager: false);
			CollapseCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				IsExpanded = false;
			}, useCommandManager: false);
			UpdateCaption();
			UpdateIndent();
			if (context == null)
			{
				unregisterContextListener = null;
				UpdateFilter();
				return;
			}
			AllowEditFilter = context.GetAllowEditFilter();
			IsFilterEnabled = context.GetIsFilterEnabled();
			unregisterContextListener = context.RegisterListener(new FilteringContextListener(UpdateFilter, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, UpdateCaption, UpdateIndent, delegate(bool isFilterEnabled)
			{
				IsFilterEnabled = isFilterEnabled;
			}, delegate(EditFilterInfo editFilterInfo)
			{
				AllowEditFilter = editFilterInfo.AllowFilterEditor && editFilterInfo.AllowFilterByColumns;
			}, delegate(bool allowMRUFilterList)
			{
				AllowMRU = allowMRUFilterList;
			}, delegate
			{
			}));
		}

		private void ClearFilter()
		{
			if (mruList != null)
			{
				mruList.EditValue = null;
			}
			Context?.ClearFilter();
		}

		private void UpdateCaption()
		{
			Caption = Context?.DetailHeaderContent;
		}

		private void UpdateIndent()
		{
			Indent = Context?.DetailIndent ?? 0.0;
		}

		private void UpdateFilter()
		{
			Filter = Context?.Filter;
		}

		private void UpdateActualMaxLineCount()
		{
			ActualMaxLineCount = ((!base.IsEnabled || !IsExpanded) ? 1 : MaxLineCount);
		}

		private void OnIsExpandedChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualMaxLineCount();
			if (IsExpanded)
			{
				CollapseOthersPanelsInGroup();
			}
		}

		internal void CollapseOthersPanelsInGroup()
		{
			List<FilteringPanelControl> list = (List<FilteringPanelControl>)FilteringPanelMasterDetailHelper.GetGroup(this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FilteringPanelControl item in list.Where((FilteringPanelControl x) => x != this))
			{
				item.IsExpanded = false;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SetHitTestAcceptors();
			if (mruList != null)
			{
				mruList.EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnMRUListEditValueChanged);
			}
			mruList = (BaseEdit)GetTemplateChild("PART_MRUList");
			if (mruList != null)
			{
				mruList.EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnMRUListEditValueChanged);
			}
		}

		private void SetHitTestAcceptors()
		{
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(GetTemplateChild("cbFilterEnable"), new FilterPanelActiveButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(GetTemplateChild("buttonExpand"), new FilterPanelExpandButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(GetTemplateChild("mru"), new MRUFilterListComboBoxHitTestAcceptor());
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(GetTemplateChild("buttonEditFilter"), new FilterPanelCustomizeButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(GetTemplateChild("buttonClearFilter"), new FilterPanelCloseButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(GetTemplateChild("buttonCollapse"), new FilterPanelCollapseButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
		}

		private void OnMRUListEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				Context.Filter = (CriteriaOperator)e.NewValue;
				((BaseEdit)sender).EditValue = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnMRUFiltersChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)oldValue).CollectionChanged -= MRUFilters_CollectionChanged;
			}
			if (newValue is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += MRUFilters_CollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void MRUFilters_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ICollection collection = sender as ICollection;
			IsMRUListEmpty = collection == null || collection.Count == 0;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}

	public class PaletteForegroundConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private sealed class MyWpfSvgPalette : WpfSvgPalette
		{
			private readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush _value;

			public MyWpfSvgPalette(System.Windows.Media.Brush value)
			{
				_value = value;
			}

			public override bool ReplaceBrush(string styleName, string actualState, string color, out System.Windows.Media.Brush result)
			{
				result = _value;
				return true;
			}

			protected override bool ReplaceColorCore<T>(string styleName, string actualState, string color, out T result)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = default(System.Windows.Media.Brush);
				if (!((WpfSvgPalette)this).ReplaceBrush(styleName, actualState, color, ref brush))
				{
					return ((WpfSvgPalette)this).ReplaceColorCore<T>(styleName, actualState, color, ref result);
				}
				result = (T)WpfSvgPalette.GetResult<T>(brush);
				return true;
			}
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			MyWpfSvgPalette myWpfSvgPalette = new MyWpfSvgPalette((System.Windows.Media.Brush)value);
			((WpfSvgPalette)myWpfSvgPalette).BeginInit();
			((WpfSvgPalette)myWpfSvgPalette).EndInit();
			return myWpfSvgPalette;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		private static EditorStringId GetEditorStringId(DateTimeFunctionType? localDateTimeFunctionType)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				return (EditorStringId)300;

			{

				1 => 368, 
				2 => 369, 
				3 => 370, 
				4 => 371, 
				5 => 372, 
				6 => 373, 
				7 => 374, 
				8 => 375, 
				9 => 376, 
				10 => 377, 
				11 => 378, 
				12 => 379, 
				13 => 380, 
				14 => 381, 
				15 => 382, 
				16 => 383, 
				17 => 384, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("localDateTimeFunctionType", localDateTimeFunctionType, null), 
			});
		}

	public abstract class SealedDataTemplateProviderBase
	{
		protected void SetSealedValue<T>(ref DataTemplate field, DataTemplate value, out Lazy<T> factory)
		{
			field = value;
			DataTemplate obj = field;
			if (obj != null && obj.CheckAccess())
			{
				field.Seal();
			}
			factory = new Lazy<T>(() => (T)TemplateHelper.LoadFromTemplate(value, typeof(object), (Func<object, object>)null));
		}
	}
	public class FormatConditionValueEditSettingsConverter : SealedDataTemplateProviderBase, IValueConverter
	{

			}

		{

				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, null), 
			};
		}

		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();

	public sealed class HyperlinkToogleBehavior : Behavior<HyperlinkEdit>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedItemProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedItem", typeof(object), typeof(HyperlinkToogleBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsSource", typeof(IList), typeof(HyperlinkToogleBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public object SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IList ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (IList)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.RequestNavigation += new HyperlinkEditRequestNavigationEventHandler(OnRequestNavigation);
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.AssociatedObject.RequestNavigation -= new HyperlinkEditRequestNavigationEventHandler(OnRequestNavigation);
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private void OnRequestNavigation(object sender, HyperlinkEditRequestNavigationEventArgs e)
		{
			IList itemsSource = ItemsSource;
			if (itemsSource != null)
			{
				int num = itemsSource.IndexOf(SelectedItem);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					SelectedItem = ((num + 1 < itemsSource.Count) ? itemsSource[num + 1] : itemsSource[0]);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public static Action SubscribeQueryParametersAndGetUnsubscribeAction(this FilterEditorControl filterEditor, Func<CriteriaOperator, string, Type, FilterEditorCriteriaOperatorType, IList<string>> getParameters)
		{
			EventHandler<QueryParametersEventArgs> onQueryParameters = delegate(object sender, QueryParametersEventArgs args)
			{
				args.Parameters = getParameters(args.Filter, args.FieldName, args.FieldType, args.OperatorType);
			};
			filterEditor.QueryParameters += onQueryParameters;
			return delegate
			{
				filterEditor.QueryParameters -= onQueryParameters;
			};

	{
		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)base.AssociatedObject, SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>.SelectedItemProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("SelectedFilterModel")
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			base.AssociatedObject.SelectionChanged += new TabControlSelectionChangedEventHandler(AssociatedObject_SelectionChanged);
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_SelectionChanged(object sender, TabControlSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldSelectedItem != null)
			{
				ExcelStyleFilterModel excelStyleFilterModel = ((FrameworkElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).DataContext as ExcelStyleFilterModel;
				if (excelStyleFilterModel?.SelectedFilterModel == null || e.NewSelectedIndex == -1)
				{
					((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)base.AssociatedObject).SelectedIndex = 1;
				}
				else
				{
					excelStyleFilterModel.SelectedFilterModel = excelStyleFilterModel.FilterModels[e.NewSelectedIndex];
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.AssociatedObject.SelectionChanged -= new TabControlSelectionChangedEventHandler(AssociatedObject_SelectionChanged);
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

	public sealed class RemoteBindingBehavior : Behavior<UIElement>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TargetProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentProperty;

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return GetContent((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			}
			set
			{
				SetContent((DependencyObject)(object)this, value);
			}
		}

		public DependencyObject Target
		{
			get
			{
				return (DependencyObject)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(TargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(TargetProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		static RemoteBindingBehavior()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(RemoteBindingBehavior);
			ContentProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Content", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(OnContentChanged));
			TargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Target", typeof(DependencyObject), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RemoteBindingBehavior)(object)d).OnTargetChanged((DependencyObject)e.OldValue);
			}));
		}

		private static void OnContentChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (obj is RemoteBindingBehavior)
			{
				((RemoteBindingBehavior)(object)obj).AssignContentToTarget();
			}
		}

		public static object GetContent(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return obj.GetValue(ContentProperty);
		}

		public static void SetContent(DependencyObject obj, object value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ContentProperty, value);
		}

		private void OnTargetChanged(DependencyObject old)
		{
			ClearSource(old);
			AssignContentToTarget();
		}

		private void ClearSource(DependencyObject old)
		{
			if (old != null)
			{
				SetContent(old, null);
			}
		}

		private void AssignContentToTarget()
		{
			if (Target != null)
			{
				SetContent(Target, Content);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			ClearSource(Target);
		}
	}
	public static class FilterElementHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FilterModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FilterElementProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ClearTextBlockMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueItemProperty;

		static FilterElementHelper()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(FilterElementHelper);
			FilterModelProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("FilterModel", typeof(FilterModelBase), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnFilterModelPropertyChanged));
			FilterElementProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("FilterElement", typeof(FilterElement), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
			ClearTextBlockMarginProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ClearTextBlockMargin", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnTextBlockMarginChanged));
			ValueItemProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ValueItem", typeof(FilterModelValueItem), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
		}

		private static void OnFilterModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FilterElement filterElement = d as FilterElement;
			FilterModelBase filterModel = (FilterModelBase)e.NewValue;
			if (filterElement != null && IsSupportedFilterModel(filterElement, filterModel))
			{
				filterElement.FilterModel = filterModel;
			}
		}

		private static void OnTextBlockMarginChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is TextBlock textBlock)
			{
				if ((bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					EditorMarginHelper.SetMargin((DependencyObject)textBlock, "0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0");
				}
				else
				{
					textBlock.ClearValue(EditorMarginHelper.MarginProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsSupportedFilterModel(FilterElement filterElement, FilterModelBase filterModel)
		{
			if (filterModel == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return filterElement.FilterModelType == filterModel.GetType();
		}

		public static FilterModelBase GetFilterModel(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (FilterModelBase)obj.GetValue(FilterModelProperty);
		}

		public static void SetFilterModel(DependencyObject obj, FilterModelBase value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(FilterModelProperty, value);
		}

		public static FilterElement GetFilterElement(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (FilterElement)obj.GetValue(FilterElementProperty);
		}

		public static void SetFilterElement(DependencyObject obj, FilterElement value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(FilterElementProperty, value);
		}

		public static void SetClearTextBlockMargin(DependencyObject element, bool value)
		{
			element.SetValue(ClearTextBlockMarginProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetClearTextBlockMargin(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (bool)element.GetValue(ClearTextBlockMarginProperty);
		}

		public static FilterModelValueItem GetValueItem(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (FilterModelValueItem)element.GetValue(ValueItemProperty);
		}

		public static void SetValueItem(DependencyObject element, FilterModelValueItem value)
		{
			element.SetValue(ValueItemProperty, value);
		}

	public static class FilteringPanelMasterDetailHelper
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey GroupPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsGroupRootProperty;

		public static object GetGroup(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return d.GetValue(GroupProperty);
		}

		private static void SetGroup(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			d.SetValue(GroupPropertyKey, value);
		}

		public static bool GetIsGroupRoot(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsGroupRootProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsGroupRoot(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(IsGroupRootProperty, value);
		}

		static FilteringPanelMasterDetailHelper()
		{
			GroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("Group", typeof(object), typeof(FilteringPanelMasterDetailHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnGroupChanged));
			GroupProperty = GroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsGroupRootProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsGroupRoot", typeof(bool), typeof(FilteringPanelMasterDetailHelper), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsGroupRootChanged));
		}

		private static void OnIsGroupRootChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				SetGroup(d, new List<FilteringPanelControl>());
			}
			else
			{
				d.ClearValue(GroupPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		private static void OnGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FilteringPanelControl filteringPanelControl)
			{
				((List<FilteringPanelControl>)e.OldValue)?.Remove(filteringPanelControl);
				((List<FilteringPanelControl>)e.NewValue)?.Add(filteringPanelControl);
				if (filteringPanelControl.IsExpanded)
				{
					filteringPanelControl.CollapseOthersPanelsInGroup();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private void UpdateFilterPanel()
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			System.Windows.Controls.Control filterPanel = FilterPanel;
			if (filterPanel != null)
			{
				filterPanel.SetValue(AdapterPropertyKey, null);
				filterPanel.Style = null;
				RemoveVisualChild(filterPanel);
				RemoveLogicalChild(filterPanel);
			}
			if (UseLegacyFilterPanel ?? CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyFilterPanel)
			{
				DataTemplate legacyFilterPanelTemplate = LegacyFilterPanelTemplate;
				filterPanel = ((legacyFilterPanelTemplate == null) ? ((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)LegacyFilterPanelType.With(delegate(Type x)
				{
					//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
					FilterPanelControlBase val = (FilterPanelControlBase)Activator.CreateInstance(x);
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Style = LegacyFilterPanelStyle;
					return val;
				})) : ((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(FilterPanelControlBase)legacyFilterPanelTemplate.LoadContent()));
			}
			else
			{
				filterPanel = new FilteringPanelControl
				{
					Style = FilteringPanelStyle
				};
			}
			FilterPanel = filterPanel;
			if (filterPanel != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(filterPanel);
				AddVisualChild(filterPanel);
				filterPanel.SetValue(AdapterPropertyKey, this);
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void UpdateLegacyFilterPanelStyle()
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Control filterPanel = FilterPanel;
			FilterPanelControlBase val = (FilterPanelControlBase)(object)((filterPanel is FilterPanelControlBase) ? filterPanel : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Style = LegacyFilterPanelStyle;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFilteringPanelStyle()
		{
			if (FilterPanel is FilteringPanelControl filteringPanelControl)
			{
				filteringPanelControl.Style = FilteringPanelStyle;
			}
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index != 0 || FilterPanel == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			return FilterPanel;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (FilterPanel == null)

			}
			FilterPanel.Measure(constraint);

			}

			return arrangeSize;
		}

	internal struct Variant<T1, T2> where T1 : struct where T2 : struct
	{
		private readonly int type;

		private readonly int value;

		private Variant(int type, int value)
		{
			this.type = type;
			this.value = value;
		}

		public static implicit operator Variant<T1, T2>(T1 value)
		{
			return new Variant<T1, T2>(1, (int)(object)value);
		}

		public static implicit operator Variant<T1, T2>(T2 value)
		{
			return new Variant<T1, T2>(2, (int)(object)value);
		}

		public T Match<T>(Func<T1, T> t1, Func<T2, T> t2)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				1 => t1((T1)(object)value), 
				2 => t2((T2)(object)value), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		public void Match(Action<T1> t1, Action<T2> t2)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case 1:
				t1((T1)(object)value);
				break;
			case 2:
				t2((T2)(object)value);
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}
	}

				t1((T1)(object)value);
				break;
			case 2:
				t2((T2)(object)value);
				break;
			case 3:
				t3((T3)(object)value);
				break;
			case 4:
				t4((T4)(object)value);
				break;
			case 5:
				t5((T5)(object)value);
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}
	}

	internal struct CustomUnaryPostfixFunction : IEquatable<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction>
	{
		public readonly CustomUnaryPostfixFunctionKind Kind;

		public readonly string Name;

		public readonly bool IsPredefinedFilter;

		public CustomUnaryPostfixFunction(CustomUnaryPostfixFunctionKind kind, string name, bool isPredefinedFilter)
		{
			Kind = kind;
			Name = name;
			IsPredefinedFilter = isPredefinedFilter;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Kind.ToString() + Name;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<CustomUnaryPostfixFunctionKind, string, bool>(Kind, Name, IsPredefinedFilter);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CustomUnaryPostfixFunction a, CustomUnaryPostfixFunction b)
		{
			if (a.Kind == b.Kind && a.Name == b.Name)
			{
				return a.IsPredefinedFilter == b.IsPredefinedFilter;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CustomUnaryPostfixFunction a, CustomUnaryPostfixFunction b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CustomUnaryPostfixFunction)
			{
				return this == (CustomUnaryPostfixFunction)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(CustomUnaryPostfixFunction other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}

		private readonly int operatorType;

		private readonly object name;

		}
