		public ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> GetChildren()
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria>(children);
		}

		public FilteringPanelCriteria Change(Func<FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria> changeChildren, int id = -1)
		{
			return Change(delegate(FilteringPanelCriteria[] children)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
				{
					children[i] = changeChildren(children[i]);
				}
			}, id);
		}

		public FilteringPanelCriteria Change(Action<FilteringPanelCriteria[]> changeChildren = null, int id = -1)
		{
			FilteringPanelCriteria[] array;
			if (children == null)
			{
				array = null;
			}
			else
			{
				array = new FilteringPanelCriteria[children.Length];
				children.CopyTo(array, 0);
				changeChildren?.Invoke(array);
			}
			return new FilteringPanelCriteria(type, array, operatorType, name, id);
		}

		public T Match<T>(Func<string, T> property, Func<object, T> value, Func<GroupOperatorType?, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria>, T> group, Func<FilteringPanelOperator, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> unaryOperator, Func<FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelOperator, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> binaryOperator, Func<FilteringPanelCriteria, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>>, T> unaryPostfixFunction, Func<FilteringPanelCriteria, BinaryInfixFunction, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> binaryInfixFunction, Func<BinaryFunctionWithPrefix, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> binaryFunctionWithPrefix, Func<BinaryFunctionWithSuffix, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> binaryFunctionWithSuffix, Func<FilteringPanelCriteria, TernaryFunction, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> ternaryFunction, Func<Either<string, PrefixFunction>, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria>, T> prefixFunction)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case CriteriaExpressionType.Property:
				return property((string)name);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.Value:
				return value(name);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryOperator:
				return binaryOperator(children[0], (FilteringPanelOperator)operatorType, children[1]);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.UnaryOperator:
				return unaryOperator((FilteringPanelOperator)operatorType, children[0]);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.UnaryPostfixFunction:
				return unaryPostfixFunction(children[0], new ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>>((IList<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>>)name));
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryInfixFunction:
				return binaryInfixFunction(children[0], (BinaryInfixFunction)operatorType, children[1]);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.PrefixFunction:
				if (name != null)
				{
					return prefixFunction(((string)name).AsLeft(), GetChildren());
				}
				return prefixFunction(((PrefixFunction)operatorType).AsRight(), GetChildren());
			case CriteriaExpressionType.Group:
				return group((operatorType == -1) ? ((GroupOperatorType?)null) : new GroupOperatorType?((GroupOperatorType)operatorType), GetChildren());
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryFunctionWithPrefix:
				return binaryFunctionWithPrefix((BinaryFunctionWithPrefix)operatorType, children[0], children[1]);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryFunctionWithSuffix:
				return binaryFunctionWithSuffix((BinaryFunctionWithSuffix)operatorType, children[0], children[1]);
			case CriteriaExpressionType.TernaryFunction:
				return ternaryFunction(children[0], (TernaryFunction)operatorType, children[1], children[2]);
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		public T AsBinaryFunctionWithSuffix<T>(Func<BinaryFunctionWithSuffix, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> binaryFunction, Func<T> other = null)
		{
			if (type == CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryFunctionWithSuffix)
			{
				return binaryFunction((BinaryFunctionWithSuffix)operatorType, children[0], children[1]);
			}
			return InvokeOrThrow(other);
		}

		public T AsTernaryFunction<T>(Func<FilteringPanelCriteria, TernaryFunction, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria, T> ternaryFunction, Func<T> other = null)
		{
			if (type == CriteriaExpressionType.TernaryFunction)
			{
				return ternaryFunction(children[0], (TernaryFunction)operatorType, children[1], children[2]);
			}
			return InvokeOrThrow(other);
		}

		public T AsPrefixFunction<T>(Func<Either<string, PrefixFunction>, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria>, T> prefixFunction, Func<T> other = null)
		{
			if (type == CriteriaExpressionType.PrefixFunction)
			{
				if (name != null)
				{
					return prefixFunction(((string)name).AsLeft(), GetChildren());
				}
				return prefixFunction(((PrefixFunction)operatorType).AsRight(), GetChildren());
			}
			return InvokeOrThrow(other);
		}

		private static T InvokeOrThrow<T>(Func<T> other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return other();
		}

		public void Match(Action<string> property, Action<object> value, Action<GroupOperatorType?, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria>> group, Action<FilteringPanelOperator, FilteringPanelCriteria> unaryOperator, Action<FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelOperator, FilteringPanelCriteria> binaryOperator, Action<FilteringPanelCriteria, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>>> unaryPostfixFunction, Action<FilteringPanelCriteria, BinaryInfixFunction, FilteringPanelCriteria> binaryInfixFunction, Action<BinaryFunctionWithPrefix, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria> binaryFunctionWithPrefix, Action<BinaryFunctionWithSuffix, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria> binaryFunctionWithSuffix, Action<FilteringPanelCriteria, TernaryFunction, FilteringPanelCriteria, FilteringPanelCriteria> ternaryFunction, Action<Either<string, PrefixFunction>, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria>> prefixFunction)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case CriteriaExpressionType.Property:
				property((string)name);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.Value:
				value(name);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryOperator:
				binaryOperator(children[0], (FilteringPanelOperator)operatorType, children[1]);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.UnaryOperator:
				unaryOperator((FilteringPanelOperator)operatorType, children[0]);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.UnaryPostfixFunction:
				unaryPostfixFunction(children[0], new ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>>((IList<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>>)name));
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryInfixFunction:
				binaryInfixFunction(children[0], (BinaryInfixFunction)operatorType, children[1]);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.Group:
				group((operatorType == -1) ? ((GroupOperatorType?)null) : new GroupOperatorType?((GroupOperatorType)operatorType), GetChildren());
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.PrefixFunction:
				if (name == null)
				{
					prefixFunction(((PrefixFunction)operatorType).AsRight(), GetChildren());
				}
				else
				{
					prefixFunction(((string)name).AsLeft(), GetChildren());
				}
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryFunctionWithPrefix:
				binaryFunctionWithPrefix((BinaryFunctionWithPrefix)operatorType, children[0], children[1]);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.BinaryFunctionWithSuffix:
				binaryFunctionWithSuffix((BinaryFunctionWithSuffix)operatorType, children[0], children[1]);
				break;
			case CriteriaExpressionType.TernaryFunction:
				ternaryFunction(children[0], (TernaryFunction)operatorType, children[1], children[2]);
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}
	}

		public static Variant<PrefixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction, TernaryFunction, FilteringPanelOperator> FilteringPanel(ConditionFilterType filterType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)filterType)
			{
			case 8:
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			case 9:
			case 11:
				return PrefixFunction.Top;
			case 10:
			case 12:
				return PrefixFunction.Bottom;
			case 13:
				return UnaryPostfixFunction.AboveAverage;
			case 14:
				return UnaryPostfixFunction.BelowAverage;
			case 15:
				return UnaryPostfixFunction.Unique;
			case 16:
				return UnaryPostfixFunction.Duplicate;
			case 2:
				return TernaryFunction.Between;
			case 0:
				return FilteringPanelOperator.Equal;
			case 5:
				return FilteringPanelOperator.Greater;
			case 6:
				return FilteringPanelOperator.GreaterOrEqual;
			case 4:
				return FilteringPanelOperator.Less;
			case 7:
				return FilteringPanelOperator.LessOrEqual;
			case 3:
				return TernaryFunction.NotBetween;
			case 1:
				return FilteringPanelOperator.NotEqual;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		private static CustomUnaryPostfixFunction? AsCustomUnaryPostfixFunction(string functionName)
		{
			if (functionName.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = functionName[0] == '$';
			if (flag)
			{
				functionName = functionName.Substring(1);
			}
			if (functionName.Length <= 2 || !char.IsUpper(functionName[2]))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (functionName.Length > 5 && char.IsUpper(functionName[5]) && functionName.StartsWith("IsNot"))
			{
				return new CustomUnaryPostfixFunction(CustomUnaryPostfixFunctionKind.IsNot, functionName.Substring(5), flag);
			}
			if (functionName.StartsWith("Is"))
			{
				return new CustomUnaryPostfixFunction(CustomUnaryPostfixFunctionKind.Is, functionName.Substring(2), flag);
			}
			if (functionName.StartsWith("To"))
			{
				return new CustomUnaryPostfixFunction(CustomUnaryPostfixFunctionKind.To, functionName.Substring(2), flag);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static FilteringPanelCriteria ToFilteringPanelCriteria(this CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			return criteria.Accept<FilteringPanelCriteria>((ICriteriaVisitor<FilteringPanelCriteria>)(object)FilteringPanelCriteriaFactory.Instance);
		}

			{
				return FilteringPanelCriteria.Group((GroupOperatorType)0, operands_);
			}
			var list2 = (from x in list.Select(delegate(FilteringPanelCriteria lower)
				{

					FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria2 = upperBounds.Where((FilteringPanelCriteria x) => x.AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => l) == testExpr).FirstOrDefault();
					return (!(filteringPanelCriteria2 == null)) ? new
					{
						lower = lower,
						upper = filteringPanelCriteria2
					} : null;
				})
				where x != null
				select x).ToList();
			if (list2.Count == 0)
			{
				return FilteringPanelCriteria.Group((GroupOperatorType)0, operands_);
			}
			List<FilteringPanelCriteria> list3 = operands_.ToList();
			foreach (var item in list2)
			{
				list3.Remove(item.upper);
				FilteringPanelCriteria argument = item.lower.AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => r);
				FilteringPanelCriteria argument2 = item.upper.AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => r);
				list3[list3.IndexOf(item.lower)] = FilteringPanelCriteria.TernaryFunction(item.lower.AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => l), TernaryFunction.Between, argument, argument2).Simplify();
			}
			FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria = FilteringPanelCriteria.Group((GroupOperatorType)0, list3.Distinct());
			ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> children = filteringPanelCriteria.GetChildren();
			if (children.Count == 1)
			{
				return children[0];
			}
			return filteringPanelCriteria;
		}

		private static FilteringPanelCriteria SimplifyOrGroup(List<FilteringPanelCriteria> operands)
		{
			Dictionary<FilteringPanelCriteria, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<FilteringPanelCriteria, int>();
			Dictionary<FilteringPanelCriteria, int> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<FilteringPanelCriteria, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < operands.Count; i++)
			{
				FilteringPanelCriteria operand = operands[i];
				FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria = operand.AsUnaryPostfixFunction((FilteringPanelCriteria a, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> _) => a, () => (FilteringPanelCriteria)null);
				if (filteringPanelCriteria != null)
				{
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(filteringPanelCriteria, out var value))
					{
						ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> source = operand.AsUnaryPostfixFunction((FilteringPanelCriteria _, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> o) => o);
						ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> function = operands[value].AsUnaryPostfixFunction((FilteringPanelCriteria _, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> g) => g);
						operands[value] = FilteringPanelCriteria.UnaryPostfixFunction(filteringPanelCriteria, function.Concat(source.Where((Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction> x) => !function.Contains(x))));
						operands[i] = null;
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(filteringPanelCriteria, i);
					}
					continue;
				}
				FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria2 = operand.AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria _) => (o != FilteringPanelOperator.Equal) ? null : l, () => operand.AsBinaryInfixFunction((FilteringPanelCriteria l, BinaryInfixFunction o, FilteringPanelCriteria _) => (o != BinaryInfixFunction.In) ? null : l, () => (FilteringPanelCriteria)null));
				if (!(filteringPanelCriteria2 != null))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (dictionary2.TryGetValue(filteringPanelCriteria2, out var addTo))
				{
					IEnumerable<FilteringPanelCriteria> second = operand.AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => r.Yield(), () => operand.AsBinaryInfixFunction((FilteringPanelCriteria l, BinaryInfixFunction o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => r.GetChildren()));
					IEnumerable<FilteringPanelCriteria> first = operands[addTo].AsBinaryOperator((FilteringPanelCriteria l, FilteringPanelOperator o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => r.Yield(), () => operands[addTo].AsBinaryInfixFunction((FilteringPanelCriteria l, BinaryInfixFunction o, FilteringPanelCriteria r) => r.GetChildren()));
					List<FilteringPanelCriteria> list = first.Concat(second).Distinct().ToList();
					operands[addTo] = ((list.Count == 1) ? FilteringPanelCriteria.BinaryOperator(filteringPanelCriteria2, FilteringPanelOperator.Equal, list[0]) : FilteringPanelCriteria.BinaryInfixFunction(filteringPanelCriteria2, BinaryInfixFunction.In, FilteringPanelCriteria.Group(null, list)));
					operands[i] = null;
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary2.Add(filteringPanelCriteria2, i);
				}
			}
			FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria3 = FilteringPanelCriteria.Group((GroupOperatorType)1, operands.Where((FilteringPanelCriteria x) => x != null));
			ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> children = filteringPanelCriteria3.GetChildren();
			if (children.Count != 1)
			{
				return filteringPanelCriteria3;
			}
			return children[0];
		}
	}
	internal static class FilteringPanelCriteriaAssignColumnsActions
	{
		private struct CriteriaAffiliation
		{
			public string SelfColumnName;

			public string ChildrenColumnName;
		}

		private enum CriteriaProperties
		{
			None,
			AllChildrenHaveSameFormat,
			AllChildrenAndResultHaveSameFormat
		}

		public static FilteringPanelCriteria AssignColumns(this FilteringPanelCriteria criteria, List<string> columnNames)
		{
			List<CriteriaAffiliation> criteriaAffiliations = new List<CriteriaAffiliation>();
			criteria = criteria.PrepareAssignColumns(criteriaAffiliations);
			return criteria.AssignColumnsCore(criteriaAffiliations, columnNames, null);
		}

		private static FilteringPanelCriteria AssignColumnsCore(this FilteringPanelCriteria criteria, List<CriteriaAffiliation> criteriaAffiliations, List<string> columnNames, string columnName)
		{
			columnName = ((criteria.Id < 0) ? null : criteriaAffiliations[criteria.Id].SelfColumnName) ?? columnName;
			int id;
			if (columnName != null)
			{
				id = columnNames.Count;
				columnNames.Add(columnName);
			}
			else
			{
				id = -1;
			}
			string childrenColumnName = ((criteria.Id < 0) ? null : criteriaAffiliations[criteria.Id].ChildrenColumnName);
			CriteriaProperties criteriaProperties = criteria.Properties();
			if (criteriaProperties == CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenAndResultHaveSameFormat)
			{
				childrenColumnName = childrenColumnName ?? columnName;
			}
			return criteria.Change((FilteringPanelCriteria child) => child.AssignColumnsCore(criteriaAffiliations, columnNames, childrenColumnName), id);
		}

		private static CriteriaProperties Properties(this FilteringPanelCriteria criteria)
		{
			return criteria.Match((string property) => CriteriaProperties.None, (object value) => CriteriaProperties.None, (GroupOperatorType? @operator, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> operands) => @operator.HasValue ? CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenHaveSameFormat : CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenAndResultHaveSameFormat, (FilteringPanelOperator @operator, FilteringPanelCriteria operand) => CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenAndResultHaveSameFormat, (FilteringPanelCriteria left, FilteringPanelOperator @operator, FilteringPanelCriteria right) => (@operator != FilteringPanelOperator.Plus && @operator != FilteringPanelOperator.Minus) ? CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenHaveSameFormat : CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenAndResultHaveSameFormat, (FilteringPanelCriteria argument, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> function) => CriteriaProperties.None, (FilteringPanelCriteria left, BinaryInfixFunction function, FilteringPanelCriteria right) => (function == BinaryInfixFunction.In || function == BinaryInfixFunction.NotIn) ? CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenHaveSameFormat : CriteriaProperties.None, (BinaryFunctionWithPrefix function, FilteringPanelCriteria arg1, FilteringPanelCriteria arg2) => CriteriaProperties.None, (BinaryFunctionWithSuffix function, FilteringPanelCriteria arg1, FilteringPanelCriteria arg2) => CriteriaProperties.None, (FilteringPanelCriteria arg1_, TernaryFunction function, FilteringPanelCriteria arg2_, FilteringPanelCriteria arg3_) => CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenHaveSameFormat, (Either<string, PrefixFunction> function, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> arguments_) => CriteriaProperties.None);
		}

		private static FilteringPanelCriteria PrepareAssignColumns(this FilteringPanelCriteria criteria, List<CriteriaAffiliation> criteriaAffiliations)
		{
			FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria = criteria.AsProperty(delegate(string property)
			{
				FilteringPanelCriteria result = FilteringPanelCriteria.Property(property, criteriaAffiliations.Count);
				criteriaAffiliations.Add(new CriteriaAffiliation
				{
					SelfColumnName = property
				});
				return result;
			}, () => (FilteringPanelCriteria)null);
			if (filteringPanelCriteria != null)
			{
				return filteringPanelCriteria;
			}
			criteria = criteria.Change((FilteringPanelCriteria child) => child.PrepareAssignColumns(criteriaAffiliations));
			CriteriaProperties criteriaProperties = criteria.Properties();
			if (criteriaProperties == CriteriaProperties.None)
			{
				return criteria;
			}
			string text = (from x in criteria.GetChildren()
				select x.Id into x
				where x >= 0
				select criteriaAffiliations[x].SelfColumnName into x
				where x != null
				select x).FirstOrDefault();
			if (text != null)
			{
				criteria = criteria.Change((Action<FilteringPanelCriteria[]>)null, criteriaAffiliations.Count);
				criteriaAffiliations.Add(new CriteriaAffiliation
				{
					SelfColumnName = ((criteriaProperties == CriteriaProperties.AllChildrenAndResultHaveSameFormat) ? text : null),
					ChildrenColumnName = text
				});
			}
			return criteria;
		}
	}

		private static string SpreadWords(this string s)
		{
			List<int> list = (from i in s.Select((char c, int i) => (!char.IsUpper(c)) ? (-1) : i)
				where i > 0
				select i).ToList();
			list.Add(s.Length);
			int num = list[0];
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder((num < s.Length) ? s.Remove(num) : s);
			foreach (int item in list.Skip(1))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(' ');
				stringBuilder.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(s[num]));
				stringBuilder.Append(s.Substring(num + 1, item - num - 1));
				num = item;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

	internal static class FilteringPanelFilterPresenterLayout
	{
		private struct LineInfo
		{
			public double Y;

			public double Height;

			public int From;

			public int To;
		}

		private static readonly System.Windows.Size InfiniteSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);

		public static System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(int maxLineCount, double lineSpace, Thickness extraPadding, double addExtraPaddingIfHeightLesserThan, IList<FilteringPanelElementPadding> children, System.Windows.Size availableSize, out bool isTrimmed, out int actualLineCount)
		{
			isTrimmed = false;
			if (children.Count == 0)
			{
				actualLineCount = 0;
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			children[0].Measure(InfiniteSize);
			double num = children[0].Padding.Right;
			double num2 = 0.0 - children[0].Padding.Left + children[0].DesiredSize.Width - num;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = children[0].DesiredSize.Height;
			double val = 0.0;
			int num5 = 0;
			actualLineCount = 1;
			int i;
			for (i = 1; i < children.Count; i++)
			{
				FilteringPanelElementPadding filteringPanelElementPadding = children[i];
				filteringPanelElementPadding.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				filteringPanelElementPadding.Measure(InfiniteSize);
				double right = filteringPanelElementPadding.Padding.Right;
				double num6 = filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Width - right;
				double num7 = num2 + num + num6;
				num = right;
				if (num7 > availableSize.Width)
				{
					isTrimmed = actualLineCount == 1;
					num5++;
					if (num5 == maxLineCount)
					{
						if (maxLineCount == 1)
						{
							num4 = Math.Max(num4, filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Height);
							num2 = num7;
						}
						else
						{
							filteringPanelElementPadding.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						}
						i++;
						break;
					}
					actualLineCount++;
					isTrimmed = false;
					num3 += lineSpace + num4;
					val = Math.Max(val, num2);
					num4 = filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Height;
					num2 = 0.0 - filteringPanelElementPadding.Padding.Left + num6;
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Height);
					num2 = num7;
				}
			}
			for (; i < children.Count; i++)
			{
				FilteringPanelElementPadding filteringPanelElementPadding2 = children[i];
				filteringPanelElementPadding2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			double num8 = num3 + num4;
			if (num8 < addExtraPaddingIfHeightLesserThan)
			{
				num8 += extraPadding.Top + extraPadding.Bottom;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(val, num2), num8);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(int maxLineCount, double lineSpace, Thickness extraPadding, double addExtraPaddingIfHeightLesserThan, IList<FilteringPanelElementPadding> children, System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (children.Count == 0)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			double num = children[0].Padding.Right;
			double num2 = 0.0 - children[0].Padding.Left + children[0].DesiredSize.Width - num;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = children[0].DesiredSize.Height;
			int num5 = 0;
			int num6 = 0;
			int i = 1;
			List<LineInfo> list = new List<LineInfo>(maxLineCount);
			for (; i < children.Count; i++)
			{
				FilteringPanelElementPadding filteringPanelElementPadding = children[i];
				if (filteringPanelElementPadding.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					break;
				}
				double right = filteringPanelElementPadding.Padding.Right;
				double num7 = filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Width - right;
				double num8 = num2 + num + num7;
				num = right;
				if (num8 > finalSize.Width)
				{
					num5++;
					if (num5 == maxLineCount)
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(new LineInfo
					{
						Y = num3,
						Height = num4,
						From = num6,
						To = i
					});
					num3 += lineSpace + num4;
					num6 = i;
					num4 = filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Height;
					num2 = 0.0 - filteringPanelElementPadding.Padding.Left + num7;
				}
				else
				{
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Height);
					num2 = num8;
				}
			}
			list.Add(new LineInfo
			{
				Y = num3,
				Height = num4,
				From = num6,
				To = i
			});
			double num9 = num3 + num4;
			Thickness thickness = ((num9 < addExtraPaddingIfHeightLesserThan) ? extraPadding : default(Thickness));
			foreach (LineInfo item in list)
			{
				ArrangeLine(children, thickness.Top + item.Y, item.Height, item.From, item.To);
			}
			for (int j = i; j < children.Count; j++)
			{
				if (children[j].Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					children[j].Arrange(default(Rect));
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(finalSize.Width, thickness.Top + num9 + thickness.Bottom);
		}

		private static void ArrangeLine(IList<FilteringPanelElementPadding> children, double y, double lineHeight, int lineStart, int lineEnd)
		{
			double num = 0.0 - children[lineStart].Padding.Left;
			for (int i = lineStart; i < lineEnd; i++)
			{
				FilteringPanelElementPadding filteringPanelElementPadding = children[i];
				filteringPanelElementPadding.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num, y), new System.Windows.Size(filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Width, lineHeight)));
				num += filteringPanelElementPadding.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
		}
	}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			bool isTrimmedCore = IsTrimmedCore;
			int actualLineCountCore = ActualLineCountCore;
			bool isTrimmedVerticalCore = IsTrimmedVerticalCore;
			System.Windows.Size result = FilteringPanelFilterPresenterLayout.MeasureOverride(MaxLineCount, LineSpace, ExtraPadding, AddExtraPaddingIfHeightLesserThan, children, availableSize, out IsTrimmedCore, out ActualLineCountCore);
			if (isTrimmedCore != IsTrimmedCore)
			{
				ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					IsTrimmed = IsTrimmedCore;
				});
			}
			if (actualLineCountCore != ActualLineCountCore)
			{
				ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					ActualLineCount = ActualLineCountCore;
				});
			}
			IsTrimmedVerticalCore = ActualLineCountCore > 1 && children.Any((FilteringPanelElementPadding x) => x.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed);
			if (isTrimmedVerticalCore != IsTrimmedVerticalCore)
			{
				ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					IsTrimmedVertical = IsTrimmedVerticalCore;
				});
			}
			return result;
		}

		}

		private void UpdateColumn(string columnName)
		{
			FilteringUIContext context = Context;
			if (context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FilteringPanelContentElement item in columnDependentElements.Where((FilteringPanelContentElement x) => x.ColumnName == columnName))
			{
				item.UpdateContent(item, context);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateChildren()
		{
			FilteringUIContext context = Context;
			if (context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FilterInfo filterInfo = context.Split(Filter);
			var list = filterInfo.Columns.Select(delegate(string fieldName, int fieldIndex)
			{
				FilteringColumn column = context.GetColumn(fieldName);
				return (column != null) ? new
				{
					name = column.Name,
					visibleIndex = column.VisibleIndex
				} : new
				{
					name = fieldName,
					visibleIndex = fieldIndex
				};
			}).ToList();
			list.Sort((x, y) => x.visibleIndex.CompareTo(y.visibleIndex));
			columnDependentElements.Clear();
			List<FilteringPanelElementPadding> list2 = children;
			children = filterInfo.Build(list.Select(x => x.name), delegate(string columnName, CriteriaOperator criteria)
			{
				FilteringPanelCriteria filteringPanelCriteria = criteria.ToFilteringPanelCriteria().Simplify();
				if (filteringPanelCriteria.AsValue((object x) => x is bool && (bool)x, () => false))
				{
					return (IEnumerable<FilteringPanelElementPadding>)null;
				}
				List<string> columnNames = new List<string>();
				filteringPanelCriteria = filteringPanelCriteria.AssignColumns(columnNames);
				List<UIElement> list3 = Bracket(Criteria(filteringPanelCriteria, new CriteriaContext(context, columnNames, columnDependentElements))).Items.ToList();
				if (list3.Count == 0)
				{
					return (IEnumerable<FilteringPanelElementPadding>)null;
				}
				FilteringPanelDeleteButtonElement filteringPanelDeleteButtonElement = new FilteringPanelDeleteButtonElement
				{
					Content = list3[list3.Count - 1],
					DeleteCommand = ((columnName == null) ? DeleteComplexFilterCommand : DeleteColumnFilterCommand),
					DeleteCommandParameter = columnName
				};
				list3[list3.Count - 1] = filteringPanelDeleteButtonElement;
				for (int num = 0; num < list3.Count; num++)
				{
					list3[num] = new FilteringPanelElementPadding
					{
						Content = list3[num],
						AddExtraPadding = (num == 0),
						AllowDeleteColumnFilters = AllowDeleteColumnFilters,
						AssociatedDeleteButton = filteringPanelDeleteButtonElement
					};
				}
				return list3.Cast<FilteringPanelElementPadding>();
			}, (IEnumerable<IEnumerable<FilteringPanelElementPadding>> f) => f.Where((IEnumerable<FilteringPanelElementPadding> x) => x != null).InsertDelimiter(() => new FilteringPanelElementPadding
			{
				Content = new FilteringPanelTextElement
				{
					AddExtraPadding = false,
					Text = EditorLocalizer.Active.GetLocalizedString((EditorStringId)122)
				}
			}.Yield()).SelectMany((IEnumerable<FilteringPanelElementPadding> x) => x)
				.ToList());
			foreach (FilteringPanelElementPadding item in list2)
			{
				RemoveVisualChild(item);
				RemoveLogicalChild(item);
			}
			foreach (FilteringPanelElementPadding child in children)
			{
				AddVisualChild(child);
				AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void UpdateAllowDeleteColumnFiltersForChildren()
		{
			List<FilteringPanelElementPadding> list = children;
			if (list != null && list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FilteringPanelElementPadding child in children)
			{
				child.AllowDeleteColumnFilters = AllowDeleteColumnFilters;
			}
		}

		private static Expression Criteria(FilteringPanelCriteria criteria, CriteriaContext context)
		{
			return criteria.Match(delegate(string property)
			{
				FilteringPanelContentElement filteringPanelContentElement = new FilteringPanelContentElement
				{
					ColumnName = property,
					ElementType = FilteringPanelContentElementType.Property,
					UpdateContent = delegate(FilteringPanelContentElement e, FilteringUIContext c)
					{
						HeaderAppearance headerAppearance = c.GetVisualColumn(property)?.GetHeaderAppearance();
						e.Content = ((headerAppearance == null) ? property : headerAppearance.Content);
						e.ContentTemplateSelector = headerAppearance?.Selector;
					}
				};
				filteringPanelContentElement.UpdateContent(filteringPanelContentElement, context.FilteringContext);
				context.ColumnDependentElements.Add(filteringPanelContentElement);
				return new Expression(filteringPanelContentElement.Yield(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
			}, delegate(object value)
			{
				string columnName = ((criteria.Id < 0) ? null : context.ColumnNames[criteria.Id]);
				FilteringPanelContentElement filteringPanelContentElement = new FilteringPanelContentElement
				{
					ColumnName = columnName,
					ElementType = FilteringPanelContentElementType.Value,
					UpdateContent = delegate(FilteringPanelContentElement e, FilteringUIContext c)
					{
						VisualFilteringColumn visualFilteringColumn = ((columnName == null) ? null : c.GetVisualColumn(columnName));
						e.Content = ((visualFilteringColumn == null) ? value : visualFilteringColumn.GetDisplayText(value));
					}
				};
				filteringPanelContentElement.UpdateContent(filteringPanelContentElement, context.FilteringContext);
				context.ColumnDependentElements.Add(filteringPanelContentElement);
				return new Expression(filteringPanelContentElement.Yield(), 0, 0, 0, 0);
			}, (GroupOperatorType? @operator, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> operands) => Group(@operator, @operator.HasValue ? Precedence(@operator.Value) : 0, operands.Select((FilteringPanelCriteria x) => Criteria(x, context))), (FilteringPanelOperator @operator, FilteringPanelCriteria operand) => UnaryOperator(@operator, Criteria(operand, context)), (FilteringPanelCriteria left, FilteringPanelOperator @operator, FilteringPanelCriteria right) => BinaryOperator(Criteria(left, context), @operator, Criteria(right, context)), (FilteringPanelCriteria argument, ReadOnlyCollection<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> function) => UnaryPostfixFunctionExpression(Criteria(argument, context), function), (FilteringPanelCriteria left, BinaryInfixFunction function, FilteringPanelCriteria right) => BinaryInfixFunctionExpression(Criteria(left, context), function, Criteria(right, context)), (BinaryFunctionWithPrefix function, FilteringPanelCriteria arg1, FilteringPanelCriteria arg2) => BinaryFunctionWithPrefixExpression(function, Criteria(arg1, context), Criteria(arg2, context)), (BinaryFunctionWithSuffix function, FilteringPanelCriteria arg1, FilteringPanelCriteria arg2) => BinaryFunctionWithSuffixExpression(function, Criteria(arg1, context), Criteria(arg2, context)), (FilteringPanelCriteria arg1, TernaryFunction function, FilteringPanelCriteria arg2, FilteringPanelCriteria arg3) => TernaryFunctionExpression(Criteria(arg1, context), function, Criteria(arg2, context), Criteria(arg3, context)), (Either<string, PrefixFunction> function, ReadOnlyCollection<FilteringPanelCriteria> arguments) => PrefixFunctionExpression(function, arguments.Select((FilteringPanelCriteria x) => Criteria(x, context)).ToList()));
		}

		private static Expression Group(GroupOperatorType? operatorType, int precedence, IEnumerable<Expression> operands)
		{
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<Expression> list = operands.Select((Expression x) => BracketIfNeed(x, precedence)).ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new Expression(EmptyArray<UIElement>.Instance, 0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			IEnumerable<IEnumerable<UIElement>> source = list.Select((Expression x) => x.Items);
			if (operatorType.HasValue)
			{
				string delimiter = operatorType.Value.DisplayName();
				source = source.InsertDelimiter(() => new FilteringPanelTextElement
				{
					Text = delimiter
				}.Yield());
			}
			return new Expression(source.SelectMany((IEnumerable<UIElement> x) => x), precedence, list.Aggregate(0, (int m, Expression x) => Math.Max(m, x.Nesting)), list[0].HeadNesting, list[list.Count - 1].TailNesting);
		}

		private static Expression Bracket(Expression expression)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = expression.Items.ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return new Expression(new FilteringPanelBracketPairElement
				{
					Content = list[0]
				}.Yield(), 0, expression.Nesting + 1, expression.Nesting + 1, expression.Nesting + 1);
			}
			return new Expression(new FilteringPanelBracketElement
			{
				HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
				Content = list[0],
				Level = 1 + expression.Nesting - expression.HeadNesting
			}.Yield().Concat(list.Skip(1).Take(list.Count - 2)).Concat(new FilteringPanelBracketElement
			{
				HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
				Content = list[list.Count - 1],
				Level = 1 + expression.Nesting - expression.TailNesting
			}.Yield()), 0, expression.Nesting + 1, expression.Nesting + 1, expression.Nesting + 1);
		}

		private static Expression UnaryOperator(FilteringPanelOperator operatorType, Expression expression)
		{
			List<UIElement> second = expression.Items.ToList();
			return new Expression(new FilteringPanelOperatorElement
			{
				OperatorType = operatorType
			}.Yield().Concat(second), 2, expression.Nesting, expression.HeadNesting, expression.TailNesting);
		}

		private static Expression BracketIfNeed(Expression expression, int precedence)
		{
			if (expression.Precedence > precedence)
			{
				return Bracket(expression);
			}
			return expression;
		}

		private static Expression BinaryOperator(Expression left, FilteringPanelOperator operatorType, Expression right)
		{
			return Infix(new FilteringPanelOperatorElement
			{
				OperatorType = operatorType
			}, Precedence(operatorType), left, right);
		}

		private static Expression BinaryInfixFunctionExpression(Expression left, BinaryInfixFunction functionType, Expression right)
		{
			FilteringPanelTextElementType elementType;
			switch (functionType)
			{
			case BinaryInfixFunction.Like:
			case BinaryInfixFunction.NotLike:
			case BinaryInfixFunction.In:
			case BinaryInfixFunction.NotIn:
			case BinaryInfixFunction.Aggregate:
				elementType = FilteringPanelTextElementType.Standard;
				break;
			default:
				elementType = FilteringPanelTextElementType.Highlighted;
				break;
			}
			return Infix(new FilteringPanelTextElement
			{
				Text = functionType.DisplayName(),
				ElementType = elementType
			}, 4, left, right);
		}

		private static Expression PrefixFunctionExpression(Either<string, PrefixFunction> functionType, IList<Expression> arguments)
		{
			FilteringPanelTextElement filteringPanelTextElement = new FilteringPanelTextElement();
			filteringPanelTextElement.Text = functionType.Match(FilteringPanelCriteriaDisplayActions.CustomPrefixFunctionDisplayName, (PrefixFunction x) => x.DisplayName());
			filteringPanelTextElement.ElementType = FilteringPanelTextElementType.Highlighted;
			return Prefix(filteringPanelTextElement, arguments);
		}

		private static Expression UnaryPostfixFunctionExpression(Expression argument, IEnumerable<Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction>> functionType)
		{
			return Postfix(argument, functionType.Select((Either<CustomUnaryPostfixFunction, UnaryPostfixFunction> f) => new FilteringPanelTextElement
			{
				Text = f.Match((CustomUnaryPostfixFunction x) => x.DisplayName(), (UnaryPostfixFunction x) => x.DisplayName()),
				ElementType = FilteringPanelTextElementType.Highlighted
			}));
		}

		private static Expression BinaryFunctionWithPrefixExpression(BinaryFunctionWithPrefix functionType, Expression arg1, Expression arg2)
		{
			arg1 = BracketIfNeed(arg1, 1);
			arg2 = BracketIfNeed(arg2, 1);

			{

		}

		private static Expression BinaryFunctionWithSuffixExpression(BinaryFunctionWithSuffix functionType, Expression arg1, Expression arg2)
		{

		}

		private static Expression TernaryFunctionExpression(Expression arg1, TernaryFunction functionType, Expression arg2, Expression arg3)
		{
			arg1 = BracketIfNeed(arg1, 1);
			arg2 = BracketIfNeed(arg2, 1);

			{

			}.Yield())

		}

		private static Expression Infix(UIElement operatorVisual, int operatorPrecedence, Expression left, Expression right)
		{
			left = BracketIfNeed(left, operatorPrecedence);
			right = BracketIfNeed(right, operatorPrecedence);
			return new Expression(left.Items.Concat(operatorVisual.Yield()).Concat(right.Items), operatorPrecedence, Math.Max(left.Nesting, right.Nesting), left.HeadNesting, right.TailNesting);
		}

		private static Expression Prefix(UIElement functionVisual, IList<Expression> arguments)
		{
			arguments = ((arguments.Count == 1) ? new List<Expression> { BracketIfNeed(arguments[0], 1) } : arguments.Select((Expression x) => BracketIfNeed(x, 0)).ToList());
			return new Expression(functionVisual.Yield().Concat(arguments.SelectMany((Expression x) => x.Items)), 1, ((IEnumerable<Expression>)arguments).Max((Func<Expression, int?>)((Expression x) => x.Nesting)) ?? 0, 0, arguments.LastOrDefault().TailNesting);
		}

		private static Expression Postfix(Expression argument, IEnumerable<UIElement> functionVisual)
		{
			argument = BracketIfNeed(argument, 1);
			return new Expression(argument.Items.Concat(functionVisual), 1, argument.Nesting, argument.HeadNesting, 0);
		}

		private static int Precedence(GroupOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)operatorType != 0)
			{
				return 7;
			}
			return 6;
		}

		private static int Precedence(FilteringPanelOperator operatorType)
		{
			return operatorType switch
			{
				FilteringPanelOperator.Divide => 2, 
				FilteringPanelOperator.Modulo => 2, 
				FilteringPanelOperator.Multiply => 2, 
				FilteringPanelOperator.Plus => 3,

				FilteringPanelOperator.LessOrEqual => 4, 
				FilteringPanelOperator.GreaterOrEqual => 4, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		private object CalcMinMax(IEnumerable valuesEnumerable, bool isMax, SummaryCache<SortedList<object, int>> summaryCache, bool ignoreNullValues)
		{
			summaryCache.Value.Clear();
			summaryCache.NullCount = 0;
			foreach (object item in valuesEnumerable)
			{
				if (!ignoreNullValues || item != null)
				{
					ProcessMinMaxValue(summaryCache, item, isMax, 1, force: true);
				}
			}
			return GetSummaryValue(isMax, summaryCache);
		}

		private void ProcessMinMaxValue(SummaryCache<SortedList<object, int>> summaryCache, object item, bool isMax, int increment, bool force)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				if (!((DataControllerBase)this).SummariesIgnoreNullValues)
				{
					summaryCache.NullCount++;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (summaryCache.Value.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				summaryCache.Value[item] += increment;
				return;
			}
			int index = ((!isMax) ? (summaryCache.Value.Count - 1) : 0);
			if ((force && summaryCache.Value.Count < summaryCache.Value.Capacity) || (summaryCache.Value.Count > 0 && ((Comparer.Default.Compare(summaryCache.Value.Keys[index], item) > 0) ^ isMax)))
			{
				if (summaryCache.Value.Count == summaryCache.Value.Capacity)
				{
					summaryCache.Value.RemoveAt(index);
				}
				summaryCache.Value[item] = increment;
			}
		}

		private object GetSummaryValue(bool isMax, SummaryCache<SortedList<object, int>> summaryCache)
		{
			if (!isMax && summaryCache.NullCount > 0 && !((DataControllerBase)this).SummariesIgnoreNullValues)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (summaryCache.Value.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;

		}

		private object CalcSumOnAdded(object summaryValue, object value, Type type)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return summaryValue;
			}
			if (summaryValue == null)
			{
				summaryValue = 0;
			}
			Type boxedType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(type);
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(boxedType))
			{
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
			{
				long num3 = Convert.ToInt64(summaryValue) + Convert.ToInt64(value);
				return (num3 > int.MaxValue || num3 < int.MinValue) ? num3 : ((int)num3);
			}
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
			{
				ulong num2 = Convert.ToUInt64(summaryValue) + Convert.ToUInt64(value);
				return (num2 > uint.MaxValue) ? num2 : ((uint)num2);
			}
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return Convert.ToDecimal(summaryValue) + Convert.ToDecimal(value);
			case TypeCode.Double:
			{
				double num = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				return Convert.ToDouble(summaryValue) + (double.IsNaN(num) ? 0.0 : num);
			}
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return Convert.ToSingle(summaryValue) + Convert.ToSingle(value);
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (boxedType == typeof(TimeSpan))
				{
					double value2 = ((TimeSpan)summaryValue).TotalMilliseconds + ((TimeSpan)value).TotalMilliseconds;
					return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value2);
				}
				break;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format("The GridControl cannot calculate the {0} summary over {1} values.", "Sum", type.ToString()));
		}

		private object CalcSumOnDeleted(object summaryValue, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return summaryValue;
			}
			Type type = summaryValue.GetType();
			Type boxedType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(type);
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(boxedType))
			{
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
			{
				long num3 = Convert.ToInt64(summaryValue) - Convert.ToInt64(value);
				return (num3 > int.MaxValue || num3 < int.MinValue) ? num3 : ((int)num3);
			}
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
			{
				ulong num2 = Convert.ToUInt64(summaryValue) - Convert.ToUInt64(value);
				return (num2 > uint.MaxValue) ? num2 : ((uint)num2);
			}
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return Convert.ToDecimal(summaryValue) - Convert.ToDecimal(value);
			case TypeCode.Double:
			{
				double num = Convert.ToDouble(value);
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return summaryValue;
				}
				return Convert.ToDouble(summaryValue) - num;
			}
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return Convert.ToSingle(summaryValue) - Convert.ToSingle(value);
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (boxedType == typeof(TimeSpan))
				{
					double value2 = ((TimeSpan)summaryValue).TotalMilliseconds - ((TimeSpan)value).TotalMilliseconds;
					return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value2);
				}
				break;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format("The GridControl cannot calculate the {0} summary over {1} values.", "Sum", type.ToString()));
		}

		private object CalcAverage(object total, int count)
		{
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = total.GetType();
			Type boxedType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(type);
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(boxedType))
			{
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return Convert.ToDecimal(total) / (decimal)count;
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return Convert.ToDecimal(total) / (decimal)count;
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return Convert.ToDecimal(total) / (decimal)count;
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (boxedType == typeof(TimeSpan))
				{
					return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(((TimeSpan)total).TotalMilliseconds / (double)count);
				}

	internal class AsyncOperationWaitHandle
	{
		private bool isInterrupted;

		private readonly List<ManualResetEvent> handlers = new List<ManualResetEvent>();

		public bool IsInterrupted
		{
			get
			{
				return isInterrupted;
			}
			set
			{
				isInterrupted = value;
				if (!value)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ManualResetEvent handler in handlers)
				{
					handler.Set();
				}
			}
		}

		public T Run<T>(Func<ManualResetEvent, T> action)
		{
			ManualResetEvent manualResetEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: true);
			handlers.Add(manualResetEvent);
			return action(manualResetEvent);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AsyncOperationBase<T>
	{
		private readonly GridControl grid;

		protected GridControl Grid => grid;

		protected AsyncOperationWaitHandle WaitHandle => Grid.AsyncWaitHandle;

		protected DataController DataController => Grid.DataController;

		protected virtual T FallbackValue => default(T);

		protected bool IsAsyncServerMode => Grid.DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode;

		protected AsyncOperationBase(GridControl grid)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
		}

		protected bool IsValidOperation()
		{
			if (DataController != null)
			{
				return IsValidOperationCore();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Task<T> RunDataControllerTask(Task<T> task)
		{
			if (IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				task.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				task.RunSynchronously();
			}
			return task;
		}

		public Task<T> GetTask()
		{
			Task<T> task = (IsValidOperation() ? GetTaskCore() : GetDefaultTask());
			return RunDataControllerTask(task);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsValidOperationCore()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected Task<T> GetDefaultTask()
		{
			return new Task<T>(() => FallbackValue);
		}

		protected abstract Task<T> GetTaskCore();
	}
	internal abstract class SingleRowAsyncOperation<T> : AsyncOperationBase<T>
	{
		private readonly Func<T> getValueCallback;

		private bool isLoaded;

		private T result;

		protected T AsyncResult => result;

		protected virtual bool CanCompleteWithoutSynchronization => false;

		protected SingleRowAsyncOperation(GridControl grid, Func<T> getValueCallback)
			: base(grid)
		{
			this.getValueCallback = getValueCallback;
		}

		protected SingleRowAsyncOperation(GridControl grid)
			: base(grid)
		{
		}

		protected override Task<T> GetTaskCore()
		{
			return base.WaitHandle.Run((ManualResetEvent wh) => LoadRowAsyncCore(wh));
		}

		private Task<T> LoadRowAsyncCore(ManualResetEvent localWaitHandle)
		{
			SynchronizationContext uiContext = new DispatcherSynchronizationContext(base.Grid.Dispatcher);
			BeginLoadIfNeeded(localWaitHandle);
			return new Task<T>(delegate
			{
				localWaitHandle.WaitOne();
				if (!isLoaded && base.WaitHandle.IsInterrupted)
				{
					return FallbackValue;
				}
				T result = default(T);
				if (base.IsAsyncServerMode && CanCompleteWithoutSynchronization)
				{
					return GetValueCore();
				}
				uiContext.Send(delegate
				{
					result = GetValueCore();
				}, result);
				return result;
			});
		}

		private void BeginLoadIfNeeded(ManualResetEvent localWaitHandle)
		{
			if (!NeedLoad())
			{
				isLoaded = true;
				return;
			}
			isLoaded = false;
			localWaitHandle.Reset();
			BeginLoadCore(localWaitHandle);
		}

		protected void OnLoaded(ManualResetEvent localWaitHandle, object result)
		{
			isLoaded = true;
			this.result = (T)result;
			localWaitHandle.Set();
		}

		private bool NeedLoad()
		{
			if (base.IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				return NeedLoadCore();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual T GetValueCore()
		{
			return getValueCallback();
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedLoadCore()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract void BeginLoadCore(ManualResetEvent localWaitHandle);
	}

	internal class GetRowsAsyncOperation : AsyncOperationBase<IList>
	{
		private readonly int startFrom;

		private readonly int count;

		private Task<object>[] tasks;

		private int EndRowHandle => startFrom + count - 1;

		public GetRowsAsyncOperation(GridControl grid, int startFrom, int count)
			: base(grid)
		{
			this.count = count;
			this.startFrom = startFrom;
			PopulateTasks();
		}

		private void PopulateTasks()
		{
			if (IsValidOperation())
			{
				tasks = new Task<object>[count];
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					tasks[i] = base.Grid.GetRowAsync(i + startFrom);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Task<IList> GetTaskCore()
		{
			return new Task<IList>(delegate
			{
				Task.WaitAll(tasks);
				List<object> list = tasks.Select((Task<object> t) => t.Result).ToList();
				return (!list.Contains(null)) ? list : null;
			});
		}

		protected override bool IsValidOperationCore()
		{
			if (base.Grid.IsValidRowHandle(startFrom))
			{
				return base.Grid.IsValidRowHandle(EndRowHandle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private bool ShouldShowLoadingRow
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0049: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0057: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (base.InfiniteSource != null)
				{
					if (!((VirtualSourceBase)base.InfiniteSource).AreRowsFetching && ((VirtualSourceBase)base.InfiniteSource).FetchRowsException == null && ((int)base.InfiniteSource.FetchMode != 0 || (int)base.InfiniteSource.RowsFetchState != 4))
					{
						if ((int)base.InfiniteSource.FetchMode == 1)
						{
							return (int)base.InfiniteSource.RowsFetchState != 1;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static DataColumnInfo GetActualColumnInfo(DataController dataController, string fieldName)
		{
			return ((DataControllerBase)dataController).Columns[fieldName] ?? ((DataControllerBase)dataController).DetailColumns[fieldName];
		}

		internal static object GetRowValueByListIndex(DataController dataController, int listIndex, string fieldName)
		{
			DataColumnInfo actualColumnInfo = GetActualColumnInfo(dataController, fieldName);
			return GetRowValueByListIndex(dataController, listIndex, actualColumnInfo);
		}

		internal static object GetRowValueByListIndex(DataController dataController, int listIndex, DataColumnInfo info)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dataController.GetListSourceRowValue(listIndex, info);
		}

		internal static object GetRowByListIndex(DataController dataController, int listSourceRowIndex)
		{
			return dataController.GetRowByListSourceIndex(listSourceRowIndex);
		}

		internal static int GetLevelNextIndex(int index, GroupRowInfoCollection groupInfo)
		{
			int level = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo)[index].Level;
			do
			{
				index++;
			}
			while (index != ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo).Count && ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo)[index].Level > level);
			return index;
		}

		private void InitializeDataController()
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			((DataControllerBase)dataController).ListSourceChanged += OnListSourceChanged;
			((DataController)dataController).CustomSummary += new CustomSummaryEventHandler(OnCustomSummary);
			((DataController)dataController).CustomSummaryExists += new CustomSummaryExistEventHandler(OnCustomSummaryExists);
			((DataController)dataController).SelectionChanged += new SelectionChangedEventHandler(OnSelectionChanged);
			((DataControllerBase)dataController).VisibleRowCountChanged += OnVisibleRowCountChanged;

		private void DestoryDataController()
		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown

			//IL_0066: Expected O, but got Unknown

				((DataController)dataController).SelectionChanged -= new SelectionChangedEventHandler(OnSelectionChanged);

		private void UpdateDataControllerType()
		{
			requiredDataControllerType = DataControllerType.Regular;
			if (IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				requiredDataControllerType = DataControllerType.AsyncServerMode;
			}
			if (IsServerMode)
			{
				if (IsICollectionView && !IsIPagedCollectionView)
				{
					requiredDataControllerType = DataControllerType.CollectionView;
				}
				else
				{
					requiredDataControllerType = DataControllerType.ServerMode;
				}
			}
			if (Owner.OptimizeSummaryCalculation && List is IListChanging)
			{
				requiredDataControllerType = DataControllerType.ChunkList;
			}
		}

		private bool CheckRecreateDataController(bool reset)
		{
			UpdateDataControllerType();
			DataControllerType dataControllerType = DataControllerType.Regular;
			if (dataController is StateServerModeDataController)
			{
				dataControllerType = DataControllerType.ServerMode;
			}
			if (dataController is AsyncServerModeGridDataController)
			{
				dataControllerType = DataControllerType.AsyncServerMode;
			}
			if (dataController is CollectionViewDataController)
			{
				dataControllerType = DataControllerType.CollectionView;
			}
			if (dataController is ChunkListDataController)
			{
				dataControllerType = DataControllerType.ChunkList;
			}
			if (isSynchronizing || reset || dataControllerType != requiredDataControllerType)
			{
				DestoryDataController();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual BaseGridController CreateDataController()
		{
			switch (requiredDataControllerType)
			{
			case DataControllerType.ServerMode:
				return (BaseGridController)(object)new StateServerModeDataController(Owner);
			case DataControllerType.AsyncServerMode:
			{
				AsyncServerModeGridDataController asyncServerModeGridDataController = new AsyncServerModeGridDataController(owner);
				((DataControllerBase)asyncServerModeGridDataController).ThreadClient = (IDataControllerThreadClient)(object)new GridDataControllerThreadClient(this);
				return (BaseGridController)(object)asyncServerModeGridDataController;
			}
			case DataControllerType.CollectionView:
				return (BaseGridController)(object)new CollectionViewDataController(owner);
			case DataControllerType.ChunkList:
				return (BaseGridController)(object)new ChunkListDataController(Owner);
			default:
				return CreateDefaultDataController();
			}
		}

		internal GridServerModeDataControllerPrintInfo SubstituteDataControllerForPrinting(IList printingSource, bool expandAllGroups, Dictionary<int, int> originalRowHandles)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BaseGridController val = CreateDefaultDataController();
			((DataController)val).ByPassFilter = IsServerMode || IsAsyncServerMode;
			((DataControllerBase)val).DataClient = (IDataControllerData)(object)new PrintingDataClient((IDataControllerData2)(object)this, originalRowHandles);
			((DataController)val).CustomSummary += new CustomSummaryEventHandler(OnCustomSummary);
			((DataController)val).CustomSummaryExists += new CustomSummaryExistEventHandler(OnCustomSummaryExists);
			((DataController)val).VisualClient = (IDataControllerVisualClient)(object)new PrintingVisualClient(VisualClient);
			((DataControllerBase)val).SortClient = (IDataControllerSort)(object)this;
			BaseGridController oldDataController = DataController;
			dataController = val;
			bool flag = printingSource.Count != 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				val.DataSource = printingSource;
			}
			((DataControlBase)Owner).UpdateTotalSummary();
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> printingTotalSummaries = GetPrintingTotalSummaries();
			string fixedSummariesLeftString = ((DataControlBase)Owner).viewCore.GetFixedSummariesLeftString();
			string fixedSummariesRightString = ((DataControlBase)Owner).viewCore.GetFixedSummariesRightString();
			if (flag)
			{
				((DataController)val).VisualClient.RequestSynchronization();
			}
			if (expandAllGroups)
			{
				ExpandAll();
			}
			else
			{
				LoadGroupStatesToPrintingController(oldDataController);
			}
			return new GridServerModeDataControllerPrintInfo(val, printingTotalSummaries, fixedSummariesLeftString, fixedSummariesRightString);
		}

		private Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> GetPrintingTotalSummaries()
		{
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, string>();
			DataViewBase view = ((DataControlBase)Owner).viewCore;
			foreach (ColumnBase item in view.DataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (item.TotalSummariesCore.Any((SummaryItemBase x) => view.GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows))
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					foreach (GridTotalSummaryData totalSummary in item.TotalSummaries)
					{
						if (view.GetActualCalculationMode(totalSummary.Item) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
						{
							if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
							{
								stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
							}
							stringBuilder.Append(ColumnBase.GetSummaryText(totalSummary));
						}
					}
					dictionary.Add(item, stringBuilder.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(item, item.TotalSummaryText);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		internal void ClearPrintingControllerEvents(BaseGridController printingController)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((DataController)printingController).CustomSummary -= new CustomSummaryEventHandler(OnCustomSummary);
			((DataController)printingController).CustomSummaryExists -= new CustomSummaryExistEventHandler(OnCustomSummaryExists);
		}

		private void LoadGroupStatesToPrintingController(BaseGridController oldDataController)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			((DataController)oldDataController).SaveRowState((Stream)memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			((DataController)DataController).RestoreRowState((Stream)memoryStream);
		}

		internal override void EnsureAllRowsLoaded(int firstRowIndex, int rowsCount)
		{
			if (!IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = firstRowIndex; i < firstRowIndex + rowsCount; i++)
			{
				object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = VisibleIndicesProvider.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(i);
				if (!(visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey))
				{
					int controllerRowHandle = ((DataController)DataController).GetControllerRowHandle((int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex + VisibleIndicesProvider.PageOffset);
					((DataController)DataController).ScrollingCheckRowLoaded(controllerRowHandle);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnDataSourceChanged(bool reset)
		{
			//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UnsubscribeBindingList();
			list = ExtractDataSource(base.DataSource);
			OnDataSourceExtracted();
			SubscribeBindingList();
			bool isUpdateLocked = ((DataControllerBase)DataController).IsUpdateLocked;
			bool flag = CheckRecreateDataController(reset);
			if (unsubscribeVirtualSourceEvents != null)
			{
				unsubscribeVirtualSourceEvents();
				unsubscribeVirtualSourceEvents = null;
				virtualSourceSortInfo = null;
			}
			if (base.IsVirtualSource)
			{
				unsubscribeVirtualSourceEvents = SubscribeVirtualSourceEvents();
				InfiniteSourceBase infiniteSource = base.InfiniteSource;
				if (infiniteSource != null && (int)infiniteSource.FetchMode == 1)
				{
					base.InfiniteSource.FetchMoreRows();
				}
			}
			if (flag && isUpdateLocked)
			{
				((DataControllerBase)DataController).BeginUpdate();
			}
			if (base.IsPagedSource)
			{
				DataController.KeepFocusedRowOnUpdate = false;
				if ((Owner as DataControlBase)?.viewCore is GridViewBase gridViewBase)
				{
					gridViewBase.SetUninitializedState();
				}
			}
			if (flag && VisualClient != null && List == null && !IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				VisualClient.RequestSynchronization();
			}
			SetInitiallyFocusedRow(val: false);
			InitiallyFocusedRowLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				((BaseListSourceDataController)DataController).SetDataSource((object)List);
			});
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = (Owner as DataControlBase)?.viewCore;
			if (dataViewBase != null && dataViewBase.IsRootView)
			{
				dataViewBase.ClearFreeRowData();
			}
			SetInitiallyFocusedRow(val: true);
			Owner.ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			ScheduleRepopulateColumnsIfNeeded();
			ResetValidationAttributes();
		}

		private Action SubscribeVirtualSourceEvents()
		{
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Func<DataViewBase> getView = () => (Owner as DataControlBase)?.viewCore;
			Action<double> setOffset = delegate
			{
				DataViewBase dataViewBase = getView();
				if (dataViewBase?.DataPresenter != null)
				{
					dataViewBase.DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.DefineSizeScrollInfo.SetOffsetForce(0.0);
				}
			};
			VirtualSourceClient client = new VirtualSourceClient((Action)delegate
			{
				getView()?.UpdateColumnsTotalSummary();
			}, (Func<VisibleRowInfo?>)delegate
			{
				//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				DataRowNode dataRowNode = (DataRowNode)(getView()?.RootNodeContainer?.Items?.LastOrDefault((RowNode x) => !(x is LoadingRowNode)));
				if (dataRowNode == null)
				{
					return (VisibleRowInfo?)null;
				}
				int num = dataRowNode.ControllerValues.VisibleIndex + 1;
				return new VisibleRowInfo(num, num == VisibleCount);
			}, (Action<RowsResetInfo>)delegate(RowsResetInfo info)
			{
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				DataViewBase dataViewBase = getView();
				if (dataViewBase != null)
				{
					if (base.IsPagedSource)
					{
						dataViewBase.ClearSelectionCore();
					}
					if (!info.KeepScrollPosition)
					{
						setOffset(0.0);
					}
				}
			}, (Func<int?>)delegate
			{
				int? num = getView()?.FocusedRowHandle;
				return (num != int.MinValue && num != -2147483645 && num != -2147483647) ? num : ((int?)null);
			}, (Action<int>)delegate(int i)
			{
				getView().Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
				{
					x.FocusedRowHandle = i;
				});
			}, (Action<Action>)delegate(Action action)
			{
				DataViewBase dataViewBase = getView();
				if (dataViewBase != null)
				{
					dataViewBase.ScrollIntoViewLocker.DoLockedAction(action);
				}
				else
				{
					action();
				}
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				getView()?.UpdatePagerControlPageIndex(initFromSource: true);
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateLoadingRow(Owner as DataControlBase, ShouldShowLoadingRow);
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				getView()?.UpdatePagerControlPageSize();
			}, (Func<CriteriaOperator, object>)((CriteriaOperator x) => (Owner as DataControlBase)?.ConvertCriteria(x) ?? x));
			PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChangedHandler = delegate(object o, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				GridControl gridControl = Owner as GridControl;
				if (e.PropertyName == "FetchRowsException")
				{
					if (base.IsPagedSource && VirtualSource.FetchRowsException != null)
					{
						gridControl.UpdateErrorPanel(() => VirtualSource.FetchRowsException.With((Exception x) => x.Message));
					}
					UpdateLoadingRow(gridControl, ShouldShowLoadingRow);
					if (base.InfiniteSource != null)
					{
						gridControl.SetCurrentValue(DataControlBase.ShowLoadingPanelProperty, false);
					}
				}
				if (e.PropertyName == "IsCurrentPageLoading")
				{
					gridControl.SetCurrentValue(DataControlBase.ShowLoadingPanelProperty, base.PagedSource.IsCurrentPageLoading);
				}
				if (e.PropertyName == "AreRowsFetching" || e.PropertyName == "RowsFetchState")
				{

			}

		}

		public override int GetActualRowLevel(int rowHandle, int level)
		{
			if (!((DataControllerBase)DataController).AllowPartialGrouping || IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return level;
			}
			int parentRowHandle = GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle);
			while (parentRowHandle != int.MinValue)
			{
				if (GetChildRowCount(parentRowHandle) == 1)
				{
					level--;
					parentRowHandle = GetParentRowHandle(parentRowHandle);
					continue;
				}
				return level;
			}
			return level;
		}

		internal bool IsGroupVisible(GroupRowInfo groupInfo, int childCount)
		{
			if (((DataControllerBase)DataController).AllowPartialGrouping && childCount <= 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Owner.HasFixedRows)
			{
				if (groupInfo.Level == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Owner.IsRowFixed(groupInfo.ChildControllerRow))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			GroupRowInfo parentGroup = groupInfo.ParentGroup;
			if (parentGroup == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			while (parentGroup != null && (!owner.HasFixedRows || parentGroup.Level != 0))
			{
				if (!parentGroup.Expanded)
				{
					return false;
				}
				parentGroup = parentGroup.ParentGroup;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int GetVisibleRowCount(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			int num = 0;
			GroupRowInfo groupRowInfoByHandle = ((DataController)DataController).GroupInfo.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(groupRowHandle);
			if (groupRowInfoByHandle == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!groupRowInfoByHandle.Expanded)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (((DataController)DataController).GroupInfo.IsLastLevel(groupRowInfoByHandle))
			{
				return groupRowInfoByHandle.ChildControllerRowCount;
			}
			int totalChildrenGroupCount = ((DataController)DataController).GroupInfo.GetTotalChildrenGroupCount(groupRowInfoByHandle);
			for (int i = 0; i < totalChildrenGroupCount; i++)
			{
				GroupRowInfo val = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)((DataController)DataController).GroupInfo)[groupRowInfoByHandle.Index + i + 1];
				if (val.IsVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (val.Expanded && ((DataController)DataController).GroupInfo.IsLastLevel(val))
				{
					num += val.ChildControllerRowCount;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override object GetRowValue(int rowHandle, object row, string fieldName)
		{
			if (row != null && !AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(row) && rowHandle >= 0)
			{
				DataColumnInfo actualColumnInfo = GetActualColumnInfo(fieldName);
				if (actualColumnInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!actualColumnInfo.Unbound)
				{
					try
					{
						return actualColumnInfo.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(row);
					}
					catch (ArgumentException)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			return GetRowValue(rowHandle, fieldName);
		}

		public virtual RowPosition GetRowPosition(int visibleIndex)
		{
			RowPosition rowPosition = RowPosition.Middle;
			if (GetRowLevelByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex) == 0)
			{
				rowPosition = GetRowPosition(visibleIndex, 0, VisibleCount - 1);
			}
			else
			{
				GroupRowInfo parentGroupRow = ((DataController)DataController).GetParentGroupRow(GetControllerRow(visibleIndex));
				int visibleIndex2 = ((DataController)DataController).GetVisibleIndex(parentGroupRow.ChildControllerRow);
				rowPosition = GetRowPosition(visibleIndex, visibleIndex2, visibleIndex2 + parentGroupRow.ChildControllerRowCount - 1);
			}
			return GetRowPositionByCheckingPrevRow(visibleIndex, rowPosition);
		}

		protected RowPosition GetRowPositionByCheckingPrevRow(int visibleIndex, RowPosition rowPosition)
		{
			int rowLevelByVisibleIndex = GetRowLevelByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
			if (rowPosition == RowPosition.Middle && rowLevelByVisibleIndex < ((DataController)DataController).GroupInfo.LevelCount && GetRowLevelByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex - 1) > rowLevelByVisibleIndex)
			{
				return RowPosition.Top;
			}
			return rowPosition;
		}

		protected RowPosition GetRowPosition(int visibleIndex, int startLevelIndex, int endLevelIndex)
		{
			if (startLevelIndex == endLevelIndex)
			{
				return RowPosition.Single;
			}
			if (visibleIndex == startLevelIndex)
			{
				return RowPosition.Top;
			}
			if (visibleIndex == endLevelIndex)
			{
				return RowPosition.Bottom;
			}
			return RowPosition.Middle;
		}
