		internal override void ScheduleAutoPopulateColumns()
		{
			autoPopulateColumns = true;
		}

		private void ScheduleRepopulateColumnsIfNeeded()
		{
			if (IsDataSourceEmpty())
			{
				SetRepopulateColumnsConditions(value: true);
			}
		}

		private void TryRePopulateColumns()
		{
			if (isRepopulateColumnsNeeded && (!IsDataSourceEmpty() || IsAsyncServerMode))
			{
				bool flag = autoPopulateColumns && ShouldTryRepopulateColumns();
				Owner.RePopulateDataControllerColumns();
				if (flag)
				{
					Owner.PopulateColumns();
				}
				SetRepopulateColumnsConditions(value: false);
			}
		}

		private bool IsDataSourceEmpty()
		{
			if (List != null && List.Count == 0 && EditableView != null && EditableView.IsAddingNew)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (List != null)
			{
				return List.Count == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetRepopulateColumnsConditions(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				isRepopulateColumnsNeeded = true;
				isDummySource = false;
				if (((CollectionBase)(object)Columns).Count != 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				Type type = Columns[0].PropertyDescriptor.GetType();
				string[] dummyPropertyDescriptors = DummyPropertyDescriptors;
				foreach (string text in dummyPropertyDescriptors)
				{
					if (type.Name == text)
					{
						isDummySource = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				isRepopulateColumnsNeeded = false;
				isDummySource = false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldTryRepopulateColumns()
		{
			if (!isDummySource)
			{
				return ((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)Owner.GetColumns()).Count == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override int ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(int visibleIndex, bool allowFixedGroups)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = ((Owner.NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.Bottom || visibleIndex != VisibleCount) ? ((DataController)DataController).GetVisibleIndexes().ConvertIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex, allowFixedGroups) : visibleIndex);
			return num - ((DataControlBase)Owner).viewCore.PageOffset + VisibleIndicesProvider.CalcVisibleSummaryRowsCountBeforeRow(visibleIndex, allowFixedGroups);
		}

		internal override int ConvertScrollIndexToVisibleIndex(int scrollIndex, bool allowFixedGroups)
		{
			DataViewBase viewCore = ((DataControlBase)Owner).viewCore;
			if (viewCore == null)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			scrollIndex = VisibleIndicesProvider.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndexSafe(scrollIndex) + ((DataControlBase)Owner).viewCore.PageOffset;
			return ((DataController)DataController).GetVisibleIndexes().ConvertScrollIndexToIndex(scrollIndex, allowFixedGroups);
		}

		public override object GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex)
		{
			return VisibleIndicesProvider.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex);
		}

		internal override int GetSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			return VisibleIndicesProvider.GetCachedSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(rowHandle);
		}

		internal override bool IsSummaryItemExists(SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType, SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			SummaryItemCollection val = (SummaryItemCollection)((collectionType == SummaryItemCollectionType.Total) ? ((object)((DataController)DataController).TotalSummary) : ((object)((DataController)DataController).GroupSummary));
			SummaryItem summaryItemByTag = val.GetSummaryItemByTag((object)item);
			if (summaryItemByTag != null)
			{
				return summaryItemByTag.Exists;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateVisibleItems(ListChangedType changedType, int newRowHandle, int? oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (VisibleItems != null)
			{
				if (changedType == ListChangedType.Reset || changedType == ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded || changedType == ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged || changedType == ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted || (newRowHandle < 0 && oldRowHandle >= 0) || (newRowHandle >= 0 && oldRowHandle < 0))
				{
					UpdateAllVisibleItems();
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateChangedVisibleItems(changedType, newRowHandle, (!oldRowHandle.HasValue) ? int.MinValue : oldRowHandle.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateChangedVisibleItems(ListChangedType changedType, int newRowHandle, int oldRowHandle)
		{
			switch (changedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				if (newRowHandle >= 0)
				{
					if (oldRowHandle != newRowHandle && oldRowHandle >= 0)
					{
						((ObservableCollection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).Move(oldRowHandle, newRowHandle);
					}
					UpdateVisibleItemsItem(newRowHandle);
				}
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				if (newRowHandle >= 0)
				{
					object row = ((DataController)DataController).GetRow(newRowHandle);
					if (row != null)
					{
						((Collection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).Insert(newRowHandle, row);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				if (oldRowHandle >= 0)
				{
					((Collection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).RemoveAt(oldRowHandle);
				}
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
				if (oldRowHandle >= 0)
				{
					((ObservableCollection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).Move(oldRowHandle, newRowHandle);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateAllVisibleItems()
		{
			int visibleListSourceRowCount = ((DataController)DataController).VisibleListSourceRowCount;
			int num = ((Collection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).Count;
			int i = visibleListSourceRowCount - num;
			VisibleItems.BeginUpdate();
			for (int j = 0; j < num + i; j++)
			{
				if (j < num)
				{
					((Collection<object>)(object)VisibleItems)[j] = ((DataController)DataController).GetRow(j);
				}
				else
				{
					((Collection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).Add(((DataController)DataController).GetRow(j));
				}
			}
			for (; i < 0; i++)
			{
				((Collection<object>)(object)VisibleItems).RemoveAt(--num);
			}
			VisibleItems.EndUpdate();
		}

		protected internal override bool? CompareRowKeys(object key1, object key2)
		{
			DataColumnInfo val = Columns[Owner.RestoreStateKeyFieldName];
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return object.Equals(((DataControllerBase)DataController).Helper.GetRowValue(key1, val), ((DataControllerBase)DataController).Helper.GetRowValue(key2, val));
		}

		protected override object GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(int controllerRow, string columnName)
		{
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				return base.GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(controllerRow, columnName);
			}
			if (!(Owner is DataControlBase { viewCore: not null } dataControlBase))
			{
				return base.GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(controllerRow, columnName);
			}
			if (dataControlBase.viewCore.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && controllerRow == dataControlBase.viewCore.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				RowData rowData = dataControlBase.viewCore.GetRowData(dataControlBase.viewCore.FocusedRowHandle);
				GridColumnData cellDataByColumn = rowData.GetCellDataByColumn(dataControlBase.ColumnsCore[columnName]);
				if (cellDataByColumn != null)
				{
					if (cellDataByColumn.Editor == null || ((InplaceEditorBase)cellDataByColumn.Editor).Edit == null)
					{
						return ((EditableDataObject)cellDataByColumn).Value;
					}
					return ((InplaceEditorBase)cellDataByColumn.Editor).Edit.EditValue;
				}
			}
			return base.GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(controllerRow, columnName);
		}

		protected internal override int FindEditingControllerRow()
		{
			if (base.EditingControllerRowObject == null || base.EditingControllerRow == int.MinValue)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (base.EditingControllerRow == -2147483647 || base.EditingControllerRow == -2147483645)
			{
				return base.EditingControllerRow;
			}
			return ((DataController)DataController).FindControllerRowByRowReference(base.EditingControllerRowObject, base.EditingControllerRow);
		}
	}

	{

		protected DataViewBase View => ((DataControlBase)DataProvider.Owner).viewCore;

		protected internal int PageOffset => View.PageOffset;

		protected bool IsBottomNewItemRowVisible => DataProvider.Owner.NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom;

		public bool IsCacheEmpty => CachedRowCount == 0;

		public int CachedRowCount => visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap.Count;

		public bool ShowGroupSummaryFooter
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataProvider.Owner.ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
				{
					return ShowGroupSummaryFooterInternal;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int VisibleGroupSummaryRowCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataProvider.IsServerMode || DataProvider.IsAsyncServerMode)
				{
					return currentSummaryRowCount;
				}
				ValidateVisibleGroupSummaryRowCountCache();
				return cachedVisibleGroupSummaryRowCount;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowGroupSummaryFooterInternal { get; set; }

		public VisibleIndicesProvider(GridDataProvider dataProvider)
		{
			DataProvider = dataProvider;
			ShowGroupSummaryFooterInternal = true;
		}

		public void InvalidateCache()
		{
			isValid = false;
			cachedVisibleGroupSummaryRowCount = -1;
			visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap.Clear();
			groupRowHandleToSummaryRowCountMap.Clear();
		}

		protected void ValidateVisibleGroupSummaryRowCountCache()
		{
			if (cachedVisibleGroupSummaryRowCount < 0)
			{
				cachedVisibleGroupSummaryRowCount = ((IEnumerable<GroupRowInfo>)((DataController)DataProvider.DataController).GroupInfo).Count(delegate(GroupRowInfo info)
				{
					bool isVisible = info.IsVisible;
					return DataProvider.IsGroupVisible(info, DataProvider.GetChildRowCount(info.Handle)) && DataProvider.OnShowingGroupFooter(info.Handle, info.Level);
				});
			}
		}

		public virtual object GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex)
		{
			if (!ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			ValidateCache();
			if (IsCacheEmpty)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			UpdateMaxCacheRowCountIfNeeded(scrollIndex);
			if (scrollIndex >= CachedRowCount)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			return visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[scrollIndex];
		}

		public virtual int GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndexSafe(int scrollIndex)
		{
			if (!ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			ValidateCache();
			if (IsCacheEmpty)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			UpdateMaxCacheRowCountIfNeeded(scrollIndex);
			if (scrollIndex >= CachedRowCount)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			for (int num = scrollIndex; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[num];
				if (obj is int)
				{
					return (int)obj;
				}
			}
			return scrollIndex;
		}

		protected void ValidateCache()
		{
			if (!isValid)
			{
				visibleIndex = (index = 0);
				groupInfoIndex = 0;
				currentSummaryRowCount = 0;
				maxCachedRowCount = 50;
				BuildCache();
				isValid = true;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateMaxCacheRowCountIfNeeded(int requestedScrollIndex)
		{
			if (requestedScrollIndex > maxCachedRowCount)
			{
				maxCachedRowCount = requestedScrollIndex + 20;
				BuildCache();
			}
		}

		private bool IsSingleRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!((DataControllerBase)DataProvider.DataController).AllowPartialGrouping)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int parentRowHandle = DataProvider.GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle);
			return DataProvider.GetChildRowCount(parentRowHandle) == 1;
		}

		protected virtual bool BuildCache()
		{
			GroupRowInfoCollection groupInfo = ((DataController)DataProvider.DataController).GroupInfo;
			if (groupInfoIndex >= ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo).Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (groupInfoIndex < ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo).Count)
			{
				GroupRowInfo val = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo)[groupInfoIndex];
				bool flag = DataProvider.IsGroupVisible(val);
				if (flag)
				{
					visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[index] = visibleIndex;
					visibleIndex++;
					index++;
					groupRowHandleToSummaryRowCountMap[val.Handle] = currentSummaryRowCount;
				}
				if (val.Expanded || !flag)
				{
					if (val.Level == groupInfo.LevelCount - 1)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < val.ChildControllerRowCount; i++)
						{
							visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[index] = visibleIndex;
							visibleIndex++;
							index++;
							if (!flag)
							{
								groupRowHandleToSummaryRowCountMap[val.ChildControllerRow] = currentSummaryRowCount;
							}
						}
					}
					groupInfoIndex++;
				}
				else
				{
					groupInfoIndex = GridDataProvider.GetLevelNextIndex(groupInfoIndex, groupInfo);
				}
				int num = ((groupInfoIndex < ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo).Count) ? ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo)[groupInfoIndex].Level : 0);
				for (int num2 = val.Level; num2 >= num; num2--)
				{
					if (DataProvider.IsGroupVisible(val) && DataProvider.OnShowingGroupFooter(val.Handle, num2))
					{
						visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[index] = new GroupSummaryRowKey(new RowHandle(val.Handle), num2 - (DataProvider.Owner.HasFixedRows ? 1 : 0));
						currentSummaryRowCount++;
						index++;
					}
					val = val.ParentGroup;
				}
				if (CachedRowCount > maxCachedRowCount)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (IsBottomNewItemRowVisible && visibleIndex == DataProvider.VisibleCount)
			{
				visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[index] = visibleIndex;
				groupRowHandleToSummaryRowCountMap[-2147483647] = currentSummaryRowCount;
				visibleIndex++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal int CalcVisibleSummaryRowsCountBeforeRow(int visibleIndex, bool allowFixedGroups)
		{
			if (!ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			ValidateCache();
			if (IsCacheEmpty)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			while (visibleIndex > this.visibleIndex - 1)
			{
				maxCachedRowCount += visibleIndex - this.visibleIndex - 1 + 20;
				if (!BuildCache())
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (IsBottomNewItemRowVisible && visibleIndex == DataProvider.VisibleCount)
			{
				return groupRowHandleToSummaryRowCountMap[-2147483647];
			}
			if (allowFixedGroups)
			{
				int[] scrollableIndexes = ((DataController)DataProvider.DataController).GetVisibleIndexes().ScrollableIndexes;
				int num = visibleIndex;
				foreach (int num2 in scrollableIndexes)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num2, num);
					if (num2 == visibleIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				visibleIndex = num;
			}
			return GetSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(visibleIndex);
		}

		private int GetSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int controllerRow = DataProvider.GetControllerRow(visibleIndex);
			if (DataProvider.IsGroupRowHandle(controllerRow) || IsSingleRow(controllerRow))
			{
				return GetCachedSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(controllerRow);
			}
			return GetCachedSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(DataProvider.GetParentRowHandle(controllerRow));
		}

		internal int GetCachedSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			ValidateCache();
			int value = 0;
			if (rowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				return value;
			}
			while (!groupRowHandleToSummaryRowCountMap.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				maxCachedRowCount += 20;
				BuildCache();
				if (visibleIndex >= DataProvider.VisibleCount)
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	public class DetailInfoCollection : RowStateCollection
	{
		public DetailInfoCollection(RowStateController selectionController)
			: base(selectionController)
		{
		}

		protected override void SetSelectionObject(int? row, object selectionObject)
		{
			((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).SetSelectionObject(row, selectionObject);
			if (selectionObject is RowDetailContainer rowDetailContainer)
			{
				rowDetailContainer.MasterListIndex = row.Value;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> GetRowListIndicesWithExpandedDetails()
		{
			foreach (int? key in ((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).Rows.Keys)
			{
				int value = key.Value;
				RowDetailContainer rowDetailContainer = (RowDetailContainer)((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).Rows[value];
				if (rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
				{
					yield return value;
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<RowDetailContainer> GetContainers()
		{
			return from int x in ((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).Rows.Keys
				select (RowDetailContainer)((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).Rows[x];
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> GetContainersIndices()
		{
			return ((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).Rows.Keys.Cast<int>().ToList();
		}

		public void RemoveRowDetailContainer(int controllerRow)
		{
			((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).Rows.Remove(controllerRow);
		}

		protected override void OnItemDeleted(int listSourceRow)
		{
			if (((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)this).GetSelectedObject((int?)listSourceRow) is RowDetailContainer rowDetailContainer)
			{
				rowDetailContainer.Detach();
			}
			((SelectedRowsCollection)this).OnItemDeleted(listSourceRow);
		}
	}
	public class CollapsedRowsKeeper : SelectedRowsKeeper
	{
		protected RowStateController RowStateController => ((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Controller.Selection as RowStateController;

		protected virtual RowStateCollection RowStateCollection => RowStateController.CollapsedRows;

		public CollapsedRowsKeeper(DataController controller, bool allowKeepSelection)
			: base(controller, allowKeepSelection)
		{
		}

		protected override void RestoreCore(object row, int level, object value)
		{
			((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)RowStateCollection).SetRowSelected(GetRowHandleByObject(row), true, value);
		}

		internal int GetRowHandleByObject(object row)
		{
			if (row is GroupRowInfo)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			return ((DataControllerBase)((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Controller).GetControllerRow((int)row);
		}

		public void SaveRow(int listSourceRow)
		{
			int controllerRow = ((DataControllerBase)((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Controller).GetControllerRow(listSourceRow);
			((SelectedRowsKeeper)this).SaveRowCore(controllerRow, ((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)RowStateCollection).GetRowSelectedObject(controllerRow));
		}

		public void SaveCore()
		{
			if (((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)RowStateCollection).Count != 0)
			{
				int[] array = ((SelectedRowsCollection)RowStateCollection).CopyToArray();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					SaveRow(array[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void RestoreCore(bool clear)
		{
			if (((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Helper.Count > 0 && !((BaseRowsKeeper)this).IsEmpty)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Helper.Count; i++)
				{
					object rowKey = ((BaseRowsKeeper)this).GetRowKey(i);
					((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Restore(rowKey, (object)i);
				}
			}
			if (!clear)
			{
				((BaseRowsKeeper)this).Clear();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DetailInfoKeeper : CollapsedRowsKeeper
	{
		private List<object> cache = new List<object>();

		protected override RowStateCollection RowStateCollection => base.RowStateController.DetailInfoCollection;

		public DetailInfoKeeper(DataController controller, bool allowKeepSelection)
			: base(controller, allowKeepSelection)
		{
		}

		protected override void SaveRowCore(int controllerRow, object selectedObject)
		{
			((SelectedRowsKeeper)this).SaveRowCore(controllerRow, selectedObject);
			if (selectedObject != null)
			{
				cache.Add(selectedObject);
			}
		}

		protected override void RestoreCore(object row, int level, object value)
		{
			base.RestoreCore(row, level, value);
			if (((BaseSelectionCollection<int?>)(object)RowStateCollection).GetRowSelected(GetRowHandleByObject(row)))
			{
				cache.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void RestoreCore(bool clear)

		private SummaryMode? GetActualSummaryModeForMixedMode(SummaryItem summary)

	public class ColumnFilteringUIContentPresenter : ContentPresenter
	{
		public ColumnFilteringUIContentPresenter()
		{
			base.DataContextChanged += delegate
			{
				UpdateFilterElement();
			};
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			UpdateFilterElement();
		}

		private void UpdateFilterElement()
		{
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_FilterElement") is FilterElement filterElement)
			{
				ColumnFilteringUIDataContext columnFilteringUIDataContext = base.Content as ColumnFilteringUIDataContext;
				if (columnFilteringUIDataContext != null)
				{
					filterElement.ProcessGetUniqueValues = (FilterElement.ProcessGetUniqueValuesEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(filterElement.ProcessGetUniqueValues, new FilterElement.ProcessGetUniqueValuesEventHandler(ProcessGetUniqueValues));
					SetupExcelStyleFilterElement(filterElement as ExcelStyleFilterElement, columnFilteringUIDataContext);
				}
				filterElement.Context = columnFilteringUIDataContext?.Context;
				filterElement.FieldName = columnFilteringUIDataContext?.PropertyName;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessGetUniqueValues(object sender, ProcessGetUniqueValuesEventArgs args)
		{
			DataControlBase.GetActiveView(this).Do(delegate(DataViewBase view)
			{
				view.IsColumnFilterLoaded = args.Status == GetUniqueValuesStatus.End;
			});
		}

		private void SetupExcelStyleFilterElement(ExcelStyleFilterElement excelStyleFilterElement, ColumnFilteringUIDataContext filteringUIDataContext)
		{
			if (excelStyleFilterElement == null || filteringUIDataContext == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			excelStyleFilterElement.ShowAllLookUpFilterValues = filteringUIDataContext.IncludeFilteredOut;
			excelStyleFilterElement.ProcessUniqueValuesForValuesTab += delegate(object d, FilterValuesEventArgs e)
			{
				if (filteringUIDataContext.GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab != null)
				{
					e.FilterValues = filteringUIDataContext.GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab(e.FilterValues);
				}
			};
		}

	{

		{
			if (!(dropTargetElement is ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView extendedColumnChooserTreeListView))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(extendedColumnChooserTreeListView.DataContext is ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel viewModel))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (IDropTarget)(object)new ExtendedColumnChooserDropTarget(extendedColumnChooserTreeListView, viewModel);
		}

		public override bool IsCompatibleDropTargetFactory(UIElement dropTargetElement, BaseGridHeader sourceHeader)
		{
			if (!(dropTargetElement is ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView extendedColumnChooserTreeListView))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsCompatibleDataControl(extendedColumnChooserTreeListView.OriginalDataControl, sourceHeader.GridView.DataControl);
		}

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserGridColumnHeader : GridColumnHeader, IExtendedColumnChooserColumnHeader, ISupportDragDropColumnHeader, ISupportDragDrop

		internal class DropMarkerHelper
		{
			private readonly UIElement source;

			private AdornedMarkerDisplayer displayer;

			public DropMarkerHelper(UIElement source)
			{
				this.source = source;
			}

			public void Update(DropPosition? dropPosition, DataTemplate dropMarkerTemplate)
			{
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (displayer != null)
				{
					displayer.Hide();
				}
				if (dropPosition.HasValue)
				{
					DropMarkerData val = new DropMarkerData();
					val.Position = dropPosition.Value;
					val.Orientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
					val.Padding = new Thickness(1.0);
					displayer = new AdornedMarkerDisplayer((object)val, (Func<DataTemplate>)(() => dropMarkerTemplate));
					displayer.Show(source);
				}
			}
		}

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserSearchNullTextConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public string SearchColumnsKey { get; set; }

		public string SearchColumnsAndBandsKey { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is LocalizationDescriptor) || !(values[1] is bool))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			LocalizationDescriptor localizationDescriptor = (LocalizationDescriptor)values[0];
			return localizationDescriptor.GetValue(((bool)values[1]) ? SearchColumnsAndBandsKey : SearchColumnsKey);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class ExtendedColumnChooserExpandButtonVisibleConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is bool) || !(values[1] is ExtendedColumnChooserColumn))
			{
				return false;

			if ((bool)values[0])
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((ExtendedColumnChooserColumn)values[1]).Source is BandBase;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is bool) || !(values[1] is bool))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(bool)values[0])
			{
				return true;

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserHeaderPresenterTypeConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is bool) || !(values[1] is bool))
			{
				return HeaderPresenterType.Headers;
			}
			if (!(bool)values[0])
			{
				return HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser;
			}
			return ((bool)values[1]) ? HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel : HeaderPresenterType.Headers;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserColumnTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ColumnHeaderTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate BandHeaderTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (!(item is EditGridCellData editGridCellData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (editGridCellData.RowData.Row is ExtendedColumnChooserColumn extendedColumnChooserColumn && extendedColumnChooserColumn.Source is BandBase)

				return BandHeaderTemplate;

			return ColumnHeaderTemplate;
		}

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserRowControl : RowControl
	{
		static ExtendedColumnChooserRowControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ExtendedColumnChooserRowControl>();
		}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserRowControl(RowData rowData)
			: base(rowData)
		{
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateBottomLine();
		}

		protected override void UpdateRowHandle(RowHandle rowHandle)
		{
			base.UpdateRowHandle(rowHandle);
			UpdateBottomLine();
		}

		protected internal void UpdateBottomLine()
		{
			if (bottomLine == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListView treeListView = (TreeListView)rowData.View;
			TreeListNode node = ((TreeListRowData)rowData).Node;
			if (node == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListNode rootNode = node.RootNode;
			int nodeVisibleIndex = treeListView.GetNodeVisibleIndex(node);
			TreeListNode nodeByVisibleIndex = treeListView.GetNodeByVisibleIndex(nodeVisibleIndex + 1);
			if (nodeByVisibleIndex == null || nodeByVisibleIndex.RootNode != nodeByVisibleIndex)
			{
				bottomLine.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			ExtendedColumnChooserColumn extendedColumnChooserColumn = ((TreeListNodeBase)rootNode).Content as ExtendedColumnChooserColumn;
			ExtendedColumnChooserColumn extendedColumnChooserColumn2 = ((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByVisibleIndex).Content as ExtendedColumnChooserColumn;
			if (extendedColumnChooserColumn == null || extendedColumnChooserColumn2 == null)
			{
				bottomLine.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				bottomLine.Visibility = ((extendedColumnChooserColumn.Fixed == extendedColumnChooserColumn2.Fixed) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected override CellsControl CreateCellsControl(Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc)
		{
			return new ExtendedColumnChooserCellsControl(this, getCellDataFunc, getBandsFunc);
		}

		internal override RowMarginControl CreateRowMarginControl(RowData rowData)
		{
			return new ExtendedColumnChooserRowMarginControl(rowData);
		}
	}
	public class ExtendedColumnChooserCellsControl : CellsControl
	{
		public ExtendedColumnChooserCellsControl(RowControl rowControl, Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc)
			: base(rowControl, getCellDataFunc, getBandsFunc)

	[Browsable(false)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView : TreeListView, IExtendedColumnChooserView
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OriginalDataControlProperty;

		private GridDragScrollService scrollService;

		private DispatcherTimer updateTimer;

		public DataControlBase OriginalDataControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataControlBase)GetValue(OriginalDataControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OriginalDataControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private GridDragScrollService ScrollService
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollService == null)
				{
					scrollService = new GridDragScrollService(this);
				}
				return scrollService;
			}
		}

		private DispatcherTimer UpdateTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (updateTimer == null)
				{
					updateTimer = new DispatcherTimer
					{
						Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100.0)
					};
					updateTimer.Tick += UpdateTimer_Tick;
				}
				return updateTimer;
			}
		}

		public bool IsInScrollingMode => UpdateTimer.IsEnabled;

		static ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView()
		{
			OriginalDataControlProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OriginalDataControl", typeof(DataControlBase), typeof(ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView), new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		internal override FrameworkElement CreateRowElement(RowData rowData)
		{
			return base.TreeListViewBehavior.CreateElement(() => new ExtendedColumnChooserRowControl(rowData), () => new GridRow(), DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.UseLightweightTemplates.Row);
		}

		public void UpdateRowsFixedState()
		{
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow is ExtendedColumnChooserRowControl extendedColumnChooserRowControl)
				{
					extendedColumnChooserRowControl.UpdateBottomLine();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateScrollPosition();
		}

		public void StartUpdateScrollPosition()
		{
			if (!UpdateTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				UpdateTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		public void EndUpdateScrollPosition()
		{
			if (UpdateTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				UpdateTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScrollPosition(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!LayoutHelper.IsPointInsideElementBounds(point, base.ScrollContentPresenter, new Thickness(20.0)))
			{
				EndUpdateScrollPosition();
				return;
			}
			ScrollService.Update((Func<IInputElement, System.Windows.Point>)((IInputElement el) => point));
		}

		private void UpdateScrollPosition()
		{
			UpdateScrollPosition(Mouse.GetPosition(base.ScrollContentPresenter));
		}

		protected internal override IDragElement CreateDragElement(BaseGridHeader columnHeader, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			return (IDragElement)(object)new ExtendedColumnChooserHeaderDragElement(columnHeader, offset);
		}

		public void UpdateNodeExpandState(BandBase targetBand, BaseColumn source)
		{
			TreeListNode nodeByCellValue = GetNodeByCellValue("Source", targetBand);
			if (nodeByCellValue != null)
			{
				((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByCellValue).ExpandAll();
			}
		}

		IDragElement IExtendedColumnChooserView.CreateDragElement(BaseGridHeader columnHeader, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			return CreateDragElement(columnHeader, offset);
		}
	}

		protected override void SetPrintWidth(BaseColumn column, double width)
		{
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintColumnWidth((DependencyObject)(object)column, width);
		}

		internal override BandsLayoutBase CloneAndFillEmptyBands()
		{
			BandsLayoutBase bandsLayoutBase = base.CloneAndFillEmptyBands();
			PrintLayoutAssigner layoutAssigner = new PrintLayoutAssigner();
			bandsLayoutBase.UpdateFixedBands(layoutAssigner);
			bandsLayoutBase.UpdateBandsPositions(layoutAssigner);
			return bandsLayoutBase;
		}

		internal override void PatchBands(List<BandBase> bands, bool hasFixedLeftBands)
		{
			if (IsCheckBoxSelectorBandVisible)
			{
				UpdateCheckBoxSelectorBand(hasFixedLeftBands);
				bands.Insert(0, CheckBoxSelectorBand);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCheckBoxSelectorBand(bool hasFixedLeftBands)
		{
			UpdateIsCheckBoxSelectorBandFixed(hasFixedLeftBands);
			UpdateCheckBoxSelectorBandColumns();
			CheckBoxSelectorBand.OnBandsLayoutChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateIsCheckBoxSelectorBandFixed(bool hasFixedLeftBands)
		{
			if (hasFixedLeftBands)
			{
				CheckBoxSelectorBand.Fixed = FixedStyle.Left;
			}
			else
			{
				CheckBoxSelectorBand.Fixed = FixedStyle.None;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCheckBoxSelectorBandColumns()
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = null;
			if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.DataView is TableView)
			{
				gridColumn = (GridColumn)base.DataControl.DataView.CheckBoxSelectorColumn;
			}
			if (gridColumn != null && !((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)CheckBoxSelectorBand.Columns).Contains(gridColumn))
			{
				if (((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)CheckBoxSelectorBand.Columns).Count != 0)
				{
					((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)CheckBoxSelectorBand.Columns).Clear();
				}
				((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)CheckBoxSelectorBand.Columns).Add(gridColumn);
			}
		}

		private GridControlBand CreateCheckBoxSelectorBand()
		{
			GridControlBand gridControlBand = new GridControlBand();
			gridControlBand.AllowMoving = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridControlBand.AllowResizing = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridControlBand.Owner = this;
			gridControlBand.BandsLayout = this;
			gridControlBand.AllowPrinting = false;
			return gridControlBand;
		}
	}

				notificationHelper.Subscribe();

		}

		protected internal override ColumnBase GetColumn(FrameworkElement element)

			if (element is IRowMarginControl)

	public class BandsGroupSummaryAlignByColumnsPanel : BandsNoneDropPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FixedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Fixed", typeof(FixedStyle), typeof(BandsGroupSummaryAlignByColumnsPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(FixedStyle.None, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LeftMarginProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LeftMargin", typeof(double), typeof(BandsGroupSummaryAlignByColumnsPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		private double leftIndent;

		private GroupRowData GroupRowData => base.DataContext as GroupRowData;

		public FixedStyle Fixed
		{
			get
			{
				return (FixedStyle)GetValue(FixedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FixedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double LeftMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LeftMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LeftMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private TableView TableView => ((GroupRowData)base.DataContext).View as TableView;

		protected override void ArrangeChild(UIElement child, double x, double y, double width, double height)
		{
			bool hasOverlap = HasOverlap(x);
			base.ArrangeChild(child, CalcX(x, hasOverlap), y, CalcWidth(width, x, hasOverlap), height);
		}

		protected override void MeasureChild(UIElement child, double availableWidth, double availableHeight, double x)
		{
			base.MeasureChild(child, CalcWidth(availableWidth, x, HasOverlap(x)), availableHeight, x);
		}

		private bool HasOverlap(double x)
		{
			return x < leftIndent;
		}

		private double CalcX(double x, bool hasOverlap)
		{
			if (!hasOverlap)
			{
				return x;
			}
			return leftIndent;
		}

		private double CalcWidth(double width, double x, bool hasOverlap)
		{
			if (!hasOverlap)
			{
				return width;
			}
			return Math.Max(0.0, width - leftIndent + x);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			UpdateLeftIndent();
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		private void UpdateLeftIndent()
		{
			if (!(base.DataContext is GroupRowData))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			if (Fixed == FixedStyle.None || Fixed == FixedStyle.Right)
			{
				if (TableView.FixedLeftVisibleColumns != null && TableView.FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count > 0)
				{
					num += TableView.FixedLeftContentWidth + TableView.TotalGroupAreaIndent + TableView.FixedLineWidth;
				}
				num = ((Fixed != FixedStyle.None) ? (num + (TableView.FixedNoneContentWidth + TableView.FixedLineWidth)) : (num + TableView.ScrollingHeaderVirtualizationMargin.Left));
			}
			leftIndent = Math.Max(0.0, 0.0 - LeftMargin - num);
		}

		protected internal override double GetBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			return GetActualColumnWidth(band);
		}

		protected internal override double GetColumnWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return GetActualColumnWidth(column);
		}

		private double GetActualColumnWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (GroupRowData != null && column != null && column.View is GridViewBase { IsGroupRowOptimized: not false, ViewBehavior: not null } gridViewBase && column.ActualHeaderWidth > 0.0 && gridViewBase.ViewBehavior.IsFirstColumn(column, isPrinting: false))
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, column.ActualHeaderWidth - GroupRowData.Offset);
			}
			return column.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		protected override void SetMargin(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				ColumnBase column = GetColumn(frameworkElement);
				if (column != null)
				{
					frameworkElement.Margin = new Thickness(column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth, frameworkElement.Margin.Top, column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore, column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class BandsCellsPanel : BandsColumnHeadersPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FixedNoneContentWidthProperty;

		public double FixedNoneContentWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(FixedNoneContentWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FixedNoneContentWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal new RowData RowData => base.DataContext as RowData;

		protected override bool AllowHeaderMerge => false;

		static BandsCellsPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BandsCellsPanel);
			FixedNoneContentWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FixedNoneContentWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsCellsPanel)d).OnFixedNoneContentWidthChanged();
			}));
		}

		protected internal override ColumnBase GetColumn(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is IGridCellEditorOwner gridCellEditorOwner))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return gridCellEditorOwner.AssociatedColumn;
		}

		protected internal override double GetColumnWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return Math.Max(0.0, column.ActualDataWidth + RowData.GetRowIndent(column));
		}

		protected internal override double GetTreeColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (RowData == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return RowData.GetTreeColumnOffset(column);
		}

		protected internal override double GetBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			if (!band.HasLeftSibling && View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, band.ActualHeaderWidth - ((ITableView)View).TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.FirstColumnIndent + RowData.GetRowIndent(isFirstColumn: true));
			}
			return band.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		private void OnFixedNoneContentWidthChanged()
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}
	public class BandsColumnHeadersPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		private abstract class BandLayoutStrategyBase
		{
			public abstract System.Windows.Size MeasureElements(BandBase band, System.Windows.Size availableSize, double width, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel, IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider);

			public abstract double ArrangeElements(BandBase band, System.Windows.Size finalSize, double width, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel, IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider, Func<LightweightCellEditor, System.Windows.Size, Tuple<double, double>> GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight);
		}

		private class StackBandLayoutStrategy : BandLayoutStrategyBase
		{
			public static readonly BandLayoutStrategyBase Instance = new StackBandLayoutStrategy();

			private StackBandLayoutStrategy()
			{
			}

			public override System.Windows.Size MeasureElements(BandBase band, System.Windows.Size availableSize, double width, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel, IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double mergeHeight = mergeHeightProvider.GetMergeHeight(band);
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, FrameworkElement> bandElements = GetBandElements(panel);
				System.Windows.Controls.Control rowMarginControl = panel.RowMarginControl;
				if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < band.ActualRows.Count; i++)
					{
						BandRow bandRow = band.ActualRows[i];
						double num3 = 0.0;
						double num4 = 0.0;
						double num5 = width;
						bool flag = i == band.ActualRows.Count - 1;
						foreach (ColumnBase column in bandRow.Columns)
						{
							if (bandElements.ContainsKey(column))
							{
								FrameworkElement frameworkElement = bandElements[column];
								if (OrderPanelBase.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)frameworkElement) < 0)
								{
									continue;
								}
								if (rowMarginControl != null && panel.View.IsTreeColumn(column))
								{
									rowMarginControl.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
									panel.MeasureChild(rowMarginControl, availableSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - num), num5);
									num5 += rowMarginControl.DesiredSize.Width;
								}
								frameworkElement.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
								panel.MeasureChild(frameworkElement, Math.Max(0.0, panel.GetColumnWidth(column) + panel.GetHorizontalCorrection(column) - panel.GetTreeColumnOffset(column)), Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - num + (flag ? mergeHeight : 0.0)), num5);
								num3 = Math.Max(num3, frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height);
								num4 += panel.GetColumnWidth(column);
							}
							num5 += panel.GetColumnWidth(column);
						}
						num += num3;
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, num4);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = panel.GetBandWidth(band);
				}
				return new System.Windows.Size((band.VisibleBands.Count == 0) ? num2 : 0.0, num);
			}

			public override double ArrangeElements(BandBase band, System.Windows.Size finalSize, double width, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel, IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider, Func<LightweightCellEditor, System.Windows.Size, Tuple<double, double>> GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight)
			{
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, FrameworkElement> bandElements = GetBandElements(panel);
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double mergeHeight = mergeHeightProvider.GetMergeHeight(band);
				System.Windows.Controls.Control rowMarginControl = panel.RowMarginControl;
				if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < band.ActualRows.Count; i++)
					{
						double num3 = width;
						double num4 = 0.0;
						bool flag = i == band.ActualRows.Count - 1;
						if (i == band.ActualRows.Count - 1)
						{
							num4 = finalSize.Height - num;
						}
						else
						{
							foreach (ColumnBase column in band.ActualRows[i].Columns)
							{
								if (bandElements.ContainsKey(column))
								{
									num4 = Math.Max(bandElements[column].DesiredSize.Height, num4);
								}
							}
						}
						for (int j = 0; j < band.ActualRows[i].Columns.Count; j++)
						{
							ColumnBase columnBase = band.ActualRows[i].Columns[j];
							if (bandElements.ContainsKey(columnBase))
							{
								FrameworkElement frameworkElement = bandElements[columnBase];
								double horizontalCorrection = panel.GetHorizontalCorrection(columnBase);
								if (rowMarginControl != null && panel.View.IsTreeColumn(columnBase))
								{
									panel.ArrangeChild(rowMarginControl, num3, num, rowMarginControl.DesiredSize.Width, num4 + (double)(panel.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight ? 1 : 0));
									panel.ArrangeChild(frameworkElement, num3 - horizontalCorrection + rowMarginControl.DesiredSize.Width, num, Math.Max(0.0, panel.GetColumnWidth(columnBase) + horizontalCorrection - panel.GetTreeColumnOffset(columnBase)), num4);
								}
								else
								{
									Tuple<double, double> tuple = GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight?.Invoke(frameworkElement as LightweightCellEditor, finalSize);
									if (columnBase != null && columnBase.SeparatorForceUpdate)
									{
										UIElement uIElement = frameworkElement;
										if (uIElement != null && uIElement.IsArrangeValid)
										{
											uIElement.InvalidateVisual();
										}
									}
									panel.ArrangeChild(frameworkElement, num3 - horizontalCorrection, tuple?.Item1 ?? (num - mergeHeight), panel.GetColumnWidth(columnBase) + horizontalCorrection - panel.GetTreeColumnOffset(columnBase), tuple?.Item2 ?? (num4 + (flag ? mergeHeight : 0.0)));
								}
							}
							num3 += panel.GetColumnWidth(columnBase);
						}
						num += num4;
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, num3);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = panel.GetBandWidth(band) + width;
				}
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					return width;
				}
				return num2;
			}

			private static Dictionary<ColumnBase, FrameworkElement> GetBandElements(BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel)
			{
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, FrameworkElement> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, FrameworkElement>(panel.Children.Count);
				foreach (FrameworkElement child in panel.Children)
				{
					ColumnBase column = panel.GetColumn(child);
					if (column != null)
					{
						dictionary[column] = child;
					}
				}
				return dictionary;
			}
		}

		private class GridBandLayoutStrategy : BandLayoutStrategyBase
		{
			public static readonly BandLayoutStrategyBase Instance = new GridBandLayoutStrategy();

			private GridBandLayoutStrategy()
			{
			}

			public override System.Windows.Size MeasureElements(BandBase band, System.Windows.Size availableSize, double width, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel, IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				Dictionary<GridColumn, UIElement> bandElements = GetBandElements(band, panel);
				foreach (GridColumn key in bandElements.Keys)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = bandElements[key];
					panel.MeasureChild(uIElement, double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity, num2 + width);
					num = Math.Max(num, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
					num2 += uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (band.RowDefinitions.Count != 0)
				{
					num = 0.0;
					foreach (BandRowDefinition rowDefinition in band.RowDefinitions)
					{
						num += rowDefinition.Height.Value;
					}
				}
				if (band.ColumnDefinitions.Count == 0)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(num2, num);
				}
				num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (BandColumnDefinition columnDefinition in band.ColumnDefinitions)
				{
					num2 += columnDefinition.Width.Value;
				}
				return new System.Windows.Size(num2, num);
			}

			public override double ArrangeElements(BandBase band, System.Windows.Size finalSize, double width, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel, IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider, Func<LightweightCellEditor, System.Windows.Size, Tuple<double, double>> GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight)
			{
				Dictionary<GridColumn, UIElement> bandElements = GetBandElements(band, panel);
				foreach (GridColumn key in bandElements.Keys)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = bandElements[key];
					double num = 0.0;
					for (int i = 0; i < BandBase.GetGridRow((DependencyObject)(object)key); i++)
					{
						num += band.RowDefinitions[i].Height.Value;
					}
					double num2 = 0.0;
					for (int j = 0; j < BandBase.GetGridColumn((DependencyObject)(object)key); j++)
					{
						num2 += band.ColumnDefinitions[j].Width.Value;
					}
					Tuple<double, double> tuple = GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight?.Invoke(uIElement as LightweightCellEditor, finalSize);
					panel.ArrangeChild(uIElement, width + num2, tuple?.Item1 ?? num, GetColumnWidth(BandBase.GetGridColumn((DependencyObject)(object)key), band), tuple?.Item2 ?? GetRowHeight(BandBase.GetGridRow((DependencyObject)(object)key), band, finalSize.Height));
				}
				double num3 = 0.0;
				foreach (BandColumnDefinition columnDefinition in band.ColumnDefinitions)
				{
					num3 += columnDefinition.Width.Value;
				}
				return width + num3;
			}

			private double GetColumnWidth(int i, BandBase band)
			{
				if (i < 0 || band.ColumnDefinitions.Count < i + 1)
				{
					return 120.0;
				}
				return band.ColumnDefinitions[i].Width.Value;
			}

			private double GetRowHeight(int i, BandBase band, double maxHeight)
			{
				if (i < 0 || band.RowDefinitions.Count < i + 1)
				{
					return maxHeight;
				}
				return band.RowDefinitions[i].Height.Value;
			}

			private static Dictionary<GridColumn, UIElement> GetBandElements(BandBase band, BandsColumnHeadersPanel panel)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					return new Dictionary<GridColumn, UIElement>();
				}
				Dictionary<GridColumn, UIElement> dictionary = new Dictionary<GridColumn, UIElement>(panel.Children.Count);
				foreach (FrameworkElement child in panel.Children)
				{
					GridColumn gridColumn = child.DataContext as GridColumn;
					if (band.ColumnsCore.Contains(gridColumn))
					{
						dictionary[gridColumn] = child;
					}
				}
				return dictionary;
			}
		}

		protected interface IMergeHeightProvider
		{
			double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band);
		}

		private class BandMergeHeightProvider : IMergeHeightProvider
		{
			private readonly Func<BandsPanel> getBandsPanelCore;

			private BandsPanel panelCore;

			private BandsPanel Panel => panelCore ?? (panelCore = getBandsPanelCore());

			public BandMergeHeightProvider(Func<BandsPanel> getBandsPanel)
			{
				if (getBandsPanel == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				getBandsPanelCore = getBandsPanel;
			}

			public double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band)
			{
				if (band == null || band.ActualShowInBandsPanel)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return Panel?.GetMergeHeight(band, (FrameworkElement x) => x.ActualHeight) ?? 0.0;
			}
		}

		private class EmptyMergeHeightProvider : IMergeHeightProvider
		{
			public double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BandsProperty;

		public IList<BandBase> Bands
		{
			get
			{
				return (IList<BandBase>)GetValue(BandsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BandsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected System.Windows.Controls.Control RowMarginControl { get; private set; }

		protected virtual bool AllowHeaderMerge => true;

		protected virtual bool ExtendRowMarginControlHeight => View.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight;

		internal ColumnsRowDataBase RowData => base.DataContext as ColumnsRowDataBase;

		protected virtual DataViewBase View => RowData.View;

		static BandsColumnHeadersPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BandsColumnHeadersPanel);
			BandsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Bands", typeof(IList<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsColumnHeadersPanel)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			}));
		}

		private BandLayoutStrategyBase GetLayoutStrategy(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band.ColumnDefinitions.Count > 0 || band.RowDefinitions.Count > 0)
			{
				return GridBandLayoutStrategy.Instance;
			}
			return StackBandLayoutStrategy.Instance;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double width = 0.0;
			double height = 0.0;
			double x = 0.0;
			IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider = CreateMergeHeightProvider();
			BandsLayoutBase.ForeachVisibleBand(Bands, delegate(BandBase band)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = GetLayoutStrategy(band).MeasureElements(band, availableSize, x, this, mergeHeightProvider);
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count == 0)
				{
					x += GetBandWidth(band);
				}
				width += size.Width;
				height = Math.Max(height, size.Height);
			});
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				SetMargin(child);
				if (OrderPanelBase.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)child) < 0)
				{
					child.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double width = 0.0;
			IMergeHeightProvider mergeHeightProvider = CreateMergeHeightProvider();
			BandsLayoutBase.ForeachVisibleBand(Bands, delegate(BandBase band)
			{
				width = GetLayoutStrategy(band).ArrangeElements(band, finalSize, width, this, mergeHeightProvider, GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight);
			});
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected virtual Tuple<double, double> GetMergeCellOffsetAndHeight(LightweightCellEditor cell, System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual ColumnBase GetColumn(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return element.DataContext as ColumnBase;
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetColumnWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return column.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			return band.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetHorizontalCorrection(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return column.GetHorizontalCorrection();
		}

		protected virtual void ArrangeChild(UIElement child, double x, double y, double width, double height)
		{
			child.Arrange(new Rect(x, y, width, height));
		}

		protected virtual void MeasureChild(UIElement child, double availableWidth, double availableHeight, double x)
		{
			child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableWidth, availableHeight));
		}

		private BandsPanel GetBandsPanel()
		{
			BandsLayoutBase bandsLayoutBase = RowData.With((ColumnsRowDataBase r) => r.View).With((DataViewBase v) => v.DataControl).With((DataControlBase dc) => dc.BandsLayoutCore);
			if (bandsLayoutBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(bandsLayoutBase.GetBandsContainerControl() is BandsContainerControl bandsContainerControl))
			{
				return null;
			}
			FixedStyle fixedStyle = FixedStyle.None;
			BandBase bandBase = Bands.FirstOrDefault();
			if (bandBase != null)
			{
				BandBase rootBand = bandsLayoutBase.GetRootBand(bandBase);
				if (rootBand != null)
				{
					fixedStyle = rootBand.Fixed;
				}
			}
			return bandsContainerControl.GetBandsPanel(fixedStyle);
		}

		protected virtual IMergeHeightProvider CreateMergeHeightProvider()
		{
			if (!AllowHeaderMerge)
			{
				return new EmptyMergeHeightProvider();
			}
			return new BandMergeHeightProvider(GetBandsPanel);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeBands(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			return GetLayoutClipInternal(layoutSlotSize);
		}

		internal Geometry GetLayoutClipInternal(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
		{
			if (visualRemoved is IRowMarginControl)
			{
				RowMarginControl = null;
			}
			if (visualAdded is IRowMarginControl)
			{
				RowMarginControl = (System.Windows.Controls.Control)visualAdded;
			}
			base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetTreeColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual void SetMargin(UIElement element)
		{
		}
	}

		}

		internal Geometry GetLayoutClipInternal(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			double mergeMargin = GetMergeMargin();
			return new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0 - mergeMargin, base.RenderSize.Width, base.RenderSize.Height + mergeMargin));
		}

		private double GetMergeMargin()
		{
			return (base.DataContext as RowDataBase).With((RowDataBase r) => r.View).With((DataViewBase v) => v.DataControl).With((DataControlBase dt) => dt.GetRootDataControl())
				.Return((DataControlBase dc) => dc.ActualHeight, () => 0.0);
		}
	}

	public abstract class BandsPanelBase : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		internal const double OverlayHeaderByChildrenY = -1000000.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BandsProperty;

		private readonly Dictionary<BandBase, FrameworkElement> bandsDictionary = new Dictionary<BandBase, FrameworkElement>();

		private List<FrameworkElement> freeBands = new List<FrameworkElement>();

		public IList<BandBase> Bands
		{
			get
			{
				return (IList<BandBase>)GetValue(BandsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BandsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal Dictionary<BandBase, FrameworkElement> BandsDictionary => bandsDictionary;

		public bool AllowVirtualization { get; set; }

		private bool ActualAllowVirtualization
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllowVirtualization)
				{
					return TableView.AllowHorizontalScrollingVirtualization;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private double GroupAreaIndent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TableView.TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements)
				{
					return TableView.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		protected ITableView TableView => DataView as ITableView;

		protected DataViewBase DataView => DataControlBase.GetCurrentView(this);

		static BandsPanelBase()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BandsPanelBase);
			BandsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Bands", typeof(IList<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsPanelBase)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			}));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Bands == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			List<BandBase> list = bandsDictionary.Keys.ToList();
			RemoveUnusedBands(Bands, list, 0.0);
			foreach (BandBase item in list)
			{
				freeBands.Add(bandsDictionary[item]);
				bandsDictionary.Remove(item);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (BandBase band in Bands)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, MeasureBand(band, num2));
				num2 += GetBandWidth(band);
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement freeBand in freeBands)
			{
				freeBand.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				freeBand.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num2, num);
		}

		private void RemoveUnusedBands(IList<BandBase> bands, List<BandBase> unusedBands, double currentWidth)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (!ActualAllowVirtualization || (currentWidth + GetBandWidth(band) > TableView.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalOffset && currentWidth <= TableView.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalOffset + TableView.HorizontalViewport + GroupAreaIndent))
				{
					unusedBands.Remove(band);
				}
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					RemoveUnusedBands(band.VisibleBands, unusedBands, currentWidth);
				}
				currentWidth += band.ActualHeaderWidth;
			}
		}

		private double MeasureBand(BandBase band, double currentWidth)
		{
			if (ActualAllowVirtualization)
			{
				if (currentWidth > TableView.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalOffset + TableView.HorizontalViewport + GroupAreaIndent)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (currentWidth + GetBandWidth(band) <= TableView.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalOffset)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
			}
			FrameworkElement value = null;
			bool flag = true;
			if (!bandsDictionary.TryGetValue(band, out value))
			{
				if (freeBands.Count > 0)
				{
					value = freeBands[0];
					freeBands.RemoveAt(0);
					value.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					value.DataContext = band;
					BaseGridHeader.SetGridColumn(value, band);
				}
				else
				{
					value = CreateBandElement(band);
					flag = PrintBandsPanel.GetActualShowInBandsPanel(band);
					if (flag)
					{
						base.Children.Add(value);
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					base.Children.Remove(value);
				}
				bandsDictionary[band] = value;
			}
			value.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(GetBandWidth(band), double.PositiveInfinity));
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, MeasureBand(visibleBand, currentWidth));
				currentWidth += visibleBand.ActualHeaderWidth;
			}
			return value.DesiredSize.Height + num;
		}

		protected abstract FrameworkElement CreateBandElement(BandBase band);

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (Bands == null)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandBase band in Bands)
			{
				ArrangeBand(band, new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0), finalSize.Height);
				num += GetBandWidth(band);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void ArrangeBand(BandBase band, System.Windows.Point offset, double height)
		{
			if (ActualAllowVirtualization && (offset.X > TableView.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalOffset + TableView.HorizontalViewport + GroupAreaIndent || offset.X + GetBandWidth(band) <= TableView.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalOffset))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement bandHeader = GetBandHeader(band);
			if (bandHeader == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
			{
				ArrangeBand(visibleBand, new System.Windows.Point(offset.X + num, offset.Y + bandHeader.DesiredSize.Height), height - bandHeader.DesiredSize.Height);
				num += GetBandWidth(visibleBand);
			}
			double actualMergeHeight = GetActualMergeHeight(band);
			bandHeader.Arrange(new Rect(offset.X, GetBandElementY(band, offset.Y - actualMergeHeight), GetBandWidth(band), ((band.VisibleBands.Count > 0) ? bandHeader.DesiredSize.Height : height) + actualMergeHeight));
		}

		protected virtual double GetActualMergeHeight(BandBase band)
		{
			if (!band.ActualShowInBandsPanel)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return GetMergeHeight(band.ParentBand);
		}

		protected virtual double GetBandElementY(BandBase band, double offset)
		{
			return offset;
		}

		protected virtual double GetBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			return band.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetBandHeader(BandBase band)
		{
			FrameworkElement value = null;
			bandsDictionary.TryGetValue(band, out value);
			return value;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeBands(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	public class BandsPanel : BandsPanelBase, ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner
	{
		private LayoutNotificationHelper notificationHelper;

		DependencyObject ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner.NotificationManager => DataControl;

		private DataControlBase DataControl => base.DataView.Return((DataViewBase x) => x.DataControl, null);

		public BandsPanel()
		{
			notificationHelper = new LayoutNotificationHelper(this);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				notificationHelper.Subscribe();
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateBandElement(BandBase band)
		{
			BandHeaderControl bandHeaderControl = new BandHeaderControl();
			bandHeaderControl.BeginInit();
			bandHeaderControl.DataContext = band;
			bandHeaderControl.CanSyncColumnPosition = true;
			BaseGridHeader.SetGridColumn(bandHeaderControl, band);
			BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)bandHeaderControl, (IPopupControl)(object)band.View.DataControlMenu);
			DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(bandHeaderControl, GridMenuType.Band);
			ColumnBase.SetHeaderPresenterType(bandHeaderControl, HeaderPresenterType.Headers);
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptor(bandHeaderControl, new BandHeaderTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
			bandHeaderControl.EndInit();
			return bandHeaderControl;
		}

		protected override double GetBandElementY(BandBase band, double offset)
		{
			if (band.ActualShowInBandsPanel)
			{
				return offset;
			}
			return -1000000.0;
		}

		protected override double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return GetMergeHeight(band, (FrameworkElement x) => x.DesiredSize.Height);
		}

		protected internal double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band, Func<FrameworkElement, double> getHeight)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			BandBase bandBase = band;
			while (bandBase != null && !bandBase.ActualShowInBandsPanel)
			{
				FrameworkElement bandHeader = GetBandHeader(bandBase);
				num += ((bandHeader != null) ? getHeight(bandHeader) : 0.0);
				bandBase = bandBase.ParentBand;
			}
			return num;
		}

		void ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner.InvalidateMeasure()
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}

	public interface IBestFitGroupRow
	{
		GridGroupSummaryColumnData SummaryData { get; set; }

		bool IsFirstColumn { get; set; }

		void SetRowData(GroupRowData rowData);

		void UpdateContent();
	}
	public class BestFitGroupControl : BestFitControlBase, IBestFitGroupRow
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFirstColumnProperty;

		public GroupColumnSummaryControl GroupColumnSummaryControl { get; set; }

		public GroupBandSummaryControl GroupBandSummaryControl { get; set; }

		public GridGroupSummaryColumnData SummaryData { get; set; }

		public GroupValueContentPresenter ValuePresenter { get; set; }

		public bool IsFirstColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsFirstColumnProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsFirstColumnProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static BestFitGroupControl()
		{
			IsFirstColumnProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsFirstColumn", typeof(bool), typeof(BestFitGroupControl), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<BestFitGroupControl>();
		}

		public BestFitGroupControl(DataViewBase view, ColumnBase column)
			: base(view, column)
		{
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			GroupColumnSummaryControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_SummaryControlPresenter") as GroupColumnSummaryControl;
			GroupBandSummaryControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_BandSummaryControlPresenter") as GroupBandSummaryControl;
			ValuePresenter = GetTemplateChild("groupValueContentPresenter") as GroupValueContentPresenter;
			UpdateGroupColumnSummaryControl();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (base.Column != null && base.Column.View is TableView && IsFirstColumn)
			{
				result.Width -= Math.Min(result.Width, ((TableView)base.Column.View).ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(base.Column) + NullDataDelta());
			}
			else
			{
				result.Width++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateGroupColumnSummaryControl()
		{
			if (base.Column.ParentBand == null)
			{
				if (GroupColumnSummaryControl != null)
				{
					GroupColumnSummaryControl.DataContext = SummaryData;
				}
			}
			else if (GroupBandSummaryControl != null)
			{
				GroupBandSummaryControl.DataContext = SummaryData;
			}
		}

		private double NullDataDelta()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (SummaryData == null)
			{
				if (GroupColumnSummaryControl != null)
				{
					num += GroupColumnSummaryControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (GroupBandSummaryControl != null)
				{
					num += GroupBandSummaryControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void SetRowData(DataViewBase view)
		{
		}

		public void SetRowData(GroupRowData rowData)
		{
			base.RowData = rowData;
			RowData.SetRowDataInternal(this, base.RowData);
			base.DataContext = rowData;
		}

		public void UpdateContent()
		{
			UpdateGroupColumnSummaryControl();
			if (base.RowData != null && ValuePresenter != null)
			{
				((ContentPresenter)(object)ValuePresenter).Content = ((GroupRowData)base.RowData).GroupValue;
			}
		}
	}
