	public class ExtendedColumnChooserControl : GridColumnChooserControlBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewModelProperty;

		static ExtendedColumnChooserControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ExtendedColumnChooserControl);
			ViewModelProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ViewModel", typeof(ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public static ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel GetViewModel(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel)obj.GetValue(ViewModelProperty);
		}

		public static void SetViewModel(DependencyObject obj, ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ViewModelProperty, value);
		}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.SetAndMeasure<ExtendedColumnChooserControl>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(ILogicalOwner oldView, ILogicalOwner newView)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldView, newView);
			GetViewModel((DependencyObject)(object)this)?.Dispose();
			if (newView is DataViewBase)
			{
				SetViewModel((DependencyObject)(object)this, CreateViewModel(((DataViewBase)(object)newView).DataControl));
			}
			else
			{
				SetViewModel((DependencyObject)(object)this, null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel CreateViewModel(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (((ColumnChooserControlBase)this).Owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel(dataControl);
		}
	}
	public class ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel : BindableBase, IDisposable
	{
		private UnsubscribeAction unsubscribeDataControl;

		private UnsubscribeAction unsubscribeBands;

		private UnsubscribeAction unsubscribeColumns;

		private BandsLayoutBase CachedBandsLayout;

		public List<ColumnBase> ExcludedColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<List<ColumnBase>>("ExcludedColumns");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "ExcludedColumns");
			}
		}

		public List<ExtendedColumnChooserColumn> Columns
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<List<ExtendedColumnChooserColumn>>("Columns");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "Columns");
			}
		}

		public bool HasBands
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("HasBands");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "HasBands");
			}
		}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBase DragDropManager
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBase>("DragDropManager");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "DragDropManager");
			}
		}

		public DataControlBase DataControl
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<DataControlBase>("DataControl");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "DataControl");
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler ColumnsFixedStateChanged;

		public ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl = dataControl;
				Initialize();
				SubscribeDataControl();
				UpdateColumnsAllowHide();
			}
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			UnsubscribeBands();
			HasBands = DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null;
			SubscribeBands();
			FillColumnsCollection(DataControl.BandsLayoutCore, DataControl.ColumnsCore);
			DragDropManager = CreateDragDropManager(DataControl);
		}

		private void ColumnsCore_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		private void SubscribeDataControl()
		{
			DataControl.ColumnsCore.CollectionChanged += ColumnsCore_CollectionChanged;
			unsubscribeDataControl = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeDataControl, (UnsubscribeAction)delegate
			{
				DataControl.ColumnsCore.CollectionChanged -= ColumnsCore_CollectionChanged;
				DataControl = null;
			});
			unsubscribeDataControl = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeDataControl, (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((DataControl.DataView as GridViewBase)?.AddPropertyChanged(UpdateColumnsAllowHide, GridViewBase.ShowGroupedColumnsProperty), (DataControl.DataView as TableView)?.AddPropertyChanged(UpdateColumnsAllowHide, TableView.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsProperty, TableView.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsProperty, TableView.FixedRightVisibleColumnsProperty, TableView.ShowBandsPanelProperty)), (DataControl.DataView as TreeListView)?.AddPropertyChanged(UpdateColumnsAllowHide, TreeListView.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsProperty, TreeListView.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsProperty, TreeListView.FixedRightVisibleColumnsProperty, TreeListView.ShowBandsPanelProperty)));
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataControl()
		{
			unsubscribeDataControl?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeDataControl = null;
		}

		private void SubscribeBands()
		{
			if (HasBands)
			{
				CachedBandsLayout = DataControl.BandsLayoutCore;
				unsubscribeBands = delegate
				{
					CachedBandsLayout = null;
				};
				unsubscribeBands = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeBands, ((DependencyObject)(object)CachedBandsLayout).AddPropertyChanged(UpdateColumnsAllowHide, BandsLayoutBase.FixedNoneVisibleBandsProperty));
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeBands()
		{
			unsubscribeBands?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeBands = null;
		}

		private void DoIfColumnsNotLocked(Action action)
		{
			DataControlBase dataControl = DataControl;
			if (dataControl == null || !dataControl.ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateColumnsAllowHide(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(UpdateColumnsAllowHide);
		}

		private ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBase CreateDragDropManager(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (HasBands)
			{
				return new ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBands(dataControl);
			}
			return new ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerColumns(dataControl);
		}

		private void FillBands(List<ExtendedColumnChooserColumn> columns, List<ColumnBase> excludedColumns, IBandsOwner owner, IBandsOwner rootBand)
		{
			foreach (BandBase item2 in owner.BandsCore)
			{
				if (!item2.IsServiceColumn())
				{
					SubscribeColumn(item2);
					if (item2.ShowInColumnChooser)
					{
						ExtendedColumnChooserColumn item = new ExtendedColumnChooserColumn(rootBand, item2, IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(item2));
						columns.Add(item);
						FillColumns(columns, excludedColumns, item2, item2.ColumnsCore);
						FillBands(columns, excludedColumns, item2, rootBand);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillColumnsCollection(IBandsOwner bandsOwner, IColumnCollection columns)
		{
			UnsubscribeColumns();
			List<ColumnBase> excludedColumns = new List<ColumnBase>();
			List<ExtendedColumnChooserColumn> list = new List<ExtendedColumnChooserColumn>();
			IBandsOwner rootBand = null;
			if (bandsOwner != null)
			{
				rootBand = bandsOwner;
				FillBands(list, excludedColumns, bandsOwner, rootBand);
			}
			else
			{
				FillColumns(list, excludedColumns, rootBand, columns);
			}
			Columns = list;
			ExcludedColumns = excludedColumns;
			unsubscribeColumns = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeColumns, (UnsubscribeAction)delegate
			{
				Columns = null;
				ExcludedColumns = null;
			});
		}

		private void FillColumns(List<ExtendedColumnChooserColumn> newColumns, List<ColumnBase> excludedColumns, IBandsOwner rootBand, IList columns)
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase item in columns.OfType<ColumnBase>())
			{
				if (!item.IsServiceColumn())
				{
					SubscribeColumn(item);
					if (!item.ShowInColumnChooser)
					{
						excludedColumns.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
					ExtendedColumnChooserColumn extendedColumnChooserColumn = ExtendedColumnChooserColumn.Factory(rootBand, item, IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(item), ref unsubscribeColumns);
					UpdateColumnIsGrouped(extendedColumnChooserColumn);
					newColumns.Add(extendedColumnChooserColumn);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateColumnFixed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(delegate
			{
				Columns.ForEach(delegate(ExtendedColumnChooserColumn column)
				{
					column.UpdateFixed();
				});
				RaiseOnFixedChanged();
			});
		}

		private void UpdateColumnIsGrouped(ExtendedColumnChooserColumn columnModel)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(delegate
			{
				if (columnModel.Source is GridColumn)
				{
					columnModel.IsGrouped = ((GridColumn)columnModel.Source).IsGrouped;
				}
			});
		}

		private void UpdateColumnsAllowHide()
		{
			Columns.ForEach(delegate(ExtendedColumnChooserColumn column)
			{
				column.UpdateAllowHide(IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(column.Source));
				UpdateColumnIsGrouped(column);
			});
		}

		private bool IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(BaseColumn baseColumn)
		{
			if (!(baseColumn is BandBase bandBase))
			{
				return DataControl.DataView.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(baseColumn);
			}
			if (bandBase.ParentBand == null)
			{
				return bandBase.Visible;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SubscribeColumn(BaseColumn baseColumn)
		{
			if (baseColumn != null)
			{
				unsubscribeColumns = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeColumns, (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(((DependencyObject)(object)baseColumn).AddPropertyChanged(UpdateColumnFixed, BaseColumn.FixedProperty), ((DependencyObject)(object)(baseColumn as ColumnBase))?.AddPropertyChanged(ShowInColumnChooserChanged, BaseColumn.ShowInColumnChooserProperty)), ((DependencyObject)(object)(baseColumn as BandBase))?.AddPropertyChanged(ShowInColumnChooserChanged, BaseColumn.ShowInColumnChooserProperty)), ((DependencyObject)(object)(baseColumn as GridColumn))?.AddPropertyChanged(UpdateColumnsAllowHide, GridColumn.IsGroupedProperty)));
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeColumns()
		{
			unsubscribeColumns?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeColumns = null;
		}

		private void ShowInColumnChooserChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			UnsubscribeDataControl();
			UnsubscribeBands();
			HasBands = false;
			DragDropManager = null;
			UnsubscribeColumns();
		}

		private void RaiseOnFixedChanged()
		{
			this.ColumnsFixedStateChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public virtual void HideColumn(BaseColumn column)
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = column as GridColumn;
			bool flag = gridColumn?.IsGrouped ?? false;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (gridColumn.OwnerControl?.DataControlOwner != null && !gridColumn.OwnerControl.DataControlOwner.CanGroupColumn(gridColumn))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (DataControl.DataView.IsLastVisibleColumn(column) || !column.CanStartDragSingleColumn)
			{
				return;
			}
			column.Visible = false;
			if (flag)
			{
				(DataControl as GridControl)?.UngroupBy(gridColumn);
			}
		}
	}

		private void UpdatePreview()
		{
			FormatType = Format?.GetType();
			UpdatePreview<System.Windows.Media.FontFamily>(System.Windows.Controls.Control.FontFamilyProperty, Format.FontFamilyProperty, null);
			UpdatePreview<System.Windows.Media.Brush>(System.Windows.Controls.Control.ForegroundProperty, Format.ForegroundProperty, null);
			UpdatePreview<System.Windows.Media.Brush>(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BackgroundProperty, Format.BackgroundProperty, null);
			UpdatePreview(System.Windows.Controls.Control.FontSizeProperty, Format.FontSizeProperty, 0.0);
			UpdatePreview(System.Windows.Controls.Control.FontStyleProperty, Format.FontStyleProperty, FontStyles.Normal);
			UpdatePreview(System.Windows.Controls.Control.FontWeightProperty, Format.FontWeightProperty, FontWeights.Normal);
		}

		private void UpdatePreview<T>(DependencyProperty previewProperty, DependencyProperty formatProperty, T defaultValue)
		{
			Freezable format = Format;
			Format val = (Format)(object)((format is Format) ? format : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				T val2 = (T)((DependencyObject)(object)val).GetValue(formatProperty);
				if (!object.Equals(val2, defaultValue))
				{
					SetValue(previewProperty, val2);
					return;
				}
			}
			ClearValue(previewProperty);
		}
	}

	internal class SelectionModeHelper
	{
		public static MultiSelectMode ConvertToMultiSelectMode(TableViewSelectMode selectMode)
		{
			return selectMode switch
			{
				TableViewSelectMode.Row => MultiSelectMode.Row, 
				TableViewSelectMode.Cell => MultiSelectMode.Cell, 
				_ => MultiSelectMode.None, 
			};
		}

		public static MultiSelectMode ConvertToMultiSelectMode(CardViewSelectMode selectMode)
		{
			if (selectMode == CardViewSelectMode.Row)
			{
				return MultiSelectMode.Row;
			}
			return MultiSelectMode.None;
		}
	}

	public class NavigationRowConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0 || values[0] == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = values[0] as DataViewBase;
			TableView tableView = dataViewBase as TableView;
			if (dataViewBase != null && dataViewBase.DataControl != null)
			{
				LocalizationDescriptor localizationDescriptor = dataViewBase.LocalizationDescriptor;
				string value = localizationDescriptor.GetValue("NavigationRecord");
				int num = dataViewBase.DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
				if (tableView != null && tableView.ActualNewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom && num > 0)
				{
					num--;
				}
				int focusedRowHandle = dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle;
				if (focusedRowHandle == int.MinValue || focusedRowHandle == -2147483645 || num == 0)
				{
					return string.Format(value, 0, num);
				}
				if (focusedRowHandle == -2147483647)
				{
					return string.Format(value, num + 1, num + 1);
				}
				int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(focusedRowHandle);
				return string.Format(value, rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore + 1, num);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class DisplayedNavigationConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			NavigatorButtonType navigatorButtonType = (NavigatorButtonType)Enum.Parse(typeof(NavigatorButtonType), parameter.ToString());
			NavigatorButtonType navigatorButtonType2 = (NavigatorButtonType)value;
			return navigatorButtonType switch
			{
				NavigatorButtonType.AddNewRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.AddNewRow) != NavigatorButtonType.AddNewRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.DeleteFocusedRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.DeleteFocusedRow) != NavigatorButtonType.DeleteFocusedRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.EditFocusedRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.EditFocusedRow) != NavigatorButtonType.EditFocusedRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.MoveFirstRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.MoveFirstRow) != NavigatorButtonType.MoveFirstRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.MoveLastRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.MoveLastRow) != NavigatorButtonType.MoveLastRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.MoveNextPage => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.MoveNextPage) != NavigatorButtonType.MoveNextPage) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.MoveNextRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.MoveNextRow) != NavigatorButtonType.MoveNextRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.MovePrevPage => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.MovePrevPage) != NavigatorButtonType.MovePrevPage) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				NavigatorButtonType.MovePrevRow => ((navigatorButtonType2 & NavigatorButtonType.MovePrevRow) != NavigatorButtonType.MovePrevRow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible, 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
			};
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class FitContentContainerConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(values[0] is TotalSummaryPosition) || !(values[1] is double) || !(values[2] is bool) || !(values[3] is Visibility))
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return ConvertCore((TotalSummaryPosition)values[0], (double)values[1], (bool)values[2], (Visibility)values[3]);
		}

		private Visibility ConvertCore(TotalSummaryPosition totalSummaryPosition, double fixedRightContentWidth, bool extendScrollBarToFixedColumns, Visibility comutedVerticalScrollBarVisibility)
		{
			if (totalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Bottom && (fixedRightContentWidth == 0.0 || extendScrollBarToFixedColumns))
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return comutedVerticalScrollBarVisibility;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public class SelectionStateToMarginBackgroundConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length != 2)
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			if (!(values[0] is SelectionState))
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			switch ((SelectionState)values[0])
			{
			case SelectionState.None:
			case SelectionState.CellMerge:
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			case SelectionState.Focused:
			case SelectionState.Selected:
			case SelectionState.FocusedAndSelected:
			case SelectionState.Highlighted:
				if (values[1] is CardView)
				{
					return new Thickness(0.0, -1.0, 0.0, -1.0);
				}
				return new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
			default:
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public abstract class CompactPanelConverterBase
	{
		protected bool IsCompactMode { get; set; }

		protected bool ActualShowCompactPanel { get; set; }

		protected HeaderPosition HeaderPosition { get; set; }

		protected object Header { get; set; }

		protected SearchPanelPosition? SearchPanelPosition { get; set; }

		protected bool GetValues(object[] values)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length < 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (values[0] is bool && values[1] is bool && values[2] is HeaderPosition)
			{
				IsCompactMode = (bool)values[0];
				ActualShowCompactPanel = (bool)values[1];
				HeaderPosition = (HeaderPosition)values[2];
				Header = values[3];
				if (values.Length >= 5 && values[4] is SearchPanelPosition)
				{
					SearchPanelPosition = (SearchPanelPosition)values[4];
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class CompactPanelGridColumnConverter : CompactPanelConverterBase, IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!GetValues(values))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!base.ActualShowCompactPanel)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.CompactPanel)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.SearchPanel && !base.IsCompactMode)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class CompactPanelGridColumnSpanConverter : CompactPanelConverterBase, IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!GetValues(values))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (!base.ActualShowCompactPanel)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.CompactPanel)
			{
				return base.IsCompactMode ? 2 : ((base.SearchPanelPosition != DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.SearchPanelPosition.Default) ? 1 : 2);
			}
			if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.SearchPanel && !base.IsCompactMode)
			{
				return (base.SearchPanelPosition != DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.SearchPanelPosition.Default) ? 1 : 2;
			}
			return base.IsCompactMode ? 3 : ((base.SearchPanelPosition == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.SearchPanelPosition.Default) ? 3 : 2);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class SearchPanelGridColumnConverter : CompactPanelConverterBase, IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!GetValues(values))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (base.SearchPanelPosition == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.SearchPanelPosition.Default)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.SearchPanel)
			{
				if (base.ActualShowCompactPanel && !base.IsCompactMode)
				{
					return 2;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			if (base.ActualShowCompactPanel && !base.IsCompactMode)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!GetValues(values))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (base.SearchPanelPosition == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.SearchPanelPosition.Default)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.SearchPanel)
			{
				if (base.ActualShowCompactPanel && !base.IsCompactMode)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 2;
			}
			if (base.ActualShowCompactPanel)
			{
				if (base.Header != null && base.HeaderPosition == HeaderPosition.SearchPanel)
				{
					return (!base.IsCompactMode) ? 1 : 2;
				}
				return (!base.IsCompactMode) ? 1 : 3;
			}
			return 3;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();

	public class HeaderVisibilityConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is bool) || !(values[1] is SearchPanelPosition))
			{

			bool flag = (bool)values[0];
			if ((SearchPanelPosition)values[1] == SearchPanelPosition.Default)
			{
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return (!flag) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
		}

			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public class SortOrderConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (values == null || values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is ColumnSortOrder) || !(values[1] is AllowedSortOrders))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ListSortDirection listSortDirection = (((int)(ColumnSortOrder)values[0] == 1) ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
			ListSortDirection actualDirection = GridSortInfo.GetActualDirection((AllowedSortOrders)values[1], listSortDirection);
			return listSortDirection == actualDirection;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class BandSeparatorAddWidthConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public double Value { get; set; }

		public BandSeparatorAddWidthConverter()
		{
			Value = 1.0;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is double && (double)value > 0.0)
			{
				return (double)value + Value;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

	public class SearchPanelShowButtonVisibilityConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length != 3 || !(values[0] is bool) || !(values[1] is SearchPanelPosition) || !(values[2] is ShowSearchPanelMode))
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			bool flag = (bool)values[0];
			SearchPanelPosition searchPanelPosition = (SearchPanelPosition)values[1];
			ShowSearchPanelMode showSearchPanelMode = (ShowSearchPanelMode)values[2];
			if (!flag && searchPanelPosition == SearchPanelPosition.Default && showSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Never && showSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Always)

	public class SearchPanelWidthConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public int Delta { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is double) || !(values[1] is double))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double panelWidth = (double)values[0];
			double maxWidth = (double)values[1];
			return GetWidth(panelWidth, maxWidth);
		}

		private double GetWidth(double panelWidth, double maxWidth)
		{
			return Math.Max((panelWidth >= maxWidth + (double)Delta) ? maxWidth : (panelWidth - (double)Delta), 0.0);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public struct DataControllerLazyValuesContainer
	{
		private GridViewBase view;

		private int? rowHandle;

		private int? listSourceIndex;

		private GridControl Grid => view.Grid;

		public int RowHandle
		{
			get
			{
				if (!rowHandle.HasValue)
				{
					rowHandle = Grid.GetRowHandleByListIndex(ListSourceIndex);
				}
				return rowHandle.Value;
			}
		}

		public int ListSourceIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (!listSourceIndex.HasValue)
				{
					listSourceIndex = ((RowHandle == int.MinValue) ? int.MinValue : Grid.GetListIndexByRowHandle(RowHandle));
				}
				return listSourceIndex.Value;
			}
		}

		public DataControllerLazyValuesContainer(GridViewBase view, int? rowHandle, int? listSourceIndex)
		{
			this.view = view;
			if ((rowHandle.HasValue && listSourceIndex.HasValue) || (!rowHandle.HasValue && !listSourceIndex.HasValue))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("rowHandle, listSourceIndex");
			}
			this.rowHandle = rowHandle;
			this.listSourceIndex = listSourceIndex;
		}

		internal object GetRow()
		{
			return Grid.GetRow(RowHandle);
		}
	}

		}

		internal override void AssignFrom(RowsContainer parentRowsContainer, NodeContainer parentNodeContainer, RowNode rowNode, bool forceUpdate)
		{
			base.AssignFrom(parentRowsContainer, parentNodeContainer, rowNode, forceUpdate);
			if (MatchKeyCore != null && !MatchKeyCore.RowHandle.Equals(RowHandle))
			{
				MatchKeyCore = new GroupSummaryRowKey(RowHandle, Level);
			}
		}

		protected double GetExpandDetailHeaderWidth()
		{
			return base.TableView.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidth;
		}

		internal override void UpdateLineLevel()
		{
			int value = RowHandle.Value;
			bool flag = base.View.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowExpanded(value);
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			int num = parentNodeContainer.Items.IndexOf(node);
			if (parentNodeContainer == base.View.RootNodeContainer && num == parentNodeContainer.Items.Count - 1)
			{
				int footerPosition;
				if (!flag)
				{
					footerPosition = 3;
				}
				else
				{
					RowPosition rowPosition = (FooterPosition = RowPosition.Bottom);
					footerPosition = (int)rowPosition;
				}
				FooterPosition = (RowPosition)footerPosition;
				return;
			}
			if (num > -1)
			{
				if (num < parentNodeContainer.Items.Count - 1 && !(parentNodeContainer.Items[num + 1] is GroupSummaryRowNode))
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (num > 0 && parentNodeContainer.Items[num - 1] is GroupNode)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag || Level == ((DataController)base.View.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo.LevelCount - 1)
			{
				FooterPosition = ((flag2 && flag3) ? RowPosition.Single : RowPosition.Top);
			}
			else if (flag2 && flag)
			{
				FooterPosition = RowPosition.Bottom;
			}
			else
			{
				FooterPosition = RowPosition.Middle;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExtractGridGroupSummaryItem(SummaryItemBase summary)
		{
			if (summary is GridSummaryItem gridSummaryItem)
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(gridSummaryItem.ShowInGroupColumnFooter);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal static class GroupSummaryLayoutCalculator
	{
		internal static bool IsFirstColumn(ColumnBase column, RowData rowData)
		{
			if (column.ParentBand != null)
			{
				if (rowData.View != null && rowData.View.DataControl != null && rowData.View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
				{
					if (IsFirstBand(column.ParentBand) && column.BandRow != null && column.BandRow.Columns[0] == column)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> ownedColumns = GetOwnedColumns(column, rowData);
			if (ownedColumns != null && ownedColumns.Count > 0)
			{
				return ownedColumns[0] == column;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsFirstBand(BandBase band)
		{
			while (band != null)
			{
				if (band.ActualVisibleIndex != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				band = band.ParentBand;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static IList<ColumnBase> GetOwnedColumns(ColumnBase column, RowData rowData)
		{
			if (rowData == null || rowData.VisualDataTreeBuilder == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> fixedLeftColumns = rowData.VisualDataTreeBuilder.GetFixedLeftColumns();
			if (fixedLeftColumns != null && fixedLeftColumns.Count > 0)
			{
				return fixedLeftColumns;
			}
			return rowData.VisualDataTreeBuilder.GetFixedNoneColumns();
		}

		internal static bool IsFirstVisibleColumn(ColumnBase column, RowData rowData, bool checkFirstBand = false)
		{
			if (column == null || column.View == null || rowData == null || rowData.VisualDataTreeBuilder == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITableView tableView = column.View as ITableView;
			IList<ColumnBase> fixedLeftColumns = rowData.VisualDataTreeBuilder.GetFixedLeftColumns();
			if (fixedLeftColumns != null && fixedLeftColumns.Count > 0)
			{
				return column == fixedLeftColumns[0];
			}
			if (tableView == null || tableView.ViewportVisibleColumns == null || tableView.ViewportVisibleColumns.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (checkFirstBand && column.ParentBand != null && !IsFirstBand(column.ParentBand))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return column == tableView.ViewportVisibleColumns[0];
		}
	}
	public class GroupFooterBandsNoneDropPanel : BandsNoneDropPanel

				num -= RowData.Offset + ((ITableView)RowData.View).TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.ActualLeftDataAreaIndent;
			}
			return num;
		}

		}

			return RowData.GetTreeColumnOffset(column);
		}

			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<EditFormControl>.New().Register<EditFormLayoutSettings>("LayoutSettings", ref LayoutSettingsProperty, EditFormLayoutSettings.Empty, (Action<EditFormControl>)delegate(EditFormControl d)
			{
				d.UpdateGridPanel();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(EditFormControl);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<EditFormControl>();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((ItemsControlBase)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateGridPanel();
		}

		private void UpdateGridPanel()
		{
			if (GridPanel != null)
			{
				GridPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Clear();
				GridPanel.RowDefinitions.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < LayoutSettings.ColumnCount; i++)
				{
					GridPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = ((i % 2 == 0) ? GridLength.Auto : GridControlHelper.starGridLength)
					});
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < LayoutSettings.RowCount; j++)
				{
					GridPanel.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition
					{
						Height = GridLength.Auto
					});
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateElement(FrameworkElement element, object item)
		{
			((CachedItemsControl)this).ValidateElement(element, item);
			if (item is EditFormCellDataBase editFormCellDataBase)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumn(element, editFormCellDataBase.Column);
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRow(element, editFormCellDataBase.Row);
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumnSpan(element, editFormCellDataBase.ColumnSpan);
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRowSpan(element, editFormCellDataBase.RowSpan);
			}
		}
	}

	public class EditFormEditor : ContentPresenter
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty EditFormCellDataProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FieldNameProperty;

		private IBaseEdit editorCore;

		public EditFormCellData EditFormCellData
		{
			get

				return (EditFormCellData)GetValue(EditFormCellDataProperty);
			}
			set

			}
		}

		public string FieldName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(FieldNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FieldNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal IBaseEdit Editor
		{
			get
			{
				return editorCore;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (editorCore != value)
				{
					OnEditorChanged(editorCore, value);
					editorCore = value;
				}
			}
		}

		static EditFormEditor()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<EditFormEditor>.New().Register<EditFormCellData>("EditFormCellData", ref EditFormCellDataProperty, (EditFormCellData)null, (Action<EditFormEditor, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnEditFormCellDataChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<string>("FieldName", ref FieldNameProperty, (string)null, (Action<EditFormEditor, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnFieldNameChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		private static void OnEditFormCellDataChanged(EditFormEditor sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			sender.OnEditFormCellDataChanged(args.OldValue as EditFormCellData);
		}

		private static void OnFieldNameChanged(EditFormEditor sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			sender.InvalidateFieldData();
		}

		private void OnEditFormCellDataChanged(EditFormCellData oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.PropertyChanged -= OnDataPropertyChanged;
				oldValue.ValueChangedEvent -= OnValueChanged;
			}
			if (EditFormCellData != null)
			{
				EditFormCellData.PropertyChanged += OnDataPropertyChanged;
				EditFormCellData.ValueChangedEvent += OnValueChanged;
			}
			OnDataChanged();
		}

		private void OnDataPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "ValidationError")
			{
				ValidateEditor();
			}
			if (Editor != null && e.PropertyName == "ReadOnly")
			{
				Editor.IsReadOnly = EditFormCellData.ReadOnly;
			}
		}

		private void OnValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				Editor.EditValue = EditFormCellData.Value;
			}
		}

		public EditFormEditor()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.DataContextChanged += OnDataContextChanged;
			base.ContentTemplate = null;
			base.ContentTemplateSelector = null;
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			ProcessKey(e.Key);
		}

		protected void ProcessKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key == Key.Return && Editor != null && Editor.IsEditorActive)
			{
				MoveNext();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void MoveNext()
		{
			MoveFocus(isReverse: false);
		}

		internal virtual void MovePrev()
		{
			MoveFocus(isReverse: true);
		}

		private void MoveFocus(bool isReverse)
		{
			MoveFocusHelper.MoveFocus((FrameworkElement)this, isReverse);
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Editor != null && EditFormCellData != null && EditFormCellData.VisibleIndex == 0)
			{
				((IInputElement)Editor).Focus();
			}
		}

		private void OnDataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateFieldData();
		}

		private void InvalidateFieldData()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FieldName) && base.DataContext is EditFormRowData editFormRowData)
			{
				EditFormCellData editorData = editFormRowData.GetEditorData(FieldName);
				if (editorData != null)
				{
					EditFormCellData = editorData;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (base.ContentTemplate != null)
			{
				object obj = base.ContentTemplate.FindName("PART_Editor", this);
				IBaseEdit val = (IBaseEdit)((obj is IBaseEdit) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					Editor = val;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDataChanged()
		{
			if (EditFormCellData == null)
			{
				Reset();
				return;
			}
			if (EditFormCellData.EditorTemplate != null)
			{
				base.Content = EditFormCellData;
				base.ContentTemplate = EditFormCellData.EditorTemplate;
				return;
			}
			Reset();
			Editor = EditFormCellData.EditSettings.With((BaseEditSettings s) => s.CreateEditor(ShouldAssignEditorSettings(s), EditFormCellData.EditorViewInfo, (EditorOptimizationMode)0));
			base.Content = Editor;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldAssignEditorSettings(BaseEditSettings editSettings)
		{
			return !(editSettings is LookUpEditSettingsBase);
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			if (base.Content != null)
			{
				base.Content = null;
			}
			if (base.ContentTemplate != null)
			{
				base.ContentTemplate = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorChanged(IBaseEdit oldValue, IBaseEdit newValue)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnEditValueChanged);
			}
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			newValue.EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnEditValueChanged);
			newValue.EditValue = EditFormCellData.Value;
			if (EditFormCellData.ReadOnly)
			{
				newValue.IsReadOnly = true;
			}
			BaseEdit val = (BaseEdit)(object)((newValue is BaseEdit) ? newValue : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (!EditFormCellData.ReadOnly && EditFormCellData.IsReadOnlyBinding != null && BindingOperations.GetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, BaseEdit.IsReadOnlyProperty) == null)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val).SetBinding(BaseEdit.IsReadOnlyProperty, EditFormCellData.IsReadOnlyBinding);
				}
				if (EditFormCellData.IsEnabledBinding != null && BindingOperations.GetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty) == null)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val).SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, EditFormCellData.IsEnabledBinding);
				}
			}
			ValidateEditorCore(newValue);
		}

		private void ValidateEditor()
		{
			ValidateEditorCore(Editor);
		}

		private void ValidateEditorCore(IBaseEdit editor)
		{
			if (editor != null && EditFormCellData != null)
			{
				editor.ValidationError = EditFormCellData.ValidationError;
				BaseEditHelper.UpdateErrorTooltip(editor);
			}
		}

		private void OnEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IBaseEdit val = (IBaseEdit)sender;
			if (EditFormCellData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			EditFormRowData rowData = EditFormCellData.RowData;
			if (rowData == null || rowData.EditFormOwner == null || rowData.EditFormOwner.IsEditing)
			{
				bool flag = val.DoValidate();
				EditFormCellData.HasInnerError = !flag;
				if (val.EditValue != EditFormCellData.Value)
				{
					EditFormCellData.Value = val.EditValue;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class EditFormCellTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate CaptionTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate EditorTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (!(item is IEditFormLayoutItem { ItemType: var itemType } editFormLayoutItem))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (editFormLayoutItem.ItemType == EditFormLayoutItemType.Caption)
			{
				return CaptionTemplate;
			}
			if (editFormLayoutItem.ItemType == EditFormLayoutItemType.Editor)
			{
				return EditorTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		{

		private void OnColumnHeaderChanged()
		{
			GroupColumnHeaderText = $"{ColumnHeader}: ";
			UpdateText();
		}

		private void OnTextChanged()
		{
			UpdateText();
		}

		private void OnHighlightingPropertiesChanged()
		{
			UpdateText();
		}

		private List<GridColumn> GetMergeColumns()
		{
			GridViewBase gridView = base.View as GridViewBase;
			if (gridView == null || gridView.SortInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = ((GridViewBase)base.View).SortInfo[base.Column.FieldName];
			if (gridSortInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)gridView.SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(gridSortInfo, gridView.SortInfo.GroupCount);
			if (mergeSortInfo == null)
			{
				return new List<GridColumn> { (GridColumn)base.Column };
			}
			return mergeSortInfo.Select((GridSortInfo x) => gridView.Columns[x.FieldName]).ToList();
		}

		private void UpdateText()
		{
			DisplayText = GroupColumnHeaderText + Text;
			if ((UpdateTextLocker == null || !UpdateTextLocker.IsLocked) && client != null)
			{
				client.UpdateText();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnColumnChanged(ColumnBase newValue)
		{
			base.OnColumnChanged(newValue);
			GroupRowData rowData = RowData;
			if (rowData != null && (UpdateTextLocker == null || !UpdateTextLocker.IsLocked))
			{
				rowData.UpdateClientGroupValueTemplateSelector();
			}
		}

		internal string GetMergeText()
		{
			if (!ShowSeparator)
			{
				return Text;
			}
			return Text + base.View?.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.MergedGroupsSeparator);
		}
	}

		public int RowHandle => base.RowHandleCore;

		[Description("Gets the column which contains the cell.")]
		public GridColumn Column => (GridColumn)base.ColumnCore;

		[Description("Gets the cell’s value.")]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = GridControl.GetCellValue(RowHandle, Column);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets a row object that contains the cell.")]
		public object Row
		{
			get
			{
				if (row == null)
				{
					row = GridControl.GetRow(RowHandle);
				}
				return row;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the GridControl which owns the current View.")]

	public class ExcelColumnFilterComboBoxFocusBehavior : Behavior<ComboBoxEdit>
	{
		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosed += new ClosePopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosed);
			((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupOpened += AssociatedObject_PopupOpened;
			((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosing += new ClosingPopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosing);
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_PopupOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UIElement child = ((Popup)(object)PopupBaseEditHelper.GetPopup((PopupBaseEdit)(object)base.AssociatedObject)).Child;
			child.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged += Popup_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
		}

		private void Popup_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(bool)e.NewValue && ((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).IsPopupOpen)
			{
				((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).CancelPopup();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosed -= new ClosePopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosed);
			((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupOpened -= AssociatedObject_PopupOpened;
			((PopupBaseEdit)base.AssociatedObject).PopupClosing -= new ClosingPopupEventHandler(AssociatedObject_PopupClosing);
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_PopupClosing(object sender, ClosePopupEventArgs e)
		{
			((Popup)(object)PopupBaseEditHelper.GetPopup((PopupBaseEdit)(object)base.AssociatedObject)).Child.IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged -= Popup_IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged;
		}

		private void RestoreFocus()
		{
			if (((FrameworkElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).Parent is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)BaseEdit.GetOwnerEdit((DependencyObject)frameworkElement))?.Focus();
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_PopupClosed(object sender, ClosePopupEventArgs e)
		{
			RestoreFocus();
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	public class ExcelColumnFilterButtonHeaderBehavior : Behavior<ExcelColumnFilterHeaderButton>
	{
		private ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase info;

		public ExcelColumnFilterType FilterType { get; set; }

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			info = base.AssociatedObject.DataContext as ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase;
			if (info != null)
			{
				info.PropertyChanged += Info_PropertyChanged;
				base.AssociatedObject.Click += AssociatedObject_Click;
				UpdateIsSelected();
			}
		}

		private void Info_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.PropertyName != "FilterType"))
			{
				UpdateIsSelected();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIsSelected()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.IsSelected = info.FilterType == FilterType;
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (info != null)
			{
				info.FilterType = FilterType;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			if (info != null)
			{
				base.AssociatedObject.Click -= AssociatedObject_Click;
				info.PropertyChanged -= Info_PropertyChanged;
				info = null;
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExcelColumnFilterCellTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		private DataTemplate _serviceValueTemplate;

		public DataTemplate ServiceValueTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return _serviceValueTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				_serviceValueTemplate = value;
				DataTemplate serviceValueTemplate = _serviceValueTemplate;
				if (serviceValueTemplate != null && serviceValueTemplate.CheckAccess())
				{
					_serviceValueTemplate.Seal();
				}
			}
		}

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (ServiceValueTemplate != null)
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue = ((EditGridCellData)item).RowData.Row as ExcelColumnFilterValue;
				if (excelColumnFilterValue is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase)
				{
					return ServiceValueTemplate;
				}
				if (excelColumnFilterValue != null && excelColumnFilterValue.DisplayValue != null)
				{
					return ServiceValueTemplate;
				}
			}
			return base.SelectTemplate(item, container);
		}
	}

	public class ExcelColumnFilterListBehavior : Behavior<TreeListView>
	{
		private DataControlBase DataControl;

		private bool ForceCalcVisibility;

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			DataControl = base.AssociatedObject.DataControl;
			DataControl.FilterChanged += AssociatedObject_FilterChanged;
			DataControl.ItemsSourceChanged += AssociatedObject_ItemsSourceChanged;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomNodeFilter += View_CustomNodeFilter;
			SubscribeItemsSourceEvents(base.AssociatedObject.DataControl.ItemsSource);
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomColumnDisplayText += AssociatedObject_CustomColumnDisplayText;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomUnboundColumnData += AssociatedObject_CustomUnboundColumnData;
			base.AssociatedObject.EditorInitialized += AssociatedObject_EditorCreated;
			if (DataControl.DataContext is ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase excelColumnFilterInfoBase)
			{
				if (excelColumnFilterInfoBase.Column.ActualHorizontalContentAlignment != System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.AssignEditorSettings = false;
				}
				if (excelColumnFilterInfoBase is ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.ChildNodesPath = excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo.ChildPropertyName;
					excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo.BeginUpdateExpandState += BeginUpdateExpandState;
					excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo.EndUpdateExpandState += EndUpdateExpandState;
					base.AssociatedObject.Unloaded += AssociatedObject_Unloaded;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).Detach();
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_CustomUnboundColumnData(object sender, TreeListUnboundColumnDataEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.Column.FieldName != "SearchValue") && ((TreeListNodeBase)e.Node).Content is ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue)
			{
				if (excelColumnFilterValue.DisplayValue != null)
				{
					e.Value = excelColumnFilterValue.DisplayValue;
				}
				else if (DataControl.DataContext is ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase excelColumnFilterInfoBase)
				{
					e.Value = excelColumnFilterInfoBase.GetDisplayText(excelColumnFilterValue.EditValue, (excelColumnFilterValue.EditValue == null) ? string.Empty : excelColumnFilterValue.EditValue.ToString());
				}
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_EditorCreated(object sender, EditorInitializedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Editor != null && e.Editor.HorizontalContentAlignment != System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left)
			{
				e.Editor.HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}
		}

		private void View_CustomNodeFilter(object sender, TreeListNodeFilterEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(((TreeListNodeBase)e.Node).Content is ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (excelColumnFilterValue is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase)
			{
				e.Visible = excelColumnFilterValue.IsVisible;
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			if (ForceCalcVisibility)
			{
				excelColumnFilterValue.SetIsVisible(e.CalcVisibility());
			}
			e.Visible = excelColumnFilterValue.IsVisible;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_FilterChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject.DataContext is ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase excelColumnFilterInfoBase)
			{
				excelColumnFilterInfoBase.UpdateValuesFilter();
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeItemsSourceEvents(object itemsSource)
		{
			if (itemsSource is ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase excelColumnFilterValuesListBase)
			{
				excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.BeginSelection += beginSelection;
				excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.EndSelection += endSelection;
				ForceCalcVisibility = excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.ForceCalcVisibility;
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribeItemsSourceEvents(object itemsSource)
		{
			if (itemsSource is ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase excelColumnFilterValuesListBase)
			{
				excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.BeginSelection -= beginSelection;
				excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.EndSelection -= endSelection;
				ForceCalcVisibility = false;
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_ItemsSourceChanged(object sender, ItemsSourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnSubscribeItemsSourceEvents(e.OldItemsSource);
			SubscribeItemsSourceEvents(e.NewItemsSource);
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_CustomColumnDisplayText(object sender, TreeListCustomColumnDisplayTextEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject.DataContext is ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase excelColumnFilterInfoBase)
			{
				e.DisplayText = excelColumnFilterInfoBase.GetDisplayText(e.Value, e.DisplayText);
			}
		}

		private void beginSelection(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				base.AssociatedObject.DataControl.BeginDataUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void endSelection(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				base.AssociatedObject.DataControl.EndDataUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void BeginUpdateExpandState(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				base.AssociatedObject.DataControl.BeginDataUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void EndUpdateExpandState(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				base.AssociatedObject.SaveNodesState();
				base.AssociatedObject.DataControl.EndDataUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.Unloaded -= AssociatedObject_Unloaded;
			base.AssociatedObject.EditorInitialized -= AssociatedObject_EditorCreated;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomNodeFilter -= View_CustomNodeFilter;
			DataControl.FilterChanged -= AssociatedObject_FilterChanged;
			DataControl.ItemsSourceChanged -= AssociatedObject_ItemsSourceChanged;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomColumnDisplayText -= AssociatedObject_CustomColumnDisplayText;
			base.AssociatedObject.CustomUnboundColumnData -= AssociatedObject_CustomUnboundColumnData;
			UnSubscribeItemsSourceEvents(DataControl.ItemsSource);
			if (DataControl.DataContext is ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo)
			{
				excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo.BeginUpdateExpandState -= BeginUpdateExpandState;
				excelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo.EndUpdateExpandState -= EndUpdateExpandState;
			}
			DataControl = null;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}
	}
	public class ExcelColumnFilterMouseClickBehavior : Behavior<TreeListView>
	{
		private int currentRowHandle = int.MinValue;

		private FrameworkElement cellElement;

		private bool isPressed;

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.MouseLeftButtonDown += AssociatedObject_MouseLeftButtonDown;
			base.AssociatedObject.MouseLeftButtonUp += AssociatedObject_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			base.AssociatedObject.MouseMove += AssociatedObject_MouseMove;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.MouseLeftButtonDown -= AssociatedObject_MouseLeftButtonDown;
			base.AssociatedObject.MouseLeftButtonUp -= AssociatedObject_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			base.AssociatedObject.MouseMove -= AssociatedObject_MouseMove;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private void UpdateIsPressed()
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.PrimaryDevice.GetPosition(cellElement);
			isPressed = position.X >= 0.0 && position.X <= cellElement.ActualWidth && position.Y >= 0.0 && position.Y <= cellElement.ActualHeight;
		}

		private void ReleaseState()
		{
			cellElement = null;
			isPressed = false;
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			currentRowHandle = base.AssociatedObject.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e);
			if (currentRowHandle != int.MinValue)
			{
				cellElement = base.AssociatedObject.GetCellElementByMouseEventArgs(e);
				if (cellElement != null)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
					cellElement.CaptureMouse();
					isPressed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (cellElement != null && cellElement.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				UpdateIsPressed();
			}
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (cellElement == null || !cellElement.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				return;
			}
			cellElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			if (!isPressed)
			{
				ReleaseState();
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement cellElementByMouseEventArgs = base.AssociatedObject.GetCellElementByMouseEventArgs(e);
			if (cellElement != cellElementByMouseEventArgs)
			{
				ReleaseState();
				return;
			}
			ReleaseState();
			if (currentRowHandle == base.AssociatedObject.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e))
			{
				if (base.AssociatedObject.FocusedRowHandle != currentRowHandle)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.FocusedRowHandle = currentRowHandle;
				}
				if (base.AssociatedObject.Navigation is TreeListViewRowNavigation treeListViewRowNavigation)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
					treeListViewRowNavigation.OnSpace();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class ExcelColumnFilterPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LastChildFilledProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildMinWidthProperty;

		public bool LastChildFilled
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(LastChildFilledProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LastChildFilledProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ChildMinWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ChildMinWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChildMinWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ExcelColumnFilterPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ExcelColumnFilterPanel);
			LastChildFilledProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LastChildFilled", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			ChildMinWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChildMinWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = availableSize;
			double num = ChildMinWidth;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!LastChildFilled || i != base.Children.Count - 1)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = base.Children[i];
					uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
					availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, Math.Max(1.0, availableSize.Height - uIElement.DesiredSize.Height));
					num = Math.Max(num, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
			}
			if (LastChildFilled && base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				UIElement uIElement2 = base.Children[base.Children.Count - 1];
				double contentWidth = GetContentWidth(availableSize, num);
				System.Windows.Size availableSize3 = new System.Windows.Size(contentWidth, availableSize2.Height);
				uIElement2.Measure(availableSize3);
				num = Math.Max(uIElement2.DesiredSize.Width, num);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, availableSize.Height);
		}

		private double GetContentWidth(System.Windows.Size availableSize, double maxWidth)
		{
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				return availableSize.Width;
			}
			return Math.Max(ChildMinWidth, maxWidth);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = finalSize;
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, finalSize.Height - size.Height, size.Width, size.Height));
				size = new System.Windows.Size(size.Width, Math.Max(1.0, size.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public class ExcelColumnFilterSearchNullTextConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public string Simple { get; set; }

		public string DateAll { get; set; }

		public string DateYear { get; set; }

		public string DateMonth { get; set; }

		public string DateDay { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase excelColumnFilterInfoBase = values[0] as ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase;
			LocalizationDescriptor localizationDescriptor = excelColumnFilterInfoBase.Column.View.LocalizationDescriptor;
			string name = null;
			if (!excelColumnFilterInfoBase.ShowSearchPanelScopeSelector)
			{
				name = Simple;
			}
			else if (!(values[1] is ExcelDateColumnFilterScope))
			{
				name = Simple;
			}
			else
			{
				switch ((ExcelDateColumnFilterScope)values[1])
				{
				case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.All:
					name = DateAll;
					break;
				case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Year:
					name = DateYear;
					break;
				case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Month:
					name = DateMonth;
					break;
				case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Day:
					name = DateDay;
					break;
				}
			}
			return localizationDescriptor.GetValue(name);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

			{
				((ExcelCustomFilterOperandBehaviorBase<T>)(object)d).UpdateClauseAndEditor();
			}));
			OperandCaptionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OperandCaption", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		}

		private void AssociatedObject_DataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateClauseAndEditor();
		}

		private void UpdateClauseAndEditor()
		{
			CleanEditor();
			if (((Behavior<T>)this).AssociatedObject == null)
			{
				Clause = null;
				return;
			}
			Clause = ((Behavior<T>)this).AssociatedObject.DataContext as ExcelCustomFilterClause;
			if (Clause == null)
			{
				if (CustomFilterInfo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Clause = CustomFilterInfo.Clause;
			}
			CreateEditor();
		}

		protected sealed override void OnDetaching()
		{
			CleanEditor();
			((Behavior<T>)this).AssociatedObject.DataContextChanged -= AssociatedObject_DataContextChanged;
			((Behavior<T>)this).AssociatedObject.Content = null;
			Clause = null;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		protected abstract void CreateEditor();

		protected abstract void CleanEditor();
	}

			: base(clause, editValuePath, nullTextLocalizationKey)

			ComboBox.CreateComboBoxEdit(SetupComboBox);
			UpdateComboBoxItems();
		}

		{
			base.CleanEditor();
			ComboBox = null;
		}

		private void UpdateComboBoxItems()
		{
			bool isColumnFilterItemsLoading = false;
			ColumnBase column = Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column;
			IList columnFilterItems = Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Info.GetColumnFilterItems(Clause.CustomFilterInfo.CopyValues(), CreateFilterList, SortColumnFilterItems, ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetIncludeFilteredOut(column), column.RoundDateTimeForColumnFilter, column.View.DataControl.ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, addNullItem: false, out isColumnFilterItemsLoading);
			ComboBox.UpdateItems(Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column.View, isColumnFilterItemsLoading, columnFilterItems);
		}

		private void SortColumnFilterItems(object[] values)
		{
			ColumnFilterInfoHelper.SortComboBoxItems(values, Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column, ComboBox.ComboBoxEditSettings, (object value) => Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Info.GetItem(ComboBox, value, Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column.View.DataControl.ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering));
		}

		private IList CreateFilterList()
		{
			return ColumnFilterInfoHelper.CreateFilterList(Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column.View, Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column);
		}

		private void SetupComboBox(ComboBoxEdit comboBoxEdit)
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((BaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).EditMode = (EditMode)0;
			((ButtonEdit)comboBoxEdit).ShowText = true;
			((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).ApplyItemTemplateToSelectedItem = false;
			((ButtonEdit)comboBoxEdit).IsTextEditable = Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Info is ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo;
			((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).AutoComplete = true;
			((BaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).StyleSettings = (BaseEditStyleSettings)new ComboBoxStyleSettings();
			((BaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).ShowNullText = true;
			((BaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).NullText = Clause.CustomFilterInfo.Column.View.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(NullTextLocalizationKey);
		}
	}

	public class ExcelCustonFilterEditorTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate DateTimeTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate NumericTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate ObjectEditableTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate ObjectNonEditableTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (item is ExcelCustomFilterClause excelCustomFilterClause)
			{
				FilterColumn val = FilterClauseHelper.CreateFilterColumn(excelCustomFilterClause.CustomFilterInfo.Column);
				if (SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsNumericalType(val.ColumnType))
				{
					return NumericTemplate;
				}
				if (SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsDateTime(val.ColumnType))
				{
					return DateTimeTemplate;
				}
				ClauseType operation = excelCustomFilterClause.Operation;
				switch (operation - 10)
				{
				case 0:
				case 2:
				case 3:
					return ObjectEditableTemplate;
				default:
					return ObjectNonEditableTemplate;
				}
			}
			return base.SelectTemplate(item, container);
		}
	}

		private IEnumerable<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> FilterElements => from x in UpperFilterElements.Concat(BottomFilterElements)

		private IEnumerable<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> BottomFilterElements

		private IEnumerable<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> UpperFilterElements

			}
		}
