				(d as CalendarFilterControl).OnOwnerChanged();
			}));
			DateFilterStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DateFilterStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(CalendarFilterControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ShowDateNavigatorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowDateNavigator", typeof(bool), typeof(CalendarFilterControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			AllowDateNavigatorMultipleRangesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowDateNavigatorMultipleRanges", typeof(bool), typeof(CalendarFilterControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<CalendarFilterControl>();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Unsubscribe();
			upperFiltersPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_UpperFiltersPanel") as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
			bottomFiltersPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_BottomFiltersPanel") as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
			ref DateNavigator reference = ref dateNavigator;
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_DateNavigator");
			reference = (DateNavigator)(object)((templateChild is DateNavigator) ? templateChild : null);
			if (dateNavigator != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)dateNavigator).Visibility = ((!ShowDateNavigator) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				dateNavigator.AllowMultipleRanges = AllowDateNavigatorMultipleRanges;
			}
			PopulateUpperFilters();
			PopulateBottomFilters();
			Subscribe();
		}

		private void Subscribe()
		{
			SubscribeShowAll();
			SubscribeFilterBySpecificDate();
			SubscribeDateNavigator();
			SubscribeFilters();
		}

		private void SubscribeDateNavigator()
		{
			if (dateNavigator != null)
			{
				dateNavigator.SelectedDatesChanged += OnSelectedDatesChanged;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeFilters()
		{
			ForEachFilterElement(SubscribeFilter);
		}

		private void SubscribeFilter(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox filter)
		{
			if (filter != null)
			{
				filter.Checked += OnFilterChecked;
				filter.Unchecked += OnFilterUnchecked;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeShowAll()
		{
			if (cbShowAll != null)
			{
				cbShowAll.Checked += OnShowAll;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeFilterBySpecificDate()
		{
			if (cbFilterBySpecificDate != null)
			{
				cbFilterBySpecificDate.Checked += OnFilterBySpecificDate;
				cbFilterBySpecificDate.Unchecked += OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked;
			}
		}

		private void Unsubscribe()
		{
			UnsubscribeShowAll();
			UnsubscribeFilterBySpecificDate();
			UnsubscribeDateNavigator();
			UnsubscribeFilters();
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDateNavigator()
		{
			if (dateNavigator != null)
			{
				dateNavigator.SelectedDatesChanged -= OnSelectedDatesChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFilters()
		{
			ForEachFilterElement(delegate(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox filter)
			{
				UnsubscribeFilter(filter);
			});
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFilter(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox filter)
		{
			if (filter != null)
			{
				filter.Checked -= OnFilterChecked;
				filter.Unchecked -= OnFilterUnchecked;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeShowAll()
		{
			if (cbShowAll != null)
			{
				cbShowAll.Checked -= OnShowAll;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFilterBySpecificDate()
		{
			if (cbFilterBySpecificDate != null)
			{
				cbFilterBySpecificDate.Checked -= OnFilterBySpecificDate;
				cbFilterBySpecificDate.Unchecked -= OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked;
			}
		}

		private void PopulateUpperFilters()
		{
			if (upperFiltersPanel != null && UpperFiltersData != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> source = CreateFilters(UpperFiltersData);
				source.ForEach(delegate(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox x)
				{
					upperFiltersPanel.Children.Add(x);
				});
				cbShowAll = FindShowAll();
				cbFilterBySpecificDate = FindFilterBySpecificDate();
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox FindShowAll()
		{
			return FindFilter(FilterDateType.None);
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox FindFilterBySpecificDate()
		{
			return FindFilter(FilterDateType.SpecificDate);
		}

		private void PopulateBottomFilters()
		{
			if (bottomFiltersPanel != null && BottomFiltersData != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> source = CreateFilters(BottomFiltersData);
				source.ForEach(delegate(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox filter)
				{
					bottomFiltersPanel.Children.Add(filter);
				});
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> CreateFilters(IEnumerable<FilterData> data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox>();
			}
			return data.Select(CreateFilterElement);
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox CreateFilterElement(FilterData filter)
		{
			return new CalendarFilterCheckBox
			{
				Content = filter.Caption,
				ToolTip = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter.Tooltip)) ? filter.Tooltip : null),
				Style = DateFilterStyle,
				Tag = filter,
				IsThreeState = false
			};
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox FindFilter(FilterDateType type)
		{
			return UpperFilterElements.Concat(BottomFilterElements).FirstOrDefault((System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox x) => x.Tag is FilterData && (x.Tag as FilterData).FilterType == type);
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox FindFilter(FilterData filter)
		{
			return FilterElements.FirstOrDefault((System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox x) => x.Tag == filter);
		}

		private FilterData ToFilterData(object filterElement)
		{
			if (!(filterElement is System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox checkBox))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(checkBox.Tag is FilterData result))
			{
				return FilterData.Null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ForEachFilterElement(Action<System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox> visitor)
		{
			FilterElements.ForEach(visitor);
		}

		private void OnOwnerChanged()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.SetCalendarFilter(this);
			}
		}

		private void OnShowAll(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				LockedIfCan(delegate
				{
					Owner.OnShowAll();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterBySpecificDate(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				LockedIfCan(delegate
				{
					Owner.OnFilterBySpecificDateChecked();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				LockedIfCan(delegate
				{
					Owner.OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				LockedIfCan(delegate
				{
					Owner.OnFilterChecked(ToFilterData(sender));
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterUnchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				LockedIfCan(delegate
				{
					Owner.OnFilterUnchecked(ToFilterData(sender));
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedDatesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				LockedIfCan(delegate
				{
					Owner.OnSelectedDatesChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		private void LockedIfCan(Action action)
		{
			eventLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(action);
		}

		private void Locked(Action action)
		{
			eventLocker.DoLockedAction(action);
		}

		public void UncheckAllFilters()
		{
			ForEachFilterElement(delegate(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox x)
			{
				Uncheck(x);
			});
		}

		public void CheckFilters(params FilterData[] filters)
		{
			filters.ForEach(delegate(FilterData x)
			{
				SetFilterChecked(x, @checked: true);
			});
		}

		public void UncheckFilters(params FilterData[] filters)
		{
			filters.ForEach(delegate(FilterData x)
			{
				SetFilterChecked(x, @checked: false);
			});
		}

		private void SetFilterChecked(FilterData filter, bool @checked)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox cb = FindFilter(filter);
			SetChecked(cb, @checked);
		}

		public void CheckShowAll()
		{
			Check(cbShowAll);
		}

		public void UncheckShowAll()
		{
			Uncheck(cbShowAll);
		}

		public void CheckFilterBySpecificDate()
		{
			Check(cbFilterBySpecificDate);
		}

		public void UncheckFilterBySpecificDate()
		{
			Uncheck(cbFilterBySpecificDate);
		}

		private void Check(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox cb)
		{
			SetChecked(cb, @checked: true);
		}

		private void Uncheck(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox cb)
		{
			SetChecked(cb, @checked: false);
		}

		private void SetChecked(System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox cb, bool @checked)
		{
			if (cb != null)
			{
				Locked(delegate
				{
					cb.IsChecked = @checked;
				});
			}
		}

		public void RebuildFilters()
		{
			UnsubscribeFilters();
			ClearBottomFilters();
			PopulateBottomFilters();
			SubscribeFilters();
		}

		private void ClearBottomFilters()
		{
			if (bottomFiltersPanel != null)
			{
				bottomFiltersPanel.Children.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Unsubscribe();
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.SetCalendarFilter(null);
				Owner = null;
				ClearValue(OwnerProperty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class DateAltColumnFilterInfo : DateCompactColumnFilterInfo
	{
		private class DatesCache
		{
			private DateTime[] data;

			public bool HasData
			{
				get
				{
					if (data != null)
					{
						return data.Length != 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public IList<DateTime> Data => new ReadOnlyCollection<DateTime>(data ?? new DateTime[0]);

			public void Store(IList<DateTime> dates)
			{
				if (dates == null || dates.Count == 0)
				{
					Dirty();
					return;
				}
				data = new DateTime[dates.Count];
				dates.CopyTo(data, 0);
			}

			public void Dirty()
			{
				data = null;
			}
		}

		private readonly DatesCache selectedDatesBeforePopupLastClose = new DatesCache();

		public DateAltColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		protected override FilterDateType[] CreateFilters()
		{
			List<FilterDateType> list = new List<FilterDateType>();
			if (base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.Beyond);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAfter2);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAfter1);
			}
			if (base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsNextWeek))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.NextWeek);
			}
			if (base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsToday))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.Today);
			}
			if (base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.ThisWeek);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.ThisMonth);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAgo1);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAgo2);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAgo3);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAgo4);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAgo5);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.MonthAgo6);
				list.Add(FilterDateType.Earlier);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override void ClearPopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			SaveSelectedDates();
			base.ClearPopupData(popup);
		}

		private void SaveSelectedDates()
		{
			if (base.CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				selectedDatesBeforePopupLastClose.Store(base.CalendarFilter.SelectedDates);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateFilterBySpecificDateCheckState()
		{
			if (base.CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				if (!base.IsFiltered || !selectedDatesBeforePopupLastClose.HasData)
				{
					base.CalendarFilter.UncheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				}
				else
				{
					base.CalendarFilter.CheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateSelectedDates()
		{
			if (base.CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				if (!base.IsFiltered)
				{
					base.CalendarFilter.SelectedDates = null;
					return;
				}
				IList<DateTime> data = selectedDatesBeforePopupLastClose.Data;
				base.CalendarFilter.SelectedDates = data;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateFiltersCheckState()
		{
			if (base.CalendarFilterExists && base.IsFiltered)
			{
				if (selectedDatesBeforePopupLastClose.HasData)
				{
					base.CalendarFilter.UncheckAllFilters();
				}
				else
				{
					base.UpdateFiltersCheckState();
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool CanShowFilterPopup()
		{
			if (!base.Column.AllowAnyFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges, AllowedDateTimeFilters.SingleDateRange, AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsToday, AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsNextWeek))
			{
				if (base.Column.ShowEmptyDateFilter)
				{
					return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNull);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DateColumnFilterInfoBase : ColumnFilterInfoBase, ICalendarFilterOwner
	{
		protected DataControlBase Grid => base.View.DataControl;

		protected string FieldName => base.Column.FieldName;

		protected bool IsFiltered => ColumnCriteria != null;

		protected CriteriaOperator ColumnCriteria => Grid.GetColumnFilterCriteria(base.Column);

		private FilterData[] UpperFilters { get; set; }

		private FilterData[] BottomFilters { get; set; }

		private IEnumerable<FilterData> Filters
		{
			get
			{
				FilterData[] first = UpperFilters ?? new FilterData[0];
				FilterData[] second = BottomFilters ?? new FilterData[0];
				return first.Concat(second).Distinct(new AnonymousEqualityComparer<FilterData>((FilterData x, FilterData y) => x.FilterType == y.FilterType, (FilterData x) => x.GetHashCode()));
			}
		}

		protected bool CalendarFilterExists => CalendarFilter != null;

		protected ICalendarFilter CalendarFilter { get; private set; }

		FilterData[] ICalendarFilterOwner.UpperFilters => UpperFilters;

		FilterData[] ICalendarFilterOwner.BottomFilters => BottomFilters;

		public DateColumnFilterInfoBase(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		protected abstract FilterData[] CreateUpperFilters();

		protected abstract FilterData[] CreateBottomFilters();

		internal override PopupBaseEdit CreateColumnFilterPopup()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PopupBaseEdit val = new PopupBaseEdit
			{
				ShowNullText = false,
				IsTextEditable = false
			};
			((FrameworkElement)val).DataContext = this;
			val.PopupContentTemplate = CreatePopupTemplate();
			return val;
		}

		private ControlTemplate CreatePopupTemplate()
		{
			string text = $"ShowDateNavigator=\"{base.Column.AllowAnyFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges, AllowedDateTimeFilters.SingleDateRange)}\"";
			string text2 = $"AllowDateNavigatorMultipleRanges=\"{base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges)}\"";
			string text3 = text + " " + text2;
			string xamlText = "<ControlTemplate xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation\" xmlns:dxg=\"http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/grid\"><dxg:CalendarFilterControl Owner=\"{Binding DataContext, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}\" " + text3 + "/></ControlTemplate>";
			return XamlReader.Parse(xamlText) as ControlTemplate;
		}

		protected override void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			if (UpperFilters == null)
			{
				UpdateUpperFilters();
			}
			if (BottomFilters == null)
			{
				UpdateBottomFilters();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateUpperFilters()
		{
			UpperFilters = CreateUpperFilters();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateBottomFilters()
		{
			BottomFilters = CreateBottomFilters();
		}

		protected override void UpdateSizeGripVisibility(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnPopupOpenedCore(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			UpdateShowAllCheckState();
			UpdateFilterBySpecificDateCheckState();
			UpdateSelectedDates();
			UpdateFiltersCheckState();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateShowAllCheckState()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				if (!IsFiltered)
				{
					CalendarFilter.CheckShowAll();
				}
				else
				{
					CalendarFilter.UncheckShowAll();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateFilterBySpecificDateCheckState()
		{
			if (!CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsFiltered)
			{
				CalendarFilter.UncheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				return;
			}
			DateTime[] array = ColumnCriteria.ToDates(FieldName);
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				CalendarFilter.CheckFilterBySpecificDate();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectedDates()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				if (!IsFiltered)
				{
					CalendarFilter.SelectedDates = null;
					return;
				}
				DateTime[] selectedDates = ColumnCriteria.ToDates(FieldName);
				CalendarFilter.SelectedDates = selectedDates;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateFiltersCheckState()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists && IsFiltered)
			{
				FilterDateType[] types = ColumnCriteria.ToFilters(FieldName);
				FilterData[] filters = MapToFilterData(types);
				CalendarFilter.CheckFilters(filters);
			}
		}

		private FilterData[] MapToFilterData(FilterDateType[] types)
		{
			Dictionary<FilterDateType, FilterData> map = Filters.ToDictionary((FilterData pair) => pair.FilterType);
			return (from x in types
				where map.ContainsKey(x)
				select map[x]).ToArray();
		}

		protected internal override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria()
		{
			return GetCriteria();
		}

		protected override void ClearPopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.Dispose();
				CalendarFilter = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnShowAll()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.CheckShowAll();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckAllFilters();
				ClearColumnFilter();
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterBySpecificDateChecked()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.UncheckShowAll();
				CalendarFilter.CheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckAllFilters();
				if (CalendarFilter.HasSelectedDates)
				{
					FilterBySelectedDates();
				}
				else
				{
					FilterByFocusedDate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.CheckShowAll();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckAllFilters();
				ClearColumnFilter();
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedDatesChanged()
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.UncheckShowAll();
				CalendarFilter.CheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckAllFilters();
				FilterBySelectedDates();
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterChecked(FilterData filter)
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.UncheckShowAll();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				CalendarFilter.SelectedDates = null;
				CalendarFilter.CheckFilters(filter);
				SetColumnFilter();
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterUnchecked(FilterData filter)
		{
			if (CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				CalendarFilter.UncheckShowAll();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckFilterBySpecificDate();
				CalendarFilter.UncheckFilters(filter);
				if (!CalendarFilter.HasCheckedFilters)
				{
					CalendarFilter.CheckShowAll();
				}
				SetColumnFilter();
			}
		}

		private void SetColumnFilter()
		{
			UpdateColumnFilterIfNeeded(() => GetCriteria());
		}

		private void ClearColumnFilter()
		{
			UpdateColumnFilterIfNeeded(() => (CriteriaOperator)null);
		}

		private void FilterByFocusedDate()
		{
			UpdateColumnFilterIfNeeded(() => GetCriteriaForFocusedDate());
		}

		private void FilterBySelectedDates()
		{
			UpdateColumnFilterIfNeeded(() => GetCriteriaForSelectedDates());
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetCriteriaForFocusedDate()
		{
			if (!CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DatesToCriteria(new DateTime[1] { CalendarFilter.FocusedDate });
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetCriteriaForSelectedDates()
		{
			if (!CalendarFilterExists || CalendarFilter.SelectedDates == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DatesToCriteria(CalendarFilter.SelectedDates);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator DatesToCriteria(IEnumerable<DateTime> dates)
		{
			return MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(FieldName, dates);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetCriteria()
		{
			if (!CalendarFilterExists)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CalendarFilter.IsShowAllChecked)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FilterData[] checkedFilters = CalendarFilter.CheckedFilters;
			if (checkedFilters.Length == 0)
			{
				return GetCriteriaForSelectedDates();
			}
			IEnumerable<FilterDateType> filters = checkedFilters.Select((FilterData f) => f.FilterType);
			return filters.ToCriteria(FieldName);
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.SetCalendarFilter(ICalendarFilter calendar)
		{
			CalendarFilter = calendar;
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.OnShowAll()
		{
			OnShowAll();
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.OnFilterBySpecificDateChecked()
		{
			OnFilterBySpecificDateChecked();
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked()
		{
			OnFilterBySpecificDateUnchecked();
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.OnFilterChecked(FilterData filter)
		{
			OnFilterChecked(filter);
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.OnFilterUnchecked(FilterData filter)
		{
			OnFilterUnchecked(filter);
		}

		void ICalendarFilterOwner.OnSelectedDatesChanged()
		{
			OnSelectedDatesChanged();
		}
	}
	public class DateCompactColumnFilterInfo : DateColumnFilterInfoBase
	{
		protected virtual FilterDateType[] Filters => CreateFilters();

		public DateCompactColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		protected virtual FilterDateType[] CreateFilters()
		{
			return new FilterDateType[0];
		}

		protected override FilterData[] CreateUpperFilters()
		{
			FilterFactory filterFactory = new FilterFactory(base.Grid, base.FieldName);
			List<FilterData> list = new List<FilterData>();
			list.Add(filterFactory.CreateNoneData());
			if (base.Column.ShowEmptyDateFilter && base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNull))
			{
				list.Add(filterFactory.CreateEmptyData());
			}
			if (base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges))
			{
				list.Add(filterFactory.CreateSpecificDateData());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override FilterData[] CreateBottomFilters()
		{
			FilterFactory factory = new FilterFactory(base.Grid, base.FieldName);
			return factory.CreateFilters(Filters);
		}

		public override bool CanShowFilterPopup()
		{
			if (!base.Column.AllowAnyFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges, AllowedDateTimeFilters.SingleDateRange))
			{
				if (base.Column.ShowEmptyDateFilter)
				{
					return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNull);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			base.UpdatePopupData(popup);
			Cache.Clear();
			UpdateBottomFilters();
		}

		protected override void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup, object[] values)
		{
			Cache.UpdateValuesForColumn(values);
			UpdateBottomFilters();
			base.CalendarFilter.RebuildFilters();
		}

		protected override FilterData[] CreateBottomFilters()
		{
			FilterData[] source = base.CreateBottomFilters();
			return source.Where((FilterData x) => Cache.IsFilterVisibleForColumn(x)).ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class DateColumnFilterInfo : DateCompactColumnFilterInfo
	{

			: base(column)

		}

		protected override FilterDateType[] CreateFilters()
		{
			AllowedDateTimeFilters filters = (AllowedDateTimeFilters)(((int?)base.Column.AllowedDateTimeFilters) ?? ((!GetIsVirtualSource()) ? 32767 : 0));
			return DatePeriodsFilterModel.GetFilters(filters.ToCoreFilters());
		}

		private bool IsAllowDateTimeOperators()
		{
			if (!base.Column.AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasValue)
			{
				return !GetIsVirtualSource();
			}
			return base.Column.AllowedDateTimeFilters.Value != AllowedDateTimeFilters.None;
		}

		public override bool CanShowFilterPopup()
		{
			if (!IsAllowDateTimeOperators())
			{
				if (base.Column.ShowEmptyDateFilter)
				{
					return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNull);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class CellMergingPanel : StackVisibleIndexPanel
	{
		internal static readonly double InvisibleCellVerticalOffset = -10000.0;

		private RowData RowData => ((FrameworkElement)this).DataContext as RowData;

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeSortedChildrenOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize, IList<UIElement> sortedChildren)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (LightweightCellEditor sortedChild in sortedChildren)
			{
				Rect finalRect = new Rect(num, 0.0, ((UIElement)(object)sortedChild).DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
				Tuple<double, double> offsetAndHeightMergeCell = RowData.View.GetOffsetAndHeightMergeCell(sortedChild, RowData, finalSize.Height);
				if (offsetAndHeightMergeCell != null)
				{
					finalRect.Y = offsetAndHeightMergeCell.Item1;
					finalRect.Height = offsetAndHeightMergeCell.Item2;
				}
				((UIElement)(object)sortedChild).Arrange(finalRect);
				num += finalRect.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureSortedChildrenOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize, IList<UIElement> sortedChildren)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = ((StackVisibleIndexPanel)this).MeasureSortedChildrenOverride(availableSize, sortedChildren);
			if (TableViewProperties.GetFixedAreaStyle((DependencyObject)(object)this) == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, result.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		internal void SetColumn(ColumnBase column)

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();

			sortedElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Columns") as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
			filterPopUpElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_FilterContextMenu") as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
			mergeElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_MergeBtn") as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase;
			Subscribe(sortedElement, GridMenuType.CompactPanelSortElement);
			Subscribe(filterPopUpElement, GridMenuType.CompactPanelFilter);
			Subscribe(mergeElement, GridMenuType.CompactPanelMergeMenu);
			if (View != null)
			{
				string text = ((View.SortInfoCore != null && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)View.SortInfoCore).Count > 0) ? ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)View.SortInfoCore)[0].FieldName : null);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					SetColumn(View.ColumnsCore[text]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SelectedFilterChanged()
		{
			if (View == null || ((ITableView)View).CompactModeFilterItems.Count == 0 || filterUpdateLock.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			object selectedFilter = SelectedFilter;
			ICustomItem val = (ICustomItem)((selectedFilter is ICustomItem) ? selectedFilter : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (val.EditValue == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.EditValue.ToString()))
			{
				View.ClearFilter();
				return;
			}
			string text = val.EditValue as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				View.DataControl.FilterString = text;
				return;
			}
			object editValue = val.EditValue;
			CriteriaOperator val2 = (CriteriaOperator)((editValue is CriteriaOperator) ? editValue : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				View.DataControl.FilterCriteria = val2;
			}
		}

		private void OpenContextMenu_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled && View != null)
			{
				((BarPopupBase)View.DataControlMenu).ShowPopup(sender as UIElement);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnViewChanged()
		{
			DataControlBase.SetCurrentView(this, View);
			UpdateFilter();
		}

		internal void UpdateFilter()
		{
			ITableView tView = View as ITableView;
			filterUpdateLock.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (tView != null && View.DataControl != null && tView.CompactModeFilterItems.Count != 0)
				{
					IList<ICustomItem> compactModeFilterItems = tView.CompactModeFilterItems;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.DataControl.FilterString))
					{
						int num = IListExtensions.FindIndex<ICustomItem>(compactModeFilterItems, (Predicate<ICustomItem>)((ICustomItem x) => View.DataControl.FilterString == x.EditValue as string));
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							SelectedFilter = compactModeFilterItems[num];
							return;
						}
					}
					if (!object.Equals(View.DataControl.FilterCriteria, null))
					{
						int num2 = IListExtensions.FindIndex<ICustomItem>(compactModeFilterItems, (Predicate<ICustomItem>)((ICustomItem x) => object.Equals(View.DataControl.FilterCriteria, x.EditValue)));
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							SelectedFilter = compactModeFilterItems[num2];
							return;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						int num3 = IListExtensions.FindIndex<ICustomItem>(compactModeFilterItems, (Predicate<ICustomItem>)((ICustomItem x) => x.EditValue == null));
						if (num3 >= 0)
						{
							SelectedFilter = compactModeFilterItems[num3];
							return;
						}
					}
					SelectedFilter = null;
				}
			});
		}

		private void OnOrderChanged()
		{
			if (Column != null)
			{
				Column.SortOrder = (ColumnSortOrder)((!Order) ? 1 : 2);
			}
		}

		private void ContextMenuUpdate()
		{
			switch (CompactFilterElementShowMode)
			{
			default:
				DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(this, (CompactSortElementShowMode != CompactSortElementShowMode.Never) ? new GridMenuType?(GridMenuType.CompactPanelSortElement) : ((GridMenuType?)null));
				break;
			case CompactFilterElementShowMode.ContextMenuWithSorting:
				DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(this, GridMenuType.CompactPanelMergeMenu);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

		private void RefreshItems(bool refreshSelectedItem = true)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0173: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0177: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.Column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FilterColumn val = CreateFilterColumn(base.Column);
			if (!refreshSelectedItem && val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClauseType? defaultOperation = GetDefaultOperation(val);
			int num = -1;
			ClauseType? val2 = ((SelectedFilterItem != null) ? new ClauseType?(SelectedFilterItem.ClauseType) : ((ClauseType?)null));
			List<FilterItem> list = new List<FilterItem>();
			List<ClauseType> listOperationsByTypes = FilterClauseHelper.GetListOperationsByTypes(val, base.Column, checkSingleFieldClause: true);
			for (int i = 0; i < listOperationsByTypes.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((ClauseType?)listOperationsByTypes[i] == defaultOperation)
				{
					num = i;
				}
				list.Add(new FilterItem
				{
					Name = OperationHelper.GetMenuStringByType(listOperationsByTypes[i]),
					Image = base.Column.View.GetGlyphFilterCriteria(((object)listOperationsByTypes[i]/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString()),
					ClauseType = listOperationsByTypes[i]
				});
			}
			if (base.Column.View != null && base.Column.View.IsTreeView)
			{
				list.Add(new FilterItem
				{
					Name = base.Column.View.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlRuntimeStringId.FilterCriteriaDefault.ToString()),
					Image = DefaultImage,
					ClauseType = (ClauseType)(((int)defaultOperation.Value == 12) ? 10 : ((int)defaultOperation.Value)),
					IsDefault = true
				});
				num = listOperationsByTypes.Count;
			}
			ListCollectionView listCollectionView = new ListCollectionView(list);
			listCollectionView.GroupDescriptions.Add(new PropertyGroupDescription("IsDefault"));
			if (!refreshSelectedItem && ItemsSource != null && ItemsSource.Count == list.Count && ((List<FilterItem>)ItemsSource.SourceCollection).SequenceEqual(list))
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemsSource = listCollectionView;
			ClauseType? autoFilterCriteria = ((!refreshSelectedItem) ? val2 : ((base.Column != null) ? base.Column.AutoFilterCriteria : ((ClauseType?)null)));
			if (autoFilterCriteria.HasValue)
			{
				int num2 = ((List<FilterItem>)ItemsSource.SourceCollection).FindLastIndex((FilterItem x) => (ClauseType?)x.ClauseType == autoFilterCriteria);
				if (num2 != -1)
				{
					base.DefaultIndex = num2;
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (base.Column != null && base.Column.ActualShowCriteriaInAutoFilterRow && SelectedFilterItem == null && (base.DefaultIndex == -1 || !base.Column.AutoFilterCriteria.HasValue))
			{
				base.DefaultIndex = num;
				SelectedFilterItem = list[num];
				if (lockColumnChange.IsLocked)
				{
					SelectedFilterItemChangedCore();
				}
				return;
			}
			base.DefaultIndex = num;
		}

		protected internal virtual ClauseType? GetDefaultOperation(FilterColumn filterColumn)
		{
			return FilterClauseHelper.GetDefaultOperation(filterColumn, base.Column, SelectedFilterItem == null);
		}

		}

	public class FixedTotalSummaryPrintPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		private const string LeftPart = "PART_EditLeft";

		private const string RightPart = "PART_EditRight";

		private FrameworkElement leftControl;

		private FrameworkElement rightControl;

		private bool measureHalfProportionMode;

		public FrameworkElement LeftControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (leftControl == null)
				{
					leftControl = FindPart("PART_EditLeft");
				}
				return leftControl;
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement RightControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (rightControl == null)
				{
					rightControl = FindPart("PART_EditRight");
				}
				return rightControl;
			}
		}

		private bool AllowLeftSide
		{
			get
			{
				if (LeftControl != null)
				{
					return LeftControl.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool AllowRightSide
		{
			get
			{
				if (RightControl != null)
				{
					return RightControl.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement FindPart(string name)
		{
			FrameworkElement result = null;
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.Name == name)
				{
					result = child;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			measureHalfProportionMode = false;
			if (!AllowLeftSide)
			{
				RightControl.Measure(constraint);
				return new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width, RightControl.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			double maximumHeight = 0.0;
			if (!AllowRightSide)
			{
				MeasureRealProportion(constraint, out maximumHeight);
				return new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width, maximumHeight);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			System.Windows.Size availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Height));
			RightControl.Measure(availableSize);
			if (RightControl.DesiredSize.Width >= constraint.Width)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				LeftControl.Measure(availableSize);
				if (LeftControl.DesiredSize.Width + RightControl.DesiredSize.Width >= constraint.Width)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				MeasureRealProportion(constraint, out maximumHeight);
			}
			else
			{
				MeasureHalfProportion(constraint, out maximumHeight);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width, maximumHeight);
		}

		private void MeasureRealProportion(System.Windows.Size constraint, out double maximumHeight)
		{
			System.Windows.Size availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width), Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Height));
			RightControl.Measure(availableSize);
			double width = RightControl.DesiredSize.Width;
			maximumHeight = Math.Max(0.0, RightControl.DesiredSize.Height);
			availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width - width), Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Height));
			LeftControl.Measure(availableSize);
			width += LeftControl.DesiredSize.Width;
			maximumHeight = Math.Max(maximumHeight, LeftControl.DesiredSize.Height);
			maximumHeight = Math.Max(0.0, maximumHeight);
		}

		private void MeasureHalfProportion(System.Windows.Size constraint, out double maximumHeight)
		{
			measureHalfProportionMode = true;
			System.Windows.Size availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Floor(Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width) / 2.0) - 2.0, constraint.Height);
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width - availableSize.Width, constraint.Height);
			LeftControl.Measure(availableSize);
			RightControl.Measure(availableSize2);
			maximumHeight = Math.Max(LeftControl.DesiredSize.Height, RightControl.DesiredSize.Height);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Rect empty = Rect.Empty;
			if (!AllowLeftSide)
			{
				empty = GetRemainingRect(arrangeSize, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				RightControl.Arrange(empty);
				return arrangeSize;
			}
			double left = 0.0;
			double top = 0.0;
			double num = 0.0;
			double bottom = 0.0;
			empty = GetRemainingRect(arrangeSize, left, top, num, bottom);
			num += (measureHalfProportionMode ? (arrangeSize.Width / 2.0 - 2.0) : RightControl.DesiredSize.Width);
			empty.X = Math.Max(0.0, arrangeSize.Width - num);
			empty.Width = (measureHalfProportionMode ? (arrangeSize.Width - empty.X) : RightControl.DesiredSize.Width);
			RightControl.Arrange(empty);
			empty = GetRemainingRect(arrangeSize, left, top, RightControl.RenderSize.Width, bottom);
			LeftControl.Arrange(empty);
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		private Rect GetRemainingRect(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize, double left, double top, double right, double bottom)
		{
			return new Rect(left, top, Math.Max(0.0, arrangeSize.Width - left - right), Math.Max(0.0, arrangeSize.Height - top - bottom));
		}
	}
	public class GridCardPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty HeaderProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BodyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsExpandedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RotateOnCollapseProperty;

		public UIElement Header
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(HeaderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HeaderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public UIElement Body
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(BodyProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BodyProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsExpandedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsExpandedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool RotateOnCollapse
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(RotateOnCollapseProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RotateOnCollapseProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static GridCardPanel()
		{
			HeaderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Header", typeof(UIElement), typeof(GridCardPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridCardPanel)d).OnChildChanged((UIElement)e.OldValue, (UIElement)e.NewValue);
			}));
			BodyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Body", typeof(UIElement), typeof(GridCardPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridCardPanel)d).OnBodyChanged((UIElement)e.OldValue);
			}));
			IsExpandedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsExpanded", typeof(bool), typeof(GridCardPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridCardPanel)d).UpdateBodyVisibility();
			}));
			RotateOnCollapseProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RotateOnCollapse", typeof(bool), typeof(GridCardPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
		}

		private void OnBodyChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, Body);
			UpdateBodyVisibility();
		}

		private void OnChildChanged(UIElement oldValue, UIElement newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(newValue);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBodyVisibility()
		{
			if (Body != null)
			{
				if (IsExpanded)
				{
					Body.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					Body.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Header.Measure(availableSize);
			Body.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, availableSize.Height - Header.DesiredSize.Height));
			if (RotateOnCollapse && !IsExpanded)
			{
				Header.InvalidateMeasure();
				Header.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Header.DesiredSize.Height + Body.DesiredSize.Height, double.PositiveInfinity));
				return new System.Windows.Size(Header.DesiredSize.Height, Header.DesiredSize.Height + Body.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(Header.DesiredSize.Width, Body.DesiredSize.Width), Header.DesiredSize.Height + (IsExpanded ? Body.DesiredSize.Height : 0.0));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = null;
			if (!IsExpanded && RotateOnCollapse)
			{
				transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
				{
					Angle = -90.0
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					Y = finalSize.Height
				});
			}
			Header.RenderTransform = transformGroup ?? Transform.Identity;
			Rect finalRect = ((IsExpanded || !RotateOnCollapse) ? new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, Header.DesiredSize.Height) : new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Height, finalSize.Width));
			Header.Arrange(finalRect);
			finalRect = (IsExpanded ? new Rect(0.0, Header.DesiredSize.Height, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height - Header.DesiredSize.Height) : default(Rect));
			Body.Arrange(finalRect);
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class GridSearchControl : GridSearchControlBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupPanelShownProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualShowButtonCloseProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowSearchPanelModeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualVisibilityProperty;

		internal override bool IsLogicControl => false;

		public bool GroupPanelShown
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(GroupPanelShownProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(GroupPanelShownProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public bool ActualShowButtonClose
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ActualShowButtonCloseProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ActualShowButtonCloseProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public ShowSearchPanelMode ShowSearchPanelMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (ShowSearchPanelMode)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ShowSearchPanelModeProperty);

			set

			}
		}

		static GridSearchControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GridSearchControl);
			GroupPanelShownProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupPanelShown", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
			ActualShowButtonCloseProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ActualShowButtonClose", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridSearchControl)(object)d).UpdateCloseButtonVisibility();
			}));
			ShowSearchPanelModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowSearchPanelMode", typeof(ShowSearchPanelMode), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ShowSearchPanelMode.Default, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridSearchControl)(object)d).UpdateCloseButtonVisibility();
			}));
			ActualVisibilityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ActualVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Visibility.Collapsed, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			}));
		}

		public GridSearchControl()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).GotFocus += GridSearchControl_GotFocus;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Loaded += GridSearchControl_Loaded;
			base.ClearButtonIsVisible = true;
		}

		private void GridSearchControl_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.CommitEditingInternal();
				base.View.SetSearchPanelFocus(isKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel: true);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCloseButtonVisibility()
		{
			switch (ShowSearchPanelMode)
			{
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Always:
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Never:
				((SearchControl)this).ShowCloseButton = false;
				break;
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Default:
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.HotKey:
				((SearchControl)this).ShowCloseButton = ActualShowButtonClose;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SearchControl)this).OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			if (!(bool)e.NewValue && base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.SetSearchPanelFocus();
				FocusViewOnShowContextMenu();
			}
		}

		private void FocusViewOnShowContextMenu()
		{
			if (PopupMenuManager.TopPopup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement placementTarget = ((Popup)(object)PopupMenuManager.TopPopup).PlacementTarget;
			if (placementTarget != null)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject((DependencyObject)placementTarget, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject el) => el == base.View), false, (DependencyObject)null);
				if (dependencyObject != null)
				{
					base.View.Focus();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (base.View != null && e.Key == Key.Tab)
			{
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
				{
					SetFocusOnCellEditor();
					ViewInplaceEditorMoveFocus(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					SetFocusOnCellEditor();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanMovement()
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (base.View != null && !base.View.SearchPanelAllowFilter)
			{
				return (int)base.View.SearchPanelFindMode != 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((SearchControl)this).OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.NoModifiers(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Return && ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) && CanMovement())
				{
					base.View.SearchResultPrev();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			ButtonEdit editorControl = ((SearchControl)this).GetEditorControl();
			PopupBaseEdit val = (PopupBaseEdit)(object)((editorControl is PopupBaseEdit) ? editorControl : null);
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Down:
				if (val == null || !val.IsPopupOpen)
				{
					SetFocusOnCellEditor();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Escape:
				if (val != null && !val.IsPopupOpen && !e.Handled && base.View != null && base.View.ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Always)
				{
					base.View.HideSearchPanel();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Return:
				if (CanMovement() && base.View.DataControl != null && !base.View.DataControl.IsServerMode)
				{
					base.View.SearchResultNext();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetFocusOnCellEditor()
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.SetSearchPanelFocus();
				base.View.Focus();
			}
		}

		private void ViewInplaceEditorMoveFocus(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)base.View.InplaceEditorOwner).MoveFocus(e);
		}

		private void GridSearchControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((UIElement)(object)this).Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && base.View != null && base.View.PostponedSearchControlFocus)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)this).Focus();
				base.View.PostponedSearchControlFocus = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != newValue && base.View != null && ((UIElement)(object)this).Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				SetFocusOnCellEditor();
				if (base.View.SearchPanelClearOnClose && !base.View.DataControl.IsDeserializing)
				{
					((SearchControl)this).SearchText = null;
					((SearchControl)this).OnFindCommandExecuted();
				}
			}
		}

		private void BindShowGroupPanel(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view is GridViewBase)
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
				binding.Source = view;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(GridViewBase.ActualShowGroupPanelProperty));
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding2 = binding;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(GroupPanelShownProperty, (BindingBase)binding2);
			}
		}

		protected override void BindSearchPanel(DataViewBase view)
		{
			base.BindSearchPanel(view);
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.ShowSearchPanelMRUButtonProperty));
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding2 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.ShowMRUButtonProperty, (BindingBase)binding2);
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.ShowSearchPanelFindButtonProperty));
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding3 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.ShowFindButtonProperty, (BindingBase)binding3);
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = view.Commands;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("HideSearchPanel");
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding4 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.CloseCommandProperty, (BindingBase)binding4);
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.ShowSearchPanelCloseButtonProperty));
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding5 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(ActualShowButtonCloseProperty, (BindingBase)binding5);
			((SearchControl)this).ShowCloseButton = ActualShowButtonClose;
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.ShowSearchPanelModeProperty));
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding6 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(ShowSearchPanelModeProperty, (BindingBase)binding6);
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = this;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(UIElement.VisibilityProperty));
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding7 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(ActualVisibilityProperty, (BindingBase)binding7);
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchPanelImmediateMRUPopupProperty));
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding8 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.ImmediateMRUPopupProperty, (BindingBase)binding8);
			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();

			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding9 = binding;

			binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();

		protected override void UpdateClearButtonVisibility()
		{
			((SearchControl)this).UpdateClearButtonVisibility();
			if (!((SearchControl)this).ShowClearButton)
			{
				base.ClearButtonIsVisible = true;
			}
			else if (base.View != null && ((SearchControl)this).SearchControlPropertyProvider != null)

					base.View.ActualShowSearchPanelResultInfo = false;
				}
				else
				{
					base.ClearButtonIsVisible = true;
					base.View.UpdateShowSearchPanelResultInfo();
				}
			}
		}

	public class NoRecordsControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataControlProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NoRecordsFoundTextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NoRecordsTextProperty;

		private DataViewBase view;

		public DataControlBase DataControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataControlBase)GetValue(DataControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DataControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string NoRecordsFoundText
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(NoRecordsFoundTextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NoRecordsFoundTextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string NoRecordsText
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(NoRecordsTextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NoRecordsTextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool NoRecords { get; private set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		static NoRecordsControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(NoRecordsControl);
			DataControlProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataControl", typeof(DataControlBase), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((NoRecordsControl)d).OnDataControlChanged(e.OldValue);
			}));
			NoRecordsFoundTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NoRecordsFoundText", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			NoRecordsTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NoRecordsText", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<NoRecordsControl>();
		}

		private void OnDataControlChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is DataControlBase dataControlBase)
			{
				dataControlBase.PropertyChanged -= DataControl_PropertyChanged;
			}
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl.PropertyChanged += DataControl_PropertyChanged;
			}
			OnViewChanged();
			VisibilityUpdate();
			NoRecordsUpdate();
		}

		private void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (view != null)
			{
				view.PropertyChanged -= View_PropertyChanged;
			}
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				view = DataControl.viewCore;
			}
			else
			{
				view = null;
			}
			if (view != null)
			{
				view.PropertyChanged += View_PropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void View_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == DataViewBase.ShowEmptyTextProperty.Name)
			{
				VisibilityUpdate();
			}
			if (e.PropertyName == DataViewBase.SearchStringProperty.Name)
			{
				NoRecordsUpdate();
				VisibilityUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void DataControl_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "View")
			{
				OnViewChanged();
			}
			if (e.PropertyName == "VisibleRowCount" || e.PropertyName == DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty.Name || e.PropertyName == "View" || e.PropertyName == DataControlBase.FilterStringProperty.Name || e.PropertyName == DataControlBase.ShowLoadingPanelProperty.Name)
			{
				NoRecordsUpdate();
				VisibilityUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void NoRecordsUpdate()
		{
			if (DataControl != null && DataControl.DataProviderBase != null && DataControl.DataView != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataControl.FilterString) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataControl.DataView.SearchString))
				{
					NoRecords = false;
				}
				else
				{
					NoRecords = DataControl.ItemsSource == null || DataControl.DataProviderBase.ListSourceRowCount == 0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				NoRecords = false;
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("NoRecords");
		}

		private void VisibilityUpdate()
		{
			if (DataControl == null || DataControl == null || view == null || !view.ShowEmptyText || DataControl.ShowLoadingPanel)
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			int visibleRowCount = DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
			if (DataControl.DataView is TableView tableView)
			{
				base.Visibility = ((tableView.NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.Bottom) ? ((visibleRowCount != 0) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible) : ((visibleRowCount != 1) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible));
			}
			else
			{
				base.Visibility = ((visibleRowCount != 0) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string p)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(p));
			}
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarAnnotationsControl : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScrollBarProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewportSizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaximumProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RangeCollectionProperty;

		private int fixedTopRowsCount;

		private int fixedBottomRowsCount;

		private int visibleRowCount;

		private double upButtonOffset;

		private double actualHeightTrack;

		private double startWidth;

		private RepeatButton _upButton;

		public System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar ScrollBar
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar)GetValue(ScrollBarProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ScrollBarProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ViewportSize
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ViewportSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewportSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaximumProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaximumProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> RangeCollection
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>)GetValue(RangeCollectionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RangeCollectionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private RepeatButton UpButton
		{
			get
			{
				if (_upButton == null)
				{
					_upButton = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)ScrollBar, "PART_LineUpButton") as RepeatButton;
				}
				return _upButton;
			}
		}

		static ScrollBarAnnotationsControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ScrollBarAnnotationsControl);
			ScrollBarProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollBar", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ScrollBarAnnotationsControl)d).ScrollBarChanged(e);
			}));
			ViewportSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewportSize", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ScrollBarAnnotationsControl)d).InvalidateVisual();
			}));
			MaximumProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Maximum", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ScrollBarAnnotationsControl)d).InvalidateVisual();
			}));
			RangeCollectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RangeCollection", typeof(IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ScrollBarAnnotationsControl)d).RangeCollectionChange();
			}));
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeRangeCollection(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void ScrollBarChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar)e.OldValue).LayoutUpdated -= ScrollBar_LayoutUpdated;
			}
			upButtonOffset = 0.0;
			actualHeightTrack = 0.0;
			if (ScrollBar != null)
			{
				ScrollBar.LayoutUpdated += ScrollBar_LayoutUpdated;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_upButton = null;
		}

		private void ScrollBar_LayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (ScrollBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((int)ScrollBarExtensions.GetScrollBarMode((DependencyObject)ScrollBar) == 1)
			{
				actualHeightTrack = ScrollBar.ActualHeight;
				upButtonOffset = 0.0;
			}
			else if (UpButton != null && ScrollBar.Track != null)
			{
				double actualHeight = UpButton.ActualHeight;
				if (actualHeightTrack != ScrollBar.Track.ActualHeight || upButtonOffset != actualHeight)
				{
					actualHeightTrack = ScrollBar.Track.ActualHeight;
					upButtonOffset = actualHeight;
					InvalidateVisual();
				}
			}
		}

		private void RangeCollectionChange()
		{
			if (RangeCollection == null || !RangeCollection.Any())
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			fixedTopRowsCount = 0;
			fixedBottomRowsCount = 0;
			visibleRowCount = 0;
			if (RangeCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			if (ScrollBar == null || Maximum + ViewportSize == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			startWidth = 0.0;
			if ((int)ScrollBarExtensions.GetScrollBarMode((DependencyObject)ScrollBar) == 1)
			{
				startWidth = Math.Floor(base.ActualWidth - 10.0);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, null, new Rect(startWidth, 0.0, base.ActualWidth - startWidth, base.ActualHeight));
			}
			foreach (ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo item in RangeCollection)
			{
				if (item is ScrollBarAnnotationFixedRowInfo)
				{
					fixedTopRowsCount = ((ScrollBarAnnotationFixedRowInfo)item).FixedTopRowCount;
					fixedBottomRowsCount = ((ScrollBarAnnotationFixedRowInfo)item).FixedBottomRowCount;
					visibleRowCount = ((ScrollBarAnnotationFixedRowInfo)item).VisibleRowCount;
					continue;
				}
				Tuple<double, double> y = GetY(item);
				if (y == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double width = Math.Floor(Math.Min(item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Width, base.ActualWidth));
				System.Windows.Point point;
				System.Windows.Point point2;
				if (y.Item1 == y.Item2)
				{
					point = GetPoint0(item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Alignment, y.Item1, width);
					point2 = GetPoint1(item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Alignment, y.Item1 + item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.MinHeight, width);
				}
				else
				{
					point = GetPoint0(item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Alignment, y.Item1, width);
					point2 = GetPoint1(item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Alignment, y.Item2, width);
					if (point2.Y - point.Y < item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.MinHeight)
					{
						point2.Y = point.Y + item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.MinHeight;
					}
				}
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(item.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Brush, null, new Rect(point, point2));
			}
		}

		private double GetY(int visibleIndex, double thickness, bool center = false, bool end = false)
		{
			double val;
			if (center)
			{
				val = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(ScrollBar.Track.ActualHeight, actualHeightTrack) / (Maximum + ViewportSize) * (double)visibleIndex + upButtonOffset);
				val = Math.Min(val, base.ActualHeight - thickness * 2.0);
				double val2 = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(ScrollBar.Track.ActualHeight, actualHeightTrack) / (Maximum + ViewportSize) * (double)(visibleIndex + 1) + upButtonOffset);
				val2 = Math.Min(val2, base.ActualHeight - thickness * 2.0);
				return val + (val2 - val) / 2.0;
			}
			if (end)
			{
				double val2 = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(ScrollBar.Track.ActualHeight, actualHeightTrack) / (Maximum + ViewportSize) * (double)(visibleIndex + 1) + upButtonOffset);
				return Math.Min(val2, base.ActualHeight - thickness * 2.0);
			}
			val = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(ScrollBar.Track.ActualHeight, actualHeightTrack) / (Maximum + ViewportSize) * (double)visibleIndex + upButtonOffset);
			return Math.Min(val, base.ActualHeight - thickness * 2.0);
		}

		private Tuple<double, double> GetY(ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo info)
		{
			double minHeight = info.ScrollAnnotationInfo.MinHeight;
			bool isRange = Math.Abs(info.EndRowIndex - info.RowIndex) > 1;
			int? correctIndex = GetCorrectIndex(info.RowIndex, isRange);
			if (!correctIndex.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int? correctIndex2 = GetCorrectIndex(info.EndRowIndex, isRange);
			if (!correctIndex2.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new Tuple<double, double>(GetY(correctIndex.Value, minHeight, info.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Alignment == ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Full), GetY(correctIndex2.Value, minHeight, center: false, info.ScrollAnnotationInfo.Alignment != ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Full));
		}

		private int? GetCorrectIndex(int visibleIndex, bool isRange)
		{
			if (fixedTopRowsCount == 0 && fixedBottomRowsCount == 0)
			{
				return visibleIndex;
			}
			if (fixedTopRowsCount > 0 && visibleIndex - fixedTopRowsCount < 0 && !isRange)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fixedBottomRowsCount > 0 && visibleIndex + fixedBottomRowsCount >= visibleRowCount && !isRange)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return visibleIndex - fixedTopRowsCount;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPoint0(ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment alignment, double y, double width)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Left:
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Full:
				return PointFloor(startWidth, y);
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Right:
				return PointFloor(Math.Floor(base.ActualWidth - width), y);
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Center:
				return PointFloor((base.ActualWidth - startWidth) / 2.0 - width / 2.0 + startWidth, y);
			default:
				return PointFloor(0.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPoint1(ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment alignment, double y, double width)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Left:
				return PointFloor(startWidth + width, y);
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Right:
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Full:
				return PointFloor(Math.Floor(base.ActualWidth), y);
			case ScrollBarAnnotationAlignment.Center:
				return PointFloor((base.ActualWidth - startWidth) / 2.0 + width / 2.0 + startWidth, y);
			default:
				return PointFloor(0.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point PointFloor(double x, double y)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(Math.Floor(x), Math.Floor(y));
		}
	}
	public class TrimmingPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DirectionTrimmingProperty;

		public System.Windows.FlowDirection DirectionTrimming
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.FlowDirection)GetValue(DirectionTrimmingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DirectionTrimmingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static TrimmingPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TrimmingPanel);
			DirectionTrimmingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DirectionTrimming", typeof(System.Windows.FlowDirection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TrimmingPanel)d).InvalidateArrange();
			}));
		}

		private double ArrangeItem(System.Windows.Size finalSize, UIElement item, bool reverse, int idx, ref double x, ref bool isVisibleItem)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			if (isVisibleItem)
			{
				isVisibleItem = (reverse ? (Math.Round(x - item.DesiredSize.Width, 3) >= 0.0) : (Math.Round(x + item.DesiredSize.Width, 3) <= Math.Round(finalSize.Width, 3)));
			}
			if (isVisibleItem)
			{
				result = item.DesiredSize.Width;
				if (reverse)
				{
					x -= item.DesiredSize.Width;
					item.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0), item.DesiredSize));
				}
				else
				{
					item.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0), item.DesiredSize));
					x += item.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				item.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0)));
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			bool isVisibleItem = true;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (DirectionTrimming == System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				double x = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.InternalChildren.Count; i++)
				{
					num += ArrangeItem(finalSize, base.InternalChildren[i], reverse: false, i, ref x, ref isVisibleItem);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double x2 = finalSize.Width;
				for (int num2 = base.InternalChildren.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					num += ArrangeItem(finalSize, base.InternalChildren[num2], reverse: true, num2, ref x2, ref isVisibleItem);
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double val = 0.0;
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				internalChild.Measure(availableSize2);
				val = Math.Max(val, internalChild.DesiredSize.Height);
				num += internalChild.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(num, availableSize.Width), Math.Min(val, availableSize.Height));
		}
	}

	public class GridGroupSummaryHelper : GridSummaryHelper
	{
		protected override ISummaryItemOwner SummaryItems => ((GridControl)view.DataControl).GroupSummary;

		public GridGroupSummaryHelper(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetEditorTitle()
		{
			return view.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.GroupSummaryEditorFormCaption);
		}

		protected internal override bool CanUseSummaryItem(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IGroupFooterSummaryItem)item).ShowInGroupColumnFooter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(view is IGroupSummaryDisplayMode) || (int)item.SummaryType != 3)
			{
				return base.CanUseSummaryItem(item);
			}
			IGroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode = view as IGroupSummaryDisplayMode;
			if (groupSummaryDisplayMode.GroupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default)
			{
				return item.FieldName == "";
			}
			return base.CanUseSummaryItem(item);
		}

		protected override SummaryEditorType GetSummaryEditorType()
		{
			return SummaryEditorType.GroupSummary;
		}

		public override bool IsSummaryItemExists(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			return view.DataProviderBase.IsSummaryItemExists(SummaryItemCollectionType.Group, (SummaryItemBase)(object)item);
		}

		protected override bool AreItemsEqual(SummaryItemBase item1, SummaryItemBase item2)
		{
			if (base.AreItemsEqual(item1, item2))
			{
				return ((IGroupFooterSummaryItem)item1).ShowInGroupColumnFooter == ((IGroupFooterSummaryItem)item2).ShowInGroupColumnFooter;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ColumnMenuInfoBase : GridMenuInfo, IConditionalFormattingDialogBuilder
	{
		protected ColumnSortOrder SortOrder
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (base.Column != null)
				{
					return base.Column.SortOrder;
				}
				return (ColumnSortOrder)0;
			}
		}

		private HeaderPresenterType HeaderPresenterType { get; set; }

		public override GridMenuType MenuType => GridMenuType.Column;

		internal override bool IsMenuEnabled => base.View.IsColumnMenuEnabled;

		public override BarManagerMenuController MenuController => base.View.ColumnMenuController;

		public ColumnMenuInfoBase(DataControlPopupMenu menu)
			: base(menu)
		{
		}

		protected void CreateFixedStyleItems()
		{
			if (base.View.ViewBehavior.CanShowFixedColumnMenu && CanCreateFixedStyleMenu())
			{
				BarSubItem val = CreateBarSubItem("FixedStyle", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnFixedStyle, beginGroup: true, null, null);
				CreateFixedStyleItem("FixedStyleNone", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnFixedNone, ImageHelper.GetImage("FixedNone"), val.ItemLinks, FixedStyle.None);
				CreateFixedStyleItem("FixedStyleLeft", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnFixedLeft, ImageHelper.GetImage("FixedLeft"), val.ItemLinks, FixedStyle.Left);
				CreateFixedStyleItem("FixedStyleRight", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnFixedRight, ImageHelper.GetImage("FixedRight"), val.ItemLinks, FixedStyle.Right);
				if (!base.View.CanBecameFixed(base.BaseColumn))
				{
					((ContentElement)(object)((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)val.ItemLinks)[1]).IsEnabled = false;
					((ContentElement)(object)((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)val.ItemLinks)[2]).IsEnabled = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanCreateFixedStyleMenu()
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void CreateFixedStyleItem(string name, GridControlStringId id, ImageSource image, BarItemLinkCollection links, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			((BarItem)((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)base.Menu).CreateBarCheckItem(name, (object)base.View.GetLocalizedString(id), (bool?)(base.BaseColumn.Fixed == fixedStyle), false, image, links)).Command = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				base.BaseColumn.Fixed = fixedStyle;
			}, () => true, useCommandManager: false);
		}

		protected void CreateSortingItems()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			CreateBarCheckItem("ItemSortAscending", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortAscending, (int)SortOrder == 1, !CanClearSorting(), ImageHelper.GetImage("ItemSortAscending"), DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				SetColumnSortOrder((ColumnSortOrder)1);
			}, () => CanSortColumn(base.Column) && CheckAllowSortOrder(AllowedSortOrders.Ascending), useCommandManager: false));
			CreateBarCheckItem("ItemSortDescending", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortDescending, (int)SortOrder == 2, beginGroup: false, ImageHelper.GetImage("ItemSortDescending"), DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				SetColumnSortOrder((ColumnSortOrder)2);
			}, () => CanSortColumn(base.Column) && CheckAllowSortOrder(AllowedSortOrders.Descending), useCommandManager: false));
			CreateBarButtonItem("ItemClearSorting", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnClearSorting, beginGroup: false, ImageHelper.GetImage("ItemClearSorting"), DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				ClearSorting();
			}, () => CanSortColumn(base.Column) && CanClearSorting() && (int)base.Column.SortOrder > 0, useCommandManager: false));
		}

		private bool CheckAllowSortOrder(AllowedSortOrders sortOrder)
		{
			if (base.View.GetAllowGroupingSortingBySingleColumnOnly() && base.Column.GroupIndexCore == -1 && base.View.SortInfoCore.IsSingleGroup())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (base.Column.AllowedSortOrders & sortOrder) == sortOrder;
