		private bool IsAllowFilterEditorForColumn(DataViewBase view, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return IsAllowFilterEditor(view);
			}
			if (IsAllowFilterEditor(view))
			{
				return column.ActualAllowFilterEditor;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAllowFilterEditor(DataViewBase view)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!EnumExtensions.ToBoolean(view.AllowFilterEditor, !base.View.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (view.ActualUseLegacyFilterEditor && !CriteriaToTreeProcessor.IsConvertibleOperator(base.DataControl.FilterCriteria, false, false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in view.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (item.ActualAllowFilterEditor)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public sealed override bool Initialize(IInputElement value)
		{
			BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BaseGridHeader>(value as DependencyObject);
			HeaderPresenterType = ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(baseGridHeader);
			InitializeCore(baseGridHeader);
			return ((MenuInfoBase)this).Initialize(value);
		}

		{
			base.BaseColumn = BaseGridHeader.GetGridColumn(gridHeader);
		}

		protected sealed override void CreateItems()
		{
			if (base.BaseColumn != null)
			{
				CreateItemsCore();
			}
		}

		protected abstract void CreateItemsCore();

		protected virtual void CreateBestFitItemsCore(BaseColumn column, ICommand bestFitColumn, ICommand bestFitColumns)

			BarButtonItem val2 = CreateBarButtonItem("BestFitColumns", GridControlStringId.MenuColumnBestFitColumns, beginGroup: false, null, bestFitColumns);
			((BarItem)val2).IsVisible = base.View.ViewBehavior.CanBestFitAllColumns();
		}

		private bool IsDateTimeColumn()
		{
			Type columnType = TargetView.GetColumnType(Column);
			if (columnType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Type.GetTypeCode(columnType) == TypeCode.DateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(columnType);
			if (underlyingType != null && Type.GetTypeCode(underlyingType) == TypeCode.DateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void GroupColumn()
		{

			//IL_012b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			if (View.GetAllowGroupingSortingBySingleColumnOnly())

				{
					Grid.ClearGrouping();

				{
					Grid.ClearSorting();
				}
			}
			Column.Visible = true;
			Grid.GroupBy(Column, ((int)Column.SortOrder == 0) ? GetColumnSortOrder(Column.AllowedSortOrders, Column.DefaultSortOrder) : Column.SortOrder, mergeWithPreviousGroup);
		}

			GridControlStringId? menuSortByGroupSummaryStringId = GridControlLocalizer.GetMenuSortByGroupSummaryStringId(item.SummaryType);

			BarButtonItem val = ((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)base.Menu).CreateBarButtonItem(string.Concat(((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)base.Menu).GetItemName(), item.SummaryType, order, item.GetHashCode()), (object)string.Format(localizedString, GetDisplaySummaryName(item), arg2, arg), beginGroup, (ImageSource)null, links);

		private bool GetIsGroupSummaryEnabled(string fieldName, GridSummaryItem item, ColumnSortOrder sortOrder)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool result = true;
			foreach (GridGroupSummarySortInfo item2 in (Collection<GridGroupSummarySortInfo>)(object)Grid.GroupSummarySortInfo)
			{
				if (item2.FieldName == fieldName && item2.SummaryItem == item)
				{
					result = GridSortInfo.GetColumnSortOrder(item2.SortOrder) != sortOrder;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void GroupBySummary(GridSummaryItem summaryItem, ColumnSortOrder sortOrder)
		{
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!Column.IsGrouped)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<GridGroupSummarySortInfo> list = new List<GridGroupSummarySortInfo>();
			foreach (GridGroupSummarySortInfo item in (Collection<GridGroupSummarySortInfo>)(object)Grid.GroupSummarySortInfo)
			{
				if (!(item.FieldName == Column.FieldName))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			list.Add(new GridGroupSummarySortInfo(summaryItem, Column.FieldName, GridSortInfo.GetSortDirectionBySortOrder(sortOrder)));
			Grid.GroupSummarySortInfo.ClearAndAddRange(list.ToArray());
		}

		}

		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			SummaryItemsCore.CollectionChanged += OnSummaryItemsCollectionChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubcribeEvents()
		{
			SummaryItemsCore.CollectionChanged -= OnSummaryItemsCollectionChanged;
		}

		public override void Uninitialize()
		{
			((MenuInfoBase)this).Uninitialize();
			UnsubcribeEvents();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSummaryItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (synchronizingSummaries > 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			synchronizingSummaries++;
			try
			{
				ISummaryItemOwner summaryItemOwner = (ISummaryItemOwner)sender;
				foreach (SummaryItemBase item in summaryItemOwner)
				{
					if (!((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).Items.Contains((ISummaryItem)(object)item) && item.Visible && SummaryHelper.CanUseSummaryItem((ISummaryItem)(object)item))
					{
						((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).Items.Add((ISummaryItem)(object)item);
					}
				}
				foreach (ISummaryItem item2 in new List<ISummaryItem>(((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).Items))
				{
					if (!summaryItemOwner.Contains(item2))
					{
						((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).Items.Remove(item2);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				synchronizingSummaries--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeCore(IInputElement value)
		{
			if (value is FrameworkElement { DataContext: GridColumnData dataContext })
			{
				base.BaseColumn = dataContext.Column;
			}
		}

			CreateTotalSummaryMenuItem((SummaryItemType)0, "ItemSum", GridControlStringId.MenuFooterSum);

		}

			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (AllowTotalSummary(summaryItemType))

				string fieldName = base.Column.FieldName;
				bool isVirtualSource = base.View != null && base.View.DataControl != null && base.View.DataControl.DataProviderBase != null && base.View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource;
				Func<bool> canExecuteMethod = () => isVirtualSource || ((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).CanApplySummary(summaryItemType, fieldName);
				DelegateCommand command = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
				{
					//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					SetSummary(fieldName, summaryItemType);
				}, canExecuteMethod, useCommandManager: false);
				CreateBarCheckItem(name, id, ((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).HasSummary(fieldName, summaryItemType), beginGroup: false, ImageHelper.GetImage(name), command);
			}
		}

		private bool IsCountButtonEnabled()
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (base.View.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore.Count + base.View.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (SummaryItemBase item in base.View.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore)
			{
				if ((int)item.SummaryType == 3)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (SummaryItemBase item2 in base.View.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore)
			{
				if ((int)item2.SummaryType == 3)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

	public abstract class CompactPanelMenuInfo : GridMenuInfo
	{
		protected bool IsGroupMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.View is TableView { CompactPanel: not null, Grid: not null } tableView))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (tableView.Grid.SortInfo != null && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tableView.Grid.SortInfo).Count > 0 && tableView.Grid.Columns != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tableView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].FieldName) && tableView.Grid.Columns[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tableView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].FieldName] != null && tableView.Grid.Columns[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tableView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].FieldName].ActualAllowGrouping)
				{
					tableView.CompactPanel.IsGroupMode = tableView.Grid.SortInfo.GroupCount > 0;
				}
				return tableView.CompactPanel.IsGroupMode;
			}
		}

		protected CompactPanelMenuInfo(DataControlPopupMenu menu)
			: base(menu)
		{
		}

		protected void CreateColumnCheckItem(ColumnBase item, int idx, BarItemLinkCollection link = null)
		{
			if (item.ActualAllowSorting)
			{
				string text = ((item.HeaderCaption != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.HeaderCaption.ToString())) ? item.HeaderCaption.ToString() : item.FieldName.ToString());
				ColumnBase columnBase = ((base.View != null) ? base.View.ColumnsCore[item.FieldName] : null);
				bool flag = ((!IsGroupMode) ? (item.SortIndex >= 0 || (columnBase != null && columnBase.SortIndex >= 0)) : (item.GroupIndexCore >= 0 || (columnBase != null && columnBase.GroupIndexCore >= 0)));
				ICommand command = CreateColumnCommand(item, flag);
				BarCheckItem val = ((link == null) ? ((CustomizablePopupMenuInfoBase)this).CreateBarCheckItem("column" + idx, text, (bool?)flag, false, (ImageSource)null, command) : ((CustomizablePopupMenuInfoBase)this).CreateBarCheckItem(link, "column" + idx, text, (bool?)flag, false, (ImageSource)null, command));
				((BarItem)val).ContentTemplate = item.HeaderTemplate;
				((ContentElement)(object)val).IsEnabled = !IsGroupMode || item.ActualAllowGroupingCore;
			}
		}

		protected ICommand CreateColumnCommand(ColumnBase item, bool isChecked)
		{
			TableView tView = base.View as TableView;
			ICommand command = null;
			if (!IsGroupMode)
			{
				return DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
				{
					//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore).BeginUpdate();
					try
					{
						((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore).Clear();
						base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore.VerifyDefaultSorting();
						if (tView != null)
						{
							tView.Grid.GroupCount = 0;
						}
						if (!isChecked)
						{
							base.View.DataControl.SortByCore(item, GetColumnSortOrder(item.AllowedSortOrders, item.DefaultSortOrder));
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore).EndUpdate();
					}
				});
			}
			return DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore).BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore).Clear();
					base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore.VerifyDefaultSorting();
					tView.Grid.GroupCount = 0;
					if (!isChecked)
					{
						tView.Grid.GroupBy((GridColumn)item, GetColumnSortOrder(item.AllowedSortOrders, item.DefaultSortOrder));
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)base.View.DataControl.SortInfoCore).EndUpdate();
				}
			});
		}

		protected bool CreateFilterItems()
		{
			if (!(base.View is ITableView tableView) || base.View.DataControl == null || tableView.CompactModeFilterItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CriteriaOperator criteria = default(CriteriaOperator);
			for (int i = 0; i < tableView.CompactModeFilterItems.Count; i++)
			{
				ICustomItem val = tableView.CompactModeFilterItems[i];
				string text = val.DisplayValue as string;
				bool value = false;
				ICommand command = null;
				if (object.Equals(val.EditValue, null))
				{
					value = string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.View.DataControl.FilterString);
					command = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
					{
						base.View.DataControl.FilterString = null;
					});
				}
				else
				{
					string filterString = val.EditValue as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterString))
					{
						value = base.View.DataControl.FilterString == filterString;
						command = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
						{
							base.View.DataControl.FilterString = filterString;
						});
					}
					else
					{
						ref CriteriaOperator reference = ref criteria;
						object editValue = val.EditValue;
						reference = (CriteriaOperator)((editValue is CriteriaOperator) ? editValue : null);
						if (criteria != null)
						{
							value = object.Equals(base.View.DataControl.FilterCriteria, criteria);
							command = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
							{
								base.View.DataControl.FilterCriteria = criteria;
							});
						}
					}
				}
				((CustomizablePopupMenuInfoBase)this).CreateBarCheckItem("filterItem" + i, text, (bool?)value, false, (ImageSource)null, command);
			}
			return tableView.CompactModeFilterItems.Count > 0;
		}

		protected void CreateShowInGroups()
		{
			TableView tView = base.View as TableView;
			if (tView == null || tView.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource)
			{
				return;
			}
			BarCheckItem val = CreateBarCheckItem("ShowInGroups", GridControlStringId.MenuCompactModeShowInGroups, IsGroupMode, beginGroup: true, null, DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				if (tView.CompactPanel != null)
				{
					tView.CompactPanel.IsGroupMode = !tView.CompactPanel.IsGroupMode;
					if (tView.Grid != null && tView.Grid.SortInfo != null && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tView.Grid.SortInfo).Count > 0 && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.View.SortInfoCore)[0] != null)
					{
						if (((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].IsGrouped)
						{
							tView.Grid.SortInfo.GroupCount = 0;
						}
						else if (tView.Grid.Columns != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].FieldName) && tView.Grid.Columns[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].FieldName] != null && tView.Grid.Columns[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)tView.Grid.SortInfo)[0].FieldName].ActualAllowGrouping)
						{
							tView.Grid.SortInfo.GroupCount = 1;
						}
					}
				}
			}));
		}
	}

		private static Dictionary<string, ImageSource> images = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<string, ImageSource> imagesSvg = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();

		private static ImageSource LoadImage(string imageName)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Expected O, but got Unknown
			bool flag = MappingName.Value.ContainsKey(imageName);
			if (!ApplicationThemeHelper.UseDefaultSvgImages || !flag)
			{
				string name = $"DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.Images.{imageName}.png";
				using Stream stream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream(name);
				return ImageHelper.CreateImageFromStream(stream);
			}
			string text = MappingName.Value[imageName];
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SvgImageSourceExtension val = new SvgImageSourceExtension();
			string arg = "pack://application:,,,/DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.v23.2;component/Images/Svg/";
			val.Uri = new Uri($"{arg}{text}.svg");
			return (ImageSource)((MarkupExtension)(object)val).ProvideValue((IServiceProvider)null);
		}

		public static ImageSource GetImage(string imageName)
		{
			if (images == null)
			{
				images = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();
			}
			if (imagesSvg == null)
			{
				imagesSvg = new Dictionary<string, ImageSource>();
			}
			Dictionary<string, ImageSource> dictionary = (ApplicationThemeHelper.UseDefaultSvgImages ? imagesSvg : images);
			if (!images.TryGetValue(imageName, out var value))
			{
				value = LoadImage(imageName);
				images.Add(imageName, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	public abstract class GridViewHitInfoBase : HitInfoBase<DataViewHitTestVisitorBase>, IDataViewHitInfo
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty HitTestAcceptorProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("HitTestAcceptor", typeof(DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase), typeof(GridViewHitInfoBase), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		internal readonly DataViewBase view;

		private readonly bool isEmpty;

		protected ColumnBase columnCore;

		protected BandBase bandCore;

		public int RowHandle { get; internal set; }

		ColumnBase IDataViewHitInfo.Column => columnCore;

		public GridColumn Column => columnCore as GridColumn;

		public BandBase Band
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnCore != null)
				{
					return columnCore.ParentBand;
				}
				return bandCore;
			}
		}

		public bool InFilterPanel => HitInfoInArea(TableViewHitTest.FilterPanel, TableViewHitTest.FilterPanelText, TableViewHitTest.FilterPanelCloseButton, TableViewHitTest.FilterPanelCustomizeButton, TableViewHitTest.FilterPanelActiveButton, TableViewHitTest.MRUFilterListComboBox, TableViewHitTest.FilterPanelExpandButton, TableViewHitTest.FilterPanelCollapseButton);

		public virtual bool InGroupPanel => HitInfoInArea(TableViewHitTest.GroupPanel, TableViewHitTest.GroupPanelColumnHeader, TableViewHitTest.GroupPanelColumnHeaderFilterButton);

		public bool InColumnPanel => HitInfoInArea(TableViewHitTest.ColumnHeaderPanel, TableViewHitTest.ColumnButton, TableViewHitTest.ColumnHeader, TableViewHitTest.ColumnHeaderFilterButton, TableViewHitTest.ColumnEdge);

		public bool InBandPanel => HitInfoInArea(TableViewHitTest.BandHeaderPanel, TableViewHitTest.BandButton, TableViewHitTest.BandHeader, TableViewHitTest.BandEdge);

		bool IDataViewHitInfo.IsRowCell => IsRowCellCore();

		public virtual bool IsDataArea => false;

		public static DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase GetHitTestAcceptor(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase)obj.GetValue(HitTestAcceptorProperty);
		}

		public static void SetHitTestAcceptor(DependencyObject obj, DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(HitTestAcceptorProperty, value);
		}

		internal static void SetHitTestAcceptorSafe(DependencyObject obj, DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase value)
		{
			obj?.SetValue(HitTestAcceptorProperty, value);
		}

		protected static bool HitInfoInArea<T>(T value, params T[] areaTypes)
		{
			return areaTypes.Contains(value);
		}

		internal static TreeListViewHitTest ConvertToTreeListViewHitTest(TableViewHitTest hitTest)
		{
			switch (hitTest)
			{
			case TableViewHitTest.GroupFooterRow:
				return TreeListViewHitTest.NodeFooterRow;
			case TableViewHitTest.GroupFooterSummary:
				return TreeListViewHitTest.NodeFooterSummary;
			default:
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TreeListViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString()))
				{
					return TreeListViewHitTest.None;
				}
				return (TreeListViewHitTest)Enum.Parse(typeof(TreeListViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString(), ignoreCase: true);
			}
		}

		internal static TableViewHitTest ConvertToTableViewHitTest(TreeListViewHitTest hitTest)
		{
			switch (hitTest)
			{
			case TreeListViewHitTest.NodeIndent:
			case TreeListViewHitTest.ExpandButton:
			case TreeListViewHitTest.NodeImage:
				return TableViewHitTest.Row;
			case TreeListViewHitTest.NodeFooterRow:
				return TableViewHitTest.GroupFooterRow;
			case TreeListViewHitTest.NodeFooterSummary:
				return TableViewHitTest.GroupFooterSummary;
			default:
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TableViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString()))
				{
					return TableViewHitTest.None;
				}
				return (TableViewHitTest)Enum.Parse(typeof(TableViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString(), ignoreCase: true);
			}
		}

		internal static CardViewHitTest ConvertToCardViewHitTest(TableViewHitTest hitTest)
		{
			return hitTest switch
			{
				TableViewHitTest.RowCell => CardViewHitTest.FieldValue, 
				TableViewHitTest.Row => CardViewHitTest.Card, 
				_ => (CardViewHitTest)Enum.Parse(typeof(CardViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString(), ignoreCase: true), 
			};
		}

		internal static TableViewHitTest ConvertToTableViewHitTest(CardViewHitTest hitTest)
		{
			switch (hitTest)
			{
			case CardViewHitTest.FieldValue:
				return TableViewHitTest.RowCell;
			case CardViewHitTest.Card:
				return TableViewHitTest.Row;
			default:
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TableViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString()))
				{
					return TableViewHitTest.None;
				}
				return (TableViewHitTest)Enum.Parse(typeof(TableViewHitTest), hitTest.ToString(), ignoreCase: true);
			}
		}

		protected GridViewHitInfoBase(DependencyObject d, DataViewBase view)
			: base(d, (DependencyObject)view)
		{
			RowHandle = int.MinValue;
			base.Accept((DataViewHitTestVisitorBase)CreateDefaultVisitor());
			isEmpty = view == null;
			this.view = view;
		}

		internal virtual void SetHitTest(TableViewHitTest hitTest)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetColumn(ColumnBase value)
		{
			if (!isEmpty)
			{
				columnCore = value;
			}
		}

		internal void SetBand(BandBase value)
		{
			if (!isEmpty)
			{
				bandCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected sealed override HitTestAcceptorBase<DataViewHitTestVisitorBase> GetAcceptor(DependencyObject treeElement)
		{
			return GetHitTestAcceptor(treeElement);
		}

		protected abstract GridViewHitTestVisitorBase CreateDefaultVisitor();

		private bool HitInfoInArea(params TableViewHitTest[] areaTypes)
		{
			return HitInfoInArea(GetTableViewHitTest(), areaTypes);
		}

		protected abstract TableViewHitTest GetTableViewHitTest();

		protected void CorrectRowHandleIfNeeded(DependencyObject d, System.Windows.Point? relativePoint)
		{
			if (view == null || !relativePoint.HasValue || RowHandle == -2147483645 || RowHandle == -2147483647 || !(view.GetCellElementByTreeElement(d) is LightweightCellEditor lightweightCellEditor))
			{
				return;
			}
			relativePoint = view.TranslatePoint(relativePoint.Value, (UIElement)(object)lightweightCellEditor);
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = lightweightCellEditor.Column.View;
			if (!dataViewBase.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = ((FrameworkElement)(object)lightweightCellEditor).ActualHeight;
			int num2 = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(RowHandle);
			while (dataViewBase.IsPrevRowCellMerged(num2, columnCore, checkRowData: true))
			{
				FrameworkElement rowElementByRowHandle = dataViewBase.GetRowElementByRowHandle(dataViewBase.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num2));
				if (relativePoint.Value.Y > num - rowElementByRowHandle.ActualHeight)
				{
					break;
				}
				num -= rowElementByRowHandle.ActualHeight;
				num2--;
			}
			RowHandle = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num2);
		}

		void IDataViewHitInfo.SetHitTest(TableViewHitTest hitTest)
		{
			SetHitTest(hitTest);
		}

		void IDataViewHitInfo.SetColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			SetColumn(column);
		}

		void IDataViewHitInfo.SetBand(BandBase band)
		{
			SetBand(band);
		}

		void IDataViewHitInfo.SetRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			RowHandle = rowHandle;
		}

		internal abstract bool IsRowCellCore();
	}

		}

			}
		}

		private object CoerceDataContext(object baseValue)
		{
			if (!HasStyle)

				return baseValue;

			return base.CellData ?? baseValue;

		public LightweightCellEditor(CellsControl cellsControl)
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			formattingHelper = new ConditionalFormattingHelper<LightweightCellEditor>(this, (DependencyProperty)null);
			this.cellsControl = cellsControl;
			base.GridCellEditorOwner = this;
			border = (RenderBorderContext)ChromeHelper.CreateContext((IChrome)(object)this, backgroundTemplate);
			((FrameworkRenderElementContext)border).UseLayoutRounding = true;
			conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper = new ConditionalFormatContentRenderHelper<LightweightCellEditor>(this);
			UpdateBorderFromBrushSet();
		}

		private void UpdateDataContext(bool force)
		{
			if (force || HasStyle)
			{
				RegisterDataContextCoerceCallback();
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OnColumnChanged(ColumnBase oldValue, ColumnBase newValue)
		{
			base.OnColumnChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UpdateStyle();
			UpdateConditionalAppearance();
			isMenuAssigned = false;
			if (BorderSeparator != null)
			{
				BorderSeparator.Background = base.Column?.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore ?? GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(checkSeparator: true);
			}
			if (BorderLeftSeparator != null)
			{
				BorderLeftSeparator.Background = base.Column?.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore ?? GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(checkSeparator: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(e);
			if (!isMenuAssigned)
			{
				AssignContextMenu();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (!isMenuAssigned && IsContextMenuKey(e))
			{
				AssignContextMenu();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsContextMenuKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Apps)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.System && e.SystemKey == Key.F10)
				{
					return ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e));
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void AssignContextMenu()
		{
			if (!base.View.IsTreeView)
			{
				BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)(object)this, (IPopupControl)(object)base.View.DataControlMenu);
				isMenuAssigned = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnColumnContentChanged(object sender, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnColumnContentChanged(sender, e);
			StylePropertyChanged(e.Property);
			BandSeparatorBorderChanged(e.Property);
		}

		protected virtual Style GetActualStyle()
		{
			return base.Column?.ActualCellStyle;
		}

		protected virtual void StylePropertyChanged(DependencyProperty property)

				UpdateStyle();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BandSeparatorBorderChanged(DependencyProperty property, bool force = false)
		{
			if (force || property == BaseColumn.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorProperty || property == BaseColumn.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorProperty)
			{
				if (BorderSeparator != null)
				{
					BorderSeparator.Background = ((base.Column != null && base.Column.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore != null) ? base.Column.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore : GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(checkSeparator: true));
				}
				if (BorderLeftSeparator != null)
				{
					BorderLeftSeparator.Background = ((base.Column != null && base.Column.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore != null) ? base.Column.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore : GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(checkSeparator: true));
				}
				UpdateSeparatorBorderBrush();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateStyle()
		{
			Style style = GetActualStyle();
			if (style is DefaultStyle)
			{
				style = null;
			}
			if (style != styleCore)
			{
				styleCore = style;
				if (style != null)
				{
					UpdateDataContext(force: true);
				}
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Style = style;
				if (style == null)
				{
					UpdateDataContext(force: true);
				}
				UpdateBackgroundFromBrushSet();
				UpdateBorderFromBrushSet();
				UpdateForegroundFromBrushSet();
				UpdateBackgroundFromStyle();
				UpdateBorderFromStyle();
				UpdateForegroundFromStyle();
				UpdatePaddingFromStyle();
			}
		}

		protected override EditorOptimizationMode GetEditorOptimizationMode()
		{
			return (EditorOptimizationMode)1;
		}

		internal void SetBorderState(GridCellData cellData, SelectionState rowSelectionState)
		{
			Thickness cellBorderThickness = GetCellBorderThickness(cellData);
			border.BorderThickness = cellBorderThickness;
			UpdateChildMargin();
			double num = ((base.RowData != null && base.Column != null) ? (base.RowData.GetRowIndent(base.Column) - base.Column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore - base.Column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore) : 0.0);
			conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper.SetMargin(new Thickness(num + cellBorderThickness.Left + base.Column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore, cellBorderThickness.Top, cellBorderThickness.Right + base.Column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore, cellBorderThickness.Bottom));
			if (RowSelectionState != rowSelectionState)
			{
				RowSelectionState = rowSelectionState;
				UpdateBorderFromBrushSet();
				UpdateConditionalAppearance();
			}
		}

		private Thickness GetCellBorderThickness(GridCellData cellData)
		{
			Thickness result = default(Thickness);
			ITableView tableView = (ITableView)cellData.View;
			if (tableView.ShowVerticalLines)
			{
				if (cellData.Column.HasLeftSibling && cellData.Column.ColumnPosition == ColumnPosition.Left)
				{
					result.Left = 1.0;
				}
				if (cellData.Column.HasRightSibling)
				{
					result.Right = 1.0;
				}
			}
			if (tableView.ShowHorizontalLines && cellData.Column.HasTopElement)
			{
				result.Top = 1.0;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateChildMargin()
		{
			if (border.BorderThickness.HasValue)
			{
				Thickness value = border.BorderThickness.Value;
				if (childMargin != value)
				{
					childMargin = value;
					((UIElement)(object)this).InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
		{
			((Visual)(object)this).OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			UpdateChildMargin();
		}

		private void UpdatePaddingFromStyle()
		{
			border.Padding = Padding;
		}

		private void UpdateBorderFromStyle()
		{
			border.BorderBrush = BorderBrush;
			BandSeparatorBorderChanged(null, force: true);
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundFromStyle()
		{
			border.Background = formattingHelper.CoerceBackground(Background);
		}

		private void UpdateForegroundFromStyle()
		{
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty);
		}

		private bool HasBrushesInRow(BrushSet brushSet)
		{
			if (brushSet.Elements != null)
			{
				return brushSet.Elements.Count != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateBorderFromBrushSet()
		{
			if (HasBackgroundBrushesInRow)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush borderBrushFromBrushSet = GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(checkSeparator: true, getActualValue: false);
				if (borderBrushFromBrushSet != null)
				{
					border.BorderBrush = borderBrushFromBrushSet;
				}
				if (base.Column != null)
				{
					if (base.Column.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor == null && BorderSeparator != null)
					{
						BorderSeparator.Background = GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet();
					}
					if (base.Column.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor == null && BorderLeftSeparator != null)
					{
						BorderLeftSeparator.Background = GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet();
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateSeparatorBorderBrush();
		}

		private void UpdateSeparatorBorderBrush()
		{
			if (BorderSeparator != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush borderBrushFromBrushSet = GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(checkSeparator: true);
				if (borderBrushFromBrushSet != null)
				{
					BorderSeparator.BorderBrush = borderBrushFromBrushSet;
				}
			}
			if (BorderLeftSeparator != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush borderBrushFromBrushSet2 = GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet();
				if (borderBrushFromBrushSet2 != null)
				{
					BorderLeftSeparator.BorderBrush = borderBrushFromBrushSet2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTreeViewBorder()
		{
			if (BorderTreeViewEditing != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush borderBrushFromBrushSet = GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet();
				if (borderBrushFromBrushSet != null)
				{
					BorderTreeViewEditing.BorderBrush = borderBrushFromBrushSet;
				}
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush GetBorderBrushFromBrushSet(bool checkSeparator = false, bool getActualValue = true)
		{
			string text = "BorderBrush";
			if (RowSelectionState == SelectionState.Focused && !HasCustomAppearance && (base.Column == null || !checkSeparator || base.Column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore == 0.0))
			{
				text += "FocusedRow";
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = cellsControl.RowControl.CellBackgroundBrushes.GetBrush(text);
			if (getActualValue && brush == null)
			{
				brush = BorderBrush;
			}
			return brush;
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundFromBrushSet()
		{
			if (HasBackgroundBrushesInRow)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = cellsControl.RowControl.CellBackgroundBrushes.GetBrush(SelectionState.ToString());
				if (brush != null)
				{
					border.Background = formattingHelper.CoerceBackground(cellsControl.RowControl.CellBackgroundBrushes.GetBrush(SelectionState.ToString()));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateForegroundFromBrushSet()
		{
			if (HasForegroundBrushesInRow)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = cellsControl.RowControl.CellForegroundBrushes.GetBrush(SelectionState.ToString());
				if (brush != null)
				{
					cellsControl.RowControl.CellForegroundBrushes.ApplyForeground((DependencyObject)(object)this, SelectionState.ToString());
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = constraint;
			if (base.ColumnCore != null && base.ColumnCore.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				constraint = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			}
			conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper.Measure(size);
			double verticalMargin = GetVerticalMargin(childMargin);
			double horizontalMargin = GetHorizontalMargin(childMargin);
			System.Windows.Size size2 = ((base.ColumnCore != null && base.ColumnCore.WidthCore.IsAuto) ? base.MeasureOverride(size) : base.MeasureOverride(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width - horizontalMargin), Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Height - verticalMargin))));
			return new System.Windows.Size(size2.Width + horizontalMargin, size2.Height + verticalMargin);
		}

		protected override double MeasureWidthAdditional()
		{
			return base.MeasureWidthAdditional() + GetHorizontalMargin(childMargin) + GetConditionalFormatIconSize().Width;
		}

		private double LastHeightTopFixedRow()
		{
			if (!(base.View is TableView { HasFixedRows: not false } tableView) || base.RowDataCore == null || !base.RowDataCore.IsLastFixedRow)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return tableView.FixedLineHeight;
		}

		internal bool IsLastRow()
		{
			if (base.RowDataCore != null)
			{
				if (base.RowDataCore.RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					return base.RowDataCore.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal double GetStartPositionSeparator()
		{
			if (base.RowDataCore == null || base.RowDataCore.FixedRowPositionCore != FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (!base.RowDataCore.IsLastFixedRow)
			{
				return -1.0;
			}
			return 0.0 - LastHeightTopFixedRow();
		}

		internal double GetFinalHeightSeparator(double finalHeight)
		{
			if (!IsLastRow())
			{
				return finalHeight + 1.0 + LastHeightTopFixedRow();
			}
			return finalHeight;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (IsTreeViewCell && base.ColumnCore != null && base.View?.DataControl is TreeViewControl treeViewControl)
			{
				int? autoBestFitWidth = base.ColumnCore.GetAutoBestFitWidth(Id);
				if (autoBestFitWidth.HasValue && BorderTreeViewEditing != null && treeViewControl.AllowEditing)
				{
					finalSize = new System.Windows.Size(autoBestFitWidth.Value, finalSize.Height);
					((FrameworkRenderElementContext)BorderTreeViewEditing).Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, autoBestFitWidth.Value, finalSize.Height));
				}
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.ColumnCore != null && base.ColumnCore.CheckAndUpdateBandSeparatorWidth())
			{
				num = base.ColumnCore.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
				double actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore = base.ColumnCore.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
				double finalHeightSeparator = GetFinalHeightSeparator(finalSize.Height);
				double startPositionSeparator = GetStartPositionSeparator();
				RenderBorderContext obj = BorderLeftSeparator;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					((FrameworkRenderElementContext)obj).Arrange(new Rect(0.0, startPositionSeparator, num, finalHeightSeparator));
				}
				((FrameworkRenderElementContext)border).Arrange(new Rect(num, 0.0, finalSize.Width - actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore - num, finalSize.Height));
				RenderBorderContext obj2 = BorderSeparator;
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					((FrameworkRenderElementContext)obj2).Arrange(new Rect(finalSize.Width - actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore, startPositionSeparator, actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore, finalHeightSeparator));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((FrameworkRenderElementContext)border).Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height));
			}
			conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper.Arrange(finalSize);
			if (Child != null)
			{
				Child.Arrange(new Rect(childMargin.Left + num, childMargin.Top, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - GetHorizontalMargin(childMargin)), Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - GetVerticalMargin(childMargin))));
				return finalSize;
			}
			return ((ContentPresenter)(object)this).ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}

		private double GetVerticalMargin(Thickness margin)
		{
			return DXArranger.Ceiling(margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
		}

		private double GetHorizontalMargin(Thickness thickness)
		{
			return DXArranger.Ceiling(thickness.Left + thickness.Right) + ((base.ColumnCore != null) ? (base.ColumnCore.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore + base.ColumnCore.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore) : 0.0);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			bool flag = base.ColumnCore.CheckAndUpdateBandSeparatorWidth();
			if (flag && BorderLeftSeparator != null)
			{
				((FrameworkRenderElementContext)BorderLeftSeparator).Render(dc);
			}
			((FrameworkRenderElementContext)border).Render(dc);
			if (flag && BorderSeparator != null)
			{
				((FrameworkRenderElementContext)BorderSeparator).Render(dc);
			}
			if (conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper.IconImage != null)
			{
				((FrameworkRenderElementContext)conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper.IconImage).SvgPalette = ConditionalFormattingSvgPalette;
			}
			conditionalFormatContentRenderHelper.Render(dc);
			if (IsTreeViewCell && BorderTreeViewEditing != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsEditorActive)
			{
				((FrameworkRenderElementContext)BorderTreeViewEditing).Render(dc);
			}
		}

		void IConditionalFormattingClient<LightweightCellEditor>.UpdateCustomAppearance(CustomAppearanceEventArgs args)
		{
			if (base.View is ITableView tableView)
			{
				CustomCellAppearanceEventArgs e = new CustomCellAppearanceEventArgs(args);
				e.Column = base.Column;
				e.RowHandle = RowHandle;
				e.Source = base.View;
				e.RowSelectionState = RowSelectionState;
				e.CellSelectionState = SelectionState;
				e.IsEditorVisible = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).IsEditorVisible;
				tableView.RaiseCustomCellAppearance(e);
				e.SetActualResult(args);
				HasCustomAppearance = ((CustomAppearanceEventArgs)e).Handled;
			}
			else
			{
				HasCustomAppearance = false;
			}
		}

		}

		}

	public class CellsControl : CellItemsControlBase
	{
		private static readonly ControlTemplate OrdinarPanelTemplate;

		private static readonly ControlTemplate BandsPanelTemplate;

		private static readonly ControlTemplate BandsMergePanelTemplate;

		private static readonly ControlTemplate CellMergingPanelTemplate;

		private readonly Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc;

		private readonly Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc;

		private Thickness panelOffset;

		protected virtual bool ActualAllowCellMerge => View.ActualAllowCellMerge;

		internal RowControl RowControl { get; private set; }

		protected override int ActualChildrenCount => ((CachedItemsControl)this).ActualChildrenCount - ((base.RowMarginControl != null) ? 1 : 0);

		static CellsControl()
		{
			FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(OrdinaryStackVisibleIndexPanel));
			frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(OrderPanelBase.ArrangeAccordingToVisibleIndexProperty, true);
			frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(OrderPanelBase.OrientationProperty, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal);
			OrdinarPanelTemplate = CreatePanelTemplate(frameworkElementFactory);
			ItemsControlBase.ItemsPanelProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CellsControl), new PropertyMetadata(OrdinarPanelTemplate));
			FrameworkElementFactory panelFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(BandsCellsPanel));
			BandsPanelTemplate = CreatePanelTemplate(panelFactory);
			FrameworkElementFactory panelFactory2 = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(BandsCellMergingPanel));
			BandsMergePanelTemplate = CreatePanelTemplate(panelFactory2);
			FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory2 = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(CellMergingPanel));
			frameworkElementFactory2.SetValue(OrderPanelBase.ArrangeAccordingToVisibleIndexProperty, true);
			frameworkElementFactory2.SetValue(OrderPanelBase.OrientationProperty, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal);
			CellMergingPanelTemplate = CreatePanelTemplate(frameworkElementFactory2);
		}

		private static ControlTemplate CreatePanelTemplate(FrameworkElementFactory panelFactory)
		{
			ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate(typeof(ItemsControlBase));
			controlTemplate.VisualTree = panelFactory;
			controlTemplate.Seal();
			return controlTemplate;
		}

		public CellsControl(RowControl rowControl, Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc)
		{
			RowControl = rowControl;
			this.getCellDataFunc = getCellDataFunc;
			this.getBandsFunc = getBandsFunc;
		}

		private double LastHeightTopFixedRow()
		{
			if (!(View is TableView { HasFixedRows: not false } tableView) || RowControl?.rowData == null || !RowControl.rowData.IsLastFixedRow)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return tableView.FixedLineHeight;
		}

		internal double GetStartPositionSeparator()
		{
			if (RowControl?.rowData != null && RowControl.rowData.FixedRowPositionCore == FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				if (!RowControl.rowData.IsLastFixedRow)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				return 0.0 - LastHeightTopFixedRow();
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = ((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)this).ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			double num = result.Height;
			double y = 0.0;
			if (View?.DataControl?.BandsCore != null && View.DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0 && View.VisibleColumnsCore != null && (!(((FrameworkElement)(object)this).DataContext is AdditionalRowData) || !View.DataControl.IsGroupedCore))
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in View.VisibleColumnsCore)
				{
					if (item.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0 || item.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0)
					{
						num += 1.0 + LastHeightTopFixedRow();
						y = GetStartPositionSeparator();
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				double height = View.RootDataPresenter.LastConstraint.Height;
				double width = ((TableViewProperties.GetFixedAreaStyle((DependencyObject)(object)this) == FixedStyle.None) ? RowControl.rowData.FixedNoneContentWidth : result.Width);
				((UIElement)(object)this).Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0 - height, width, height + num));
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)(object)this).Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, y, result.Width, num + (base.IsRowMarginControlVisible ? (base.RowMarginControl.ActualHeight - num) : 0.0)));
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void UpdateItemsSource()
		{
			((ItemsControlBase)this).ItemsSource = getCellDataFunc(RowControl.rowData);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((ItemsControlBase)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdatePanelOffset();
			UpdateBands();
		}

		internal void UpdateBands()
		{
			if (((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel is BandsCellsPanel bandsCellsPanel && RowControl.IsBandedLayout)
			{
				bandsCellsPanel.Bands = getBandsFunc(RowControl.BandsLayout);
			}
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateChildCore(GridCellData cellData)
		{
			LightweightCellEditor lightweightCellEditor = new LightweightCellEditor(this);
			lightweightCellEditor.RowData = cellData.RowData;
			lightweightCellEditor.IsTreeViewCell = View is TreeViewControlView;
			return (FrameworkElement)(object)lightweightCellEditor;
		}

		protected override void ValidateElementCore(FrameworkElement element, GridCellData cellData)
		{
			LightweightCellEditor lightweightCellEditor = GetLightweightCellEditor(element);
			lightweightCellEditor.CellData = (EditGridCellData)cellData;
			lightweightCellEditor.Column = cellData.Column;
			cellData.OnEditorContentUpdated();
			UpdateElementWidth(element, cellData);
			cellData.SyncLeftMargin(element);
			ColumnBase.SetNavigationIndex(element, BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)cellData.Column));
			lightweightCellEditor.SetBorderState(cellData, RowControl.rowData.SelectionState);
		}

		protected override void ValidateRowMarginControl()
		{
			base.ValidateRowMarginControl();
			if (base.RowMarginControl is IRowMarginControl rowMarginControl)
			{
				rowMarginControl.Update();
			}
		}

		protected virtual LightweightCellEditor GetLightweightCellEditor(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return (LightweightCellEditor)(object)element;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateElementWidth(FrameworkElement element, GridCellData cellData)
		{
			if (cellData?.RowData?.RowHandle != null && cellData.RowData.RowHandle.Value == -2147483647)
			{
				element.Width = CalcNewItemRowCellWidth(cellData.Column, cellData.GetActualCellWidth(), cellData.RowData);
			}
			else
			{
				element.Width = cellData.GetActualCellWidth();
			}
		}

		private double CalcNewItemRowCellWidth(ColumnBase column, double headerWidth, RowData rowData)
		{
			if (column != null && headerWidth > 0.0 && rowData != null && !GroupSummaryLayoutCalculator.IsFirstColumn(column, rowData) && GroupSummaryLayoutCalculator.IsFirstVisibleColumn(column, rowData))
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, headerWidth + rowData.View.ViewBehavior.NewItemRowCellIndent);
			}
			return headerWidth;
		}

		internal void SetPanelOffset(Thickness panelOffset)
		{
			if (!(this.panelOffset == panelOffset))
			{
				this.panelOffset = panelOffset;
				UpdatePanelOffset();
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePanelOffset()
		{
			if (((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel != null)
			{
				((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel.Margin = panelOffset;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdatePanel()
		{
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)this).Template = GetTemplate();
		}

		internal void InvalidatePanel()
		{
			((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel?.InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual ControlTemplate GetTemplate()
		{
			if (RowControl.IsBandedLayout)
			{
				if (!ActualAllowCellMerge)
				{
					return BandsPanelTemplate;
				}
				return BandsMergePanelTemplate;
			}
			if (!ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				return OrdinarPanelTemplate;
			}
			return CellMergingPanelTemplate;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Controls.Control CreateRowMarginControl()
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Control control = GridRowHelper.CreateRowMarginControl(RowControl.rowData, RowControl.CreateRowMarginControl);
			control?.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BorderBrushProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("BorderBrush")
			{
				Source = RowControl
			});
			return control;
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			if (((Visual)(object)this).VisualParent == null && base.RowMarginControl != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(base.RowMarginControl, System.Windows.Controls.Control.BorderBrushProperty);
				base.RowMarginControl = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class OrdinaryStackVisibleIndexPanel : StackVisibleIndexPanel
	{
		protected RowData RowData => ((FrameworkElement)this).DataContext as RowData;

		protected DataViewBase View => RowData?.View;

		protected bool ExtendRowMarginControlHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (View != null)
				{
					return View.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeSortedChildrenOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize, IList<UIElement> sortedChildren)
		{
			if (!ExtendRowMarginControlHeight)
			{
				return ((StackVisibleIndexPanel)this).ArrangeSortedChildrenOverride(finalSize, sortedChildren);
			}
			return ArrangeSortedChildrenWithRowMarginControl(finalSize, sortedChildren);
		}

		private double LastHeightTopFixedRow()
		{
			if (!(View is TableView { HasFixedRows: not false } tableView) || RowData == null || !RowData.IsLastFixedRow)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return tableView.FixedLineHeight;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			if (View?.VisibleColumnsCore != null && View.DataControl?.BandsCore != null && View.DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in View.VisibleColumnsCore)
				{
					if (item.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0 || item.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0)
					{
						return new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, double.PositiveInfinity, ((UIElement)this).DesiredSize.Height + 1.0 + LastHeightTopFixedRow()));
					}
				}
			}
			return ((FrameworkElement)this).GetLayoutClip(layoutSlotSize);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size ArrangeSortedChildrenWithRowMarginControl(System.Windows.Size finalSize, IList<UIElement> sortedChildren)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement sortedChild in sortedChildren)
			{
				Rect finalRect = new Rect(num, 0.0, sortedChild.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
				if (sortedChild is IRowMarginControl)
				{
					finalRect.Height += 1.0;
				}
				sortedChild.Arrange(finalRect);
				num += finalRect.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureSortedChildrenOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize, IList<UIElement> sortedChildren)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = ((StackVisibleIndexPanel)this).MeasureSortedChildrenOverride(availableSize, sortedChildren);
			if (!ExtendRowMarginControlHeight || RowData is StandaloneRowData || TableViewProperties.GetFixedAreaStyle((DependencyObject)(object)this) != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, result.Height);
		}
	}
	public class BestFitGroupRowControl : GroupRowControl
	{
		private readonly GridGroupSummaryColumnData SummaryData;

		private readonly bool IsFirstColumn;

		private readonly ColumnBase Column;

		private GroupRowColumnSummaryControl summaryController;

		private GroupBandSummaryControl summaryBandController;

		public BestFitGroupRowControl(GroupRowData rowData, GridGroupSummaryColumnData summaryData, bool isFirstColumn, ColumnBase column)
			: base(rowData)
		{
			SummaryData = summaryData;
			IsFirstColumn = isFirstColumn;
			ColumnSummaryPosition = new IndexDefinition(1, 0, 3);
			Column = column;
			if (rowData != null && base.View != null)
			{
				((IGroupRowStateClient)this).UpdateGroupRowStyle();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateDateSummaryAlignByColumns()
		{
			if (base.SummaryAlignByColumnsController != null && SummaryData != null)
			{
				base.SummaryAlignByColumnsController.UpdateBestFitData(new List<GridGroupSummaryColumnData> { SummaryData });
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (SummaryData != null || IsFirstColumn)
			{
				base.OnApplyTemplate();
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateDefaultContent()
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj2 = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj2.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			obj2.Add(new Layer(), 1);
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj3 = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj3.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj, 0);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj2, 1);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj3, 2);
			if (IsFirstColumn)
			{
				UpdateCheckBoxSelector();
				UpdateGroupValuePresenter();
				UpdateSummary();
				UpdateGroupExpandButton();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSummary();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateSummary()
		{
			GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode = ((base.ViewTable != null) ? base.ViewTable.GroupSummaryDisplayMode : GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default);
			if (groupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.AlignByColumns)
			{
				UpdateGroupSummaryAlignByColumns();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGroupSummaryAlignByColumns()
		{
			if (Column.ParentBand == null)
			{
				if (summaryController == null)
				{
					summaryController = new GroupRowColumnSummaryControl
					{
						DataContext = SummaryData,
						ColumnData = SummaryData
					};
					RemovePanelElement(ColumnSummaryPosition);
					AddPanelElement(summaryController, ColumnSummaryPosition);
				}
				else
				{
					summaryController.DataContext = SummaryData;
					summaryController.ColumnData = SummaryData;
				}
			}
			else if (summaryBandController == null)
			{
				summaryBandController = new GroupBandSummaryControl
				{
					DataContext = SummaryData
				};
				RemovePanelElement(ColumnSummaryPosition);
				AddPanelElement(summaryBandController, ColumnSummaryPosition);
			}
			else
			{
				summaryBandController.DataContext = SummaryData;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetGroupRowStateClient(GroupRowData rowData)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateLayoutSummaryPanelClip(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateFixedNoneContentWidth()
		{
		}

		internal double NullDataDelta()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (SummaryData == null)
			{
				if (summaryController != null)
				{
					num += summaryController.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (summaryBandController != null)
				{
					num += summaryBandController.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void UpdateGroupValuePresenterContent()
		{
			if (base.groupValuePresenter is GroupValuePresenter groupValuePresenter)
			{
				rowData.InitGroupValue();
				base.groupValuePresenter.ValueData = rowData.GroupValue;
				groupValuePresenter.BeginUpdate();
				groupValuePresenter.EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}
	public class LightweightBestFitGroupRowControl : BestFitControlBase, IBestFitGroupRow
	{
		private GroupRowData rowData;

		public bool IsFirstColumn { get; set; }

		public GridGroupSummaryColumnData SummaryData { get; set; }

		public LightweightBestFitGroupRowControl(DataViewBase view, ColumnBase column)
			: base(view, column)
		{
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateContent();
		}

		public void SetRowData(GroupRowData rowData)
		{
			this.rowData = rowData;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (IsFirstColumn && base.Content is BestFitGroupRowControl)
			{
				((BestFitGroupRowControl)base.Content).UpdateGroupValuePresenterContent();
				result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			if (base.Column != null && base.Column.View is TableView && IsFirstColumn && base.Content is BestFitGroupRowControl)
			{
				result.Width -= Math.Min(result.Width, ((TableView)base.Column.View).ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(base.Column) + ((BestFitGroupRowControl)base.Content).NullDataDelta());
			}
			else
			{
				result.Width++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void UpdateContent()
		{
			base.Content = new BestFitGroupRowControl(rowData, SummaryData, IsFirstColumn, base.Column);
		}
	}
	public class GroupCardRowControl : GroupRowControl
	{
		private Thickness borderTopThickness;

		private Border BorderTop;

		private CardView CardView => (CardView)rowData.View;

		static GroupCardRowControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GroupCardRowControl);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupCardRowControl>();
			DataControlPopupMenu.GridMenuTypeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(GridMenuType.GroupRow));
			GridViewHitInfoBase.HitTestAcceptorProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(new GroupRowTableViewHitTestAcceptor()));
		}

		public GroupCardRowControl(GroupRowData rowData)
			: base(rowData)
		{
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			BorderTop = (Border)GetTemplateChild("BorderTop");
			borderTopThickness = BorderTop.BorderThickness;
			IsPreviewExpandedChanged();
			UpdateCardLayoutChanged();
			if (base.FocusOffset > 0.0)
			{
				bottomLine = (Border)GetTemplateChild("BottomLine");
			}
		}

		protected override void IsPreviewExpandedChanged()
		{
			if (BorderTop != null)
			{
				if (!rowData.IsPreviewExpanded)
				{
					BorderTop.BorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					BorderTop.BorderThickness = borderTopThickness;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override double CalcLevelOffset()
		{
			if (CardView != null)
			{
				return CardView.LeftGroupAreaIndent * (double)rowData.Level;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override void UpdateCardLayoutChanged()
		{
			if (CardView != null && rootPanel != null)
			{
				switch (CardView.Orientation)
				{
				case System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal:
					((FrameworkElement)rootPanel).LayoutTransform = new RotateTransform(-90.0);
					break;
				case System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical:
					((FrameworkElement)rootPanel).LayoutTransform = new RotateTransform(0.0);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size RoundRowSize(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			return DXArranger.Round(size);
		}
	}

			DataControlPopupMenu.GridMenuTypeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(GridMenuType.GroupRow));

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(e);

		internal void AssignContextMenu()
		{
			BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)this, (IPopupControl)(object)View.DataControlMenu);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (e.ClickCount == 2)
			{
				RowExpandedCommand();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			rootPanel = (System.Windows.Controls.Grid)GetTemplateChild("PART_RootPanel");
			layoutPanel = (GroupRowControlPanel)GetTemplateChild("PART_LayoutPanel");
			backgroundBorder = (Border)GetTemplateChild("Background");
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(backgroundBorder);
			if (FocusOffset > 0.0)
			{
				bottomLine = (Border)GetTemplateChild("BottomLine");
			}
			CreateContent();
			UpdateLayoutSummaryPanelClip(base.DesiredSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			return RoundRowSize(size);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size RoundRowSize(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			return DXArranger.Ceiling(size);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			UpdateLayoutSummaryPanelClip(arrangeBounds);
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected void AddPanelElement(FrameworkElement element, IndexDefinition index)
		{
			if (element != null && layoutPanel != null)
			{
				layoutPanel.Groups.Add(new Column(element), index);
				element.SizeChanged += LayoutPanelElementSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void LayoutPanelElementSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateLayoutSummaryPanelClip(e.NewSize);
		}

		protected void RemovePanelElement(IndexDefinition index)
		{
			if (layoutPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Column column = layoutPanel.Groups.Get(index);
			if (column != null)
			{
				if (column.Element is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.SizeChanged -= LayoutPanelElementSizeChanged;
				}
				layoutPanel.Groups.Remove(index);
			}
		}

		private void CreateContent()
		{
			ClearElements();
			oldUseTemplate = UseGroupRowTemplate();
			if (oldUseTemplate)
			{
				CreateTemplateContent();
			}
			else
			{
				CreateDefaultContent();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CreateDefaultContent()
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj2 = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj2.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			obj2.Add(new Layer(), 1);
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj3 = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group
			{
				DockToRight = true
			};
			obj3.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj4 = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj4.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj, 0);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj2, 1);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj3, 2);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj4, 3);
			UpdateIndicator();
			UpdateOffsetPresenter();
			UpdateCheckBoxSelector();
			UpdateGroupValuePresenter();
			UpdateSummary();
			UpdateGroupExpandButton();
			UpdateDetailViewIndents();
		}

		private void CreateTemplateContent()
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group obj = new DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group();
			obj.Add(new Layer(), 0);
			layoutPanel.Groups.Add(obj, 0);
			UpdateIndicator();
			UpdateOffsetPresenter();
			UpdateRowIsExpanded();
			contentPresenter = (ContentPresenter)(object)new GroupGridRowPresenter
			{
				Content = rowData,
				ContentTemplateSelector = View.ActualGroupRowTemplateSelector
			};
			AddPanelElement(contentPresenter, ContentPresenterPosition);
		}

		private void ClearElements()
		{
			layoutPanel.ResetGroups();
			summaryAlignByColumnsController = null;
			indicator = null;
			offsetPresenter = null;
			groupExpandButton = null;
			checkBoxSelector = null;
			groupValuePresenter = null;
			summaryDefaultControl = null;
			detailLeftIndentControl = null;
			detailRightIndentControl = null;
			contentPresenter = null;
			groupValuePresenter = new NullGroupValuePresenter();
			fitContent = null;
		}

		private bool UseGroupRowTemplate()
		{
			if (IsNullOrDefaultTemplate(View.GroupRowTemplate))
			{
				if (View.GroupRowTemplateSelector != null)
				{
					return !IsNullOrDefaultTemplate(View.GroupRowTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(rowData, null));
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateContent()
		{
			if (layoutPanel != null)
			{
				if (oldUseTemplate != UseGroupRowTemplate())
				{
					CreateContent();
				}
				else if (contentPresenter != null)
				{
					contentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelector = View.ActualGroupRowTemplateSelector;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFadeSelection()
		{
			DataViewBase rootView = View.RootView;
			if (rootView.DataControl != null)
			{
				FadeSelection = FadeSelectionHelper.IsFadeNeeded(rootView.ActualFadeSelectionOnLostFocus, rootView.DataControl.IsKeyboardFocusWithin) && SelectionState != SelectionState.None;
			}
		}

		}

		{
		}

		private void MouseEnterOrLeave()
		{
			if (rowData != null && rowData.View != null && rowData.View.CanHighlightedState(rowData.RowHandle.Value, null, isCell: false, rowData.SelectionState, isGroupRow: true))
			{
				rowData.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			MouseEnterOrLeave();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			MouseEnterOrLeave();
		}

		protected virtual double CalcLevelOffset()
		{
			return CalcLevelOffset(rowData.Level);
		}

		protected virtual double CalcLevelOffset(int level)
		{
			if (ViewTable != null)
			{
				return ViewTable.LeftGroupAreaIndent * (double)level - ((ViewTable.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidth <= ViewTable.LeftGroupAreaIndent * (double)rowData.Level) ? ViewTable.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidth : 0.0);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual double CalcLeftIndent()
		{
			if (ViewTable == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return ((ViewTable.ShowFixRowButton != ShowFixRowButton.Never) ? ViewTable.FixRowButtonWidth : 0.0) + ((ViewTable.GroupValueTemplate is DefaultDataTemplate) ? ViewTable.LeftGroupAreaIndent : 0.0);
		}

		private double CalcOffset()
		{
			double num = FocusOffset;
			if (indicator != null && indicator.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ViewTable != null)
			{
				num += ViewTable.ActualIndicatorWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcFullOffset()
		{
			double num = CalcOffset();
			if (rowData.Level > 0)
			{
				num += CalcLevelOffset();
			}
			if (detailLeftIndentControl != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in detailLeftIndentControl.ItemsSource)
				{
					if (item is DetailIndent detailIndent)
					{
						num += detailIndent.Width;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected void UpdateOffsetPresenter()
		{
			if (layoutPanel != null && (rowData.Level > 0 || View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft) && offsetPresenter == null)
			{
				offsetPresenter = new GroupRowOffsetPresenter();
				AddPanelElement(offsetPresenter, GroupOffsetPosition);
			}
			UpdateLeftOffset();
			UpdateBottomLineOffset();
		}

		private void UpdateLeftOffset()
		{
			if (offsetPresenter != null)
			{
				if (rowData.Level > 0)
				{
					offsetPresenter.Width = CalcLevelOffset();
					return;
				}
				RemovePanelElement(GroupOffsetPosition);
				offsetPresenter = null;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateBottomLineOffset()
		{
			if (FocusOffset > 0.0 && bottomLine != null)
			{
				if (rowData.IsRowExpanded && SelectionState == SelectionState.None)
				{
					bottomLine.Margin = new Thickness(CalcFullOffset(), bottomLine.Margin.Top, bottomLine.Margin.Right, bottomLine.Margin.Bottom);
				}
				else
				{
					bottomLine.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, bottomLine.Margin.Top, bottomLine.Margin.Right, bottomLine.Margin.Bottom);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicator()
		{
			if (ViewTable != null)
			{
				indicator = new GroupRowIndicator();
				UpdateIndicatorWidth();
				if (!ViewTable.ActualShowIndicator)
				{
					UpdateIndicatorVisibility();
				}
				if (rowData.IndicatorState != IndicatorState.None)
				{
					UpdateIndicatorState();
				}
				AddPanelElement(indicator, IndicatorPosition);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorWidth()
		{
			if (indicator != null && ViewTable != null)
			{
				indicator.Width = ViewTable.ActualIndicatorWidth;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorVisibility()
		{
			if (indicator != null && ViewTable != null)
			{
				indicator.Visibility = ((!ViewTable.ActualShowIndicator) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorState()
		{
			if (indicator != null)
			{
				indicator.IndicatorState = rowData.IndicatorState;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorContentTemplate()
		{
			if (indicator != null)
			{
				indicator.UpdateContent();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateGroupExpandButton()
		{
			if (groupExpandButton == null && layoutPanel != null)
			{
				groupExpandButton = new GroupRowExpandButton();
				groupExpandButton.Command = new DelegateCommand(RowExpandedCommand);
				UpdateRowIsExpanded();
				AddPanelElement(groupExpandButton, GroupExpandButtonPosition);
			}
		}

		private void RowExpandedCommand()
		{
			GridCommands.ChangeGroupExpanded.Execute(rowData.RowHandle.Value, View);
		}

		protected void UpdateRowIsExpanded()
		{
			if (groupExpandButton != null)
			{
				groupExpandButton.IsChecked = rowData.IsRowExpanded;
			}
			if (LogicalItemsContainer != null)
			{
				LogicalItemsContainer.AnimationProgress = (rowData.IsRowExpanded ? 1 : 0);
			}
			UpdateBottomLineOffset();
		}

		protected void UpdateCheckBoxSelector()
		{
			if (checkBoxSelector == null && layoutPanel != null && (View.ActualShowCheckBoxSelectorInGroupRow || (ViewTable != null && ViewTable.ActualShowCheckBoxInGroupRow)))
			{
				checkBoxSelector = new GroupRowCheckBoxSelector();
				AddPanelElement(checkBoxSelector, CheckBoxSelectorPosition);
			}
			if (checkBoxSelector != null)
			{
				checkBoxSelector.Visibility = ((!View.ActualShowCheckBoxSelectorInGroupRow && (ViewTable == null || !ViewTable.ActualShowCheckBoxInGroupRow)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateGroupValuePresenter()
		{
			if (!(groupValuePresenter is GroupValuePresenter))
			{
				RemovePanelElement(GroupValuePresenterPosition);
				groupValuePresenter = new GroupValuePresenter();
				AddPanelElement(groupValuePresenter.Element, GroupValuePresenterPosition);
			}
			UpdateGroupValuePresenterContent();
			UpdateGroupValuePresenterTemplateSelector();
		}

		private void UpdateGroupValuePresenterContent()
		{
			groupValuePresenter.ValueData = rowData.GroupValue;
		}

		private void UpdateGroupValuePresenterTemplateSelector()
		{
			if (Column != null)
			{
				groupValuePresenter.ContentTemplateSelector = Column.ActualGroupValueTemplateSelector;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsNullOrDefaultTemplate(DataTemplate template)
		{
			if (template != null)
			{
				return template is DefaultDataTemplate;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSummary()
		{
			if (layoutPanel == null || rowData.GroupSummaryData == null || rowData.GroupSummaryData.Count == 0)
			{
				RemoveDefaultSummary();
				RemoveSummaryAlignByColumns();
				return;
			}
			switch ((ViewTable != null) ? ViewTable.GroupSummaryDisplayMode : GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default)
			{
			case GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default:
				RemoveSummaryAlignByColumns();
				UpdateGroupSummaryDefault();
				break;
			case GroupSummaryDisplayMode.AlignByColumns:
				if (View.GetIsCompactMode())
				{
					RemoveSummaryAlignByColumns();
					break;
				}
				RemoveDefaultSummary();
				UpdateGroupSummaryAlignByColumns();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGroupSummaryDefault()
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (summaryDefaultControl == null)
			{
				summaryDefaultControl = new GroupRowDefaultSummaryControl();
				AddPanelElement((FrameworkElement)(object)summaryDefaultControl, DefaultSummaryPosition);
			}
			ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper val = (ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper)View.ActualGroupSummaryItemTemplateSelector;
			if (IsNullOrDefaultTemplate(val.Template) && val.Selector == null)
			{
				val = null;
			}
			summaryDefaultControl.ItemTemplateSelector = (DataTemplateSelector)(object)val;
			((ItemsControlBase)summaryDefaultControl).ItemsSource = rowData.GroupSummaryData;
		}

		private void UpdateGroupSummaryAlignByColumns()
		{
			if (summaryAlignByColumnsController == null)
			{
				summaryAlignByColumnsController = new SummaryAlignByColumnsController(View.DataControl);
				AddPanelElement(summaryAlignByColumnsController.LayoutPanel, ColumnSummaryPosition);
			}
			if (fitContent == null)
			{
				fitContent = new RowFitBorder();
				UpdateFitContent();
				AddPanelElement(fitContent, FitContentPosition);
			}
			UpdateDateSummaryAlignByColumns();
			UpdateFixedNoneContentWidth();
			UpdateSummaryScrollingMargin();
			if (ViewTable != null)
			{
				summaryAlignByColumnsController.UpdateGroupColumnSummaryItemTemplate(IsNullOrDefaultTemplate(ViewTable.GroupColumnSummaryItemTemplate) && ViewTable.GroupColumnSummaryContentStyle == null);
			}
			UpdateLayoutSummaryPanelClip(base.DesiredSize);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateDateSummaryAlignByColumns()
		{
			if (summaryAlignByColumnsController != null)
			{
				summaryAlignByColumnsController.UpdateData(rowData);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveDefaultSummary()
		{
			if (summaryDefaultControl != null)
			{
				RemovePanelElement(DefaultSummaryPosition);
				summaryDefaultControl = null;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveSummaryAlignByColumns()
		{
			if (summaryAlignByColumnsController != null)
			{
				RemovePanelElement(ColumnSummaryPosition);
				summaryAlignByColumnsController = null;
			}
			if (fitContent != null)
			{
				RemovePanelElement(FitContentPosition);
				fitContent = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSummaryScrollingMargin()
		{
			if (summaryAlignByColumnsController != null && ViewTable != null)
			{
				if (rowData.Level > 0)
				{
					rowData.OnActualHeaderWidthChange();
				}
				summaryAlignByColumnsController.SetScrollingMargin(ViewTable.ScrollingHeaderVirtualizationMargin);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFitContent()
		{
			UpdateFitContentBorderBrush();
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(fitContent);
		}

		private void UpdateFitContentBorderBrush()
		{
			if (fitContent != null)
			{
				fitContent.BorderBrush = RowFitBorderBrush;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBottomLineMargin()
		{
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(backgroundBorder);
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(fitContent);
		}

		private void UpdateBottomLineMargin(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				element.Margin = BottomLineMargin;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateLayoutSummaryPanelClip(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			if (summaryAlignByColumnsController != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = summaryAlignByColumnsController.LayoutPanel;
				double layoutSummaryPanelLeftIndent = GetLayoutSummaryPanelLeftIndent();
				Rect rect = new Rect(layoutSummaryPanelLeftIndent, 0.0, Math.Max(0.0, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width - layoutSummaryPanelLeftIndent), Math.Max(uIElement.RenderSize.Height, arrangeBounds.Height));
				if (!(rect == oldGroupSummaryRect) || (rowData.GroupValues != null && rowData.GroupValues.Count > 1))
				{
					oldGroupSummaryRect = rect;
					uIElement.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
					summaryAlignByColumnsController.SetLeftIndent(layoutSummaryPanelLeftIndent + CalcLeftIndent());
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetLayoutSummaryPanelLeftIndent()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (groupExpandButton != null)
			{
				num += groupExpandButton.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			if (groupValuePresenter.Element != null)
			{
				num += groupValuePresenter.Element.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			if (checkBoxSelector != null)
			{
				num += checkBoxSelector.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void UpdateBands(FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			if (summaryAlignByColumnsController != null)
			{
				summaryAlignByColumnsController.UpdateBands(fixedStyle);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateDetailViewIndents()
		{
			IList<DetailIndent> detailIndents = rowData.DetailIndents;
			if (detailIndents != null)
			{
				if (detailLeftIndentControl == null && layoutPanel != null)
				{
					detailLeftIndentControl = new DetailRowsIndentControl();
					AddPanelElement(detailLeftIndentControl, LeftDetailIndentPosition);
				}
				if (detailRightIndentControl == null && layoutPanel != null)
				{
					detailRightIndentControl = new DetailRowsIndentControl
					{
						IsLeft = false
					};
					AddPanelElement(detailRightIndentControl, RightDetailIndentPosition);
				}
				if (detailRightIndentControl != null)
				{
					detailRightIndentControl.ItemsSource = detailIndents;
				}
				if (detailLeftIndentControl != null)
				{
					detailLeftIndentControl.ItemsSource = detailIndents;
					UpdateOffsetPresenter();
				}
			}
		}

		void IGroupRowStateClient.UpdateGroupRowStyle()
		{
			Style style = View.GroupRowStyle;
			if (style is DefaultStyle)
			{
				style = null;
				if (base.Style != null && base.Style.TargetType == GetType())
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (base.Style != style)
			{
				base.Style = style;
			}
		}

			}

	public class GroupRowControlPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		private GroupContainer groupsCore;

		public GroupContainer Groups
		{
			get
			{
				if (groupsCore == null)
				{
					groupsCore = new GroupContainer();
					groupsCore.Parent = new GroupPanelVisualItemOwner(this);
				}
