		public void ResetGroups()
		{
			groupsCore = null;
			base.Children.Clear();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group item in (IEnumerable<DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group>)Groups)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = MeasureGroup(item, Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - num), availableSize.Height);
				num += size.Width;
				if (size.Height > num2)
				{
					num2 = size.Height;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size MeasureGroup(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group group, double availableWidth, double availableHeight)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (Layer item in (IEnumerable<Layer>)group)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = MeasureLayer(item, availableWidth, availableHeight);
				if (size.Width > num)
				{
					num = size.Width;
				}
				if (size.Height > num2)
				{
					num2 = size.Height;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size MeasureLayer(Layer layer, double availableWidth, double availableHeight)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (Column item in (IEnumerable<Column>)layer)
			{
				UIElement element = item.Element;
				element.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableWidth - num), availableHeight));
				num += element.DesiredSize.Width;
				if (element.DesiredSize.Height > num2)
				{
					num2 = element.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = 0;
			foreach (DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group item in (IEnumerable<DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group>)Groups)
			{
				num3++;
				double num4 = ArrangeGroup(item, num, new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - num2), finalSize.Height), num3 == Groups.Count, item.DockToRight);
				if (item.DockToRight)
				{
					num2 += num4;
				}
				else
				{
					num += num4;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private static double ArrangeGroup(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout.Group group, double left, System.Windows.Size finalSize, bool isLastGroup, bool isRight)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (Layer item in (IEnumerable<Layer>)group)
			{
				double num2 = ArrangeLayer(item, left, finalSize, isLastGroup, isRight);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double ArrangeLayer(Layer layer, double left, System.Windows.Size finalSize, bool isLastGroup, bool isRight)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (Column item in (IEnumerable<Column>)layer)
			{
				num2++;
				UIElement element = item.Element;
				double num3 = (isRight ? (finalSize.Width - element.DesiredSize.Width) : (left + num));
				double width = ((isLastGroup && num2 == layer.Count) ? Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - num3) : element.DesiredSize.Width);
				element.Arrange(new Rect(num3, 0.0, width, finalSize.Height));
				num += element.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	public class GroupRowColumnSummaryControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control, IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient, ISupportLoadingAnimation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BorderBrushesProperty;

		private InlineTextUpdater updater = new InlineTextUpdater();

		private TextBlock textBlock;

		private Border border;

		public BrushSet BorderBrushes

			get

				{
					loadingAnimationHelper = new LoadingAnimationHelper(this);
				}
				return loadingAnimationHelper;
			}

		bool ISupportLoadingAnimation.IsReady => ColumnData.GroupRowData.IsReady;

		double ISupportLoadingAnimation.EditorOpacity => 1.0;

		internal void SyncWithColumnData()
		{
			if (ColumnData != null)
			{
				UpdateTextBlock();
				UpdateBorderThickness();
				UpdateBorderWidth();
				UpdateBorderBrush();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBorderThickness()
		{
			if (border != null)
			{
				border.BorderThickness = (ColumnData.HasRightSibling ? normalThickness : rightThickness);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateBorderWidth()
		{
			if (border != null)
			{
				ColumnData.OnActualHeaderWidthChange();
				border.Width = ColumnData.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBorderBrush()
		{
			if (border != null && BorderBrushes != null && View != null)
			{
				border.BorderBrush = BorderBrushes.GetBrush((ColumnData.GroupRowData.IsFocused && View.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && View.FadeSelectionOnLostFocus) ? "Focused" : "Normal");
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTextBlock()
		{
			if (ColumnData.HasSummary)
			{
				if (textBlock == null && border != null)
				{
					textBlock = new TextBlock
					{
						TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Right,
						TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis
					};
					TextBlockService.SetAllowIsTextTrimmed((DependencyObject)textBlock, true);
					TextBlockService.AddIsTextTrimmedChangedHandler((DependencyObject)textBlock, (RoutedEventHandler)OnIsTextTrimmedChanged);
					border.Child = textBlock;
					updater.TextBlock = textBlock;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				textBlock = null;
				if (border != null)
				{
					border.Child = null;
				}
				updater.TextBlock = null;
			}
			UpdateTextBlockValue();
		}

		private void UpdateTextBlockValue()
		{
			InlineCollectionInfo summaryTextInfo = ColumnData.SummaryTextInfo;
			if (summaryTextInfo != null)
			{
				updater.UseInlines = summaryTextInfo.HasStyle;
				updater.Update(summaryTextInfo);
			}
		}

		private void OnIsTextTrimmedChanged(object o, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			textBlock.ToolTip = (TextBlockService.GetIsTextTrimmed(textBlock) ? ((EditableDataObject)ColumnData).Value : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
		}

		static GroupRowColumnSummaryControl()
		{
			BorderBrushesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderBrushes", typeof(BrushSet), typeof(GroupRowColumnSummaryControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GroupRowColumnSummaryControl)d).UpdateBorderBrush();
			}));
			normalThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			rightThickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupRowColumnSummaryControl>();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			border = (Border)GetTemplateChild("PART_Border");
			SyncWithColumnData();
		}

		void IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient.UpdateFocusState()
		{
			UpdateBorderBrush();
		}

		void IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient.UpdateIsReady()
		{
			if (ColumnData != null)
			{
				LoadingAnimationHelper.ApplyAnimation();
			}
		}

		void IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient.UpdateHasSummary()
		{
			UpdateTextBlock();
		}

		void IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient.UpdateSummaryValue()
		{
			UpdateTextBlockValue();
		}

		void IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient.UpdateWidth()
		{
			if (border != null)
			{
				border.Width = ColumnData.ActualWidth;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SummaryAlignByColumnsController
	{
		internal abstract class GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase
		{
			private readonly System.Windows.Controls.Panel layoutPanel;

			private readonly DataControlBase ownerControl;

			protected GroupRowAlignByColumnsSummaryControl SummaryControl { get; set; }

			protected ITableView View => ownerControl.viewCore as ITableView;

			private BandsLayoutBase BandsLayout => ownerControl.BandsLayoutCore;

			protected GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase(System.Windows.Controls.Panel layoutPanel, DataControlBase ownerControl)
			{
				this.layoutPanel = layoutPanel;
				this.ownerControl = ownerControl;
			}

			public void UpdateData(GroupRowData data)
			{
				IList<GridGroupSummaryColumnData> fixedColumnData = GetFixedColumnData(data);
				UpdateData(fixedColumnData);
			}

			public void UpdateData(IList<GridGroupSummaryColumnData> columnData)
			{
				if (columnData != null && columnData.Count > 0 && HasElements(ownerControl.viewCore as TableView))
				{
					if (SummaryControl == null)
					{
						CreateElements();
						UpdateBands();
						UpdatePanel();
					}
					if (SummaryControl != null)
					{
						((ItemsControlBase)SummaryControl).ItemsSource = columnData;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Clear();
				}
			}

			protected virtual void Clear()
			{
				Remove((FrameworkElement)(object)SummaryControl);
				SummaryControl = null;
			}

			public void UpdateBands()
			{
				if (SummaryControl != null)
				{
					IList<BandBase> bands = null;
					if (BandsLayout != null)
					{
						bands = GetBands(BandsLayout);
					}
					SummaryControl.Bands = bands;
				}
			}

			public void UpdatePanel()
			{
				if (SummaryControl != null)
				{
					SummaryControl.UpdatePanel(BandsLayout != null);
				}
			}

			public void SetCanUseDefaultTemplate(bool canUse)

		private abstract class FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase : GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase
		{
			protected internal GroupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl FixedLine { get; set; }

			protected FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase(System.Windows.Controls.Panel layoutPanel, DataControlBase ownerControl)
				: base(layoutPanel, ownerControl)
			{
			}

			protected void CreateFixedElements(int summaryColumn, int separatorColumn, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
			{
				base.SummaryControl = CreateSummaryItemsControl(summaryColumn, fixedStyle);
				FixedLine = CreateFixedLine(separatorColumn);
				UpdateFixedSeparatorWidth();
				UpdateFixedSeparatorShowVertialLines();
				UpdateFixedSeparatorVisibility();
				Add(FixedLine);
			}

			private GroupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl CreateFixedLine(int column)
			{
				GroupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl groupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl = new GroupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl(GetFixedColumns, GetBands);
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumn(groupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl, column);
				return groupRowFixedLineSeparatorControl;
			}

			internal void UpdateFixedSeparatorWidth()
			{
				if (FixedLine != null)
				{
					FixedLine.Width = base.View.FixedLineWidth;
				}
			}

			internal void UpdateFixedSeparatorShowVertialLines()
			{
				if (FixedLine != null)
				{
					FixedLine.ShowVerticalLines = base.View.ShowVerticalLines;
				}
			}

			internal void UpdateFixedSeparatorVisibility()
			{
				if (FixedLine != null)
				{
					FixedLine.UpdateVisibility(base.View.ViewBase.DataControl);
				}
			}

			protected override void Clear()
			{
				base.Clear();
				Remove(FixedLine);
				FixedLine = null;
			}

			protected abstract IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedColumns(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior);

			internal void InvalidatePanel()
			{
				if (base.SummaryControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)base.SummaryControl).InvalidateMeasure();
					if (((ItemsControlBase)base.SummaryControl).Panel != null)
					{
						((ItemsControlBase)base.SummaryControl).Panel.InvalidateMeasure();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly FixedNoneSummaryControlUpdater fixedNoneUpdater;

		private readonly FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase fixedLeftUpdater;

		private readonly FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase fixedRightUpdater;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Grid LayoutPanel { get; private set; }

		public SummaryAlignByColumnsController(DataControlBase ownerControl)
		{
			LayoutPanel = new System.Windows.Controls.Grid();
			LayoutPanel.HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			ColumnDefinitionCollection columnDefinitions = LayoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions;
			columnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridLength.Auto
			});
			columnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridLength.Auto
			});
			columnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridControlHelper.starGridLength
			});
			columnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridLength.Auto
			});
			columnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridLength.Auto
			});
			fixedNoneUpdater = new FixedNoneSummaryControlUpdater(LayoutPanel, ownerControl);
			fixedLeftUpdater = new FixedLeftSummaryControlUpdater(LayoutPanel, ownerControl);
			fixedRightUpdater = new FixedRightSummaryControlUpdater(LayoutPanel, ownerControl);
		}

		internal void UpdateData(GroupRowData data)
		{
			DoUpdateAction(delegate(GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.UpdateData(data);
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateBestFitData(IList<GridGroupSummaryColumnData> columnData)
		{
			fixedNoneUpdater.UpdateData(columnData);
		}

		internal void SetScrollingMargin(Thickness scrollingMargin)
		{
			fixedNoneUpdater.SetScrollingMargin(scrollingMargin);
		}

		internal void UpdateGroupColumnSummaryItemTemplate(bool useDefaultTemplate)
		{
			DoUpdateAction(delegate(GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.SetCanUseDefaultTemplate(useDefaultTemplate);
			});
		}

		internal void UpdatePanel()
		{
			DoUpdateAction(delegate(GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.UpdatePanel();
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateBands(FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			DoUpdateAction(fixedStyle, delegate(GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.UpdateBands();
			});
		}

		internal void SetLeftIndent(double leftIndent)
		{
			DoUpdateAction(delegate(GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.SetLeftIndent(leftIndent);
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedSeparatorWidth()
		{
			DoFixedSummaryUpdateAction(delegate(FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.UpdateFixedSeparatorWidth();
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedSeparatorShowVertialLines()
		{
			DoFixedSummaryUpdateAction(delegate(FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase u)
			{
				u.UpdateFixedSeparatorShowVertialLines();
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedSeparatorVisibility()
		{
			UpdateFixedLeftSeparatorVisibility();
			UpdateFixedRightSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedLeftSeparatorVisibility()
		{
			fixedLeftUpdater.UpdateFixedSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedRightSeparatorVisibility()
		{
			fixedRightUpdater.UpdateFixedSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		internal void InvalidateFixedLeft()
		{
			fixedLeftUpdater.InvalidatePanel();
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedNoneContentWidth(double width)
		{
			fixedNoneUpdater.UpdateWidth(width);
		}

		private void DoUpdateAction(FixedStyle fixedStyle, Action<GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase> updateAction)
		{
			updateAction(fixedStyle switch
			{
				FixedStyle.None => fixedNoneUpdater, 
				FixedStyle.Left => fixedLeftUpdater, 
				FixedStyle.Right => fixedRightUpdater, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			});
		}

		private void DoUpdateAction(Action<GroupSummaryControlUpdaterBase> updateAction)
		{
			updateAction(fixedNoneUpdater);
			updateAction(fixedLeftUpdater);
			updateAction(fixedRightUpdater);
		}

		private void DoFixedSummaryUpdateAction(Action<FixedSummaryControlUpdaterBase> updateAction)
		{
			updateAction(fixedLeftUpdater);
			updateAction(fixedRightUpdater);
		}
	}

	public class GroupValuePresenter : System.Windows.Controls.Control, IGroupValuePresenter
	{
		private class GroupCustomPresenter
		{
			public ContentPresenter Presenter { get; set; }

			public GroupValueSeparator Separator { get; set; }

			public TextBlock HeaderTextBlock { get; set; }

			public TextBlock ValueTextBlock { get; set; }

			public bool IsTemplate => Presenter != null;
		}

		public const string PanelName = "PART_GroupValuesPanel";

		public const string GroupColumnHeaderFormat = "{0}: ";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnHeaderProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupColumnHeaderTextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HighlightingPropertiesProperty;

		private GroupValuePresenterController controller;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Panel _panel;

		private GroupCustomPresenter[] TextElements;

		private readonly Locker locker = new Locker();

		public string ColumnHeader
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(ColumnHeaderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ColumnHeaderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(TextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public GroupTextHighlightingProperties HighlightingProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return (GroupTextHighlightingProperties)GetValue(HighlightingPropertiesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HighlightingPropertiesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string GroupColumnHeaderText
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(GroupColumnHeaderTextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GroupColumnHeaderTextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private ObservableCollection<GridGroupValueData> GroupValues => controller.ValueData.RowData.GroupValues;

		GridGroupValueData IGroupValuePresenter.ValueData
		{
			get
			{
				return controller.ValueData;
			}
			set
			{
				controller.ValueData = value;
			}
		}

		bool? IGroupValuePresenter.UseTemplate => false;

		FrameworkElement IGroupValuePresenter.Element => this;

		DataTemplateSelector IGroupValuePresenter.ContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				FullUpdateTextBlocks();
			}
		}

		static GroupValuePresenter()
		{
			ColumnHeaderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ColumnHeader", typeof(string), typeof(GroupValuePresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GroupValuePresenter)d).OnColumnHeaderChanged();
			}));
			GroupColumnHeaderTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GroupColumnHeaderText", typeof(string), typeof(GroupValuePresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			TextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Text", typeof(string), typeof(GroupValuePresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			HighlightingPropertiesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HighlightingProperties", typeof(GroupTextHighlightingProperties), typeof(GroupValuePresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GroupValuePresenter)d).FullUpdateTextBlocks();
			}));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GroupValuePresenter);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupValuePresenter>();
			GridViewHitInfoBase.HitTestAcceptorProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(new GroupValueTableViewHitTestAcceptor()));
		}

		public GroupValuePresenter()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			controller = new GroupValuePresenterController(this);
		}

		private void OnColumnHeaderChanged()
		{
			GroupColumnHeaderText = GetGroupColumnHeaderText(ColumnHeader);
		}

		internal string GetGroupColumnHeaderText(string columnHeader)
		{
			return $"{columnHeader}: ";
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_panel = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_GroupValuesPanel") as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
			FullUpdateTextBlocks();
		}

		internal void BeginUpdate()
		{
			locker.Lock();
		}

		internal void EndUpdate()
		{
			locker.Unlock();
			FullUpdateTextBlocks();
		}

		private void FullUpdateTextBlocks()
		{
			if (!locker.IsLocked && _panel != null)
			{
				if (TextElements == null || TextElements.Length == 0)
				{
					_panel.Children.Clear();
				}
				if (GroupValues == null || GroupValues.Count == 0)
				{
					_panel.Children.Clear();
					TextElements = null;
				}
				else if (TextElements == null || TextElements.Length != GroupValues.Count)
				{
					TextElements = new GroupCustomPresenter[GroupValues.Count];
					_panel.Children.Clear();
					UpdateTextBlock(createElements: true);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateTextBlock();
				}
			}
		}

		private DataTemplateSelector GetDataTemplateSelectorByColumn(int idx)
		{
			if (GroupValues == null || GroupValues.Count <= idx)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(GroupValues[idx].Column is GridColumn gridColumn))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return gridColumn.ActualGroupValueTemplateSelector;
		}

		private bool UseGroupValueTemplate(DataTemplateSelector template, int idx)
		{
			if (template == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !(template.SelectTemplate(GroupValues[idx], null) is DefaultDataTemplate);
		}

		private void UpdateTextBlock(bool createElements = false)
		{
			//IL_03d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03df: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_03e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0418: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_039c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03aa: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_043e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			for (int i = 0; i < GroupValues.Count; i++)
			{
				DataTemplateSelector dataTemplateSelectorByColumn = GetDataTemplateSelectorByColumn(i);
				bool flag = UseGroupValueTemplate(dataTemplateSelectorByColumn, i);
				bool flag2 = !createElements && TextElements[i] != null && !flag && TextElements[i].IsTemplate;
				bool flag3 = !createElements && TextElements[i] != null && flag && !TextElements[i].IsTemplate;
				if (createElements || flag2 || flag3)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						int num = -1;
						if (flag2)
						{
							num = _panel.Children.IndexOf(TextElements[i].Presenter);
							if (num != -1)
							{
								_panel.Children.RemoveAt(num);
								if (TextElements[i].Separator != null)
								{
									_panel.Children.Remove(TextElements[i].Separator);
								}
							}
						}
						TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock();
						TextBlock textBlock2 = new TextBlock();
						TextElements[i] = new GroupCustomPresenter
						{
							HeaderTextBlock = textBlock,
							ValueTextBlock = textBlock2
						};
						if (num != -1 && num < _panel.Children.Count)
						{
							_panel.Children.Insert(num, textBlock2);
							_panel.Children.Insert(num, textBlock);
						}
						else
						{
							_panel.Children.Add(textBlock);
							_panel.Children.Add(textBlock2);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						int num2 = -1;
						if (flag3)
						{
							num2 = _panel.Children.IndexOf(TextElements[i].HeaderTextBlock);
							if (num2 != -1)
							{
								_panel.Children.RemoveAt(num2);
								_panel.Children.Remove(TextElements[i].ValueTextBlock);
							}
						}
						GridDataContentPresenter gridDataContentPresenter = new GridDataContentPresenter
						{
							Content = GroupValues[i],
							ContentTemplateSelector = dataTemplateSelectorByColumn
						};
						TextElements[i] = new GroupCustomPresenter
						{
							Presenter = (ContentPresenter)(object)gridDataContentPresenter,
							Separator = ((i != GroupValues.Count - 1) ? new GroupValueSeparator() : null)
						};
						if (num2 != -1 && num2 < _panel.Children.Count)
						{
							_panel.Children.Insert(num2, (UIElement)(object)gridDataContentPresenter);
							if (TextElements[i].Separator != null)
							{
								_panel.Children.Insert(num2 + 1, TextElements[i].Separator);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							_panel.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)gridDataContentPresenter);
							if (TextElements[i].Separator != null)
							{
								_panel.Children.Add(TextElements[i].Separator);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (TextElements[i].IsTemplate)
				{
					UpdateSeparators(i, i != GroupValues.Count - 1);
				}
				if (TextElements[i].Presenter == null)
				{
					TextElements[i].HeaderTextBlock.Text = GroupValues[i].GroupColumnHeaderText;
					if (HighlightingProperties == null)
					{
						string mergeText = GroupValues[i].GetMergeText();
						if (TextElements[i].ValueTextBlock.Text != mergeText)
						{
							TextElements[i].ValueTextBlock.Text = mergeText;
						}
						if (controller != null && controller.ClearHighlighting)
						{
							TextBlockService.UpdateTextBlock(TextElements[i].ValueTextBlock, (IHighlighterAppearance)new TextEditStyleSettings(), mergeText, (string)null, (HighlightedTextCriteria)1);
							if (i == GroupValues.Count - 1)
							{
								controller.ClearHighlighting = false;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						HighlightedTextCriteria val = (HighlightedTextCriteria)((int)HighlightingProperties.TextHighlightingProperties.FilterCondition != 1);
						TextBlockService.UpdateTextBlock(TextElements[i].ValueTextBlock, (IHighlighterAppearance)((HighlightingProperties.EditSettings.StyleSettings != null) ? ((object)HighlightingProperties.EditSettings.StyleSettings) : ((object)new TextEditStyleSettings())), GroupValues[i].GetMergeText(), HighlightingProperties.TextHighlightingProperties.Text, val);
						if (controller != null)
						{
							controller.ClearHighlighting = false;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!createElements)
				{
					TextElements[i].Presenter.Content = GroupValues[i];
					TextElements[i].Presenter.ContentTemplateSelector = dataTemplateSelectorByColumn;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeparators(int idx, bool show)
		{
			if (!(TextElements[idx].Separator != null && show) && (TextElements[idx].Separator != null || show))
			{
				if (show)
				{
					int num = _panel.Children.IndexOf(TextElements[idx].Presenter);
					TextElements[idx].Separator = new GroupValueSeparator();
					_panel.Children.Insert(num + 1, TextElements[idx].Separator);
				}
				else
				{
					_panel.Children.Remove(TextElements[idx].Separator);
					TextElements[idx].Separator = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}
	}
	internal abstract class GroupValuePresenterControllerBase<T> : IGroupValueClient where T : GridColumnData
	{
		private T valueDataCore;

		protected internal T ValueData
		{
			get
			{
				return valueDataCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (valueDataCore != value)
				{
					SetClient(null);
					valueDataCore = value;
					SetClient(this);
					UpdateColumnHeader();
					UpdateText();
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateText();

		protected abstract void UpdateColumnHeader();

		protected abstract void SetClient(IGroupValueClient client);

		void IGroupValueClient.UpdateText()
		{
			UpdateText();
		}

		void IGroupValueClient.UpdateColumnHeader()
		{
			UpdateColumnHeader();
		}
	}
	internal class GroupValuePresenterController : GroupValuePresenterControllerBase<GridGroupValueData>
	{
		private readonly GroupValuePresenter presenter;

		internal bool ClearHighlighting { get; set; }

		public GroupValuePresenterController(GroupValuePresenter presenter)
		{
			this.presenter = presenter;
		}

		protected override void UpdateText()
		{
			UpdateTextCore();
		}

		protected override void UpdateColumnHeader()
		{
			UpdateTextCore();
		}

		private List<GridColumn> GetMergeColumns()
		{
			if (base.ValueData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridViewBase gridView = base.ValueData.View as GridViewBase;
			if (gridView == null || gridView.SortInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = ((GridViewBase)base.ValueData.View).SortInfo[base.ValueData.Column.FieldName];
			if (gridSortInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)gridView.SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(gridSortInfo, gridView.SortInfo.GroupCount);
			if (mergeSortInfo == null)
			{
				return new List<GridColumn> { (GridColumn)base.ValueData.Column };
			}
			return mergeSortInfo.Select((GridSortInfo x) => gridView.Columns[x.FieldName]).ToList();
		}

		private void UpdateTextCore()
		{
			presenter.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				if (base.ValueData == null)
				{
					presenter.Text = null;
					presenter.HighlightingProperties = null;
					presenter.GroupColumnHeaderText = null;
				}
				else
				{
					ClearHighlighting = base.ValueData.HighlightingProperties == null && presenter.HighlightingProperties != null;
					presenter.HighlightingProperties = base.ValueData.HighlightingProperties;
					presenter.ColumnHeader = base.ValueData.ColumnHeader;
					presenter.Text = base.ValueData.Text;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				presenter.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void SetClient(IGroupValueClient client)
		{
			if (base.ValueData != null)
			{
				base.ValueData.SetGroupValueClient(client);
			}
		}
	}

			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(offsetPresenter.ActualWidth))
				{
					return offsetPresenter.ActualWidth;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

			{
				((UIElement)(object)cellsControl).InvalidateMeasure();
				if (((ItemsControlBase)cellsControl).Panel != null)
				{
					((ItemsControlBase)cellsControl).Panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

			if (rootView.DataControl != null)
			{
				FadeSelection = FadeSelectionHelper.IsFadeNeeded(rootView.ActualFadeSelectionOnLostFocus, rootView.DataControl.IsKeyboardFocusWithin) && SelectionState != SelectionState.None;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			layoutPanel = (System.Windows.Controls.Grid)GetTemplateChild("PART_LayoutPanel");
			backgroundBorder = (Border)GetTemplateChild("Background");
			bottomLine = GetTemplateChild("BottomLine") as Border;
			UpdateBottomLineHeight();
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(backgroundBorder, useMargin: true);
			CreateContent();
		}

		private void CreateContent()
		{
			ClearElements();
			if (UseTemplate)
			{
				CreateTemplateContent();
			}
			else
			{
				CreateDefaultContent();
			}
			oldUseTemplate = UseTemplate;
			((IRowStateClient)this).UpdateCompactMode(TableView.DataRowCompactTemplate);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearElements()
		{
			layoutPanel.Children.Clear();
			layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Clear();
			layoutPanel.RowDefinitions.Clear();
			CellsControl = null;
			fixedLeftCellsControl = null;
			fixedRightCellsControl = null;
			leftSeparator = null;
			rightSeparator = null;
			fitContent = null;
			indicator = null;
			offsetPresenter = null;
			detailExpandButtonContainer = null;
			if (fixRowControl != null)
			{
				fixRowControl.RowData = null;
			}
			fixRowControl = null;
			detailLeftIndentControl = null;
			detailRightIndentControl = null;
			contentPresenter = null;
			detailContentPresenter = null;
			indentScroller = null;
			EditFormContainer = null;
			compactModePresenter = null;
			UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter = null;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			return CeilingSize(size);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size CeilingSize(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (rowData.View != null && rowData.View.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				return size;
			}
			return DXArranger.Ceiling(size);
		}

		protected virtual void CreateDefaultContent()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
			{
				layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
				{
					Width = GridLength.Auto
				});
			}
			layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridControlHelper.starGridLength
			});
			layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridLength.Auto
			});
			if (AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
			{
				indentScroller = new IndentScroller();
				AddPanelElement(indentScroller, 2);
			}
			UpdateIndicator();
			UpdateOffsetPresenter();
			UpdateFitContent();
			CellsControl = CreateAndInitFixedNoneCellsControl(7, (RowData x) => x.FixedNoneCellData, (BandsLayoutBase x) => x.FixedNoneVisibleBands);
			UpdateFixedNoneContentWidth();
			UpdateFixedLeftCellData(null);
			UpdateFixedRightCellData(null);
			UpdateScrollingMargin();
			UpdateDetailExpandButton();
			UpdateFixRowButton();
			UpdateLeftDetailViewIndents();
			UpdateRightDetailViewIndents();
			UpdateDetails();
			UpdateInlineEditFormContainer();
			UpdateBottomLineMargin();
		}

		private void UpdateOffsetPresenter()
		{
			if (rowData.Level > 0 || rowData.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft)
			{
				UpdateOffsetPresenterLevel();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFitContent()
		{
			fitContent = new RowFitBorder();
			DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(fitContent, GridMenuType.RowCell);
			UpdateFitContentContextMenu();
			AddPanelElement(fitContent, 10);
			UpdateFitContentBorderBrush();
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(fitContent, !ShowDetails);
		}

		private void UpdateFitContentContextMenu()
		{
			if (fitContent != null)
			{
				BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)fitContent, (IPopupControl)(object)rowData.View.DataControlMenu);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicator()
		{
			indicator = new RowIndicator();
			DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(indicator, GridMenuType.RowCell);
			System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRowSpan(indicator, 3);
			UpdateIndicatorContextMenu();
			AddPanelElement(indicator, 0);
			UpdateIndicatorWidth();
			if (!((ITableView)rowData.View).ActualShowIndicator)
			{
				UpdateIndicatorVisibility();
			}
			if (rowData.IndicatorState != IndicatorState.None)
			{
				UpdateIndicatorState();
			}
			if (rowData.HasValidationErrorInternal)
			{
				UpdateRowValidationError();
			}
			UpdateIndicatorShowRowBreak();
			UpdateIndicatorFixedRowPosition();
			UpdateIndicatorIsLastFixedRow();
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorShowRowBreak()
		{
			if (indicator != null)
			{
				indicator.ShowRowBreak = ShowRowBreak;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == ShowRowBreakProperty)
			{
				UpdateBottomLineMargin();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorContextMenu()
		{
			if (indicator != null)
			{
				BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)indicator, (IPopupControl)(object)rowData.View.DataControlMenu);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CreateTemplateContent()
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0093: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int num = (IsTreeView ? 2 : 5);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
				{
					Width = GridLength.Auto
				});
			}
			layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
			{
				Width = GridControlHelper.starGridLength
			});
			UpdateIndicator();
			UpdateTemplateContentIndentScroller();
			UpdateOffsetPresenter();
			DataContentPresenter val = new DataContentPresenter();
			((ContentPresenter)val).Content = rowData;
			((ContentPresenter)val).ContentTemplateSelector = TableView.ActualDataRowTemplateSelector;
			contentPresenter = (ContentPresenter)val;
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(contentPresenter, !IsTreeView);
			if (AllowTreeIndentScrollingForTemplateContent && indentScroller != null)
			{
				indentScroller.AddScrollableElement(contentPresenter, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				AddPanelElement(contentPresenter, 5);
			}
			UpdateDetailExpandButton();
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateContentIndentScroller()
		{
			if (AllowTreeIndentScrollingForTemplateContent && indentScroller == null)
			{
				indentScroller = new IndentScroller();
				AddPanelElement(indentScroller, 2);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateOffsetPresenterLevel()
		{
			if (offsetPresenter == null && layoutPanel != null && (!AllowTreeIndentScrolling || indentScroller != null))
			{
				offsetPresenter = GridRowHelper.CreateRowOffsetContent(rowData, this, CreateRowMarginControl);
				if (offsetPresenter != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRowSpan(offsetPresenter, 3);
				}
				if (AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
				{
					indentScroller.AddScrollableElement(offsetPresenter, 0);
				}
				else
				{
					AddPanelElement(offsetPresenter, 2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual RowMarginControl CreateRowMarginControl(RowData rowData)
		{
			return TableView.CreateRowMarginControl(rowData) as RowMarginControl;
		}

		private void UpdateDetails()
		{
			if (layoutPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ShowDetails)
			{
				if (detailContentPresenter == null)
				{
					UpdateRowDefinitions();
					detailContentPresenter = new RowDetailsControl
					{
						Content = rowData
					};
					UpdateDetailContentPresenterRow();
					int num = (IsTreeView ? 2 : 5);
					System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumnSpan(detailContentPresenter, 10 - num + 1);
					if (indentScroller != null && IsTreeView)
					{
						indentScroller.AddScrollableElement(detailContentPresenter, 0, 1);
					}
					else
					{
						AddPanelElement(detailContentPresenter, num);
					}
					UpdateBottomLineMargin(detailContentPresenter, useMargin: true);
				}
				detailContentPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				detailContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelector = TableView.ActualRowDetailsTemplateSelector;
			}
			else if (detailContentPresenter != null)
			{
				detailContentPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			UpdateBottomLineMargin();
		}

		private void UpdateDetailContentPresenterRow()
		{
			if (detailContentPresenter != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRow(detailContentPresenter, (!ShowInlineEditForm) ? (UpdateRowButtonsAddRow ? 2 : ((!IsCompactMode) ? 1 : 2)) : (IsCompactMode ? 3 : 2));
			}
		}

		private void HideRowButtons(bool success)
		{

			{

				FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(FocusManager.GetFocusScope(UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter), null);
				FocusManager.SetIsFocusScope(UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter, value: false);
				UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				TableView.ViewBase.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown = false;
				TableView.ViewBase.RootView.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown = false;
				UpdateBottomLineMargin();
			}
		}

				UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter.ContentTemplate = TableView.UpdateRowButtonsTemplate;

				TableView.ViewBase.RootView.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown = true;
				UpdateBottomLineMargin();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRowButtonsControlMoveNext(bool prev)
		{
			if (UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter == null || UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<DependencyObject> enumerable = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter, false);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<System.Windows.Controls.Button> list = enumerable.Where((DependencyObject x) => x is System.Windows.Controls.Button && ((System.Windows.Controls.Button)x).IsTabStop && ((System.Windows.Controls.Button)x).IsEnabled)?.Cast<System.Windows.Controls.Button>()?.OrderBy((System.Windows.Controls.Button x) => x.TabIndex)?.ToList();
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < list.Count; num2++)
			{
				if (list[num2].IsFocused)
				{
					num = num2;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (prev)
			{
				switch (num)
				{
				case -1:
					num = list.Count;
					break;
				case 0:
					rowData.View.MoveLastCell();
					((UIElement)(object)rowData.View.CurrentCellEditor)?.Focus();
					return;
				}
				num--;
				list[num].Focus();
			}
			else if (num == list.Count - 1)
			{
				rowData.View.MoveFirstCell();
				((UIElement)(object)rowData.View.CurrentCellEditor)?.Focus();
				FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(FocusManager.GetFocusScope(list[num]), null);
			}
			else
			{
				num++;
				list[num].Focus();
			}
		}

		private bool UpdateRowButtonsControlIsFocused()
		{
			if (UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter == null || UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<DependencyObject> enumerable = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter, false);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<System.Windows.Controls.Control> list = enumerable.Where((DependencyObject x) => x is System.Windows.Controls.Control && ((System.Windows.Controls.Control)x).IsTabStop)?.Cast<System.Windows.Controls.Control>()?.OrderBy((System.Windows.Controls.Control x) => x.TabIndex)?.ToList();
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				if (list[num].IsFocused)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateFixedNoneContentWidth()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)((!AllowTreeIndentScrolling) ? (IsCompactMode ? ((object)compactModePresenter) : ((object)CellsControl)) : indentScroller);
			if (IsTreeView && AllowTreeIndentScrolling && UseTemplate)

				});

			bool flag = this.rowData?.RowHandle != null && rowData == null && TableView is TreeViewControlView;

		}

		private void UpdateBottomLineMargin()
		{
			if (layoutPanel != null)
			{
				bool useMargin = !ShowDetails && !ShowInlineEditForm;
				UpdateBottomLineMargin((FrameworkElement)(object)CellsControl, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin((FrameworkElement)(object)fixedLeftCellsControl, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin((FrameworkElement)(object)fixedRightCellsControl, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin(leftSeparator, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin(rightSeparator, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin(backgroundBorder, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin(fitContent, useMargin);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin(detailContentPresenter, useMargin: true);
				UpdateBottomLineMargin(UpdateRowButtonsControlPresenter, useMargin: true);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateBottomLineMargin(FrameworkElement element, bool useMargin)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double top = 0.0;
			double bottom = 0.0;
			double left = 0.0;
			if (useMargin && (ShowHorizontalLines || rowData.ShowBottomLine || IsLastFixedRow))
			{
				double num = ((bottomLine == null) ? 0.0 : (bottomLine.BorderThickness.Top + bottomLine.BorderThickness.Bottom));
				if (IsLastFixedRow)
				{
					num = TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLineHeight;
				}
				if (FixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					bottom = num;
				}
				else
				{
					top = num;
				}
			}
			if (useMargin && IsTreeView && ShowDetails)
			{
				left = GetTreeContentOffset();
			}
			element.Margin = new Thickness(left, top, 0.0, bottom);
		}

		private void UpdateScrollingMargin()
		{
			Thickness offset = ((ITableView)rowData.View).ScrollingVirtualizationMargin;
			if (AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
			{
				indentScroller.Do(delegate(IndentScroller x)
				{
					x.SetScrollOffset(offset);
				});
				return;
			}
			CellsControl.Do(delegate(CellsControl x)
			{
				x.SetPanelOffset(offset);
			});
			if (IsTreeView && ShowDetails && indentScroller == null)
			{
				UpdateDetailContentPresenterMargin();
			}
		}

		private double GetTreeContentOffset()
		{
			return rowData.GetTreeColumnOffset() + ((indentScroller == null) ? ((ITableView)rowData.View).ScrollingVirtualizationMargin.Left : 0.0);
		}

		private void UpdateDetailContentPresenterMargin()
		{
			if (detailContentPresenter != null)
			{
				detailContentPresenter.Margin = new Thickness(GetTreeContentOffset(), detailContentPresenter.Margin.Top, detailContentPresenter.Margin.Right, detailContentPresenter.Margin.Bottom);
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeFixedCellDataChanged(IList<GridColumnData> oldValue, IList<GridColumnData> newValue, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler handler)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)oldValue).CollectionChanged -= handler;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)newValue).CollectionChanged += handler;
			}
		}

		}

		private void CreateAndInitCellsControl(ref CellsControl cellsControl, int position, ref RowFixedLineSeparatorControl separator, int separatorPosition, Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getFixedBandsFunc, Func<TableViewBehavior, IList<ColumnBase>> getFixedColumnsFunc, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			if (layoutPanel != null && !UseTemplate)
			{
				IList<GridColumnData> list = getCellDataFunc(rowData);
				IList<BandBase> list2 = ((BandsLayout != null) ? getFixedBandsFunc(BandsLayout) : null);
				if (cellsControl == null && ((list != null && list.Count > 0) || list2 != null))
				{
					cellsControl = CreateAndInitCellsControl(position, getCellDataFunc, getFixedBandsFunc, fixedStyle);
					TableViewProperties.SetFixedAreaStyle((DependencyObject)(object)cellsControl, fixedStyle);
					separator = new RowFixedLineSeparatorControl(getFixedColumnsFunc, getFixedBandsFunc);
					UpdateFixedSeparatorHitTestAcceptor(separator, separatorPosition);
					separator.Width = ((ITableView)rowData.View).FixedLineWidth;
					UpdateFixedSeparatorShowVertialLines(separator);
					UpdateFixedSeparatorWidth(separator);
					UpdateFixedSeparatorVisibility(separator);
					UpdateBottomLineMargin(separator, !ShowDetails);
					AddPanelElement(separator, separatorPosition);
				}
				((IRowStateClient)this).UpdateCompactMode(TableView.DataRowCompactTemplate);
			}
		}

		private CellsControl CreateAndInitCellsControl(int position, Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			CellsControl cellsControl = CreateCellsControl(getCellDataFunc, getBandsFunc);
			UpdateView(cellsControl);
			UpdateBottomLineMargin((FrameworkElement)(object)cellsControl, !ShowDetails);
			if (AllowTreeIndentScrolling && fixedStyle == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				indentScroller.AddScrollableElement((UIElement)(object)cellsControl, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				AddPanelElement((FrameworkElement)(object)cellsControl, position);
			}
			if (IsBandedLayout || ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				UpdateCellsPanel(cellsControl);
			}
			UpdateCellData(cellsControl);
			return cellsControl;
		}

		protected virtual CellsControl CreateCellsControl(Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc)

		}

			FocusRectPresenter.SetIsHorizontalScrollHost((DependencyObject)(object)cellsControl, value: true);
			return cellsControl;
		}

		private double CalculateRowContentIndent()
		{
			if (layoutPanel == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 5;
			if (indentScroller != null)
			{
				num2 = 2;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				num += layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions[i].ActualWidth;
			}
			if (indentScroller != null)
			{
				num += indentScroller.GetRowIndentWidth();
			}
			else if (TableView != null && TableView.ViewBase.IsTreeView && CellsControl != null && CellsControl.RowMarginControl != null)
			{
				num += CellsControl.RowMarginControl.ActualWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void UpdateEditFormData()
		{
			if (rowData.RowHandle != null && rowData.View != null)
			{
				EditFormData = rowData.View.EditFormManager.GetInplaceData(rowData.RowHandle.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				EditFormData = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInlineEditFormContainer()
		{
			editFormCloseLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateInlineEditFormContainerCore();
			});
		}

		private void UpdateInlineEditFormContainerCore()
		{
			if (layoutPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateRowDefinitions();
			if (ShowInlineEditForm)
			{
				int value = 0;
				int value2 = 1;
				if (TableView.EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.InlineHideRow)
				{
					ClearElements();
					for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
					{
						layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
						{
							Width = GridLength.Auto
						});
					}
					layoutPanel.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = GridControlHelper.starGridLength
					});
					UpdateIndicator();
					UpdateOffsetPresenter();
				}
				else
				{
					value = 1;
					value2 = 6;
				}
				if (EditFormContainer == null)
				{
					EditFormContainer = new EditFormContainer();
					System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRow(EditFormContainer, value);
					System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumnSpan(EditFormContainer, value2);
					EditFormContainer.ShowMode = TableView.EditFormShowMode;
					AddPanelElement(EditFormContainer, 5);
				}
				EditFormContainer.ContentTemplate = TableView.EditFormTemplate;
				EditFormContainer.Content = EditFormData;
				EditFormContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else if (EditFormContainer != null)
			{
				if (appliedEditingMode == EditFormShowMode.InlineHideRow)
				{
					CreateContent();
				}
				else
				{
					layoutPanel.Children.Remove(EditFormContainer);
					EditFormContainer = null;
				}
			}
			appliedEditingMode = TableView.EditFormShowMode;
			UpdateDetailContentPresenterRow();
			UpdateBottomLineMargin();
		}

		private void OnEditFormContainerChanged()
		{
			editFormCloseLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (EditFormContainer == null)
				{
					rowData.View.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
					{
						x.EditFormManager.OnEditFormClosed(success: false);
					});
				}
			});
		}

		private void UpdateRowDefinitions()
		{
			if (layoutPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 1;
			if (ShowInlineEditForm)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (ShowDetails)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (IsCompactMode)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (UpdateRowButtonsAddRow)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (num > 1)
			{
				RowDefinitionCollection rowDefinitions = layoutPanel.RowDefinitions;
				for (int i = rowDefinitions.Count; i < num; i++)
				{
					rowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition
					{
						Height = ((i == 0) ? GridControlHelper.starGridLength : GridLength.Auto)
					});
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRowStyleBase()
		{
			Style style = ((ITableView)rowData.View).RowStyle;
			if (style is DefaultStyle)
			{
				style = null;
			}
			if (base.Style != style)
			{
				if (style == null)
				{
					ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Style = style;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateInnerElementsVisibility(Visibility visibility)
		{
			if (CellsControl != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)CellsControl).Opacity = ((visibility == Visibility.Hidden) ? 0.01 : 1.0);
			}
			if (contentPresenter != null)
			{
				contentPresenter.Visibility = visibility;
			}
			if (fixedLeftCellsControl != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)fixedLeftCellsControl).Visibility = visibility;
			}
			if (fixedRightCellsControl != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)fixedRightCellsControl).Visibility = visibility;
			}
			if (leftSeparator != null)
			{
				leftSeparator.Visibility = (TableView.TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements ? visibility : Visibility.Collapsed);
			}
			if (rightSeparator != null)
			{
				rightSeparator.Visibility = (TableView.TableViewBehavior.HasFixedRightElements ? visibility : Visibility.Collapsed);
			}
			if (fitContent != null)
			{
				fitContent.Visibility = visibility;
			}
			if (detailExpandButtonContainer != null)
			{
				detailExpandButtonContainer.Opacity = ((visibility == Visibility.Hidden) ? 0.01 : 1.0);
			}
			if (layoutPanel != null)
			{
				Border child = TreeHelper.GetChild<Border>((DependencyObject)layoutPanel, (Func<Border, bool>)((Border x) => x.Name == "detailRightLine"));
				if (child != null)
				{
					child.Visibility = visibility;
				}
			}
		}

		void IRowStateClient.UpdateCompactMode(DataTemplate template)
		{
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (template != null && IsCompactMode)
			{
				if (CellsControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)CellsControl).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (contentPresenter != null)
				{
					contentPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (fixedLeftCellsControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)fixedLeftCellsControl).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (fixedRightCellsControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)fixedRightCellsControl).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (leftSeparator != null)
				{
					leftSeparator.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (rightSeparator != null)
				{
					rightSeparator.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (compactModePresenter == null)
				{
					DataContentPresenter val = new DataContentPresenter();
					((FrameworkElement)val).Name = "PART_CompactModeRowContent";
					((ContentPresenter)val).Content = rowData;
					compactModePresenter = (ContentPresenter)val;
					System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRow(compactModePresenter, 0);
					AddPanelElement(compactModePresenter, 5);
					System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumnSpan(compactModePresenter, 11);
				}
				compactModePresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				compactModePresenter.ContentTemplate = template;
			}
			else
			{
				if (CellsControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)CellsControl).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (contentPresenter != null)
				{
					contentPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (fixedLeftCellsControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)fixedLeftCellsControl).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (fixedRightCellsControl != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)fixedRightCellsControl).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (leftSeparator != null)
				{
					leftSeparator.Visibility = ((!TableView.TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				if (rightSeparator != null)
				{
					rightSeparator.Visibility = ((!TableView.TableViewBehavior.HasFixedRightElements) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				if (compactModePresenter != null)
				{
					compactModePresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					compactModePresenter.ContentTemplate = template;
				}
			}
			UpdateRowDefinitions();
		}

		FormatValueProvider? IConditionalFormattingClient<RowControl>.GetValueProvider(string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (rowData.RowHandle == null || DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rowData.GetValueProvider(fieldName);
		}

		}

		}

		void IConditionalFormattingClient<RowControl>.UpdateCustomAppearance(CustomAppearanceEventArgs args)
		{
			ITableView tableView = TableView;
			int num = rowData.RowHandle.Return((RowHandle r) => r.Value, () => int.MinValue);
			if (tableView != null && num != int.MinValue)
			{
				CustomRowAppearanceEventArgs e = new CustomRowAppearanceEventArgs(args);
				e.RowHandle = num;
				e.Source = tableView as DataViewBase;
				e.RowSelectionState = SelectionState;
				tableView.RaiseCustomRowAppearance(e);
				e.SetActualResult(args);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(e);
			if (!isMenuAssigned)
			{
				AssignContextMenu();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (!isMenuAssigned && IsContextMenuKey(e))
			{
				AssignContextMenu();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsContextMenuKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Apps)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.System && e.SystemKey == Key.F10)
				{
					return ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e));
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void AssignContextMenu()
		{
			if (rowData != null && rowData.View != null && rowData.View.IsTreeView)
			{
				DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(this, GridMenuType.RowCell);
				BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)this, (IPopupControl)(object)rowData.View.DataControlMenu);
				isMenuAssigned = true;
			}
		}
	}

	public class RowFixedLineSeparatorControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private readonly Func<TableViewBehavior, IList<ColumnBase>> getFixedColumnsFunc;

		private readonly Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getFixedBandsFunc;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowVerticalLinesProperty;

		public bool ShowVerticalLines
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public RowFixedLineSeparatorControl(Func<TableViewBehavior, IList<ColumnBase>> getFixedColumnsFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getFixedBandsFunc)
		{
			this.getFixedColumnsFunc = getFixedColumnsFunc;
			this.getFixedBandsFunc = getFixedBandsFunc;
		}

		internal void UpdateVisibility(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			IList list = ((dataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null) ? ((IList)getFixedBandsFunc(dataControl.BandsLayoutCore)) : ((IList)getFixedColumnsFunc((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.viewCore.ViewBehavior)));
			base.Visibility = ((list == null || list.Count <= 0) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		static RowFixedLineSeparatorControl()
		{
			ShowVerticalLinesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowVerticalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(RowFixedLineSeparatorControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RowFixedLineSeparatorControl>();
		}
	}
	public class ToolTipHelper : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowTooltipProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ShowTooltip", typeof(bool), typeof(ToolTipHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateToolTip(d, e);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Content", typeof(object), typeof(ToolTipHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateToolTip(d, e);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(ToolTipHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateToolTip(d, e);
		}));

		public static bool GetShowTooltip(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(ShowTooltipProperty);
		}

		public static void SetShowTooltip(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ShowTooltipProperty, value);
		}

		public static object GetContent(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return obj.GetValue(ContentProperty);
		}

		public static void SetContent(DependencyObject obj, object value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ContentProperty, value);
		}

		public static DataTemplate GetContentTemplate(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (DataTemplate)obj.GetValue(ContentTemplateProperty);
		}

		public static void SetContentTemplate(DependencyObject obj, DataTemplate value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ContentTemplateProperty, value);
		}

		private static void UpdateToolTip(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GetShowTooltip(d) && GetContent(d) != null && GetContentTemplate(d) != null)
			{
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(d, new System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip
				{
					Content = GetContent(d),
					ContentTemplate = GetContentTemplate(d)
				});
			}
			else
			{
				d.ClearValue(ToolTipService.ToolTipProperty);
			}
		}
	}

			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsLastFixedRowProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal Border ContentBorder
		{
			get
			{
				return contentBorder;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (contentBorder != value)
				{
					if (contentBorder != null)
					{
						contentBorder.Child = null;
					}
					contentBorder = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private RowDataBase RowData => base.DataContext as RowDataBase;

		private ITableView TableView
		{
			get
			{
				if (RowData == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return RowData.View as ITableView;
			}
		}

		static RowIndicator()
		{

			}));

			}));

			FixedRowPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FixedRowPosition", typeof(FixedRowPosition), typeof(RowIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(FixedRowPosition.None));
			IsLastFixedRowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsLastFixedRow", typeof(bool), typeof(RowIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			}));

		private void OnIndicatorStateChanged()
		{
			UpdateContent();
		}

		private void OnContentTemplateChanged()
		{
			UpdateContent();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_ContentBorder") as Border;
			bottomBorder = GetTemplateChild("BottomBorder") as Border;
			UpdateFixedLineHeight();
			UpdateContent();
		}

		internal void UpdateContent()
		{
			if (TableView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = GetContentTemplate();
			if (ContentBorder == null || dataTemplate == contentTemplate)
			{
				return;
			}
			contentTemplate = dataTemplate;
			if (contentTemplate != null && contentPresenter == null)
			{
				contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			}
			if (contentPresenter != null)
			{
				contentPresenter.Content = null;
				contentPresenter.ContentTemplate = contentTemplate;
				if (contentTemplate != null)
				{
					contentPresenter.Content = RowData;
				}
			}
			ContentBorder.Child = contentPresenter;
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedLineHeight()
		{
			if (bottomBorder != null && TableView != null)
			{
				if (IsLastFixedRow)
				{
					bottomBorder.Height = TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLineHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					bottomBorder.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		internal DataTemplate GetContentTemplate()
		{
			if (TableView.RowIndicatorContentTemplate != null && !(TableView.RowIndicatorContentTemplate is DefaultDataTemplate))
			{
				return TableView.RowIndicatorContentTemplate;
			}
			return IndicatorState switch
			{
				IndicatorState.AutoFilterRow => AutoFilterRowContentTemplate, 
				IndicatorState.Changed => ChangedContentTemplate, 
				IndicatorState.Editing => EditingContentTemplate, 
				IndicatorState.Error => ErrorContentTemplate, 
				IndicatorState.Focused => FocusedContentTemplate, 
				IndicatorState.FocusedError => FocusedErrorContentTemplate, 
				IndicatorState.NewItemRow => NewItemRowContentTemplate, 
				_ => NoneContentTemplate, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class RowNewItemControl : AdditionalRowControl
	{
		private RowNewItemTextControl backgroundText;

		protected override bool AllowTreeIndentScrolling => false;

		private DataViewBase View => rowData.View;

		public RowNewItemControl(RowData rowData)
			: base(rowData)
		{
			base.Name = "PART_NewItemRow";
			if (rowData is AdditionalRowData)
			{
				((AdditionalRowData)rowData).ChangeWholeElement(this);
			}
		}

		static RowNewItemControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RowNewItemControl>();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateDetailBorderVisible();
			if (rowData == null || rowData.View == null || rowData.RowHandle == null || rowData.View.FocusedRowHandle != rowData.RowHandle.Value)
			{
				UpdateInnerElementsVisibility(Visibility.Hidden);
			}
		}

		protected override CellsControl CreateCellsControl(Func<RowData, IList<GridColumnData>> getCellDataFunc, Func<BandsLayoutBase, IList<BandBase>> getBandsFunc)
		{
			return new NewItemsCellsControl(this, getCellDataFunc, getBandsFunc);
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundText()
		{
			if (backgroundText == null)
			{
				backgroundText = new RowNewItemTextControl
				{
					DataContext = rowData
				};
			}
			DataControlBase.SetCurrentView(backgroundText, rowData.View);
			System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumnSpan(backgroundText, 8);
			UpdateBottomLineMargin(backgroundText, useMargin: true);
			AddPanelElement(backgroundText, 3);
		}

		protected override void CreateDefaultContent()
		{
			base.CreateDefaultContent();
			UpdateBackgroundText();
			UpdateIsFocused();
		}

		protected override void CreateTemplateContent()
		{
			base.CreateTemplateContent();
			UpdateBackgroundText();
			UpdateIsFocused();
		}

		protected override void ClearElements()
		{
			base.ClearElements();
			backgroundText = null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateIsFocused()
		{
			base.UpdateIsFocused();
			if (backgroundText == null)
			{
				UpdateBackgroundText();
			}
			UpdateDetailBorderVisible();
			if (rowData.View.FocusedRowHandle == rowData.RowHandle.Value)
			{
				backgroundText.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				UpdateInnerElementsVisibility(Visibility.Visible);
			}
			else
			{
				backgroundText.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				UpdateInnerElementsVisibility(Visibility.Hidden);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRowPosition()
		{
			base.UpdateRowPosition();
			if (View != null)
			{
				base.Visibility = ((!View.ViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateDetailExpandButton()
		{
			base.UpdateDetailExpandButton();
			UpdateDetailBorderVisible();
		}

		private void UpdateDetailBorderVisible()
		{
			if (detailExpandButtonContainer != null)
			{
				detailExpandButtonContainer.ShowRightBorder = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRowStyleBase()
		{
		}
	}
	public class RowDetailNewItemControl : DetailRowControlBase
	{
		private DetailInfoWithContent.DetailColumnsData currentDataContext;

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty)
			{
				if (currentDataContext != null)
				{
					((DataObjectBase)currentDataContext).PropertyChanged -= CurrentDataContext_PropertyChanged;
				}
				currentDataContext = e.NewValue as DetailInfoWithContent.DetailColumnsData;
				if (currentDataContext != null)
				{
					((DataObjectBase)currentDataContext).PropertyChanged += CurrentDataContext_PropertyChanged;
					UpdateTemplate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CurrentDataContext_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "View")
			{
				UpdateTemplate();
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == "DetailLevel")
			{
				RowData newItemRowData = ((ITableView)currentDataContext.View).NewItemRowData;
				if (newItemRowData is AdditionalRowData && newItemRowData.DetailLevel != currentDataContext.DetailLevel)
				{
					((AdditionalRowData)newItemRowData).SetDetailLevel(currentDataContext.DetailLevel);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTemplate()
		{
			if (currentDataContext != null && currentDataContext.View is ITableView)
			{
				RowData newItemRowData = ((ITableView)currentDataContext.View).NewItemRowData;
				base.Content = new RowNewItemControl(newItemRowData);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Content = null;
			}
		}
	}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualSelectedIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ActualSelectedIndex", typeof(int), typeof(DetailTabControl), new PropertyMetadata(-1, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		}));

			}

			}
		}

		public DetailTabControl()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((DXTabControl)this).SelectionChanging += new TabControlSelectionChangingEventHandler(OnSelectionChanging);
			((DXTabControl)this).SelectionChanged += new TabControlSelectionChangedEventHandler(OnSelectionChanged);
		}

		private void OnSelectionChanging(object sender, TabControlSelectionChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RowData != null)
			{
				RowData.SelectedIndexLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = !RowData.CurrentTabsDetailInfo.MasterDataControl.DataView.CommitEditingInternal();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectionChanged(object sender, TabControlSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RowData != null)
			{
				ActualSelectedIndex = e.NewSelectedIndex;
			}
		}

		private void OnActualSelectedIndexChanged()
		{
			((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)this).SelectItem(ActualSelectedIndex, false);
		}

		private void OnRowDataChanged(TabsDetailInfo.TabHeadersRowData oldRowData)
		{
			if (oldRowData != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)oldRowData, TabsDetailInfo.TabHeadersRowData.SelectedTabIndexProperty);
			}
			if (RowData != null)
			{
				RowData.SelectedIndexLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)this).SelectItem(RowData.SelectedTabIndex, false);
				});
				BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)RowData, TabsDetailInfo.TabHeadersRowData.SelectedTabIndexProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ActualSelectedIndex")
				{
					Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay,
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((DXTabControl)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)(object)this, "PART_ContentContainer");
			frameworkElement.Height = 1.0;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((DXTabControl)this).PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			DXTabItem val = (DXTabItem)element;
			((UIElement)(object)val).Focusable = false;
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)val).IsTabStop = false;
		}

	public class DetailDescriptorContentBorder : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowBottomLineProperty;

		public bool ShowBottomLine
		{

		internal static IRootDataNode CreatePrintingTreeNode(CardView view, System.Windows.Size usablePageSize, ItemsGenerationStrategyBase itemsGenerationStrategy = null)
		{
			CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder = view.CreatePrintingDataTreeBuilder(new System.Windows.Size(usablePageSize.Width, 0.0).Width, itemsGenerationStrategy);
			cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder.View.layoutUpdatedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder.GenerateAllItems);
			DoAfterGenerateNodeTreeAction(cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder);
			return (IRootDataNode)(object)new CardViewRootPrintingNode(cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder, usablePageSize);
		}

		internal static void CreatePrintingTreeNodeAsync(CardView view, System.Windows.Size usablePageSize)
		{
			ItemsGenerationAsyncServerModeStrategyAsync itemsGenerationStrategy = new ItemsGenerationAsyncServerModeStrategyAsync(view);
			itemsGenerationStrategy.StartFetchingAllFilteredAndSortedRows(delegate
			{
				IRootDataNode rootNode = CreatePrintingTreeNode(view, usablePageSize, itemsGenerationStrategy);
				view.RaiseCreateRootNodeCompleted(rootNode);
			});
		}

		{
		}

		public static void UpdatePageBricks(IEnumerator pageBrickEnumerator, Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> pageBrickUpdaters, bool updateTopRowBricks, bool skipUpdateLastRowBricks)
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (pageBrickUpdaters.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			VisualBrick val = null;
			List<VisualBrick> list = new List<VisualBrick>();
			while (pageBrickEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = pageBrickEnumerator.Current;
				val = (VisualBrick)((current is VisualBrick) ? current : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(val);
				if (updateTopRowBricks)
				{
					TextBrick val2 = (TextBrick)(object)((val is TextBrick) ? val : null);
					if (val2 != null && (double)((BrickBase)val2).Rect.Y == 0.0)
					{
						((VisualBrick)val2).Sides = (BorderSide)(((VisualBrick)val2).Sides | 2);
					}
				}
			}
			GridPrintingHelper.UpdateTopBorders(pageBrickUpdaters, list);
		}
