		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0)
			{
				return RowIndentControl;
			}
			return VisualChildren[index - 1];
		}

		private RowData GetNextRowData()
		{
			CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder = (CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder)RowData.treeBuilder;
			if (LastPrintRowData == null)
			{
				return CreateCardData(cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder, RowData.node);
			}
			int num = cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder.AllNodes.IndexOf((DataRowNode)LastPrintRowData.node) + 1;
			if (num >= cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder.AllNodes.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataRowNode dataRowNode = cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder.AllNodes[num];
			if (dataRowNode is GroupNode)
			{
				UpdateAfterGroupRowHandle(cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder, num);
				return null;
			}
			return CreateCardData(cardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder, dataRowNode);
		}

		private CardData CreateCardData(CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, RowNode node)
		{
			RowDataBase rowDataBase = node.CreateRowData();
			rowDataBase.AssignFromInternal(null, treeBuilder.ReusingRowData.parentNodeContainer, node);
			treeBuilder.UpdateRowData((RowData)rowDataBase);
			return (CardData)rowDataBase;
		}

		private void UpdateAfterGroupRowHandle(CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int currentIndex)
		{
			for (int i = currentIndex + 1; i < treeBuilder.AllNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				DataRowNode dataRowNode = treeBuilder.AllNodes[i];
				if (!(dataRowNode is GroupNode))
				{
					afterGroupRowHandle = dataRowNode.RowHandle.Value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size RemergeCurrentRow(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size rowIndentControlSize = GetRowIndentControlSize(availableSize);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - rowIndentControlSize.Width), availableSize.Height);
			availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(size.Width, availableSize.Height);
			System.Windows.Size result = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Height);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((PrintMaximumCardColumns > 0) ? PrintMaximumCardColumns : int.MaxValue);
			while (true)
			{
				if (num == VisualChildren.Count)
				{
					RowData nextRowData = GetNextRowData();
					if (nextRowData == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					AddVisualChildFromCache();
					ContentControl contentControl = VisualChildren[num];
					contentControl.Content = nextRowData;
				}
				ContentControl contentControl2 = VisualChildren[num];
				RowData rowData = (RowData)contentControl2.Content;
				SetIsFirstCardInRow((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, num == 0);
				contentControl2.Measure(availableSize);
				if ((contentControl2.DesiredSize.Width > size.Width && num > 0) || num == num2)
				{
					LastPrintRowData = (RowData)VisualChildren[num - 1].Content;
					PutVisualChildInCache(contentControl2);
					break;
				}
				size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, size.Width - contentControl2.DesiredSize.Width), size.Height);
				result = new System.Windows.Size(result.Width, Math.Max(result.Height, contentControl2.DesiredSize.Height));
				LastPrintRowData = rowData;
				num++;
			}
			int num3 = num;
			for (int num4 = VisualChildren.Count - num; num4 > 0; num4--)
			{
				PutVisualChildInCache(VisualChildren.Last());
			}
			return result;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetRowIndentControlSize(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (RowIndentControl == null)
			{
				RowIndentControl = new ContentControl();
				RowIndentControl.ContentTemplate = RowIndentControlTemplate;
				AddVisualChild(RowIndentControl);
				AddLogicalChild(RowIndentControl);
			}
			RowIndentControl.Content = base.DataContext;
			RowIndentControl.Measure(availableSize);
			return RowIndentControl.DesiredSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (RowData.RowHandle.Value == lastRowHandle)
			{
				return RemergeCurrentRow(availableSize);
			}
			if (RowData.RowHandle.Value == afterGroupRowHandle)
			{
				LastPrintRowData = null;
			}
			lastRowHandle = RowData.RowHandle.Value;
			System.Windows.Size rowIndentControlSize = GetRowIndentControlSize(availableSize);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - rowIndentControlSize.Width), availableSize.Height);
			availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(size.Width, availableSize.Height);
			System.Windows.Size result = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Height);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((PrintMaximumCardColumns > 0) ? PrintMaximumCardColumns : int.MaxValue);
			while (true)
			{
				RowData nextRowData = GetNextRowData();
				if (nextRowData == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				SetIsFirstCardInRow((DependencyObject)(object)nextRowData, num == 0);
				if (num == VisualChildren.Count)
				{
					AddVisualChildFromCache();
				}
				ContentControl contentControl = VisualChildren[num];
				contentControl.Content = nextRowData;
				contentControl.Measure(availableSize);
				if ((contentControl.DesiredSize.Width > size.Width && num > 0) || num == num2)
				{
					PutVisualChildInCache(contentControl);
					break;
				}
				size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, size.Width - contentControl.DesiredSize.Width), size.Height);
				result = new System.Windows.Size(result.Width, Math.Max(result.Height, contentControl.DesiredSize.Height));
				LastPrintRowData = nextRowData;
				num++;
			}
			int num3 = num;
			for (int num4 = VisualChildren.Count - num; num4 > 0; num4--)
			{
				PutVisualChildInCache(VisualChildren.Last());
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (VisualChildren.Count == 0)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			RowIndentControl.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, RowIndentControl.DesiredSize.Width, RowIndentControl.DesiredSize.Height));
			double num = RowIndentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
			foreach (ContentControl visualChild in VisualChildren)
			{
				visualChild.Arrange(new Rect(num, 0.0, visualChild.DesiredSize.Width, visualChild.DesiredSize.Height));
				num += visualChild.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void PutVisualChildInCache(ContentControl control)
		{
			VisualChildrenCache.Add(control);
			RemoveVisualChild(control);
			VisualChildren.Remove(control);
			RemoveLogicalChild(control);
			control.Content = null;
		}

		private void AddVisualChildFromCache()
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = null;
			if (VisualChildrenCache.Count > 0)
			{
				contentControl = VisualChildrenCache[0];
				VisualChildrenCache.RemoveAt(0);
				VisualChildren.Add(contentControl);
				AddVisualChild(contentControl);
				AddLogicalChild(contentControl);
			}
			else
			{
				contentControl = new ContentControl();
				contentControl.ContentTemplate = ItemTemplate;
				VisualChildren.Add(contentControl);
				AddVisualChild(contentControl);
				AddLogicalChild(contentControl);
			}
		}
	}

		private static double CalcTotalPrintHeaderWidth(ITableView view, BandsLayoutBase bandsLayout)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (bandsLayout == null)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase printableColumn in view.ViewBase.PrintableColumns)
				{
					num += GetPrintColumnWidth((DependencyObject)(object)printableColumn);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in bandsLayout.VisibleBands)
				{
					num += GetPrintColumnWidth((DependencyObject)(object)visibleBand);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static void UpdatePageBricks(IEnumerator pageBrickEnumerator, Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> pageBrickUpdaters, bool updateTopRowBricks, bool skipUpdateLastRowBricks)
		{
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (pageBrickUpdaters.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<int, List<VisualBrick>> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, List<VisualBrick>>();
			VisualBrick val = null;
			double num = double.MinValue;
			List<VisualBrick> list = new List<VisualBrick>();
			while (pageBrickEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = pageBrickEnumerator.Current;
				val = (VisualBrick)((current is VisualBrick) ? current : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(val);
				int key = 0;
				if (!((Brick)val).TryGetAttachedValue<int>(BrickAttachedProperties.ParentID, ref key))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					dictionary[key] = new List<VisualBrick>();
				}
				dictionary[key].Add(val);
				if (updateTopRowBricks)
				{
					TextBrick val2 = (TextBrick)(object)((val is TextBrick) ? val : null);
					if (val2 != null && (double)((BrickBase)val2).Rect.Y == 0.0)
					{
						((VisualBrick)val2).Sides = (BorderSide)(((VisualBrick)val2).Sides | 2);
					}
				}
				if ((double)((BrickBase)val).Rect.Y > num)
				{
					num = ((BrickBase)val).Rect.Y;
				}
			}
			UpdateTopBorders(pageBrickUpdaters, list);
			if (val != null)
			{
				UpdateBottomBorders(pageBrickUpdaters, dictionary, val, skipUpdateLastRowBricks, num);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateBottomBorders(Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> pageBrickUpdaters, Dictionary<int, List<VisualBrick>> printedBricksGroupedByBand, VisualBrick currentPageBrick, bool skipUpdateLastRowBricks, double maxBrickY)
		{
			foreach (List<VisualBrick> value2 in printedBricksGroupedByBand.Values)
			{
				foreach (VisualBrick item in value2)
				{
					if (!pageBrickUpdaters.TryGetValue((IVisualBrick)(object)item, out var value) || !(value is LastOnPageUpdater))
					{
						continue;
					}
					LastOnPageUpdater lastOnPageUpdater = value as LastOnPageUpdater;
					if (!(lastOnPageUpdater is IndentBorderUpdater { UpdateBottomBorder: false }))
					{
						if ((double)((BrickBase)item).Rect.Bottom < maxBrickY || Math.Abs((double)((BrickBase)item).Rect.Bottom - maxBrickY) <= 0.01)
						{
							lastOnPageUpdater.Rollback((IVisualBrick)(object)item);
						}
						else
						{
							value.Update((IVisualBrick)(object)item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateTopBorders(Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> pageBrickUpdaters, List<VisualBrick> bricks)

			printingDataTreeBuilderBase.View.layoutUpdatedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)printingDataTreeBuilderBase.GenerateAllItems);
			DoAfterGenerateNodeTreeAction(printingDataTreeBuilderBase);

		}

		private static void CalcPrintLayout(ITableView view, System.Windows.Size pageSize, BandsLayoutBase bandsLayout, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{

		}

				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				brick.Sides = sides;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<IVisualBrick, SavedState> savedStates = new Dictionary<IVisualBrick, SavedState>();

		public void Rollback(IVisualBrick brick)
		{

			}
		}

		void IOnPageUpdater.Update(IVisualBrick brick)
		{

					if (((IBaseBrick)brick).Rect.X == 0f)
					{
						SetSides((IVisualBrick)(object)val2, (BorderSide)0);
					}
					else if ((val2.Sides & 1) == 1)
					{

			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PanelBrick val = (PanelBrick)(object)((brick is PanelBrick) ? brick : null);
			if (val == null || ((IBaseBrick)brick).Rect.Y != 0f)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (VisualBrick item in (Collection<Brick>)(object)((Brick)val).Bricks)
			{
				VisualBrick val2 = item;
				val2.Sides = (BorderSide)(val2.Sides | 2);
			}
		}
	}

		{
			if (values.Length == 2 && values[0] is string && values[1] is HeadersData)
			{
				HeadersData element = (HeadersData)values[1];
				string printFixedFooterTextLeft = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintFixedFooterTextLeft((DependencyObject)(object)element);
				string printFixedFooterTextRight = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintFixedFooterTextRight((DependencyObject)(object)element);
				string text = values[0].ToString();
				if (text == "PART_EditLeft")
				{
					return (printFixedFooterTextRight == string.Empty) ? new Thickness(BorderThickness.Left, 0.0, BorderThickness.Right, BorderThickness.Bottom) : new Thickness(BorderThickness.Left, 0.0, 0.0, BorderThickness.Bottom);
				}
				if (text == "PART_EditRight")
				{
					return (printFixedFooterTextLeft == string.Empty) ? new Thickness(BorderThickness.Left, 0.0, BorderThickness.Right, BorderThickness.Bottom) : new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, BorderThickness.Right, BorderThickness.Bottom);

		}

	public abstract class PrintHeaderBorderConverterBase : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is PrintCellInfo printCellInfo))
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			int num = ((!(parameter is int)) ? 1 : ((int)parameter));
			double top = ((printCellInfo.IsColumnHeaderVisible && (!printCellInfo.HasTopElement || printCellInfo.HasNotParentBand)) ? ((double)num) : 0.0);
			return new Thickness(CalcLeftBorder(printCellInfo, num), top, CalcRightBorder(printCellInfo, num), num);
		}

		{

		}

	}
	public class PrintHeaderBorderConverter : PrintHeaderBorderConverterBase
	{
		protected override double CalcLeftBorder(PrintCellInfo cellInfo, int thicknessValue)
		{
			return (cellInfo.HeaderImage == null || cellInfo.ImageAlignment != StringAlignment.Near) ? thicknessValue : 0;
		}

		protected override double CalcRightBorder(PrintCellInfo cellInfo, int thicknessValue)
		{
			return (cellInfo.IsRight && (cellInfo.HeaderImage == null || cellInfo.ImageAlignment != StringAlignment.Far)) ? thicknessValue : 0;
		}
	}
	public class PrintHeaderImageBorderConverter : PrintHeaderBorderConverterBase
	{
		protected override double CalcLeftBorder(PrintCellInfo cellInfo, int thicknessValue)
		{
			return (cellInfo.ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Near || cellInfo.ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Center) ? thicknessValue : 0;
		}

		protected override double CalcRightBorder(PrintCellInfo cellInfo, int thicknessValue)
		{
			return ((cellInfo.ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Far || cellInfo.ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Center) && cellInfo.IsRight) ? thicknessValue : 0;
		}
	}

	public class PrintBandsPanel : BandsPanelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PanelProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Panel", typeof(PrintBandsPanel), typeof(PrintBandsPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		internal event EventHandler<SizeChangedInfoEventArgs> RenderSizeChanged;

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			if (this.RenderSizeChanged != null)
			{
				this.RenderSizeChanged(this, new SizeChangedInfoEventArgs(sizeInfo));
			}
		}

		public static PrintBandsPanel GetPanel(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (PrintBandsPanel)obj.GetValue(PanelProperty);
		}

		public static void SetPanel(DependencyObject obj, PrintBandsPanel value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(PanelProperty, value);
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateBandElement(BandBase band)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SetPanel((DependencyObject)(object)band, this);
			PrintCellInfo printCellInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)band);
			TextEdit val = new TextEdit();
			((FrameworkElement)val).Style = printCellInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle;
			TextEdit val2 = val;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).SetBinding(BaseEdit.EditValueProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath("(0).HeaderCaption", GridPrintingHelper.PrintCellInfoProperty),
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).Style = printCellInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).DataContext = band;
			return (FrameworkElement)(object)val2;
		}

		protected override double GetBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			return GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)band).PrintColumnWidth;
		}

		internal BandBase FindParent(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band == null || base.BandsDictionary == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<BandBase, FrameworkElement> item in base.BandsDictionary)
			{
				BandBase key = item.Key;
				if (key == null || key.VisibleBands == null || key.VisibleBands.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in key.VisibleBands)
				{
					if (visibleBand == band)
					{
						return key;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool GetActualShowInBandsPanel(BandBase band)
		{
			PrintBandInfo printBandInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintBandInfo((DependencyObject)(object)band);
			if (printBandInfo != null && printBandInfo.OriginationBand != null)
			{
				return printBandInfo.OriginationBand.ActualShowInBandsPanel;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetActualMergeHeight(BandBase band)
		{
			if (!GetActualShowInBandsPanel(band))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return GetMergeHeight(FindParent(band));
		}

		protected override double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			BandBase bandBase = band;
			while (bandBase != null && !GetActualShowInBandsPanel(bandBase))
			{
				FrameworkElement value = null;
				base.BandsDictionary.TryGetValue(bandBase, out value);
				num += value?.ActualHeight ?? 0.0;
				bandBase = FindParent(bandBase);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class PrintBandsColumnsPanel : BandsNoneDropPanel
	{
		private class BandPrintMergeHeightProvider : IMergeHeightProvider
		{
			internal bool IsFooterPanel { get; set; }

			public double GetMergeHeight(BandBase band)
			{
				if (band == null || PrintBandsPanel.GetActualShowInBandsPanel(band))
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				BandBase bandBase = band;
				while (bandBase != null && !PrintBandsPanel.GetActualShowInBandsPanel(bandBase))
				{
					FrameworkElement value = null;
					PrintBandsPanel panel = PrintBandsPanel.GetPanel((DependencyObject)(object)band);
					if (panel == null || IsFooterPanel)
					{
						break;
					}
					panel.BandsDictionary.TryGetValue(bandBase, out value);
					num += value?.ActualHeight ?? 0.0;
					SetHasNotParentBand(bandBase);
					bandBase = panel.FindParent(bandBase);
				}
				return num;
			}

			private static void SetHasNotParentBand(BandBase band)
			{
				PrintBandsPanel panel = PrintBandsPanel.GetPanel((DependencyObject)(object)band);
				if (panel == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (band.VisibleBands != null && band.VisibleBands.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
					{
						PrintCellInfo printCellInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)visibleBand);
						if (printCellInfo != null)
						{
							printCellInfo.HasNotParentBand = true;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				PrintBandInfo printBandInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintBandInfo((DependencyObject)(object)band);
				if (printBandInfo == null || printBandInfo.OriginationBand == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				BandBase originationBand = printBandInfo.OriginationBand;
				object dataContext = panel.DataContext;
				RowContent val = (RowContent)((dataContext is RowContent) ? dataContext : null);
				if (val == null || !(val.Content is HeadersData headersData) || originationBand.ActualRows == null || originationBand.ActualRows.Count <= 0 || originationBand.ActualRows[0].Columns == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase column in originationBand.ActualRows[0].Columns)
				{
					PrintCellInfo printCellInfo2 = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)headersData.GetCellDataByColumn(column, updateNewCellData: false, addToCache: true));
					if (printCellInfo2 != null)
					{
						printCellInfo2.HasNotParentBand = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal new ColumnsRowDataBase RowData => ((RowContent)base.DataContext).Content as ColumnsRowDataBase;

		protected PrintingDataTreeBuilder TreeBuilder => RowData.treeBuilder as PrintingDataTreeBuilder;

		protected override DataViewBase View => RowData.View;

		protected override bool ExtendRowMarginControlHeight => false;

		public bool IsFooterPanel { get; set; }

		protected internal override double GetColumnWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			GridColumnData cellDataByColumn = RowData.GetCellDataByColumn(column);
			return GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)cellDataByColumn).PrintColumnWidth + GetTreeColumnOffset(column);
		}

		protected internal override double GetBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			return GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)band).PrintColumnWidth;
		}

		protected override IMergeHeightProvider CreateMergeHeightProvider()
		{
			return new BandPrintMergeHeightProvider
			{
				IsFooterPanel = IsFooterPanel
			};
		}

		protected internal override double GetTreeColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (TreeBuilder != null && View.IsTreeColumn(column))
			{
				return (double)TreeBuilder.GetActualRowLevel(RowData) * View.PrintRowIndentWidth;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override double GetHorizontalCorrection(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}

			return GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)band).PrintColumnWidth;
		}

		protected internal override double GetHorizontalCorrection(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	public class ProgressControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private DispatcherTimer stopTimer;

		private ManualResetEvent stopEvent;

		private bool shutdownDispatcher;

		private DXWindow progressWindow;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnCancel;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public DXWindow ProgressWindow => progressWindow;

		private void Stop()
		{
			if (stopEvent == null)
			{
				stopTimer.Stop();
			}
			((Window)(object)ProgressWindow).Close();
		}

		private void stopTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (stopTimer.IsEnabled && stopEvent != null && stopEvent.WaitOne(1))
			{
				stopTimer.Stop();
				Stop();
				if (shutdownDispatcher)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.InvokeShutdown();
				}
			}
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Stop();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		public ProgressControl(DXWindow progressWindow, ManualResetEvent stopEvent, bool shutdownDispatcher, string cancelCaption)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			this.progressWindow = progressWindow;
			((Window)(object)this.progressWindow).Closed += delegate
			{
				stopTimer.Stop();
			};
			this.stopEvent = stopEvent;
			this.shutdownDispatcher = shutdownDispatcher;
			btnCancel.Content = cancelCaption;
			stopTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background);
			stopTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100.0);
			stopTimer.Tick += stopTimer_Tick;
			stopTimer.Start();
		}

		public static DXWindow CreateProgressWindow(ManualResetEvent stopEvent, bool shutdownDispatcher, string title, string cancelCaption)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DXWindow val = new DXWindow();
			((ContentControl)(object)val).Content = new ProgressControl(val, stopEvent, shutdownDispatcher, cancelCaption);
			((Window)(object)val).Title = title;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Width = 500.0;
			((Window)(object)val).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Height;
			val.ShowIcon = false;
			((Window)(object)val).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen;
			((Window)(object)val).WindowStyle = WindowStyle.ToolWindow;
			return val;
		}

		internal static void MakeAsyncOperation(DataViewBase view, Action<Func<bool>> asyncAction)
		{
			string progressWindowTitle = view.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ProgressWindowTitle);
			string cancelButtonCaption = view.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ProgressWindowCancel);
			string cancelledTitle = view.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ProgressWindowTitleCancelling);
			ManualResetEvent stopEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
			try
			{
				bool sheduleCloseProgressWindow = false;
				bool isCancel = false;
				Thread progressThread = new Thread((ThreadStart)delegate
				{
					DXWindow progressWindow = CreateProgressWindow(stopEvent, shutdownDispatcher: true, progressWindowTitle, cancelButtonCaption);
					((Window)(object)progressWindow).Closing += delegate(object d, CancelEventArgs e)
					{
						isCancel = true;
						((Window)(object)progressWindow).Title = cancelledTitle;
						e.Cancel = !sheduleCloseProgressWindow;
					};
					((Window)(object)progressWindow).Show();
					Dispatcher.Run();
				});
				progressThread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
				progressThread.Start();
				asyncAction(() => progressThread.Join(100) || isCancel);
				sheduleCloseProgressWindow = true;
				stopEvent.Set();
				progressThread.Join();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (stopEvent != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)stopEvent).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.v23.2;component/grid/frameworkelements/progresscontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			if (connectionId == 1)
			{
				btnCancel = (System.Windows.Controls.Button)target;
				btnCancel.Click += btnCancel_Click;
			}
			else
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
			}
		}

	public static class TreeBuilderPrintingHelper
	{
		public static IList<SummaryItemBase> CloneGroupSummaries(GridSummaryItemCollection groupSummary)
		{
			return CopyList((IList<SummaryItemBase>)new SimpleBridgeList<SummaryItemBase, GridSummaryItem>((IList<GridSummaryItem>)groupSummary, (Func<GridSummaryItem, SummaryItemBase>)((GridSummaryItem item) => new GridSummaryItem
			{
				DisplayFormat = item.DisplayFormat,
				FieldName = item.FieldName,
				ShowInColumn = item.ShowInColumn,
				SummaryType = item.SummaryType,
				Visible = item.Visible,
				ShowInGroupColumnFooter = item.ShowInGroupColumnFooter,
				CalculationMode = item.CalculationMode
			}), (Func<SummaryItemBase, GridSummaryItem>)null));
		}

		private static IList<T> CopyList<T>(IList<T> source)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>(source.Count);
			foreach (T item in source)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static void UpdatePrintGroupRowInfo(PrintRowInfoBase rowInfo, GroupRowData groupRowData, GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, string groupRowText, int detailLevel)
		{
			PrintGroupRowInfo printGroupRowInfo = new PrintGroupRowInfo();
			printGroupRowInfo.IsExpanded = groupRowData.IsRowExpanded;
			printGroupRowInfo.CaptionCell = CreateGroupCaptionCellInfo(groupRowData, rowInfo, printGroupRowInfo, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, detailLevel);
			printGroupRowInfo.GroupCells = CreateGroupCellInfos(groupRowData, rowInfo, printGroupRowInfo, groupSummaryDisplayMode, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, detailLevel);
			printGroupRowInfo.FirstColumnCell = CreateFirstColumnGroupCellInfo(groupRowData, rowInfo, printGroupRowInfo, groupSummaryDisplayMode, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, groupRowText, detailLevel);
			printGroupRowInfo.IsLast = ((GroupNode)groupRowData.node).PrintInfo.IsLast;
			ApplyNearEmptyInfos(printGroupRowInfo);
			UpdateBorders(printGroupRowInfo);
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintGroupRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)groupRowData, printGroupRowInfo);
		}

		private static void UpdateBorders(PrintGroupRowInfo groupRowInfo)
		{
			groupRowInfo.CaptionCell.HasLeftBorder = true;
			groupRowInfo.CaptionCell.HasRightBorder = !HasSummaryValue(groupRowInfo.FirstColumnCell) && groupRowInfo.GroupCells.Count == 0;
			groupRowInfo.FirstColumnCell.HasLeftBorder = false;
			groupRowInfo.FirstColumnCell.HasRightBorder = groupRowInfo.GroupCells.Count == 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < groupRowInfo.GroupCells.Count; i++)
			{
				PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo = groupRowInfo.GroupCells[i];
				if (i == 0)
				{
					printGroupRowCellInfo.HasLeftBorder = HasSummaryValue(printGroupRowCellInfo) || HasSummaryValue(groupRowInfo.FirstColumnCell);
				}
				else
				{
					PrintGroupRowCellInfo cellInfo = groupRowInfo.GroupCells[i - 1];
					printGroupRowCellInfo.HasLeftBorder = HasSummaryValue(printGroupRowCellInfo) || HasSummaryValue(cellInfo);
				}
				if (i == groupRowInfo.GroupCells.Count - 1)
				{
					printGroupRowCellInfo.HasRightBorder = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static PrintGroupRowCellInfo CreateFirstColumnGroupCellInfo(GroupRowData rowData, PrintRowInfoBase rowInfo, PrintGroupRowInfo groupRowInfo, GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, string groupRowText, int detailLevel)
		{
			PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo = CreatePrintGroupRowCellInfo(rowData, rowInfo, groupRowInfo, detailLevel);
			printGroupRowCellInfo.VisibleIndex = 1;
			printGroupRowCellInfo.Text = ((printGroupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default) ? groupRowText : GetAlignedGroupSummaryText(rowData, rowData.CellData[0].Column, groupSummaryDisplayMode, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode));
			printGroupRowCellInfo.Position = ((groupRowInfo.GroupCells.Count != 0) ? PrintGroupCellPosition.None : PrintGroupCellPosition.Separator);
			return printGroupRowCellInfo;
		}

		private static string GetAlignedGroupSummaryText(GroupRowData rowData, ColumnBase column, GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < rowData.GroupSummaryData.Count; i++)
			{
				GridGroupSummaryData gridGroupSummaryData = rowData.GroupSummaryData[i];
				bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(gridGroupSummaryData.SummaryItem.ShowInColumn);
				if (((gridGroupSummaryData.Column == column && !flag) || (flag && gridGroupSummaryData.SummaryItem.ShowInColumn == column.FieldName)) && SummaryIsAllRowCalculation(rowData, rowData.GroupSummaryData[i]))
				{
					list.Add(GetGroupSummaryText(rowData, gridGroupSummaryData, groupSummaryDisplayMode, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode));
				}
			}
			return string.Join(", ", list);
		}

		public static string GetGroupRowText(GroupRowData rowData, GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, string stringFormat, bool useFirstIndent)
		{
			GridColumnData groupValue = rowData.GroupValue;
			string text = "";
			if (rowData.GroupSummaryData.Count > 0 && useFirstIndent)
			{
				text += " ";
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < rowData.GroupSummaryData.Count; i++)
			{
				if (SummaryIsAllRowCalculation(rowData, rowData.GroupSummaryData[i]))
				{
					text += string.Format(stringFormat, GetGroupSummaryText(rowData, rowData.GroupSummaryData[i], groupSummaryDisplayMode, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode));
					if (!rowData.GroupSummaryData[i].IsLast)
					{
						text += ", ";
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static bool SummaryIsAllRowCalculation(GroupRowData item, GridGroupSummaryData summaryData)
		{
			if (item.View is TableView tableView && summaryData.SummaryItem != null && tableView.GetActualCalculationMode(summaryData.SummaryItem) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static string GetGroupSummaryText(GroupRowData item, GridGroupSummaryData summaryData, GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode)
		{
			if (printGroupSummaryDisplayMode == groupSummaryDisplayMode)
			{
				return summaryData.Text;
			}
			object value = null;
			item.treeBuilder.TryGetGroupSummaryValue(item, summaryData.SummaryItem, out value);
			if (!(item.View is TableView tableView))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return item.GetGroupSummaryText(summaryData.SummaryItem, summaryData.Column, tableView, value, isPrinting: true);
		}

		private static void ApplyNearEmptyInfos(PrintGroupRowInfo rowInfo)
		{
			List<PrintGroupRowCellInfo> list = new List<PrintGroupRowCellInfo>(rowInfo.GroupCells);
			list.Add(rowInfo.CaptionCell);
			list.Add(rowInfo.FirstColumnCell);
			foreach (PrintGroupRowCellInfo item in list)
			{
				int leftVisibleIndex = item.VisibleIndex - 1;
				PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo = list.FirstOrDefault((PrintGroupRowCellInfo i) => i.VisibleIndex == leftVisibleIndex);
				if (printGroupRowCellInfo == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(printGroupRowCellInfo.Text))
				{
					item.IsLeftGroupSummaryValueEmpty = true;
				}
				int rightVisibleIndex = item.VisibleIndex + 1;
				PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo2 = list.FirstOrDefault((PrintGroupRowCellInfo i) => i.VisibleIndex == rightVisibleIndex);
				if (printGroupRowCellInfo2 == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(printGroupRowCellInfo2.Text))
				{
					item.IsRightGroupSummaryValueEmpty = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static PrintGroupRowCellInfo CreateGroupCaptionCellInfo(GroupRowData rowData, PrintRowInfoBase rowInfo, PrintGroupRowInfo groupRowInfo, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, int detailLevel)
		{
			PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo = CreatePrintGroupRowCellInfo(rowData, rowInfo, groupRowInfo, detailLevel);
			printGroupRowCellInfo.Text = GetGroupRowTextStart(rowData, rowData.GroupValue);
			printGroupRowCellInfo.Width = GetFirstColumnWidth(rowData, rowInfo, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode);
			printGroupRowCellInfo.VisibleIndex = 0;
			printGroupRowCellInfo.Position = PrintGroupCellPosition.Default;
			return printGroupRowCellInfo;
		}

		private static bool HasSummaryValue(PrintGroupRowCellInfo cellInfo)
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cellInfo.Text);
		}

		private static PrintGroupRowCellInfo CreatePrintGroupRowCellInfo(GroupRowData rowData, PrintRowInfoBase rowInfo, PrintGroupRowInfo groupRowInfo, int detailLevel)
		{
			PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo = new PrintGroupRowCellInfo();
			printGroupRowCellInfo.DetailLevel = detailLevel;
			printGroupRowCellInfo.GroupLevel = rowData.GroupLevel;
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintGroupRowInfo(printGroupRowCellInfo, groupRowInfo);
			printGroupRowCellInfo.PrintGroupRowStyle = rowInfo.PrintGroupRowStyle;
			return printGroupRowCellInfo;
		}

		private static double GetFirstColumnWidth(RowData rowData, PrintRowInfoBase rowInfo, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode)
		{
			if (printGroupSummaryDisplayMode != GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default)
			{
				return GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData.CellData[0]).PrintColumnWidth;
			}
			return rowInfo.TotalHeaderWidth;
		}

		private static string GetGroupRowTextStart(GroupRowData rowData, GridColumnData columnData)
		{
			return ((GroupRowNodePrintInfo)rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo).GroupDisplayText;
		}

		private static List<PrintGroupRowCellInfo> CreateGroupCellInfos(GroupRowData rowData, PrintRowInfoBase rowInfo, PrintGroupRowInfo groupRowInfo, GroupSummaryDisplayMode groupSummaryDisplayMode, GroupSummaryDisplayMode printGroupSummaryDisplayMode, int detailLevel)
		{
			if (printGroupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default)
			{
				return new List<PrintGroupRowCellInfo>();
			}
			List<PrintGroupRowCellInfo> list = new List<PrintGroupRowCellInfo>();
			for (int i = 1; i < rowData.CellData.Count; i++)
			{
				PrintGroupRowCellInfo printGroupRowCellInfo = CreatePrintGroupRowCellInfo(rowData, rowInfo, groupRowInfo, detailLevel);
				printGroupRowCellInfo.VisibleIndex = i + 1;
				printGroupRowCellInfo.Width = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData.CellData[i]).PrintColumnWidth;
				printGroupRowCellInfo.Position = ((i == rowData.CellData.Count - 1) ? PrintGroupCellPosition.Last : PrintGroupCellPosition.Default);
				printGroupRowCellInfo.Text = GetAlignedGroupSummaryText(rowData, rowData.CellData[i].Column, groupSummaryDisplayMode, printGroupSummaryDisplayMode);
				list.Add(printGroupRowCellInfo);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class RowOffsetBase : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OffsetProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowLevelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NextRowLevelProperty;

		{

		private double OldHeight { get; set; }

		protected RowData RowData => base.DataContext as RowData;

		protected DataViewBase View
		{
			get
			{
				if (RowData == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return RowData.View;
			}

		static RowOffsetBase()
		{

		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			OffsetPath = GetTemplateChild("PART_OffsetPath") as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
			base.Loaded += RowOffsetBase_Loaded;
			base.SizeChanged += RowOffsetBase_SizeChanged;
		}

		private void RowOffsetBase_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (OldHeight != double.MinValue && OldHeight != base.ActualHeight)
			{
				DrawLines(base.ActualHeight);
			}
		}

		private void RowOffsetBase_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateContent(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected virtual void OnNextRowLevelChanged()
		{
			DrawLines(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected void DrawLines(double height)
		{
			if (OffsetPath != null)
			{
				OldHeight = height;
				Group = new GeometryGroup();
				DrawLinesCore(height);
				OffsetPath.Data = Group;
				UpdateOffsetPathHeight(height);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateOffsetPathHeight(double height)
		{
			OffsetPath.Height = height;
		}

		protected virtual void DrawLinesCore(double height)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeWidth()
		{
			base.Width = Offset * (double)RowLevel;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateContent(double height)
		{
			ChangeWidth();
			DrawLines(height);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected System.Windows.Size BaseMeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			result.Height = Math.Min(GetMinHeight(), result.Height);
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual double GetMinHeight()
		{
			return 1.0;
		}
	}
	public class RowOffset : RowOffsetBase
	{

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AllowHorizontalLinesProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowRowBreakProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsLastFixedRowProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FixedRowPositionProperty;

		protected bool ShowGroupSummaryFooter
		{

		public bool AllowVerticalLines

		static RowOffset()
		{
			AllowVerticalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowVerticalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(RowOffset));
			AllowHorizontalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowHorizontalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(RowOffset), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RowOffset)d).UpdateContent(((RowOffset)d).ActualHeight);

		private void OnShowRowBreakChanged()
		{
			DrawLines(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected override void DrawLinesCore(double height)
		{
			if (AllowHorizontalLines && !ShowRowBreak && FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.None)
			{
				DrawHorizontalLines(height);
			}
			if (AllowVerticalLines)
			{
				DrawVerticalLines(height);
			}
		}

		private bool BottomHorizontalLineIsFull(int horizontalLinesCount)
		{
			if (horizontalLinesCount < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(base.View is TableView tableView))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !tableView.UseGroupShadowIndent;
		}

		protected virtual void DrawHorizontalLines(double height)
		{
			int num = base.RowLevel - base.NextRowLevel;
			if (ShowGroupSummaryFooter && num > 0)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			else if (BottomHorizontalLineIsFull(num))
			{
				num = base.RowLevel;
			}
			int num2 = base.RowLevel;
			double y = height - 0.5;
			while (num > 0)
			{
				base.Group.Children.Add(GetLine(new System.Windows.Point((double)num2 * base.Offset, y), new System.Windows.Point((double)(num2 - 1) * base.Offset, y)));
				num--;
				num2--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawVerticalLines(double height)
		{
			for (int i = 1; i <= base.RowLevel; i++)
			{
				base.Group.Children.Add(GetLine(new System.Windows.Point((double)i * base.Offset - 0.5, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point((double)i * base.Offset - 0.5, height)));
			}
		}

		private LineGeometry GetLine(System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point endPoint)
		{
			LineGeometry lineGeometry = new LineGeometry();
			lineGeometry.StartPoint = startPoint;
			lineGeometry.EndPoint = endPoint;
			return lineGeometry;
		}
	}

	public class RowFilterEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private int listSourceRowIndex;

		private bool handled;

		private bool visible;

		public bool Handled
		{
			get
			{
				return handled;
			}
			set
			{
				handled = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
			}
		}

		public int ListSourceRowIndex => listSourceRowIndex;

		public GridControl Source { get; private set; }

		internal RowFilterEventArgs()
		{
		}

		public RowFilterEventArgs(GridControl source, int listSourceRowIndex, bool fit)
		{
			SetArgs(source, listSourceRowIndex, fit);
		}

		internal void SetArgs(GridControl source, int listSourceRowIndex, bool fit)
		{
			Source = source;
			this.listSourceRowIndex = listSourceRowIndex;
			handled = false;
			visible = fit;
		}

		internal void ClearArgs(bool fit)
		{
			SetArgs(null, -1, fit);
		}
	}

		{
			DataViewBase currentView = DataControlBase.GetCurrentView(d);
			if (currentView != null)

				Execute(currentView, (FrameworkElement)d);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void Execute(DataViewBase view, FrameworkElement element);
	}

	public class VerticalScrollBarBlendCustomizationExtension : DependencyObject, INotifyCurrentViewChanged
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ElementVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ElementVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(VerticalScrollBarBlendCustomizationExtension), new PropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as VerticalScrollBarBlendCustomizationExtension).UpdateVerticalScrollbarWidth();
		}));

		public Visibility ElementVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				return (Visibility)GetValue(ElementVisibilityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ElementVisibilityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement Element { get; set; }

		void INotifyCurrentViewChanged.OnCurrentViewChanged(DependencyObject d)
		{
			Element = d as FrameworkElement;
			Element.SizeChanged += delegate
			{
				UpdateVerticalScrollbarWidth();
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ElementVisibilityProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Visibility")
			{
				Source = d
			});
			UpdateVerticalScrollbarWidth();
		}

		private void UpdateVerticalScrollbarWidth()
		{
			DataControlBase.GetCurrentView(Element)?.ViewBehavior.SetVerticalScrollBarWidth(ColumnsLayoutParametersValidator.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Element.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) ? Element.ActualWidth : 0.0));
		}
	}

	public class SelectionStateToVisibilityConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public SelectionState Value { get; set; }

		public bool Invert { get; set; }

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			SelectionState selectionState = (SelectionState)value;
			bool flag = selectionState == Value;
			if (Invert)
			{
				flag = !flag;
			}
			return (!flag) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public class GroupLevelToMarginConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Thickness thickness = (Thickness)parameter;
			int num = (int)value;
			return new Thickness(thickness.Left * (double)num, thickness.Top, thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class GroupLevelToMarginMultiConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (parameter == null || !(parameter is Thickness thickness))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (values == null || values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is int) || !(values[1] is double))
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			int num = (int)values[0];
			double num2 = (double)values[1];
			return new Thickness(num2 * (double)num, thickness.Top, thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();

			binding.RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.Self);
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("Data." + FieldName);

		}

			GroupIndexProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupIndex", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(-1, OnGroupIndexChanged));
			GroupValueTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupValueTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridColumn)(object)d).UpdateActualGroupValueTemplateSelector();
			}));
			GroupValueTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupValueTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridColumn)(object)d).UpdateActualGroupValueTemplateSelector();
			}));
			ActualGroupValueTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualGroupValueTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridColumn)(object)d).OnActualGroupValueTemplateSelectorChanged();
			}));
			ActualGroupValueTemplateSelectorProperty = ActualGroupValueTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AllowGroupingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowGrouping", typeof(DefaultBoolean), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)(DefaultBoolean)2, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridColumn)(object)d).UpdateActualAllowGrouping();
			}));
			ActualAllowGroupingPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualAllowGrouping", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			ActualAllowGroupingProperty = ActualAllowGroupingPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowGroupedColumnProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowGroupedColumn", typeof(DefaultBoolean), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata((object)(DefaultBoolean)2, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridColumn)(object)d).UpdateActualShowGroupedColumn();
			}));
			MergeWithPreviousGroupProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MergeWithPreviousGroup", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnGroupIndexChanged));
			GroupLevelPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("GroupLevel", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(-1, OnGroupIndexChanged));
			GroupLevelProperty = GroupLevelPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		private static void OnGroupIndexChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is GridColumn gridColumn)
			{
				gridColumn.OnGroupIndexChanged();
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateViewInfo(bool updateDataPropertiesOnly = false)
		{
			base.UpdateViewInfo(updateDataPropertiesOnly);
			if (Grid != null && !updateDataPropertiesOnly)
			{
				UpdateAutoFilterValueCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void SetSortInfo(ColumnSortOrder sortOrder, bool isGrouped)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.SetSortInfo(sortOrder, isGrouped);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(IsGroupedPropertyKey, (object)isGrouped);
		}

		private void OnGroupIndexChanged()
		{
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				Grid.ApplyColumnGroupIndex(this);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateActualGroupValueTemplateSelector()
		{
			UpdateActualTemplateSelector(ActualGroupValueTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, GroupValueTemplateSelector, GroupValueTemplate, (DataTemplateSelector s, DataTemplate t) => (DataTemplateSelector)(object)ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper.Combine(base.Owner.ActualGroupValueTemplateSelector, s, t));
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged()
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged();
			UpdateActualGroupValueTemplateSelector();
		}

		protected void OnGroupIntervalChanged()
		{
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				Grid.NeedSynchronize = true;
			}
			OnDataPropertyChanged();
		}

		private bool CalcActualAllowGrouping()
		{
			if (!base.ActualAllowSorting)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return GetActualAllowGroupingCore();
		}

		internal override bool GetActualAllowGroupingCore()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (DefaultBooleanExtension.GetValue(AllowGrouping, base.Owner.AllowGrouping))
			{
				return base.GetActualAllowGroupingCore();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateActualAllowGrouping()
		{
			ActualAllowGrouping = CalcActualAllowGrouping();
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualAllowSorting()
		{
			base.UpdateActualAllowSorting();
			UpdateActualAllowGrouping();
		}

		private void UpdateActualShowGroupedColumn()
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.RebuildColumns();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnValidation(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			((GridColumn)GetEventTargetColumn()).OnValidationCore(e);
		}

		private void OnValidationCore(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Validate != null)
			{
				this.Validate(this, (GridCellValidationEventArgs)e);
			}
		}

		internal override bool SupportValidate()
		{
			return this.Validate != null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateGroupingCore(string oldFieldName)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsGrouped && Grid != null)
			{
				int groupIndex = GroupIndex;
				ColumnSortOrder sortOrder = base.SortOrder;
				Grid.BeginDataUpdate();
				base.Owner.UngroupColumn(oldFieldName);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FieldName))
				{
					base.Owner.GroupColumn(FieldName, groupIndex, sortOrder);
				}
				Grid.EndDataUpdate();
			}
		}

		BaseColumn IDetailElement<BaseColumn>.CreateNewInstance(params object[] args)
		{
			Type type = ((object)this).GetType();
			GridColumn gridColumn = Activator.CreateInstance(type) as GridColumn;
			gridColumn.IsCloned = true;
			gridColumn.isAutoDetectedUnboundDataType = isAutoDetectedUnboundDataType;
			return gridColumn;
		}

		internal override bool IsServiceColumn()
		{
			return TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(FieldName);
		}

		private void OnActualGroupValueTemplateSelectorChanged()
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.UpdateRowData(delegate(RowData rowData)
				{
					rowData.UpdateClientGroupValueTemplateSelector();
				});
			}
		}

		internal override void SetGroupMerge(bool mergeWithPreviousGroup, int groupLevel)
		{
			MergeWithPreviousGroup = mergeWithPreviousGroup;
			GroupLevel = groupLevel;
		}
	}

	{
		private class VisualClientUpdater
		{
			private enum UpdateMode
			{
				None,
				Scrollbar,
				SingleRows,
				Rows
			}

			private readonly GridControl grid;

			private UpdateMode updateMode;

			public bool IsRowsUpdateEnqueued => updateMode == UpdateMode.Rows;

			public bool CanScheduleUpdate
			{
				get
				{
					if (grid.DataView != null && grid.DataView.RootDataPresenter != null)
					{
						return !IsNewItemRowCommiting();
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public VisualClientUpdater(GridControl grid)
			{
				this.grid = grid;
			}

			public void ScheduleUpdateScrollbar()
			{
				if (grid.BottomRowBelowOldVisibleRowCount)
				{
					grid.ScheduleUpdateRows();
					return;
				}
				SetUpdateMode(UpdateMode.Scrollbar);
				EnqueueUpdateAction();
			}

			public void ScheduleUpdateSingleRows()
			{
				SetUpdateMode(UpdateMode.SingleRows);
				EnqueueUpdateAction();
			}

			public void ScheduleUpdateRows()
			{
				SetUpdateMode(UpdateMode.Rows);
				EnqueueUpdateAction();
			}

			private void SetUpdateMode(UpdateMode newUpdateMode)
			{
				updateMode = (UpdateMode)Math.Max((int)updateMode, (int)newUpdateMode);
				grid.InvalidateDetailScrollInfoCache(updateMode == UpdateMode.Scrollbar);
			}

			public void ClearUpdateMode()
			{
				updateMode = UpdateMode.None;
			}

			private void EnqueueUpdateAction()
			{
				if (grid.DataView == null || !grid.DataView.UpdateActionEnqueued)
				{
					if (!CanScheduleUpdate)
					{
						Update();
						return;
					}
					grid.DataView.UpdateActionEnqueued = true;
					grid.viewCore.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)Update);
				}
			}

			private bool IsNewItemRowCommiting()
			{
				if (grid.DataView.CommitEditingLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					return grid.DataView.IsNewItemRowFocused;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Update()
			{
				grid.DataView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
				{
					x.UpdateActionEnqueued = false;
				});
				switch (updateMode)
				{
				case UpdateMode.SingleRows:
					grid.UpdateSingleRows();
					break;
				case UpdateMode.Rows:
					grid.UpdateRowsCore(updateColumnsViewInfo: false);
					break;
				}
				grid.OnRowsUpdateComplete();
				ClearUpdateMode();
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessServiceSummary(GridControl grid, CustomSummaryEventArgs e, ServiceSummaryItem serviceSummaryItem)
		{
			if (grid == null || grid.DataProviderBase == null || !grid.DataProviderBase.IsServerMode)
			{
				switch (serviceSummaryItem.CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Value)
				{
				case CustomServiceSummaryItemType.SortedList:
					CustomSortedListSummary(grid, serviceSummaryItem, e);
					break;
				case CustomServiceSummaryItemType.DateTimeAverage:
					CustomDateTimeAverageSummary(grid, serviceSummaryItem, e);
					break;
				case CustomServiceSummaryItemType.DateTimeRange:
					CustomDateTimeRangeSummary(grid, serviceSummaryItem, e);
					break;
				case CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Unique:
				case CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Duplicate:
					CustomUniqueDuplicateSummary(grid, serviceSummaryItem, e);
					break;
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CustomSortedListSummary(GridControl grid, ServiceSummaryItem serviceSummaryItem, CustomSummaryEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((int)e.SummaryProcess != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataColumnInfo val = ((DataControllerBase)grid.DataController).Columns[serviceSummaryItem.FieldName];
			if (val != null && (typeof(IComparable).IsAssignableFrom(val.GetDataType()) || val.UnboundWithExpression))
			{
				object obj = (grid.HasConditionFormatFilters ? grid.GetFormatConditionSummary(serviceSummaryItem.FieldName, (ConditionalFormatSummaryType)3, (TopBottomFilterKind)0) : null);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					e.TotalValue = obj;
				}
				else
				{
					int[] sortedListIndices = GetSortedListIndices(grid, val);
					sortedListIndices = ((GridDataProvider)grid.DataProviderBase).FilterSortedListIndicesForNullValues(sortedListIndices, val);
					e.TotalValue = (object)new SortedIndices(sortedListIndices);
				}
			}
			e.TotalValueReady = true;
		}

		private static int[] GetSortedListIndices(GridControl grid, DataColumnInfo column)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisibleListSourceRowCollection visibleListSourceRowCollection = GetVisibleListSourceRowCollection(grid);
			visibleListSourceRowCollection.SortRows((DataColumnSortInfo[])(object)new DataColumnSortInfo[1]
			{
				new DataColumnSortInfo(column)
			});
			return visibleListSourceRowCollection.ToArray();
		}

		private static VisibleListSourceRowCollection GetVisibleListSourceRowCollection(GridControl grid)
		{
			VisibleListSourceRowCollection visibleListSourceRows = grid.DataController.GroupInfo.VisibleListSourceRows;
			return visibleListSourceRows.CloneThatWouldBeForSureModifiedAndOrForgottenBeforeAnythingHappensToOriginal();
		}

		private static void CustomDateTimeAverageSummary(GridControl grid, ServiceSummaryItem serviceSummaryItem, CustomSummaryEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (grid.HasConditionFormatFilters)
			{
				e.TotalValue = grid.GetFormatConditionSummary(serviceSummaryItem.FieldName, (ConditionalFormatSummaryType)2, (TopBottomFilterKind)0);
				e.TotalValueReady = true;
				return;
			}
			if ((int)e.SummaryProcess == 0)
			{
				e.TotalValue = new AverageDateTimeCalculator();
			}
			if ((int)e.SummaryProcess == 1)
			{
				AverageDateTimeCalculator averageDateTimeCalculator = (AverageDateTimeCalculator)e.TotalValue;
				averageDateTimeCalculator.AddValue((DateTime)e.FieldValue);
			}
			if ((int)e.SummaryProcess == 2)
			{
				AverageDateTimeCalculator averageDateTimeCalculator2 = (AverageDateTimeCalculator)e.TotalValue;
				e.TotalValue = averageDateTimeCalculator2.GetValue();
			}
		}

		private static void CustomDateTimeRangeSummary(GridControl grid, ServiceSummaryItem serviceSummaryItem, CustomSummaryEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			CustomSummaryProcess summaryProcess = e.SummaryProcess;
			if ((int)summaryProcess != 0)
			{
				if ((int)summaryProcess == 1)
				{
					DateTimeRange dateTimeRange = (DateTimeRange)e.TotalValue;
					DateTimeRange dateTimeRange2 = (DateTimeRange)e.FieldValue;
					e.TotalValue = new DateTimeRange((dateTimeRange2.Start < dateTimeRange.Start) ? dateTimeRange2.Start : dateTimeRange.Start, (dateTimeRange2.End > dateTimeRange.End) ? dateTimeRange2.End : dateTimeRange.End);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				e.TotalValue = new DateTimeRange(DateTime.MaxValue, DateTime.MinValue);
			}
		}

		private static void CustomUniqueDuplicateSummary(GridControl grid, ServiceSummaryItem serviceSummaryItem, CustomSummaryEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)e.SummaryProcess == 0)
			{
				e.TotalValue = (grid.HasConditionFormatFilters ? grid.GetFormatConditionSummary(serviceSummaryItem.FieldName, (ConditionalFormatSummaryType)((serviceSummaryItem.CustomServiceSummaryItemType == CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Unique) ? 4 : 5), (TopBottomFilterKind)0) : CalcUniqueDuplicateSummary(grid, serviceSummaryItem.FieldName, (UniqueDuplicateRule)(serviceSummaryItem.CustomServiceSummaryItemType != CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Unique), GetVisibleListSourceRowCollection(grid).With((VisibleListSourceRowCollection rows) => Enumerable.Range(0, rows.VisibleRowCount).Select((Func<int, int>)rows.GetListSourceRow))));
				e.TotalValueReady = true;
			}
		}

		internal static HashSet<object> CalcUniqueDuplicateSummary(GridControl grid, string fieldName, UniqueDuplicateRule rule, IEnumerable<int> indices)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GridDataProvider gridDataProvider = (GridDataProvider)grid.DataProviderBase;
			DataColumnInfo val = ((DataControllerBase)grid.DataController).Columns[fieldName];
			if (val != null)
			{
				UniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator uniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator = new UniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator(rule);
				foreach (int index in indices)
				{
					uniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator.Calculate(gridDataProvider.GetRowValueByListIndex(index, val));
				}
				return uniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator.Finish();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override int[] GetRecursiveSelectedRowHandles()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			PopulateListWithRecursiveSelectedRowHandles(GetSelectedRowHandles(), list);
			return list.Distinct().ToArray();
		}

		private void PopulateListWithRecursiveSelectedRowHandles(IEnumerable<int> currentLevelRowHandles, List<int> result)
		{
			foreach (int rowHandle in currentLevelRowHandles)
			{
				if (IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
				{
					int childRowCount = GetChildRowCount(rowHandle);
					PopulateListWithRecursiveSelectedRowHandles(from x in Enumerable.Range(0, childRowCount)
						select GetChildRowHandle(rowHandle, x), result);
				}
				else
				{
					result.Add(rowHandle);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override ColumnFilterInfoBase CreateDateColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return DateColumnFilterInfoHelper.CreateDateColumnFilterInfo(column);
		}

		private static void CopyCore(GridControl d)
		{
			if (d == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataViewBase focusedView = d.DataView.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView;
			if (focusedView.ClipboardMode == ClipboardMode.Formatted)
			{
				try
				{
					d.callCopyClipboardFromCommand = true;
					d.Copy();
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					d.callCopyClipboardFromCommand = false;
				}
			}
			d.Copy();
		}

			customColumnDisplayTextArgs = ArgsMutator.CreateColumnDisplayTextArgs(base.GetRow, (int h) => (h != int.MinValue) ? GetListIndexByRowHandle(h) : int.MinValue, GetRowHandleByListIndex);
			customRowFilterArgs = ArgsMutator.CreateCustomRowFilterArgs(GetRowByListIndex);
			customSummaryArgsItem = ArgsMutator.CreateSummaryItem();
			customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo = new List<GroupInfo>();
			customSummaryArgs = ArgsMutator.CreateRowSummaryArgs(base.GetRow, GetListIndexByRowHandle, new ReadOnlyCollection<GroupInfo>(customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo));
			customSummaryExistArgs = ArgsMutator.CreateRowSummaryExistsArgs(new ReadOnlyCollection<GroupInfo>(customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo));

			((ObservableCollection<GridSummaryItem>)(object)GroupSummary).CollectionChanged += base.OnGroupSummaryCollectionChanged;
			visualClientUpdater = new VisualClientUpdater(this);
			EnableRowUpdateOptimization = true;
		}

		private void OnIsGroupedChanged()
		{
			UpdateIsAnyDetailGrouped();
			View.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.UpdateMasterDetailViewProperties();
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateIsAnyDetailGrouped()
		{
			if (!IsOriginationDataControl())
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isGrouped = false;
			UpdateAllOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{
				if (x.DataView is GridViewBase gridViewBase && x.IsGroupedCore && gridViewBase.ShowGroupPanel)
				{
					isGrouped = true;
				}
			});
			DataControlBase rootGridControl = GetRootDataControl();
			rootGridControl.SetIsAnyDetailGrouped(isGrouped);
			bool found = false;
			UpdateAllOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{
				if (x.DataView is GridViewBase gridViewBase)
				{
					if (gridViewBase.IsPagingMode)
					{
						gridViewBase.ActualShowGroupPanel = false;
					}
					else if (!gridViewBase.ShowGroupPanel)
					{
						gridViewBase.ActualShowGroupPanel = false;
					}
					else if (rootGridControl.DataView.ShowGroupPanelsForUngroupedDetailsCore)
					{
						gridViewBase.ActualShowGroupPanel = true;
					}
					else if (isGrouped)
					{
						gridViewBase.ActualShowGroupPanel = x.IsGroupedCore;
					}
					else
					{
						gridViewBase.ActualShowGroupPanel = !found;
						if (gridViewBase.ShowGroupPanel)
						{
							found = true;
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void OnIsAnyDetailGroupedChanged()
		{
			View.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.UpdateGroupPanelDragText();
			});
		}

		private void RaiseCustomUnboundColumnDataCore(GridColumnDataEventArgs e)
		{
			object value = e.Value;
			if (customUnboundColumnData != null)
			{
				customUnboundColumnData(this, e);
			}
			if (CustomUnboundColumnDataCommand != null)
			{
				int listSourceRowIndex = e.ListSourceRowIndex;
				UnboundColumnRowArgs unboundColumnRowArgs = new UnboundColumnRowArgs(e.Source.GetRowByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex), listSourceRowIndex, e.Column.FieldName, e.IsGetData, value);
				CustomUnboundColumnDataCommand.Execute(unboundColumnRowArgs);
				e.Value = unboundColumnRowArgs.Value;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCustomSummaryExists(object sender, CustomSummaryExistEventArgs e)
		{
			GridControl originationGridControl = GetOriginationGridControl();
			bool flag = DataControlBase.HasCustomSummaryCommand(originationGridControl.CustomSummaryExistsCommand, (SummaryItemBase)e.Item);
			if (flag)
			{
				DataControlBase.SetSummaryItem((SummaryItemBase)e.Item, customSummaryArgsItem);
				if (e.IsGroupSummary)
				{
					FillGroupInfo(customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo, this, GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(e.GroupRowHandle));
				}
				ArgsMutator.SetRowSummaryExistsArgs(customSummaryExistArgs, customSummaryArgsItem);
			}
			originationGridControl.RaiseCustomSummaryExistsCore(sender, e);
			if (flag)
			{
				originationGridControl.CustomSummaryExistsCommand.Execute(customSummaryExistArgs);
				e.Exists = customSummaryExistArgs.Exists;
				customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo.Clear();
				ArgsMutator.ClearSummaryItem(customSummaryArgsItem);
				ArgsMutator.ClearRowSummaryExistsArgs(customSummaryExistArgs);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCustomSummaryExistsCore(object sender, CustomSummaryExistEventArgs e)
		{
			if (customSummaryExists != null)
			{
				customSummaryExists.Invoke(sender, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseCustomSummary(object sender, CustomSummaryEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.Item is ServiceSummaryItem serviceSummaryItem && (int)serviceSummaryItem.SummaryType == 5)
			{
				ProcessServiceSummary(this, e, serviceSummaryItem);
				return;
			}
			GridControl originationGridControl = GetOriginationGridControl();
			bool flag = DataControlBase.HasCustomSummaryCommand(originationGridControl.CustomSummaryCommand, (SummaryItemBase)e.Item);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (e.IsGroupSummary)
				{
					FillGroupInfo(customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo, this, GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(e.GroupRowHandle));
				}
				DataControlBase.SetSummaryItem((SummaryItemBase)e.Item, customSummaryArgsItem);
				ArgsMutator.SetRowSummaryArgs(customSummaryArgs, e.RowHandle, customSummaryArgsItem, e.FieldValue, e.TotalValue, DataControlBase.ToSummaryProcess(e.SummaryProcess), DataControlBase.ToSummaryMode(e.Mode));
			}
			originationGridControl.RaiseCustomSummaryCore(sender, e);
			if (flag)
			{
				originationGridControl.CustomSummaryCommand.Execute(customSummaryArgs);
				e.TotalValue = customSummaryArgs.TotalValue;
				e.TotalValueReady = customSummaryArgs.TotalValueReady;
				customSummaryExistArgsGroupInfo.Clear();
				ArgsMutator.ClearSummaryItem(customSummaryArgsItem);
				ArgsMutator.ClearRowSummaryArgs(customSummaryArgs);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCustomSummaryCore(object sender, CustomSummaryEventArgs e)
		{
			if (customSummary != null)
			{
				customSummary.Invoke(sender, e);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool RaiseCopyingToClipboard(CopyingToClipboardEventArgsBase e)

		protected virtual int RaiseCustomRowFilter(int listSourceRowIndex, bool fit)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = fit;
			GridControl originationGridControl = GetOriginationGridControl();
			if (HasCutomRowFilterEventSubscription(originationGridControl))
			{
				if (rowFilterEventArgs == null)
				{
					rowFilterEventArgs = new RowFilterEventArgs();
				}
				rowFilterEventArgs.SetArgs(this, listSourceRowIndex, fit);
				originationGridControl.RaiseCustomRowFilterEvent(rowFilterEventArgs);
				flag = rowFilterEventArgs.Handled;
				flag2 = rowFilterEventArgs.Visible;
				rowFilterEventArgs.ClearArgs(fit);
			}
			if (!flag && HasCustomRowFilterCommand(originationGridControl))
			{
				ArgsMutator.SetRowFilterArgs(customRowFilterArgs, listSourceRowIndex, fit);
				originationGridControl.ExecuteCustomRowFilterCommand(customRowFilterArgs);
				flag = customRowFilterArgs.Visible.HasValue;
				if (flag)
				{
					flag2 = customRowFilterArgs.Visible.Value;
				}
				ArgsMutator.ClearRowFilterArgs(customRowFilterArgs);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected internal void ChangeGroupExpandedCore(int rowHandle, bool recursive)
		{
			PurgeCache(GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandle));
			View.SupressCacheCleanCountLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				base.DataProviderBase.ChangeGroupExpanded(rowHandle, recursive);
				ScrollBarAnnotationsGeneration();
			});

		private void PurgeCache(int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (!base.DataProviderBase.IsServerMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, DataRowNode> node in DataView.Nodes)
			{
				if (GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(node.Key) > visibleIndex)
				{
					list.Add(node.Key);
				}
			}
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				DataView.Nodes.Remove(item);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal override void SyncSortBySummaryInfo()
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (GridColumn item in (Collection<GridColumn>)(object)Columns)
			{
				item.IsSortedBySummary = false;
			}
			foreach (GridGroupSummarySortInfo item2 in (Collection<GridGroupSummarySortInfo>)(object)GroupSummarySortInfo)
			{
				GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[item2.FieldName];
				if (gridColumn != null)

				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInvalidGroupCache()
		{
			base.InvalidGroupCache.Clear();
			if (base.DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource == null || base.DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource.GroupDescriptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GroupDescription groupDescription in base.DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource.GroupDescriptions)
			{
				if (groupDescription is PropertyGroupDescription propertyGroupDescription && Columns[propertyGroupDescription.PropertyName] == null)
				{
					base.InvalidGroupCache.Add(propertyGroupDescription.PropertyName, propertyGroupDescription);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void Copy()
		{
			if (DataView.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.ClipboardMode == ClipboardMode.Formatted)
			{
				DataView.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase dataView)
				{
					dataView.SelectionStrategy.CopyMasterDetailToClipboard();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				DataView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase dataView)
				{
					dataView.SelectionStrategy.CopyMasterDetailToClipboard();
				});
			}
		}

		internal void CopyAllSelectedItemsToClipboard()
		{
			IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> selectedRows = GetSelectedRows();
			if (selectedRows.Count() > 0)
			{
				DataView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					view.CopyAllRowsToClipboardCore(selectedRows);
				});
			}
			else if (View.FocusedView.FocusedRowHandle != int.MinValue)
			{
				KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> focusedRow = new KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>(View.FocusedView.DataControl, View.FocusedView.FocusedRowHandle);
				DataView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					view.CopyAllRowsToClipboardCore(new List<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> { focusedRow });
				});
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> GetSelectedRows()
		{
			List<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.VisibleRowCount; i++)
			{
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndex = GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(i);
				if (DataView.IsRowSelected(rowHandleByVisibleIndex))
				{
					list.Add(new KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>(this, rowHandleByVisibleIndex));
				}
				if (IsMasterRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndex))
				{
					GridControl gridControl = (GridControl)GetVisibleDetail(rowHandleByVisibleIndex);
					if (gridControl != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(gridControl.GetSelectedRows());
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

			{
				return false;

		internal void OnGroupRowCollapsed(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (View != null && View.AllowFixedGroupsCore && IsRowVisible(rowHandle))
			{
				View.ScrollAnimationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					View.ScrollIntoView(rowHandle);
				});
			}
			RaiseGroupRowCollapsed(rowHandle);
		}

		private void OnIsAsyncOperationInProgressChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			if (View is GridViewBase gridViewBase)
			{
				isAsyncOperationInProgress = newValue;
				if (newValue)
				{
					gridViewBase.SetWaitIndicator();
					RaiseAsyncOperationBegin();
				}
				else
				{
					gridViewBase.ClearWaitIndicator();
					gridViewBase.OnRefreshDataSourceEnded();
					RaiseAsyncOperationEnd();
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				asyncOpWaitHandle.IsInterrupted = !newValue;
			}
		}

				DataView.SelectionStrategy.OnItemChanged(e);

			}
		}

		{

			gridViewBase.RaiseRowCanceled(e2);
			bool handled = e2.Handled;
			if (!handled)
			{
				ICommand<RowCanceledArgs> rowCanceledCommand = gridViewBase.EventTargetGridView.RowCanceledCommand;
				if (rowCanceledCommand != null)
				{
					RowCanceledArgs rowCanceledArgs = new RowCanceledArgs(GetRow(e.RowHandle), GetListIndexByRowHandle(e.RowHandle));
					rowCanceledCommand.Execute(rowCanceledArgs);
					handled = rowCanceledArgs.Handled;
				}
			}
			if (!handled && !CanCancelRow(e.Row) && View != null && !View.CancelRowEditLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				View.CancelRowChangesCore(useCache: true);
			}
		}

		void IDataProviderOwner.RaiseValidatingCurrentRow(ValidateControllerRowEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GridViewBase gridViewBase = (GridViewBase)View;
			GridRowValidationEventArgs e2;
			if (gridViewBase.UpdateRowValidateEventArgs != null)
			{
				e2 = gridViewBase.UpdateRowValidateEventArgs;
				if (e2.Exception != null)
				{
					SetRowStateError(((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, new GridRowValidationError(e2.Exception.Message, e2.Exception, ((ValidationEventArgs)e2).ErrorType, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle));
					throw e2.Exception;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				e2 = gridViewBase.RaiseValidateRowCore(this, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).Row, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, CancellationToken.None);
				if (e2.Exception != null)
				{
					SetRowStateError(((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, new GridRowValidationError(e2.Exception.Message, e2.Exception, ((ValidationEventArgs)e2).ErrorType, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle));
					throw e2.Exception;
				}
			}

			SetRowStateError(((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, new GridRowValidationError(text, null, ((ValidationEventArgs)e2).ErrorType, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle));
