		object IDataProviderEvents.GetUnboundData(int listSourceRowIndex, string fieldName, object value)
		{
			if (fieldName == "FixedRow")
			{
				return DataView.Return((DataViewBase x) => x.GetFixedRowIndex(listSourceRowIndex), () => -1);
			}
			if (IsConditionalFormattingServiceColumn(fieldName))
			{
				return value;
			}
			GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[fieldName];
			if (gridColumn == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (gridColumn.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator != null)
			{
				int rowHandleByListIndex = GetRowHandleByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex);
				return gridColumn.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator.GetValue(rowHandleByListIndex, listSourceRowIndex);
			}
			GridColumnDataEventArgs e = CreateArgs(listSourceRowIndex, fieldName, value, isGetAction: true);
			RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(e);
			return e.Value;
		}

		void IDataProviderEvents.SetUnboundData(int listSourceRowIndex, string fieldName, object value)
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[fieldName];
			if (gridColumn != null)
			{
				if (gridColumn.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator != null)
				{
					int rowHandleByListIndex = GetRowHandleByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex);
					gridColumn.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator.SetValue(rowHandleByListIndex, value);
				}
				GridColumnDataEventArgs e = CreateArgs(listSourceRowIndex, fieldName, value, isGetAction: false);
				RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(e);
			}
		}

		}

		{
			SortInfo.UngroupByColumn(column.FieldName);
		}

		public void ClearGrouping()
		{
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)SortInfo).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				foreach (GridColumn item in (Collection<GridColumn>)(object)Columns)
				{
					if (item.IsGrouped)
					{
						UngroupBy(item);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)SortInfo).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void GroupByColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SortInfo.GroupByColumn(column.FieldName, GroupCount, column.SortOrder);
		}

		private void DoOnColumnsArePopulated(Action action)
		{
			if (((Collection<GridColumn>)(object)Columns).Count > 0)
			{
				action();
				return;
			}
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler handler = null;
			handler = delegate
			{
				action();
				((ObservableCollection<GridColumn>)(object)Columns).CollectionChanged -= handler;
			};
			((ObservableCollection<GridColumn>)(object)Columns).CollectionChanged += handler;
		}

		void IDataControllerVisualClient.RequireSynchronization(IDataSync dataSync)
		{
			DoOnColumnsArePopulated(delegate
			{
				//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0112: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				List<GridSortInfo> list = new List<GridSortInfo>();
				bool flag = false;
				base.InvalidSortCache.Clear();
				foreach (ListSortInfo item in dataSync.Sort)
				{
					GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[item.PropertyName];
					if (gridColumn != null)
					{
						list.Add(new GridSortInfo(gridColumn.FieldName, item.SortDirection));
					}
					else
					{
						base.InvalidSortCache[item.PropertyName] = new GridSortInfo(item.PropertyName, item.SortDirection);
					}
					if (item.PropertyName == base.DefaultSorting)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				UpdateInvalidGroupCache();
				if (!flag && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.DefaultSorting))
				{
					GridColumn gridColumn2 = Columns[base.DefaultSorting];
					ListSortDirection listSortDirection = ((gridColumn2 != null && (int)gridColumn2.SortOrder == 2) ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
					list.Add(new GridSortInfo(base.DefaultSorting, listSortDirection));
					base.DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource.SortDescriptions.Add(new SortDescription(base.DefaultSorting, listSortDirection));
				}
				BeginDataUpdate();
				try
				{
					SortInfo.ClearAndAddRange(dataSync.GroupCount, list.ToArray());
					if (!dataSync.HasFilter && base.FilterCriteria != null)
					{
						base.FilterCriteria = null;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					EndDataUpdate();
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void DoUpdateRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!ScheduleUpdateSingleRow(rowHandle, base.DataProviderBase.ItemChangedPropertyDescriptorName))
			{
				base.DoUpdateRow(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ScheduleUpdateSingleRow(int rowHandle, string propertyName, object row = null)
		{
			if (!AllowUpdateOptimization || !visualClientUpdater.CanScheduleUpdate)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowHandle == base.DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow && base.DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing && base.CurrentColumn != null && base.CurrentColumn.FieldName == propertyName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EnsureChangedRows();
			SaveChangedItem(row ?? GetRow(rowHandle));
			if (visualClientUpdater.IsRowsUpdateEnqueued)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (changedRowHandles == null)
			{
				changedRowHandles = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<string>>();
			}
			HashSet<string> value = null;
			if (!changedRowHandles.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
				{
					value = new HashSet<string>();
				}
				changedRowHandles[rowHandle] = value;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				value = null;
				changedRowHandles[rowHandle] = null;
			}
			if (value != null && !value.Contains(propertyName))
			{
				value.Add(propertyName);
			}
			visualClientUpdater.ScheduleUpdateSingleRows();
			return true;
		}

		void IDataControllerVisualClient.UpdateRowIndexes(int newTopRowIndex)
		{
			SaveChangedItems(null);
			ScheduleUpdateRows();
		}

		void IDataControllerVisualClient.UpdateRows(int topRowIndexDelta)

			}
		}

		internal void UpdateErrorPanel(Func<string> getText)
		{
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_ErrorPanel") is ErrorPanel errorPanel && DataController != null)
			{
				string text = getText();
				errorPanel.DataContext = string.Format(GridControlLocalizer.GetString(GridControlStringId.ErrorPanelTextFormatString), text);
				errorPanel.Visibility = ((text == "" || !base.IsLoaded) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDeserializeCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			string collectionName = e.CollectionName;
			if (!(collectionName == "GroupSummary"))
			{
				if (collectionName == "GroupSummarySortInfo")
				{
					GridGroupSummarySortInfo item = (GridGroupSummarySortInfo)(e.CollectionItem = new GridGroupSummarySortInfoDeserializable());
					((Collection<GridGroupSummarySortInfo>)(object)GroupSummarySortInfo).Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					base.OnDeserializeCreateCollectionItem(e);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GridSummaryItem item2 = (GridSummaryItem)(e.CollectionItem = new GridSummaryItem());
				((Collection<GridSummaryItem>)(object)GroupSummary).Add(item2);
			}
		}

		public void ExpandAllGroups()
		{
			if (RaiseGroupRowExpanding(int.MinValue))
			{
				base.DataProviderBase.ExpandAll();
				ExpandCollapseAllDetailGroups(expanded: true);
				RaiseGroupRowExpanded(int.MinValue);
				ScrollBarAnnotationsGeneration();
			}
		}

		protected void ExpandCollapseAllDetailGroups(bool expanded)
		{
			if (View == null || !View.HasClonedDetails)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataControlOriginationElementHelper.EnumerateDependentElements(this, (DataControlBase grid) => grid as GridControl, delegate(GridControl grid)
			{
				if (expanded)
				{
					grid.ExpandAllGroups();
				}
				else
				{
					grid.CollapseAllGroups();
				}
			});
		}

		public void CollapseAllGroups()
		{
			if (RaiseGroupRowCollapsing(int.MinValue))
			{
				base.DataProviderBase.CollapseAll();
				ExpandCollapseAllDetailGroups(expanded: false);
				RaiseGroupRowCollapsed(int.MinValue);
				ScrollBarAnnotationsGeneration();
			}
		}

		internal int GetChildRowHandle(int rowHandle, int childIndex, GroupRowInfo info, List<GroupRowInfo> list)
		{
			if (childIndex < 0 || info == null || info.ChildControllerRowCount == 0)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (DataController.GroupInfo.IsLastLevel(info))
			{
				if (childIndex < info.ChildControllerRowCount)
				{
					return info.ChildControllerRow + childIndex;
				}
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (childIndex < list.Count)
			{
				return list[childIndex].Handle;
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		}

		internal List<GroupRowInfo> GetChildrenGroups(GroupRowInfo info)
		{
			if (info == null || (DataController == null && DataController.GroupInfo == null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GroupRowInfo> list = new List<GroupRowInfo>();
			DataController.GroupInfo.GetChildrenGroups(info, (IList<GroupRowInfo>)list);
			return list;
		}

		}

		protected internal override void UpdateGroupRowChecked(int rowHandle, string fieldName)
		{
			if (View is GridViewBase gridViewBase && IsGrouped && !IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle) && gridViewBase.ActualShowCheckBoxInGroupRow && gridViewBase.GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore == fieldName)
			{
				int rowHandle2 = rowHandle;
				for (int parentRowHandle = GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle); parentRowHandle != int.MinValue; parentRowHandle = GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle2))
				{
					rowHandle2 = parentRowHandle;
				}
				if (gridViewBase.GetRowData(rowHandle2) is GroupRowData groupRowData)
				{
					groupRowData.UpdateIsChecked(fullUpdate: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetCheckBoxSelectorColumnValue(int rowHandle, object value)
		{
			if ((bool)value)
			{
				DataView.SelectRowCore(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				DataView.UnselectRowCore(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected internal override object GetCellValue(RowData rowData, string fieldName)
		{
			if (TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(fieldName))
			{
				return GetCheckBoxSelectorColumnValue(rowData.RowHandleCore.Value);
			}
			return base.GetCellValue(rowData, fieldName);
		}

		internal override object GetCellValueCore(int rowHandle, string fieldName)
		{
			if (TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(fieldName))
			{
				return GetCheckBoxSelectorColumnValue(rowHandle);
			}
			return base.GetCellValueCore(rowHandle, fieldName);
		}

		private bool GetCheckBoxSelectorColumnValue(int rowHandle)
		{
			return DataView.Return((DataViewBase dataView) => dataView.IsRowSelected(rowHandle), () => false);
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeColumnMove(BaseColumn column, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			base.BeforeColumnMove(column, moveFrom);
			(column as GridColumn).Do(delegate(GridColumn col)
			{
				if (moveFrom == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel && col.IsGrouped && View != null)
				{
					View.HandleGroupMoveAction((GridColumn)column, int.MinValue, HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel, HeaderPresenterType.Headers);
				}
			});
		}

		internal void ScheduleUpdateRows(DataControllerChangedItemCollection changedItems = null)
		{
			SaveChangedItems(changedItems);
			visualClientUpdater.ScheduleUpdateRows();
		}

		void IDataProviderOwner.UpdateRows(DataControllerChangedItemCollection changedItems)
		{
			ScheduleUpdateRows(changedItems);
		}

		private void SaveChangedItems(DataControllerChangedItemCollection changedItems)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!AllowUpdateOptimization)
			{
				return;
			}
			EnsureChangedRows();
			if (changedItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < changedItems.Count; i++)
			{
				DataControllerChangedItem val = changedItems[i];
				if ((int)val.ChangedType != 2)
				{
					SaveChangedItem(GetRow(val.ControllerRowHandle));
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureChangedRows()
		{
			if (changedRows == null)
			{
				changedRows = new HashSet<object>();
			}
		}

		private void SaveChangedItem(object row)
		{
			changedRows.Add(row);
		}

		internal void OnRowsUpdateComplete()
		{
			changedRows = null;
			changedRowHandles = null;
		}

		private void UpdateSingleRows()
		{
			if (changedRowHandles == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateSingleRowsLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				foreach (int rowHandle in changedRowHandles.Keys)
				{
					View.UpdateRowDataByRowHandle(rowHandle, delegate(RowData rowData)
					{
						if (changedRowHandles != null)
						{
							HashSet<string> hashSet = changedRowHandles[rowHandle];
							if (hashSet == null || View.ViewBehavior.HasRowTemplateSelector)
							{
								rowData.UpdateDataOnRowPropertyChanged();
							}
							else
							{
								rowData.UpdateDependentCellData(hashSet);
							}
						}
					});
				}
			});
			View.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
		}

		protected internal override void OnRowUpdated(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (changedRowHandles != null && !UpdateSingleRowsLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				changedRowHandles.Remove(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldUpdateRow(object row)
		{
			if (!visualClientUpdater.IsRowsUpdateEnqueued)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (changedRows != null && !changedRows.Contains(row))
			{
				if (DataView != null)
				{
					return DataView.ViewBehavior.HasFormatConditions;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsRowUpdateEnqueued(object row)
		{
			if (changedRows != null)
			{
				return changedRows.Contains(row);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void InitiallyFocusedRowAfterFiltering(object row)
		{
			if (!base.IsServerMode)
			{
				base.InitiallyFocusedRowAfterFiltering(row);
			}
			else
			{
				if (base.AllowInitiallyFocusedRow || row == null || DataView == null || DataView.FocusedRowHandle == int.MinValue || DataView.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483638)
				{
					return;
				}
				Task<object> rowAsync = GetRowAsync(DataView.FocusedRowHandle);
				try
				{
					rowAsync.ContinueWith(delegate(Task<object> x)
					{
						try
						{
							if (x.Result != row)
							{
								base.DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow = int.MinValue;
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}, CancellationToken.None, TaskContinuationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.FromCurrentSynchronizationContext());
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		internal override DataTemplate CreateFilterHeaderTemplate(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return HeaderImageControl.CreateTemplate(column, column.FilterEditorHeaderTemplate);
		}

		DataDependentEntity IDataProviderOwner.GetPropertyChangeDependency(string changedPropertyName)
		{
			return GetPropertyChangeDependency(changedPropertyName);
		}

		private void OnCustomUnboundColumnDataCommandChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DataControlBase.OnDataEventCommandChanged(this, e);
			UpdatePropertySchemeController();
		}

		internal override bool IsDataEventsCommandsReady()
		{
			if (!base.IsDataEventsCommandsReady())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomRowFilterCommand, CustomRowFilterCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomColumnDisplayTextCommand, CustomColumnDisplayTextCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomGroupDisplayTextCommand, CustomGroupDisplayTextCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomColumnGroupCommand, CustomColumnGroupCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomColumnSortCommand, CustomColumnSortCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomSummaryCommand, CustomSummaryCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomSummaryExistsCommand, CustomSummaryExistsCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomUnboundColumnDataCommand, CustomUnboundColumnDataCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void FillGroupInfo(List<GroupInfo> infos, GridControl grid, GroupRowInfo groupRowInfo)
		{
			infos.Add(new GroupInfo(grid.GroupedColumns[groupRowInfo.Level].FieldName, groupRowInfo.GroupValue, groupRowInfo.Level));
			if (groupRowInfo.ParentGroup != null)
			{
				FillGroupInfo(infos, grid, groupRowInfo.ParentGroup);
			}
		}

		[SpecialName]
		Dispatcher IDataProviderOwner.get_Dispatcher()
		{
			return base.Dispatcher;
		}
	}

		protected internal PagerControl PagerControl { get; private set; }

		protected int ActualPageSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!PageSize.HasValue)
				{
					if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsPagedSource)
					{
						return DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageSize;
					}
					return 20;
				}
				return PageSize.Value;
			}
		}

		protected PagerControlInitializationState PagerControlState { get; set; }

		private bool IsPagedSource
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataProviderBase != null)
				{
					return DataProviderBase.IsPagedSource;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsPagingMode
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return AllowPaging;
			}
		}

		protected override int ItemsOnPage
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.VisibleCount < PageSize)
				{
					return DataProviderBase.VisibleCount;
				}
				return LastVisibleIndexOnPage - FirstVisibleIndexOnPage + 1;
			}
		}

		protected override int LastVisibleIndexOnPage
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				int num = PageOffset + ActualPageSize - 1;
				if (DataProviderBase != null && num > DataProviderBase.VisibleCount)
				{
					return DataProviderBase.VisibleCount - 1;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected override int FirstVisibleIndexOnPage
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return PageOffset;
			}
		}

		protected override int PageOffset
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (!IsPagingMode)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return CurrentPageIndex * ActualPageSize;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsGroupRowOptimized => false;

		static GridViewBase()
		{
			FilteringPanelStyleProperty = FilterPanelControlAdapter.FilteringPanelStyleProperty.AddOwner(typeof(GridViewBase));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GridViewBase);
			GridViewSelectionControlWrapper.Register();
			ClipboardCopyMaxRowCountInServerModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ClipboardCopyMaxRowCountInServerMode", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1000));
			ShowGroupedColumnsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowGroupedColumns", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).RebuildColumns();
			}));
			ActualShowGroupPanelPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualShowGroupPanel", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			ActualShowGroupPanelProperty = ActualShowGroupPanelPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowGroupPanelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowGroupPanel", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).OnShowGroupPanelChanged();
			}));
			IsGroupPanelVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsGroupPanelVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).UpdateActualSearchPanelPosition();
			}));
			IsGroupPanelVisibleProperty = IsGroupPanelVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsGroupPanelTextVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsGroupPanelTextVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			IsGroupPanelTextVisibleProperty = IsGroupPanelTextVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			VisibleColumnsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("VisibleColumns", typeof(IList<GridColumn>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			VisibleColumnsProperty = VisibleColumnsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AllowGroupingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowGrouping", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, DataViewBase.OnUpdateColumnsViewInfo));
			RowUpdatedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("RowUpdated", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(RowEventHandler), typeFromHandle);

		private static void RegisterClassCommandBindings()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GridViewBase);
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.ChangeGroupExpanded, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).ChangeGroupExpanded(e.Parameter);
			}));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.ExpandAllGroups, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).ExpandAllGroups(e);
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).OnCanExpandCollapseAll(e);
			}));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.CollapseAllGroups, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).CollapseAllGroups(e);
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).OnCanExpandCollapseAll(e);
			}));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.MoveParentGroupRow, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).MoveParentGroupRow();
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				e.CanExecute = ((GridViewBase)d).CanMoveGroupParentRow();
			}));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.ClearGrouping, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).ClearGrouping();
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridViewBase)d).OnCanClearGrouping(e);
			}));
		}

		protected override GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs ValidateRowDeletionCore(IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs e = new GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs(ValidateRowDeletionEvent, this, rowHandles);
			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);
			if (!e.Handled && EventTargetGridView.ValidateRowDeletionCommand != null)
			{
				ValidateRowDeletionArgs validateRowDeletionArgs = new ValidateRowDeletionArgs(e.Rows, rowHandles.Select((int r) => DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(r)).ToArray());
				EventTargetGridView.ValidateRowDeletionCommand.Execute(validateRowDeletionArgs);
				e.Result = validateRowDeletionArgs.Result;
				e.DisplayErrorMode = validateRowDeletionArgs.DisplayErrorMode;
				e.ResultAsync = validateRowDeletionArgs.ResultAsync;
			}
			return e;
		}

		internal override void UpdateMasterDetailViewProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateMasterDetailViewProperties();

			{
				x.UpdateIsAnyDetailGrouped();
			});

		private void UpdateIsGroupPanelTextVisible()
		{
			bool isAnyGridGrouped = false;
			UpdateAllOriginationViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
			{
				if (view.DataControl != null)
				{
					isAnyGridGrouped |= ((GridControl)view.DataControl).IsGrouped;
				}
			});
			((GridViewBase)base.RootView).IsGroupPanelTextVisible = !isAnyGridGrouped;
		}

		protected void UpdateIsGroupPanelVisible()
		{
			bool isAnyGroupPanelVisible = false;
			if (DataProviderBase == null || (!DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource && !IsPagingMode))
			{
				UpdateAllOriginationViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					isAnyGroupPanelVisible |= !GetIsCompactMode() && ((GridViewBase)view).ShowGroupPanel;
				});
			}
			((GridViewBase)base.RootView).IsGroupPanelVisible = isAnyGroupPanelVisible;
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseValidateCell(GridRowValidationEventArgs rowEventArgs)
		{
			GridCellValidationEventArgs e = (GridCellValidationEventArgs)rowEventArgs;
			if (this.ValidateCell != null)
			{
				this.ValidateCell(this, e);
			}
			if (!((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled && ValidateCellCommand != null)
			{
				DataViewBase.ExecuteValidateCommand(ValidateCellCommand, new RowCellValidationArgs(e.Cell.Property, e.CellValue, ((ValidationEventArgs)e).Value, e.Row, DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(e.RowHandle), e.RowHandle == -2147483647, e.CancellationToken, e.AllowAsyncResult), e);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool SupportValidateCell()
		{
			if (EventTargetGridView.ValidateCell != null || EventTargetGridView.ValidateCellCommand != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (GridColumn visibleColumn in VisibleColumns)
			{
				if (visibleColumn.SupportValidate())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool SupportValidateRow()
		{
			if (EventTargetGridView.ValidateRow == null)
			{
				return EventTargetGridView.ValidateRowCommand != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void HandleGroupMoveAction(ColumnBase source, int newVisibleIndex, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, HeaderPresenterType moveTo, MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition = MergeGroupPosition.None)
		{
			if (IsGroupMoveAction(moveFrom, moveTo))
			{
				ListSortDirection actualDirection = GridSortInfo.GetActualDirection(source.AllowedSortOrders, source.DefaultSortOrder);
				SortInfo.OnGroupColumnMove(source.FieldName, newVisibleIndex, moveFrom == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel, moveTo == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel, actualDirection, GetAllowGroupingSortingBySingleColumnOnly(), mergeGroupPosition, !AllowMergedGrouping || MergedGroupingMode == MergedGroupingMode.CtrlKeyPressed);
			}
		}

		protected internal override object RaiseAddingNewRow()
		{
			object result = null;
			AddingNewEventHandler addingNewEventHandler = this.AddingNewRow ?? ((GridViewBase)base.OriginationView)?.AddingNewRow;
			if (addingNewEventHandler != null)
			{
				AddingNewEventArgs e = new AddingNewEventArgs();
				addingNewEventHandler(this, e);
				result = e.NewObject;
			}
			ICommand<NewRowArgs> command = AddingNewRowCommand ?? ((GridViewBase)base.OriginationView)?.AddingNewRowCommand;
			if (command != null)
			{
				NewRowArgs newRowArgs = new NewRowArgs();
				command.Execute(newRowArgs);
				result = newRowArgs.Item;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanRaiseAddingNewRow()
		{
			if (this.AddingNewRow != null || AddingNewRowCommand != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			GridViewBase gridViewBase = (GridViewBase)base.OriginationView;
			if (gridViewBase != null && (gridViewBase.AddingNewRow != null || gridViewBase.AddingNewRowCommand != null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);

		protected internal virtual void RaiseValidateRow(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			EventTargetGridView.RaiseValidateRowCore(e);
		}

		private void RaiseValidateRowCore(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			this.ValidateRow?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (!((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled && ValidateRowCommand != null)
			{
				DataViewBase.ExecuteValidateCommand(ValidateRowCommand, new RowValidationArgs(e.Row, DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(e.RowHandle), e.RowHandle == -2147483647, e.CancellationToken, e.AllowAsyncResult), e);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseRowUpdated(RowEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				EventTargetGridView.RowUpdatedCommand?.Execute(new RowUpdatedArgs(e.Row, DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(e.RowHandle)));
			}
		}

		protected override void RaiseRowUpdatedBase(int rowHandle)

			RaiseRowUpdated(new RowEventArgs(RowUpdatedEvent, this, rowHandle));
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseRowCanceled(RowEventArgs e)

		}

		private object GetGroupDisplayValueCore(object originalValue, int rowLevel, string fieldName, int rowHandle)
		{
			GridDataColumnSortInfo sortInfo = Grid.SortData.GetSortInfo(DataProviderBase.Columns[fieldName]);
			object obj = originalValue;
			if (sortInfo != null)
			{
				obj = ((BaseGridColumnInfo)sortInfo).UpdateGroupDisplayValue(originalValue);
			}
			string groupDisplayText = GetGroupDisplayText(rowHandle, obj, Columns[fieldName], sortInfo?.GetColumnGroupFormatString());
			if (sortInfo != null)
			{
				groupDisplayText = ((BaseGridColumnInfo)sortInfo).GetGroupDisplayText(obj, groupDisplayText);
			}
			return Grid.RaiseCustomDisplayText(rowHandle, null, Grid.Columns[fieldName], originalValue, groupDisplayText);
		}

		protected internal override object GetGroupDisplayValue(int rowHandle)
		{
			int rowLevelByRowHandle = Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			GridSortInfo sortInfoBySortLevel = GetSortInfoBySortLevel(rowLevelByRowHandle);
			if (sortInfoBySortLevel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string fieldName = sortInfoBySortLevel.FieldName;
			object groupRowValue = Grid.GetGroupRowValue(rowHandle, Columns[fieldName]);
			return GetGroupDisplayValueCore(groupRowValue, rowLevelByRowHandle, fieldName, rowHandle);
		}

		protected internal override object[] GetGroupDisplayValues(int rowHandle)
		{
			int rowLevelByRowHandle = Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (rowLevelByRowHandle >= ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfo).Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridSortInfo sortInfoByActualLevel = SortInfo.GetSortInfoByActualLevel(rowLevelByRowHandle);
			if (sortInfoByActualLevel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(sortInfoByActualLevel, SortInfo.GroupCount);
			if (mergeSortInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in mergeSortInfo)
			{
				GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[item.FieldName];
				if (gridColumn != null)
				{
					object cellValue = Grid.GetCellValue(Grid.GetDataRowHandleByGroupRowHandle(rowHandle), item.FieldName);
					list.Add(GetGroupDisplayValueCore(cellValue, rowLevelByRowHandle, item.FieldName, rowHandle));
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal override string GetGroupRowDisplayText(int rowHandle)
		{
			int rowLevelByRowHandle = Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			string fieldName = GetSortInfoBySortLevel(rowLevelByRowHandle).FieldName;
			GridSortInfo sortInfoByActualLevel = SortInfo.GetSortInfoByActualLevel(rowLevelByRowHandle);
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(sortInfoByActualLevel, SortInfo.GroupCount);
			if (mergeSortInfo == null)
			{
				GridColumn gridColumn = (GridColumn)GetColumnBySortLevel(Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle));
				if (gridColumn != null)
				{
					return $"{gridColumn.HeaderCaption}: " + (string)GetGroupDisplayValue(rowHandle);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			object[] groupDisplayValues = GetGroupDisplayValues(rowHandle);
			for (int i = 0; i < mergeSortInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				GridColumn gridColumn2 = Columns[mergeSortInfo[i].FieldName];
				if (gridColumn2 != null)
				{
					string text = ((groupDisplayValues == null || groupDisplayValues.Length < i) ? ((string)GetGroupDisplayValue(rowHandle)) : ((groupDisplayValues[i] != null) ? groupDisplayValues[i].ToString() : null));
					stringBuilder.Append($"{gridColumn2.HeaderCaption}: " + text);
					if (i != mergeSortInfo.Count - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.MergedGroupsSeparator));
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected internal override string GetGroupRowHeaderCaption(int rowHandle)
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = (GridColumn)GetColumnBySortLevel(Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle));
			if (gridColumn != null)
			{
				return gridColumn.HeaderCaption.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetGroupRowHeadersCaptions(int rowHandle)
		{
			int rowLevelByRowHandle = Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (rowLevelByRowHandle >= ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfo).Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridSortInfo sortInfoByActualLevel = SortInfo.GetSortInfoByActualLevel(rowLevelByRowHandle);
			if (sortInfoByActualLevel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(sortInfoByActualLevel, SortInfo.GroupCount);
			if (mergeSortInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in mergeSortInfo)
			{
				GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[item.FieldName];
				if (gridColumn != null)
				{
					list.Add(gridColumn.HeaderCaption.ToString());
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal override GroupTextHighlightingProperties GetGroupHighlightingProperties(int rowHandle)
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = (GridColumn)GetColumnBySortLevel(Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle));
			if (gridColumn != null && base.SearchPanelColumnProvider != null)
			{
				TextHighlightingProperties textHighlightingProperties = base.SearchPanelColumnProvider.GetTextHighlightingProperties(gridColumn);
				if (textHighlightingProperties != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(textHighlightingProperties.Text))
				{
					return new GroupTextHighlightingProperties(textHighlightingProperties, gridColumn.ActualEditSettings);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override GridSortInfo GetSortInfoBySortLevel(int level)
		{
			if (level >= base.DataControl.ActualSortInfo.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in base.DataControl.ActualSortInfo)
			{
				if (num != 0 && item.MergeWithPreviousGroup)
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (num == level)
				{
					return item;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetGroupDisplayText(int rowHandle, object value, GridColumn column, string formatString)
		{
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (column == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			object obj = value;
			if (obj is object[] array && array.Length != 0)
			{
				if (array.Length == 1)
				{
					obj = array[0];
				}
				else
				{
					GridSortInfo sortInfo = SortInfo[column.FieldName];
					List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(sortInfo, SortInfo.GroupCount);
					if (mergeSortInfo != null)
					{
						int num = mergeSortInfo.FindIndex((GridSortInfo x) => x.FieldName == column.FieldName);
						if (num >= 0 && array.Length > num)
						{
							obj = array[num];
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formatString))
			{
				obj = GetDisplayObject(obj, column);
			}
			else
			{
				if ((int)column.GetSortMode() != 1)
				{
					obj = GetDisplayObject(obj, column, applyFormat: false);
				}
				obj = FormatStringConverter.GetFormattedValue(formatString, obj, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			string displayText = obj?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
			return Grid.RaiseCustomGroupDisplayText(rowHandle, column, value, displayText);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPostRowException(ControllerRowExceptionEventArgs controllerArgs)
		{
			InvalidRowExceptionEventArgs e = new InvalidRowExceptionEventArgs(this, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)controllerArgs).RowHandle, controllerArgs.Exception.Message, GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ErrorWindowTitle), controllerArgs.Exception, ExceptionMode.DisplayError);
			RaiseInvalidRowException(e);
			if (!e.Handled && EventTargetGridView.InvalidRowExceptionCommand != null)
			{
				InvalidRowExceptionArgs invalidRowExceptionArgs = new InvalidRowExceptionArgs(((ControllerRowEventArgs)controllerArgs).Row, ((ControllerRowEventArgs)controllerArgs).RowHandle == -2147483647, DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(((ControllerRowEventArgs)controllerArgs).RowHandle), controllerArgs.Exception, controllerArgs.Exception.Message, GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ErrorWindowTitle), DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode.DisplayError);
				EventTargetGridView.InvalidRowExceptionCommand.Execute(invalidRowExceptionArgs);
				e.ErrorText = invalidRowExceptionArgs.ErrorText;
				e.WindowCaption = invalidRowExceptionArgs.WindowCaption;
				e.ExceptionMode = DataViewBase.ToGridExceptionMode(invalidRowExceptionArgs.ExceptionMode);
			}
			HandleInvalidRowExceptionEventArgs(controllerArgs, e);
		}

		}

		private void OnChangeGroupExpanded(object commandParameter)
		{
			if (commandParameter is int)
			{
				ChangeGroupExpandedWithAnimation((int)commandParameter, ((GridControl)base.DataControl).IsRecursiveExpand);
			}
		}

		internal void ChangeGroupExpandedWithAnimation(int rowHandle, bool recursive)
		{
			if (base.RootDataPresenter != null && CommitEditingInternal() && base.DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandle) && base.Nodes.ContainsKey(rowHandle) && GetRowElementByRowHandle(rowHandle) != null)
			{
				GroupNode groupNode = (GroupNode)base.Nodes[rowHandle];
				if (UseAnimationWhenExpanding && !base.ActualAllowCellMerge)
				{
					base.RootDataPresenter.EnqueueContinousAction(new ExpandRowWithAnimationAction(base.RootDataPresenter, groupNode, recursive));
				}
				else if (groupNode.IsExpanded)
				{
					Grid.CollapseGroupRowWithEvents(groupNode.RowHandle.Value, recursive);
				}
				else
				{
					Grid.ExpandGroupRowWithEvents(groupNode.RowHandle.Value, recursive);
				}
				base.RootDataPresenter.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PagerControl != null)
			{
				UninitializePagerControl();
			}
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_PagerControl");
			PagerControl = (PagerControl)(object)((templateChild is PagerControl) ? templateChild : null);
			if (PagerControl != null)
			{
				InitializePagerControl();
			}
		}

		protected void UninitializePagerControl()
		{
			PagerControl.PageSizeChanged -= OnPageSizeChanged;
			PagerControl.RefreshPage -= OnPagerControlRefreshPage;
			PagerControl.PageIndexChanged -= OnPagerControlPageIndexChanged;
			PagerControl.PageIndexChanging -= OnPagerControlPageIndexChanging;
		}

		protected void InitializePagerControl()
		{
			PagerControl.PageSizeChanged += OnPageSizeChanged;
			PagerControl.PageIndexChanged += OnPagerControlPageIndexChanged;
			PagerControl.PageIndexChanging += OnPagerControlPageIndexChanging;
			PagerControl.RefreshPage += OnPagerControlRefreshPage;
			UpdatePagerControlProperties();
		}

		private void OnPageSizeChanged(object sender, DataPagerPageSizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue != ActualPageSize)
			{
				PageSize = e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private void OnPagerControlPageIndexChanging(object sender, DataPagerPageIndexChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = RaiseCurrentPageIndexChanging(((DataPagerPageIndexChangedEventArgs)e).OldValue, ((DataPagerPageIndexChangedEventArgs)e).NewValue);
			e.IsCancel = !RequestUIUpdate() || !flag;
		}

		private void OnPagerControlPageIndexChanged(object sender, DataPagerPageIndexChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCurrentPageIndex();
			RaiseCurrentPageIndexChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		private async void OnPagerControlRefreshPage(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (CanRefreshDataSource())
			{
				await RefreshDataSourceAsync();
			}
		}

		internal void SetUninitializedState()
		{
			PagerControlState = PagerControlInitializationState.Uninitialized;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdatePagerControlProperties()
		{
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (PagerControl == null || DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateServerModePageSize();
			base.ActualShowPager = IsPagingMode || DataProviderBase.IsPagedSource;
			if (!base.ActualShowPager)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataProviderBase.IsPagedSource)
			{
				if ((PagerControlState & PagerControlInitializationState.PagedSource) != PagerControlInitializationState.PagedSource)
				{
					PagerControlState = PagerControlInitializationState.PagedSource;
					((FrameworkElement)(object)PagerControl).SetBinding(PagerControl.ItemCountProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("TotalItemCount")
					{
						Source = DataProviderBase.PagedSource,
						Converter = (IValueConverter)new PagerControlItemCountConverter()
					});
					((FrameworkElement)(object)PagerControl).SetBinding(PagerControl.HasMorePagesProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("HasMorePages")
					{
						Source = DataProviderBase.PagedSource
					});
					UpdatePagerControlPageIndex(initFromSource: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				PagerControlState = PagerControlInitializationState.IsPaging;
				UpdatePagerControlItemCount();
				UpdatePagerControlPageIndex();
			}
			UpdatePagerControlPageSize();
			((FrameworkElement)(object)PagerControl).SetBinding(PagerControl.NumericButtonCountProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(PagerNumericButtonCountProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this
			});
			((DependencyObject)(object)PagerControl).SetCurrentValue(PagerControl.ShowRefreshPageButtonProperty, (object)DataProviderBase.IsPagedSource);
		}

		{

		}

			base.TopRowIndex = 0;
			UpdateVisibleGroupPanel();
			UpdateMasterDetailViewProperties();
		}

			UpdateServerModePageSize();
			OnPagerSettingsChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentPageIndexChanged()
		{
			UpdatePagerControlPageIndex();
			if (base.IsMultiSelection)
			{
				base.SelectionStrategy.ResetSelectionMasterAnchorInternal();
				SetSelectionAnchor();
			}
			if (base.ScrollInfoOwner != null && !IsPagedSource)
			{
				base.ViewBehavior.UpdateTopRowIndex();
			}
			OnPagerSettingsChanged();
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceCurrentPageIndex(int value)
		{
			if (PagerControl != null && !synchronizingCurrentPageIndex)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)PagerControl).SetCurrentValue(PagerControl.PageIndexProperty, (object)value);
				return PagerControl.PageIndex;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdatePagerControlPageSize()
		{
			if (PagerControl != null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)PagerControl).SetCurrentValue(PagerControl.PageSizeProperty, (object)ActualPageSize);
				if (IsPagedSource && PageSize.HasValue && DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageSize != ActualPageSize)
				{
					DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageSize = ActualPageSize;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdatePagerControlItemCount()
		{
			if (PagerControl != null && base.DataControl != null && !IsPagedSource)
			{
				PagerControl.ItemCount = base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
				PagerControl.Update();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdatePagerControlPageIndex(bool initFromSource = false)
		{
			if (initFromSource && IsPagedSource)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(CurrentPageIndexProperty, DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				CoerceValue(CurrentPageIndexProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CheckPagerControlPageCount()
		{
			if (IsPagedSource && DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageCount < PageCount)
			{
				PagerControl.Update();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateServerModePageSize()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.DataController != null)
			{
				object dataSource = DataProviderBase.DataController.DataSource;
				IListServerHints val = (IListServerHints)((dataSource is IListServerHints) ? dataSource : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.HintGridIsPaged(IsPagingMode ? ActualPageSize : 0);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentPageIndex()
		{
			try
			{
				synchronizingCurrentPageIndex = true;
				SetCurrentValue(CurrentPageIndexProperty, PagerControl.PageIndex);
				if (IsPagedSource && DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageIndex != CurrentPageIndex)
				{
					DataProviderBase.PagedSource.PageIndex = CurrentPageIndex;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				synchronizingCurrentPageIndex = false;
			}
		}

		protected void OnPagerSettingsChanged()
		{
			if (base.DataControl != null && !IsPagedSource)
			{
				base.DataControl.UpdateRowsCore();
			}
		}

				this.CurrentPageIndexChanging(this, e);

			return true;
		}

			}
		}

		protected internal override InlineCollectionInfo GetGroupSummaryTextValues(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle, bool groupFooter)
		{
			SummaryInlineInfoCreator summaryInlineInfoCreator = new SummaryInlineInfoCreator();
			Func<GridSummaryItem, Style> itemStyleSelector = null;
			if (groupFooter)
			{
				summaryInlineInfoCreator.SeparatorText = Environment.NewLine;
				summaryInlineInfoCreator.DefaultStyle = GetGroupSummaryElementStyle(groupFooter: true);
				itemStyleSelector = (GridSummaryItem s) => s.GroupColumnFooterElementStyle;
			}
			else
			{
				summaryInlineInfoCreator.SeparatorText = base.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlStringId.SummaryItemsSeparator.ToString());
				summaryInlineInfoCreator.DefaultStyle = GetGroupSummaryElementStyle(groupFooter: false);
				itemStyleSelector = (GridSummaryItem s) => s.GroupColumnSummaryElementStyle;
			}
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.GetSummaryStyle = (SummaryItemBase s) => (s is GridSummaryItem arg) ? itemStyleSelector(arg) : null;
			string columnDisplayFormat = GroupRowData.GetColumnDisplayFormat(column);
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.GetItemDisplayText = delegate(GridSummaryData d)
			{
				string result = null;
				SummaryItemBase item = d.Item;
				if (item != null)
				{
					result = item.GetGroupColumnDisplayText(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, ColumnBase.GetSummaryDisplayName(base.DataControl.ColumnsCore[item.FieldName], item), d.Value, columnDisplayFormat);
				}
				return result;
			};
			return summaryInlineInfoCreator.Create(CreateGroupColumnSummaryData(column, rowHandle, groupFooter));
		}

		private IEnumerable<GridSummaryData> CreateGroupColumnSummaryData(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle, bool groupFooter)
		{
			foreach (GridSummaryItem item in column.GroupSummariesCore)
			{
				object value = null;
				if (DataProviderBase.TryGetGroupSummaryValue(rowHandle, item, out value) && !(groupFooter ^ (item.ShowInGroupColumnFooter == column.FieldName)))
				{
					yield return new GridSummaryData(item, value, column);
				}
			}
		}

				throw new InvalidOperationException(errorMessage);
			}

		protected internal virtual bool IsMergedGroupingCore()
		{
			if (!AllowMergedGrouping)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MergedGroupingMode switch
			{
				MergedGroupingMode.CtrlKeyPressed => ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers), 
				MergedGroupingMode.Always => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		internal ItemsGenerationStrategyBase CreateItemsGenerationStrategy()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase.IsServerMode)
			{
				return new ItemsGenerationServerModeStrategy(this);
			}
			if (DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				return new ItemsGenerationAsyncServerModeStrategy(this);
			}
			if (base.PrintSelectedRowsOnly)
			{
				return new ItemsGenerationSelectedRowsStrategy(this);
			}
			if (PrintAllGroups)
			{
				return new ItemsGenerationPrintAllGroupsStrategy(this);
			}
			return new ItemsGenerationSimpleStrategy(this);
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<int> GetChildHandles(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid == null || !Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(groupRowHandle))
			{
				yield break;
			}
			GroupRowInfo groupInfo = Grid.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(groupRowHandle);
			List<GroupRowInfo> list = Grid.GetChildrenGroups(groupInfo);
			int count = list?.Count ?? 0;
			bool isGroup = true;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				count = Grid.GetChildRowCount(groupRowHandle);
				isGroup = false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int childRowHandle = Grid.GetChildRowHandle(groupRowHandle, i, groupInfo, list);
				if (isGroup)
				{
					foreach (int childHandle in GetChildHandles(childRowHandle))
					{
						yield return childHandle;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					yield return childRowHandle;
				}
			}
		}

		{

		}

		{

		}

		internal override int GetFirstDataFocusedRowHandle()
		{
			if (Grid == null)
			{
				return base.GetFirstDataFocusedRowHandle();
			}
			if (Grid.IsGrouped && IsGroupRowFocused())
			{
				int num = base.FocusedRowHandle;
				while (Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(num))
				{
					num = GetChildHandles(num).FirstOrDefault();
				}
				return num;
			}
			return base.GetFirstDataFocusedRowHandle();
		}

		}

		internal override bool AttachObservablePropertyScheme(ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] scheme)
		{
			if (base.AttachObservablePropertyScheme(scheme))
			{
				return true;
			}
			BindingListAdapterBase obj = ((Grid?.DataProviderBase is GridDataProvider gridDataProvider) ? gridDataProvider.BindingListAdapter : null);
			BindingListAdapter val = (BindingListAdapter)(object)((obj is BindingListAdapter) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.ObservablePropertyScheme = scheme;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void SearchPanelHorizontalAlignmentChanged()
		{
			base.ActualSearchPanelHorizontalAlignment = (base.SearchPanelHorizontalAlignment.HasValue ? base.SearchPanelHorizontalAlignment.Value : ((SearchPanelPosition == SearchPanelPosition.Default) ? System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right : System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left));
		}

		{

		}

		protected internal override GridRowValidationEventArgs RaiseValidateRowCore(object source, object row, int rowHandle, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			GridRowValidationEventArgs e = new GridRowValidationEventArgs(source, row, rowHandle, this)
			{
				CancellationToken = cancellationToken
			};
			try
			{
				RaiseValidateRow(e);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				((ValidationEventArgs)e).SetError((object)ex.Message, (ErrorType)1);
				e.Exception = ex;
			}
			return e;
		}

		internal override bool IsDataEventsCommandsReady()
		{
			if (!base.IsDataEventsCommandsReady())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(ValidateRowCommand, ValidateRowCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(AddingNewRowCommand, AddingNewRowCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(RowUpdatedCommand, RowUpdatedCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(RowCanceledCommand, RowCanceledCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CellValueChangedCommand, CellValueChangedCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CellValueChangingCommand, CellValueChangingCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(InvalidRowExceptionCommand, InvalidRowExceptionCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(ValidateCellCommand, ValidateCellCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(ValidateRowDeletionCommand, ValidateRowDeletionCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		internal GridViewClipboardHelper ClipboardHelperManager { get; private set; }

		private IClipboardManager<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> ClipboardManager => _clipboardManager ?? (_clipboardManager = CreateClipboardManager());

		[Description("Gets an object that returns data for the clipboard in a variety of formats (plain text, plain unicode text, rich text, CSV, Biff8, HTML).")]
		[Category("Data")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public virtual GridClipboardDataProvider ClipboardDataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardDataProvider == null)
				{
					clipboardDataProvider = new GridClipboardDataProvider(ClipboardManager as ClipboardExportManagerBase<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>);
				}
				return clipboardDataProvider as GridClipboardDataProvider;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IClipboardPasteManager ClipboardPasteManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardPasteManagerCore == null)
				{
					clipboardPasteManagerCore = new DefaultClipboardPasteManager<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>(ClipboardPasteHelper);
				}
				object obj = clipboardPasteManagerCore;
				return (IClipboardPasteManager)((obj is IClipboardPasteManager) ? obj : null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual IClipboardPasteHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> ClipboardPasteHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardPasteHelperCore == null)
				{
					clipboardPasteHelperCore = new ClipboardPasteHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>(this);
				}
				return clipboardPasteHelperCore as IClipboardPasteHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsClipboardPastingInProgress
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return (clipboardPasteHelperCore as ClipboardPasteHelperBase<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)?.IsPastingInProgress ?? false;
			}
		}

		bool ITableView.AllowClipboardPaste
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)((ITableView)this).ActualPasteMode != 0)
				{
					return (int)PasteMode != 2;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		PasteMode ITableView.ActualPasteMode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (base.IsRootView || (int)PasteMode != 0)
				{
					return PasteMode;
				}
				return (PasteMode)(((??)((ITableView)((base.DataControl?.GetMasterGridCore())?.DataView))?.PasteMode) ?? 0);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal override bool ActualAllowCountTotalSummary
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllowCountTotalSummary.HasValue)
				{
					return AllowCountTotalSummary.Value;
				}
				if (base.DataControl != null)
				{
					return !base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal RowFixingPosition ActualAllowRowFixing
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllowRowFixing != RowFixingPosition.None && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					return RowFixingPosition.Top;
				}
				return AllowRowFixing;
			}
		}

		private CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<TableView> CompactModeFilterItemsCollectionChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (compactModeFilterItemsChangedHandler == null)
				{
					compactModeFilterItemsChangedHandler = new CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<TableView>(this, (Action<TableView, object, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TableView e, object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
					{
						e.CompactModeFilterItemsCore_CollectionChanged(o, args);
					});
				}
				return compactModeFilterItemsChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<ICustomItem> CompactModeFilterItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (compactModeFilterItemsCore == null)
				{
					compactModeFilterItemsCore = new ObservableCollection<ICustomItem>();
					compactModeFilterItemsCore.CollectionChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemsCollectionChangedHandler).Handler;
				}
				return compactModeFilterItemsCore;
			}
		}

		ScrollBarAnnotationMode ITableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsRootView)
				{
					return ScrollBarAnnotationModeCore ?? DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None;
				}
				if (!ScrollBarAnnotationModeCore.HasValue)
				{
					DataControlBase dataControlBase = ((base.DataControl != null) ? base.DataControl.GetMasterGridCore() : null);
					if (dataControlBase == null || dataControlBase.DataView == null)
					{
						return DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None;
					}
					return ((ITableView)dataControlBase.DataView).ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual;
				}
				return ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Value;
			}
		}

					{
						e.OnFixedRowsCollectionChanged(o, args, FixedRowPosition.Top);
					});
				}
				return fixedTopRowsCollectionChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		protected internal override int FindRowHandle(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (!base.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				return base.FindRowHandle(element);
			}
			TableView tableView = (TableView)base.RootView;
			System.Windows.Point hitTestPoint = tableView.ScrollContentPresenter.TranslatePoint(tableView.TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition, tableView);
			TableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = tableView.CalcHitInfo(hitTestPoint);
			if (!tableViewHitInfo.InRowCell)
			{
				return base.FindRowHandle(element);
			}
			return tableViewHitInfo.RowHandle;
		}

		private IClipboardManager<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> CreateClipboardManager()
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ClipboardHelperManager = ((base.DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0) ? new BandedGridViewClipboardHelper(this, (ExportTarget)1) : new GridViewClipboardHelper(this, (ExportTarget)1));
			return (IClipboardManager<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)PrintHelper.ClipboardExportManagerInstance(typeof(ColumnWrapper), typeof(RowBaseWrapper), ClipboardHelperManager);
		}

		protected internal override bool SetDataAwareClipboardData(IClipboardFormatted clipboardDataProvider, bool callCopyFromCommand)
		{
			SetActualClipboardOptions(base.OptionsClipboard);
			if (ClipboardManager != null && ClipboardHelperManager != null && !ClipboardHelperManager.CanCopyToClipboard())
			{
				return false;
			}
			ClipboardHelperManager.ClipboardFormatted = (callCopyFromCommand ? null : clipboardDataProvider);
			IPortableDataObject val = ClipboardManager.CreateClipboardDataObject();
			ClipboardManager.AssignOptions((BaseOptions)(object)base.OptionsClipboard);
			ClipboardManager.SetClipboardData(val);
			if (val.GetFormats().Count() != 0)
			{
				return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.SetDataObject(val);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetDataAwareClipboardData_DEBUG()
		{
			SetActualClipboardOptions(base.OptionsClipboard);
			IPortableDataObject clipboardData = ClipboardManager.CreateClipboardDataObject();
			ClipboardManager.AssignOptions((BaseOptions)(object)base.OptionsClipboard);
			ClipboardManager.SetClipboardData(clipboardData);
		}

		public virtual void OnPaste()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!((ITableView)this).AllowClipboardPaste)
				{
					return;
				}
				IClipboardSource val = ClipboardSourceFactory<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>.CreateSource(ClipboardPasteHelper);
				if (val != null)
				{
					IClipboardData data = val.GetData();
					if (data != null)
					{
						ClipboardPasteManager.Paste(data);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new PasteOperationException(innerException);
			}
		}

		private void OnPasteModeUpdate()
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OptionsClipboard.PasteMode = PasteMode;
		}

		internal bool? RaiseCellMerge(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle1, int rowHandle2, bool checkValues)
		{
			return ((ITableView)this).RaiseCellMerge(column, rowHandle1, rowHandle2, checkValues);
		}

		bool? ITableView.RaiseCellMerge(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle1, int rowHandle2, bool checkValues)
		{
			object cellValue = base.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandle1, column.FieldName);
			object cellValue2 = base.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandle2, column.FieldName);
			if (EventTargetTableView.CellMerge != null)
			{
				if (cellMergeEventArgs == null)
				{
					cellMergeEventArgs = new CellMergeEventArgs();
				}
				cellMergeEventArgs.SetArgs((GridColumn)column, rowHandle1, rowHandle2, cellValue, cellValue2);
				EventTargetTableView.CellMerge(this, cellMergeEventArgs);
				if (cellMergeEventArgs.Handled)
				{
					return cellMergeEventArgs.Merge;
				}
			}
			if (EventTargetTableView.CellMergeCommand != null)
			{
				if (cellMergeArgs == null)
				{
					cellMergeArgs = ArgsMutator.CreateCellMergeArgs(base.DataControl.GetRow, DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle);
				}
				ArgsMutator.SetCellMergeArgs(cellMergeArgs, column.FieldName, cellValue, cellValue2, rowHandle1, rowHandle2);
				EventTargetTableView.CellMergeCommand.Execute(cellMergeArgs);
				bool? merge = cellMergeArgs.Merge;
				ArgsMutator.ClearCellMergeArgs(cellMergeArgs);
				if (merge.HasValue)
				{
					return merge.Value;
				}
			}
			if (checkValues)
			{
				return object.Equals(cellValue, cellValue2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		private static void RegisterClassCommandBindings()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TableView);
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.BestFitColumn, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TableView)d).BestFitColumn(e);
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TableView)d).OnCanBestFitColumn(e);
			}));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.BestFitColumns, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TableView)d).BestFitColumns();
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TableView)d).OnCanBestFitColumns(e);
			}));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.AddNewRow, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TableView)((DataViewBase)d).MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView).AddNewRow(showUpdateRowButtons: true);
			}, delegate(object d, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				DataViewBase.CanExecuteWithCheckActualView(e, () => ((DataViewBase)d).MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.CanAddNewRow());
			}));
		}

		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown

				{
					((TableView)s).OnDeserializeCreateCollectionItem(e);
				};

		}

		private static void OnNewItemRowPositionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TableView)d).OnNewItemRowPositionChanged();
		}

		private static void OnExpandDetailButtonWidthChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TableView tableView = (TableView)d;
			if (tableView.DetailMargin.Left != tableView.ExpandDetailButtonWidth)
			{
				tableView.DetailMargin = new Thickness((double)e.NewValue, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private static void OnDetailMarginChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TableView tableView = (TableView)d;
			if (tableView.ExpandDetailButtonWidth != tableView.DetailMargin.Left)
			{
				tableView.ExpandDetailButtonWidth = tableView.DetailMargin.Left;
			}
			tableView.OnDetailMarginChanged();
		}

		private void OnDetailMarginChanged()
		{
			TableViewBehavior.UpdateActualExpandDetailButtonWidth();
			TableViewBehavior.UpdateActualDetailMargin();
			UpdateColumnsPositions();
		}

		internal override void UpdateActualFadeSelectionOnLostFocus(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TableViewBehavior.OnFadeSelectionOnLostFocusChanged(d, e);
		}

		private void OnGroupFooterRowStyleChanged()
		{
			FooterRowStyle = GroupFooterRowStyle;
		}

		private void OnGroupFooterSummaryContentStyleChanged()
		{
			FooterSummaryContentStyle = GroupFooterSummaryContentStyle;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanAdjustScrollbar()
		{
			if (base.CanAdjustScrollbar())
			{
				return !base.Grid.IsAsyncOperationInProgress;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public TableView()
			: this(null, null, null)
		{
		}

		public override int GetPrevRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top && ShowAutoFilterRow)
			{
				return -2147483645;
			}
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 2;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.IsFirst(rowHandle))
			{
				if (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
				{
					return -2147483647;
				}
				if (ShowAutoFilterRow)
				{
					return -2147483645;
				}
			}
			return base.GetPrevRowHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		public override int GetNextRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			switch (rowHandle)
			{
			case -2147483645:
				if (NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.Top)
				{
					return FirstVisibleIndexOnPage;
				}
				return -2147483647;
			case -2147483647:
				if (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
				{
					return FirstVisibleIndexOnPage;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.IsLast(rowHandle) && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return -2147483647;
			}
			return base.GetNextRowHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		internal override bool IsNewItemRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			return rowHandle == -2147483647;
		}

		private void CheckInfiniteAsyncSource()
		{
			if (IsInfiniteAsyncSource && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The InfiniteAsyncSource cannot display the New Item Row at the bottom of the view.Set the NewItemRowPosition property to Top instead.");
			}
		}

		private void CheckNewItemRowPositonAndPaging()
		{
			if (IsPagingMode && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The paged GridControl does not support the new item row in the bottom position.");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAllowPagingPropertyChanged()
		{
			CheckNewItemRowPositonAndPaging();
			base.OnAllowPagingPropertyChanged();
		}

		private void OnNewItemRowPositionChanged()
		{
			CheckNewItemRowPositonAndPaging();
			CheckInfiniteAsyncSource();
			UpdateNewItemRowPosition();
		}

		private void UpdateNewItemRowPosition()
		{
			ActualNewItemRowPosition = ((!IsPagingMode || NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.Bottom) ? NewItemRowPosition : NewItemRowPosition.None);
		}

		protected override bool IsFirstNewRow()
		{
			if (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
			{
				return base.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnLeftGroupAreaIndentChanged()
		{
			UpdateColumnsPositions();
			UpdateRowData(delegate(RowData data)
			{
				data.UpdateClientOffsetLevel();
			});
		}

		private void OnActualNewItemRowPositionChanged(NewItemRowPosition oldValue)
		{
			if (TableViewBehavior != null)
			{
				TableViewBehavior.UpdateNewItemRowPosition();
			}
			if (base.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647 && base.HasValidationError)
			{
				base.CurrentCellEditor.CancelEditInVisibleEditor();
			}
			if (base.DataControl != null)
			{
				base.DataControl.ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			}
			if (DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				DataProviderBase.InvalidateVisibleIndicesCache();
			}
			if (TableViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowVisible && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				NewItemRowData.UpdateData();
			}
			if (NewItemRowData is AdditionalRowData)
			{
				((AdditionalRowData)NewItemRowData).UpdateVisible();
			}
			if (ActualNewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.None && TableViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowFocused && base.Grid != null)
			{
				SetFocusedRowHandle(base.Grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex((oldValue != NewItemRowPosition.Top) ? (base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1) : 0));
			}
			if (base.DataPresenter != null && DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				base.DataPresenter.ClearInvisibleItems();
			}
			if ((oldValue == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom || ActualNewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom) && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				base.DataControl.RaiseVisibleRowCountChanged();
			}
			if (base.IsNewItemRowFocused && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				OnFocusedRowHandleChangedCore(int.MinValue);
			}
			InvalidateParentTree();
		}

		protected internal override bool IsNewItemRowInCurrentPageBounds()
		{
			return ActualNewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top;
		}

		public void AddNewRow(bool showUpdateRowButtons = false)
		{
			CheckInfiniteAsyncSource();
			if (base.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647)
			{
				CommitEditingLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					GridDataProvider.EndCurrentRowEdit();
				});
			}
			bool flag = ActualNewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.None;
			if (!flag && !IsClipboardPastingInProgress)
			{
				ActualNewItemRowPosition = ((IsInfiniteAsyncSource || base.AllowPaging) ? NewItemRowPosition.Top : NewItemRowPosition.Bottom);
			}
			GridDataProvider.AddNewRow();
			GridDataProvider.BeginCurrentRowEdit();
			if (!IsClipboardPastingInProgress)
			{
				RowData rowData = GetRowData(-2147483647);
				rowData.Do(delegate(RowData x)
				{
					x.UpdateData();
				});
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.None)
				{
					ScrollIntoView(-2147483647);
				}
				TableViewBehavior.InitNewRowEditing(showUpdateRowButtons);
			}
		}

		private void OnNewItemRowChanged()
		{
			if (base.IsNewItemRowFocused && !FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				base.DataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
				base.SelectionStrategy.OnFocusedRowDataChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void OnStartNewItemRow()
		{
			if (IsClipboardPastingInProgress)
			{
				RaiseEventInOriginationView(new InitNewRowEventArgs(InitNewRowEvent, this, -2147483647));
				return;
			}
			OnNewItemRowChanged();
			RaiseInitNewRowEvent();
			GetRowData(-2147483647).Do(delegate(RowData data)
			{
				data.UpdateData();
			});
		}

		private void RaiseInitNewRowEvent()
		{
			InitNewRowEventArgs e = new InitNewRowEventArgs(InitNewRowEvent, this, -2147483647);
			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);
			if (!e.Handled && EventTargetTableView.InitNewRowCommand != null)
			{
				EventTargetTableView.InitNewRowCommand.Execute(new InitNewRowArgs(base.DataControl.GetRow(-2147483647), DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(-2147483647)));
			}
		}

		internal void OnEndNewItemRow()
		{
			if (!IsClipboardPastingInProgress)
			{
				GetRowData(-2147483647)?.UpdateData();
				base.ErrorWatch.CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, -2147483647, -2147483647);
				OnNewItemRowChanged();
				ActualNewItemRowPosition = NewItemRowPosition;
			}
		}

		protected override SelectionStrategyBase CreateSelectionStrategy()
		{
			if (base.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				if (GetActualSelectionMode() == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.None)
				{
					return new CellMergeNoneSelectionStrategy(this);
				}
				return new CellMergeSelectionStrategy(this);
			}
			DataViewBase rootView = base.RootView;
			if (rootView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.None)
			{
				return new SelectionStrategyNavigationNone(this);
			}
			if (!IsMultiSelection)
			{
				return new TableViewSelectionStrategyNone(this);
			}
			if (IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible)
			{
				return new SelectionStrategyCheckBoxRow(this);
			}
			if (IsMultiRowSelection || rootView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
			{
				if (!ShowSelectionRectangle || GetActualSelectionMode() == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
				{
					return new SelectionStrategyRow(this);
				}
				return new SelectionStrategyRowRange(this);
			}
			if (base.ShowSelectionRectangle && base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.SelectionMode == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.Cell)
			{
				return new SelectionStrategyCellRectangle(this);
			}
			return new SelectionStrategyCell(this);
		}

		{

			if (footerRowElementByRowHandleCore == null)

			return LayoutHelper.FindElement(footerRowElementByRowHandleCore, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement element) => element is GroupFooterSummaryControl && ((GridGroupSummaryColumnData)((GroupFooterSummaryControl)element).DataContext).Column == column && element.Visibility == Visibility.Visible));
		}

		protected internal virtual void ShowNewItemRow(NewItemRowPosition? position)
		{
			NewItemRowPosition = ((!position.HasValue) ? NewItemRowPosition.Top : position.Value);
			if (NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.None && !base.IsNewItemRowFocused)
			{
				SetFocusedRowHandle(-2147483647);
				if (base.VisibleColumns.Count > 0 && base.DataControl != null)
				{
					base.DataControl.CurrentColumn = base.VisibleColumns[0];
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopySelectedCellsToClipboard()
		{
			if (base.DataControl.SelectionMode == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.Row || base.DataControl.SelectionMode == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.DataControl.CopySelectedItemsToClipboard();
			}
			else
			{
				base.ClipboardController.CopyCellsToClipboard(GetSelectedCells(includeDetails: true), isSelectedCells: true);
			}
		}

		void ITableView.RaiseRowDoubleClickEvent(ITableViewHitInfo hitInfo, System.Windows.Input.MouseButton changedButton)
		{
			RowDoubleClickEventArgs e = new RowDoubleClickEventArgs((GridViewHitInfoBase)hitInfo, changedButton, this)
			{
				RoutedEvent = RowDoubleClickEvent
			};
			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);
			if (!e.Handled && RowDoubleClickCommand != null)
			{
				DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.MouseButton? mouseButton = DataControlBase.ToMouseButton(changedButton);
				if (mouseButton.HasValue)
				{
					RowDoubleClickCommand.Execute(new RowClickArgs(DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(hitInfo.RowHandle), DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle), mouseButton.Value));
				}
			}
		}

		void ITableView.RaiseCellValueChangingInEditForm(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, object value, object oldValue, CellEditorData[] editors)
		{
			CellValueChangedInEditFormEventArgs e = new CellValueChangedInEditFormEventArgs(GridViewBase.CellValueChangingEvent, this, rowHandle, (GridColumn)column, value, oldValue, editors);
			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);
			if (!e.Handled && base.EventTargetGridView.CellValueChangingCommand != null)
			{
				base.EventTargetGridView.CellValueChangingCommand.Execute(new CellValueChangedInEditFormArgs(base.Grid.GetRow(rowHandle), column.FieldName, value, e.OldValue, editors));
			}
		}

		private CellEditorData[] CreateCellEditorData(CellEditorData[] cellEditors)
		{
			CellEditorData[] array = new CellEditorData[cellEditors.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < cellEditors.Length; i++)
			{
				string fieldName = cellEditors[i].FieldName;
				object cellValue = base.DataControl.GetCellValue(base.FocusedRowHandle, fieldName);
				bool readOnly = base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsColumnReadonly(fieldName, requireColumn: false);
				array[i] = new CellEditorData(cellValue, fieldName, readOnly);
			}
			return array;
		}

		IEditStartingEventArgs ITableView.RaiseRowEditStarting(int rowHandle, CellEditorData[] cellEditors)
		{
			RowEditStartingEventArgs e = new RowEditStartingEventArgs(RowEditStartingEvent, this, rowHandle, cellEditors);
			CellEditorData[] array = CreateCellEditorData(e.CellEditors);
			RowEditStartingArgs rowEditStartingArgs = new RowEditStartingArgs(base.DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle), DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle), rowHandle == -2147483647, array);
			RaiseRoutedEvent(e, RowEditStartingEvent, EventTargetTableView.RowEditStartingCommand, rowEditStartingArgs);
			if (EventTargetTableView.RowEditStartingCommand != null && !e.Handled)
			{
				e.Cancel = rowEditStartingArgs.Cancel;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					e.CellEditors[i].Value = array[i].Value;
					e.CellEditors[i].ReadOnly = array[i].ReadOnly;
				}
			}
			return e;
		}

		void ITableView.RaiseRowEditStarted(int rowHandle)

			RaiseRoutedEvent(eventArgs, RowEditStartedEvent, EventTargetTableView.RowEditStartedCommand, commandArgs);
		}
