		internal override void BindDetailContainerNextLevelItemsControl(ItemsControl itemsControl)
		{
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Expected O, but got Unknown
			itemsControl.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.DataControl.DetailDescriptor.DataControlDetailDescriptors")
			{
				RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.TemplatedParent)
			});
			itemsControl.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.AllowMasterDetail")
			{
				RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.TemplatedParent),
				Converter = (IValueConverter)new BoolToVisibilityConverter()
			});
		}

		internal override void ThrowNotSupportedInMasterDetailException()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedInMasterDetailException("The GridControl bound to the Virtual data source does not support master-detail data presentation. For a complete list of limitations, please see http://go.devexpress.com/XPF-MasterDetail-Limitations.aspx");
			}
			if (KeepViewportOnDataUpdate)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedInMasterDetailException("Keeping viewport on data update is not supported in Master-Detail mode. For a complete list of limitations, please see http://go.devexpress.com/XPF-MasterDetail-Limitations.aspx");
			}
			if (IsPagingMode)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedInMasterDetailException("The paged GridControl does not support master-detail data presentation. For a complete list of limitations, please see http://go.devexpress.com/XPF-MasterDetail-Limitations.aspx");
			}
		}

		internal override void ThrowNotSupportedInDetailException()
		{
			if (ShowAutoFilterRow)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedInMasterDetailException("The Auto-Filter Row feature is not supported by detail grids. For a complete list of limitations, please see http://go.devexpress.com/XPF-MasterDetail-Limitations.aspx");
			}
			if (base.AllowDragDrop)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedInMasterDetailException("Set the AllowDragDrop property only in the master grid to enable drag-and-drop functionality within detail grids.");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDataControlChanged(DataControlBase oldValue)
		{
			base.OnDataControlChanged(oldValue);
			oldValue.Do(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				RemoveCheckBoxSelectorColumn(dataControl);
			});
			base.DataControl.Do(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				AddCheckBoxSelectorColumn(dataControl);
				dataControl.ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			});
			UpdateIsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible();
		}

		private void AddCheckBoxSelectorColumn(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn.OwnerControl != dataControl)
			{
				base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn.OwnerControl = dataControl;
				dataControl.AddChild((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveCheckBoxSelectorColumn(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			dataControl.RemoveChild((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn);
			base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn.OwnerControl = null;
		}

		bool ITableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{

		}

		protected virtual GridColumn CreateCheckBoxSelectorColumn()
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = new GridColumn();
			gridColumn.FieldName = "DX$CheckboxSelectorColumn";
			gridColumn.Header = GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.CheckboxSelectorColumnCaption);
			gridColumn.Width = CheckBoxSelectorColumnWidth;
			gridColumn.FixedWidth = true;
			gridColumn.ShowInColumnChooser = false;
			gridColumn.AllowResizing = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridColumn.AllowSorting = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridColumn.AllowGrouping = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridColumn.AllowMoving = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridColumn.AllowColumnFiltering = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridColumn.AllowEditing = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			gridColumn.AllowConditionalFormattingMenu = false;
			gridColumn.AllowIncrementalSearch = false;
			gridColumn.FieldType = typeof(bool);
			gridColumn.VisibleIndex = 0;
			gridColumn.HeaderTemplate = CheckBoxSelectorColumnHeaderTemplate;
			gridColumn.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
			gridColumn.AllowPrinting = false;
			gridColumn.CellTemplateSelector = new CheckBoxColumnTemplateSelector();
			ControlTemplate controlTemplate = new ControlTemplate();
			controlTemplate.Seal();
			gridColumn.AutoFilterRowDisplayTemplate = controlTemplate;
			gridColumn.AutoFilterRowEditTemplate = controlTemplate;
			gridColumn.FilterPopupMode = FilterPopupMode.List;
			return gridColumn;
		}

		protected override int? CompareGroupedColumns(BaseColumn x, BaseColumn y)
		{
			if (!AllowPartialGroupingCore)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (x == base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn || y == base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridColumn gridColumn = x as GridColumn;
			GridColumn gridColumn2 = y as GridColumn;
			if (gridColumn == null || gridColumn2 == null || (!gridColumn.IsGrouped && !gridColumn2.IsGrouped))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!gridColumn.IsGrouped)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (!gridColumn2.IsGrouped)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(gridColumn.GroupIndex, gridColumn2.GroupIndex);
		}

		private void UpdateIsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible()
		{
			InvalidateVirtualDataSource();
			ResetSelectionStrategy();
			RebuildColumns();
			UpdateActualShowCheckBoxSelectorInGroupRow();
			if (IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible)
			{
				base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn.UpdateViewInfo();
				base.DataControl.Do(delegate(DataControlBase x)
				{
					x.CurrentColumn = base.CheckBoxSelectorColumn;
				});
			}
		}

		{

				return;

				}
			});
		}

		private void ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceChanged(bool generation)

				((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)

		protected internal override void OnDataChanged(bool rebuildVisibleColumns, bool updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly = false)
		{
			base.OnDataChanged(rebuildVisibleColumns, updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly);
			if (base.RootView != null && ((ITableView)base.RootView).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.GridLoaded && base.DataControl != null && !base.DataControl.DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
			}
			if (CompactPanel != null && CompactPanel.IsVisible)
			{
				CompactPanel.SetColumn((((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.SortInfo).Count > 0) ? Columns[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.SortInfo)[0].FieldName] : null);
			}
			OnGroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameChanged();
		}

		internal override void CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType changedType, int newHandle, int? oldRowHandle)
		{
			((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationChanged(changedType, newHandle, oldRowHandle);
			base.CurrentRowChanged(changedType, newHandle, oldRowHandle);
			OnListChanged(newHandle, changedType);
			if (!base.ActualShowCheckBoxInGroupRow || base.Grid == null || !GetIsGrouped())
			{
				return;
			}
			int parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(newHandle);
			while (base.Grid.IsValidRowHandle(parentRowHandle))
			{
				if (!(GetRowData(parentRowHandle) is GroupRowData groupRowData))
				{
					parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(parentRowHandle);
					continue;
				}
				groupRowData.UpdateIsChecked();
				parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(parentRowHandle);
			}
		}

		internal override bool NeedWatchRowChanged()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.NeedWatchRowChanged())
			{
				return EnumExtensions.HasAnyFlag((Enum)((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual, new Enum[4]
				{
					DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells,
					DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows,
					DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult,
					DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom
				});
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		internal override bool ShouldCalcBestFitGroupSummary(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (DataProviderBase != null && base.DataControl != null && column != null && base.VisibleColumns != null && DataProviderBase.GroupedColumnCount > 0 && GroupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.AlignByColumns && base.DataControl.GroupSummaryCore != null && base.DataControl.GroupSummaryCore.Count > 0)
			{
				return base.DataControl.GroupSummaryCore.Any((SummaryItemBase x) => base.VisibleColumns.Any((GridColumn col) => col.FieldName == x.ActualShowInColumn));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnFixedTopRowsChanged(IList oldValue)
		{
			SubscribeEvents(oldValue, FixedTopRows, () => ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)FixedTopRowsCollectionChangedHandler).Handler, () => ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, ListChangedEventArgs, ListChangedEventHandler>)(object)FixedTopRowsListChangedHandler).Handler);
			OnFixedTopBottomRowsChanged();
		}

		private void OnFixedBottomRowsChanged(IList oldValue)
		{
			SubscribeEvents(oldValue, FixedBottomRows, () => ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)FixedBottomRowsCollectionChangedHandler).Handler, () => ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, ListChangedEventArgs, ListChangedEventHandler>)(object)FixedBottomRowsListChangedHandler).Handler);
			OnFixedTopBottomRowsChanged();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents(IList oldValue, IList newValue, Func<NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler> getCollectionChangedHandler, Func<ListChangedEventHandler> getListChangedHandler)
		{
			if (oldValue is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)oldValue).CollectionChanged -= getCollectionChangedHandler();
			}
			else if (oldValue is IBindingList)
			{
				((IBindingList)oldValue).ListChanged -= getListChangedHandler();
			}
			if (newValue is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)newValue).CollectionChanged += getCollectionChangedHandler();
			}
			else if (newValue is IBindingList)
			{
				((IBindingList)newValue).ListChanged += getListChangedHandler();
			}
		}

		private void OnFixedTopBottomRowsChanged()
		{
			if (!fixedRowCollectionLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				UpdateFixedCollectionAndPerformUpdate(RefreshFixedRowsCache, forceRefresh: true);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshFixedRowsCache()
		{
			fixedRowsCache.Clear();
			UpdateFixedRows(FixedTopRows, FixedRowPosition.Top);
			if (NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				UpdateFixedRows(FixedBottomRows, FixedRowPosition.Bottom);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFixedRows(IList items, FixedRowPosition fixedRowPosition)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				fixedRowsCache[item] = fixedRowPosition;
			}
		}

		protected internal override FixedRowPosition GetFixedRowByItemCore(object item)
		{
			FixedRowPosition value = FixedRowPosition.None;
			if (!HasFixedRows || item == null)
			{
				return FixedRowPosition.None;
			}
			if (fixedRowsCache.TryGetValue(item, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return FixedRowPosition.None;
		}

		protected internal override bool RowIsFixedByVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (!HasFixedRows || visibleIndex < 0 || base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (FixedTopRows != null && FixedTopRows.Count > 0 && visibleIndex <= FixedTopRows.Count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (FixedBottomRows != null && base.DataControl != null && FixedBottomRows.Count > 0 && visibleIndex >= base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - FixedBottomRows.Count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public FixedRowPosition GetFixedRowPositionByItem(object item)
		{
			return GetFixedRowByItemCore(item);
		}

		public FixedRowPosition GetFixedRowPosition(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetFixedRowByItemCore(base.Grid.GetRow(rowHandle));
		}

		private void OnFixedRowsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, FixedRowPosition fixedRowPosition)
		{
			if (fixedRowCollectionLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateFixedCollectionAndPerformUpdate(delegate
			{
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					RefreshFixedRowsCache();
				}
				else
				{
					if (e.OldItems != null)
					{
						foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
						{
							fixedRowsCache.Remove(oldItem);
							base.Grid.RefreshRow(base.Grid.FindRow(oldItem));
						}
					}
					if (e.NewItems != null)
					{
						foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
						{
							fixedRowsCache[newItem] = fixedRowPosition;
							base.Grid.RefreshRow(base.Grid.FindRow(newItem));
						}
					}
				}
			}, e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
		}

		private void UpdateFixedCollectionAndPerformUpdate(Action action, bool forceRefresh)
		{
			bool hasFixedRows = HasFixedRows;
			action();
			if (HasFixedRows && DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The GridControl bound to the Virtual data source does not support the row fixing feature.");
			}
			if (IsPagingMode)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The paged GridControl does not support the row fixing feature.");
			}
			UpdateDataControllerForFixedRows(hasFixedRows != HasFixedRows, forceRefresh);
		}

		private void UpdateDataControllerForFixedRows(bool updateColumn, bool forceRefresh)
		{
			if (updateColumn)
			{
				base.DataControl.Do(delegate(DataControlBase x)
				{
					x.DataSourceChangingLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
					{
						x.OnColumnUnboundChangedPosponed();
					});
				});
			}
			else if (forceRefresh)
			{
				base.DataControl.Do(delegate(DataControlBase x)
				{
					x.RefreshData();
				});
			}
			base.Grid.Do(delegate(GridControl x)
			{
				x.ScheduleUpdateRows();
			});
			UpdateContentLayout();
			((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRangeChanged();
		}

		private void OnFixedRowsListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e, FixedRowPosition fixedRowPosition)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e2 = null;
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				e2 = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, ((IList)sender)[e.NewIndex], e.NewIndex);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.Reset:
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				e2 = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
				break;
			}
			OnFixedRowsCollectionChanged(this, e2, fixedRowPosition);
		}

		protected internal override int GetFixedRowIndex(int listSourceRowIndex)
		{
			FixedRowPosition fixedRowCore = GetFixedRowCore(listSourceRowIndex);
			object rowByListIndex = base.Grid.GetRowByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex);
			return fixedRowCore switch
			{
				FixedRowPosition.None => FixedTopRows.Return((IList x) => x.Count, () => 0), 
				FixedRowPosition.Top => FixedTopRows.IndexOf(rowByListIndex), 
				_ => base.Grid.DataProviderBase.ListSourceRowCount - FixedBottomRows.Count + FixedBottomRows.IndexOf(rowByListIndex), 
			};
		}

		private void CompactModeFilterItemsCore_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CompactPanel != null && CompactPanel.IsVisible)
			{
				CompactPanel.UpdateFilter();
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (oldItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
					{
						((INotifyPropertyChanged)oldItem).PropertyChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemPropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				if (newItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)newItem).PropertyChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemPropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)newItem).PropertyChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<TableView, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemPropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
				}
			}
		}

		public void FixRow(int rowHandle, FixedRowPosition fixedRowPosition)

		public void FixItem(object item, FixedRowPosition fixedRowPosition)
		{
			if (fixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Bottom && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateFixedCollectionAndPerformUpdate(delegate
			{
				fixedRowCollectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					FixedRowPosition fixedRowByItemCore = GetFixedRowByItemCore(item);
					if (fixedRowByItemCore != fixedRowPosition)
					{
						switch (fixedRowByItemCore)
						{
						case FixedRowPosition.Top:
							if (FixedTopRows != null)
							{
								FixedTopRows.Remove(item);
							}
							break;
						case FixedRowPosition.Bottom:
							if (FixedBottomRows != null)
							{
								FixedBottomRows.Remove(item);
							}
							break;
						}
						if (fixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Top)
						{
							if (FixedTopRows == null)
							{
								FixedTopRows = new List<object>();
							}
							FixedTopRows.Add(item);
						}
						else if (fixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
						{
							if (FixedBottomRows == null)
							{
								FixedBottomRows = new List<object>();
							}
							FixedBottomRows.Add(item);
						}
						if (fixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.None)
						{
							fixedRowsCache.Remove(item);
						}
						else
						{
							fixedRowsCache[item] = fixedRowPosition;
						}
						base.Grid.RefreshRow(base.Grid.FindRow(item));
					}
				});
			}, forceRefresh: false);
		}

		private void OnListChanged(int rowHandle, ListChangedType listChangedType)

			if (HasFixedRows && listChangedType == ListChangedType.ItemChanged && GetFixedRowPositionByItem(base.DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle)) != FixedRowPosition.None)

			}
		}

		internal override void GroupIsCheckedChanged(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			string fName = GroupRowCheckBoxFieldName;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fName))
			{
				return;
			}
			GridColumn gridColumn = Columns[fName];
			GridControl grid = base.DataControl as GridControl;
			if (gridColumn == null || grid == null || grid.DataProviderBase == null || !grid.IsGroupRowHandleCore(groupRowHandle))
			{
				return;
			}
			GroupRowData groupData = GetRowData(groupRowHandle) as GroupRowData;
			if (groupData == null || !groupData.IsChecked.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isChecked = groupData.IsChecked.Value;
			AutoExpandAllGroupsLockAction(delegate
			{
				base.DataControl.UpdateGroupRowCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					GroupRowInfo groupRowInfoByHandle = grid.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(groupRowHandle);
					List<GroupRowInfo> childrenGroups = grid.GetChildrenGroups(groupRowInfoByHandle);
					int num2 = childrenGroups?.Count ?? 0;
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						num2 = base.Grid.GetChildRowCount(groupRowHandle);
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
					{
						int childRowHandle = grid.GetChildRowHandle(groupRowHandle, i, groupRowInfoByHandle, childrenGroups);
						if (grid.IsGroupRowHandleCore(childRowHandle))
						{
							if (!(GetRowData(childRowHandle) is GroupRowData groupRowData2))
							{
								foreach (int childHandle in GetChildHandles(childRowHandle))
								{
									base.DataControl.SetCellValueCore(childHandle, fName, isChecked);
									RaiseRowUpdated(childHandle);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								groupRowData2.IsChecked = isChecked;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							base.DataControl.SetCellValueCore(childRowHandle, fName, isChecked);
							RaiseRowUpdated(childRowHandle);
						}
					}
				});
				int rowHandle = groupRowHandle;
				for (int num = 0; num < groupData.Level; num++)
				{
					int parentRowHandle = grid.GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle);
					if (!base.DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(parentRowHandle) || !(GetRowData(parentRowHandle) is GroupRowData groupRowData))
					{
						return;
					}
					groupRowData.UpdateIsChecked();
					rowHandle = parentRowHandle;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase showCheckBoxInHeaderColumn in ShowCheckBoxInHeaderColumns)
				{
					showCheckBoxInHeaderColumn.UpdateIsChecked();
				}
			});
		}

		private void RaiseRowUpdated(int rowHandle)

			RaiseRowUpdated(new RowEventArgs(GridViewBase.RowUpdatedEvent, this, rowHandle));
		}

		internal override bool CanShowEditor(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			bool flag = rowHandle != -2147483645;
			bool flag2 = ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && !base.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown;
			bool flag3 = ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.None && base.EditingRowHandle != rowHandle;
			if (flag && !base.RowEditStartingLocker && (flag2 || flag3))
			{
				if (((ITableView)this).RaiseRowEditStarting(rowHandle, new CellEditorData[0]).Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				base.RowEditStartingLocker = true;
			}
			return base.CanShowEditor(rowHandle, column);
		}

	internal class TableViewDataAwareExportHelper : IDataAwareExportHelper
	{
		private IDataAwareExportOptions options;

		private ExportTarget exportTarget;

		private TableView view;

		public TableViewDataAwareExportHelper(TableView view, ExportTarget exportTarget, IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.view = view;
			this.exportTarget = exportTarget;
			this.options = options;
		}

		public void Export(Stream stream)
		{
			ExportDataCoreWithLockedRowFetch(delegate(GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> exporter)
			{
				((BaseViewExcelExporter<IGridView<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>>)(object)exporter).Export(stream);
			});
		}

		public void Export(string filePath)
		{
			ExportDataCoreWithLockedRowFetch(delegate(GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> exporter)
			{
				((BaseViewExcelExporter<IGridView<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>>)(object)exporter).Export(filePath);
			});
		}

		private void ExportDataCoreWithLockedRowFetch(Action<GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>> exportAction)
		{
			GridDataProvider gridDataProvider = view.DataProviderBase as GridDataProvider;
			Action action = delegate
			{
				ExportDataCore(exportAction);
			};
			if (gridDataProvider == null)
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				gridDataProvider.DoActionWithLockedItemFetch(action);
			}
		}

		private void ExportDataCore(Action<GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>> exportAction)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)options.LayoutMode != 1 && (int)options.BandedLayoutMode != 2 && view.DataControl != null && view.DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				using (BandedGridViewExportHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> bandedGridViewExportHelper = CreateBandedGridViewExportHelper(view, exportTarget))
				{
					BandedGridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> obj = (BandedGridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)(view.AllowBandMultiRow ? ((object)new AdvBandedGridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>((IBandedGridView<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)bandedGridViewExportHelper, options)) : ((object)new BandedGridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>((IBandedGridView<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)bandedGridViewExportHelper, options)));
					exportAction((GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)(object)obj);
					return;
				}
			}
			using GridViewExportHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> gridViewExportHelper = new GridViewExportHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>(view, exportTarget);
			GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> obj2 = (GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)(((int)options.LayoutMode == 1) ? ((object)new TableGridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>((IGridView<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)gridViewExportHelper, options)) : ((object)new GridViewExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>((IGridView<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>)gridViewExportHelper, options)));
			exportAction(obj2);
		}

		protected virtual BandedGridViewExportHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper> CreateBandedGridViewExportHelper(TableView view, ExportTarget exportTarget)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!view.AllowBandMultiRow)
			{
				return new BandedGridViewExportHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>(view, exportTarget);
			}
			return new AdvBandedGridViewExportHelper<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>(view, exportTarget);
		}

	internal class ExportHelper<T> where T : ExportOptionsBase
	{
		private Action<DataViewBase, Stream> ExportToStream;

		private Action<DataViewBase, Stream, T> ExportToStreamWithOptions;

		private Action<DataViewBase, string> ExportToFile;

		private Action<DataViewBase, string, T> ExportToFileWithOptions;

		public DataViewBase View { get; private set; }

		public ExportTarget ExportTarget { get; private set; }

		protected ITableView TableView => View as ITableView;

		public ExportHelper(DataViewBase view, ExportTarget exportTarget, Action<DataViewBase, Stream> exportToStream, Action<DataViewBase, Stream, T> exportToStreamWithOptions, Action<DataViewBase, string> exportToFile, Action<DataViewBase, string, T> exportToFileWithOptions)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			View = view;
			ExportToStream = exportToStream;
			ExportToStreamWithOptions = exportToStreamWithOptions;
			ExportToFile = exportToFile;
			ExportToFileWithOptions = exportToFileWithOptions;
			ExportTarget = exportTarget;
		}

		public void Export(Stream stream)
		{
			Export(delegate
			{
				ExportToStream(View, stream);
			}, delegate
			{
				ExportData(stream, default(T));
			}, null);
		}

		public void Export(Stream stream, T options)
		{
			Action layoutExport = delegate
			{
				ExportToStreamWithOptions(View, stream, options);
			};
			Action dataExport = delegate
			{
				ExportData(stream, options);
			};
			object obj = options;
			Export(layoutExport, dataExport, (IDataAwareExportOptions)((obj is IDataAwareExportOptions) ? obj : null));
		}

		public void Export(string filePath)
		{
			Export(delegate
			{
				ExportToFile(View, filePath);
			}, delegate
			{
				ExportData(filePath, default(T));
			}, null);
		}

		public void Export(string filePath, T options)
		{
			Action layoutExport = delegate
			{
				ExportToFileWithOptions(View, filePath, options);
			};
			Action dataExport = delegate
			{
				ExportData(filePath, options);
			};
			object obj = options;
			Export(layoutExport, dataExport, (IDataAwareExportOptions)((obj is IDataAwareExportOptions) ? obj : null));
		}

		private static void Export(Action layoutExport, Action dataExport, IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			if (IsDataAwareExport(options))
			{
				dataExport();
			}
			else
			{
				layoutExport();
			}
		}

		private static bool IsDataAwareExport(IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExportType val = ExportSettings.DefaultExportType;
			if (options != null)
			{
				val = options.ExportType;
			}
			return (int)val == 1;
		}

		private IDataAwareExportHelper GetDataAwareExportHelper(ExportTarget exportTarget, IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return View.CreateDataAwareExportHelper(exportTarget, options);
		}

		internal IDataAwareExportOptions CreateExporterOptions(T printOptions)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IDataAwareExportOptions val = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.Create(ExportTarget, (ExportOptionsBase)(object)printOptions);
			ApplyViewOptions(val);
			if (printOptions != null)
			{
				ApplyPrintOptions(val, printOptions);
			}
			ApplyDefaults(val);
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyDefaults(IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			options.InitDefaults();
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyViewOptions(IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			options.AllowCellMerge = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.AllowCellMerge, GetAllowCellMerge());
			options.ShowTotalSummaries = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.ShowTotalSummaries, View.ShouldPrintTotalSummary || View.ShouldPrintFixedTotalSummary || View.ShouldPrintGroupSummaryInTotal);
			options.ShowColumnHeaders = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.ShowColumnHeaders, View.ShowColumnHeaders && TableView.PrintColumnHeaders);
			options.AllowHorzLines = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.AllowHorzLines, TableView.ShowHorizontalLines);
			options.AllowVertLines = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.AllowVertLines, TableView.ShowVerticalLines);
			options.RightToLeftDocument = (DefaultBoolean)(View.FlowDirection != System.Windows.FlowDirection.RightToLeft);
		}

		protected virtual bool GetAllowCellMerge()
		{
			if (View.DataControl.BandsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (object item in View.DataControl.BandsCore)
			{
				BandBase bandBase = item as BandBase;
				if ((bandBase == null || bandBase.Visible) && (bandBase == null || bandBase.ActualRows.Count > 1 || bandBase.BandsCore.Count > 0))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyPrintOptions(IDataAwareExportOptions target, T source)
		{
		}

		private void ExportData(string filePath, T options)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GetDataAwareExportHelper(ExportTarget, CreateExporterOptions(options)).Export(filePath);
		}

		private void ExportData(Stream stream, T options)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GetDataAwareExportHelper(ExportTarget, CreateExporterOptions(options)).Export(stream);
		}

		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			options.ShowBandHeaders = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.ShowBandHeaders, base.TableView.PrintBandHeaders);
			options.ShowColumnHeaders = DataAwareExportOptionsFactory.UpdateDefaultBoolean(options.ShowColumnHeaders, base.View.ShowColumnHeaders && base.TableView.PrintColumnHeaders);

		}

			target.CSVSeparator = ((TextExportOptionsBase)source).Separator;
		}

		protected override bool ExtendRowMarginControlHeight
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
				{
					return (int)ShowTreeIndentAsCellPart == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<TreeListView> CompactModeFilterItemsCollectionChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (compactModeFilterItemsChangedHandler == null)
				{
					compactModeFilterItemsChangedHandler = new CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<TreeListView>(this, (Action<TreeListView, object, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TreeListView e, object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
					{
						e.CompactModeFilterItemsCore_CollectionChanged(o, args);
					});
				}
				return compactModeFilterItemsChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<ICustomItem> CompactModeFilterItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (compactModeFilterItemsCore == null)
				{
					compactModeFilterItemsCore = new ObservableCollection<ICustomItem>();
					compactModeFilterItemsCore.CollectionChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<TreeListView, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemsCollectionChangedHandler).Handler;
				}
				return compactModeFilterItemsCore;
			}
		}

		internal override RowMarginControlDisplayMode RowMarginControlDisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TreeListViewBehavior.UseOptimizedTemplate)
				{
					return RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft;
				}
				if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null && AllowBandMultiRow)
				{
					return RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft;
				}
				if (!IsTreeColumnSpecified)
				{
					return RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft;
				}
				return RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl;
			}
		}

		internal TreeListViewClipboardHelper ClipboardHelperManager { get; private set; }

		private IClipboardManager<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper> ClipboardManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardManager == null)
				{
					clipboardManager = CreateClipboardManager();
				}
				return clipboardManager;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets an object that returns data for the clipboard in a variety of formats (plain text, plain unicode text, rich text, CSV, Biff8, HTML).")]
		[Category("Data")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public virtual TreeListClipboardDataProvider ClipboardDataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardDataProvider == null)
				{
					clipboardDataProvider = new TreeListClipboardDataProvider(ClipboardManager as ClipboardExportManagerBase<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>);
				}
				return clipboardDataProvider as TreeListClipboardDataProvider;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IClipboardPasteManager ClipboardPasteManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardPasteManagerCore == null)
				{
					clipboardPasteManagerCore = new DefaultClipboardPasteManager<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>(ClipboardPasteHelper);
				}
				object obj = clipboardPasteManagerCore;
				return (IClipboardPasteManager)((obj is IClipboardPasteManager) ? obj : null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual IClipboardPasteHelper<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper> ClipboardPasteHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipboardPasteHelperCore == null)
				{
					clipboardPasteHelperCore = new ClipboardPasteTreeListHelper<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>(this);
				}
				return clipboardPasteHelperCore as IClipboardPasteHelper<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>;
			}
		}

		bool ITableView.AllowClipboardPaste
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)PasteMode != 0)
				{
					return (int)PasteMode != 2;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		PasteMode ITableView.ActualPasteMode => PasteMode;

		protected override GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs ValidateRowDeletionCore(IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			TreeListValidateNodeDeletionEventArgs e = new TreeListValidateNodeDeletionEventArgs(ValidateNodeDeletionEvent, this, rowHandles);
			RaiseEvent(e);
			if (!e.Handled && ValidateNodeDeletionCommand != null)
			{
				ValidateNodeDeletionArgs validateNodeDeletionArgs = new ValidateNodeDeletionArgs(e.Rows, e.Rows.Select((object row) => GetPath(GetNodeByContent(row))).ToArray());
				ValidateNodeDeletionCommand.Execute(validateNodeDeletionArgs);
				e.Result = validateNodeDeletionArgs.Result;
				e.DisplayErrorMode = validateNodeDeletionArgs.DisplayErrorMode;
				e.ResultAsync = validateNodeDeletionArgs.ResultAsync;
			}
			return e;
		}

		internal void CancelChildNodesFetching(object commandParameter)
		{
			TreeListDataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle((int)commandParameter).CancellationTokenSource?.Cancel();
		}

		internal void RetryChildNodesFetching(object commandParameter)
		{
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = TreeListDataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle((int)commandParameter);
			if (nodeByRowHandle.ChildrenFetchingProgress == FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenFailed)
			{
				OnChangeNodeExpanded(commandParameter);
			}
			if (nodeByRowHandle.ChildrenFetchingProgress == FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenFailed)
			{
				TreeListDataProvider.DataHelper.NodeExpandingCollapsing((TreeListNodeBase)(object)nodeByRowHandle);
			}
		}

		internal override bool RaiseCustomDataUpdateFormatCondition(CustomDataUpdateFormatConditionEventArgsSource argsSource)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CustomDataUpdateFormatConditionEventArgs e = TreeListViewBehavior.CreateCustomDataUpdateFormatConditionArgs(argsSource);
			RaiseCustomDataUpdateFormatCondition(e);
			return e.Allow;
		}

		{
			this.CustomDataUpdateFormatCondition?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		internal override DragManagerBuilder CreateDragManagerBuilder()
		{
			DragManagerBuilder val = base.CreateDragManagerBuilder();
			val.CreateDataModifier = () => (IDataModifier)(object)new TreeListViewDataModifier(this);
			val.AllowInsideDrop = true;
			val.CreateDragDropInfoFactory = () => (IDragDropInfoFactory)(object)new TreeListViewDragDropInfoFactory(this);
			val.CreateAutoExpandService = () => (IAutoExpandService)(object)new TreeListExpandService(this);
			val.CreateDropTargetValidatorFactory = () => new DropTargetValidatorFactory((Func<DragInfo, IDropTargetValidator>)((DragInfo activeDragInfo) => (IDropTargetValidator)(object)new TreeListInternalDragValidator(this, activeDragInfo)), (Func<IDropTargetValidator>)(() => (IDropTargetValidator)(object)new GridExternalDragValidator<TreeListView>(this)));
			val.CreateLeftIndentCalculator = () => (FrameworkElement element) => (element as IFocusedRowBorderObject).Return((IFocusedRowBorderObject x) => x.LeftIndent, () => 0.0);
			return val;
		}

		internal virtual IDataControlModifier CreateDataModifier(DragDropTreeDerivationMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				DragDropTreeDerivationMode.SelfReference => new TreeListViewSelfReferenceDataModifier(this), 
				DragDropTreeDerivationMode.Hierarchical => new TreeListViewNodeDataModifier(this, new HierarchicalNodeSourceAdapter()), 
				DragDropTreeDerivationMode.Unbound => new TreeListViewNodeDataModifier(this, new UnboundNodeSourceAdapter()), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		internal override IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase> GetFormatConditions()
		{
			return (IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)FormatConditions;
		}

		internal override void UpdateRowValidationError(int rowHandle)
		{
			base.UpdateRowValidationError(rowHandle);
			TreeListViewBehavior.UpdateScrollBarAnnotations(rowHandle);
		}

		internal override IEnumerable<DataDependentEntityInfo> GetDataDependentEntityInfo()
		{
			return new TreeListViewDataDependentEntityProvider(this).GetDataDependentEntityInfo();
		}

		internal override bool AttachObservablePropertyScheme(ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] scheme)
		{
			if (base.AttachObservablePropertyScheme(scheme))
			{
				return true;
			}
			TreeListDataHelperBase val = TreeListDataProvider?.DataHelper;
			if (val != null)
			{
				foreach (BindingListAdapter item in val.GetBindingLists().OfType<BindingListAdapter>())
				{
					item.ObservablePropertyScheme = scheme;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateActualNodeFooterSummaryItemTemplateSelector()
		{
			DataControlOriginationElementHelper.UpdateActualTemplateSelector(this, base.OriginationView, ActualGroupFooterSummaryItemTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, NodeFooterSummaryItemTemplateSelector, NodeFooterSummaryItemTemplate);
		}

		private void UpdateActualNodeFooterRowTemplateSelector()
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ActualGroupFooterRowTemplateSelector = (DataTemplateSelector)new ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper(NodeFooterRowTemplateSelector, NodeFooterRowTemplate);
		}

		private void OnNodeFooterRowStyleChanged()
		{
			FooterRowStyle = NodeFooterRowStyle;
		}

		private void OnNodeFooterSummaryContentStyleChanged()
		{
			FooterSummaryContentStyle = NodeFooterSummaryContentStyle;
		}

		internal override void UpdateActualFadeSelectionOnLostFocus(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TableViewBehavior.OnFadeSelectionOnLostFocusChanged(d, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFocusedNodeChanged()
		{
			if (base.FocusedRowHandle != -2147483645 && !FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked && (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.None || base.FocusedRowHandle != -2147483647))
			{
				int rowHandle = ((FocusedNode != null) ? TreeListDataProvider.GetRowHandleByNode(FocusedNode) : int.MinValue);
				SetFocusedRowHandle(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected void OnRestoreFocusOnExpandChanged()
		{
			if (!RestoreFocusOnExpand)
			{
				ClearFocusedNodeSave();
			}
		}

		private void OnAutoPopulateServiceColumnsChanged()
		{
			if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.AutoGenerateColumns != AutoGenerateColumnsMode.None)
			{
				base.DataControl.PopulateColumns();
			}
		}

		private void OnCheckBoxFieldNameChanged()
		{

		}

		protected override SelectionStrategyBase CreateSelectionStrategy()
		{
			if (base.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.None)
			{
				return new SelectionStrategyNavigationNone(this);
			}
			if (!base.IsMultiSelection)
			{
				return new SelectionStrategyNone(this);
			}
			if (base.IsMultiRowSelection)
			{
				if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.SelectionMode == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.Row && base.ShowSelectionRectangle)
				{
					return new TreeListSelectionStrategyRowRange(this);
				}
				return new TreeListSelectionStrategyRow(this);
			}
			if (base.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
			{
				return new TreeListSelectionStrategyRow(this);
			}
			if (base.ShowSelectionRectangle && base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.SelectionMode == DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.MultiSelectMode.Cell)
			{
				return new TreeListSelectionStrageryCellRectangle(this);
			}
			return new TreeListSelectionStrageryCell(this);
		}

		private void CheckAllNodesCore(bool isChecked)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode value in TreeListDataProvider.FlattenNodes.Values)
			{
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)value).IsVisible)
				{
					value.SetNodeChecked(value, isChecked);
					RaiseNodeChanged(value, (NodeChangeType)6);
				}
			}
			UpdateRows();
		}

		public override int GetPrevRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top && ShowAutoFilterRow)
			{
				return -2147483645;
			}
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.IsFirst(rowHandle))
			{
				if (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
				{
					return -2147483647;
				}
				if (ShowAutoFilterRow)
				{
					return -2147483645;
				}
			}
			return base.GetPrevRowHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		public override int GetNextRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == -2147483645)
			{
				if (NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.Top)
				{
					return FirstVisibleIndexOnPage;
				}
				if (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
				{
					return -2147483647;
				}
			}
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
			{
				return FirstVisibleIndexOnPage;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.IsLast(rowHandle) && NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return -2147483647;
			}
			return base.GetNextRowHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		internal void UpdateFocusedNode()
		{
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = TreeListDataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(base.FocusedRowHandle);
			FocusedNode = nodeByRowHandle;
			if (!FocusedNodeSaveLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				ClearFocusedNodeSave();
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ChangeNodeExpanded(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!CommitEditingInternal())
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = TreeListDataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (nodeByRowHandle != null)
			{
				bool isExpanded = ((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByRowHandle).IsExpanded;
				((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByRowHandle).IsExpanded = !((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByRowHandle).IsExpanded;
				return isExpanded != ((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByRowHandle).IsExpanded;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool ChangeNodeCheckState(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!CommitEditingInternal())
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = TreeListDataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (nodeByRowHandle != null)
			{
				bool? isChecked = nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked;
				if (nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked == true)
				{
					if (AllowIndeterminateCheckState)
					{
						nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked = null;
					}
					else
					{
						nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked = false;
					}
				}
				else if (!nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked.HasValue)
				{
					nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked = false;
				}
				else
				{
					nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked = true;
				}
				return isChecked != nodeByRowHandle.IsChecked;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnFocusedRowHandleChangedCore(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			UpdateFocusedNode();
			base.OnFocusedRowHandleChangedCore(oldRowHandle);
			if (!((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)base.InplaceEditorOwner).EditorWasClosed || (RowDetailsVisibilityMode != RowDetailsVisibilityMode.Collapsed && (RowDetailsTemplate != null || RowDetailsTemplateSelector != null)))
			{
				UpdateCellMergingPanels();
			}
			((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow);
		}

		protected internal override void OnDataChanged(bool rebuildVisibleColumns, bool updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly = false)
		{
			if (TreeListDataProvider.IsUnboundMode)
			{
				TreeListDataProvider.RePopulateColumns();
			}
			base.OnDataChanged(rebuildVisibleColumns, updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly);
			ForceAutoExpandAllNodes();
			if (base.RootView != null && ((ITableView)base.RootView).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.GridLoaded && base.DataControl != null && !base.DataControl.DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				((ITableView)this).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
			}
			if (CompactPanel != null)
			{
				CompactPanel.SetColumn((((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.SortInfoCore).Count > 0) ? base.ColumnsCore[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.SortInfoCore)[0].FieldName] : null);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetNodeDisplayText(TreeListNode node, string fieldName, object value)
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnBase column = base.DataControl.ColumnsCore[fieldName];
			string text = GetDisplayObject(value, column).ToString();
			if (!HasCustomColumnDisplayText())
			{
				return text;
			}
			return RaiseCustomColumnDisplayText(node, column, value, text);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseNodeChanged(TreeListNode node, NodeChangeType changeType)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (nodeChanged != null)
			{
				nodeChanged(this, new TreeListNodeChangedEventArgs(node, changeType));
			}
			NodeChangedCommand?.Execute(new NodeChangedArgs(node.GetContent(), GetPath(node), DataControlBase.ToNodeChangeCommandType(changeType)));
		}

		protected virtual string RaiseCustomColumnDisplayText(TreeListNode node, ColumnBase column, object value, string displayText)
		{
			string result = displayText;
			if (HasCustomColumnDisplayTextSubscription())
			{
				if (customColumnDisplayTextEventArgs == null)
				{
					customColumnDisplayTextEventArgs = new TreeListCustomColumnDisplayTextEventArgs(node, column, value, displayText);
				}
				else
				{
					customColumnDisplayTextEventArgs.SetArgs(node, column, value, displayText);
				}
				customColumnDisplayText(this, customColumnDisplayTextEventArgs);
				customColumnDisplayTextEventArgs.Clear();
				result = customColumnDisplayTextEventArgs.DisplayText;
			}
			if (HasCustomColumnDisplayTextCommand())
			{
				ArgsMutator.SetNodeDisplayTextArgs(customColumnDisplayTextArgs, node, column.FieldName, node.GetContent(), value, displayText, showAsNullText: false);
				CustomColumnDisplayTextCommand.Execute(customColumnDisplayTextArgs);
				ArgsMutator.ClearNodeDisplayTextArgs(customColumnDisplayTextArgs);
				result = customColumnDisplayTextArgs.DisplayText;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual object RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(object p, string propName, object value, bool isGetAction)
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object result = value;
			if (customUnboundColumnData != null)
			{
				TreeListUnboundColumnDataEventArgs e = new TreeListUnboundColumnDataEventArgs(base.DataControl.ColumnsCore[propName], p as TreeListNode, value, isGetAction);
				customUnboundColumnData(this, e);
				result = e.Value;
			}
			if (CustomUnboundColumnDataCommand != null)
			{
				TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)p;
				UnboundColumnNodeArgs unboundColumnNodeArgs = new UnboundColumnNodeArgs(treeListNode.GetContent(), GetPath(treeListNode), propName, isGetAction, value);
				CustomUnboundColumnDataCommand.Execute(unboundColumnNodeArgs);
				result = unboundColumnNodeArgs.Value;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool? RaiseCustomNodeFilter(TreeListNode node)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool value = true;
			if (customNodeFilter != null)
			{
				if (nodeFilterEventArgs == null)
				{
					nodeFilterEventArgs = new TreeListNodeFilterEventArgs();
				}
				nodeFilterEventArgs.SetArgs(node);
				customNodeFilter(this, nodeFilterEventArgs);
				flag = nodeFilterEventArgs.Handled;
				value = nodeFilterEventArgs.Visible;
				nodeFilterEventArgs.Clear();
			}
			if (!flag && CustomNodeFilterCommand != null)
			{
				ArgsMutator.SetNodeFilterArgs(nodeFilterArgs, node, node.GetContent());
				CustomNodeFilterCommand.Execute(nodeFilterArgs);
				flag = nodeFilterArgs.Visible.HasValue;
				if (flag)
				{
					value = nodeFilterArgs.Visible.Value;
				}
				ArgsMutator.ClearNodeFilterArgs(nodeFilterArgs);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

				substituteFilter(this, e);

		protected internal override GridRowValidationEventArgs RaiseValidateRowCore(object source, object row, int rowHandle, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			TreeListNodeValidationEventArgs e = new TreeListNodeValidationEventArgs(row, rowHandle, this)
			{
				RoutedEvent = ValidateNodeEvent,
				CancellationToken = cancellationToken
			};
			try
			{
				RaiseEvent((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e);
				if (!((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled && ValidateNodeCommand != null)
				{
					DataViewBase.ExecuteValidateCommand(ValidateNodeCommand, new NodeValidationArgs(e.Row, GetPath(GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle)), e.RowHandle == -2147483647, e.CancellationToken, e.AllowAsyncResult), e);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				((ValidationEventArgs)e).SetError((object)ex.Message, (ErrorType)1);
				e.Exception = ex;
			}
			return e;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool RaiseValidateNode(int rowHandle, object value)
		{
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			TreeListNodeValidationEventArgs e;
			if (base.UpdateRowValidateEventArgs != null)
			{
				e = (TreeListNodeValidationEventArgs)base.UpdateRowValidateEventArgs;
				if (e.Exception != null)
				{
					base.DataControl.SetRowStateError(rowHandle, new GridRowValidationError(e.Exception.Message, e.Exception, ((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorType, rowHandle));
					throw e.Exception;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				e = (TreeListNodeValidationEventArgs)RaiseValidateRowCore(base.DataControl, value, rowHandle, CancellationToken.None);
				if (e.Exception != null)
				{
					base.DataControl.SetRowStateError(rowHandle, new GridRowValidationError(e.Exception.Message, e.Exception, ((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorType, rowHandle));
					throw e.Exception;
				}
			}
			if (((ValidationEventArgs)e).IsValid)
			{
				base.DataControl.SetRowStateError(rowHandle, null);
				return ((ValidationEventArgs)e).IsValid;
			}
			string text = ((((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorContent != null) ? ((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorContent.ToString() : string.Empty);
			base.DataControl.SetRowStateError(rowHandle, new GridRowValidationError(text, null, ((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorType, rowHandle));
			throw new WarningException(text);
		}

		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = obj;

				{
					return (RowMarginControl)dependencyObject;
				}
				dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject, false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal void CheckFocusedNodeOnCollapse(TreeListNode treeListNode)
		{
			if (FocusedNode == null || !((TreeListNodeBase)FocusedNode).IsDescendantOf((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (RestoreFocusOnExpand)
			{
				FocusedNodeSaveLocker.Lock();
				if (FocusedNodeSave == null)
				{
					FocusedNodeSave = FocusedNode;
				}
			}
			FocusedNode = treeListNode;
			FocusedNodeSaveLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected internal void CheckFocusedNodeOnExpand(TreeListNode treeListNode)
		{
			if (RestoreFocusOnExpand && FocusedNodeSave != null && FocusedNode != FocusedNodeSave && ((TreeListNodeBase)FocusedNodeSave).IsDescendantOf((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode))
			{
				FocusedNodeSaveLocker.Lock();
				FocusedNode = FindTopVisibleParentNode(FocusedNodeSave, treeListNode);
				FocusedNodeSaveLocker.Unlock();
				if (FocusedNode == FocusedNodeSave)
				{
					ClearFocusedNodeSave();
				}
			}
		}

		private TreeListNode FindTopVisibleParentNode(TreeListNode startNode, TreeListNode stopNode)
		{
			TreeListNode treeListNode = startNode;
			TreeListNode treeListNode2 = null;
			while (treeListNode != null && treeListNode != stopNode)
			{
				if (!((TreeListNodeBase)treeListNode.ParentNode).IsExpanded)
				{
					treeListNode2 = null;
				}
				else if (treeListNode2 == null)
				{
					treeListNode2 = treeListNode;
				}
				treeListNode = treeListNode.ParentNode;
			}
			return treeListNode2;
		}

		}

			}
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<TreeListNode> GetNodesFromRowHandles(IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			if (rowHandles == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<TreeListNode> list = new List<TreeListNode>();
			foreach (int rowHandle in rowHandles)
			{
				TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle);
				if (nodeByRowHandle != null)
				{
					list.Add(nodeByRowHandle);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<int> GetRowHandlesFromNodes(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (TreeListNode node in nodes)
			{
				int rowHandleByNode = TreeListDataProvider.GetRowHandleByNode(node);
				if (rowHandleByNode >= 0)
				{
					list.Add(rowHandleByNode);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsTreeColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null || RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return column.FieldName == TreeColumnFieldName;
		}

		protected internal virtual ColumnBase GetTreeColumn()
		{
			if (RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.ColumnsCore[TreeColumnFieldName];
		}

		protected internal override double CalcCellFocusedRectangleOffset()
		{
			if (RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && !ExtendRowMarginControlHeight && base.DataControl != null && IsTreeColumn(base.DataControl.CurrentColumn))
			{
				return (0.0 - RowIndent) * (double)(FocusedNode.Return((TreeListNode x) => x.ActualLevel, () => 0) + ServiceIndentsCount);
			}
			return base.CalcCellFocusedRectangleOffset();
		}

		protected internal override bool ShowGroupFooterSummaryItemVerticalSeparator(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!ExtendRowMarginControlHeight || !ShowVerticalLines)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = FixedLeftVisibleColumns.LastOrDefault();
			if (columnBase != null && column == columnBase)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int currentIndex = VisibleColumns.IndexOf(column);
			if (currentIndex > -1)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase2 = VisibleColumns.FirstOrDefault((ColumnBase c) => c.VisibleIndex == currentIndex + 1);
				if (columnBase2 != null && IsTreeColumn(columnBase2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ITableView.RaiseRowDoubleClickEvent(ITableViewHitInfo hitInfo, System.Windows.Input.MouseButton changedButton)
		{
			RowDoubleClickEventArgs e = new RowDoubleClickEventArgs((GridViewHitInfoBase)hitInfo, changedButton, this)
			{
				RoutedEvent = RowDoubleClickEvent
			};
			RaiseEvent(e);
			if (!e.Handled && RowDoubleClickCommand != null)
			{
				DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.MouseButton? mouseButton = DataControlBase.ToMouseButton(changedButton);
				if (mouseButton.HasValue)
				{
					TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = GetNodeByRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
					RowDoubleClickCommand.Execute(new NodeClickArgs(nodeByRowHandle.GetContent(), GetPath(nodeByRowHandle), mouseButton.Value));
				}
			}
		}

		private CellEditorData[] CreateCellEditorData(CellEditorData[] cellEditors)
		{
			CellEditorData[] array = new CellEditorData[cellEditors.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < cellEditors.Length; i++)
			{
				string fieldName = cellEditors[i].FieldName;
				object cellValue = base.DataControl.GetCellValue(base.FocusedRowHandle, fieldName);
				bool readOnly = base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsColumnReadonly(fieldName, requireColumn: false);
				array[i] = new CellEditorData(cellValue, fieldName, readOnly);
			}
			return array;
		}

		IEditStartingEventArgs ITableView.RaiseRowEditStarting(int rowHandle, CellEditorData[] cellEditors)
		{
			TreeListNodeEditStartingEventArgs e = new TreeListNodeEditStartingEventArgs(GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle), cellEditors);
			CellEditorData[] array = CreateCellEditorData(e.CellEditors);
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			NodeEditStartingArgs nodeEditStartingArgs = new NodeEditStartingArgs(nodeByRowHandle.GetContent(), GetPath(nodeByRowHandle), rowHandle == -2147483647, array);
			RaiseRoutedEvent(e, NodeEditStartingEvent, NodeEditStartingCommand, nodeEditStartingArgs);
			if (!e.Handled && NodeEditStartingCommand != null)
			{
				e.Cancel = nodeEditStartingArgs.Cancel;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					e.CellEditors[i].Value = array[i].Value;
					e.CellEditors[i].ReadOnly = array[i].ReadOnly;
				}
			}
			return e;
		}

		void ITableView.RaiseRowEditStarted(int rowHandle)
		{
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			TreeListNodeEditStartedEventArgs eventArgs = new TreeListNodeEditStartedEventArgs(nodeByRowHandle);
			NodeEditStartedArgs commandArgs = new NodeEditStartedArgs(nodeByRowHandle.GetContent(), GetPath(nodeByRowHandle));
			RaiseRoutedEvent(eventArgs, NodeEditStartedEvent, NodeEditStartedCommand, commandArgs);
		}

			RaiseRoutedEvent(eventArgs, NodeEditFinishedEvent, NodeEditFinishedCommand, commandArgs);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseNodeCanceled(TreeListNode node)
		{
			TreeListNodeEventArgs e = new TreeListNodeEventArgs(node)
			{
				RoutedEvent = NodeCanceledEvent
			};
			RaiseEvent(e);
			bool handled = e.Handled;
			if (!handled)
			{
				ICommand<NodeCanceledArgs> nodeCanceledCommand = NodeCanceledCommand;
				if (nodeCanceledCommand != null)
				{
					NodeCanceledArgs nodeCanceledArgs = new NodeCanceledArgs(node.GetContent(), GetPath(node));
					nodeCanceledCommand.Execute(nodeCanceledArgs);
					handled = nodeCanceledArgs.Handled;
				}
			}
			if (!handled && base.DataControl != null && !base.DataControl.CanCancelRow(e.Row) && !CancelRowEditLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				CancelRowChangesCore(useCache: true);
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal override bool SetDataAwareClipboardData(IClipboardFormatted clipboardDataProvider, bool callCopyFromCommand)
		{
			SetActualClipboardOptions(base.OptionsClipboard);
			if (ClipboardManager != null && ClipboardHelperManager != null && !ClipboardHelperManager.CanCopyToClipboard())
			{
				return false;
			}
			ClipboardHelperManager.ClipboardFormatted = (callCopyFromCommand ? null : clipboardDataProvider);
			IPortableDataObject val = ClipboardManager.CreateClipboardDataObject();
			ClipboardHelperManager.ResetNodesProvider();
			ClipboardManager.AssignOptions((BaseOptions)(object)base.OptionsClipboard);
			ClipboardManager.SetClipboardData(val);
			if (val.GetFormats().Count() != 0)
			{
				return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.SetDataObject(val);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void OnPaste()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!((ITableView)this).AllowClipboardPaste)
				{
					return;
				}
				IClipboardSource val = ClipboardSourceFactory<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>.CreateSource(ClipboardPasteHelper);
				if (val != null)
				{
					IClipboardData data = val.GetData();
					if (data != null)
					{
						ClipboardPasteManager.Paste(data);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new PasteOperationException(innerException);
			}
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<TreeListNode> GetNodesToIndentOutdent()
		{
			if (!IsMultiSelection)
			{
				yield return TreeListDataProvider.CurrentNode;
			}
			TreeListNode[] selectedNodes = TreeListDataProvider.TreeListSelection.GetSelectedNodes();
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedNodes.Length; i++)
			{
				yield return selectedNodes[i];
			}
		}

		protected Dictionary<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> GetIndentOudentParentNodes(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes)
		{
			Dictionary<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> dictionary = new Dictionary<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>>();
			foreach (TreeListNode item in from n in nodes
				where n != null
				orderby ((TreeListNodeBase)n).RowHandle
				select n)
			{
				TreeListNode parentNodeInternal = item.GetParentNodeInternal();
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(parentNodeInternal))
				{
					dictionary.Add(parentNodeInternal, new Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>());
				}
				dictionary[parentNodeInternal].Add(item, null);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public virtual void IndentNode(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				IndentNodes(new TreeListNode[1] { node });
			}
		}

		public virtual void IndentNodes(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes)
		{
			DoIndentOutdentNodesAction(nodes, delegate(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> sourceNodes)
			{
				IndentNodesCore(GetIndentOudentParentNodes(sourceNodes));
			});
		}

		internal bool CanExecuteIndentNodes(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Dictionary<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> indentOudentParentNodes = GetIndentOudentParentNodes(nodes);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> item in indentOudentParentNodes)
			{
				int i = 0;
				TreeListNode treeListNode = null;
				for (; i < ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)item.Key.Nodes).Count; i++)
				{
					TreeListNode treeListNode2 = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)item.Key.Nodes)[i];
					if (!item.Value.ContainsKey(treeListNode2))
					{
						treeListNode = treeListNode2;
					}
					else if (treeListNode != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void IndentNodesCore(Dictionary<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> parentNodes)
		{
			TreeListViewDataModifier treeListViewDataModifier = new TreeListViewDataModifier(this);
			treeListViewDataModifier.Selector.IsImmediate = false;
			treeListViewDataModifier.AllowSortInfoSync = false;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> parentNode in parentNodes)
			{
				int num = 0;
				TreeListNode treeListNode = null;
				int num2 = parentNode.Value.Count;
				List<TreeListNode> list = new List<TreeListNode>((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)parentNode.Key.Nodes);
				List<TreeListNode> list2 = new List<TreeListNode>();
				while (num2 > 0 && num < list.Count)
				{
					TreeListNode treeListNode2 = list[num];
					if (!parentNode.Value.ContainsKey(treeListNode2))
					{
						if (list2.Count > 0)
						{
							MoveNodesToParent(treeListViewDataModifier, list2, treeListNode);
							num2 -= list2.Count;
							list2.Clear();
						}
						treeListNode = treeListNode2;
					}
					else if (treeListNode != null)
					{
						list2.Add(treeListNode2);
					}
					num++;
				}
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					MoveNodesToParent(treeListViewDataModifier, list2, treeListNode);
					list2.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		private void MoveNodesToParent(TreeListViewDataModifier modifier, List<TreeListNode> nodes, TreeListNode parentNode)
		{
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RowPointer[] rowPointers = ((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)nodes).Select((Func<TreeListNode, RowPointer>)((TreeListNode n) => new RowPointer(((TreeListNodeBase)n).RowHandle))).ToArray();
			if (((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode).HasChildren)
			{
				modifier.Move(rowPointers, new DropPointer(new RowPointer(((TreeListNodeBase)((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)parentNode.Nodes).Last()).RowHandle), (DropPosition)2));
			}
			else
			{
				modifier.Move(rowPointers, new DropPointer(new RowPointer(((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode).RowHandle), (DropPosition)3));
			}
			parentNode.IsExpandButtonVisible = (DefaultBoolean)0;
			((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode).IsExpanded = true;
			TreeListDataProvider.NodesState.UpdateNodeExpandState(parentNode, ((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode).IsExpanded);
		}

		internal bool CanExecuteOutdentNodes(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (TreeListNode node in nodes)
			{
				if (node != null && node.Level > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void OutdentNodesCore(Dictionary<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> parentNodes)
		{
			TreeListViewDataModifier treeListViewDataModifier = new TreeListViewDataModifier(this);
			treeListViewDataModifier.Selector.IsImmediate = false;
			treeListViewDataModifier.AllowSortInfoSync = false;
			TreeListNode treeListNode = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TreeListNode, Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>> parentNode in parentNodes)
			{
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode.Key).RowHandle == int.MinValue || parentNode.Key == treeListNode)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int i = 0;
				List<TreeListNode> list = new List<TreeListNode>((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)parentNode.Key.Nodes);
				List<TreeListNode> list2 = new List<TreeListNode>();
				List<TreeListNode> list3 = new List<TreeListNode>();
				TreeListNode treeListNode2 = null;
				TreeListNode treeListNode3 = null;
				for (; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					TreeListNode treeListNode4 = list[i];
					if (!parentNode.Value.ContainsKey(treeListNode4))
					{
						if (list2.Count > 0 && treeListNode2 == null)
						{
							InsertNodesToParent(treeListViewDataModifier, list2, (treeListNode3 != null) ? treeListNode3 : parentNode.Key);
							treeListNode2 = list2.Last();
							treeListNode2.SetParentNodeInternal(parentNode.Key.GetParentNodeInternal());
							treeListNode3 = treeListNode2;
							list3.Add(treeListNode4);
							list2.Clear();
						}
						else if (treeListNode2 != null)
						{
							list3.Add(treeListNode4);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (list3.Count > 0 && treeListNode2 != null)
						{
							MoveNodesToParent(treeListViewDataModifier, list3, treeListNode2);
							list3.Clear();
						}
						list2.Add(treeListNode4);
						treeListNode2 = null;
					}
				}
				if (list3.Count > 0 && treeListNode2 != null)
				{
					MoveNodesToParent(treeListViewDataModifier, list3, treeListNode2);
					list3.Clear();
				}
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					InsertNodesToParent(treeListViewDataModifier, list2, (treeListNode3 != null) ? treeListNode3 : parentNode.Key);
					list2.Clear();
				}
				treeListNode = parentNode.Value.Keys.Last();
			}
		}

		private void InsertNodesToParent(TreeListViewDataModifier modifier, List<TreeListNode> nodes, TreeListNode parentNode)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RowPointer[] rowPointers = ((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)nodes).Select((Func<TreeListNode, RowPointer>)((TreeListNode node) => new RowPointer(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle))).ToArray();
			modifier.Move(rowPointers, new DropPointer(new RowPointer(((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode).RowHandle), (DropPosition)2));
		}

		private void DoIndentOutdentNodesAction(IEnumerable<TreeListNode> nodes, Action<IEnumerable<TreeListNode>> action)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListDataProvider.ForceAllowReloadNodesOnEndUpdate = true;
			TreeListDataProvider.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				action(nodes);
			}
			finally
			{
				TreeListDataProvider.EndUpdate();
				TreeListDataProvider.ForceAllowReloadNodesOnEndUpdate = false;
			}
		}

		public TreeListNode AddNewNode(TreeListNode parentNode, bool showUpdateRowButtons = false)
		{
			if (NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.None)
			{
				if (TreeListViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowEditing)
				{
					return GetNodeByRowHandle(-2147483647);
				}
				TreeListNode treeListNode = AddNewNodeCore(parentNode ?? TreeListDataProvider.RootNode);
				if (treeListNode != null && IsNewItemRowHandle(base.FocusedRowHandle))
				{
					TreeListViewBehavior.InitNewRowEditing(showUpdateRowButtons);
				}
				return treeListNode;
			}
			TreeListNode treeListNode2 = AddNewNodeCore(parentNode);
			if (treeListNode2 != null)
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode2, (NodeChangeType)0, (string)null, false, false);
			}
			return treeListNode2;
		}

		protected internal virtual TreeListNode AddNewNodeCore(TreeListNode parentNode)
		{
			if (base.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647 && !TreeListDataProvider.EndCurrentRowEdit())
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (parentNode == null)
			{
				parentNode = TreeListDataProvider.RootNode;
			}
			if (parentNode.Controller == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).AddNewNode((TreeListNodeBase)(object)parentNode) as TreeListNode;
		}

		protected internal virtual object RaiseAddingNewNode(TreeListNode parentNode)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (this.AddingNewNode != null)
			{
				TreeListAddingNewEventArgs e = new TreeListAddingNewEventArgs((parentNode == null || parentNode.IsRootNode) ? null : parentNode);
				this.AddingNewNode(this, e);
				result = e.NewObject;
			}
			if (AddingNewNodeCommand != null)
			{
				NewNodeArgs newNodeArgs = new NewNodeArgs(parentNode.GetContent(), GetPath(parentNode));
				AddingNewNodeCommand.Execute(newNodeArgs);
				result = newNodeArgs.Item;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void OnAddNewNode(object param)
		{
			AddNewNode(GetParentNodeFromParameter(param), showUpdateRowButtons: true);
		}

		internal bool CanAddNewNode(object param)
		{
			if (base.IsEditing || base.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown || base.DoingLongTermOperation)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TreeListNode parentNodeFromParameter = GetParentNodeFromParameter(param);
			if (parentNodeFromParameter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TreeListDataProvider.DataHelper.AllowNew((TreeListNodeBase)(object)parentNodeFromParameter);
		}

		private TreeListNode GetParentNodeFromParameter(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return TreeListDataProvider.RootNode;
			}
			if (obj is TreeListNode)
			{
				return (TreeListNode)obj;
			}
			if (obj is int)
			{
				return GetNodeByRowHandle((int)obj);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseInitNewNode(TreeListNode node)
		{
			TreeListNodeEventArgs e = new TreeListNodeEventArgs(node)
			{
				RoutedEvent = InitNewNodeEvent
			};
			RaiseEvent(e);
			if (!e.Handled && InitNewNodeCommand != null)
			{
				InitNewNodeCommand.Execute(new InitNewNodeArgs(node.GetContent(), GetPath(node)));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseInvalidNodeException(TreeListNode node, ControllerRowExceptionEventArgs controllerArgs)
		{
			TreeListInvalidNodeExceptionEventArgs e = new TreeListInvalidNodeExceptionEventArgs(node, controllerArgs.Exception.Message, GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ErrorWindowTitle), controllerArgs.Exception, ExceptionMode.DisplayError)
			{
				RoutedEvent = InvalidNodeExceptionEvent
			};
			RaiseEvent(e);
			if (!e.Handled && InvalidNodeExceptionCommand != null)
			{
				InvalidNodeExceptionArgs invalidNodeExceptionArgs = new InvalidNodeExceptionArgs(node.GetContent(), ((ControllerRowEventArgs)controllerArgs).RowHandle == -2147483647, GetPath(node), controllerArgs.Exception, controllerArgs.Exception.Message, GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.ErrorWindowTitle), DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode.DisplayError);
				InvalidNodeExceptionCommand.Execute(invalidNodeExceptionArgs);
				e.ErrorText = invalidNodeExceptionArgs.ErrorText;
				e.WindowCaption = invalidNodeExceptionArgs.WindowCaption;
				e.ExceptionMode = DataViewBase.ToGridExceptionMode(invalidNodeExceptionArgs.ExceptionMode);
			}
			HandleInvalidRowExceptionEventArgs(controllerArgs, e);
		}

		protected override bool IsFirstNewRow()
		{

				return base.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647;
			}
			return false;
