		protected void OnNewItemRowPositionChanged(NewItemRowPosition oldValue)
		{
			((TreeListNodesInfo)TreeListDataProvider.NodesInfo).SetDirty();
			if (TreeListViewBehavior != null)
			{
				TreeListViewBehavior.UpdateNewItemRowPosition();
			}
			if (base.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647 && base.HasValidationError)
			{
				base.CurrentCellEditor.CancelEditInVisibleEditor();
			}
			if (TreeListViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowVisible && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				NewItemRowData.UpdateData();
			}
			if (NewItemRowData is AdditionalRowData)
			{
				((AdditionalRowData)NewItemRowData).UpdateVisible();
			}
			if (NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.None && TreeListViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowFocused && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				SetFocusedRowHandle(base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore((oldValue != NewItemRowPosition.Top) ? (base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1) : 0));
			}
			if (base.DataPresenter != null && DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				base.DataPresenter.ClearInvisibleItems();
			}
			if ((oldValue == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom || NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom) && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				base.DataControl.RaiseVisibleRowCountChanged();
			}
			if (base.IsNewItemRowFocused && base.DataControl != null)
			{
				OnFocusedRowHandleChangedCore(int.MinValue);
			}
			UpdateRows();
		}

		{
			if (base.IsNewItemRowFocused)

				GetRowData(-2147483647).Do(delegate(RowData data)

					data.UpdateData();
				});
				if (!FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					base.DataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
					base.SelectionStrategy.OnFocusedRowDataChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CompactModeFilterItemsCore_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CompactPanel != null)
			{
				CompactPanel.UpdateFilter();
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (oldItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
					{
						((INotifyPropertyChanged)oldItem).PropertyChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<TreeListView, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemPropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				if (newItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)newItem).PropertyChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<TreeListView, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemPropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)newItem).PropertyChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<TreeListView, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemPropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
				}
			}
		}

		void ITableView.UnsubscribeFilterItemsSource(IEnumerable filterItems)
		{
			if (filterItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object filterItem in filterItems)
			{
				if (filterItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)filterItem).PropertyChanged -= CompactModeFilterItem_PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool NeedWatchRowChanged()
		{
			if (TreeListDataProvider.IsUpdateLocked && !((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).IsLockedDeletingInProgress)

		bool? ITableView.RaiseCellMerge(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle1, int rowHandle2, bool checkValues)
		{
			object cellValue = base.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandle1, column.FieldName);
			object cellValue2 = base.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandle2, column.FieldName);
			TreeListView treeListView = ((base.OriginationView == null) ? this : (base.OriginationView as TreeListView));
			if (treeListView != null && treeListView.CellMerge != null)
			{
				if (cellMergeEventArgs == null)
				{
					cellMergeEventArgs = new TreeListCellMergeEventArgs();
				}
				cellMergeEventArgs.SetArgs(column, rowHandle1, rowHandle2, cellValue, cellValue2);
				treeListView.CellMerge(this, cellMergeEventArgs);
				if (cellMergeEventArgs.Handled)
				{
					return cellMergeEventArgs.Merge;
				}
			}
			if (checkValues)
			{
				return object.Equals(cellValue, cellValue2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateSelectionSummary()
		{
			if (TreeListDataProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TreeListDataProvider.TotalSummaryCore != null && base.DataControl.TotalSummaryCore.FirstOrDefault((SummaryItemBase x) => GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows) != null)
			{
				List<TreeListSummaryItem> list = ((IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem>)((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).TotalSummary).Where((TreeListSummaryItem x) => GetActualCalculationMode((SummaryItemBase)((SummaryItemBase)x).Tag) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows).ToList();
				if (list.Count != 0)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).UpdateTotalSummary((IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem>)list);
					UpdateColumnsTotalSummary();
				}
			}
			if (TreeListDataProvider.HasNodeSummary && TreeListDataProvider.GroupSummaryCore.FirstOrDefault((SummaryItemBase x) => GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows) != null)
			{
				List<TreeListSummaryItem> list2 = ((IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem>)((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).NodeSummary).Where((TreeListSummaryItem x) => GetActualCalculationMode((SummaryItemBase)((SummaryItemBase)x).Tag) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows).ToList();
				if (list2.Count != 0)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).UpdateNodeSummary((IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem>)list2);
					UpdateNodeFooterSummary();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSummaryCalculationModeChanged()
		{
			if (TreeListDataProvider != null && TreeListDataProvider.Controller != null)
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).UpdateNodeSummary();
				UpdateNodeFooterSummary();
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)TreeListDataProvider.Controller).UpdateTotalSummary();
				UpdateColumnsTotalSummary();
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanShowEditor(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			bool flag = rowHandle != -2147483645;
			bool flag2 = ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && !base.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown;
			bool flag3 = ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.None && base.EditingRowHandle != rowHandle;
			if (flag && !base.RowEditStartingLocker && (flag2 || flag3))
			{
				if (((ITableView)this).RaiseRowEditStarting(rowHandle, new CellEditorData[0]).Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				base.RowEditStartingLocker = true;
			}
			return base.CanShowEditor(rowHandle, column);
		}

	internal class TreeListViewDataAwareExportHelper : IDataAwareExportHelper
	{
		private IDataAwareExportOptions options;

		private ExportTarget exportTarget;

		private TreeListView view;

		public TreeListViewDataAwareExportHelper(TreeListView view, ExportTarget exportTarget, IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.view = view;
			this.exportTarget = exportTarget;
			this.options = options;
		}

		public void Export(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (view.DataControl != null && view.DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				((BaseViewExcelExporter<IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>>)(object)CreateBandedTreeListExporter(view, exportTarget, options)).Export(stream);
			}
			else
			{
				((BaseViewExcelExporter<IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>>)(object)new TreeListExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>((IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>)new TreeListViewExportHelper(view, exportTarget), options)).Export(stream);
			}
		}

		public void Export(string filePath)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)options.BandedLayoutMode != 2 && view.DataControl != null && view.DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				((BaseViewExcelExporter<IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>>)(object)CreateBandedTreeListExporter(view, exportTarget, options)).Export(filePath);
			}
			else
			{
				((BaseViewExcelExporter<IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>>)(object)new TreeListExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>((IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>)new TreeListViewExportHelper(view, exportTarget), options)).Export(filePath);
			}
		}

		protected virtual BandedTreeListExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper> CreateBandedTreeListExporter(TreeListView view, ExportTarget exportTarget, IDataAwareExportOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (view.AllowBandMultiRow)
			{
				return (BandedTreeListExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>)(object)new AdvBandedTreeListExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>((IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>)new AdvBandedTreeListViewExportHelper(view, exportTarget), options);
			}
			return new BandedTreeListExcelExporter<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>((IGridView<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>)new BandedTreeListViewExportHelper(view, exportTarget), options);
		}
	}
	public class RowPropertyValueConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public IValueConverter InnerConverter { get; set; }

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			object obj = ConvertCore(value, parameter);
			if (InnerConverter != null)
			{
				obj = InnerConverter.Convert(obj, targetType, parameter, culture);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private object ConvertCore(object value, object parameter)
		{
			if (!(value is RowTypeDescriptorBase rowTypeDescriptorBase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rowTypeDescriptorBase.GetValue(parameter as string);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowDownArrowProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static DragIndicatorPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(DragIndicatorPanel);
			DropPlaceOrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropPlaceOrientation", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DragIndicatorPanel)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			}));
			CanGroupMergeStateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CanGroupMergeState", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DragIndicatorPanel)d).UpdateLayoutCore();
			}));
			VisibilityGroupMergeStateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VisibilityGroupMergeState", typeof(Visibility), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Visibility.Collapsed, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DragIndicatorPanel)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			}));
			IsGroupPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsGroupPanel", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DragIndicatorPanel)d).UpdateIsDownOffset();
			}));
			IsDownOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDownOffset", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DragIndicatorPanel)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			}));
			ShowDownArrowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowDownArrow", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DragIndicatorPanel)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			}));
		}

		private void UpdateLayoutCore()
		{
			VisibilityGroupMergeState = ((!CanGroupMergeState) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			UpdateIsDownOffset();
		}

		private void UpdateIsDownOffset()
		{
			IsDownOffset = IsGroupPanel && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[0];
			uIElement.Measure(GetCorrectSize(availableSize));
			return GetCorrectSize(uIElement.DesiredSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[0];
			System.Windows.Size correctSize = GetCorrectSize(finalSize);
			uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, correctSize.Width, correctSize.Height));
			base.RenderTransform = GetTransform();
			return GetCorrectSize(correctSize);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetCorrectSize(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (DropPlaceOrientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(size.Height, size.Width);
			}
			return size;
		}

		private Transform GetTransform()
		{
			if (DropPlaceOrientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return GetTransformVertical();
			}
			return GetTransformHorizontal();
		}

		private Transform GetTransformVertical()
		{
			return new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = -90.0,
				CenterX = 0.5,
				CenterY = 0.5
			};
		}

		private Transform GetTransformHorizontal()
		{
			return new MatrixTransform();
		}
	}

		private static void OnIsDetailButtonVisibleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is GridDetailExpandButtonContainer gridDetailExpandButtonContainer)
			{
				gridDetailExpandButtonContainer.OnIsDetailButtonVisibleChangedCore();
			}
		}

		public static bool GetIsDetailButtonVisible(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (d == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsDetailButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsDetailButtonVisible(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d?.SetValue(IsDetailButtonVisibleProperty, value);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			button = GetTemplateChild("PART_ExpandButton") as GridDetailExpandButton;
			Border border = GetTemplateChild("detailRightLine") as Border;
			if (ShowRightBorder && border != null)
			{
				border.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			UpdateBindings();
			UpdateExpandButtonVisibilityBinding();
			UpdateMargin();
		}

		private void OnIsDetailButtonVisibleChangedCore()
		{
			if (button != null)
			{
				button.IsHitTestVisible = GetIsDetailButtonVisible(this);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateExpandButtonVisibilityBinding()
		{
			if (RowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				if (IsDetailButtonVisibleBindingContainer != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsDetailButtonVisibleProperty, IsDetailButtonVisibleBindingContainer.Binding);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(IsDetailButtonVisibleProperty);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetIsDetailButtonVisible(this, value: false);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateWidthBinding(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (oldRowHandle == -2147483647 && RowHandle != oldRowHandle)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View." + DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidthProperty)));
			}
			if (RowHandle == -2147483647 && RowHandle != oldRowHandle)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View." + DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(TableView.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidthProperty)));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBindings()
		{
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsDetailButtonVisibleBindingContainerProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View." + DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(TableView.IsDetailButtonVisibleBindingContainerProperty)));
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View." + ((RowHandle == -2147483647) ? DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(TableView.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidthProperty) : DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidthProperty))));
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ShowHorizontalLinesProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View." + DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(TableView.ShowHorizontalLinesProperty)));
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, RowHandleProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("RowHandle.Value"));
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(IsDetailButtonVisibleBindingContainerProperty);
				ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				ClearValue(ShowHorizontalLinesProperty);
				ClearValue(RowHandleProperty);
			}
		}

		void INotifyVisibilityChanged.OnVisibilityChanged()
		{
			UpdateBindings();
		}

		private void UpdateMargin()
		{
			if (ShowHorizontalLines && (RowPosition == RowPosition.Bottom || RowPosition == RowPosition.Single) && !IsMasterRowExpanded)
			{
				base.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Margin = new Thickness(0.0);
			}
		}

		private void OnRowHandleChanged(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			UpdateExpandButtonVisibilityBinding();
			UpdateWidthBinding(oldRowHandle);
		}
	}
	public class FixRowControl : System.Windows.Controls.Button
	{
		private RowData rowData;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FixedRowPositionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowButtonProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsButtonVisibleProperty;

		public RowData RowData
		{
			get
			{
				return rowData;
			}
			set
			{
				if (rowData != value)
				{
					if (rowData != null)
					{
						UnsubscribeMouseEvents(rowData.RowElement);
					}
					rowData = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private TableView View => RowData.View as TableView;

		public FixedRowPosition FixedRowPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return (FixedRowPosition)GetValue(FixedRowPositionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FixedRowPositionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowButton
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowButtonProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowButtonProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsButtonVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsButtonVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static FixRowControl()
		{
			FixedRowPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FixedRowPosition", typeof(FixedRowPosition), typeof(FixRowControl), new PropertyMetadata(FixedRowPosition.None));
			ShowButtonProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowButton", typeof(bool), typeof(FixRowControl), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsButtonVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(FixRowControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FixRowControl>();
		}

		public FixRowControl()
		{
			DataControlPopupMenu.SetGridMenuType(this, GridMenuType.FixRowControl);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (View.IsDesignTime)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (View.ActualAllowRowFixing)
			{
			case RowFixingPosition.Both:
				((BarPopupBase)View.DataControlMenu).ShowPopup((UIElement)this);
				break;
			case RowFixingPosition.Top:
			case RowFixingPosition.Bottom:
				if (View.GetFixedRowPositionByItem(RowData.Row) != FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					View.FixItem(RowData.Row, FixedRowPosition.None);
				}
				else
				{
					View.FixItem(RowData.Row, (View.ActualAllowRowFixing == RowFixingPosition.Top) ? FixedRowPosition.Top : FixedRowPosition.Bottom);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateShowFixRowButtonVisibility()
		{
			UnsubscribeMouseEvents(this);
			UnsubscribeMouseEvents(RowData.RowElement);
			if (View.ShowFixRowButton == ShowFixRowButton.Hover)
			{
				SubscribeMouseEvents(this);
			}
			else if (View.ShowFixRowButton == ShowFixRowButton.RowHover)
			{
				SubscribeMouseEvents(RowData.RowElement);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateShowButton(View.ShowFixRowButton == ShowFixRowButton.Always);
			}
		}

		private void ElementMouseEnter(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateShowButton(visible: true);
		}

		private void ElementMouseLeave(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateShowButton(visible: false);
		}

		private void SubscribeMouseEvents(UIElement element)
		{
			element.MouseEnter += ElementMouseEnter;
			element.MouseLeave += ElementMouseLeave;
			UpdateShowButton(element.IsMouseOver);
		}

		private void UpdateShowButton(bool visible)
		{
			ShowButton = visible && View.ActualAllowRowFixing != RowFixingPosition.None;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeMouseEvents(UIElement element)
		{
			element.MouseEnter -= ElementMouseEnter;
			element.MouseLeave -= ElementMouseLeave;
		}
	}
	public class GridToggleStateButton : ToggleStateButton, IDataObjectReset
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowRowBreakProperty;

		private bool isReady;

		public bool ShowRowBreak
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ShowRowBreakProperty);

			}
		}

		public Storyboard Expand { get; set; }

		public Storyboard Collapse { get; set; }

		static GridToggleStateButton()
		{
			ShowRowBreakProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowRowBreak", typeof(bool), typeof(GridToggleStateButton), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridToggleStateButton>();
		}

		public GridToggleStateButton()
		{
			((ToggleButton)this).Checked += GridToggleStateButton_Checked;
			((ToggleButton)this).Unchecked += GridToggleStateButton_Unchecked;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeIsChecked(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void GridToggleStateButton_Unchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Collapse != null)
			{
				isReady = true;
				Collapse.Begin();
			}
		}

		private void GridToggleStateButton_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Expand != null)
			{
				isReady = true;
				Expand.Begin();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			if (((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("root") is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				Expand = frameworkElement.Resources["expand"] as Storyboard;
				Collapse = frameworkElement.Resources["collapse"] as Storyboard;
				InitializeAnimation((((ToggleButton)this).IsChecked ?? false) ? Expand : Collapse);
				isReady = false;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeAnimation(Storyboard storyboard)
		{
			if (storyboard != null)
			{
				storyboard.Begin();
				storyboard.SkipToFill();
			}
		}

		void IDataObjectReset.Reset()
		{
			if (isReady)
			{
				if (Expand != null)
				{
					Expand.SkipToFill();
				}
				if (Collapse != null)
				{
					Collapse.SkipToFill();
				}
			}
		}
	}

				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ShowVerticalSeparatorProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ShowVerticalSeparatorPropertyKey, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public GroupRowData GroupRowData => (GroupRowData)base.RowDataBase;

		public double ActualWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return actualWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != actualWidth && !IgnoreActualWidth)
				{
					actualWidth = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("ActualWidth");
				}
			}
		}

		public double ActualWidthFooter
		{
			get
			{
				return actualWidthFooter;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != actualWidthFooter)
				{
					actualWidthFooter = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("ActualWidthFooter");
				}
			}
		}

		public InlineCollectionInfo SummaryTextInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryTextInfo;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (value != summaryTextInfo)
				{
					summaryTextInfo = value;
					OnInlineInfoChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IgnoreActualWidth { get; set; }

		static GridGroupSummaryColumnData()
		{
			HasRightSiblingPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("HasRightSibling", typeof(bool), typeof(GridGroupSummaryColumnData), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			HasRightSiblingProperty = HasRightSiblingPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			HasSummaryPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("HasSummary", typeof(bool), typeof(GridGroupSummaryColumnData), new PropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridGroupSummaryColumnData)(object)d).OnHasSummaryChanged();
			}));
			HasSummaryProperty = HasSummaryPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowVerticalSeparatorPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ShowVerticalSeparator", typeof(bool), typeof(GridGroupSummaryColumnData), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			ShowVerticalSeparatorProperty = ShowVerticalSeparatorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public GridGroupSummaryColumnData(GroupRowData rowData)
			: base(rowData)
		{
		}

		internal void SetColumnSummaryClient(IGroupRowColumnSummaryClient client)
		{
			columnSummaryClient = client;
		}

		internal void UpdateSummaryClientFocusState()
		{
			if (columnSummaryClient != null)
			{
				columnSummaryClient.UpdateFocusState();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSummaryIsReady()
		{
			if (columnSummaryClient != null)
			{
				columnSummaryClient.UpdateIsReady();
			}
		}

		private void OnHasSummaryChanged()
		{
			if (columnSummaryClient != null)
			{
				columnSummaryClient.UpdateHasSummary();
			}
			OnActualHeaderWidthChange();
		}

		protected override void OnValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			((EditableDataObject)this).OnValueChanged(oldValue);
			UpdateClientSummaryValue();
			OnActualHeaderWidthChange();
		}

		private void UpdateClientSummaryValue()
		{
			if (columnSummaryClient != null)
			{
				columnSummaryClient.UpdateSummaryValue();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnColumnChanged(ColumnBase newValue)
		{
			base.OnColumnChanged(newValue);
			OnActualHeaderWidthChange();
		}

		public void OnActualHeaderWidthChange(bool checkFirstViewPortColumn = true)
		{
			if (base.Column != null)
			{
				if (base.View is GridViewBase { IsGroupRowOptimized: not false })
				{
					double num = (ActualWidth = CalcWidth(base.Column, base.Column.ActualHeaderWidth, GroupRowData, checkFirstViewPortColumn));
					ActualWidthFooter = num;
				}
				else
				{
					ActualWidth = base.Column.ActualHeaderWidth;
					ActualWidthFooter = Math.Max(0.0, CalcWidth(base.Column, base.Column.ActualHeaderWidth, GroupRowData, checkFirstViewPortColumn));
				}
				if (columnSummaryClient != null)
				{
					columnSummaryClient.UpdateWidth();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnInlineInfoChanged()
		{
			((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("SummaryTextInfo");
			string text = ((SummaryTextInfo != null) ? SummaryTextInfo.TextSource : null);
			if (object.Equals(text, ((EditableDataObject)this).Value))
			{
				UpdateClientSummaryValue();
			}
			else
			{
				((EditableDataObject)this).Value = text;
			}
		}

		private static double CalcWidth(ColumnBase column, double headerWidth, GroupRowData rowData, bool checkFirstViewPortColumn)
		{
			double treeColumnOffset = rowData.GetTreeColumnOffset(column);
			if (column != null && headerWidth > 0.0 && rowData != null && (GroupSummaryLayoutCalculator.IsFirstColumn(column, rowData) || (checkFirstViewPortColumn && GroupSummaryLayoutCalculator.IsFirstVisibleColumn(column, rowData, checkFirstBand: true))))
			{
				return Math.Max(0.0, headerWidth - rowData.Offset - treeColumnOffset - ((ITableView)rowData.View).TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.ActualLeftDataAreaIndent);
			}
			return headerWidth - treeColumnOffset;
		}

		internal static GridGroupSummaryColumnData CreateBestFitData(GroupRowData rowData)
		{
			return new GridGroupSummaryColumnData(rowData)
			{
				IgnoreActualWidth = true
			};
		}
	}

	public class CardDataPresenter : DataPresenterManipulation
	{
		private CardView CardView => (CardView)base.View;

		private CardsHierarchyPanel CardsPanel => base.Panel as CardsHierarchyPanel;

		protected override int GenerateItemsOffset
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (CardsPanel == null)
				{
					return base.ScrollOffset;
				}
				return CardsPanel.GenerateItemsOffset;
			}
		}

		protected override double Extent
		{
			get
			{
				if (CardsPanel == null)
				{
					return base.Extent;
				}
				return CardsPanel.Extent;
			}
		}

		protected override DataControlScrollMode VerticalScrollModeCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (CardView.Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return DataControlScrollMode.Pixel;
				}
				if (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
				{
					return DataControlScrollMode.Item;
				}
				return DataControlScrollMode.RowPixel;
			}
		}

		protected override DataControlScrollMode HorizontalScrollModeCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (CardView.Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					return DataControlScrollMode.Pixel;
				}
				if (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
				{
					return DataControlScrollMode.Item;
				}
				return DataControlScrollMode.RowPixel;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDefineScrollInfoChangedCore()
		{
			base.OnDefineScrollInfoChangedCore();
			if (CardsPanel != null)
			{
				CardsPanel.OnDefineScrollInfoChanged();
			}
		}

		public CardDataPresenter()
		{
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptor(this, new DataAreaTableViewHitTestAcceptor());
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateContent()
		{
			return new CardsContainer
			{
				DataPresenter = this
			};
		}

		protected override void UpdateViewCore()
		{
			if (base.Content != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)base.Content).DataContext = base.View;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size GetMeasureSize(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override bool OnLayoutUpdatedCore()
		{
			if (CardsPanel.Return((CardsHierarchyPanel x) => x.OnLayoutUpdated(), () => true))
			{
				return base.OnLayoutUpdatedCore();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo CreateScrollInfo()
		{
			VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo virtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo = base.CreateScrollInfo();
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(virtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo, VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo.OrientationProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(CardView.OrientationProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = base.View
			});
			return virtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size GetFirstElementSize()
		{
			if (CardsPanel == null || CardsPanel.RowsInfo == null || CardsPanel.RowsInfo.Count == 0)
			{
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			return CardsPanel.RowsInfo[0].RenderSize;
		}

		protected override double DefineDelta(System.Windows.Point translation, System.Windows.Size firstElementSize)
		{
			if (base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
			{
				return base.SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(translation) / base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(firstElementSize);
			}
			if (CardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Columns)
			{
				return translation.X / firstElementSize.Width * 3.0;
			}
			return translation.Y / firstElementSize.Height * 3.0;
		}

		protected override double GetTranslation(double delta, System.Windows.Size firstElementSize)
		{
			if (CardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Columns)
			{
				if (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
				{
					return delta * firstElementSize.Width / 3.0;
				}
				return delta;
			}
			if (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
			{
				return delta * firstElementSize.Height / 3.0;
			}
			return delta;
		}

		protected override void ChangeOffset(DataViewBehavior behavior, double delta, System.Windows.Point translation)
		{
			behavior.ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy((CardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Columns) ? (0.0 - delta) : (0.0 - translation.X));
			behavior.ChangeVerticalOffsetBy((CardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Columns) ? (0.0 - translation.Y) : (0.0 - delta));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point GetAccumulator(double translation)
		{
			if (CardView.CardLayout != CardLayout.Columns)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(0.0, translation);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(translation, 0.0);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheelDown()
		{
			if (!CanScrollDown())
			{
				base.ScrollInfo.MouseWheelRight();
			}
			else
			{
				base.ScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheelUp()
		{
			if (!CanScrollUp())
			{
				base.ScrollInfo.MouseWheelLeft();
			}
			else
			{
				base.ScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp();
			}
		}

		protected internal bool CanScrollDown()
		{
			return base.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Extent > base.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Viewport;
		}

		protected internal bool CanScrollUp()
		{
			return base.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Extent > base.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Viewport;
		}
	}
	public class GridDataIterator : DataIteratorBase
	{
		private GridViewBase View => (GridViewBase)viewBase;

		private GridControl Grid => View.Grid;

		public GridDataIterator(GridViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool GetHasTop(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			if (!base.GetHasTop(nodeContainer))
			{
				return GetHasTopCore(nodeContainer);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetHasTopCore(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			return GetActualRowLevel(nodeContainer.StartScrollIndex - 1) < nodeContainer.GroupLevel;
		}

		protected internal override bool GetHasBottomCore(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int lastVisibleIndex)
		{
			return GetActualRowLevel(lastVisibleIndex + 1) < nodeContainer.GroupLevel;
		}

		private int GetActualRowLevel(int scrollIndex)
		{
			object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = Grid.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex);
			if (!(visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey))
			{
				return Grid.GetRowLevelByVisibleIndex((int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex);
			}
			return ((GroupSummaryRowKey)visibleIndexByScrollIndex).Level;
		}

		private GroupNode GetGroupNode(int rowHandle)
		{
			DataRowNode value = null;
			if (Grid.View.Nodes.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				return value as GroupNode;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override RowNode GetRowNodeForCurrentLevel(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int index, int startVisibleIndex, bool isFixedNode, ref bool shouldBreak)
		{
			object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = Grid.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(index + nodeContainer.treeBuilder.PageOffset);
			int num = nodeContainer.StartScrollIndex + nodeContainer.FixedTopRowsCount;
			if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey groupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				if (nodeContainer.IsGroupRowsContainer && nodeContainer.GroupLevel == groupSummaryRowKey.Level && (!nodeContainer.treeBuilder.View.AllowFixedGroupsCore || num != index))
				{
					RowNode summaryNodeForCurrentNode = GetSummaryNodeForCurrentNode(nodeContainer, groupSummaryRowKey.RowHandle, index);
					if (summaryNodeForCurrentNode != null)
					{
						GroupNode groupNode = GetGroupNode(groupSummaryRowKey.RowHandle.Value);
						if (groupNode != null)
						{
							groupNode.summaryNode = summaryNodeForCurrentNode;
						}
						return summaryNodeForCurrentNode;
					}
				}
				else if (groupSummaryRowKey.Level < nodeContainer.GroupLevel)
				{
					shouldBreak = true;
				}
				else if (num == index)
				{
					return GetGroupRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, num + (nodeContainer.treeBuilder.View.AllowFixedGroupsCore ? 1 : 0), nodeContainer.treeBuilder.View.AllowFixedGroupsCore, DataIteratorBase.CreateValuesContainer(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, nodeContainer.parentVisibleIndex), (index == nodeContainer.StartScrollIndex) ? nodeContainer.DetailStartScrollIndex : 0);
				}
				return null;
			}
			DataControllerValuesContainer dataControllerValuesContainer = DataIteratorBase.CreateValuesContainer(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, (int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex);
			if (dataControllerValuesContainer.RowHandle.Value == int.MinValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dataControllerValuesContainer.RowHandle.Value == -2147483646)
			{
				return new LoadingRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, dataControllerValuesContainer);
			}
			if (dataControllerValuesContainer.RowHandle.Value < 0 && !nodeContainer.IsGroupRowsContainer && dataControllerValuesContainer.RowHandle.Value != -2147483647 && dataControllerValuesContainer.RowHandle.Value != -2147483646)
			{
				shouldBreak = true;
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = ((!isFixedNode) ? View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetActualRowLevel(dataControllerValuesContainer.RowHandle.Value, dataControllerValuesContainer.Level) : 0);
			if (num2 > nodeContainer.GroupLevel && index == num)
			{
				return GetGroupRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, num + (View.AllowFixedGroupsCore ? 1 : 0), View.AllowFixedGroupsCore, DataIteratorBase.CreateValuesContainer(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, nodeContainer.parentVisibleIndex), startVisibleIndex);
			}
			if (nodeContainer.GroupLevel == num2)
			{
				return CreateRowNode(nodeContainer, dataControllerValuesContainer, startVisibleIndex, index);
			}
			if (num2 < nodeContainer.GroupLevel)
			{
				shouldBreak = true;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RowNode CreateRowNode(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, DataControllerValuesContainer info, int startVisibleIndex, int globalIndex)
		{
			return DataTreeBuilder.CreateRowElement(nodeContainer.IsGroupRowsContainer && View.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(info.RowHandle.Value), (Func<RowNode>)(() => GetGroupRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, globalIndex + 1, isGroupRowVisible: true, info, startVisibleIndex)), (Func<RowNode>)(() => GetRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, startVisibleIndex, info)));
		}

		protected internal override bool IsGroupRowsContainer(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			return nodeContainer.GroupLevel < View.Grid.ActualLevelCount;
		}

		private GroupNode GetGroupRowNode(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int startVisibleIndex, bool isGroupRowVisible, DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues, int detailStartVisibleIndex)
		{
			GroupNode groupNode = (GroupNode)treeBuilder.GetRowNode((DataControllerValuesContainer values) => new GroupNode(treeBuilder, values), controllerValues);
			groupNode.summaryNode = null;
			groupNode.NodesContainer.DetailStartScrollIndex = detailStartVisibleIndex;
			groupNode.UpdateExpandInfo(startVisibleIndex, isGroupRowVisible);
			return groupNode;
		}

		protected internal override RowNode GetSummaryNodeForCurrentNode(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, RowHandle rowHandle, int index)
		{
			if (View.ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				GroupSummaryRowNode groupSummaryRowNode = (GroupSummaryRowNode)nodeContainer.treeBuilder.GetGroupSummaryRowNode(rowHandle.Value);
				if (groupSummaryRowNode != null)
				{
					return groupSummaryRowNode;
				}
				return CreateGroupSummaryNode(nodeContainer, rowHandle);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual RowNode CreateGroupSummaryNode(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, RowHandle rowHandle)
		{
			GroupSummaryRowNode groupSummaryRowNode = new GroupSummaryRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, DataIteratorBase.CreateValuesContainer(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, rowHandle));
			nodeContainer.treeBuilder.AddGroupSummaryRowNode(rowHandle.Value, groupSummaryRowNode);
			return groupSummaryRowNode;
		}

		protected internal override int GetRowParentIndex(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int visibleIndex, int level)
		{
			object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = Grid.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(visibleIndex);
			if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex == null)
			{
				return base.GetRowParentIndex(nodeContainer, visibleIndex, level);
			}
			if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey groupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				return base.GetRowParentIndex(nodeContainer, nodeContainer.treeBuilder.View.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(groupSummaryRowKey.RowHandle.Value), level);
			}
			return base.GetRowParentIndex(nodeContainer, (int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex, level);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataPresenterManipulation : GridDataPresenterBase
	{
		internal System.Windows.Point accumulator;

		internal bool deltaOccured;

		internal bool isHeaderPanel;

		internal void StartManipulation()
		{
			deltaOccured = false;
		}

		internal virtual void DoManipulation(System.Windows.Point translation, System.Windows.Point totalTranslation)
		{
			if (base.View == null)
			{
				deltaOccured = false;
				return;
			}
			if (!deltaOccured && Math.Abs(totalTranslation.X) < base.View.TouchScrollThreshold && Math.Abs(totalTranslation.Y) < base.View.TouchScrollThreshold)
			{
				PointHelper.Offset(ref accumulator, translation.X, translation.Y);
				return;
			}
			deltaOccured = true;
			base.View.ScrollAnimationLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				DataViewBehavior viewBehavior = base.View.ViewBehavior;
				if (viewBehavior == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Size firstElementSize = GetFirstElementSize();
				if (!(System.Windows.Size.Empty == firstElementSize) && !(firstElementSize.Height < 1.0))
				{
					PointHelper.Offset(ref translation, accumulator.X, accumulator.Y);
					double num = DefineDelta(translation, firstElementSize);
					if (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
					{
						double num2 = Math.Truncate(num);
						ChangeOffset(viewBehavior, num2, translation);
						accumulator = GetAccumulator(GetTranslation(num - num2, firstElementSize));
					}
					else
					{
						ChangeOffset(viewBehavior, num, translation);
						accumulator = GetAccumulator(0.0);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.View.ScrollAnimationLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeOffset(DataViewBehavior behavior, double delta, System.Windows.Point translation)
		{
			behavior.ChangeVerticalOffsetBy(0.0 - delta);
			base.View.TouchHorizontalOffset(0.0 - translation.X);
		}

		protected virtual double DefineDelta(System.Windows.Point translation, System.Windows.Size firstElementSize)
		{
			return translation.Y / firstElementSize.Height;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size GetFirstElementSize()
		{
			FrameworkElement firstVisibleRow = GetFirstVisibleRow();
			if (firstVisibleRow == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(firstVisibleRow.ActualWidth, firstVisibleRow.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected virtual double GetTranslation(double delta, System.Windows.Size firstElementSize)
		{
			return delta * firstElementSize.Height;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Point GetAccumulator(double translation)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(0.0, translation);
		}

		public DataPresenterManipulation()
		{
			base.IsManipulationEnabled = true;
		}

		protected internal override void SetManipulation(bool isColumnFilterOpened)
		{
			base.IsManipulationEnabled = !isColumnFilterOpened;
		}

		internal void OnManipulationDelta(Action onManipulate, Action onCancelManipulate)
		{
			if (isHeaderPanel)
			{
				isHeaderPanel = false;
				onCancelManipulate();
			}
			else
			{
				onManipulate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnManipulationDelta(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationDelta(delegate
			{
				if (e.Manipulators.Count() == 2)
				{
					base.View.ProcessManipulationScaling(e.DeltaManipulation.Scale);
				}
				DoManipulation(new System.Windows.Point(e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X, e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.Y), new System.Windows.Point(e.CumulativeManipulation.Translation.X, e.CumulativeManipulation.Translation.Y));
				e.Handled = true;
			}, delegate
			{
				e.Cancel();
			});
		}

		protected override void OnManipulationCompleted(ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void OnStylusDown(object source)
		{
			if (source is DetailColumnHeadersControl)
			{
				isHeaderPanel = true;
			}
			StartManipulation();
		}

		protected override void OnStylusDown(StylusDownEventArgs e)
		{
			OnStylusDown(e.Source);
		}

		protected override void OnStylusUp(StylusEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!deltaOccured)
			{
				base.View.ProcessStylusUp((DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnManipulationInertiaStarting(ManipulationInertiaStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.TranslationBehavior.DesiredDeceleration = 0.001;
			e.Handled = true;
			base.OnManipulationInertiaStarting(e);
			if (!deltaOccured)
			{
				e.Cancel();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataPresenter : DataPresenterManipulation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationOffsetProperty;

		private Storyboard scrollAnimationStoryboard;

		private double oldOffset;

		public double AnimationOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(AnimationOffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnimationOffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override double ScrollItemOffset => ActualAnimationOffset % 1.0;

		protected override bool CanScrollWithAnimation
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (base.View == null || !base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling || base.AdjustmentInProgress || base.View.ScrollAnimationLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowScrollAnimation)
				{
					if (base.View.ViewBehavior.ScrollAnimationDuration == 0.0)
					{
						return base.View.ViewBehavior.ScrollAnimationMode == ScrollAnimationMode.Custom;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsAnimationInProgress
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (!CanScrollWithAnimation)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return AnimationOffset != base.ActualScrollOffset;
			}
		}

		private double ActualAnimationOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollAnimationStoryboard == null)
				{
					return (double)GetAnimationBaseValue(AnimationOffsetProperty);
				}
				return AnimationOffset;
			}
		}

		protected override int GenerateItemsOffset
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return (int)ActualAnimationOffset;
			}
		}

		protected override double CurrentOffset
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return ActualAnimationOffset;
			}
		}

		private ITableView TableView => base.View as ITableView;

		static DataPresenter()
		{
			AnimationOffsetProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AnimationOffset", typeof(double), typeof(DataPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DataPresenter)d).OnAnimationOffsetChanged((double)e.OldValue);
			}));
		}

		private void OnAnimationOffsetChanged(double oldValue)
		{
			InvalidatePanel(Math.Floor(oldValue) == Math.Floor(AnimationOffset));
		}

		private void InvalidatePanel(bool updateCellMergingPanels)
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				if (base.Content is HierarchyPanel hierarchyPanel)
				{
					hierarchyPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				if (updateCellMergingPanels)
				{
					base.View.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
					base.View.UpdateHighlightSelectionState();
					base.View.RowsStateDirty = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDefineScrollInfoChangedCore()
		{
			if (base.View != null && oldOffset != base.ScrollInfoCore.DefineSizeScrollInfo.Offset)
			{
				oldOffset = base.ScrollInfoCore.DefineSizeScrollInfo.Offset;
				if (scrollAnimationStoryboard != null)
				{
					AnimationOffset = AnimationOffset;
					scrollAnimationStoryboard.Remove();
					scrollAnimationStoryboard = null;
				}
				if (CanScrollWithAnimation)
				{
					scrollAnimationStoryboard = GetStoryboard();
					Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(scrollAnimationStoryboard, new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(AnimationOffsetProperty)));
					Storyboard.SetTarget(scrollAnimationStoryboard, this);
					scrollAnimationStoryboard.Begin();
				}
				else
				{
					AnimationOffset = base.ScrollInfoCore.DefineSizeScrollInfo.Offset;
					InvalidatePanel(updateCellMergingPanels: false);
				}
			}
			base.OnDefineScrollInfoChangedCore();
		}

		private Storyboard GetStoryboard()
		{
			if (base.View.ViewBehavior.ScrollAnimationMode == ScrollAnimationMode.Custom)
			{
				CustomScrollAnimationEventArgs e = new CustomScrollAnimationEventArgs(AnimationOffset, oldOffset);
				base.View.RaiseCustomScrollAnimation(e);
				return e.Storyboard;
			}
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.From = AnimationOffset;
			doubleAnimation.To = oldOffset;
			doubleAnimation.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(base.View.ViewBehavior.ScrollAnimationDuration));
			doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = GetEasingFunction();
			storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
			return storyboard;
		}

		private IEasingFunction GetEasingFunction()
		{
			return base.View.ViewBehavior.ScrollAnimationMode switch
			{
				ScrollAnimationMode.EaseOut => new ExponentialEase
				{
					Exponent = 3.0
				}, 
				ScrollAnimationMode.Linear => null, 
				ScrollAnimationMode.EaseInOut => new ExponentialEase
				{
					EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseInOut,
					Exponent = 3.0
				}, 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
			};
		}

		protected override double GetOffset()
		{
			RowDataBase rowDataToScroll = GetRowDataToScroll();
			if (rowDataToScroll == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return HierarchyPanel.GetScrollElementOffset(rowDataToScroll, ScrollItemOffset);
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateContent()
		{
			return new HierarchyPanel
			{
				VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top,
				DataPresenter = this
			};
		}

		protected override void UpdateViewCore()
		{
			if (base.Content is HierarchyPanel hierarchyPanel)
			{
				hierarchyPanel.ItemsContainer = base.View.MasterRootRowsContainer;
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateElements()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Content as HierarchyPanel;
			do
			{
				frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement);
				frameworkElement.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			while (frameworkElement != this);
		}

		protected override void PregenerateItems(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (LayoutUpdatedHelper.GlobalLocker.IsLocked || rendered || base.View.RootNodeContainer.ItemCount != 0 || base.View.DataControl == null || (base.View.IsDesignTime && double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height)))
			{
				return;
			}
			base.View.DataControl.ForceLoad();
			base.View.ViewBehavior.EnsureSurroundingsActualSize(base.LastConstraint);
			OnDefineScrollInfoChangedCore();
			base.View.RootNodeContainer.OnDataChangedCore();
			while (base.View.RootNodeContainer.StartScrollIndex + base.View.RootNodeContainer.ItemCount < (base.View.IsPagingMode ? base.View.ItemsOnPage : base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount))
			{
				GenerateItems(DataPresenterBase.GenerateItemsCount, constraint.Height);
				BaseMeasureOverride(constraint);
				InvalidateElements();
				if (GetChildHeight() >= constraint.Height || (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Height) && base.View.RootNodeContainer.ItemCount > 70))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			UpdateScrollInfo();
		}

		protected override void GenerateItems(int count, double availableHeight)
		{
			if (!base.IsInAction)
			{
				double num = GetFirstVisibleRow()?.DesiredSize.Height ?? TableView.RowMinHeight;
				if (num != 0.0 && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableHeight))
				{
					count = Math.Max(Math.Min(count, (int)Math.Ceiling((availableHeight - GetChildHeight()) / num) + 1), 1);
				}
			}
			base.GenerateItems(count, availableHeight);
		}

		protected override void CancelAllGetRows()
		{
			base.CancelAllGetRows();
			if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.CancelAllGetRows();
			}
		}

		protected override void EnsureAllRowsLoaded(int firstRowIndex, int rowsCount)
		{
			base.EnsureAllRowsLoaded(firstRowIndex, rowsCount);
			base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.EnsureAllRowsLoaded(firstRowIndex, rowsCount);
		}
	}
	public class CardDataPresenterScrollBehavior : DataPresenterScrollBehavior
	{
		public override void ScrollToHorizontalOffset(DependencyObject source, double offset)
		{
			if (GetDataPresenter(source) is CardDataPresenter cardDataPresenter)
			{
				if (((CardView)cardDataPresenter.View).Orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					_ = 1;
					base.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(source, offset);
				}
				else
				{
					ScrollToHorizontalOffsetCore(source, offset, !cardDataPresenter.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(source, offset);
			}
		}

		public override void ScrollToVerticalOffset(DependencyObject source, double offset)
		{
			if (!(GetDataPresenter(source) is CardDataPresenter cardDataPresenter))
			{
				base.ScrollToVerticalOffset(source, offset);
			}
			else if (((CardView)cardDataPresenter.View).Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				if ((offset > 0.0 && !cardDataPresenter.CanScrollUp()) || (offset < 0.0 && !cardDataPresenter.CanScrollDown()))
				{
					((ScrollBehaviorBase)this).ScrollToHorizontalOffset(source, 0.0 - offset);
				}
				else
				{
					ScrollToVerticalOffsetCore(source, 0.0 - offset, useAccumulator: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ScrollToVerticalOffsetCore(source, offset, useAccumulator: true);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanScrollDown(DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (base.CanScrollDown(source))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GetDataPresenter(source) is CardDataPresenter cardDataPresenter && ((CardView)cardDataPresenter.View).Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return ((ScrollBehaviorBase)this).CanScrollRight(source);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanScrollUp(DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (base.CanScrollUp(source))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GetDataPresenter(source) is CardDataPresenter cardDataPresenter && ((CardView)cardDataPresenter.View).Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return ((ScrollBehaviorBase)this).CanScrollLeft(source);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class GridDataPresenterBase : DataPresenterBase
	{
		public GridDataPresenterBase()
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateViewCore()
		{
			if (base.Content is ContentControl contentControl)
			{
				contentControl.Content = base.View.RootRowsContainer;
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			if (!(DataControlBase.GetCurrentView(this) is GridDataViewBase gridDataViewBase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new DataPanelAutomationPeer(gridDataViewBase.DataControl);
		}

		internal override bool IsEnoughExpandingItems()
		{
			VirtualItemsEnumerator virtualItemsEnumerator = new VirtualItemsEnumerator(base.View.RootNodeContainer);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)virtualItemsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				if (virtualItemsEnumerator.Current is GroupNode { IsFinished: false } groupNode)
				{
					bool flag = IsElementVisible(groupNode);
					if (groupNode.IsExpanding)
					{
						groupNode.CanGenerateItems = flag;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool IsElementVisible(RowNode node)
		{
			if (node.NodesContainer != null)
			{
				if (node.IsCollapsing)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!AreAllElementsVisible(node.NodesContainer))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return base.IsElementVisible(node);
		}
	}
	public class GridScrollBarHelper

	public class GridVerticalLinesHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectionStateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("SelectionState", typeof(SelectionState), typeof(GridVerticalLinesHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(SelectionState.None, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnShowVerticalLinesChanged(d, e);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowVerticalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ShowVerticalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(GridVerticalLinesHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnShowVerticalLinesChanged(d, e);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VerticalLinesBrushProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("VerticalLinesBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(GridVerticalLinesHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata());

		public static SelectionState GetSelectionState(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (SelectionState)obj.GetValue(SelectionStateProperty);
		}

		public static void SetSelectionState(DependencyObject obj, SelectionState value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(SelectionStateProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetShowVerticalLines(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty);
		}

		public static void SetShowVerticalLines(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty, value);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush GetVerticalLinesBrush(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)obj.GetValue(VerticalLinesBrushProperty);
		}

		public static void SetVerticalLinesBrush(DependencyObject obj, System.Windows.Media.Brush value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(VerticalLinesBrushProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnShowVerticalLinesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Border border = (Border)d;
			bool flag = (bool)border.GetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty);
			SelectionState selectionState = (SelectionState)border.GetValue(SelectionStateProperty);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)border.GetValue(VerticalLinesBrushProperty);
			bool flag2 = flag && selectionState != SelectionState.Focused;
			border.BorderBrush = (flag2 ? brush : null);
		}
	}
	public class FadeSelectionHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsKeyboardFocusWithinViewProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("IsKeyboardFocusWithinView", typeof(bool), typeof(FadeSelectionHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnFadeSelectionHelperPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FadeSelectionOnLostFocusProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("FadeSelectionOnLostFocus", typeof(bool), typeof(FadeSelectionHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnFadeSelectionHelperPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OpacityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Opacity", typeof(double), typeof(FadeSelectionHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.5, OnFadeSelectionHelperPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("IsSelected", typeof(bool?), typeof(FadeSelectionHelper), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnFadeSelectionHelperPropertyChanged));

		public static bool GetIsKeyboardFocusWithinView(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(IsKeyboardFocusWithinViewProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsKeyboardFocusWithinView(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsKeyboardFocusWithinViewProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetFadeSelectionOnLostFocus(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(FadeSelectionOnLostFocusProperty);
		}

		public static void SetFadeSelectionOnLostFocus(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(FadeSelectionOnLostFocusProperty, value);
		}

		public static double GetOpacity(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (double)obj.GetValue(OpacityProperty);
		}

		public static void SetOpacity(DependencyObject obj, double value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(OpacityProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool? GetIsSelected(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool?)obj.GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsSelected(DependencyObject obj, bool? value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
		}

		private static void UpdateElementOpacity(DependencyObject element, bool fadeSelectionOnLostFocus, bool isKeyboardFocusWithin)
		{
			bool flag = IsFadeNeeded(fadeSelectionOnLostFocus, isKeyboardFocusWithin);
			if (flag)
			{
				element.SetValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, GetOpacity(element));
			}
			else
			{
				element.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			}
			OnSelectionChanged(element, flag);
		}

		internal static bool IsFadeNeeded(bool fadeSelectionOnLostFocus, bool isKeyboardFocusWithin)
		{
			if (fadeSelectionOnLostFocus)
			{
				return !isKeyboardFocusWithin;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnFadeSelectionHelperPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateElementOpacity(d, GetFadeSelectionOnLostFocus(d), GetIsKeyboardFocusWithinView(d));
		}

		private static void OnSelectionChanged(DependencyObject d, bool isFadeNeeded)
		{
			if (GetIsSelected(d).HasValue)
			{
				if (isFadeNeeded && GetIsSelected(d) == true)
				{
					SetVisibility(d, Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else
				{
					SetVisibility(d, Visibility.Collapsed);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsFadeNeeded(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (GetFadeSelectionOnLostFocus(d))
			{
				return !GetIsKeyboardFocusWithinView(d);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void SetVisibility(DependencyObject d, Visibility value)
		{
			if (d is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.Visibility = value;
			}
		}
	}
	public class GridRow : System.Windows.Controls.Control, IFocusedRowBorderObject, IGridDataRow
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowPositionProperty;

		private ContentPresenter rowOffsetPresenter;

		public RowPosition RowPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return (RowPosition)GetValue(RowPositionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RowPositionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement RowDataContent { get; set; }

		double IFocusedRowBorderObject.LeftIndent => 0.0;

		internal GridRowContent DataRowContainer { get; private set; }

		private RowData RowData { get; set; }

		RowData IGridDataRow.RowData => base.DataContext as RowData;

		static GridRow()
		{
			RowPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("RowPosition", typeof(RowPosition), typeof(GridRow), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RowPosition.Bottom, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridRow)d).OnRowPositionChanged();
			}));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridRow>();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRowPositionChanged()
		{
		}

		public GridRow()
		{
			RowData.SetRowHandleBinding(this);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			return DXArranger.Ceiling(size);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			DataRowContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_DataRow") as GridRowContent;
			RowDataContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_DataRowContent") as FrameworkElement;
			RowData = base.DataContext as RowData;
			((DataObjectBase)RowData).PropertyChanged += rowData_PropertyChanged;
			rowOffsetPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_RowOffsetPresenter") as ContentPresenter;
			UpdateRowOffsetPresenter();
			SetBinding(RowPositionProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("RowPosition"));
		}

		private void rowData_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "Level")
			{
				UpdateRowOffsetPresenter();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRowOffsetPresenter()
		{
			if (rowOffsetPresenter != null && RowData != null && rowOffsetPresenter.Content == null)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = GridRowHelper.CreateRowOffsetContent(RowData, DataRowContainer, (RowData x) => new RowMarginControl(x));
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					rowOffsetPresenter.Content = frameworkElement;
				}
			}
		}

		void IGridDataRow.UpdateContentLayout()
		{
			if (RowData != null && RowData.View != null)
			{
				RowData.View.UpdateContentLayout();
			}
		}

		private void MouseEnterOrLeave()
		{
			if (RowData != null && RowData.View != null && RowData.View.CanHighlightedState(RowData.RowHandle.Value, null, isCell: false, RowData.SelectionState))
			{
				RowData.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			MouseEnterOrLeave();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			MouseEnterOrLeave();
		}
	}
	internal static class GridRowHelper
	{
		public static System.Windows.Controls.Control CreateRowOffsetContent(RowData rowData, System.Windows.Controls.Control backgroundSource, Func<RowData, RowMarginControl> getRowMarginControl)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Control control = null;
			if (rowData.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft)
			{
				control = CreateRowMarginControl(rowData, getRowMarginControl);
			}
			else if (rowData.Level != 0 && rowData.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.Hidden)
			{
				control = new RowOffsetPresenter();
			}
			control?.SetBinding(System.Windows.Controls.Control.BorderBrushProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("BorderBrush")
			{
				Source = backgroundSource
			});
			return control;
		}

		public static RowMarginControl CreateRowMarginControl(RowData rowData, Func<RowData, RowMarginControl> getRowMarginControl)
		{
			if (rowData is AdditionalRowData)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RowMarginControl rowMarginControl = getRowMarginControl(rowData);
			rowMarginControl.SetBinding(RowOffsetBase.NextRowLevelProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("NextRowLevel"));
			return rowMarginControl;
		}
	}

	public class GridTotalSummaryScrollablePart : GridScrollablePart
	{
		static GridTotalSummaryScrollablePart()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridTotalSummaryScrollablePart>();
		}

		protected override void InitNoneContentCellsBorderClip()
		{
			if (!(base.DataContext is HeadersData))
			{
				base.InitNoneContentCellsBorderClip();
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.DataContext is HeadersData && base.UseContentClippingSeparatorOffset)
			{
				fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, -3.0, fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.DesiredSize.Width, fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.DesiredSize.Height + 6.0));
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(constraint);
		}
	}

		{
			get

					return false;

				return ((RowData)base.DataContext).IsAutoFilterRow;
			}
		}

		protected bool UseContentClippingSeparatorOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataControl != null && View != null && DataControl.BandsCore != null && DataControl.BandsCore.Count > 0 && View.VisibleColumnsCore != null)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase item in View.VisibleColumnsCore)
					{
						if (item.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0 || item.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (fixedLeftContentInternal != null)
			{
				fixedLeftContentInternal.Content = null;
			}
			if (fitContent != null)
			{
				fitContent.Content = null;
			}
			if (fitLeftContent != null)
			{
				fitLeftContent.Content = null;
			}
			if (fixedRightContent != null)
			{
				fixedRightContent.Content = null;
			}
			if (fixedNoneContentInternal != null)
			{
				fixedNoneContentInternal.Content = null;
			}
			fixedLeftContentInternal = GetTemplateChild("PART_FixedLeftContent") as ContentPresenter;
			fitContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_FitContent") as ContentPresenter;
			fitLeftContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_FitLeftContent") as ContentPresenter;
			fixedRightContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_FixedRightContent") as ContentPresenter;
			fixedNoneContentInternal = GetTemplateChild("PART_FixedNoneContent") as ContentPresenter;
			OnFixedNoneContentChanged();
			fixedNoneContentCellsBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_FixedNoneCellsBorder") as FrameworkElement;
			if (fixedNoneContentCellsBorder != null)
			{
				InitNoneContentCellsBorderClip();
			}
			OnFixedNoneContentWidthChanged();
			OnFitContentChanged();
			OnFitLeftContentChanged();
			fixedLeftLineContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_FixedLeftLinePlaceHolder") as ContentPresenter;
			fixedRightLineContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_FixedRightLinePlaceHolder") as ContentPresenter;
			UpdateFixedParts();
			OnFixedLineWidthChanged();
			OnScrollingMarginChanged();
			OnFixedColumnsDelimiterTemplateChanged();
			scrollablePartPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollablePartPanel") as FrameworkElement;
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}

		private void OnFixedNoneContentChanged()
		{
			if (fixedNoneContentInternal != null)
			{
				fixedNoneContentInternal.Content = FixedNoneContent;
			}
		}

		private void OnFitContentChanged()
		{
			if (fitContent != null)
			{
				fitContent.Content = FitContent;
			}
		}

		private void OnFitLeftContentChanged()
		{
			if (fitLeftContent != null)
			{
				fitLeftContent.Content = FitLeftContent;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateFixedParts()
		{
			if (HasFixedLeftColumns)
			{
				if (fixedLeftContentInternal != null && fixedLeftContentInternal.Content == null)
				{
					fixedLeftContentInternal.Content = FixedLeftContent;
				}
				if (fixedLeftLineContent != null)
				{
					fixedLeftLineContent.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			else if (fixedLeftLineContent != null)
			{
				fixedLeftLineContent.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (HasFixedRightColumns)
			{
				if (fixedRightContent != null && fixedRightContent.Content == null)
				{
					fixedRightContent.Content = FixedRightContent;
				}
				if (fixedRightLineContent != null)
				{
					fixedRightLineContent.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			else if (fixedRightLineContent != null)
			{
				fixedRightLineContent.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void OnFixedLineWidthChanged()
		{
			if (fixedLeftLineContent != null)
			{
				fixedLeftLineContent.Width = FixedLineWidth;
			}
			if (fixedRightLineContent != null)
			{
				fixedRightLineContent.Width = FixedLineWidth;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFixedNoneContentWidthChanged()
		{
			if (fixedNoneContentCellsBorder != null)
			{
				if (fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.Width != FixedNoneContentWidth && scrollablePartPanel != null)
				{
					scrollablePartPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.Width = FixedNoneContentWidth;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitNoneContentCellsBorderClip()
		{
			if (!(base.DataContext is AdditionalRowData) && fixedNoneContentCellsBorder != null)
			{
				fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.ClipToBounds = true;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.DataContext is AdditionalRowData && fixedNoneContentCellsBorder != null)
			{
				if (UseContentClippingSeparatorOffset)
				{
					fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.ClipToBounds = false;
					fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.DesiredSize.Width, fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.DesiredSize.Height + 1.0));
				}
				else
				{
					fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.ClipToBounds = true;
				}
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected virtual void OnScrollingMarginChanged()
		{
			if ((View == null || !View.IsTreeView || !IsAutoFilterRow) && fixedNoneContentInternal != null)
			{
				fixedNoneContentInternal.Margin = ScrollingMargin;
			}
		}

		private void OnFixedColumnsDelimiterTemplateChanged()
		{
			if (fixedLeftLineContent != null)
			{
				fixedLeftLineContent.ContentTemplate = FixedColumnsDelimiterTemplate;
			}
			if (fixedRightLineContent != null)
			{
				fixedRightLineContent.ContentTemplate = FixedColumnsDelimiterTemplate;
			}
		}
	}

					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (TreeListView != null)
				{
					return TreeListView.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (TreeListView == null)

					return null;
				}
				return TreeListView.DataControl;
			}

		{
			LevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Level", typeof(int), typeof(GridGroupFooterScrollablePart), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridGroupFooterScrollablePart)d).UpdateMargin();
			}));
		}

		public GridGroupFooterScrollablePart()
		{
			notificationHelper = new LayoutNotificationHelper(this);
		}

		private void UpdateMargin()
		{
			OnScrollingMarginChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnScrollingMarginChanged()
		{
			if (base.FixedNoneContentCore != null)
			{
				if (TableView != null && !HasFixedLeftColumns && TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns != null && TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns.Count > 0 && TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns[0].ActualVisibleIndex > 0)
				{
					base.FixedNoneContentCore.Margin = GetFixedNoneContentScrollingMargin();
				}
				else
				{
					base.FixedNoneContentCore.Margin = new Thickness(AllowIndentScrolling ? Math.Min(0.0, base.ScrollingMargin.Left + RowData.Offset) : base.ScrollingMargin.Left, base.ScrollingMargin.Top, base.ScrollingMargin.Right, base.ScrollingMargin.Bottom);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (TreeListView != null && TreeListView.DataControl != null)
			{
				notificationHelper.Subscribe();
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		private Thickness GetFixedNoneContentScrollingMargin()
		{
			double left = ((TreeListView != null) ? ((TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns[0].ParentBand == null) ? (AllowIndentScrolling ? base.ScrollingMargin.Left : (base.ScrollingMargin.Left - RowData.Offset)) : (AllowIndentScrolling ? Math.Min(0.0, base.ScrollingMargin.Left + RowData.Offset) : base.ScrollingMargin.Left)) : ((TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns[0].ParentBand == null) ? (base.ScrollingMargin.Left - RowData.Offset) : base.ScrollingMargin.Left));
			return new Thickness(left, base.ScrollingMargin.Top, base.ScrollingMargin.Right, base.ScrollingMargin.Bottom);
		}

		protected override void InitNoneContentCellsBorderClip()
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			UpdateFixedNoneContentClip(constraint.Height);
			return base.ArrangeOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected void UpdateFixedNoneContentClip(double height)
		{
			if (fixedNoneContentCellsBorder != null)
			{
				fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, fixedNoneContentCellsBorder.DesiredSize.Width, height + (double)(UseContentClippingOffset ? 1 : 0)));
			}
		}

		void ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner.InvalidateMeasure()
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}
