	public interface IFixedGroupElement
	{
		double GetLeftMargin(bool drawAdornerUnderWholeGroup);

		double GetRightMargin(bool drawAdornerUnderWholeGroup);
	}
	internal class FixedGroupElement : IFixedGroupElement
	{
		private readonly Func<GroupRowData> getRowDataFunc;

		double IFixedGroupElement.GetLeftMargin(bool drawAdornerUnderWholeGroup)
		{
			GroupRowData groupRowData = getRowDataFunc();
			if (groupRowData == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			TableView tableView = (TableView)groupRowData.View;
			double detailLeftIndent = 0.0;
			double detailRightIndent = 0.0;
			int detailParentGroupLevel = 0;
			GetDetailIndents(tableView, out detailLeftIndent, out detailRightIndent, out detailParentGroupLevel);
			return (tableView.ActualShowIndicator ? tableView.IndicatorWidth : 0.0) + detailLeftIndent + (double)(detailParentGroupLevel + (tableView.UseGroupShadowIndent ? groupRowData.GroupLevel : 0) + ((!drawAdornerUnderWholeGroup) ? 1 : 0)) * tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent;
		}

		double IFixedGroupElement.GetRightMargin(bool drawAdornerUnderWholeGroup)
		{
			GroupRowData groupRowData = getRowDataFunc();
			if (groupRowData == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			TableView view = (TableView)groupRowData.View;
			int detailParentGroupLevel = 0;
			double detailLeftIndent = 0.0;
			double detailRightIndent = 0.0;
			GetDetailIndents(view, out detailLeftIndent, out detailRightIndent, out detailParentGroupLevel);
			return detailRightIndent;
		}

		public FixedGroupElement(Func<GroupRowData> getRowDataFunc)
		{
			this.getRowDataFunc = getRowDataFunc;
		}

		private static void GetDetailIndents(TableView view, out double detailLeftIndent, out double detailRightIndent, out int detailParentGroupLevel)
		{
			double leftIndent = 0.0;
			double rightIndent = 0.0;
			int parentGroupLevel = 0;
			view.Grid.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (dataControl is GridControl gridControl)
				{
					GridControl masterGrid = gridControl.GetMasterGrid();
					if (masterGrid != null)
					{
						parentGroupLevel += masterGrid.View.GetRowData(gridControl.GetMasterRowHandle()).Level;
					}
					TableView tableView = gridControl.View as TableView;
					if (tableView != view)
					{
						leftIndent += tableView.ActualDetailMargin.Left;
						rightIndent += tableView.ActualDetailMargin.Right;
					}
				}
			});
			detailLeftIndent = leftIndent;
			detailRightIndent = rightIndent;
			detailParentGroupLevel = parentGroupLevel;
		}

		private static void GetDetailLevels(TableView view, out int detailLevel, out int detailParentGroupLevel)
		{
			int level = -1;
			int parentGroupLevel = 0;
			view.Grid.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				level++;
				if (dataControl is GridControl gridControl)
				{
					GridControl masterGrid = gridControl.GetMasterGrid();
					if (masterGrid != null)
					{
						parentGroupLevel += masterGrid.View.GetRowData(gridControl.GetMasterRowHandle()).Level;
					}
				}
			});
			detailLevel = level;
			detailParentGroupLevel = parentGroupLevel;
		}
	}

			base.Content = new System.Windows.Controls.Grid
			{
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			return System.Windows.Size.Empty;
		}

		private void OnChanged()
		{
			if (queued || ParentControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DataViewBase>((DependencyObject)ParentControl);
			if (dataViewBase == null || dataViewBase.DataPresenter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			queued = true;
			dataViewBase.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (FixedElements != null && ParentControl != null)
				{
					queued = false;
					Panel.Children.Clear();
					for (int i = 0; i < FixedElements.Count; i++)
					{
						Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)FixedElements[i], (UIElement)ParentControl);
						System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path
						{
							Stroke = AdornerBrush,
							StrokeThickness = AdornerHeight,
							IsHitTestVisible = false
						};
						double y = relativeElementRect.Bottom + AdornerHeight / 2.0;
						IFixedGroupElement fixedGroupElement = FixedElements[i] as IFixedGroupElement;
						double num = fixedGroupElement?.GetLeftMargin(DrawAdornerUnderWholeGroup) ?? 0.0;
						double num2 = fixedGroupElement?.GetRightMargin(DrawAdornerUnderWholeGroup) ?? 0.0;
						path.Data = new LineGeometry
						{
							StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.Left + num, y),
							EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.Right - num2, y)
						};
						path.Width = relativeElementRect.Width;
						Panel.Children.Add(path);
					}
				}
			});
		}
	}

	public class GridCellContentPresenter : CellContentPresenter, ISupportLoadingAnimation
	{
		private GridCellData data;

		private LoadingAnimationHelper loadingAnimationHelper;

		internal bool ShouldSyncProperties => data == null;

		internal LoadingAnimationHelper LoadingAnimationHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (loadingAnimationHelper == null)
				{
					loadingAnimationHelper = new LoadingAnimationHelper(this);
				}
				return loadingAnimationHelper;
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement Element => (FrameworkElement)(object)base.Editor;

		public DataViewBase DataView => base.View;

		public bool IsGroupRow => false;

		double ISupportLoadingAnimation.EditorOpacity => 1.0;

		static GridCellContentPresenter()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridCellContentPresenter>();
		}

		public GridCellContentPresenter()
		{
		}

		internal GridCellContentPresenter(GridCellData data)
			: this()
		{
			this.data = data;
			base.DataContext = data;
		}

		protected internal override void OnIsReadyChanged()
		{
			LoadingAnimationHelper.ApplyAnimation();
		}

		protected override void OnRowDataChanged()
		{
			base.OnRowDataChanged();
			if (base.RowData != null)
			{
				base.IsReady = base.RowData.IsReady;
			}
		}

		internal override void SyncProperties(GridCellData cellData)
		{
			if (cellData.Column != null)
			{
				base.DataContext = cellData;
				if (base.ShowVerticalLines != ((ITableView)cellData.View).ShowVerticalLines)
				{
					base.ShowVerticalLines = ((ITableView)cellData.View).ShowVerticalLines;
				}
				if (base.ShowHorizontalLines != ((ITableView)cellData.View).ShowHorizontalLines)
				{
					base.ShowHorizontalLines = ((ITableView)cellData.View).ShowHorizontalLines;
				}
				if (base.HasRightSibling != cellData.Column.HasRightSibling)
				{
					base.HasRightSibling = cellData.Column.HasRightSibling;
				}
				if (base.HasLeftSibling != cellData.Column.HasLeftSibling)
				{
					base.HasLeftSibling = cellData.Column.HasLeftSibling;
				}
				if (base.HasTopElement != cellData.Column.HasTopElement)
				{
					base.HasTopElement = cellData.Column.HasTopElement;
				}
				base.Style = cellData.Column.ActualCellStyle;
				SyncWidth(cellData);
				SyncLeftMargin(cellData);
				base.RowData = cellData.RowData;
				ColumnBase.SetNavigationIndex(this, BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)cellData.Column));
				base.Column = cellData.Column;
				cellData.OnEditorContentUpdated();
				base.ColumnPosition = cellData.Column.ColumnPosition;
				if (base.IsSelected != cellData.IsSelected)
				{
					base.IsSelected = cellData.IsSelected;
				}
				if (base.SelectionState != cellData.SelectionState)
				{
					base.SelectionState = cellData.SelectionState;
				}
				if (base.IsFocusedCell != cellData.IsFocusedCell)
				{
					base.IsFocusedCell = cellData.IsFocusedCell;
				}
				UpdateRowSelectionState();
			}
		}

		private void SyncLeftMargin(GridCellData cellData)
		{
			cellData.SyncLeftMargin(this);
		}

		protected virtual void SyncWidth(GridCellData cellData)
		{
			base.Width = cellData.GetActualCellWidth();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (data != null)
			{
				SyncProperties(data);
				data = null;
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ISupportLoadingAnimation.get_IsReady()
		{
			return base.IsReady;
		}
	}

	public class GroupSummaryContainer : ContentPresenter, INotifyCurrentRowDataChanged, INotifyPositionChanged
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty GroupSummaryDisplayModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GroupSummaryDisplayMode", typeof(GroupSummaryDisplayMode), typeof(GroupSummaryContainer), new PropertyMetadata(GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((GroupSummaryContainer)d).OnGroupSummaryDisplayModeChanged();
		}));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsCompactModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsCompactMode", typeof(bool), typeof(GroupSummaryContainer), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((GroupSummaryContainer)d).OnGroupSummaryDisplayModeChanged();
		}));

		private GroupRowData RowData => DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.RowData.GetCurrentRowData(this) as GroupRowData;

		public GroupSummaryContainer()
		{
			base.ContentTemplate = null;
			base.ContentTemplateSelector = null;
		}

		private void OnGroupSummaryDisplayModeChanged()
		{
			if (RowData != null)
			{
				UpdateContent();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateContent()
		{
			bool flag = RowData.View is TableView && ((TableView)RowData.View).GroupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.AlignByColumns;
			if (flag && !(base.Content is GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl))
			{
				base.Content = new GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl();
			}
			if (!flag && !(base.Content is GroupSummaryDefaultLayoutControl))
			{
				base.Content = new GroupSummaryDefaultLayoutControl();
			}
			if (flag && base.Content is GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl && RowData.View is TableView)
			{
				((GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl)base.Content).UpdateVisible(!RowData.View.GetIsCompactMode());
			}
		}

		void INotifyCurrentRowDataChanged.OnCurrentRowDataChanged()
		{
			if (DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.RowData.GetCurrentRowData(this) is GroupRowData groupRowData)
			{
				if (groupRowData.View is TableView)
				{
					SetBinding(GroupSummaryDisplayModeProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.GroupSummaryDisplayMode")
					{
						Source = groupRowData
					});
					SetBinding(IsCompactModeProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.IsCompactMode")
					{
						Source = groupRowData
					});
				}
				UpdateContent();
			}
		}

		void INotifyPositionChanged.OnPositionChanged(Rect newRect)
		{
			if (base.Content is GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl groupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl)
			{
				groupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl.SetContentOffset(0.0 - newRect.X);
			}
		}
	}

	public class GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{

		static GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupSummaryAlignByColumnsLayoutControl>();

		internal void SetContentOffset(double newOffset)
		{
			if (base.DataContext is GroupRowData groupRowData)
			{
				ITableView tableView = (TableView)groupRowData.View;
				newOffset -= (double)groupRowData.Level * tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent;
				newOffset += tableView.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidth;
				newOffset -= (tableView.ShowIndicator ? 0.0 : tableView.LeftDataAreaIndent);
				if (offset != newOffset)
				{
					offset = newOffset;
					UpdateSelector();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			selector = GetTemplateChild("PART_BandedViewContentSelector") as BandedViewContentSelector;
		}

		{
			if (selector != null)
			{
				selector.Margin = new Thickness(offset, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateVisible(bool isVisible)
		{
			base.Visibility = ((!isVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

	public class GroupRowNodePrintInfo : RowNodePrintInfo
	{

	public class GroupNode : DataRowNode
	{
		public GridControl Grid => (GridControl)base.DataControl;

		internal GridViewBase GridView => (GridViewBase)Grid.View;

		public new DataNodeContainer NodesContainer => (DataNodeContainer)base.NodesContainer;

		protected override bool IsDataExpanded => Grid.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowExpanded(base.RowHandle.Value);

		internal override bool CanGenerateItems
		{
			get
			{
				return base.CanGenerateItems;
			}
			set
			{
				base.CanGenerateItems = value;
				if (NodesContainer == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (RowNode item in NodesContainer.Items)
				{
					if (item is GroupNode)
					{
						item.CanGenerateItems = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanGenerateItemsCore => true;

		internal override bool IsFixedNode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsRowVisible || !base.IsExpanded || NodesContainer.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IRootItemsContainer masterRootRowsContainer = GridView.MasterRootRowsContainer;
				if (NodesContainer.Items[0].GetRowData() == masterRootRowsContainer.ScrollItem && masterRootRowsContainer.ScrollItemOffset != 0.0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.ControllerValues.VisibleIndex + 1 < ((DataRowNode)NodesContainer.Items[0]).ControllerValues.VisibleIndex;
			}
		}

		public override int CurrentLevelItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = NodesContainer.CurrentLevelItemCount;
				if (base.IsRowVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public GroupNode(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues)
			: base(treeBuilder, controllerValues)
		{
			base.NodesContainer = new DataNodeContainer(treeBuilder, base.Level + 1, this);
			NodesContainer.OnDataChangedCore();
		}

		internal override LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues synchronizationQueues)
		{
			return synchronizationQueues.FreeGroupRowDataQueue;
		}

		internal override RowDataBase CreateRowData()
		{
			return GridView.CreateGroupRowDataCore(treeBuilder);
		}

		protected override void ValidateControllerValues()
		{
			if (base.RowHandle.Value >= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Internal error: RowHandle should be negative");
			}
		}

		internal override RowNode GetNodeToScroll()
		{
			if (GridView.AllowFixedGroupsCore || !base.IsRowVisible)
			{
				RowNode nodeToScroll = base.GetNodeToScroll();
				if (nodeToScroll == this && GridView.ShowGroupSummaryFooter && summaryNode != null)
				{
					return summaryNode;
				}
				return nodeToScroll;
			}
			return this;
		}

		public override int SkipChildNodes(int index)
		{
			if (Grid.DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode || !((DataControllerBase)Grid.DataController).AllowPartialGrouping)
			{
				return index;
			}
			object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = Grid.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(index);
			if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				return index;
			}
			index = Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(base.RowHandle.Value) + GetChildRowCount(out var footerCount);
			if (Grid.DataProviderBase.ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				index += Grid.DataProviderBase.GetSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(base.RowHandle.Value);
			}
			return index + footerCount;
		}

		private int GetChildRowCount(out int footerCount)
		{
			footerCount = 0;
			GroupRowInfoCollection groupInfo = Grid.DataController.GroupInfo;
			GroupRowInfo groupRowInfoByHandle = groupInfo.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(base.RowHandle.Value);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = groupRowInfoByHandle.Index;
			GroupRowInfo val = null;
			while (num2 != ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo).Count)
			{
				GroupRowInfo val2 = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo)[num2];
				if (val2 != groupRowInfoByHandle && val2.Level <= groupRowInfoByHandle.Level)
				{
					break;
				}
				val = val2;
				if (val2 != groupRowInfoByHandle && Grid.DataProviderBase.IsGroupVisible(val2))
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (val2.Level == groupInfo.LevelCount - 1 && (val2.Expanded || val2.ChildControllerRowCount == 1))
				{
					num += val2.ChildControllerRowCount;
				}
				num2 = ((!val2.Expanded && val2.ChildControllerRowCount != 1) ? GridDataProvider.GetLevelNextIndex(num2, groupInfo) : (num2 + 1));
			}
			if (Grid.DataProviderBase.ShowGroupSummaryFooter && val != groupRowInfoByHandle)
			{
				while (true)
				{
					if (Grid.DataProviderBase.IsGroupVisible(val) && Grid.DataProviderBase.OnShowingGroupFooter(val.Handle, val.Level))
					{
						footerCount++;
					}
					if (val.ParentGroup == groupRowInfoByHandle)
					{
						break;
					}
					val = val.ParentGroup;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		protected virtual void UpdateGroupSummariesCore()
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (GroupSummaryData == null)
			{
				GroupSummaryData = new ObservableCollection<GridGroupSummaryData>();
			}
			int num = 0;
			IList<SummaryItemBase> groupSummaries = treeBuilder.GetGroupSummaries();
			foreach (GridSummaryItem item in groupSummaries)
			{
				object value = null;
				if (treeBuilder.TryGetGroupSummaryValue(this, item, out value) && CanUpdateSummary(item))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			int num2 = num - GroupSummaryData.Count;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					GroupSummaryData.Add(new GridGroupSummaryData(this));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < -num2; j++)
				{
					GroupSummaryData.RemoveAt(GroupSummaryData.Count - 1);
				}
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int k = 0; k < groupSummaries.Count; k++)
			{
				GridSummaryItem gridSummaryItem = (GridSummaryItem)groupSummaries[k];
				GridColumn column = Grid.Columns[gridSummaryItem.FieldName];
				object value2 = null;
				if (treeBuilder.TryGetGroupSummaryValue(this, gridSummaryItem, out value2) && CanUpdateSummary(gridSummaryItem))
				{
					GridGroupSummaryData gridGroupSummaryData = GroupSummaryData[num3];
					gridGroupSummaryData.Column = column;
					gridGroupSummaryData.Text = GetGroupSummaryText(gridSummaryItem, column, base.View as TableView, value2);
					gridGroupSummaryData.SummaryItem = gridSummaryItem;
					gridGroupSummaryData.Data = base.DataContext;
					((EditableDataObject)gridGroupSummaryData).Value = value2;
					gridGroupSummaryData.SummaryValue = value2;
					gridGroupSummaryData.IsLast = num3 == GroupSummaryData.Count - 1;
					gridGroupSummaryData.IsFirst = k == 0;
					num3++;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanUpdateSummary(GridSummaryItem item)
		{
			if (item.Visible)
			{
				return CanExtractGridGroupSummaryItem(item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected IList<SummaryItemBase> ExtractGridGroupSummaries(IList<SummaryItemBase> summaries)
		{
			List<SummaryItemBase> list = new List<SummaryItemBase>();
			foreach (SummaryItemBase summary in summaries)
			{
				if (CanExtractGridGroupSummaryItem(summary))
				{
					list.Add(summary);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanExtractGridGroupSummaryItem(SummaryItemBase summary)
		{
			if (summary is GridSummaryItem gridSummaryItem)
			{
				return string.IsNullOrEmpty(gridSummaryItem.ShowInGroupColumnFooter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal string GetGroupSummaryText(GridSummaryItem summaryItem, ColumnBase column, TableView tableView, object value, bool isPrinting = false)
		{
			if (tableView == null || GetActualGroupSummaryDisplayMode(tableView, isPrinting) == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default)
			{
				return summaryItem.GetGroupDisplayText(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, ColumnBase.GetSummaryDisplayName(column, summaryItem), value, GetColumnDisplayFormat(column));
			}
			return summaryItem.GetGroupColumnDisplayText(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, ColumnBase.GetSummaryDisplayName(column, summaryItem), value, GetColumnDisplayFormat(column));
		}

		private GroupSummaryDisplayMode GetActualGroupSummaryDisplayMode(TableView tableView, bool isPrinting)
		{
			if (!isPrinting)
			{
				return tableView.GroupSummaryDisplayMode;
			}
			return tableView.PrintGroupSummaryDisplayMode;
		}

		internal void InitGroupValue()
		{
			if (GroupValue == null)
			{
				GridGroupValueData gridGroupValueData = new GridGroupValueData(this)
				{
					IsFirstGroupValue = true
				};
				gridGroupValueData.BeginUpdate();
				UpdateGroupValueData(gridGroupValueData);
				GroupValue = gridGroupValueData;
				if (GroupValue.Column == null)
				{
					UpdateColumnAndValueCore();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GroupValue.BeginUpdate();
				UpdateColumnAndValueCore();
			}
			InitGroupValues();
		}

		private List<GridSortInfo> GetMergeSortInfos()
		{
			if (GridView == null || GridView.SortInfo == null || GroupValue == null || GroupValue.Column == null || !(GroupValue.Column is GridColumn))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)GridView.SortInfo).GetMergeSortInfo(GridView.SortInfo[GroupValue.Column.FieldName], GridView.SortInfo.GroupCount);
		}

		private void InitGroupValues()
		{
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfos = GetMergeSortInfos();
			if (mergeSortInfos == null)
			{
				GroupValue.ShowSeparator = false;
				GroupValue.IsFirstGroupValue = true;
				if (GroupValues == null || GroupValues.Count != 1)
				{
					GroupValues = new ObservableCollection<GridGroupValueData> { GroupValue };
				}
				else
				{
					GroupValues[0] = GroupValue;
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (GroupValues == null || GroupValues.Count != mergeSortInfos.Count)
			{
				GroupValues = new ObservableCollection<GridGroupValueData>();
				flag = false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < mergeSortInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				GridGroupValueData gridGroupValueData = null;
				gridGroupValueData = ((i != 0) ? GetGridGroupValueData(mergeSortInfos, i) : GroupValue);
				gridGroupValueData.ShowSeparator = i != mergeSortInfos.Count - 1;
				if (flag)
				{
					GroupValues[i] = gridGroupValueData;
				}
				else
				{
					GroupValues.Add(gridGroupValueData);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual GridGroupValueData GetGridGroupValueData(IList<GridSortInfo> infos, int idx)
		{
			GridGroupValueData gridGroupValueData = new GridGroupValueData(this);
			gridGroupValueData.Column = GridView.Columns[infos[idx].FieldName];
			UpdateGroupValueData(gridGroupValueData);
			return gridGroupValueData;
		}

		internal override void AssignFrom(RowsContainer parentRowsContainer, NodeContainer parentNodeContainer, RowNode rowNode, bool forceUpdate)
		{
			base.AssignFrom(parentRowsContainer, parentNodeContainer, rowNode, forceUpdate);
			if (GridView != null)
			{
				InitGroupValue();
				UpdateColumnAndValue();
				UpdateDisplayText(calcValues: false);
				IsLastVisibleElementRow = GetIsLastVisibleElementRow(RowHandle.Value, checkParentRow: true);
				IsLastHierarchicalRow = GetIsLastHierarchicalRow(RowHandle.Value);
				IsPreviewExpanded = GetIsPreviewExpanded(RowHandle.Value);
				if (groupRowStateClient != null)
				{
					groupRowStateClient.UpdateIsPreviewExpanded();
				}
				GroupValue.EndUpdate();
				treeBuilder.UpdateGroupRowData(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void SyncWithNode()
		{
			base.SyncWithNode();
			base.IsRowVisible = base.DataRowNode.IsRowVisible;
			base.IsRowExpanded = base.DataRowNode.IsExpanded;
			base.IsExpanding = base.DataRowNode.IsExpanding;
			GroupLevel = Level;
		}

		protected override void OnRowHandleChanged(RowHandle newValue)
		{
			base.OnRowHandleChanged(newValue);
			UpdateAllItemsSelected();
			UpdateIsChecked(fullUpdate: true);
		}

		protected internal override void OnHeaderCaptionChanged()
		{
			UpdateDisplayText();
		}

		protected internal override void OnActualHeaderWidthChange()
		{
			foreach (GridGroupSummaryColumnData fixedGroupSummaryDatum in GetFixedGroupSummaryData())
			{
				fixedGroupSummaryDatum.OnActualHeaderWidthChange();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateColumnAndValue()
		{
			if (GroupValues == null || GroupValues.Count == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<GridSortInfo> mergeSortInfos = GetMergeSortInfos();
			object[] groupValuesByNode = treeBuilder.GetGroupValuesByNode(base.DataRowNode);
			for (int i = 1; i < GroupValues.Count; i++)
			{
				if (mergeSortInfos != null && mergeSortInfos.Count > i && mergeSortInfos[i] != null)
				{
					GroupValues[i].Column = GridView.Columns[mergeSortInfos[i].FieldName];
				}
				if (groupValuesByNode != null && groupValuesByNode.Length > i)
				{
					((EditableDataObject)GroupValues[i]).Value = groupValuesByNode[i];
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateColumnAndValueCore()
		{
			if (base.DataRowNode != null)
			{
				GroupValue.Column = treeBuilder.GetGroupColumnByNode(base.DataRowNode);
				((EditableDataObject)GroupValue).Value = treeBuilder.GetGroupValueByNode(base.DataRowNode);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDisplayText(bool calcValues = true)
		{
			if (GroupValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (GroupValues.Count == 1)
			{
				UpdateDisplayTextCore(GroupValues[0], treeBuilder.GetGroupRowHeaderCaptionByNode(base.DataRowNode), calcValues ? treeBuilder.GetGroupValueByNode(base.DataRowNode) : ((EditableDataObject)GroupValues[0]).Value, (base.View != null && base.View.SearchPanelHighlightResults) ? treeBuilder.GetGroupHighlightingPropertiesByNode(base.DataRowNode) : null);
			}
			else
			{
				string[] groupRowHeadersCaptionsByNode = treeBuilder.GetGroupRowHeadersCaptionsByNode(base.DataRowNode);
				object[] array = (calcValues ? treeBuilder.GetGroupValuesByNode(base.DataRowNode) : GetGroupValues());
				GroupTextHighlightingProperties highlighting = ((base.View != null && base.View.SearchPanelHighlightResults) ? treeBuilder.GetGroupHighlightingPropertiesByNode(base.DataRowNode) : null);
				for (int i = 0; i < GroupValues.Count; i++)
				{
					string header = ((groupRowHeadersCaptionsByNode != null && groupRowHeadersCaptionsByNode.Length > i) ? groupRowHeadersCaptionsByNode[i] : null);
					object value = ((array != null && array.Length > i) ? array[i] : null);
					UpdateDisplayTextCore(GroupValues[i], header, value, highlighting);
				}
			}
			UpdateClientGroupValue();
		}

		private object[] GetGroupValues()

		}

		private bool GetIsLastVisibleElementRow(int rowHandle, bool checkParentRow)
		{
			if (!Grid.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandle))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Level > 0 && checkParentRow && GetLastRowHandle(Grid.GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle)) == rowHandle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int lastRowHandle = GetLastRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (!Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(lastRowHandle))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return GetIsLastVisibleElementRow(lastRowHandle, checkParentRow: false);
		}

		private bool GetIsLastHierarchicalRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			return base.ControllerVisibleIndex == Grid.VisibleRowCount - 1;
		}

		private bool GetIsPreviewExpanded(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (base.RowPosition == RowPosition.Top || base.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Grid.IsGroupRowExpanded(Grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(base.ControllerVisibleIndex - 1));
		}

		private int GetLastRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			return Grid.GridDataProvider.GetChildRowHandle(rowHandle, Grid.GridDataProvider.GetChildRowCount(rowHandle) - 1);
		}

		private void RefreshFixedNoneCellData(bool virtualized, bool updateGroupSummary)
		{
			base.View.PerformUpdateGroupSummaryDataAction(delegate
			{
				if (updateGroupSummary)
				{
					UpdateGroupColumnSummaries();
				}
				if (virtualized)
				{
					ITableView tableView = (ITableView)base.View;
					ReuseCellData((ColumnsRowDataBase x) => ((GroupRowData)x).FixedNoneGroupSummaryData, delegate(ColumnsRowDataBase x, IList val)
					{
						((GroupRowData)x).FixedNoneGroupSummaryData = (IList<GridGroupSummaryColumnData>)val;
					}, updateGroupSummaryDataStrategy, tableView.ViewportVisibleColumns, tableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns.Count, 0);
					UpdateHasRightSibling(tableView.ViewportVisibleColumns ?? treeBuilder.GetFixedNoneColumns());
				}
				else
				{
					ReuseGroupSummaryDataNotVirtualized((ColumnsRowDataBase x) => ((GroupRowData)x).FixedNoneGroupSummaryData, delegate(ColumnsRowDataBase x, IList val)
					{
						((GroupRowData)x).FixedNoneGroupSummaryData = (IList<GridGroupSummaryColumnData>)val;
					}, treeBuilder.GetFixedNoneColumns());
				}
			});
			if (GridView != null)
			{
				UpdateGroupSummariesCore();
			}
		}

		internal void ReuseGroupSummaryDataNotVirtualized(Func<ColumnsRowDataBase, IList<GridGroupSummaryColumnData>> getter, Action<ColumnsRowDataBase, IList> setter, IList<ColumnBase> sourceColumns)
		{
			ReuseCellDataNotVirtualized(getter, setter, updateGroupSummaryDataStrategy, sourceColumns);
			UpdateHasRightSibling(sourceColumns);
		}

		private void UpdateHasRightSibling(IList<ColumnBase> sourceColumns)
		{
			if (sourceColumns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sourceColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = sourceColumns[i];
				GridGroupSummaryColumnData gridGroupSummaryColumnData = SafeGetGroupSummaryColumnData(columnBase);
				if (gridGroupSummaryColumnData == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = columnBase.HasRightSibling;
				if (flag)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (i < sourceColumns.Count - 1)
					{
						GridGroupSummaryColumnData gridGroupSummaryColumnData2 = SafeGetGroupSummaryColumnData(sourceColumns[i + 1]);
						if (gridGroupSummaryColumnData2 != null)
						{
							flag2 = string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)((EditableDataObject)gridGroupSummaryColumnData2).Value);
						}
					}
					bool flag3 = string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)((EditableDataObject)gridGroupSummaryColumnData).Value);
					if (flag2 && flag3)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				gridGroupSummaryColumnData.HasRightSibling = flag;
			}
		}

		protected internal GridGroupSummaryColumnData SafeGetGroupSummaryColumnData(ColumnBase column)
		{
			updateGroupSummaryDataStrategy.DataCache.TryGetValue(column, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		internal void SetAllItemsSelected(bool? allItemsSelected)
		{
			UpdateAllItemsSelectedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				AllItemsSelected = allItemsSelected;
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateAllItemsSelected()
		{
			if (GridView == null || !GridView.ActualShowCheckBoxSelectorInGroupRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isSelectEnabled = true;
			bool isUnselectEnabled = true;
			SetAllItemsSelected(GridView.AreAllItemsSelected(RowHandle.Value, out isSelectEnabled, out isUnselectEnabled));
			bool enabledSelected = EnabledSelected;
			if (AllItemsSelected == true)
			{
				EnabledSelected = isUnselectEnabled;
			}
			else if (AllItemsSelected == false)
			{
				EnabledSelected = isSelectEnabled;
			}
			if (enabledSelected != EnabledSelected && base.View != null && base.View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible && base.View.CanRaiseCanSelectRow() && base.View.DataProviderBase != null && base.View.DataControl != null && RowHandle != null)
			{
				int rowParentIndex = base.View.GetRowParentIndex(base.View.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(RowHandle.Value), 0);
				if (rowParentIndex < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(rowParentIndex);
				if (base.View.GetRowData(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore) is GroupRowData groupRowData)
				{
					groupRowData.UpdateAllItemsSelected();
				}
			}
			if (base.View != null && base.View.CanRaiseCanSelectRow() && base.View.SelectionStrategy is SelectionStrategyCheckBoxRow)
			{
				SelectionStrategyCheckBoxRow selectionStrategyCheckBoxRow = (SelectionStrategyCheckBoxRow)base.View.SelectionStrategy;
				if (!selectionStrategyCheckBoxRow.CheckBoxSelectionChangedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					base.View.UpdateCheckBoxSelectorState();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnAllItemsSelectedChanged()
		{
			if (!AllItemsSelected.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateAllItemsSelectedLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				GridView.CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					if (AllItemsSelected.Value)
					{
						GridView.SelectRowRecursively(RowHandle.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						GridView.UnselectRowRecursively(RowHandle.Value);
					}
				});
			});
		}

		private void OnIsCheckedChanged()
		{
			if (IsChecked.HasValue && GridView != null && RowHandle != null && GridView.ActualShowCheckBoxInGroupRow)
			{
				IsCheckedLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					GridView.GroupIsCheckedChanged(RowHandle.Value);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateIsChecked(bool fullUpdate = false)
		{
			if (Grid == null || RowHandle == null || GridView == null || !GridView.ActualShowCheckBoxInGroupRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool? result = null;
			GroupRowInfo groupRowInfoByHandle = Grid.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(RowHandle.Value);
			List<GroupRowInfo> childrenGroups = Grid.GetChildrenGroups(groupRowInfoByHandle);
			int num = childrenGroups?.Count ?? 0;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = Grid.GetChildRowCount(RowHandle.Value);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int childRowHandle = Grid.GetChildRowHandle(RowHandle.Value, i, groupRowInfoByHandle, childrenGroups);
				if (Grid.IsGroupRowHandleCore(childRowHandle))
				{
					if (!(base.View.GetRowData(childRowHandle) is GroupRowData groupRowData))
					{
						int num2 = 0;
						foreach (int childHandle in GridView.GetChildHandles(RowHandle.Value))
						{
							if (base.View.DataControl.GetCellValue(childHandle, GridView.GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore) is bool flag)
							{
								if (num2 == 0)
								{
									result = flag;
								}
								else if (result != flag)
								{
									result = null;
									break;
								}
								num2++;
								continue;
							}
							result = null;
							break;
						}
						IsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => IsChecked = result));
						return;
					}
					if (fullUpdate)
					{
						groupRowData.UpdateIsChecked(fullUpdate: true);
					}
					if (!groupRowData.IsChecked.HasValue)
					{
						result = null;
						break;
					}
					if (i == 0)
					{
						result = groupRowData.IsChecked;
					}
					else if (result != groupRowData.IsChecked.Value)
					{
						result = null;
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(base.View.DataControl.GetCellValue(childRowHandle, GridView.GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore) is bool flag2))
					{
						result = null;
						break;
					}
					if (i == 0)
					{
						result = flag2;
					}
					else if (result != flag2)
					{
						result = null;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			IsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => IsChecked = result));
		}

		private IEnumerable<GridGroupSummaryColumnData> GetFixedGroupSummaryData()
		{
			if (FixedNoneGroupSummaryData != null)
			{
				foreach (GridGroupSummaryColumnData fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum in FixedNoneGroupSummaryData)
				{
					yield return fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum;
				}
			}
			if (FixedLeftGroupSummaryData != null)
			{
				foreach (GridGroupSummaryColumnData fixedLeftGroupSummaryDatum in FixedLeftGroupSummaryData)
				{
					yield return fixedLeftGroupSummaryDatum;
				}
			}
			if (FixedRightGroupSummaryData == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (GridGroupSummaryColumnData fixedRightGroupSummaryDatum in FixedRightGroupSummaryData)
			{
				yield return fixedRightGroupSummaryDatum;
			}
		}

		protected override GridGroupValueData GetGridGroupValueData(IList<GridSortInfo> infos, int idx)
		{
			GridGroupValueData gridGroupValueData = new GridGroupValueData(this);
			gridGroupValueData.Column = base.GridView.Columns[infos[idx].FieldName];
			if (gridGroupValueData.Column == null)
			{
				return gridGroupValueData;
			}
			gridGroupValueData.ColumnHeader = ((gridGroupValueData.Column.HeaderCaption != null) ? gridGroupValueData.Column.HeaderCaption.ToString() : gridGroupValueData.Column.FieldName);
			object[] groupDisplayValues = base.View.GetGroupDisplayValues(RowHandle.Value);
			if (groupDisplayValues != null && gridGroupValueData != null && groupDisplayValues.Length > idx && groupDisplayValues[idx] != null)
			{
				gridGroupValueData.Text = groupDisplayValues[idx].ToString();
				((EditableDataObject)gridGroupValueData).Value = groupDisplayValues[idx];
			}
			return gridGroupValueData;
		}
	}

		protected override System.Windows.Controls.Orientation OrientationCore
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return Orientation;
			}
		}

		protected override ScrollingMode ScrollingModeCore
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (ScrollMode == ScrollMode.Pixel)
				{
					return ScrollingMode.Smart;
				}
				return base.ScrollingMode;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsDesignTimeAdornerPanelLeftAligned => true;

		internal override TotalSummaryPosition TotalSummaryDefaultPosition => TotalSummaryPosition.Top;

		protected internal CardData FocusedCardData => (CardData)base.FocusedRowData;

		public CardViewCommands CardViewCommands => (CardViewCommands)base.Commands;

		private ScrollInfoBase ScrollInfo => base.DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.DefineSizeScrollInfo;

		private bool SearchInHorizontalRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (Orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool SearchInVerticalRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (Orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private DependencyObject CurrNavigationObject
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.CurrentCell == null)
				{
					return base.FocusedRowElement;
				}
				return base.CurrentCell;
			}
		}

		internal double CardsPanelMaxSize
		{
			get
			{
				CardsHierarchyPanel cardsHierarchyPanel = (CardsHierarchyPanel)LayoutHelper.FindElement(base.DataPresenter.ContentElement, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement e) => e is CardsHierarchyPanel));
				return cardsHierarchyPanel.MaxSecondarySize;
			}
		}

		internal double CardsPanelViewPort
		{
			get
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(base.DataPresenter.ActualWidth, base.DataPresenter.ActualHeight);
				return base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(size);
			}
		}

		private CardsHierarchyPanel CardsHierarchyPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DataPresenter == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.DataPresenter.Panel as CardsHierarchyPanel;
			}
		}

		{
			protected internal get

				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ForceShowTotalSummaryColumnName
		{
			protected internal get

				return true;
			}
		}

		internal List<CardRowInfo> CardRowInfoCollection => CardsHierarchyPanel.RowsInfo;

		internal double GetRowOffset => CardsHierarchyPanel.GetRowOffset();

		private CardViewBehavior CardViewBehavior => base.ViewBehavior as CardViewBehavior;

		protected internal override bool IsGroupRowOptimized
		{
			get
			{
				if (CardViewBehavior != null)
				{
					return CardViewBehavior.UseLightweightTemplatesHasFlag(UseCardLightweightTemplates.GroupRow);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldDisplayLoadingRow
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return base.ShowLoadingRow;
			}
		}

		static CardView()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(CardView);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<CardView>();
			ScrollModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollMode", typeof(ScrollMode), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(ScrollMode.Pixel, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).OnAllowPerPixelScrollingChanged();
			}));
			FocusedCardBorderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FocusedCardBorderTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			FocusedCellBorderCardViewTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FocusedCellBorderCardViewTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			VerticalFocusedGroupRowBorderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalFocusedGroupRowBorderTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			FixedSizeProperty = CardsPanel.FixedSizeProperty.AddOwner(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateIsResizingEnabled();
			}, (DependencyObject d, object baseValue) => Math.Max((double)baseValue, ((CardView)d).MinFixedSize)));
			MaxCardCountInRowProperty = CardsPanel.MaxCardCountInRowProperty.AddOwner(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(int.MaxValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.CoerceValue(CollapsedCardOrientationProperty);
			}, (DependencyObject d, object baseValue) => ((int)baseValue <= 0) ? ((CardView)d).MaxCardCountInRow : ((int)baseValue)));
			CardAlignmentProperty = CardsPanel.CardAlignmentProperty.AddOwner(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)(Alignment)0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null, null));
			CardLayoutProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardLayout", typeof(CardLayout), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OrientationToCardLayout(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).OnCardLayoutChanged();
			}));
			OrientationPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Orientation", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal));
			OrientationProperty = OrientationPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CardMarginProperty = CardsPanel.CardMarginProperty.AddOwner(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null, null));
			ShowCardExpandButtonProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowCardExpandButton", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			MinFixedSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinFixedSize", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(10.0, null, CoerceMinFixedSize));
			AllowCardResizingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowCardResizing", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateIsResizingEnabled();
			}));
			IsResizingEnabledPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("IsResizingEnabled", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
			IsResizingEnabledProperty = IsResizingEnabledPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CardTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateActualCardTemplateSelector();
			}));
			CardTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateActualCardTemplateSelector();
			}));
			ActualCardTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualCardTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualCardTemplateSelectorProperty = ActualCardTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CardHeaderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardHeaderTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateActualCardHeaderTemplateSelector();
			}));
			CardHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardHeaderTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateActualCardHeaderTemplateSelector();
			}));
			ActualCardHeaderTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualCardHeaderTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualCardHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty = ActualCardHeaderTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CardRowTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardRowTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateActualCardRowTemplateSelector();
			}));
			CardRowTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardRowTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateActualCardRowTemplateSelector();
			}));
			ActualCardRowTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualCardRowTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualCardRowTemplateSelectorProperty = ActualCardRowTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SeparatorTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeparatorTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			SeparatorThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeparatorThickness", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(7.0));
			CardStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			MultiSelectModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MultiSelectMode", typeof(CardViewSelectMode), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(CardViewSelectMode.None, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).OnMultiSelectModeChanged();
			}));
			CollapsedCardOrientationPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CollapsedCardOrientation", typeof(CollapsedCardOrientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(CollapsedCardOrientation.Horizontal, null, CoerceCollapsedCardOrientation));
			CollapsedCardOrientationProperty = CollapsedCardOrientationPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeFromHandle, new CommandBinding(GridCommands.ChangeCardExpanded, delegate(object d, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).OnChangeCardExpanded(e);
			}));
			UseLightweightTemplatesProperty = CardViewBehavior.RegisterUseLightweightTemplatesProperty(typeFromHandle);
			LeftGroupAreaIndentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LeftGroupAreaIndent", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardView)d).UpdateColumnsPositions();
			}));
			PrintCardRowTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardRowTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			PrintCardTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			PrintCardContentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			PrintCardHeaderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardHeaderTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			PrintCardViewItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardViewItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			PrintCardRowIndentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardRowIndentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			PrintCardMarginProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintCardMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(20.0, 0.0, 0.0, 20.0)));
			PrintAutoCardWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintAutoCardWidth", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(false));
			PrintMaximumCardColumnsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintMaximumCardColumns", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(-1));
			PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, DataViewBase.OnUpdateColumnsAppearance));
		}

		private static object CoerceCollapsedCardOrientation(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			CardView cardView = (CardView)d;
			CollapsedCardOrientation collapsedCardOrientation = CollapsedCardOrientation.Horizontal;
			if ((cardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Rows && cardView.MaxCardCountInRow != 1) || (cardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Columns && cardView.MaxCardCountInRow == 1))
			{
				collapsedCardOrientation = CollapsedCardOrientation.Vertical;
			}
			if (!IsDefaultFixedSize(cardView.FixedSize))
			{
				if (cardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Rows)
				{
					collapsedCardOrientation = CollapsedCardOrientation.Vertical;
				}
				if (cardView.CardLayout == CardLayout.Columns)
				{
					collapsedCardOrientation = CollapsedCardOrientation.Horizontal;
				}
			}
			return collapsedCardOrientation;
		}

		private static bool IsDefaultFixedSize(double size)
		{
			if (DoubleExtension.IsNotNumber(double.NaN))
			{
				return DoubleExtension.IsNotNumber(size);
			}
			return size == double.NaN;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Controls.Orientation CardLayoutToOrientation(CardLayout cardLayout)
		{
			if (cardLayout != CardLayout.Columns)
			{
				return System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical;
			}
			return System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
		}

		internal static CardLayout OrientationToCardLayout(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (orientation != System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return CardLayout.Rows;
			}
			return CardLayout.Columns;
		}

		private static object CoerceMinFixedSize(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			CardView cardView = (CardView)d;
			double num = Math.Max((double)baseValue, cardView.MinFixedSize);
			cardView.FixedSize = Math.Max(cardView.FixedSize, num);
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldProcessObjectByLocation(System.Windows.Point currLoc, System.Windows.Point loc, NavObjectDirection dir)
		{
			return dir switch
			{
				NavObjectDirection.Top => currLoc.Y > loc.Y, 
				NavObjectDirection.Bottom => currLoc.Y < loc.Y, 
				NavObjectDirection.Left => currLoc.X > loc.X, 
				NavObjectDirection.Right => currLoc.X < loc.X, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual DependencyObject FindNearNavObject(DependencyObject currObj, NavObjectDirection dir, bool processCells, bool searchInCurrentCardRow)
		{
			if (!(currObj is UIElement uIElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CardsHierarchyPanel.TryFindRowElement(base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle), out var rowIndex, out var _))
			{
				rowIndex = ((dir == NavObjectDirection.Left || dir == NavObjectDirection.Top) ? (CardsHierarchyPanel.RowsInfo.Count - 1) : 0);
			}
			DependencyObject result = null;
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(uIElement, (UIElement)CardsHierarchyPanel);
			Rect nearRect = Rect.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < CardsHierarchyPanel.RowsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				CardRowInfo cardRowInfo = CardsHierarchyPanel.RowsInfo[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < cardRowInfo.Elements.Count; j++)
				{
					RowData rowData = (RowData)cardRowInfo.Elements[j];
					FrameworkElement rowElement = rowData.RowElement;
					CardData cardData = rowData as CardData;
					bool flag = false;
					if (processCells && !(rowElement.DataContext is GroupRowData) && (cardData == null || cardData.IsExpanded) && (!searchInCurrentCardRow || rowIndex == i))
					{
						GridCellsEnumerator gridCellsEnumerator = new GridCellsEnumerator(rowElement);
						while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)gridCellsEnumerator).MoveNext())
						{
							flag = true;
							if (((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current == uIElement)
							{
								continue;
							}
							int currentNavigationIndex = gridCellsEnumerator.CurrentNavigationIndex;
							if (currentNavigationIndex < base.VisibleColumns.Count && base.VisibleColumns[currentNavigationIndex].AllowFocus)
							{
								Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current as UIElement, (UIElement)CardsHierarchyPanel);
								if (ShouldProcessObjectByLocation(relativeElementRect.TopLeft, relativeElementRect2.TopLeft, dir) && IsBetterRect(relativeElementRect, nearRect, relativeElementRect2, dir))
								{
									result = ((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current;
									nearRect = relativeElementRect2;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag && rowElement.IsVisible && rowElement != uIElement)
					{
						Rect relativeElementRect3 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)rowElement, (UIElement)CardsHierarchyPanel);
						if (ShouldProcessObjectByLocation(relativeElementRect.TopLeft, relativeElementRect3.TopLeft, dir) && IsBetterRect(relativeElementRect, nearRect, relativeElementRect3, dir))
						{
							result = rowElement;
							nearRect = relativeElementRect3;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsBetterRect(Rect lastNavRect, Rect nearRect, Rect currentRect, NavObjectDirection dir)
		{
			if (nearRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double rectDistance = GetRectDistance(lastNavRect, nearRect, dir, reverse: true);
			double rectDistance2 = GetRectDistance(lastNavRect, currentRect, dir, reverse: true);
			double rectDistance3 = GetRectDistance(lastNavRect, nearRect, dir, reverse: false);
			double rectDistance4 = GetRectDistance(lastNavRect, currentRect, dir, reverse: false);
			if (rectDistance3 > rectDistance4 && !Intersects(lastNavRect, nearRect, dir, reverse: false))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (rectDistance3 < rectDistance4 && !Intersects(lastNavRect, currentRect, dir, reverse: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (RectHelper.TopLeft(lastNavRect) - RectHelper.TopLeft(nearRect)).Length > (RectHelper.TopLeft(lastNavRect) - RectHelper.TopLeft(currentRect)).Length;
		}

		private double GetRectDistance(Rect rect1, Rect rect2, NavObjectDirection dir, bool reverse)
		{
			if ((dir == NavObjectDirection.Left || dir == NavObjectDirection.Right) ^ reverse)
			{
				return Math.Abs(RectExtension.CenterY(rect1) - RectExtension.CenterY(rect2));
			}
			return Math.Abs(RectExtension.CenterX(rect1) - RectExtension.CenterX(rect2));
		}

		private bool Intersects(Rect rect1, Rect rect2, NavObjectDirection dir, bool reverse)
		{
			if ((dir == NavObjectDirection.Left || dir == NavObjectDirection.Right) ^ reverse)
			{
				if (rect1.Top < rect2.Bottom)
				{
					return rect1.Bottom > rect2.Top;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (rect1.Left < rect2.Right)
			{
				return rect1.Right > rect2.Left;
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		}

		protected internal virtual void MoveNextRowCard()
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = FindNearNextRow(base.FocusedRowElement);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				MoveFocusedRow(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(dependencyObject).Value), NavigationType.Next);
			}
			else
			{
				MoveNextCard();
			}
		}

		private void MoveNextCard()
		{
			if (IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds() && (double)ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(base.FocusedRowHandle)) < ScrollInfo.Extent - 1.0)
			{
				MoveFocusedRow(Math.Min((int)ScrollInfo.Extent - 1, base.ScrollInfoOwner.Offset + base.ScrollInfoOwner.ItemsOnPage), NavigationType.Next);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void MovePrevRowCard()
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = FindNearPrevRow(base.FocusedRowElement);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				MoveFocusedRow(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(dependencyObject).Value), NavigationType.Prev);
			}
			else
			{
				MovePrevCard();
			}
		}

		private bool MovePrevCard()
		{
			if (!IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(base.FocusedRowHandle)) <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = Math.Max(0, CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcGenerateItemsOffset(base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset - 1.0)) + PageOffset;
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndex = base.Grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(num);
			if (!base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndex))
			{
				if (CardsHierarchyPanel.TryFindRowElement(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(base.FocusedRowHandle), out var rowIndex, out var elementIndex) && rowIndex == 0 && base.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
				{
					num += elementIndex;
				}
				rowHandleByVisibleIndex = base.Grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(num);
			}
			MoveFocusedRow(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndex));
			return true;
		}

		protected override void MoveNextPageCore()
		{
			int num = (int)(ScrollInfo.Offset + Math.Max(1.0, ScrollInfo.Viewport) - 1.0);
			int num2 = (int)CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcExtent(base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(base.DataPresenter.LastConstraint), base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle) - PageOffset);
			if ((double)num2 < ScrollInfo.Offset || (double)num2 > ScrollInfo.Offset + ScrollInfo.Viewport)
			{
				num2 = (int)ScrollInfo.Offset;
			}
			if (num2 >= num && ScrollInfo.Offset + ScrollInfo.Viewport < ScrollInfo.Extent && (double)num2 <= Math.Ceiling(ScrollInfo.Offset + ScrollInfo.Viewport))
			{
				double num3 = ((ScrollInfo.Viewport < 2.0) ? 1.0 : (Math.Floor(ScrollInfo.Viewport) - ScrollInfo.Viewport));
				ScrollInfo.SetOffset((double)num + num3);
				EnqueueImmediateAction((IAction)(object)new FocusFirstRowAfterPageDownCardView(this));
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFocusedRowToLastScrollRow();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void MoveFocusedRowToLastScrollRow()
		{
			int num = (int)(ScrollInfo.Offset + Math.Max(1.0, ScrollInfo.Viewport) - 1.0);
			int num2 = CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcGenerateItemsOffset(num) + PageOffset;
			if (base.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling && CardsHierarchyPanel.TryFindRowElement(base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle), out var rowIndex, out var elementIndex))
			{
				num2 += elementIndex;
				int num3 = (IsPagingMode ? LastVisibleIndexOnPage : (base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1));
				if (rowIndex + (int)ScrollInfo.Offset == num || num2 > num3)
				{
					num2 = num3;
				}
			}
			if (num2 != base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				FocusViewAndRow(this, base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num2), NavigationType.Last);
				base.SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationComplete(isTabPressed: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void MovePrevPageCore()
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Min(Math.Ceiling(ScrollInfo.Offset), ScrollInfo.Extent - 1.0);
			int num2 = (int)CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcExtent(base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(base.DataPresenter.LastConstraint), base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle) - PageOffset);
			if (num2 <= num && ScrollInfo.Offset > 0.0 && num2 >= (int)ScrollInfo.Offset)
			{
				double num3 = ((ScrollInfo.Viewport < 1.0) ? 1.0 : (Math.Floor(ScrollInfo.Viewport) - 1.0));
				ScrollInfo.SetOffset((double)num - num3);
				EnqueueImmediateAction((IAction)(object)new ScrollAndFocusFirstAfterPageUpCardView(this, base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle), 0));
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFocusedRowToFirstScrollRow();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void MoveFocusedRowToFirstScrollRow()
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Min(Math.Ceiling(ScrollInfo.Offset), ScrollInfo.Extent - 1.0);
			int num2 = CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcGenerateItemsOffset(num) + PageOffset;
			if (base.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling && CardsHierarchyPanel.TryFindRowElement(base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle), out var rowIndex, out var elementIndex))
			{
				num2 += elementIndex;
				if (rowIndex + (int)ScrollInfo.Offset == num)
				{
					num2 = (IsPagingMode ? FirstVisibleIndexOnPage : 0);
				}
			}
			if (num2 != base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(base.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				FocusViewAndRow(this, base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num2), NavigationType.First);
				base.SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationComplete(isTabPressed: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateNavigationIndex(DependencyObject dobj, NavObjectDirection loc)
		{
			if (dobj == null)
			{
				if ((Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical && loc == NavObjectDirection.Top) || (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal && loc == NavObjectDirection.Left))
				{
					if (MovePrevCard())
					{
						base.NavigationIndex = base.VisibleColumns.Count - 1;
					}
				}
				else if ((Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical && loc == NavObjectDirection.Bottom) || (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal && loc == NavObjectDirection.Right))
				{
					MoveNextCard();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RowHandle rowHandle = DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(DataViewBase.FindParentRow(dobj));
				if (rowHandle != null && rowHandle.Value != DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(base.FocusedRowElement).Value)
				{
					MoveFocusedRow(base.Grid.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandle.Value), (loc == NavObjectDirection.Left || loc == NavObjectDirection.Top) ? NavigationType.Prev : NavigationType.Next);
				}
				if (ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dobj) != int.MinValue)
				{
					base.NavigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dobj);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override int ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (CardsHierarchyPanel == null)
			{
				return visibleIndex;
			}
			return (int)CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcExtent(base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(base.DataPresenter.LastConstraint), visibleIndex - PageOffset);
		}

		protected internal override void ScrollToHorizontalOffset(double offset, bool useAccumulator)
		{
			FrameworkElement firstVisibleRowElement = null;
			if (base.DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll(out firstVisibleRowElement))
			{
				double correctedDelta = base.DataPresenter.accumulatorHorizontal.GetCorrectedDelta(useAccumulator, firstVisibleRowElement.ActualWidth, 0.0 - offset);
				base.ViewBehavior.ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(correctedDelta);
			}
		}

		}

		internal void GetDataRowTextCore(StringBuilder sb, int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				string cardHeaderText = GetCardHeaderText(rowHandle);
				if (cardHeaderText != null)
				{
					sb.Append(cardHeaderText);
					sb.Append("\r\n");
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				string empty2 = string.Empty;
				if (ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders && !base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
				{
					sb.Append(GetTextForClipboard(int.MinValue, i));
					sb.Append("\t");
				}
				sb.Append(GetTextForClipboard(rowHandle, i));
				sb.Append("\r\n");
				if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetCardHeaderText(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (cardHeaderData == null)
			{
				cardHeaderData = new CardHeaderData();
			}
			cardHeaderData.Data = DataProviderBase.GetWpfRow(new RowHandle(rowHandle));
			cardHeaderData.Binding = CardHeaderBinding;
			cardHeaderData.RowData = GetRowData(rowHandle);
			return cardHeaderData.Value as string;
		}

		protected override SelectionStrategyBase CreateSelectionStrategy()
		{
			if (base.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.None)
			{
				return new SelectionStrategyNavigationNone(this);
			}
			if (base.IsMultiRowSelection)
			{
				if (base.DataControl != null && base.ShowSelectionRectangle && !base.AllowDragDrop)
				{
					return new SelectionStrategyRowRange(this);
				}
				return new SelectionStrategyRow(this);
			}
			return new SelectionStrategyNone(this);
		}

		{

				base.FocusRectPresenter.SizeExpansion = value;

		protected internal override bool ShouldChangeForwardIndex(int rowHandle)
		{
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			return GetRowElementByVisibleIndex(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore) != null;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetRowElementByVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			return GetRowElementByRowHandle(base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex));
		}

		protected internal override double CalcOffsetForward(int rowHandle, bool perPixelScrolling)
		{
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(rowHandle);
			if (rowData == null || CardsHierarchyPanel == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = GetItemInvisibleSize(rowData.WholeRowElement) - CardsHierarchyPanel.GetRowOffset();
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < CardsHierarchyPanel.RowsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				CardRowInfo cardRowInfo = CardsHierarchyPanel.RowsInfo[i];
				double defineSize = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(cardRowInfo.RenderSize);
				if (defineSize >= num)
				{
					return num2 + num / defineSize;
				}
				num -= defineSize;
				num2 += 1.0;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetElementDefineOffset(FrameworkElement elem)
		{
			return base.SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(RectHelper.Location(LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)elem, (UIElement)base.DataPresenter)));
		}

	public class GridColumnCollection : ColumnCollectionBase<GridColumn>
	{
		private GridControl grid => (GridControl)((IColumnCollection)this).Owner;

		public GridColumnCollection(GridControl grid)
			: base((DataControlBase)grid)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveItem(GridColumn column)
		{
			if (!grid.IsDeserializing && !grid.IsDesignColumnMoverApplyActive)
			{
				if (column.IsGrouped)
				{
					grid.ActualGroupCountCore = Math.Max(0, grid.ActualGroupCountCore - 1);
					grid.ActualLevelCount = Math.Max(0, grid.ActualLevelCount - 1);
				}
				grid.UngroupBy(column);
				if (grid.SortInfo[column.FieldName] != null)
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)grid.SortInfo).Remove(grid.SortInfo[column.FieldName]);
				}
				GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = ((IEnumerable<GridSortInfo>)grid.ActualSortInfoCore).FirstOrDefault((GridSortInfo info) => info.FieldName == column.FieldName);
				if (gridSortInfo != null)
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)grid.ActualSortInfoCore).Remove(gridSortInfo);
				}
			}
			base.OnRemoveItem(column);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			if (!grid.IsDeserializing && !grid.IsDesignColumnMoverApplyActive)
			{
				grid.GroupCount = 0;
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}
	}
	public class GridColumnHeader : BaseGridColumnHeader
	{
		private HeaderFilterEditControl FilterEditor;

		private HeaderFilterDisplayControl FilterDisplay;

		private Lazy<DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase> defaultFilterHitTestAcceptor = new Lazy<DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase>(() => new ColumnHeaderFilterButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());

		private Lazy<DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase> groupPanelFilterHitTestAcceptor = new Lazy<DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase>(() => new GroupPanelColumnHeaderFilterButtonTableViewHitTestAcceptor());

		internal virtual bool EnableAutoFilterRowHeader => true;

		static GridColumnHeader()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridColumnHeader>();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateHeaderAutoFilterRow();
		}

		protected override bool CanShowHeaderAutoFilter()
		{
			if (EnableAutoFilterRowHeader && base.Column != null && base.Column.AllowAutoFilter && base.Column.ActualAllowAutoFilter && !base.Column.IsServiceColumn() && base.GridView is ITableView && ((ITableView)base.GridView).ShowAutoFilterRow && ((ITableView)base.GridView).AutoFilterRowPosition == AutoFilterRowPosition.Header)
			{
				return base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override TextBlock CreateTextBlock()
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = base.CreateTextBlock();
			if (base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers)
			{
				AddVisiblityBinding(textBlock);
			}
			return textBlock;
		}

		private void AddVisiblityBinding(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (base.Column != null && base.Column.View is ITableView)
			{
				MultiBinding multiBinding = new MultiBinding
				{
					Converter = new AutoFilterRowVisibilityConverter
					{
						InHeaderState = AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit,
						Position = AutoFilterRowPosition.Header,
						TrueValue = Visibility.Collapsed,
						FalseValue = Visibility.Visible
					}
				};
				multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ShowAutoFilterRow")
				{
					Source = base.Column.View
				});
				multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new System.Windows.Data.Binding("AutoFilterRowPosition")
				{
					Source = base.Column.View
				});
				multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new System.Windows.Data.Binding("AutoFilterHeaderState")
				{
					Source = base.Column
				});
				element.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, multiBinding);
			}
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateSortIndicator()
		{
			return new SortIndicatorControl();
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateHeaderFilterEditor()
		{
			if (FilterEditor == null && IsAutoFilterHeaderEditMode())
			{
				FilterEditor = new HeaderFilterEditControl(base.Column);
			}
			return FilterEditor;
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateHeaderFilterDisplay()
		{
			if (CanShowHeaderAutoFilter() && base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Display && FilterDisplay == null)
			{
				FilterDisplay = new HeaderFilterDisplayControl(base.Column);
			}
			if (base.Column != null && base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers && !base.Column.IsServiceColumn())
			{
				base.KeyDown += OnHeaderKeyDown;
				base.KeyUp += OnHeaderKeyUp;
			}
			return FilterDisplay;
		}

		private void OnHeaderKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Tab)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (FilterEditor != null)
			{
				base.Column.SetAutoFilterValue(FilterEditor.Editor.EditValue);
			}
			e.Handled = true;
			GridViewBase view = base.Column.View as GridViewBase;
			bool flag = ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e));
			int visibleIndex = base.Column.VisibleIndex;
			int newIndex = (flag ? (visibleIndex - 1) : (visibleIndex + 1));
			GridColumn gridColumn = ((IEnumerable<GridColumn>)view.Columns).FirstOrDefault((GridColumn x) => x.VisibleIndex == newIndex);
			if (gridColumn != null)
			{
				((ITableView)base.Column.View).TableViewBehavior.MakeColumnVisible(gridColumn);
				view.DataControl.CurrentColumn = gridColumn;
				view.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					view.ShowEditor();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnHeaderKeyUp(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsAutoFilterHeaderEditMode()
		{
			if (CanShowHeaderAutoFilter())
			{
				return base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnColumnContentChanged(object sender, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnColumnContentChanged(sender, e);
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.AutoFilterHeaderStateProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.ActualAllowAutoFilterProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.AutoFilterCriteriaProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.AutoFilterValueProperty || e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty)
			{
				UpdateAutoFilter();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAutoFilter()
		{
			UpdateHeaderFilterDisplay();
			UpdateHeaderFilterEditor();
			UpdateHeaderAutoFilterRow();
			UpdateColumnFilterPopup(allowHide: true);
			UpdateSortIndicators();
		}

		protected override void OnGridColumnChanged(BaseColumn oldValue)
		{
			base.OnGridColumnChanged(oldValue);
			if (FilterEditor != null)
			{
				FilterEditor.Column = base.Column;
			}
			if (FilterDisplay != null)
			{
				FilterDisplay.Column = base.Column;
				if (oldValue != null && base.Column != null)
				{
					ClearHeaderContentsVisibilityBindings();
					SetHeaderContentsVisibilityBindings();
				}
			}
			UpdateAutoFilter();
		}

		private void SetHeaderContentsVisibilityBindings()
		{
			if (base.TextBlock != null && base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers)
			{
				AddVisiblityBinding(base.TextBlock);
			}
			if (base.HeaderPresenter != null)
			{
				AddVisiblityBinding(base.HeaderPresenter);
			}
		}

		private void ClearHeaderContentsVisibilityBindings()
		{
			if (base.TextBlock != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(base.TextBlock);
			}
			if (base.HeaderPresenter != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(base.HeaderPresenter);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHeaderAutoFilterRow()
		{
			if (base.Column != null && base.Column.View is ITableView)
			{
				if (FilterDisplay != null)
				{
					FilterDisplay.Visibility = ((!CanShowHeaderAutoFilter() || base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState != AutoFilterHeaderState.Display) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					FilterDisplay.Update();
				}
				if (FilterEditor != null)
				{
					FilterEditor.Visibility = ((!IsAutoFilterHeaderEditMode()) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					FilterEditor.Update();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateSortIndicator(bool isAscending)
		{
			if (base.SortIndicator is SortIndicatorControl sortIndicatorControl)
			{
				sortIndicatorControl.SortOrder = ((!isAscending) ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
			}
		}

		protected override Thumb CreateGripper()
		{
			return (Thumb)(object)new GridThumb();
		}

		protected override XPFContentControl CreateCustomHeaderPresenter()
		{
			HeaderContentControl headerContentControl = new HeaderContentControl();
			AddVisiblityBinding((FrameworkElement)(object)headerContentControl);
			return (XPFContentControl)(object)headerContentControl;
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateDesignTimeSelectionControl()
		{
			return new DesignTimeSelectionControl
			{
				IsTabStop = false
			};
		}

		protected override void SetFilterHitTestAcceptor(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptor((DependencyObject)(object)popup, (base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel) ? groupPanelFilterHitTestAcceptor.Value : defaultFilterHitTestAcceptor.Value);
		}
	}

	public class HeaderFilterDisplayControl : BaseHeaderFilterControl
	{
		private ToggleButton searchToggle;

		static HeaderFilterDisplayControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<HeaderFilterDisplayControl>();
		}

		public HeaderFilterDisplayControl(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (searchToggle != null)
			{
				searchToggle.Checked -= OnSearchToggleChecked;
			}
			searchToggle = (ToggleButton)GetTemplateChild("PART_SearchToggle");
			if (base.Column.AutoFilterRowDisplayTemplate != null)
			{
				searchToggle.Template = base.Column.AutoFilterRowDisplayTemplate;
			}
			base.GotKeyboardFocus += OnSearchToggleGotKeyboardFocus;
			searchToggle.Checked += OnSearchToggleChecked;
			Update();
		}

		internal override void ColumnChange()
		{
			if (base.Column != null)
			{
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			if (searchToggle != null)
			{
				searchToggle.IsChecked = base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState != AutoFilterHeaderState.Display;
				searchToggle.IsChecked = base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState != AutoFilterHeaderState.Display;
				searchToggle.Content = ((base.Column.AutoFilterValue != null) ? DisplayCriteriaHelper.GetColumnDisplayText(DataControlBase.CreateDisplayCriteriaHelperClient(base.Column.View), base.Column.FieldName, base.Column.RoundDateTimeForColumnFilter, base.Column.AutoFilterValue) : null);
			}
		}

		private void OnSearchToggleChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState != AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit)
			{
				base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState = AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit;
			}
		}

		private void OnSearchToggleGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ITableView)base.Column.View).TableViewBehavior.MakeColumnVisible(base.Column);
			base.Column.View.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
			{
				searchToggle.IsChecked = true;
			});
		}
	}
	public class HeaderFilterEditControl : BaseHeaderFilterControl
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey EditorPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EditorProperty;

		public BaseEdit Editor
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return (BaseEdit)GetValue(EditorProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
