			}
		}

		public bool IsFocusedCell => true;

		static HeaderFilterEditControl()
		{

			EditorProperty = EditorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<HeaderFilterEditControl>();
		}

		public HeaderFilterEditControl(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		internal override void ColumnChange()
		{
			//IL_00fc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01af: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b9: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (base.Column != null)
			{
				if (Editor != null)
				{
					UnsubscribeEvents();
				}
				IBaseEdit obj = FilterRowCellEditor.CreateFilterRowCellEditor(base.Column, base.Column.ActualEditSettings);
				Editor = (BaseEdit)(object)((obj is BaseEdit) ? obj : null);
				Editor.ShowBorder = false;
				if (Editor is CheckEdit)
				{
					((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)Editor).Padding = new Thickness(0.0);
					((FrameworkElement)(object)Editor).HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
				}
				if (Editor is ButtonEdit)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)Editor).SetBinding(ButtonEdit.NullValueButtonPlacementProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode")
					{
						Source = base.Column.View,
						Converter = new AutoFilterRowHeaderButtonPlacementConverter(),
						ConverterParameter = ((ButtonEditSettings)base.Column.ActualEditSettings).NullValueButtonPlacement
					});
				}
				((FrameworkElement)(object)Editor).SetBinding(BaseEdit.EditValuePostModeProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ImmediateUpdateAutoFilter")
				{
					Source = base.Column,
					Converter = (IValueConverter)new BoolToObjectConverter
					{
						FalseValue = (object)(PostMode)0,
						TrueValue = (object)(PostMode)1
					}
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)Editor).SetBinding(BaseEdit.EditValuePostDelayProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("FilterRowDelay")
				{
					Source = base.Column.View
				});
				if (base.Column.View != null && base.Column.View.IsTreeView)
				{
					Editor.NullText = base.Column.View.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlRuntimeStringId.AutoFilterNullText.ToString());
				}
				Editor.EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnFilterEditorValueChanged);
				((UIElement)(object)Editor).KeyDown += OnEditorKeyDown;
				base.LostKeyboardFocus += OnLostKeyboardFocus;
				if (base.Column.AutoFilterRowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					Editor.EditTemplate = base.Column.AutoFilterRowEditTemplate;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return || e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Return)
				{
					base.Column.SetAutoFilterValue(Editor.EditValue);
				}
				if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
				{
					Editor.EditValue = base.Column.AutoFilterValue;
				}
				base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState = AutoFilterHeaderState.Display;
				base.Column.View.Focus();
			}
		}

		internal override void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings((DependencyObject)(object)Editor);
				Editor.EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnFilterEditorValueChanged);
				((UIElement)(object)Editor).KeyDown += OnEditorKeyDown;
				base.LostKeyboardFocus -= OnLostKeyboardFocus;
				Editor = null;
			}
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			if (base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit)
			{
				Editor.EditValue = base.Column.AutoFilterValue;
				((UIElement)(object)Editor).Focus();
			}
		}

		private void OnFilterEditorValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Column.ImmediateUpdateAutoFilter && base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit)
			{
				SetFilterValue();
			}
		}

		private void OnLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit && !(e.NewFocus is System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu))
			{
				SetFilterValue();
				base.Column.AutoFilterHeaderState = AutoFilterHeaderState.Display;
			}
		}

		private void SetFilterValue()
		{
			base.Column.SetAutoFilterValue(Editor.EditValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseHeaderFilterControl : ContentControl
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ColumnPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Column", typeof(ColumnBase), typeof(BaseHeaderFilterControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnColumnChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnProperty = ColumnPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public ICommand ClearCommand { get; }

		public ColumnBase Column
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColumnBase)GetValue(ColumnProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ColumnPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnColumnChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BaseHeaderFilterControl baseHeaderFilterControl = (BaseHeaderFilterControl)d;
			baseHeaderFilterControl.UnsubscribeEvents();
			baseHeaderFilterControl.ColumnChange();
		}

		public BaseHeaderFilterControl(ColumnBase column)
		{
			Column = column;
			ClearCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				Column.AutoFilterValue = null;
			});
		}

		internal virtual void ColumnChange()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
		}

		internal ITableView GetView()
		{
			return (ITableView)Column.View;
		}
	}
	public class HeaderImageControl : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ImageProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ImageStyleProperty;

		[TypeConverter(typeof(SvgImageSourceConverter))]
		public ImageSource Image
		{
			get
			{
				return (ImageSource)GetValue(ImageProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ImageProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Style ImageStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (Style)GetValue(ImageStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ImageStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static HeaderImageControl()
		{
			ImageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Image", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(HeaderImageControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ImageStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ImageStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(HeaderImageControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(HeaderImageControl);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<HeaderImageControl>();
		}

		internal static DataTemplate CreateTemplate(ColumnBase column, DataTemplate headerContenTemplate = null)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(HeaderImageControl));
			frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ImageProperty, column.Image);
			frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, column.HeaderCaption);
			if (headerContenTemplate != null)
			{
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, headerContenTemplate);
			}
			else
			{
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, column.ActualHeaderTemplateSelector);
			}
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = new DataTemplate();
			dataTemplate.VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory;
			dataTemplate.Seal();
			return dataTemplate;
		}
	}
	public class GridColumnToGridColumnDataConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is ColumnBase { View: not null } columnBase && columnBase.View.HeadersData != null)
			{
				return columnBase.View.HeadersData.GetCellDataByColumn(columnBase);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class GroupPanelPaddingConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public double Offset { get; set; }

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(value);
			return new Thickness(0.0, Offset * ((num >= 0.0) ? num : 0.0), 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}

	public class GroupPanelColumnHeaderDropTargetFactory : ColumnHeaderDropTargetFactory, IDropTargetFactoryEx
	{
		protected override IDropTarget CreateDropTargetCore(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel)
		{
			return (IDropTarget)(object)new GroupPanelDropTarget(panel, mouseOverTargetPanel: true);
		}

		protected override bool IsCompatibleDataControl(DataControlBase sourceDataControl, DataControlBase targetDataControl)
		{
			return sourceDataControl.GetRootDataControl() == targetDataControl.GetRootDataControl();
		}

		IDropTarget IDropTargetFactoryEx.CreateDropTarget(UIElement dropTargetElement, UIElement sourceElement)
		{
			BaseGridColumnHeader baseGridColumnHeader = (BaseGridColumnHeader)sourceElement;
			DataControlBase dataControl = baseGridColumnHeader.GridView.DataControl;
			if (!((GridViewBase)dataControl.DataView).ShowGroupPanel)
			{
				return EmptyDropTarget.Instance;
			}
			GroupPanelControl groupPanelControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<GroupPanelControl>((DependencyObject)dropTargetElement);
			if (groupPanelControl == null)
			{
				return (IDropTarget)(object)new GroupPanelDropTarget((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)dropTargetElement, mouseOverTargetPanel: true);
			}
			GroupPanelContainer groupPanelContainer = GetGroupPanelContainer(groupPanelControl, (FrameworkElement)dropTargetElement, dataControl);
			if (groupPanelContainer == null)
			{
				return EmptyDropTarget.Instance;
			}
			GroupPanelColumnItemsControl groupPanelColumnItemsControl = (GroupPanelColumnItemsControl)(object)groupPanelContainer.GetTemplateChildInternal("groupPanelItemsControl");
			System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel = (System.Windows.Controls.Panel)LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)(object)groupPanelColumnItemsControl, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement e) => e is System.Windows.Controls.Panel));
			return (IDropTarget)(object)new GroupPanelDropTarget(panel, panel == dropTargetElement);
		}

		private GroupPanelContainer GetGroupPanelContainer(GroupPanelControl groupPanelControl, FrameworkElement dropTargetElement, DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			GroupPanelContainer groupPanelContainer = GetGroupPanelContainer(groupPanelControl, dataControl.DataView.EventTargetView);
			DataControlBase rootDataControl = dataControl.GetRootDataControl();
			if (groupPanelContainer != null && ((GridViewBase)dataControl.DataView.EventTargetView).ActualShowGroupPanel)
			{
				return groupPanelContainer;
			}
			groupPanelContainer = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<GroupPanelContainer>((DependencyObject)dropTargetElement);
			if (groupPanelContainer == null && rootDataControl.IsAnyDetailGroupedCore && !dataControl.IsGroupedCore)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!rootDataControl.IsAnyDetailGroupedCore)
			{
				groupPanelContainer = GetGroupPanelContainer(groupPanelControl, dataControl.FindFirstOriginationDataControl((DataControlBase x) => ((GridViewBase)x.DataView).ActualShowGroupPanel).DataView);
			}
			return groupPanelContainer;
		}

		private GroupPanelContainer GetGroupPanelContainer(FrameworkElement root, DataViewBase view)
		{
			return (GroupPanelContainer)LayoutHelper.FindElement(root, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement e) => e is GroupPanelContainer { View: not null } && ((GroupPanelContainer)e).View.EventTargetView == view));
		}

	public class GridSortInfoCollection : SortInfoCollectionBase
	{
		[Description("Gets or sets how many columns are used to group data.")]
		[DefaultValue(0)]
		public int GroupCount
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GroupCountInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				base.GroupCountInternal = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual void ClearAndAddRange(int groupCount, params GridSortInfo[] items)
		{
			ClearAndAddRangeCore(groupCount, items);
		}

		public void GroupByColumn(string fieldName)
		{
			GroupByColumn(fieldName, GroupCount, (ColumnSortOrder)1);
		}

		public void GroupByColumn(string fieldName, int index, ColumnSortOrder sortOrder = (ColumnSortOrder)1, MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition = MergeGroupPosition.None, bool refreshMerge = true)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (index < 0 || (int)sortOrder == 0)
			{
				UngroupByColumn(fieldName);
				return;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = base[fieldName];
			int num = GroupCount;
			if (gridSortInfo == null || ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo) >= GroupCount)
			{
				num++;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				ListSortDirection sortDirectionBySortOrder = GridSortInfo.GetSortDirectionBySortOrder(sortOrder);
				if (gridSortInfo != null)
				{
					if (index > ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo))
					{
						index--;
					}
					base.LockVerifying = true;
					int num2 = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo);
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Remove(gridSortInfo);
					if (num2 < ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[num2].IsGrouped && refreshMerge)
					{
						((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[num2].MergeWithPreviousGroup = false;
					}
					gridSortInfo.SortOrder = sortDirectionBySortOrder;
					switch (mergeGroupPosition)
					{
					case MergeGroupPosition.None:
						gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup = false;
						index = Math.Min(num - 1, index);
						gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup = false;
						if (index < ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].IsGrouped)
						{
							((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].MergeWithPreviousGroup = false;
						}
						break;
					case MergeGroupPosition.Left:
						gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup = ((index != 0) ? true : false);
						break;
					case MergeGroupPosition.Right:
						index = Math.Min(num - 1, index);
						gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup = !refreshMerge;
						if (index < ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].IsGrouped)
						{
							gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup = !refreshMerge || ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].MergeWithPreviousGroup;
							((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].MergeWithPreviousGroup = true;
						}
						break;
					}
					base.LockVerifying = false;
				}
				else
				{
					switch (mergeGroupPosition)
					{
					case MergeGroupPosition.None:
						gridSortInfo = new GridSortInfo(fieldName, sortDirectionBySortOrder, mergeWithPreviousGroup: false);
						if (index < ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].IsGrouped)
						{
							((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].MergeWithPreviousGroup = false;
						}
						break;
					case MergeGroupPosition.Left:
						gridSortInfo = new GridSortInfo(fieldName, sortDirectionBySortOrder, (index != 0) ? true : false);
						break;
					case MergeGroupPosition.Right:
						gridSortInfo = new GridSortInfo(fieldName, sortDirectionBySortOrder, !refreshMerge);
						if (index < ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].IsGrouped)
						{
							gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup = !refreshMerge || ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].MergeWithPreviousGroup;
							((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index].MergeWithPreviousGroup = true;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				index = Math.Min(num - 1, index);
				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Insert(index, gridSortInfo);
				fGroupCount = num;
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void UngroupByColumn(string fieldName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = base[fieldName];
			if (gridSortInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				int num = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo);
				fGroupCount = Math.Max(GroupCount - 1, 0);
				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Remove(gridSortInfo);
				if (((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count > num && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[num].IsGrouped && !gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup)
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[num].MergeWithPreviousGroup = false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void OnMoveColumnToGroup(string name, int index, ColumnSortOrder sortOrder, bool singleGroupSortMode, MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition, bool refreshMerge)
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (singleGroupSortMode)
			{
				if (IsSingleGroup())
				{
					UngroupByColumn(((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[0].FieldName);
				}
				if (IsSingleSort())
				{
					GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = base[name];
					if (gridSortInfo == null || ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[0] != gridSortInfo)
					{
						ClearSorting();
					}
				}
			}
			GroupByColumn(name, index, sortOrder, mergeGroupPosition, refreshMerge);
		}

		protected internal void OnGroupColumnMove(string name, int index, bool fromGroup, bool toGroup, ListSortDirection defaultSortOrder, bool singleGroupSortMode = false, MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition = MergeGroupPosition.None, bool refreshMerge = true)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!fromGroup && !toGroup)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (fromGroup && !toGroup)
			{
				UngroupByColumn(name);
				return;
			}
			ColumnSortOrder sortOrder = GridSortInfo.GetColumnSortOrder(defaultSortOrder);
			if (base[name] != null)
			{
				sortOrder = base[name].GetSortOrder();
			}
			if (!fromGroup && toGroup)
			{
				OnMoveColumnToGroup(name, index, sortOrder, singleGroupSortMode, mergeGroupPosition, refreshMerge);
			}
			else if (fromGroup && toGroup)
			{
				GroupByColumn(name, index, sortOrder, mergeGroupPosition, refreshMerge);
			}
		}

		internal GridSortInfo GetSortInfoByActualLevel(int idx)
		{
			if (idx >= ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in (Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)
			{
				if (num != 0 && item.MergeWithPreviousGroup)
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (num == idx)
				{
					return item;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

				ValidateStyle(newStyle, typeof(GridRowContent), typeof(RowControl), UseLightweightRows ? "The RowStyle target type is not supported in the grid's optimized mode. Either disable the optimized mode or change the target type to RowControl. To learn more about the grid's optimized mode, see http://go.devexpress.com/xpf-optimized-mode.aspx" : "The RowStyle target type is not supported in the grid's unoptimized mode.");
			}
		}

		protected virtual Style ValidateStyle(Style style, Type normalTargetType, Type optimizedTargetType, string errorMessage)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (style is DefaultStyle)
			{
				if (UseLightweightRows)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			else if (!base.View.IsDesignTime)
			{
				Type c = (UseLightweightRows ? optimizedTargetType : normalTargetType);
				if (base.View.IsInitialized && style.TargetType != null && !style.TargetType.IsAssignableFrom(c) && !DataViewBase.DisableOptimizedModeVerification)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(errorMessage);
				}
			}
			return style;
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualRowDetailsTemplateSelector()
		{
			base.UpdateActualRowDetailsTemplateSelector();
			if (!UseLightweightTemplatesHasFlag(UseLightweightTemplates.Row))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("RowDetailsTemplate and RowDetailsTemplateSelector is only supported in the grid's optimized mode.");
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnRowDecorationTemplateChanged()
		{
			base.OnRowDecorationTemplateChanged();
			if (base.View.IsDesignTime || base.TableView.RowDecorationTemplate == null || base.TableView.RowDecorationTemplate is DefaultControlTemplate || !UseLightweightTemplatesHasFlag(UseLightweightTemplates.Row) || DataViewBase.DisableOptimizedModeVerification)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("RowDecorationTemplate is not supported in the grid's optimized mode. To learn more about the grid's optimized mode, see http://go.devexpress.com/xpf-optimized-mode.aspx");
		}

		protected internal override void OnCellItemsControlLoaded()
		{
			base.OnCellItemsControlLoaded();
			if (base.View.IsDesignTime || !UseOptimizedTemplate || DataViewBase.DisableOptimizedModeVerification)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("CellItemsControl (that is typically used in DefaultDataRowTemplate) is not supported in the grid's optimized mode. To learn more about the grid's optimized mode, see http://go.devexpress.com/xpf-optimized-mode.aspx");
		}

		protected internal override bool IsFirstColumn(BaseColumn column, bool isPrinting)
		{
			if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null)
			{
				if (isPrinting)
				{
					return base.View.PrintableColumns.FirstOrDefault() == column;
				}
				return column.ActualVisibleIndex == 0;
			}
			return !(isPrinting ? GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintHasLeftSibling((DependencyObject)(object)column) : column.HasLeftSibling);
		}
	}

		protected internal override double GetFixedNoneContentWidth(double totalWidth, int rowHandle)

			if (IsAdditionalRowCore(rowHandle) && !base.HasFixedLeftElements)
			{
				if (!base.TableView.ShowIndicator)

					return totalWidth - base.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;

		protected internal override void UpdateBestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl(BestFitControlBase bestFitControl, int rowHandle, IBestFitColumn column)
		{
			BestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl bestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl = (BestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl)bestFitControl;
			bestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl.DataContext = new StandaloneGroupSummaryRowData(base.View.VisualDataTreeBuilder, new RowHandle(rowHandle), (ColumnBase)(object)column);
		}

		internal override GridColumnData GetGroupSummaryColumnData(int rowHandle, IBestFitColumn column)
		{
			ColumnBase column2 = (ColumnBase)(object)column;
			RowData value = null;
			GridGroupSummaryColumnData gridGroupSummaryColumnData = null;
			if (base.View.VisualDataTreeBuilder.GroupSummaryRows.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				gridGroupSummaryColumnData = ((GroupSummaryRowData)value).SafeGetGroupSummaryColumnData(column2);
			}
			if (gridGroupSummaryColumnData == null)
			{
				GroupSummaryRowData groupSummaryRowData = new GroupSummaryRowData(base.View.VisualDataTreeBuilder, new RowHandle(rowHandle));
				groupSummaryRowData.AssignFrom(rowHandle);
				gridGroupSummaryColumnData = groupSummaryRowData.SafeGetGroupSummaryColumnData(column2);
				if (gridGroupSummaryColumnData == null)
				{
					gridGroupSummaryColumnData = new GridGroupSummaryColumnData(groupSummaryRowData);
					groupSummaryRowData.UpdateGridGroupSummaryData(column2, gridGroupSummaryColumnData);
				}
			}
			return gridGroupSummaryColumnData;
		}

		private ColumnBase GetGroupColumnByRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null || base.DataControl.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int rowLevelByControllerRow = base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowLevelByControllerRow(rowHandle);
			if (rowLevelByControllerRow < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.DataControl.ColumnsCore[((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)base.DataControl.SortInfoCore)[rowLevelByControllerRow].FieldName];
		}

		internal override void SetGroupElementsForBestFit(FrameworkElement element, IBestFitColumn column, int rowHandle)
		{
			ColumnBase column2 = (ColumnBase)(object)column;
			IBestFitGroupRow bestFitGroupRow = element as IBestFitGroupRow;
			GroupRowData groupRowData = new StandaloneGroupRowData(base.View.VisualDataTreeBuilder);
			bestFitGroupRow.SetRowData(groupRowData);
			groupRowData.AssignFrom(rowHandle);
			GridGroupSummaryColumnData gridGroupSummaryColumnData = GridGroupSummaryColumnData.CreateBestFitData(groupRowData);
			groupRowData.UpdateGridGroupSummaryData(column2, gridGroupSummaryColumnData);
			bool flag = IsFirstColumn((BaseColumn)(object)column, isPrinting: false);
			if (gridGroupSummaryColumnData == null || !gridGroupSummaryColumnData.HasSummary || gridGroupSummaryColumnData.SummaryTextInfo == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(gridGroupSummaryColumnData.SummaryTextInfo.TextSource))
			{
				bestFitGroupRow.SummaryData = null;
				if (!flag)
				{
					bestFitGroupRow.SetRowData(null);
					bestFitGroupRow.UpdateContent();
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bestFitGroupRow.SummaryData = gridGroupSummaryColumnData;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bestFitGroupRow.IsFirstColumn = true;
				groupRowData.GroupValue = new GridGroupValueData(groupRowData)
				{
					IsFirstGroupValue = true,
					Data = groupRowData.DataContext
				};
				groupRowData.GroupValue.Column = GetGroupColumnByRowHandle(rowHandle);
				groupRowData.GroupValue.ColumnHeader = base.View.GetGroupRowHeaderCaption(rowHandle);
				((EditableDataObject)groupRowData.GroupValue).Value = base.View.GetGroupRowDisplayText(rowHandle);
				object groupDisplayValue = base.View.GetGroupDisplayValue(rowHandle);
				groupRowData.GroupValue.Text = groupDisplayValue?.ToString();
				groupRowData.InitGroupValue();
			}
			else
			{
				bestFitGroupRow.IsFirstColumn = false;
			}
			bestFitGroupRow.UpdateContent();
		}

		protected internal override MouseMoveSelectionBase GetMouseMoveSelection(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if ((GridTableView.ShowCheckBoxSelectorColumn && GridTableView.RetainSelectionOnClickOutsideCheckBoxSelector) || hitInfo.Column == GridTableView.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
			{
				return MouseMoveSelectionNone.Instance;
			}
			return base.GetMouseMoveSelection(hitInfo);
		}

		protected internal override FrameworkElement GetAdditionalRowElement(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && IsNewItemRowVisible && !base.View.IsRootView)
			{
				RowDataBase newItemRowData = base.DataControl.DataControlParent.GetNewItemRowData();
				if (newItemRowData != null && newItemRowData.WholeRowElement != null)
				{
					return LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(newItemRowData.WholeRowElement, "PART_NewItemRow");
				}
			}
			return base.GetAdditionalRowElement(rowHandle);
		}

		internal override IEnumerable<IColumnInfo> GetServiceUnboundColumns()
		{
			return base.GetServiceUnboundColumns().Concat(GetFixedRowUnboundColumn());
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable<IColumnInfo> GetFixedRowUnboundColumn()
		{
			if (!base.View.HasFixedRows)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<IColumnInfo>();
			}
			return (IEnumerable<IColumnInfo>)(object)new IColumnInfo[1]
			{
				new FixedRowUndoundColumn()
			};
		}

	public class TreeListRowAutomationPeer : GridRowAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		protected TreeListView View => base.DataControl.viewCore as TreeListView;

		protected TreeListNode TreeListNode => View.GetNodeByRowHandle(base.RowHandle);

		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = View.GetNodeByRowHandle(base.RowHandle);
				if (!nodeByRowHandle.HasVisibleChildren)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if (!((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByRowHandle).IsExpanded)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public TreeListRowAutomationPeer(int rowHandle, DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(rowHandle, dataControl)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.TreeItem;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
		{
			View.CollapseNode(base.RowHandle);
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
		{
			View.ExpandNode(base.RowHandle);
		}
	}

		public TreeListNode[] GetSelectedNodes()
		{
			int[] selectedRowHandles = GetSelectedRowHandles();
			TreeListNode[] array = new TreeListNode[selectedRowHandles.Length];
			if (TreeListViewCore == null)
			{
				return array;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedRowHandles.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = TreeListViewCore.GetNodeByRowHandle(selectedRowHandles[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		}

	public class TreeListColumn : GridColumnBase
	{
		private int maxAllVisibleWidth;

		private int? maxVisibleWidthLast = 0;

		private TreeViewControl TreeViewControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.View is TreeViewControlView treeViewControlView))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (TreeViewControl)treeViewControlView.DataControl;
			}
		}

		public event TreeListCellValidationEventHandler Validate;

		protected internal override void OnValidation(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			((TreeListColumn)GetEventTargetColumn()).OnValidationCore(e);
		}

		private void OnValidationCore(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.Validate != null)
			{
				this.Validate(this, (TreeListCellValidationEventArgs)e);
			}
		}

		internal override bool SupportValidate()
		{
			return this.Validate != null;
		}

		internal override void OnIsSortedChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			base.OnIsSortedChanged(newValue);
			TreeViewControl treeViewControl = TreeViewControl;
			if (treeViewControl != null)
			{
				treeViewControl.IsSorted = newValue;
			}
		}

		private int GetViewPortWidth()
		{
			TreeViewControl treeViewControl = TreeViewControl;
			if (treeViewControl == null || treeViewControl.View == null || treeViewControl.View.TreeListViewBehavior == null || treeViewControl.View.TreeListViewBehavior.ViewInfo == null || treeViewControl.View.RootDataPresenter == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return (int)(((IScrollInfo)treeViewControl.View.RootDataPresenter).ViewportWidth - treeViewControl.View.TreeListViewBehavior.ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(this));
		}

		protected internal override void AutoBestFitCacheClear()
		{
			base.AutoBestFitCacheClear();
			maxAllVisibleWidth = 0;
			maxVisibleWidthLast = null;
		}

		protected override void SetAutoBestFitWidth(int maxVisibleWidth)
		{
			TreeViewControl treeViewControl = TreeViewControl;
			maxVisibleWidthLast = maxVisibleWidth;
			if (treeViewControl != null && treeViewControl.AutoWidthMode == AutoWidthMode.AllNodes)
			{
				maxAllVisibleWidth = Math.Max(maxAllVisibleWidth, maxVisibleWidth);
				AutoBestFitWidth = Math.Max(GetViewPortWidth(), maxAllVisibleWidth);
			}
			else
			{
				base.SetAutoBestFitWidth((maxVisibleWidth != 0) ? Math.Max(GetViewPortWidth(), maxVisibleWidth) : 0);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetAutoBestFit()
		{
			if (base.View == null || BestFitModeOnSourceChangeLocker.IsLocked || !base.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = GetViewPortWidth();
			base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (base.View != null && base.View is ITableView && !BestFitModeOnSourceChangeLocker.IsLocked && base.WidthCore.IsAuto && base.ActualVisibleIndex >= 0 && (double)Math.Max(AutoBestFitWidth, AutoBestFitHeaderWidth) != base.ActualWidth)
				{
					if (maxVisibleWidthLast.HasValue)
					{
						AutoBestFitLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
						{
							SetAutoBestFitWidth(maxVisibleWidthLast.Value);
						});
					}
					((ITableView)base.View).TableViewBehavior.ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ApplyBestFit(this, Math.Max(AutoBestFitWidth, AutoBestFitHeaderWidth), base.ParentBand == null, autoBestFit: true);
				}
			});
		}
	}

	public class RowMarginControlBase : RowOffsetBase, IRowMarginControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TreeLineStyleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowVerticalLinesProperty;

		public TreeListLineStyle TreeLineStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (TreeListLineStyle)GetValue(TreeLineStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TreeLineStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowVerticalLines
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowVerticalLinesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected new TreeListView View => base.View as TreeListView;

		protected bool ShowTreeLines => TreeLineStyle != TreeListLineStyle.None;

		protected bool ExtendRowMarginControlHeight => View.ShouldDisplayIndentLines;

		internal ColumnBase TreeColumn
		{
			get
			{
				if (View == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return View.GetTreeColumn();
			}
		}

		protected new int RowLevel => base.RowData.Level;

		protected virtual int ActualRowLevel => RowLevel + View.ServiceIndentsCount;

		protected System.Windows.Shapes.Path TreeLinePath { get; private set; }

		protected GeometryGroup TreeLineGeometry { get; private set; }

		internal virtual double TreeLineScrollOffset => 0.0;

		static RowMarginControlBase()
		{
			TreeLineStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TreeLineStyle", typeof(TreeListLineStyle), typeof(RowMarginControlBase), new PropertyMetadata(TreeListLineStyle.Solid, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RowMarginControlBase)d).UpdateContent(((RowMarginControlBase)d).ActualHeight);
			}));
			ShowVerticalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowVerticalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(RowMarginControlBase), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RowMarginControlBase)d).UpdateContent(((RowMarginControlBase)d).ActualHeight);
			}));
		}

		protected override void ChangeWidth()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				base.Offset = View.RowIndent;
				base.Width = base.Offset * (double)ActualRowLevel;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnNextRowLevelChanged()
		{
			UpdateContent(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (View != null && View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				e.Handled = CanProcessMouseDown();
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseDown(e);
		}

		private bool CanProcessMouseDown()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				return !View.RequestUIUpdate();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			TreeLinePath = GetTemplateChild("PART_TreeLinePath") as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
			if (View != null)
			{
				SetUpBindings();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetUpBindings()
		{
			SetBinding(TreeLineStyleProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.TreeLineStyle"));
			SetBinding(ShowVerticalLinesProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.ShowVerticalLines"));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = BaseMeasureOverride(constraint);
			result.Width = View.RowIndent * (double)ActualRowLevel;
			return result;
		}

		protected override void UpdateContent(double height)
		{
			if (base.RowData != null && View != null)
			{
				base.UpdateContent(height);
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawLinesCore(double height)
		{
			base.DrawLinesCore(height);
			if (base.RowData != null && View != null)
			{
				DrawRowLines(height);
				DrawTreeLines(height);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateOffsetPathHeight(double height)
		{
		}

		protected void DrawTreeLines(double height)
		{
			if (TreeLinePath != null)
			{
				TreeLineGeometry = CreateTreeLineGeometry();
				if (TreeLineGeometry != null)
				{
					DrawIndents(height);
				}
				TreeLinePath.Data = TreeLineGeometry;
			}
		}

		private GeometryGroup CreateTreeLineGeometry()
		{
			if (!ShowTreeLines)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new GeometryGroup();
		}

		protected virtual void DrawIndents(double height)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void DrawRowLines(double height)
		{
			DrawRowHorizontalLine(height);
			DrawRowVerticalLine(height);
		}

		protected virtual void DrawRowHorizontalLine(double height)
		{
		}

		private void DrawRowVerticalLine(double height)
		{
			if (ShowVerticalLines && ExtendRowMarginControlHeight)
			{
				base.Group.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(Math.Abs((double)ActualRowLevel * base.Offset - 0.5), View.ShowHorizontalLines ? (-1) : 0), new System.Windows.Point(Math.Abs((double)ActualRowLevel * base.Offset - 0.5), height)));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DrawTreeLine(int index, TreeListIndentType indent, double levelWidth, double height)
		{
			double num = (double)index * levelWidth;
			double x = num + levelWidth;
			double num2 = Math.Round(levelWidth / 2.0) - 0.5 + TreeLineScrollOffset;
			double y = Math.Floor(height / 2.0) + 0.5;
			switch (indent)
			{
			case TreeListIndentType.Root:
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y), new System.Windows.Point(x, y)));
				break;
			case TreeListIndentType.Line:
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, height)));
				break;
			case TreeListIndentType.Middle:
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y), new System.Windows.Point(x, y)));
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, height)));
				break;
			case TreeListIndentType.First:
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y), new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, height)));
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y), new System.Windows.Point(x, y)));
				break;
			case TreeListIndentType.Last:
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y)));
				TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y), new System.Windows.Point(x, y)));
				break;
			}
		}

		protected LineGeometry CreateLine(System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point endPoint)
		{
			LineGeometry lineGeometry = new LineGeometry();
			lineGeometry.StartPoint = startPoint;
			lineGeometry.EndPoint = endPoint;
			return lineGeometry;
		}

		void IRowMarginControl.Update()
		{
			base.RowData?.UpdateClientHorizontalLineVisibility();
			UpdateContent(base.ActualHeight);
		}
	}
	public class RowMarginControl : RowMarginControlBase, ISupportLoadingAnimation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsReadyProperty;

		protected RowData rowDataCore;

		private LoadingAnimationHelper loadingAnimationHelper;

		public bool IsReady
		{
			get

			}

			}
		}

		protected new TreeListRowData RowData => rowDataCore as TreeListRowData;

		protected TreeListNodeExpandButton ExpandButton { get; private set; }

		protected CheckEdit CheckBox { get; private set; }

		protected System.Windows.Controls.Image Image { get; private set; }

		protected AsyncButtonContentControl AsyncButtonContentControl { get; private set; }

		private bool IsAsyncModelEnabled { get; set; }

		DataViewBase ISupportLoadingAnimation.DataView => base.View;

		FrameworkElement ISupportLoadingAnimation.Element => Image;

		bool ISupportLoadingAnimation.IsGroupRow => false;

		double ISupportLoadingAnimation.EditorOpacity => 1.0;

		internal LoadingAnimationHelper LoadingAnimationHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (loadingAnimationHelper == null)

					loadingAnimationHelper = new LoadingAnimationHelper(this);
				}
				return loadingAnimationHelper;
			}
		}

		static RowMarginControl()
		{
			IsReadyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsReady", typeof(bool), typeof(RowMarginControl), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RowMarginControl)d).OnIsReadyChanged();
			}));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RowMarginControl>();
		}

		public RowMarginControl(RowData rowData)
		{
			rowDataCore = rowData;
			if (RowData != null)
			{
				RowData.SetRowMarginControlClient(this);
			}
			SetBinding(IsReadyProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("IsReady"));
			GridViewHitInfoBase.SetHitTestAcceptor(this, new RowMarginControlHitTestAcceptor());
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ExpandButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_ExpandButton") as TreeListNodeExpandButton;
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_NodeCheckBox");
			CheckBox = (CheckEdit)(object)((templateChild is CheckEdit) ? templateChild : null);
			Image = GetTemplateChild("PART_NodeImage") as System.Windows.Controls.Image;
			DependencyObject templateChild2 = GetTemplateChild("PART_AsyncIndicator");
			AsyncButtonContentControl = (AsyncButtonContentControl)(object)((templateChild2 is AsyncButtonContentControl) ? templateChild2 : null);
			IsAsyncModelEnabled = AsyncButtonContentControl != null;
		}

		protected override double GetMinHeight()
		{
			return ((UIElement)(object)CheckBox)?.DesiredSize.Height ?? 1.0;
		}

		protected override void OnNextRowLevelChanged()
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawIndents(double height)
		{
			if (RowData != null && RowData.Indents != null && base.ShowTreeLines && base.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight)
			{
				List<TreeListIndentType> indents = RowData.Indents;
				for (int i = 0; i < indents.Count; i++)
				{
					DrawTreeLine(i, indents[i], base.Offset, height);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawRowHorizontalLine(double height)
		{
			if (base.View.ShowHorizontalLines && base.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight && base.NextRowLevel > -1 && base.RowLevel > base.NextRowLevel && (!base.View.ShowGroupSummaryFooter || !(RowData.node is DataRowNode { summaryNode: not null })))
			{
				base.Group.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point((double)ActualRowLevel * base.Offset + 1.0, height - 0.5), new System.Windows.Point((double)(base.NextRowLevel + base.View.ServiceIndentsCount) * base.Offset, height - 0.5)));
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateContent(double height)
		{
			base.UpdateContent(height);
			UpdateAsyncPanel();
		}

		private void UpdateAsyncPanel()
		{
			if (RowData != null && IsAsyncModelEnabled)
			{
				if (ExpandButton != null)
				{
					ExpandButton.Visibility = ((RowData.LoadingPanelState != LoadingPanelState.Hidden) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				((UIElement)(object)AsyncButtonContentControl).Visibility = ((RowData.LoadingPanelState == LoadingPanelState.Hidden) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				AsyncButtonContentControl.ShowRetryButton = RowData.LoadingPanelState == LoadingPanelState.Failed;
			}
		}

		private void OnIsReadyChanged()
		{
			if (base.DataContext != null)
			{
				LoadingAnimationHelper.ApplyAnimation();
			}
		}
	}
	public class FooterMarginControl : RowMarginControlBase, IRowMarginControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScrollingMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowHorizontalLinesProperty;

		public Thickness ScrollingMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(ScrollingMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ScrollingMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowHorizontalLines
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowHorizontalLinesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowHorizontalLinesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected ITableView TableView => base.View;

		protected bool HasFixedLeftColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns != null)
				{
					return TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsFirstColumnInViewPort
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.View.AllowHorizontalScrollingVirtualization || base.View.AutoWidth)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns != null && TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns.Count > 0)
				{
					return GroupSummaryLayoutCalculator.IsFirstColumn(TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns[0], RowData);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected new TreeListNodeSummaryRowData RowData => base.RowData as TreeListNodeSummaryRowData;

		internal override double TreeLineScrollOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.View.TreeListViewBehavior.AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return ScrollingMargin.Left;
			}
		}

		static FooterMarginControl()
		{
			UIElement.ClipToBoundsProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FooterMarginControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			ScrollingMarginProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ScrollingMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(FooterMarginControl), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FooterMarginControl)d).OnScrollingMarginChanged();
			}));
			ShowHorizontalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowHorizontalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(FooterMarginControl), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FooterMarginControl)d).UpdateContent(((RowMarginControlBase)d).ActualHeight);
			}));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FooterMarginControl>();
		}

		protected virtual void OnScrollingMarginChanged()
		{
			UpdateContent(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		private double CalcWidth()
		{
			if (base.View.TreeListViewBehavior.AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
			{
				if (IsFirstColumnInViewPort || base.View.VisibleColumns.Count == 0)
				{
					return Math.Max(0.0, (double)ActualRowLevel * base.View.RowIndent + ScrollingMargin.Left);
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (double)ActualRowLevel * base.View.RowIndent;
		}

		private double CalcOffset()
		{
			if (base.View.TreeListViewBehavior.AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
			{
				if (IsFirstColumnInViewPort || base.View.VisibleColumns.Count == 0)
				{
					return base.Width / (double)ActualRowLevel;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
			return base.View.RowIndent;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = BaseMeasureOverride(constraint);
			result.Width = CalcWidth();
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			DrawLines(result.Height);
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnNextRowLevelChanged()
		{
			base.OnNextRowLevelChanged();
			DrawLines(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected override void ChangeWidth()
		{
			if (base.View != null && RowData != null)
			{
				base.Width = CalcWidth();
				base.Offset = CalcOffset();
			}
		}

		protected override void SetUpBindings()
		{
			base.SetUpBindings();
			SetBinding(ShowHorizontalLinesProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("View.ShowHorizontalLines"));
		}

		protected override void DrawIndents(double height)
		{
			if (RowData != null && base.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight && RowData.Indents != null && base.ShowTreeLines)
			{
				List<TreeListIndentType> indents = RowData.Indents;
				for (int i = 0; i < indents.Count; i++)
				{
					DrawTreeLine(i, indents[i], base.View.RowIndent, height);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void DrawRowHorizontalLine(double height)
		{
			if (ShowHorizontalLines && base.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight && base.NextRowLevel > -1 && base.RowLevel > base.NextRowLevel)
			{
				if (base.View.TreeListViewBehavior.AllowTreeIndentScrolling)
				{
					base.Group.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point((double)ActualRowLevel * base.Offset + 1.0, height - 0.5), new System.Windows.Point((double)(base.NextRowLevel + base.View.ServiceIndentsCount) * base.View.RowIndent + ((double)ActualRowLevel * base.Offset - (double)ActualRowLevel * base.View.RowIndent), height - 0.5)));
				}
				else
				{
					base.Group.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point((double)ActualRowLevel * base.Offset + 1.0, height - 0.5), new System.Windows.Point((double)(base.NextRowLevel + base.View.ServiceIndentsCount) * base.Offset, height - 0.5)));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class IndentsPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowIndentProperty;

		public double RowIndent
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RowIndentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RowIndentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static IndentsPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(IndentsPanel);
			RowIndentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("RowIndent", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(RowIndent, availableSize.Height));
				if (CanProcessChild(child))
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (child.DesiredSize.Height > num2)
				{
					num2 = child.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(RowIndent * (double)num, num2);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanProcessChild(UIElement child)
		{
			if (child.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return child.Visibility == Visibility.Hidden;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (CanProcessChild(child))
				{
					double x = (double)num * RowIndent + (RowIndent - child.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0;
					double y = (finalSize.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height) / 2.0;
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), child.DesiredSize));
					num++;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class IndentScroller : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		private System.Windows.Controls.Grid scrollableContentCore;

		private Thickness scrollableContentMarginCore;

		private Queue<UIElement> freeElements = new Queue<UIElement>();

		private System.Windows.Controls.Grid ScrollableContent
		{
			get
			{
				return scrollableContentCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (scrollableContentCore != value)
				{
					scrollableContentCore = value;
					SyncScrollableContentMargin();
				}
			}
		}

		private Thickness ScrollableContentMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return scrollableContentMarginCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (scrollableContentMarginCore != value)
				{
					scrollableContentMarginCore = value;
					SyncScrollableContentMargin();
				}
			}
		}

		static IndentScroller()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<IndentScroller>();
		}

		private void SyncScrollableContentMargin()
		{
			if (ScrollableContent != null)
			{
				ScrollableContent.Margin = ScrollableContentMargin;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ScrollableContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollableContent") as System.Windows.Controls.Grid;
			UpdateScrollableContent();
		}

		private void UpdateScrollableContent()
		{
			if (ScrollableContent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (freeElements.Count > 0)
			{
				UIElement element = freeElements.Dequeue();
				int row = System.Windows.Controls.Grid.GetRow(element);
				if (row > 0)
				{
					UpdateRowDefinitions(row);
				}
				ScrollableContent.Children.Add(element);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRowDefinitions(int row)
		{
			int num = ScrollableContent.RowDefinitions.Count - row;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				for (int i = num; i <= 0; i++)
				{
					ScrollableContent.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition
					{
						Height = GridLength.Auto
					});
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddScrollableElement(UIElement element, int position)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				freeElements.Enqueue(element);
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetColumn(element, position);
			}
		}

		internal void AddScrollableElement(UIElement element, int position, int row)
		{
			AddScrollableElement(element, position);
			if (element != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Grid.SetRow(element, row);
				UpdateScrollableContent();
			}
		}

		internal void SetScrollOffset(Thickness offset)
		{
			ScrollableContentMargin = offset;
		}

		internal double GetRowIndentWidth()
		{
			if (ScrollableContent == null || ScrollableContent.ColumnDefinitions.Count < 1)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.Max(0.0, ScrollableContent.ColumnDefinitions[0].ActualWidth + ScrollableContent.Margin.Left);
		}
	}

			}
		}

		protected internal TreeListDataProvider DataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (Controller == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Controller.DataProvider;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the collection of child nodes.")]
		public TreeListNodeCollection Nodes => (TreeListNodeCollection)(object)((TreeListNodeBase)this).NodesCore;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the expand button is displayed within the node or not.")]
		public DefaultBoolean IsExpandButtonVisible
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return isExpandButtonVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (IsExpandButtonVisible != value)
				{
					isExpandButtonVisible = value;
					((TreeListNodeBase)this).NotifyDataController((NodeChangeType)4);
					((TreeListNodeBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("IsExpandButtonVisible");
				}

		}

		public ImageSource Image
		{
			get
			{
				return image;
			}
			set

				{
					image = value;
					((TreeListNodeBase)this).NotifyDataController((NodeChangeType)5);
					((TreeListNodeBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("Image");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the node is checked.")]
		public bool? IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return isChecked;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!SetNodeChecked(this, value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (DataProvider != null && DataProvider.IsRecursiveCheckingAllowed(this))
				{
					DataProvider.DoRecursiveCheckAction(delegate
					{
						RecursiveCheckChildren(this);
						RecursiveCheckParents(this);
					});
				}
				((TreeListNodeBase)this).NotifyDataController((NodeChangeType)6);
				((TreeListNodeBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("IsChecked");
			}
		}

		[Description("Indicates whether the node’s check box is enabled.")]
		public bool IsCheckBoxEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return isCheckBoxEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isCheckBoxEnabled != value)
				{
					isCheckBoxEnabled = value;
					if (isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName.HasValue)
					{
						NodeStateBindingManager.UpdateObjectState(this, isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName.Value.Key, value, isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName.Value.Value);
					}
					else if (isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator != null)
					{
						isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator.UpdateObjectState(value);
					}
					((TreeListNodeBase)this).NotifyDataController((NodeChangeType)7);
					((TreeListNodeBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("IsCheckBoxEnabled");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the node has a child node(s) displayed within a View.")]
		public bool HasVisibleChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)this).HasChildren)
				{
					return Nodes.GetFirstVisible() != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual System.Windows.Data.Binding ExpandStateBinding
		{
			get
			{
				return expandStateBindingCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ExpandStateBinding != value)
				{
					expandStateBindingCore = value;
					InitBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState);
					ForceUpdateNodeStates(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the parent node.")]

		{
			get

				TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)(object)((TreeListNodeBase)this).ParentNodeCore;
				if (treeListNode != null && !treeListNode.IsRootNode)
				{
					return (TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode;
				}
				return null;

				((TreeListNodeBase)this).ParentNodeCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal TreeListNode RootNode
		{
			get
			{
				TreeListNode treeListNode = this;
				while (treeListNode.ParentNode != null)
				{
					treeListNode = treeListNode.ParentNode;
				}
				return treeListNode;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the node’s visible parent.")]
		public TreeListNode VisibleParent => (TreeListNode)(object)((TreeListNodeBase)this).VisibleParentCore;

		public int Level
		{
			get
			{
				if (ParentNode == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return ParentNode.Level + 1;
			}
		}

		public int ActualLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((TreeListNodeBase)this).IsVisible)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				int num = Level;
				for (TreeListNode parentNode = ParentNode; parentNode != null; parentNode = parentNode.ParentNode)
				{
					if (!((TreeListNodeBase)parentNode).IsVisible)
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the node is the first node within a collection of nodes.")]
		public bool IsFirst
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.parentNodeInternal == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)((TreeListNode)(object)base.parentNodeInternal).Nodes)[0] == this;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the node is the last node within a collection of nodes.")]
		public bool IsLast
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.parentNodeInternal == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				TreeListNodeCollection nodes = ((TreeListNode)(object)base.parentNodeInternal).Nodes;
				return ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)[((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Count - 1] == this;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.parentNodeInternal == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (VisibleParent == null && DataProvider != null)
				{
					return DataProvider.RootNode.Nodes.GetFirstVisible() == this;
				}
				return VisibleParent.Nodes.GetFirstVisible() == this;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsLastVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.parentNodeInternal == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (VisibleParent == null && DataProvider != null)
				{
					return DataProvider.RootNode.Nodes.GetLastVisible() == this;
				}
				return VisibleParent.Nodes.GetLastVisible() == this;
			}
		}

				if (checkBoxUpdateLocker == null)
				{
					checkBoxUpdateLocker = new Locker();
				}
				return checkBoxUpdateLocker;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsTogglable => ((TreeListNodeBase)this).IsTogglableCore;

		private bool ShouldSkipDisabledCheckBoxesOnRecursiveNodeChecking
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataProvider == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return DataProvider.View.SkipDisabledCheckBoxesOnRecursiveNodeChecking;
			}
		}

		internal int RowHandleCore => base.rowHandleCore;

		internal int VisibleIndexCore => base.visibleIndexCore;

		public TreeListNode()
			: this(isRootNode: false)
		{
		}

		internal TreeListNode(bool isRootNode)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IsRootNode = isRootNode;
			isChecked = false;
			isCheckBoxEnabled = true;
			isCheckStateInitialized = false;
			ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.None;
		}

			: this()

		protected override ITreeListNodeCollection CreateNodeCollection()
		{
			return (ITreeListNodeCollection)(object)new TreeListNodeCollection(this);
		}

		protected override void UninitializeController(TreeListDataControllerBase oldController)
		{
			((TreeListNodeBase)this).UninitializeController(oldController);
			ReleaseBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState);
			ReleaseBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState);
		}

		protected override void InitializeController()
		{
			((TreeListNodeBase)this).InitializeController();
			InitBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState);
			InitBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState);
		}

		internal TreeListNode GetParentNodeInternal()
		{
			return (TreeListNode)(object)base.parentNodeInternal;
		}

		internal void SetParentNodeInternal(TreeListNode node)
		{
			base.parentNodeInternal = (TreeListNodeBase)(object)node;
		}

		protected bool GetIsTogglable(bool checkHasVisibleChildren = true)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)isExpandButtonVisible == 2)
			{
				if (!checkHasVisibleChildren)
				{
					return ((TreeListNodeBase)this).HasChildren;
				}
				return HasVisibleChildren;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ChangedExpandedInternal(bool expanded)
		{
			((TreeListNodeBase)this).ChangeExpanded(expanded);
		}

		protected override void SetExpanded(bool expanded)
		{
			((TreeListNodeBase)this).SetExpanded(expanded);
			if (expandStateBindingFieldName.HasValue)
			{
				NodeStateBindingManager.UpdateObjectState(this, expandStateBindingFieldName.Value.Key, expanded, expandStateBindingFieldName.Value.Value);
			}
			else if (expandStateBindingEvaluator != null)
			{
				expandStateBindingEvaluator.UpdateObjectState(expanded);
			}
		}

		private void RecursiveCheckParents(TreeListNode node)
		{
			TreeListNode parentNode = node.ParentNode;
			if (parentNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool? flag = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)parentNode.Nodes)[0].IsChecked;
			foreach (TreeListNode item in ((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)parentNode.Nodes).Where((TreeListNode n) => !ShouldSkipDisabledCheckBoxesOnRecursiveNodeChecking || n.IsCheckBoxEnabled || ((TreeListNodeBase)n).HasChildren))
			{
				if (item.isChecked != flag)
				{
					flag = null;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (SetNodeChecked(parentNode, flag))
			{
				RecursiveCheckParents(parentNode);
			}
		}

		private void RecursiveCheckChildren(TreeListNode node)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(node))
			{
				if (!ShouldSkipDisabledCheckBoxesOnRecursiveNodeChecking || item.IsCheckBoxEnabled || HasChildrenWithEnabledCheckboxes(item))
				{
					SetNodeChecked(item, node.isChecked);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HasChildrenWithEnabledCheckboxes(TreeListNode node)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(node.Nodes))
			{
				if (item.IsCheckBoxEnabled)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool SetNodeChecked(TreeListNode node, bool? checkStatus)
		{
			if (node.isChecked == checkStatus)
			{
				return false;
			}
			node.isChecked = checkStatus;
			TreeListDataProvider dataProvider = DataProvider;
			if (dataProvider != null && !dataProvider.View.IsDesignTime && !dataProvider.IsLoading)
			{
				dataProvider.SetObjectIsChecked(node, checkStatus);
				if (isCheckStateInitialized)
				{
					dataProvider.OnNodeCheckStateChanged(node);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void InitializeNodeInternal()
		{
			InitIsChecked();
		}

		internal void InitIsChecked()
		{
			if (DataProvider != null)
			{
				InitIsChecked(DataProvider.View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName);
			}
		}

		internal void InitIsChecked(string checkBoxFieldName)
		{
			if (DataProvider != null)
			{
				isCheckStateInitialized = false;
				IsChecked = DataProvider.GetObjectIsChecked(this, checkBoxFieldName);
				isCheckStateInitialized = true;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateNodeChecked(bool? checkStatus)
		{
			if (IsChecked == checkStatus)
			{
				if (DataProvider != null && DataProvider.View.AllowDragDrop && DataProvider.IsRecursiveCheckingAllowed(this))
				{
					DataProvider.DoRecursiveCheckAction(delegate
					{
						RecursiveCheckParents(this);
					});
				}
				isCheckStateInitialized = true;
			}
			else if (DataProvider != null && DataProvider.IsRecursiveCheckingAllowed(this))
			{
				IsChecked = checkStatus;
			}
			else
			{
				CheckBoxUpdateLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					IsChecked = checkStatus;
				});
			}
		}

		internal void ForceUpdateNodeStates(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget target)
		{
			if (target == NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState && !GetIsTogglable(checkHasVisibleChildren: false))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (target == NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState)
			{
				if (expandStateBindingFieldName.HasValue)
				{
					NodeStateBindingManager.UpdateNodeState(this, expandStateBindingFieldName.Value.Key, target);
				}
				else if (expandStateBindingEvaluator != null)
				{
					expandStateBindingEvaluator.UpdateNodeState();
				}
			}
			if (target == NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState)
			{
				if (isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName.HasValue)
				{
					NodeStateBindingManager.UpdateNodeState(this, isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName.Value.Key, target);
				}
				else if (isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator != null)
				{
					isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator.UpdateNodeState();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ForceUpdateNodeStates()
		{
			ForceUpdateNodeStates(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState);
			ForceUpdateNodeStates(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState);
		}

		internal void SetId(int id)
		{
			((TreeListNodeBase)this).Id = id;
		}

		private NodeStateBindingEvaluator GetBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget target)
		{
			return target switch
			{
				NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState => expandStateBindingEvaluator, 
				NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState => isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		internal void InitBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget target)
		{
			if (((TreeListNodeBase)this).Content == null || DataProvider == null || DataProvider.View.IsDesignTime)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (target == NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState)
			{
				ReleaseBindingEvaluator(target);
				string actualExpandStateFieldName = DataProvider.View.ActualExpandStateFieldName;
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = ExpandStateBinding ?? DataProvider.View.ExpandStateBinding;
				if (binding == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualExpandStateFieldName))
				{
					return;
				}
				InitBindingEvaluatorCore(actualExpandStateFieldName, binding, out expandStateBindingEvaluator, out expandStateBindingFieldName, delegate(TreeListNode node, bool value)
				{
					node.SetNodeExpanded(value);
				});
			}
			if (target != NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState)
			{
				return;
			}
			ReleaseBindingEvaluator(target);
			string actualIsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName = DataProvider.View.ActualIsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName;
			System.Windows.Data.Binding isCheckBoxEnabledBinding = DataProvider.View.IsCheckBoxEnabledBinding;
			if (isCheckBoxEnabledBinding != null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualIsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName))
			{
				InitBindingEvaluatorCore(actualIsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName, isCheckBoxEnabledBinding, out isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator, out isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName, delegate(TreeListNode node, bool value)
				{
					node.IsCheckBoxEnabled = value;
				});
			}
		}

		private void InitBindingEvaluatorCore(string nodeStateFieldName, System.Windows.Data.Binding nodeStateBinding, out NodeStateBindingEvaluator bindingEvaluator, out KeyValuePair<string, bool>? bindingFieldName, Action<TreeListNode, bool> updateAction)
		{
			bindingEvaluator = null;
			bindingFieldName = null;
			if (NodeStateBindingManager.UseBindingEvaluator(this, nodeStateFieldName, nodeStateBinding))
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = ((DataProvider.IsUnboundMode && nodeStateBinding == null) ? new System.Windows.Data.Binding(nodeStateFieldName)
				{
					Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
				} : nodeStateBinding);
				bindingEvaluator = new NodeStateBindingEvaluator(this, BindingCloneHelper.Clone((BindingBase)binding, ((TreeListNodeBase)this).Content) as System.Windows.Data.Binding, updateAction);
			}
			else
			{
				string key = ((nodeStateBinding != null) ? nodeStateBinding.Path.Path : nodeStateFieldName);
				bindingFieldName = new KeyValuePair<string, bool>(key, nodeStateBinding == null || nodeStateBinding.Mode == BindingMode.TwoWay);
			}
		}

		internal void ReleaseBindingEvaluator(NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget target)
		{
			GetBindingEvaluator(target)?.Release();
			if (target == NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState)
			{
				expandStateBindingEvaluator = null;
				expandStateBindingFieldName = null;
			}
			if (target == NodeStateBindingManager.NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState)
			{
				isCheckBoxEnabledBindingEvaluator = null;
				isCheckBoxEnabledBindingFieldName = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TreeListNodeCollection : TreeListNodeCollectionBase<TreeListNode>, ITreeListNodeCollection, IEnumerable
	{
		protected internal TreeListNode Owner => base.OwnerCore;

		TreeListNodeBase ITreeListNodeCollection.this[int index] => (TreeListNodeBase)(object)((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[index];

		int ITreeListNodeCollection.Count => ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this).Count;

		int ITreeListNodeCollection.MinID => base.minID;

			: base(owner)

		}

		protected override void InitializeNode(TreeListNode currentNode, TreeListNode owner)
		{
			base.InitializeNode(currentNode, owner);
			if (currentNode.Controller != null && currentNode.Controller.IsUnboundMode)
			{
				currentNode.InitIsChecked();
			}
			if (owner != null && owner.ItemTemplate != null)
			{
				currentNode.Template = owner.ItemTemplate;
				currentNode.ItemTemplate = owner.ItemTemplate;
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			TreeListNode node = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[index];
			EnsureNotEditing(node);
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		private void EnsureNotEditing(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node.DataProvider != null && node.DataProvider.IsCurrentRowEditing && node.DataProvider.CurrentControllerRow == ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle && ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				node.DataProvider.CloseActiveEditor();
				node.DataProvider.EndCurrentRowEdit();
			}
		}

		protected internal TreeListNode GetFirstVisible()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this).Count; i++)
			{
				TreeListNode treeListNode = null;
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[i]).IsVisible)
				{
					return ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[i];
				}
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[i]).IsExpanded)
				{
					treeListNode = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[i].Nodes.GetFirstVisible();
				}
				if (treeListNode != null)
				{
					return treeListNode;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal TreeListNode GetLastVisible()
		{
			for (int num = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this).Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				TreeListNode treeListNode = null;
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[num]).IsVisible)
				{
					return ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[num];
				}
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[num]).IsExpanded)
				{
					treeListNode = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this)[num].Nodes.GetLastVisible();
				}
				if (treeListNode != null)
				{
					return treeListNode;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		void ITreeListNodeCollection.Add(TreeListNodeBase node)
		{
			((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)this).Add((TreeListNode)(object)node);
		}

		void ITreeListNodeCollection.AddInternal(TreeListNodeBase node)

	public class TreeListNodeIterator : IEnumerator<TreeListNode>, IDisposable, IEnumerator, IEnumerable<TreeListNode>, IEnumerable
	{
		private TreeListNode startNode;

		private TreeListNodeCollection startNodes;

		private Stack<TreeListNode> stack = new Stack<TreeListNode>();

		private bool visibleOnly;

		private TreeListNode current;

		[Description("Gets a node currently being processed by the TreeListNodeIterator object.")]
		public TreeListNode Current => current;

		object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

		public TreeListNodeIterator(TreeListNode startNode, bool visibleOnly)
		{
			this.startNode = startNode;
			this.visibleOnly = visibleOnly;
		}

		public TreeListNodeIterator(TreeListNode startNode)
			: this(startNode, visibleOnly: false)
		{
		}

		public TreeListNodeIterator(TreeListNodeCollection startNodes, bool visibleOnly)
		{
			this.startNodes = startNodes;
			this.visibleOnly = visibleOnly;
		}

		public TreeListNodeIterator(TreeListNodeCollection startNodes)
			: this(startNodes, visibleOnly: false)
		{
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (current == null)
			{
				current = startNode;
				if (current == null && startNodes != null)
				{
					TraverseChildNodes(startNodes);
					UpdateCurrent();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if ((!visibleOnly || ((TreeListNodeBase)current).IsExpanded) && ((TreeListNodeBase)current).HasChildren)
				{
					TraverseChildNodes(current.Nodes);
				}
				UpdateCurrent();
			}
			return current != null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			stack.Clear();
			current = null;
		}

		private void TraverseChildNodes(TreeListNodeCollection nodes)
		{
			int count = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				TreeListNode item = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)[count - 1 - i];
				stack.Push(item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCurrent()
		{
			current = ((stack.Count > 0) ? stack.Pop() : null);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		IEnumerator<TreeListNode> IEnumerable<TreeListNode>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return this;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
