	public class TreeListViewBehavior : GridTableViewBehaviorBase
	{
		internal const string WrongStyleTargetTypeInHierarchicalDataTemplateModeError = "When the TreeList is in HierarchicalDataTemplate mode, optimized mode is disabled, thus the following Style target type is not valid.";

		protected TreeListView TreeListView => (TreeListView)base.View;

		protected TreeListDataProvider DataProvider => TreeListView.TreeListDataProvider;

		internal override bool IsNewItemRowVisible => TreeListView.NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top;

		protected override bool IsNewItemRowFocused
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return base.View.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsNewItemRowEditing
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return ((TreeListDataControllerBase)DataProvider.Controller).IsNewNodeEditing;
			}
		}

		protected override double NewItemRowIndent
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (base.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
				{
					return base.NewItemRowIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		protected override double NewItemRowCellIndent
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				if (!base.View.ShouldDisplayBottomRow)
				{
					return base.NewItemRowCellIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualAlternateRowBackground
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return TreeListView.ActualAlternateRowBackground;
			}
		}

		protected override Style AutoFilterRowCellStyle
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return TreeListView.AutoFilterRowCellStyle;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool UseOptimizedTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.UseOptimizedTemplate)
				{
					return TreeListView.ShouldUseOptimizedTemplates();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool AllowTreeIndentScrolling
		{
			get
			{
				if (TreeListView.AllowTreeIndentScrolling && !base.HasFixedLeftElements && UseOptimizedTemplate)
				{
					return TreeListView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TreeListViewBehavior(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool IsAdditionalRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && TreeListView.NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsAdditionalRow(rowHandle))
			{
				if (base.View.ShouldDisplayBottomRow)
				{
					return rowHandle != -2147483647;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsAdditionalRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			if (!base.IsAdditionalRowData(rowData))
			{
				return rowData == TreeListView.NewItemRowData;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void OnFocusedRowCellModified()
		{
			if (IsNewItemRowFocused && !IsNewItemRowEditing)
			{
				TreeListView.AddNewNodeCore(DataProvider.RootNode);
			}
			base.OnFocusedRowCellModified();
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeShowEditForm()
		{
			if (IsNewItemRowFocused && !IsNewItemRowEditing)
			{
				TreeListView.AddNewNodeCore(DataProvider.RootNode);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanNavigateToAdditionalRow(bool allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow)
		{
			if (!base.CanNavigateToAdditionalRow(allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow))
			{
				return IsNewItemRowVisible;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override int GetAdditionalRowHandle()
		{
			if (!IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				return base.GetAdditionalRowHandle();
			}
			return -2147483647;
		}

		protected internal override RowData GetRowData(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && TreeListView.NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Top)
			{
				return TreeListView.NewItemRowData;
			}
			return base.GetRowData(rowHandle);
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateRowData(UpdateRowDataDelegate updateMethod, bool updateInvisibleRows = true, bool updateFocusedRow = true)
		{
			base.UpdateRowData(updateMethod, updateInvisibleRows, updateFocusedRow);
			if (updateInvisibleRows || IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				updateMethod(TreeListView.NewItemRowData);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsAlternateRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (base.DataControl != null && TreeListView.AlternationCount > 0 && TreeListView.ActualAlternateRowBackground != null)
			{
				int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
				return rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore % TreeListView.AlternationCount == TreeListView.AlternationCount - 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool IsFirstOrTreeColumn(BaseColumn column, bool isPrinting)
		{
			if (TreeListView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				return TreeListView.IsTreeColumn(column as ColumnBase);
			}
			return base.IsFirstOrTreeColumn(column, isPrinting);
		}

		internal override bool IsFirstAndTreeColumn(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null || base.View.IsTreeView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsFirstOrTreeColumn(column, isPrinting: false);
		}

		internal override double TreeHeaderIndentsWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			BandBase rootParentBand = column.GetRootParentBand();
			if (IsFirstOrTreeColumn(column, isPrinting: false))
			{
				num = FirstColumnIndent;
			}
			else if (rootParentBand != null && rootParentBand.ActualVisibleIndex == 0)
			{
				num = FirstColumnIndent;
			}
			if (column != null)
			{
				num += column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore + column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateBestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl(BestFitControlBase bestFitControl, int rowHandle, IBestFitColumn column)
		{
			BestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl bestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl = (BestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl)bestFitControl;
			bestFitGroupFooterSummaryControl.DataContext = new StandaloneGroupSummaryRowData(base.View.VisualDataTreeBuilder, new RowHandle(rowHandle), (ColumnBase)(object)column);
		}

		protected internal override RowData CreateRowDataCore(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, bool updateDataOnly)
		{
			return TreeListView.CreateRowData(treeBuilder);
		}

		protected internal override GridViewInfo CreateViewInfo()
		{
			return new TreeListViewInfo(TreeListView);
		}

		protected internal override GridViewInfo CreatePrintViewInfo()
		{
			return CreatePrintViewInfo(null);
		}

		protected internal override GridViewInfo CreatePrintViewInfo(BandsLayoutBase bandsLayout)
		{
			return new TreeListPrintViewInfo(TreeListView, bandsLayout);
		}

		internal override GridViewNavigationBase CreateRowNavigation()
		{
			return new TreeListViewRowNavigation(base.View);
		}

		internal override GridViewNavigationBase CreateCellNavigation()
		{
			return new TreeListViewCellNavigation(base.View);
		}

		internal override BestFitControlBase CreateBestFitControl(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return CreateElement(() => new TreeListLightweightBestFitControl(TreeListView, column), () => new BestFitControl(base.View, column), UseLightweightTemplates.Row) as BestFitControlBase;
		}

		internal override BestFitControlBase CreateBestFitGroupControl(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return new BestFitGroupControl(base.View, column);
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualDataRowTemplateSelectorCore(DataTemplate template)
		{
			base.View.UpdateActualTemplateSelector(base.TableView.ActualDataRowTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, TreeListView.DataRowTemplateSelector, template, (DataTemplateSelector s, DataTemplate t) => (ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper)(object)new TreeListRowTemplateSelectorWrapper(s, t));
			if (TreeListView.TreeDerivationMode == TreeDerivationMode.HierarchicalDataTemplate)
			{
				DataProvider.DoRefresh(keepNodesState: true);
			}
		}

		internal bool CanBestFitColumn(object columnId)
		{
			BaseColumn baseColumn = ((!(columnId is BandBase)) ? base.View.GetColumnByCommandParameter(columnId) : (columnId as BaseColumn));
			if (baseColumn != null)
			{
				return base.CanBestFitColumn(baseColumn);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override double GetFixedNoneContentWidth(double totalWidth, int rowHandle)
		{
			if (base.HasFixedLeftElements || TreeListView.ActualAllowTreeIndentScrolling || TreeListView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				return totalWidth - base.ViewInfo.ActualLeftDataAreaIndent;
			}
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = rowHandle == -2147483647 && base.View.ShouldDisplayBottomRow;
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = TreeListView.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (nodeByRowHandle != null)
			{
				if (rowHandle != -2147483647 || flag)
				{
					num = nodeByRowHandle.ActualLevel;
					num += TreeListView.ServiceIndentsCount;
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				num += TreeListView.ServiceIndentsCount;
			}
			return totalWidth - TreeListView.RowIndent * (double)num - base.ViewInfo.ActualLeftDataAreaIndent;
		}

		internal override int GetTopRow(int pageVisibleTopRowIndex)
		{
			return base.View.DataProviderBase.GetControllerRow(pageVisibleTopRowIndex);
		}

		internal override CustomBestFitEventArgsBase RaiseCustomBestFit(ColumnBase column, BestFitMode bestFitMode)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TreeListCustomBestFitEventArgs e = new TreeListCustomBestFitEventArgs(column, bestFitMode);
			base.View.RaiseEvent(e);
			return e;
		}

		internal override GridColumnData GetGroupSummaryColumnData(int rowHandle, IBestFitColumn column)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override void SetGroupElementsForBestFit(FrameworkElement element, IBestFitColumn column, int rowHandle)
		{
		}

		internal override bool UseDataRowTemplate(RowData rowData)
		{
			if (!TreeListView.ShouldUseDataRowTemplate(rowData))
			{
				return base.UseDataRowTemplate(rowData);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void ValidateRowStyle(Style newStyle)
		{
			if (!canChangeUseLightweightTemplates)
			{
				base.ValidateStyle(newStyle, typeof(GridRowContent), typeof(RowControl), base.UseLightweightRows ? "The RowStyle target type is not supported in the grid's optimized mode. Either disable the optimized mode or change the target type to RowControl. To learn more about the grid's optimized mode, see http://go.devexpress.com/xpf-optimized-mode.aspx" : "The RowStyle target type is not supported in the grid's unoptimized mode.");
			}
		}

		protected override Style ValidateStyle(Style style, Type normalTargetType, Type optimizedTargetType, string errorMessage)
		{
			if (base.UseLightweightRows && TreeListView.TreeDerivationMode == TreeDerivationMode.HierarchicalDataTemplate)
			{
				if (style is DefaultStyle)
				{
					return style;
				}
				return base.ValidateStyle(style, normalTargetType, normalTargetType, "When the TreeList is in HierarchicalDataTemplate mode, optimized mode is disabled, thus the following Style target type is not valid.");
			}
			return base.ValidateStyle(style, normalTargetType, optimizedTargetType, errorMessage);
		}

		protected override DataTemplate GetDataRowTemplateSelectorTemplate(RowData rowData)
		{
			DataTemplate dataRowTemplateSelectorTemplate = base.GetDataRowTemplateSelectorTemplate(rowData);
			if (TreeListView.TreeDerivationMode == TreeDerivationMode.HierarchicalDataTemplate && TreeListView.IsTreeView && dataRowTemplateSelectorTemplate is HierarchicalDataTemplate { Template: null })
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dataRowTemplateSelectorTemplate;
		}
	}
	public class TreeListBestFitRowControl : BestFitRowControl
	{
		private bool allowDefaultContent;

		protected BestFitGridCellContentPresenter ContentPresenter { get; private set; }

		public TreeListBestFitRowControl(RowData rowData, GridColumnData cellData, bool allowDefaultContent)
			: base(rowData, cellData)
		{
			this.allowDefaultContent = allowDefaultContent;
		}

		protected override void CreateTemplateContent()
		{
			if (allowDefaultContent)
			{
				ContentPresenter = new BestFitGridCellContentPresenter
				{
					HasRightSibling = true
				};
				ContentPresenter.DataContext = base.CellData;
				ContentPresenter.Column = base.CellData.Column;
				ContentPresenter.RowData = rowData;
				ContentPresenter.Style = base.CellData.Column.ActualCellStyle;
				AddPanelElement(ContentPresenter, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				base.CreateTemplateContent();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateIsFocusedCell(bool isFocusedCell)
		{
			if (ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				ContentPresenter.IsFocusedCell = isFocusedCell;
			}
		}
	}

	public class TreeListRowTemplateSelectorWrapper : ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper
	{
		public TreeListRowTemplateSelectorWrapper(DataTemplateSelector dataTemplateSelector, DataTemplate dataTemplate)
			: base(dataTemplateSelector, dataTemplate)
		{
		}

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			return SelectTemplateCore(item, container, checkActual: true);
		}

		internal DataTemplate SelectTemplateCore(object item, DependencyObject container, bool checkActual)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = ((ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper)this).SelectTemplate(item, container);
			DataTemplate dataTemplate2 = null;
			TreeListRowData treeListRowData = item as TreeListRowData;
			TreeListView treeListView = null;
			if (treeListRowData != null)
			{
				treeListView = treeListRowData.View as TreeListView;
				if (dataTemplate != treeListView.DefaultDataRowTemplate)
				{
					dataTemplate2 = dataTemplate;
				}
				else if (treeListRowData.Node != null)
				{
					DataTemplate template = treeListRowData.Node.Template;
					if (template != null)
					{
						dataTemplate2 = template;
					}
				}
			}
			dataTemplate2 = dataTemplate2 ?? dataTemplate;
			if (treeListView != null && treeListView.AllowDefaultContentForHierarchicalDataTemplate && treeListView.TreeDerivationMode == TreeDerivationMode.HierarchicalDataTemplate && dataTemplate2 != null && checkActual && dataTemplate2.Template == null)
			{
				return treeListView.DefaultDataRowTemplate;
			}
			return dataTemplate2;
		}
	}
	public class TreeListViewInfo : GridViewInfo
	{
		public TreeListView TreeListView => (TreeListView)base.GridView;

		private bool HasVisibleBands
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Grid != null && base.Grid.BandsLayoutCore != null)
				{
					return base.Grid.BandsLayoutCore.VisibleBands.Count != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override int GroupCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (TreeListView.ColumnsCore.Count == 0 && !HasVisibleBands)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return MaxVisibleLevel + ServiceIndentsCount;
			}
		}

		internal override int ServiceIndentsCount => TreeListView.ServiceIndentsCount;

		public int MaxVisibleLevel => TreeListView.TreeListDataProvider.MaxVisibleLevel;

		public override double TotalGroupAreaIndent => TreeListView.RowIndent * (double)GroupCount;

		public override double RightGroupAreaIndent => 0.0;

		public TreeListViewInfo(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}
	}

	public class TreeListRowsClipboardController : RowsClipboardController
	{
		public class TreeListCellsClipboardDataProvider : IClipboardDataProvider, IClipboardFormatted
		{
			protected TreeListRowsClipboardController ClipboardController { get; private set; }

			protected TreeListView View => ClipboardController.View;

			protected IEnumerable<TreeListCell> Cells { get; private set; }

			public TreeListCellsClipboardDataProvider(IEnumerable<TreeListCell> cells, TreeListRowsClipboardController clipboardController)
			{
				ClipboardController = clipboardController;
				Cells = cells;
			}

			public object GetObjectFromClipboard()
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				int num = int.MinValue;
				foreach (TreeListCell cell in Cells)
				{
					if (num != cell.RowHandle)
					{
						num = cell.RowHandle;
						list.Add(num);
					}
				}
				return ClipboardController.GetSelectedData(list);
			}

			public string GetTextFromClipboard()
			{
				if (Cells.Count() == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				List<TreeListCell> cells = PrepareCells(Cells);
				List<ColumnBase> columns = PrepareColumns(cells);
				if (View.ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders)
				{
					AppendHeadersText(stringBuilder, columns);
					AppendNewLine(stringBuilder);
				}
				AppendCellsText(cells, stringBuilder, columns);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}

			protected List<TreeListCell> PrepareCells(IEnumerable<TreeListCell> cells)
			{
				return Cells.OrderBy((TreeListCell cell) => cell, new CellComparer(View)).ToList();
			}

			protected List<ColumnBase> PrepareColumns(List<TreeListCell> cells)
			{
				List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
				foreach (TreeListCell cell in cells)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(cell.Column))
					{
						list.Add(cell.Column);
					}
				}
				list.Sort((ColumnBase column1, ColumnBase column2) => Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(column1.ActualVisibleIndex, column2.ActualVisibleIndex));
				return list;
			}

			protected virtual void AppendHeadersText(StringBuilder sb, List<ColumnBase> columns)
			{
				if (columns.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase column in columns)
				{
					sb.Append(View.GetTextForClipboard(int.MinValue, View.VisibleColumns.IndexOf(column)) + "\t");
				}
				sb.Remove(sb.Length - 1, 1);
			}

			protected virtual void AppendCellsText(List<TreeListCell> cells, StringBuilder sb, List<ColumnBase> columns)
			{
				int rowHandle = cells[0].RowHandle;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (TreeListCell cell in cells)
				{
					if (rowHandle != cell.RowHandle)
					{
						sb.Append(Environment.NewLine);
						num = 0;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < columns.IndexOf(cell.Column) - num; i++)
					{
						sb.Append("\t");
					}
					rowHandle = cell.RowHandle;
					num = columns.IndexOf(cell.Column);
					sb.Append(View.GetTextForClipboard(cell.RowHandle, View.VisibleColumns.IndexOf(cell.Column)));
				}
			}

			protected void AppendNewLine(StringBuilder sb)
			{
				sb.Append(Environment.NewLine);
			}

			int IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedCellsCount(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (Cells == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return Cells.Count();
			}

			IEnumerable<ColumnBase> IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedColumns(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (Cells == null)
				{
					return new List<ColumnBase>();
				}
				return Cells.Select((TreeListCell x) => x.ColumnCore).Distinct().ToList();
			}

			IEnumerable<int> IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedRows(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (Cells == null)
				{
					return new List<int>();
				}
				return Cells.Select((TreeListCell x) => x.RowHandle).Distinct().ToList();
			}

			bool IClipboardFormatted.IsSelect(int rowHanle, ColumnBase column, DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (column == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Cells.FirstOrDefault((TreeListCell x) => x.RowHandle == rowHanle && x.ColumnCore.FieldName == column.FieldName) != null;
			}
		}

		protected new TreeListView View => base.View as TreeListView;

		public TreeListRowsClipboardController(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public void CopyCellsToClipboard(IEnumerable<TreeListCell> cells)
		{
			CopyToClipboard(() => CreateCellsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(cells), (IClipboardDataProvider)(object)new TreeListCellsClipboardDataProvider(cells, this));
		}

		protected override CopyingToClipboardEventArgsBase CreateRowsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(IEnumerable<int> rows)
		{
			return new TreeListCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(View, rows);
		}

		protected virtual CopyingToClipboardEventArgsBase CreateCellsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(IEnumerable<TreeListCell> cells)
		{
			return new TreeListCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(View, cells);
		}
	}

	public class TreeViewRowAutomationPeer : TreeListRowAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider, IValueProvider
	{
		protected new TreeViewControlView View => base.DataControl.viewCore as TreeViewControlView;

		protected TreeViewControl TreeViewControl => base.DataControl as TreeViewControl;

		bool IValueProvider.IsReadOnly => IsReadOnlyCore;

		protected virtual bool IsReadOnlyCore => !TreeViewControl.AllowEditing;

		string IValueProvider.Value => GetValueCore();

		public TreeViewRowAutomationPeer(int rowHandle, DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(rowHandle, dataControl)
		{
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (TreeViewControl.ShowCheckboxes)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = GetFrameworkElement();
				CheckEdit child = TreeHelper.GetChild<CheckEdit>((DependencyObject)frameworkElement, (Func<CheckEdit, bool>)null);
				CheckEditAutomationPeer item = new CheckEditAutomationPeer(child);
				list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)item);
			}
			if (TreeViewControl.AllowEditing)
			{
				list.AddRange(base.GetChildrenCore());
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface != PatternInterface.Value)
			{
				return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
			}
			return this;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return GetValueCore();
		}

		protected virtual string GetValueCore()
		{
			return TreeViewControl.GetNodeDisplayText(base.RowHandle);
		}

		void IValueProvider.SetValue(string value)
		{
			if (!IsReadOnlyCore)
			{
				TreeViewControl.SetNodeValue(base.RowHandle, value);
			}
		}
	}

				return null;

			return GetNodeDisplayText(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
		}

		protected override ColumnBase CoerceCurrentColumn(ColumnBase newValue)
		{
			if (newValue == TreeViewColumn)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return (ColumnBase)DependencyObjectExtensions.GetCoerceOldValue((DependencyObject)this, DataControlBase.CurrentColumnProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTreeViewFieldNameChanged()
		{
			UpdateTreeViewColumnFieldName();
		}

		internal void UpdateCurrentNode()
		{
			TreeListNode focusedNode = View.FocusedNode;
			if (CurrentNode != focusedNode)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(CurrentNodeProperty, focusedNode);
			}
		}

		private void OnAllowEditingChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			TreeViewControlView treeViewControlView = (TreeViewControlView)DataView;
			if (treeViewControlView != null)
			{
				treeViewControlView.AllowEditing = newValue;
				treeViewControlView.NavigationStyle = (newValue ? GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell : GridViewNavigationStyle.Row);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTreeViewColumnFieldName()
		{
			if (TreeViewColumn != null)
			{
				TreeViewColumn.FieldName = ActualTreeViewFieldName;
				OnHighlightSelectedNodeIndentChanged();
			}
		}

		protected void OnHighlightSelectedNodeIndentChanged()
		{
			if (TreeViewColumn != null)
			{
				View.TreeColumnFieldName = (HighlightSelectedNodeIndent ? ActualTreeViewFieldName : string.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected void EnsureViewIsCreated()
		{
			ForceCreateView();
		}

		protected internal override DataViewBase CreateDefaultView()
		{
			TreeViewControlView treeViewControlView = CreateView();
			if (treeViewControlView != null)
			{
				InitView(treeViewControlView);
			}
			return treeViewControlView;
		}

			return new TreeViewControlView();

		private void InitTreeViewColumn()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TreeViewColumn = CreateTreeViewColumn();
			TreeViewColumn.SortFieldName = SortFieldName;
			TreeViewColumn.SortMode = SortMode;
			TreeViewColumn.SortOrder = SortOrder;
			TreeViewColumn.EditSettings = EditSettings;
			TreeViewColumn.Width = new GridColumnWidth(1.0, GridColumnUnitType.Auto);
			TreeViewColumn.MinWidth = NodeContentMinWidth;
			base.ColumnsCore.Add(TreeViewColumn);
			UpdateTreeViewColumnFieldName();
		}

		protected internal void RaiseValidateNode(GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TreeViewNodeValidationEventArgs e2 = new TreeViewNodeValidationEventArgs(this, ((ValidationEventArgs)e).Value, e.RowHandle, this);
			if (this.ValidateNode != null)
			{
				this.ValidateNode(this, e2);
			}
			((ValidationEventArgs)e).IsValid = ((ValidationEventArgs)e2).IsValid;
			((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorContent = ((ValidationEventArgs)e2).ErrorContent;
			((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorType = ((ValidationEventArgs)e2).ErrorType;
		}

		private void OnCurrentNodeChanged(TreeListNode oldValue, TreeListNode newValue)
		{
			bool hasValue = currentNodeNewValue.HasValue;
			currentNodeNewValue = newValue.AsOption();
			try
			{
				if (View.FocusedNode != newValue)
				{
					View.FocusedNode = newValue;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!hasValue)
				{
					newValue = currentNodeNewValue.ToValue();
					currentNodeNewValue = Option<TreeListNode>.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (!hasValue)
			{
				RaiseEvent(new CurrentNodeChangedEventArgs(CurrentNodeChangedEvent, oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnViewChanged(DataViewBase oldValue, DataViewBase newValue)
		{
			base.OnViewChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			TreeListView treeListView = oldValue as TreeListView;
			TreeListView treeListView2 = newValue as TreeListView;
			if (treeListView != null)
			{
				treeListView.ClipboardNodeCopying -= RaiseClipboardNodeCopying;
				treeListView.CustomColumnDisplayText -= RaiseCustomColumnDisplayText;
				treeListView.CustomScrollAnimation -= RaiseCustomScrollAnimation;
				treeListView.StartSorting -= RaiseStartSorting;
				treeListView.EndSorting -= RaiseEndSorting;
				treeListView.CustomColumnSort -= RaiseCustomColumnSort;
				treeListView.NodeExpanded -= RaiseNodeExpanded;
				treeListView.NodeExpanding -= RaiseNodeExpanding;
				treeListView.NodeCollapsed -= RaiseNodeCollapsed;
				treeListView.NodeCollapsing -= RaiseNodeCollapsing;
				treeListView.NodeCheckStateChanged -= RaiseNodeCheckStateChanged;
				treeListView.CanSelectRow -= RaiseCanSelectNode;
				treeListView.CanUnselectRow -= RaiseCanUnselectNode;
				treeListView.GiveRecordDragFeedback -= RaiseGiveRecordDragFeedback;
				treeListView.ContinueRecordDrag -= RaiseContinueRecordDrag;
				treeListView.CompleteRecordDragDrop -= RaiseCompleteRecordDragDrop;
				treeListView.DragRecordOver -= RaiseDragRecordOver;
				treeListView.DropRecord -= RaiseDropRecord;
				treeListView.StartRecordDrag -= RaiseStartRecordDrag;
				treeListView.ShowingEditor -= RaiseShowingEditor;
				treeListView.ShownEditor -= RaiseShownEditor;
				treeListView.HiddenEditor -= RaiseHiddenEditor;
				treeListView.RowDoubleClick -= RaiseNodeDoubleClick;
				treeListView.CustomNodeFilter -= RaiseCustomNodeFilter;
				treeListView.ShowGridMenu -= RaiseShowNodeMenu;
				treeListView.PropertyChanged -= OnViewPropertyChanged;
			}
			if (treeListView2 != null)
			{
				treeListView2.ShowingEditor += RaiseShowingEditor;
				treeListView2.ShownEditor += RaiseShownEditor;
				treeListView2.HiddenEditor += RaiseHiddenEditor;
				treeListView2.RowDoubleClick += RaiseNodeDoubleClick;
				treeListView2.GiveRecordDragFeedback += RaiseGiveRecordDragFeedback;

	public class TreeViewRowMarginControl : RowMarginControl
	{
		static TreeViewRowMarginControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TreeViewRowMarginControl>();
		}

		public TreeViewRowMarginControl(RowData rowData)
			: base(rowData)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawTreeLine(int index, TreeListIndentType indent, double levelWidth, double height)
		{
			if (base.RowData != null && base.RowData.IsButtonVisible)
			{
				double num = Math.Round(levelWidth / 4.0 + 0.5, MidpointRounding.ToEven);
				double num2 = (double)index * levelWidth;
				double x = num2 + levelWidth;
				double num3 = Math.Round(levelWidth / 2.0) - 0.5 + TreeLineScrollOffset;
				double num4 = Math.Floor(height / 2.0) + 0.5;
				switch (indent)
				{
				case TreeListIndentType.Root:
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num + num3, num4), new System.Windows.Point(x, num4)));
					return;
				case TreeListIndentType.Middle:
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num + num3, num4), new System.Windows.Point(x, num4)));
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, num4 - num)));
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, num4 + num), new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, height)));
					return;
				case TreeListIndentType.First:
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, num4 + num), new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, height)));
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num + num3, num4), new System.Windows.Point(x, num4)));
					return;
				case TreeListIndentType.Last:
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3, num4 - num)));
					base.TreeLineGeometry.Children.Add(CreateLine(new System.Windows.Point(num2 + num3 + num, num4), new System.Windows.Point(x, num4)));
					return;
				}
			}
			base.DrawTreeLine(index, indent, levelWidth, height);
		}
	}

		public override void DeleteNode(TreeListNodeBase baseNode, bool deleteChildren, bool modifySource)
		{
			if (modifySource)
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).DeleteNodeWithChildrenAndSource(baseNode, false);
			}
			else if (baseNode != null)
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).RemoveTreeListNode((TreeListNodeBase)(object)(TreeListNode)(object)baseNode);
			}
		}

		public override Action DeleteNodeWithChildrenAndSource(TreeListNodeBase baseNode, bool allowRollback)
		{
			if (baseNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TreeListNode node = (TreeListNode)(object)baseNode;
			TreeListNode parent = node.ParentNode;
			int index = ((!allowRollback) ? (-1) : ((parent == null) ? ((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).Nodes.IndexOf((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node) : ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)parent.Nodes).IndexOf(node)));
			IList sourceList = ((parent == null) ? ((TreeListBoundDataHelper)this).ListSource : parent.ItemsSource);
			sourceList?.Remove(((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content);
			((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).RemoveTreeListNode((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node);
			if (!allowRollback)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return delegate
			{
				sourceList?.Insert(index, ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content);
				ITreeListNodeCollection obj;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					ITreeListNodeCollection nodes = (ITreeListNodeCollection)(object)parent.Nodes;
					obj = nodes;
				}
				else
				{
					obj = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).Nodes;
				}
				ITreeListNodeCollection val = obj;
				if (val.Count <= index || !object.Equals(val[index].Content, ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content))
				{
					val.Insert(index, (TreeListNodeBase)(object)node);
				}
			};
		}

		private void ClearNotifications(List<TreeListNode> nodes)

		}

		private void ClearNotifications(TreeListNode node, bool recursive)

			}
		}

		private void ClearNotifications(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, bool recursive)
		{
			if (recursive)
			{
				foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(nodes))
				{
					ClearNodeNotification(item);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (TreeListNode item2 in (Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)
			{
				ClearNodeNotification(item2);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNodeChildren(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, object s, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).IsUpdateLocked && DataProvider.AllowReloadDataOnEndUpdate)
			{
				return;
			}
			IBindingList list = s as IBindingList;
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataProvider.InvokeRequired)
			{
				DataProvider.BeginInvoke(delegate
				{
					UpdateNodeChildrenCore(nodes, e, list);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateNodeChildrenCore(nodes, e, list);
			}
			nodes.Owner.IsExpandButtonVisible = (DefaultBoolean)2;
		}

		private void UpdateNodeChildrenCore(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, ListChangedEventArgs e, IBindingList list)
		{
			if (((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeforeListChanged((object)list, e))
			{
				if (e.ListChangedType == ListChangedType.Reset)
				{
					OnListReset(nodes, list);
				}
				else
				{
					OnListChanged(nodes, list, e);
				}
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).AfterListChanged((object)list, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnListChanged(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IBindingList list, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DataProvider.TryRepopulateColumns();
			if (e.ListChangedType == ListChangedType.ItemAdded && ((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).AddingNewNode)
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).NewNodeId = e.NewIndex;
				return;
			}
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				OnItemAdded(nodes, list, e.NewIndex);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				OnItemChanged(nodes, list, e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				OnItemDeleted(nodes, list, e);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
				OnItemMoved(nodes, e);
				break;
			}
		}

		private TreeListNode GetNodeByChangedIndex(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IBindingList list, int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TreeListNode treeListNode = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)[index];
			if (!object.Equals(((TreeListNodeBase)treeListNode).Content, list[index]))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return treeListNode;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemChanged(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IBindingList list, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = e.PropertyDescriptor;
			if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				if (e.OldIndex != e.NewIndex && (DataProvider.CurrentlyCheckingNode == null || !object.Equals(list[e.NewIndex], ((TreeListNodeBase)DataProvider.CurrentlyCheckingNode).Content)) && !DataProvider.IsRecursiveCheckInProgress)
				{
					OnListReset(nodes, list);
				}
			}
			else if (View != null && propertyDescriptor.Name == View.CheckBoxFieldName && DataProvider.IsRecursiveCheckInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListNode treeListNode = GetNodeByChangedIndex(nodes, list, e.NewIndex) ?? ((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)nodes).FirstOrDefault((TreeListNode x) => object.Equals(list[e.NewIndex], ((TreeListNodeBase)x).Content));
			if (treeListNode == null)
			{
				OnListReset(nodes, list);
				treeListNode = DataProvider.FindNodeByValue(list[e.NewIndex]);
			}
			if (propertyDescriptor != null && propertyDescriptor.Name == View.ActualHasChildNodesPath)
			{
				SetIsExpandButtonVisible(treeListNode);
				return;
			}
			if (treeListNode != DataProvider.CurrentlyCheckingNode)
			{
				Locker val = treeListNode.BeginRowEditLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					treeListNode.IsChecked = DataProvider.GetObjectIsChecked(treeListNode);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (!((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).IsLoading)
			{
				treeListNode.ForceUpdateNodeStates();
			}
			UpdateChildren(treeListNode, e);
			OnNodeContentChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode, propertyDescriptor?.Name);
		}

		internal virtual bool OnNodeContentChanged(TreeListNodeBase nodeBase, string changedPropertyName)
		{
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged(nodeBase, (NodeChangeType)3, changedPropertyName, true, true);
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateChildren(TreeListNode node, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!View.AllowChildNodeSourceUpdates || !node.ChildrenWereEverFetched)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (View.TreeDerivationMode == TreeDerivationMode.ChildNodesSelector && View.ActualChildNodesSelector() == null && e.PropertyDescriptor != null && e.PropertyDescriptor.Name == View.ActualChildNodesPath())
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).ReloadChildNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, (IEnumerable)null);
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable children = GetChildren(node);
			if (children != node.ItemsSource)
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).ReloadChildNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, children);
			}
		}

		public override void ReloadChildNodes(TreeListNodeBase baseNode, IEnumerable children = null)
		{
			TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)(object)baseNode;
			if (treeListNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearNotifications(treeListNode, recursive: true);
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).SaveFocusState();
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			try
			{
				((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)treeListNode.Nodes).Clear();
				CreateChildren(treeListNode, children);
				if ((((TreeListNodeBase)treeListNode).IsExpanded && View.FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand) || CreateAllNodes)
				{
					FillChildrenSubNodes(treeListNode, CreateAllNodes);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).RestoreFocusState();
				UpdateNodes(treeListNode);
			}
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode, (NodeChangeType)2, (string)null, true, false);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IBindingList list, int index)
		{
			object listItem = GetListItem(list, index);
			if (listItem != null)
			{
				TreeListNode treeListNode = DataProvider.CreateNode(listItem);
				treeListNode.Controller = Controller;
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).SaveFocusState();
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
				try
				{
					((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Insert(index, treeListNode);
					treeListNode.InitIsChecked();
					AddNode(nodes, treeListNode);
				}
				finally
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).RestoreFocusState();
				}
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode, (NodeChangeType)0, (string)null, false, true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemMoved(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).SaveNodesState();
			TreeListNode treeListNode = ((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)[e.OldIndex];
			try
			{
				((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Remove(treeListNode);
				((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Insert(e.NewIndex, treeListNode);
			}
			finally
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).RestoreNodesState();
			}
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)treeListNode, (NodeChangeType)0, (string)null, false, true);
		}

		protected override void UpdateNodeId(TreeListNodeBase node)
		{
			((TreeListNode)(object)node).SetId(NodeCounter++);
		}

		protected override void CalcNodeIds()
		{
			NodeCounter = 0;
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(DataProvider.Nodes))
			{
				item.SetId(NodeCounter++);
			}
		}

		public override void RecalcNodeIdsIfNeeded()
		{
			if (NodeCounter >= MaxNodeId)
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).CalcNodeIds();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemDeleted(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IBindingList list, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).SaveFocusState();
			((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).IsLockedDeletingInProgress = !((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).IsUpdateLocked;
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			List<TreeListNode> oldNodes = GetOldNodes(nodes, list, e);
			try
			{
				ClearNotifications(oldNodes);
				RemoveOldNodes(nodes, oldNodes);
			}
			finally
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).IsLockedDeletingInProgress = false;
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).RestoreFocusState();
			}
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)((oldNodes.Count > 0) ? oldNodes[0] : null), (NodeChangeType)1, (string)null, false, true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnListReset(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IBindingList list)
		{
			DataProvider.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				ClearNotifications(nodes, recursive: true);
				((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Clear();
				AddNewNodes(nodes, list);
			}
			finally
			{
				DataProvider.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private List<TreeListNode> GetOldNodes(TreeListNodeCollection treeListNodeCollection, IBindingList list, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			List<TreeListNode> list2 = new List<TreeListNode>((IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)treeListNodeCollection);
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				int num = list2.FindIndex((TreeListNode x) => object.Equals(((TreeListNodeBase)x).Content, item));
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					list2.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private void AddNodeCore(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (View.FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand || CreateAllNodes)
			{
				AddNotification(node.Nodes, GetChildren(node));
				FillSubNodes(node);
				if (CreateAllNodes)
				{
					FillChildrenSubNodes(node, CreateAllNodes);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetIsExpandButtonVisible(node);
			}
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			ResetNotifications();
			((TreeListBoundDataHelper)this).Dispose();
			((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)DataProvider.Nodes).Clear();
			DataProvider.FlattenNodes.Clear();
			DataProvider.RootNode.ItemsSource = null;
		}

			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable GetChildren(TreeListNode node)
		{
			object obj = ((node != null) ? ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content : null);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CanFetchChildren(node))
			{
				return GetChildrenCore(node);
			}
			node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenDisabled;
			return null;
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable GetChildrenCore(TreeListNode node)
		{
			object content = ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content;
			IChildNodesSelector childNodesSelector = View.ActualChildNodesSelector();
			if (childNodesSelector != null)
			{
				if (View.ActualChildNodesSelector() is IAsyncChildNodesSelector)
				{
					FetchChildrenAsync(node);
					return EmptyArray<object>.Instance;
				}
				IEnumerable enumerable = childNodesSelector.SelectChildren(content);
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					return enumerable;
				}
			}
			string text = View.ActualChildNodesPath();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(content).Find(text, ignoreCase: false)?.GetValue(content) as IEnumerable;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanFetchChildren(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.ActualHasChildNodesPath))
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				object value = ((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).GetValue(((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content, View.ActualHasChildNodesPath);
				if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!(value is bool result))
				{
					return (bool)Convert.ChangeType(value, typeof(bool));
				}
				return result;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return true;
		}

		private async void FetchChildrenAsync(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node.CancellationTokenSource != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			node.CancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			IAsyncChildNodesSelector asyncChildNodesSelector = (IAsyncChildNodesSelector)View.ActualChildNodesSelector();
			Task<IEnumerable> childrenTask = asyncChildNodesSelector.SelectChildrenAsync(((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content, node.CancellationTokenSource.Token);
			node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.FetchingStarted;
			View.TreeListDataProvider.RefreshRow(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
			try
			{
				await childrenTask;
				node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.FetchingEnded;
				IEnumerable result = childrenTask.Result;
				OnNodeExpandingCollapsingCore(node, result, shouldFetchSubLevel: false);
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)View.TreeListDataProvider.Controller).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, (NodeChangeType)2, (string)null, true, false);
			}
			catch
			{
				node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenFailed;
				node.SetNodeExpanded(expanded: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				node.CancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
				node.CancellationTokenSource = null;
				View.TreeListDataProvider.RefreshRow(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
			}
		}

		public override void LoadData()
		{
			ResetNotifications();
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).Nodes.Clear();
			if (((TreeListBoundDataHelper)this).ListSource != null)
			{
				AddNodesFromItems();
				if (View.FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand || CreateAllNodes)
				{
					FillChildrenSubNodes(Controller.RootNode, CreateAllNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetNotifications()
		{
			foreach (IBindingList bindingList in ((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).GetBindingLists())
			{
				bindingList.ListChanged -= OnBindingListChanged;
				if (bindingList != ((TreeListBoundDataHelper)this).BindingList && bindingList is IDisposable)
				{
					((IDisposable)bindingList).Dispose();
				}
			}
			NotificationDictionary.Clear();
			MirrorNotificationDictionary.Clear();
		}

		private void AddNodesFromItems()
		{
			DataProvider.RootNode.ItemsSource = DataProvider.DataSource as IList;
			AddNodesFromItems(DataProvider.RootNode, ((TreeListBoundDataHelper)this).ListSource);
			AddNotification(DataProvider.Nodes, ((TreeListBoundDataHelper)this).ListSource);
		}

		private void AddNodesFromItems(TreeListNode treeListNode, IEnumerable children)
		{
			((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).BeginLoad();
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			try
			{
				TreeListNodeCollection nodes = treeListNode.Nodes;
				foreach (object child in children)
				{
					TreeListNode treeListNode2 = DataProvider.CreateNode(child);
					Locker val = treeListNode2.ExpandItemsLocker.Lock();
					try
					{
						treeListNode2.Controller = Controller;
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
					treeListNode2.InitIsChecked();
					SetIsExpandButtonVisible(treeListNode2);
					treeListNode2.Template = GetItemTemplate(treeListNode);
					((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes).Add(treeListNode2);
					if (treeListNode2.Template == null)
					{
						AsignImplicitDataTemplate(treeListNode2);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
				UpdateNodes(treeListNode);
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).EndLoad();
				if (!((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).IsLoading && (View.ExpandStateBinding != null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.ExpandStateFieldName) || View.IsCheckBoxEnabledBinding != null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.IsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName)))
				{
					DataProvider.UpdateNodeStateBindings(treeListNode.Nodes, updateEvaluator: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetIsExpandButtonVisible(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (View.ActualChildNodesSelector() is IAsyncChildNodesSelector)
			{
				FetchHasChildrenAsync(node);
			}
			else
			{
				node.IsExpandButtonVisible = (DefaultBoolean)((!CanFetchChildren(node)) ? 2 : 0);
			}
		}

		private async void FetchHasChildrenAsync(TreeListNode node)
		{
			node.CancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			IAsyncChildNodesSelector asyncChildNodesSelector = (IAsyncChildNodesSelector)View.ActualChildNodesSelector();
			Task<bool> childrenTask = asyncChildNodesSelector.HasChildNode(((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content, node.CancellationTokenSource.Token);
			node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.FetchingStarted;
			View.TreeListDataProvider.RefreshRow(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
			try
			{
				await childrenTask;
				node.IsExpandButtonVisible = (DefaultBoolean)((!childrenTask.Result) ? 2 : 0);
				node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.None;
				node.SetNodeExpanded(expanded: false);
			}
			catch
			{
				node.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.FetchingHasChildrenFailed;
				node.IsExpandButtonVisible = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			}
			finally
			{
				node.CancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
				node.CancellationTokenSource = null;
				View.TreeListDataProvider.RefreshRow(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
			}
		}

			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private bool CreateChildren(TreeListNode node, IEnumerable children = null)
		{
			if (children == null)
			{
				children = (((TreeListNodeBase)node).HasChildren ? TryGetChildrenFromNoteDictionary(node) : null) ?? GetChildren(node);
				if (children == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			AddNotification(node.Nodes, children);
			AddNodesFromItems(node, children);
			node.ItemsSource = children as IList;
			IEnumerator enumerator = children.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable TryGetChildrenFromNoteDictionary(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (!MirrorNotificationDictionary.ContainsKey(node.Nodes))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = MirrorNotificationDictionary[node.Nodes] as IEnumerable;
			BindingListAdapter val = (BindingListAdapter)((enumerable is BindingListAdapter) ? enumerable : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return enumerable;
			}
			return ((BindingListAdapterBase)val).OriginalDataSource as IEnumerable;
		}

		private void AddNotification(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IEnumerable list)
		{
			if (list == null || EmptyArray<object>.Instance == list || NotificationDictionary.ContainsKey(list) || MirrorNotificationDictionary.ContainsKey(nodes))
			{
				return;
			}
			IBindingList bindingList = (IBindingList)((list is BindingListAdapter) ? list : null);
			IBindingList bindingList2 = bindingList ?? (((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).ExtractListSource((object)list) as IBindingList);
			if (bindingList2 != null)
			{
				NotificationDictionary.Add(bindingList2, nodes);
				MirrorNotificationDictionary.Add(nodes, bindingList2);
				bindingList2.ListChanged += OnBindingListChanged;
				BindingListAdapter val = (BindingListAdapter)((bindingList2 is BindingListAdapter) ? bindingList2 : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ErrorsChanged += OnErrorsChanged;
					View?.DataControl?.OnDataSourceExtracted(val);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnErrorsChanged(object sender, ErrorsChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			View?.OnRecivedErrorNotificationFromSource(e.Index);
		}

		private void OnBindingListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TreeListNodeCollection value = null;
			if (NotificationDictionary.TryGetValue(sender, out value))
			{
				UpdateNodeChildren(value, sender, e);
			}
		}

		public override TreeListNodeBase FindNode(object collection, int listIndex)
		{
			TreeListNodeCollection value = null;
			if (!NotificationDictionary.TryGetValue(collection, out value))

			}
			return (TreeListNodeBase)(object)((Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)value)[listIndex];
		}

		private void ClearNodeNotification(TreeListNode node)
		{
			object value = null;
			if (MirrorNotificationDictionary.TryGetValue(node.Nodes, out value))
			{
				((IBindingList)value).ListChanged -= OnBindingListChanged;
				MirrorNotificationDictionary.Remove(NotificationDictionary[value]);
				NotificationDictionary.Remove(value);
				BindingListAdapter val = (BindingListAdapter)((value is BindingListAdapter) ? value : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ErrorsChanged -= OnErrorsChanged;
					((IDisposable)val).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PatchColumnCollection(PropertyDescriptorCollection properties)
		{
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00f1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fb: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Func<string, bool> func = (string fieldName) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName) || GridDataProviderBase.IsComplexFieldName(fieldName);
			foreach (ColumnBase item in from x in View.GetColumns()
				where properties?[x.FieldName] == null
				select x)
			{
				if (!item.IsUnbound && !func(item.FieldName))
				{
					((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).PopulateColumn((PropertyDescriptor)new UnitypeDataPropertyDescriptor(item.FieldName, item.ReadOnly));
				}
			}
			if (!func(View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName) && properties != null && properties[View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName] == null)
			{
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).PopulateColumn((PropertyDescriptor)new UnitypeDataPropertyDescriptor(View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName, false));
			}
		}

		public override void NodeExpandingCollapsing(TreeListNodeBase nodeBase)
		{
			if (!CreateAllNodes && !nodeBase.IsExpanded)
			{
				TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)(object)nodeBase;
				if (treeListNode.ChildrenFetchingProgress == FetchingProgress.FetchingHasChildrenFailed)
				{
					FetchHasChildrenAsync(treeListNode);
				}
				else
				{
					OnNodeExpandingCollapsingCore(treeListNode, null, View.FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnNodeExpandingCollapsingCore(TreeListNode node, IEnumerable children, bool shouldFetchSubLevel)
		{
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).SaveFocusState();
			DataControlBase dataControl = View.DataControl;
			if (dataControl != null)
			{
				dataControl.CurrentItemChangedLocker.Lock();
			}
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				if (!((TreeListNodeBase)node).HasChildren)
				{
					flag |= FillSubNodes(node, children);
				}
				if (shouldFetchSubLevel && !View.IsAsyncMode)
				{
					flag |= FillChildrenSubNodes(node);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
				}
				else
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).CancelUpdate();
				}
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UpdateNodeSummary();
				((TreeListDataHelperBase)this).RecalcNodeIdsIfNeeded();
				DataControlBase dataControl2 = View.DataControl;
				if (dataControl2 != null)
				{
					dataControl2.CurrentItemChangedLocker.Unlock();
				}
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).RestoreFocusState();
				if (flag)
				{
					UpdateNodes(GetTopMostNode(node));
				}
			}
		}

		private TreeListNode GetTopMostNode(TreeListNode node)
		{
			while (node.ParentNode != null)
			{
				node = node.ParentNode;
			}
			return node;
		}

		private void UpdateNodes(TreeListNode parentNode)
		{
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).DoSortNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)parentNode);
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).DoFilterNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)(parentNode.ParentNode ?? Controller.RootNode));
			DataProvider.UpdateTotalSummary();
		}

		private bool FillChildrenSubNodes(TreeListNode treeListNode, bool createAllNodes = false)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)treeListNode.Nodes)
			{
				if (!((TreeListNodeBase)item).HasChildren)
				{
					flag |= FillSubNodes(item);
					if (createAllNodes)
					{
						flag |= FillChildrenSubNodes(item, createAllNodes: true);
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool FillSubNodes(TreeListNode treeListNode, IEnumerable children = null)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = false;
			if (!treeListNode.CanFetchChildren())
			{
				return false;
			}
			flag = CreateChildren(treeListNode, children);
			if (treeListNode.FetchingChildrenNotComplete())
			{
				return flag;
			}
			treeListNode.isExpandButtonVisible = (DefaultBoolean)2;
			treeListNode.ChildrenFetchingProgress = FetchingProgress.Fetched;
			return flag;
		}

		protected internal object GetRowData(TreeListNode node)
		{
			return new StandaloneTreeListRowData(node, View.VisualDataTreeBuilder);
		}

		protected override IList GetListSource(TreeListNodeBase parentNode)
		{
			TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)(object)parentNode;
			object value = null;
			if (!MirrorNotificationDictionary.TryGetValue(treeListNode.Nodes, out value))
			{
				return treeListNode.ItemsSource;
			}
			return value as IList;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IBindingList> GetBindingLists()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, TreeListNodeCollection> item in NotificationDictionary)
			{
				if (item.Key is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					yield return bindingList;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TreeListHierarchicalDataTemplateHelper : TreeListHierarchicalDataHelper
	{
		protected Dictionary<Type, DataTemplate> ImplicitTemplatesDictionary { get; set; }

		public TreeListHierarchicalDataTemplateHelper(TreeListDataController controller, object dataSource)
			: base(controller, dataSource)
		{
			ImplicitTemplatesDictionary = new Dictionary<Type, DataTemplate>();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable GetChildren(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object content = ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content;
			if (content == null || !CanFetchChildren(node))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (node.Template != null && node.Template is HierarchicalDataTemplate hierarchicalDataTemplate)
			{
				return GetChildrenByTemplate(node, hierarchicalDataTemplate);
			}
			if ((base.View.DataRowTemplate != null || base.View.DataRowTemplateSelector != null) && GetActualTemplateForNode(node) is HierarchicalDataTemplate hierarchicalDataTemplate2)
			{
				return GetChildrenByTemplate(node, hierarchicalDataTemplate2);
			}
			if (base.View.DataRowTemplateSelector == null && base.View.DataRowTemplate == null)
			{
				return GetChildrenByImplicitDataTemplate(node);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DataTemplate GetActualTemplateForNode(TreeListNode node)
		{
			return (base.View.ActualDataRowTemplateSelector as TreeListRowTemplateSelectorWrapper).SelectTemplateCore(GetRowData(node), base.View, checkActual: false);
		}

		private IEnumerable GetChildrenByTemplate(TreeListNode node, HierarchicalDataTemplate hierarchicalDataTemplate)
		{
			node.ItemTemplate = hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemTemplate;
			return GetBindingValue(hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemsSource, ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content);
		}

		private IEnumerable GetBindingValue(BindingBase binding, object content)
		{
			if (binding == null || content == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BindingBase binding2 = BindingCloneHelper.Clone(binding, content);
			BindingValueEvaluator bindingValueEvaluator = new BindingValueEvaluator(binding2);
			return bindingValueEvaluator.Value as IEnumerable;
		}

		protected override void AddNode(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, TreeListNode node)
		{
			AssignTemplate(node);
			base.AddNode(nodes, node);
		}

		protected override void AssignTemplate(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node.Template == null)
			{
				DataTemplate actualTemplateForNode = GetActualTemplateForNode(node);
				if (actualTemplateForNode != null && actualTemplateForNode is HierarchicalDataTemplate)
				{
					node.Template = actualTemplateForNode;
				}
				else if (node.ParentNode != null && node.ParentNode.ItemTemplate != null)
				{
					node.Template = node.ParentNode.ItemTemplate;
				}
				else
				{
					AsignImplicitDataTemplate(node);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override DataTemplate GetItemTemplate(TreeListNode treeListNode)
		{
			if (treeListNode.ItemTemplate != null)
			{
				return treeListNode.ItemTemplate;
			}
			if (treeListNode.Template is HierarchicalDataTemplate hierarchicalDataTemplate)
			{
				if (hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemTemplateSelector == null)
				{
					return hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemTemplate;
				}
				DataTemplate dataTemplate = hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(GetRowData(treeListNode), base.View);
				return dataTemplate ?? hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void AsignImplicitDataTemplate(TreeListNode node)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = TryFindDataTemplate(node);
			if (dataTemplate != null)
			{
				node.Template = dataTemplate;
				if (dataTemplate is HierarchicalDataTemplate hierarchicalDataTemplate)
				{
					node.ItemTemplate = hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemTemplate;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable GetChildrenByImplicitDataTemplate(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (TryFindDataTemplate(node) is HierarchicalDataTemplate hierarchicalDataTemplate)
			{
				BindingValueEvaluator bindingValueEvaluator = new BindingValueEvaluator(hierarchicalDataTemplate.ItemsSource);
				return bindingValueEvaluator.Value as IEnumerable;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected DataTemplate TryFindDataTemplate(TreeListNode node)
		{
			return TryFindDataTemplateCore(node.GetContent());
		}

		protected DataTemplate TryFindDataTemplateCore(object content)
		{
			if (content == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = content.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(object))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ImplicitTemplatesDictionary.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return ImplicitTemplatesDictionary[type];
			}
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = ((DataTemplateSelector)(object)DefaultTemplateSelector.Instance).SelectTemplate(content, (DependencyObject)base.View.DataControl);
			if (dataTemplate != null)
			{
				ImplicitTemplatesDictionary.Add(type, dataTemplate);
				return dataTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void LoadData()
		{
			ImplicitTemplatesDictionary.Clear();
			base.LoadData();
		}
	}

		public override int GetSelectedRowsCount()
		{
			return View.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles().Length;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<TreeListNodeWrapper> GetSelectedRows()
		{
			List<TreeListNodeWrapper> list = new List<TreeListNodeWrapper>();
			TreeListNode[] selectedNodes = View.TreeListDataProvider.TreeListSelection.GetSelectedNodes();
			foreach (TreeListNode treeListNode in selectedNodes)
			{
				if (treeListNode.ParentNode == null || !treeListNode.DataProvider.TreeListSelection.GetSelected(treeListNode.ParentNode))
				{
					list.Add(new TreeListNodeWrapper(nodesProvider.GetNodeObject(treeListNode)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override IList<ColumnWrapper> GetColumns(IEnumerable collection, bool isGroupColumn = false)
		{
			List<ColumnWrapper> list = new List<ColumnWrapper>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ColumnBase item in collection)
			{
				list.Add(DataViewExportHelperBase<ColumnWrapper, TreeListNodeWrapper>.CreateColumn(item, num++));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override int GetSelectedCellsCountCore(IGroupRow<TreeListNodeWrapper> groupRow)
		{
			if (View.IsMultiCellSelection)
			{
				return View.GetSelectedCells().Count;
			}
			return GetColumns(View.VisibleColumns).Count() * View.GetSelectedRowHandlesCore().Length;
		}
	}

	public class TreeListNodeObject
	{
		public TreeListNode Node { get; private set; }

		public int Level { get; internal set; }

		public List<TreeListNodeObject> Nodes { get; private set; }

		public TreeListNodeObject(TreeListNode node)
		{
			Node = node;
			Nodes = new List<TreeListNodeObject>();
		}
	}
	public class TreeListVisibleNodesProvider
	{
		private Dictionary<TreeListNode, TreeListNodeObject> cache;

		private TreeListNodeCollection nodes;

		private TreeListView view;

		private List<TreeListNodeObject> parentNodeObjects;

		public List<TreeListNodeObject> Nodes { get; private set; }

		public TreeListVisibleNodesProvider(TreeListView view)
		{
			this.view = view;
			nodes = view.Nodes;
			parentNodeObjects = new List<TreeListNodeObject>();
			Reset();
		}

		public TreeListNodeObject GetNodeObject(TreeListNode node)
		{
			TreeListNodeObject value = null;
			cache.TryGetValue(node, out value);
			return value;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			cache = new Dictionary<TreeListNode, TreeListNodeObject>();
			Nodes = Create(nodes);
		}

		internal TreeListNode GetNodeByParentIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= parentNodeObjects.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return parentNodeObjects[index].Node;
		}

		private List<TreeListNodeObject> Create(TreeListNodeCollection nodes)
		{
			List<TreeListNodeObject> list = new List<TreeListNodeObject>();
			CreateCore(list, nodes, 0);
			return list;
		}

		private void CreateCore(List<TreeListNodeObject> wrapperList, TreeListNodeCollection nodes, int level)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)
			{
				if (CanAddNode(item))
				{
					TreeListNodeObject treeListNodeObject = new TreeListNodeObject(item)
					{
						Level = level
					};
					cache[item] = treeListNodeObject;
					wrapperList.Add(treeListNodeObject);
					if (item.HasVisibleChildren)
					{
						parentNodeObjects.Add(treeListNodeObject);
						CreateCore(treeListNodeObject.Nodes, item.Nodes, level + 1);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CreateCore(wrapperList, item.Nodes, level);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanAddNode(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (!((TreeListNodeBase)node).IsVisible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (view.PrintSelectedRowsOnly)
			{
				return view.IsRowSelected(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class TreeListViewCellNavigation : GridViewCellNavigation
	{
		protected TreeListView TreeListView => base.View as TreeListView;

		public TreeListViewCellNavigation(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Multiply:
				e.Handled = OnMultiply();
				break;
			case Key.Space:
				e.Handled = OnSpace();
				break;
			}
			base.ProcessKey(e);
		}

		public override void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			bool flag = TreeListView.ShouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation && base.View.ViewBehavior.NavigationStrategyBase.IsEndNavigationIndex(base.View);
			if ((isCtrlPressed || flag) && !base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				OnPlus(isCtrlPressed: true);
				if (flag)
				{
					base.View.MoveNextCell(isTabNavigation: false);
				}
			}
			else if (base.UseAdvHorzNavigation)
			{
				DoBandedViewHorzNavigation(isRight: true);
			}
			else if (base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				KeyNavigationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.MoveNextCell(isTabNavigation: false);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MoveNextCell(isTabNavigation: false);
			}
		}

		public override void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			bool flag = TreeListView.ShouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation && base.View.ViewBehavior.NavigationStrategyBase.IsBeginNavigationIndex(base.View);
			if ((isCtrlPressed || flag) && !base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				OnMinus(isCtrlPressed: true);
				if (flag)
				{
					base.View.MovePrevCell(isTabNavigation: false);
				}
			}
			else if (base.UseAdvHorzNavigation)
			{
				DoBandedViewHorzNavigation(isRight: false);
			}
			else if (base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				KeyNavigationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.MovePrevCell(isTabNavigation: false);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MovePrevCell(isTabNavigation: false);
			}
		}

		public override bool OnMinus(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsEditing || base.View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.OnMinus(isCtrlPressed);
		}

		public override bool OnPlus(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsEditing || base.View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.OnPlus(isCtrlPressed);
		}

		public virtual bool OnMultiply()
		{
			if (base.View.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle || base.View.IsExpanded(base.View.FocusedRowHandle) || base.View.IsEditing || base.View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TreeListView.ExpandNodeAndAllChildren();
		}

		public virtual bool OnSpace()
		{
			if (base.View.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle || base.View.IsEditing || !TreeListView.ShowCheckboxes || !TreeListView.GetNodeByRowHandle(base.View.FocusedRowHandle).IsCheckBoxEnabled || base.View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TreeListView.ChangeNodeCheckState(base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessMouse(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			if (TreeListView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				TreeListViewHitInfo treeListViewHitInfo = (TreeListViewHitInfo)TreeListView.CalcHitInfoCore(originalSource);
				if (treeListViewHitInfo != null && (treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeExpandButton || treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeCheckbox))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (TreeListView.FindRowMarginControl(originalSource) != null && !(originalSource is System.Windows.Controls.Image))
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ProcessMouse(originalSource);
		}
	}
	public class TreeListViewRowNavigation : GridViewRowNavigation
	{
		protected TreeListView TreeListView => base.View as TreeListView;

		public TreeListViewRowNavigation(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (e.Key == Key.Multiply)
			{
				flag = OnMultiply();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Space)
			{
				flag = OnSpace();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ProcessKey(e);
			}
		}

		public override void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			bool shouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation = TreeListView.ShouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation;
			if ((isCtrlPressed || shouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation) && !OnPlus(isCtrlPressed: true) && shouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation && TreeListView.FocusedNode != null && TreeListView.FocusedNode.IsTogglable)
			{
				OnDown();
			}
		}

		public override void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			bool shouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation = TreeListView.ShouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation;
			if ((isCtrlPressed || shouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation) && !OnMinus(isCtrlPressed: true) && shouldExpandCollapseNodesOnNavigation && TreeListView.FocusedNode != null && TreeListView.FocusedNode.ParentNode != null)
			{
				TreeListView.FocusedNode = TreeListView.FocusedNode.ParentNode;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool OnMultiply()
		{
			if (base.View.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle || base.View.IsExpanded(base.View.FocusedRowHandle) || base.View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TreeListView.ExpandNodeAndAllChildren();
		}

		public virtual bool OnSpace()
		{
			if (base.View.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle || !TreeListView.ShowCheckboxes || !TreeListView.GetNodeByRowHandle(base.View.FocusedRowHandle).IsCheckBoxEnabled || base.View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TreeListView.ChangeNodeCheckState(base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessMouse(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			if (TreeListView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				TreeListViewHitInfo treeListViewHitInfo = (TreeListViewHitInfo)TreeListView.CalcHitInfoCore(originalSource);
				if (treeListViewHitInfo != null && (treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeExpandButton || treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeCheckbox))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (TreeListView.FindRowMarginControl(originalSource) != null && !(originalSource is System.Windows.Controls.Image))
			{
				return;
			}
			base.ProcessMouse(originalSource);
		}

		public override void OnTab(bool isShiftPressed)
		{
			if (isShiftPressed)
			{
				OnUp(isCtrlPressed: true);
			}
			else
			{
				OnDown();
			}
		}
	}

		}

		private void UpdatePrintingTotalSummaries_PrintSelectedRows()
		{

			View.TreeListDataProvider.Controller.CalcPrintSummary(summaryData, View.PrintSelectedRowsOnly);
			TotalSummaries = View.DataControl.ColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>().ToDictionary((ColumnBase c) => c, (ColumnBase c) => GetTotalSummaryValue(c, summaryData));
			IList<GridTotalSummaryData> list = new List<GridTotalSummaryData>();
			IList<GridTotalSummaryData> list2 = new List<GridTotalSummaryData>();
			FixedTotalSummaryHelper.GenerateTotalSummaries(View.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore, View.ColumnsCore, (SummaryItemBase summaryItem) => View.TreeListDataProvider.Controller.GetPringSummaryValue(View.TreeListDataProvider.RootNode, summaryItem, summaryData), list);
			FixedTotalSummaryHelper.GenerateTotalSummaries(View.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore, View.ColumnsCore, (SummaryItemBase summaryItem) => View.TreeListDataProvider.Controller.GetPringSummaryValue(View.TreeListDataProvider.RootNode, summaryItem, summaryData), list2);
			FixedLeftSummary = FixedTotalSummaryHelper.GetFixedSummariesString(list);
			FixedRightSummary = FixedTotalSummaryHelper.GetFixedSummariesString(list2);
		}

		private Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> GetTotalSummaries()
		{
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, string>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in View.DataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (item.TotalSummariesCore.Any((SummaryItemBase x) => View.GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows))
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					foreach (GridTotalSummaryData totalSummary in item.TotalSummaries)
					{
						if (View.GetActualCalculationMode(totalSummary.Item) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
						{
							if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
							{
								stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
							}
							stringBuilder.Append(ColumnBase.GetSummaryText(totalSummary));
						}
					}
					dictionary.Add(item, stringBuilder.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(item, item.TotalSummaryText);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private string GetTotalSummaryValue(ColumnBase column, Dictionary<TreeListNodeBase, SummaryDataItem> summaryData)
		{
			return column.GetPrintingTotalSummaryText((SummaryItemBase summaryItem) => (View.GetActualCalculationMode(summaryItem) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows) ? null : View.TreeListDataProvider.Controller.GetPringSummaryValue(View.TreeListDataProvider.RootNode, summaryItem, summaryData));
		}

		protected override string GetTotalSummaryText(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!TotalSummaries.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return TotalSummaries[column] ?? string.Empty;
		}

		protected internal override int GetActualRowLevel(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData)
		{
