		}

		private double GetActualButtonIndentWidth(RowData rowData)
		{
			if (rowData.Level == 0 && !PrintRootIndent)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return View.PrintRowIndentWidth;
		}

		internal override void UpdateRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			double totalHeaderWidth = base.TotalHeaderWidth - View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)GetActualRowLevel(rowData);
			RowNodePrintInfo printInfo = rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo;
			int actualRowLevel = GetActualRowLevel(rowData);
			int num = ((printInfo.RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom) ? GetActualNextNodeLevel(printInfo) : 0);
			Thickness printButtonIndentBorderThickness;
			double printButtonIndent;
			Thickness printDataIndentMargin;
			double printImageIndent;
			Thickness printImageIndentBorderThickness;
			if (rowData.Level == 0 && (printInfo.RowPosition == RowPosition.Bottom || printInfo.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single) && IsPrintFooters())
			{
				printButtonIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
				printButtonIndent = GetActualButtonIndentWidth(rowData);
				printDataIndentMargin = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
				printImageIndent = (PrintNodeImages ? View.PrintRowIndentWidth : 0.0);
				printImageIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
			}
			else if (rowData.Level > printInfo.NextNodeLevel)
			{
				double num2 = actualRowLevel - num;
				if (num2 > 1.0)
				{
					printButtonIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
					printButtonIndent = GetActualButtonIndentWidth(rowData) * (num2 - (double)(PrintNodeImages ? 1 : 0));
					printDataIndentMargin = new Thickness((double)num * View.PrintRowIndentWidth, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					printButtonIndentBorderThickness = (PrintNodeImages ? FillControl.EmptyThickness : new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness()));
					printButtonIndent = GetActualButtonIndentWidth(rowData) * num2;
					printDataIndentMargin = new Thickness((double)(num - (PrintNodeImages ? 1 : 0)) * View.PrintRowIndentWidth, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
				printImageIndent = (PrintNodeImages ? View.PrintRowIndentWidth : 0.0);
				printImageIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
			}
			else
			{
				printImageIndent = (PrintNodeImages ? View.PrintRowIndentWidth : 0.0);
				printImageIndentBorderThickness = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
				printButtonIndentBorderThickness = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
				printButtonIndent = GetActualButtonIndentWidth(rowData);
				printDataIndentMargin = new Thickness(View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)(rowData.Level - ((!PrintRootIndent && rowData.Level > 0) ? 1 : 0)), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			TreeListPrintRowInfo treeListPrintRowInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData) as TreeListPrintRowInfo;
			if (treeListPrintRowInfo == null)
			{
				treeListPrintRowInfo = CreatePrintRowInfo();
				GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, treeListPrintRowInfo);
			}
			treeListPrintRowInfo.RowPosition = printInfo.RowPosition;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintFixedFooterStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintFixedFooterStyle;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintRowIndentStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintRowIndentStyle;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintDataIndentMargin = printDataIndentMargin;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.EmptyIndentWidth = printDataIndentMargin.Left;
			if (View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				treeListPrintRowInfo.ShowIndentHorizontalLines = !View.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight;
				if (treeListPrintRowInfo.ShowIndentHorizontalLines)
				{
					treeListPrintRowInfo.EmptyIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(GetBorderThickness(), 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
					printButtonIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
					printImageIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
				}
				else if (!IsTreeColumnFirst)
				{
					treeListPrintRowInfo.EmptyIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(GetBorderThickness(), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
				if (treeListPrintRowInfo.EmptyIndentWidth == 0.0 && (treeListPrintRowInfo.ShowIndentHorizontalLines || !IsTreeColumnFirst))
				{
					printButtonIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(GetBorderThickness(), printButtonIndentBorderThickness.Top, printButtonIndentBorderThickness.Right, printButtonIndentBorderThickness.Bottom);
				}
			}
			treeListPrintRowInfo.TotalHeaderWidth = totalHeaderWidth;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible = basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.IsPrintBandHeadersVisible = basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintBandHeadersVisible;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.RowState = GetRowState(rowData);
			treeListPrintRowInfo.Image = GetRowImage(rowData);
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintImageIndentBorderThickness = printImageIndentBorderThickness;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintImageIndent = printImageIndent;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintButtonIndentBorderThickness = printButtonIndentBorderThickness;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.PrintButtonIndent = printButtonIndent;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.BandsLayout = basePrintRowInfo.BandsLayout;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.IsCellFillControlVisible = View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl;
			treeListPrintRowInfo.ShowIndentTopBorder = !treeListPrintRowInfo.IsCellFillControlVisible && !treeListPrintRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible && treeListPrintRowInfo.ShowIndentHorizontalLines;
		}

		protected override void UpdatePrintCellThickness(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, GridColumnData cellData, PrintCellInfo actualPrintCellInfo)
		{
			double left = ((View.IsTreeColumn(cellData.Column) && !View.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight && (PrintRootIndent || rowData.Level > 0)) ? 0.0 : GetBorderThickness());
			actualPrintCellInfo.PrintCellThickness = (actualPrintCellInfo.IsRight ? new Thickness(left, 0.0, GetBorderThickness(), GetBorderThickness()) : new Thickness(left, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness()));
		}

		protected virtual PrintRowState GetRowState(RowData rowData)
		{
			if (!View.PrintExpandButtons || IsNodeSummaryRowData(rowData))
			{
				return PrintRowState.Default;
			}
			TreeListNode nodeByRowHandle = View.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowData.RowHandle.Value);
			if (nodeByRowHandle == null || !nodeByRowHandle.HasVisibleChildren)
			{
				return PrintRowState.Default;
			}
			if (PrintAllNodes)
			{
				return PrintRowState.Expanded;
			}
			if (!((TreeListNodeBase)nodeByRowHandle).IsExpanded)
			{
				return PrintRowState.Collapsed;
			}
			return PrintRowState.Expanded;
		}

		protected virtual ImageSource GetRowImage(RowData rowData)
		{
			if (!PrintNodeImages || IsNodeSummaryRowData(rowData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((TreeListRowData)rowData).GetImageSource();
		}

		public override void GenerateAllItems()
		{
			TreeListScrollNodesInfo treeListScrollNodesInfo = null;
			bool showNodeSummaryFootersCore = false;
			try
			{
				if (printNodesInfo != null)
				{
					treeListScrollNodesInfo = Controller.NodesInfo;
					Controller.NodesInfo = printNodesInfo;
				}
				Controller.NodesInfo.ShowNodeSummaryFootersForPrinting = PrintNodeFooters;
				showNodeSummaryFootersCore = Controller.NodesInfo.ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore;
				Controller.NodesInfo.ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore = PrintNodeFooters;
				base.RootNodeContainer.ReGenerateItemsCore(0, VisibleCount);
			}
			finally
			{
				Controller.NodesInfo.ShowNodeSummaryFootersForPrinting = true;
				Controller.NodesInfo.ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore = showNodeSummaryFootersCore;
				if (treeListScrollNodesInfo != null)
				{
					Controller.NodesInfo = treeListScrollNodesInfo;
				}
			}
			base.RootNodeContainer.PrintInfo = new NodeContainerPrintInfo
			{
				IsGroupRowsContainer = false
			};
			VirtualItemsEnumerator virtualItemsEnumerator = new VirtualItemsEnumerator(base.RootNodeContainer);
			DataRowNode dataRowNode = null;
			int num = 0;
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)virtualItemsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				DataRowNode dataRowNode2 = virtualItemsEnumerator.Current as DataRowNode;
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo = new RowNodePrintInfo();
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.RowPosition = ((DataNodeContainer)virtualItemsEnumerator.CurrentContainer).GetRowPosition(dataRowNode2);
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.Index = num++;
				if (dataRowNode != null)
				{
					dataRowNode.PrintInfo.NextNodeLevel = dataRowNode2.Level;
				}
				dataRowNode = dataRowNode2;
			}
			if (View.PrintSelectedRowsOnly && dataRowNode != null)
			{
				dataRowNode.PrintInfo.RowPosition = RowPosition.Bottom;
			}
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintFixedFooterTextLeft((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData, View.GetFixedSummariesLeftString());
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintFixedFooterTextRight((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData, View.GetFixedSummariesRightString());
			CreatePrintSerivceSummaryData();
			UpdateTotalSummary(base.HeadersData);
		}

		protected virtual void CreatePrintSerivceSummaryData()
		{
			if (!View.ViewBehavior.GetServiceSummaries().Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			SummaryDataItem rootSummaryItem = View.TreeListDataProvider.GetRootSummaryItem();
			if (rootSummaryItem != null)
			{
				printServiceSummaryData = ((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TreeListSummaryItem, TreeListSummaryValue>>)rootSummaryItem).Where((KeyValuePair<TreeListSummaryItem, TreeListSummaryValue> x) => ((SummaryItemBase)x.Key).Tag is ServiceSummaryItem).ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<TreeListSummaryItem, TreeListSummaryValue> x) => ((SummaryItemBase)x.Key).Tag as SummaryItemBase, (KeyValuePair<TreeListSummaryItem, TreeListSummaryValue> x) => x.Value.Value);
			}
		}

	public class NodeSummaryPrintingNode : GridDetailPrintingNode, IVisualDetailNode, IDataNode
	{
		protected readonly NodeContainer parentContainer;

		protected TreeListSummaryRowNode SummaryRowNode => rowNode as TreeListSummaryRowNode;

		protected internal new TreeListPrintingDataTreeBuilder TreeBuilder => base.TreeBuilder as TreeListPrintingDataTreeBuilder;

		public NodeSummaryPrintingNode(NodeContainer parentContainer, RowNode rowNode, TreeListPrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, IDataNode parent, int index)
			: base(parentContainer, rowNode, treeBuilder, parent, index)
		{
			this.parentContainer = parentContainer;
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualDetailNode.GetDetail(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			GroupSummaryRowData groupSummaryRowData = (GroupSummaryRowData)SummaryRowNode.CreateRowData();
			groupSummaryRowData.AssignFromInternal(null, parentContainer, SummaryRowNode, forceUpdate: true);
			UpdatePrintSummaryInfo(groupSummaryRowData);
			return CreateRowElement(groupSummaryRowData, TreeBuilder.View.PrintNodeFooterTemplate);
		}

		private void UpdatePrintSummaryInfo(GroupSummaryRowData rowData)
		{
			foreach (GridGroupSummaryColumnData fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum in rowData.FixedNoneGroupSummaryData)
			{
				double printColumnWidth = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData.GetCellDataByColumn(fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum.Column)).PrintColumnWidth;
				TreeListNodeSummaryRowData treeListNodeSummaryRowData = fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum.Data as TreeListNodeSummaryRowData;
				string nodeSummaryText = GetNodeSummaryText(fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum);
				bool isRight = !fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum.Column.HasRightSibling;
				PrintGroupSummaryInfo value = new PrintGroupSummaryInfo(printColumnWidth, nodeSummaryText, TreeBuilder.View.PrintNodeFooterStyle, isRight);
				GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintGroupSummaryInfo((DependencyObject)(object)fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum, value);
			}
		}

		private string GetNodeSummaryText(GridGroupSummaryColumnData dataSummary)
		{
			TreeListView treeListView = dataSummary.View as TreeListView;
			if (dataSummary.Column.GroupSummariesCore.Any((SummaryItemBase x) => dataSummary.Column.View.GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows))
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				foreach (SummaryItemBase item in dataSummary.Column.GroupSummariesCore)
				{
					if (dataSummary.Column.View.GetActualCalculationMode(item) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
					{
						if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(GetNodeSummaryTextCore(item, dataSummary.Column, treeListView.GetNodeSummaryValue(dataSummary.GroupRowData.RowHandle.Value, item)));
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return ((EditableDataObject)dataSummary).Value.ToString();
		}

		private string GetNodeSummaryTextCore(SummaryItemBase item, ColumnBase column, object value)
		{
			return item.GetGroupColumnDisplayText(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, ColumnBase.GetSummaryDisplayName(column, item), value, GroupRowData.GetColumnDisplayFormat(column));
		}
	}
	public class TreeListSelectionController : ISelectionController
	{
		private class RowHandleComparer : IComparer<TreeListNode>
		{
			private static RowHandleComparer defaultComparer = new RowHandleComparer();

			public static RowHandleComparer Default => defaultComparer;

			public int Compare(TreeListNode x, TreeListNode y)
			{
				return Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(((TreeListNodeBase)x).RowHandle, ((TreeListNodeBase)y).RowHandle);
			}
		}

		private int selectionLockCount;

		private bool actuallyChanged;

		private TreeListDataProvider dataProvider;

		public bool IsSelectionLocked => selectionLockCount != 0;

		public int Count => Selection.Count;

		protected Dictionary<TreeListNode, object> Selection { get; private set; }

		protected TreeListDataProvider DataProvider => dataProvider;

		public TreeListSelectionController(TreeListDataProvider dataProvider)
		{
			this.dataProvider = dataProvider;
			Selection = new Dictionary<TreeListNode, object>();
		}

		public void BeginSelection()
		{
			if (selectionLockCount++ == 0)
			{
				actuallyChanged = false;
			}
		}

		public void EndSelection()
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (--selectionLockCount == 0 && actuallyChanged)
			{
				OnSelectionChanged(new SelectionChangedEventArgs());
			}
		}

		public void CancelSelection()
		{
			selectionLockCount--;
		}

		public bool GetSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetSelected(DataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle));
		}

		public bool GetSelected(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Selection.ContainsKey(node);
		}

		public void SetSelected(TreeListNode node, bool selected)
		{
			SetSelected(node, selected, null);
		}

		public void SetSelected(TreeListNode node, bool selected, object selectedObject)
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (node != null && (GetSelected(node) != selected || (selected && selectedObject != null && !object.Equals(GetSelectedObject(node), selectedObject))))
			{
				if (!selected)
				{
					Selection.Remove(node);
				}
				else
				{
					Selection[node] = selectedObject;
				}
				OnSelectionChanged(new SelectionChangedEventArgs(selected ? CollectionChangeAction.Add : CollectionChangeAction.Remove, node.RowHandleCore));
			}
		}

		public void SetSelected(int rowHandle, bool selected)
		{
			SetSelected(DataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle), selected);
		}

		public void SetSelected(int rowHandle, bool selected, object selectedObject)
		{
			SetSelected(DataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle), selected, selectedObject);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Count != 0)
			{
				Selection.Clear();
				OnSelectionChanged(new SelectionChangedEventArgs());
			}
		}

		public void SelectAll()
		{
			BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				Clear();
				foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(DataProvider.Nodes))
				{
					if (((TreeListNodeBase)item).IsVisible)
					{
						SetSelected(item, selected: true);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSelection();
			}
		}

		public int[] GetSelectedRows()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return new int[0];
			}
			int[] array = (from TreeListNode node in Selection.Keys
				select ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle).ToArray();
			Array.Sort(array);
			return array;
		}

		public TreeListNode[] GetSelectedNodes()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return new TreeListNode[0];
			}
			return Selection.Keys.OrderBy((TreeListNode n) => ((TreeListNodeBase)n).RowHandle).ToArray();
		}

		public void SetActuallyChanged()
		{
			if (IsSelectionLocked)
			{
				actuallyChanged = true;
			}
		}

		internal TreeListNode[] GetSelectedNodesCore()
		{
			return Selection.Keys.ToArray();
		}

		protected void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			actuallyChanged = true;
			DataProvider.View.SelectionStrategy.OnBeforeSelectionChanged(e);
			if (!IsSelectionLocked)
			{
				DataProvider.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			}
		}

		protected object GetSelectedObject(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node != null && Selection.ContainsKey(node))
			{
				return Selection[node];
			}
			return null;
		}

		object ISelectionController.GetSelectedObject(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetSelectedObject(DataProvider.GetNodeByRowHandle(rowHandle));
		}

		void ISelectionController.SetSelected(int rowHandle, bool selected, object selectionObject)
		{
			SetSelected(rowHandle, selected, selectionObject);
		}
	}
	public class TreeListSelectionStrageryCell : SelectionStrategyCellBase
	{
		private TreeListView TreeListView => base.DataView as TreeListView;

		public TreeListSelectionStrageryCell(TreeListView treeListView)
			: base(treeListView)
		{
		}

		public override void CopyToClipboard()
		{
			TreeListView.CopySelectedCellsToClipboard();
		}

		protected override CellBase CreateCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, DataViewBase view = null)
		{
			return ((ITableView)TreeListView).CreateGridCell(rowHandle, column, view);
		}

		protected override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			TreeListViewHitInfo treeListViewHitInfo = (TreeListViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
			if (!treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeExpandButton && !treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeCheckbox && !treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeFooter && (view.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl || !treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeIndent))
			{
				base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(hitInfo);
			}
		}
	}
	public class TreeListSelectionStrageryCellRectangle : TreeListSelectionStrageryCell
	{
		private ITableViewHitInfo hitInfo;

		public TreeListSelectionStrageryCellRectangle(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			base.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(originalSource);
			hitInfo = ((TreeListView)view).CalcTreeListHitInfo(originalSource);
			Tuple<int, ColumnBase> actualRowAndColumn = SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper.GetActualRowAndColumn(hitInfo, view);
			if (actualRowAndColumn != null)
			{
				SetOldRowAndColumn(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			Tuple<int, ColumnBase> actualRowAndColumn = SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper.GetActualRowAndColumn((ITableViewHitInfo)hitInfo, view);
			if (actualRowAndColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (actualRowAndColumn.Item1 == view.FocusedRowHandle && actualRowAndColumn.Item2 == base.CurrentColumn)
			{
				flag = Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed;
				if (!flag)
				{
					base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(hitInfo);
					hitInfo = null;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (view.IsEditing)
			{
				return;
			}
			ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = (ITableViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
			if (!IsValidRowHandle(actualRowAndColumn.Item1) || (oldRowHandle == actualRowAndColumn.Item1 && oldColumn == actualRowAndColumn.Item2 && actualRowAndColumn.Item2 != null && !IsElementFocused(tableViewHitInfo) && !IsCellSelected(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2) && ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && !flag && (oldRowHandle == actualRowAndColumn.Item1 || ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers)))
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForceCore(tableViewHitInfo, actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
				return;
			}
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForceCore(tableViewHitInfo, actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
			}
			if (actualRowAndColumn.Item2 != null && IsCellSelected(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2) && Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginSelection();
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				if (CanClearSelesction(hitInfo))
				{
					ClearSelectionCore();
				}
				if (flag && tableViewHitInfo != null && !tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					SelectCell(view.FocusedRowHandle, base.CurrentColumn);
				}
			}
			if (tableViewHitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
			{
				SelectRow(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			}
			EndSelection();
		}

		private bool CanClearSelesction(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo is TreeListViewHitInfo treeListViewHitInfo && (treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeExpandButton || treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeCheckbox))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!hitInfo.IsDataArea)
			{
				return hitInfo.InRow;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectionBoundsForceCore(ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo, int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			selectionAnchor = ((IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle) && column != null) ? CreateCell(rowHandle, column) : null);
			oldSelectionRectangle = System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty;
			oldRowHandle = rowHandle;
			oldColumn = column;
		}

		public override void UpdateSelectionRect(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (hitInfo == null)
			{
				base.UpdateSelectionRect(rowHandle, column);
				return;
			}
			if (selectionAnchor == null)
			{
				Tuple<int, ColumnBase> actualRowAndColumn = SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper.GetActualRowAndColumn(hitInfo, view);
				if (actualRowAndColumn == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				selectionAnchor = CreateCell(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
				oldSelectionRectangle = System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			if (selectionAnchor.ColumnCore != null)
			{
				SelectAnchorRange(selectionAnchor.RowHandleCore, selectionAnchor.ColumnCore.ActualVisibleIndex, rowHandle, column.ActualVisibleIndex);
			}
		}
	}
	public class TreeListCell : CellBase
	{
		public int RowHandle => base.RowHandleCore;

		public ColumnBase Column => base.ColumnCore;

		public TreeListCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
			: base(rowHandle, column)
		{
		}
	}
	public class TreeListSelectionStrategyRow : SelectionStrategyRowBase
	{
		private int selectionAnchorRowHandle;

		private int oldFocusedRowHandle;

		private bool isSelectionLocked;

		private Action postponedSelectionAction;

		protected TreeListView TreeListView => view as TreeListView;

		protected TreeListDataProvider DataProvider => TreeListView.TreeListDataProvider;

		public TreeListSelectionStrategyRow(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override bool IsRowSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			return DataProvider.Selection.GetSelected(rowHandle);
		}

		public virtual bool IsRowSelected(TreeListNode node)
		{
			return DataProvider.TreeListSelection.GetSelected(node);
		}

		public override void SelectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle) && (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanSelectRow(rowHandle)))
			{
				DataProvider.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, selected: true);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SelectRow(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node != null && (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanSelectRow(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle)))
			{
				DataProvider.TreeListSelection.SetSelected(node, selected: true);
			}
		}

		public override void UnselectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle) && (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanUnselectRow(rowHandle)))
			{
				DataProvider.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, selected: false);
			}
		}

		public virtual void UnselectRow(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node != null && (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanUnselectRow(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle)))
			{
				DataProvider.TreeListSelection.SetSelected(node, selected: false);
			}
		}

		public override void ClearSelection()
		{
			if (view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked && view.CanRaiseCanUnselectRow() && view.DataControl != null)
			{
				int[] selectedRowHandles = view.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
				int[] array = selectedRowHandles;
				foreach (int rowHandle in array)
				{
					UnselectRow(rowHandle);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		public override void BeginSelection()
		{
			base.BeginSelection();
			DataProvider.Selection.BeginSelection();
		}

		public override void EndSelection()
		{
			DataProvider.Selection.EndSelection();
			base.EndSelection();
		}

		public override void BeginRangeSelection()
		{
			base.BeginRangeSelection();
			BeginRangeSelectionCore();
		}

		public override void EndRangeSelection()
		{
			base.EndRangeSelection();
			EndRangeSelectionCore();
		}

		protected override void SelectAllRows()
		{
			view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SelectAll();
		}

		public override int[] GetSelectedRows()
		{
			return DataProvider.Selection.GetSelectedRows();
		}

		public virtual TreeListNode[] GetSelectedNodes()
		{
			return DataProvider.TreeListSelection.GetSelectedNodes();
		}

		protected virtual bool IsValidRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			return DataProvider.IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		public override void OnInvertSelection()
		{
			if (IsValidRowHandle(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				InvertRowSelection(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InvertRowSelection(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
			{
				UnselectRow(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectRow(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		public override SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
				{
					return SelectionState.None;
				}
				return SelectionState.Focused;
			}
			if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return SelectionState.Selected;
		}

		protected override SelectionState GetCellSelectionStateCore(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
			{
				return base.GetCellSelectionStateCore(rowHandle, isFocused, isSelected, column);
			}
			return SelectionState.None;
		}

		public override bool UpdateBorderForFocusedElementCore()
		{
			if (TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483645)
			{
				if (TreeListView.CurrentCellEditor != null)
				{
					TreeListView.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (IsRowSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle) && !view.ShowFocusedRectangle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TreeListView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell)
			{
				TreeListView.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
			}
			else
			{
				TreeListView.SetFocusedRectangleOnRow();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetFocusedRowSelected()
		{
			SetSingleRowSelectedCore(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		private void SetSingleRowSelectedCore(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				ClearSelection();
				SelectRow(rowHandle);
				SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(rowHandle);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSelection();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAssignedToGridCore()
		{
			base.OnAssignedToGridCore();
			SetFocusedRowSelected();
		}

		protected void SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			selectionAnchorRowHandle = rowHandle;
		}

		public override void OnFocusedRowHandleChanged(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (!isSelectionLocked)
			{
				SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				oldFocusedRowHandle = TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle;
			}
		}

		public override void CopyToClipboard()
		{
			int[] array = GetSelectedRows();
			if (array.Length == 0 && !view.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle)
			{
				array = new int[1] { view.FocusedRowHandle };
			}
			TreeListView.DataControl.CopyRowsToClipboard(array);
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			base.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(originalSource);
			oldFocusedRowHandle = TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle;
			isSelectionLocked = true;
			view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
		}

		public override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
			OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(hitInfo);
			isSelectionLocked = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			postponedSelectionAction = null;
			if (view.IsEditing)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListViewHitInfo treeListViewHitInfo = (TreeListViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
			if (treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeExpandButton || treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeCheckbox || treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeFooter || (view.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeIndent) || !IsValidRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle) || base.HasValidationError)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && (IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) || base.IsControlPressed || (base.IsMultipleMode && IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle))))
			{
				SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsMultipleMode)
			{
				SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				TreeListView.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
				if (IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) && !base.IsControlPressed && !base.IsShiftPressed)
				{
					postponedSelectionAction = delegate
					{
						InvertRowSelection(hitInfo.RowHandle);
					};
				}
				else
				{
					InvertRowSelection(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				if (!base.IsControlPressed && IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) && TreeListView.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles().Length > 1)
				{
					TreeListView.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
					postponedSelectionAction = delegate
					{
						SetSingleRowSelectedCore(hitInfo.RowHandle);
					};
					return;
				}
			}
			if (IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) && !base.IsShiftPressed && !base.IsControlPressed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsShiftPressed && base.IsControlPressed)
			{
				InvertRowSelection(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				TreeListView.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
				return;
			}
			BeginRangeSelection();
			try
			{
				if (!base.IsControlPressed)
				{
					ClearSelection();
				}
				if (!base.IsShiftPressed)
				{
					if (!base.IsControlPressed)
					{
						SelectRow(hitInfo.RowHandle);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SelectRange(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle, selectionAnchorRowHandle);
					TreeListView.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (postponedSelectionAction != null && view.FocusedRowHandle == view.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e))
			{
				postponedSelectionAction();
			}
			postponedSelectionAction = null;
		}

		public override void OnBeforeProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnBeforeProcessKeyDown(e);
			isSelectionLocked = true;
			oldFocusedRowHandle = TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle;
		}

		public override void OnAfterProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Next && e.Key != Key.Prior && e.Key != Key.F3)
			{
				OnNavigationComplete(e.Key == Key.Tab);
			}
		}

		public override void OnNavigationComplete(bool isTabPressed)
		{
			OnNavigationCompleteCore(isTabPressed);
			isSelectionLocked = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnNavigationCompleteCore(bool isTabPressed)
		{
			if (oldFocusedRowHandle == TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle || !IsValidRowHandle(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle) || base.IsMultipleMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginRangeSelection();
			try
			{
				if (!base.IsControlPressed || isTabPressed)
				{
					ClearSelection();
				}
				if (!base.IsShiftPressed || isTabPressed)
				{
					if (!base.IsControlPressed)
					{
						SelectRow(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle);
					}
					SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectRange(TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle, selectionAnchorRowHandle);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace()
		{
			if (base.ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace())
			{
				return !TreeListView.ShowCheckboxes;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void SelectItemsCore(IList items)
		{
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				if (item != null && DataProvider.FlattenNodes.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					SelectRow(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void SelectAllCore()
		{
			BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				ClearSelection();
				foreach (TreeListNode item in DataProvider.FlattenNodes.Values.Where((TreeListNode node) => ((TreeListNodeBase)node).IsVisible))
				{
					SelectRow(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSelection();
			}
		}
	}
	public class TreeListSelectionStrategyRowRange : TreeListSelectionStrategyRow
	{
		private readonly SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper helper;

		private HashSet<int> selectedOldRowHandle = new HashSet<int>();

		private List<int> selectedRowHandle = new List<int>();

		public TreeListSelectionStrategyRowRange(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			helper = new SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper(this);
		}

		public override void SelectRowRange(IEnumerable<int> selectedRowsHandles)
		{
			if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
				return;
			}
			BeginRangeSelection();
			helper.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
			EndRangeSelection();
		}

		public override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				if (base.HasValidationError || hitInfo.RowHandle == int.MinValue || view.IsEditing)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && (IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) || base.IsControlPressed || (base.IsMultipleMode && IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle))))
				{
					SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
					return;
				}
				if (hitInfo is ITableViewHitInfo { IsRowIndicator: not false })
				{
					BeginRangeSelection();
					base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
					EndRangeSelection();
					return;
				}
				TreeListViewHitInfo treeListViewHitInfo = (TreeListViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
				if (treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeIndent || treeListViewHitInfo.InNodeExpandButton || !IsValidRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle) || base.HasValidationError)
				{
					return;
				}
				BeginRangeSelection();
				if (base.IsShiftPressed)
				{
					if (base.TreeListView.GlobalSelectionAnchor == null)
					{
						base.TreeListView.SetSelectionAnchor();
					}
					else
					{
						ClearSelection();
					}
					SelectRange(base.TreeListView.FocusedRowHandle, base.TreeListView.GlobalSelectionAnchor.RowHandle);
					base.TreeListView.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
				}
				else
				{
					SetSelectionAnchorRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
					helper.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo, OnAfterMouseLeftButtonCore, base.DataControl);
					base.TreeListView.SetSelectionAnchor();
				}
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		private bool OnAfterMouseLeftButtonCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (base.HasValidationError || Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed || hitInfo.RowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CanInvertSelection(hitInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			InvertRowSelection(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			return !view.IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle);
		}
	}
	public class TreeListViewSelectionControlWrapper : SelectionControlWrapper
	{
		protected Action<IList, IList> Action { get; set; }

		protected TreeListView View { get; set; }

		public static void Register()
		{
			SelectionControlWrapper.Wrappers.Add(typeof(TreeListView), typeof(TreeListViewSelectionControlWrapper));
		}

		public TreeListViewSelectionControlWrapper(TreeListView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public override void SubscribeSelectionChanged(Action<IList, IList> action)
		{
			Action = action;
			if (View.DataControl is GridControl)
			{
				((GridControl)View.DataControl).SelectionChanged += OnSelectionChanged;
			}
			if (View.DataControl is TreeListControlBase)
			{
				((TreeListControlBase)View.DataControl).SelectionChanged += OnSelectionChanged;
			}
		}

		public override void UnsubscribeSelectionChanged()
		{
			if (View.DataControl is GridControl)
			{
				((GridControl)View.DataControl).SelectionChanged -= OnSelectionChanged;
			}
			if (View.DataControl is TreeListControlBase)
			{
				((TreeListControlBase)View.DataControl).SelectionChanged -= OnSelectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectionChanged(object sender, GridSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IList arg = null;
			IList arg2 = null;
			if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Add)
			{
				arg = new object[1] { View.DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(e.ControllerRow) };

			}
			Action(arg, arg2);
		}

		public override void ResetCurrentPosition()
		{
			if (DataProvider?.View == null || DataProvider.View.FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked || (DataProvider.View.DataControl != null && DataProvider.View.DataControl.CurrentItemChangedLocker.IsLocked) || ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsUpdateLocked)

			}
			if (DataProvider.View.DataControl == null || DataProvider.View.DataControl.GetAllowInitiallyFocusedRow())
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).ResetCurrentPosition();
			}
			if (!DataProvider.View.IsMultiSelection || !DataProvider.View.IsMultiRowSelection || ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CurrentControllerRow == int.MinValue || !DataProvider.View.DataControl.AllowUpdateSelectedItems() || Selection.Count != 0 || (!DataProvider.View.DataControl.IsSelectionInitialized && DataProvider.View.DataControl.SelectedItems != null))
			{
				return;
			}
			Selection.BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				Selection.SetSelected(((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CurrentControllerRow, selected: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (Selection.GetSelected(((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CurrentControllerRow))
				{
					Selection.EndSelection();
				}
				else
				{
					Selection.CancelSelection();
				}
			}
		}

			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			addingFirstNode = false;
			if ((int)changeType == 1 && DataProvider != null && DataProvider.View != null)
			{
				if (DataProvider.View.NeedWatchRowChanged())
				{
					int rowHandle = node.RowHandle;
					if (rowHandle != int.MinValue)
					{
						DataProvider.View.CurrentRowRemoving(rowHandle);
					}
				}
				UnselectRemovedNode((TreeListNode)(object)node);
			}
			if ((int)changeType == 0 && ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).Nodes.Count == 0)
			{

			}
		}

		private void UnselectRemovedNode(TreeListNode node)

		protected void SelectNodesRecursive(TreeListNode node, bool selected)
		{

			}
		}

		public override bool BeforeListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				DataProvider.View.DataControl.BeginRestoreOffset(() => FindVisibleIndex(sender, e));
			}
			if (DataProvider.View == null || !DataProvider.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction || (e.ListChangedType == ListChangedType.ItemAdded && DataProvider.View.IsNewItemRowFocused))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (e.ListChangedType != ListChangedType.ItemChanged || DataProvider.View.FocusedRowHandle == ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(DataProvider.GetRowHandleByListIndex(e.OldIndex)))
			{
				DataProvider.View.CancelRowChangesCore();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int FindVisibleIndex(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (e.ListChangedType != ListChangedType.ItemChanged && e.ListChangedType != ListChangedType.ItemDeleted)
			{
				return result;
			}
			TreeListNodeBase val = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DataHelper.FindNode(sender, e.NewIndex);
			if (val != null)
			{
				result = val.VisibleIndex;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void AfterListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{

				DataProvider.View.DataControl.EndRestoreOffset();
			}
		}

		public override void OnNodeCollectionChanged(TreeListNodeBase nodeBase, NodeChangeType changeType, string changedPropertyName = null, bool raiseNodeChangedEvent = true, bool sourceIsUpdated = false)
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0123: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0125: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0127: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0145: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015b: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsNodeCollectionChangedLocked || ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsDisposed || (((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsNewNodeEditing && DataProvider.View.NewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.None))
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListNode node = (TreeListNode)(object)nodeBase;
			if (raiseNodeChangedEvent)
			{
				DataProvider.OnNodeChanged(node, changeType);
			}
			if ((int)changeType == 0 && !IsLoading)
			{
				node.ForceUpdateNodeStates();
			}
			switch (changeType - 4)
			{
			case 0:
			case 1:
			case 3:
				DataProvider.UpdateRow(node);
				return;
			case 2:
				if (DataProvider.IsRecursiveCheckingAllowed(node))
				{
					node.CheckBoxUpdateLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
					{
						DataProvider.UpdateRows();
					});
					return;
				}
				node.CheckBoxUpdateLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					DataProvider.UpdateRow(node);
				});
				node.isCheckStateInitialized = true;
				return;
			}
			bool flag = DataProvider.View.NeedWatchRowChanged();
			int? num = null;
			if (flag)
			{
				num = ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle;
			}
			if ((int)changeType == 1 || (int)changeType == 0)
			{
				DataProvider.rowStates.Clear();
				((TreeListNodesInfo)NodesInfo).SetDirty();
			}
			switch ((int)changeType)
			{
			case 0:
				OnNodeAdded(node);
				if (flag)
				{
					DataProvider.View.CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle, num.Value);
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				if (flag)
				{
					int rowHandle = ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle;
					if (rowHandle != int.MinValue)
					{
						DataProvider.View.CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, rowHandle, rowHandle);
					}
				}
				if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DataHelper.IsDeletingChildrenInProgress)
				{
					OnNodeRemoved(node);
				}
				break;
			case 3:
				if (((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsSelfReferenceMode && sourceIsUpdated)
				{
					if (!IsLoading)
					{
						node.ForceUpdateNodeStates();
					}
					if (node != DataProvider.CurrentlyCheckingNode)
					{
						Locker val = node.BeginRowEditLocker.Lock();
						try
						{
							node.IsChecked = DataProvider.GetObjectIsChecked(node);
						}
						finally
						{
							((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				OnNodeContentChanged(node, changedPropertyName);
				if (flag)
				{
					DataProvider.View.CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType.ItemChanged, ((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle, num.Value);
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				((TreeListNodesInfo)NodesInfo).SetDirty(true);
				DataProvider.UpdateRows();
				if (flag)
				{
					DataProvider.View.UpdateScrollBarAnnotations();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnNodeAdded(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				UpdateNodeInternal(node, (NodeChangeType)0, filterNodes: true, filterChildren: true, sortNodes: true, string.Empty);
				node.InitIsChecked();
				if (NodesState.FocusedRow == null && ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CurrentControllerRow != -2147483647)
				{
					DataProvider.View.UpdateFocusedNode();
				}
				DataProvider.UpdateColumnsUnboundTypeIfNeeded();
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DataHelper.RecalcNodeIdsIfNeeded();
				DataProvider.UpdateRows();
				if (addingFirstNode)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).ResetCurrentPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnNodeRemoved(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, (NodeChangeType)1, (string)null, false, false);
				bool flag = DataProvider.View.FocusedNode != null;
				if (flag && DataProvider.View.FocusedNode.Controller != this && NodesState.FocusedRow == null)
				{
					int focusedRowHandle = DataProvider.View.FocusedRowHandle;
					DataProvider.View.FocusedNode = FindVisibleNode((focusedRowHandle == -2147483647) ? Math.Max(0, Math.Max(0, node.RowHandleCore) - 1) : focusedRowHandle);
				}
				DataProvider.UpdateRows();
				if (flag)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).ResetCurrentPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnNodeContentChanged(TreeListNode node, string propertyName, bool delayed = false)
		{
			bool flag = ShouldResortNodesOnContentChanged(propertyName);
			if (node.CheckBoxUpdateLocker.IsLocked || (!delayed && flag && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && propertyName == DataProvider.View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName))
			{
				DataProvider.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					OnNodeContentChanged(node, propertyName, delayed: true);
				});
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsFiltered && ShouldUpdateFilterOnNodeContentChanged(propertyName);
			UpdateNodeInternal(node, (NodeChangeType)3, flag2, DataProvider.View.FilteringMode == TreeListFilteringMode.Recursive, flag, propertyName);
			if (DataProvider.VisibleItems != null)
			{
				DataProvider.UpdateVisibleItemsItem(((TreeListNodeBase)node).RowHandle);
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataProvider.View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName) || !(propertyName == DataProvider.View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName) || delayed)
			{
				DoRefreshRow(node, flag && ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsSorted, flag2);
				if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsUpdateLocked && (object)node == ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CurrentNode && DataProvider.View.DataControl != null)
				{
					DataProvider.View.DataControl.UpdateCurrentCellValue();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldUpdateFilterOnNodeContentChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!DataProvider.View.ImmediateUpdateRowPosition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataProvider.View.DataControl != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && !DataProvider.View.IsCustomNodeFilterAssigned)
			{
				return DataProvider.View.DataControl.GetColumnFilterCriteria(propertyName) != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldResortNodesOnContentChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!DataProvider.View.ImmediateUpdateRowPosition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DataProvider.View.DataControl?.GetPropertyChangeDependency(propertyName).HasSorting ?? false;
		}

		private void DoRefreshRow(TreeListNode node, bool shouldSortNodes, bool shouldFilterNodes)
		{
			if (shouldSortNodes || shouldFilterNodes || DataProvider.View.ViewBehavior.GetServiceSummaries().Any((KeyValuePair<ServiceSummaryItemKey, ServiceSummaryItem> x) => x.Value.ShouldUpdateRows))
			{
				DataProvider.UpdateRows();
			}
			else
			{
				DataProvider.UpdateRow(node);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateNodeInternal(TreeListNode node, NodeChangeType type, bool filterNodes, bool filterChildren, bool sortNodes, string changedPropertyName)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsUpdateLocked && !((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsCurrentRowEditing)
			{
				if (filterNodes)
				{
					UpdateNodeVisiblility(node, filterChildren);
				}
				if (sortNodes)
				{
					DoSortInternal(node);
				}
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).OnNodeCollectionChanged((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, type, changedPropertyName, true, false);
				if (((IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem>)((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).TotalSummary).Any((TreeListSummaryItem x) => (int)((SummaryItem)x).SummaryTypeEx != 6) || ((IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem>)((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).NodeSummary).Any((TreeListSummaryItem x) => (int)((SummaryItem)x).SummaryTypeEx != 6))
				{
					DataProvider.View.UpdateColumnsTotalSummary();
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoSortInternal(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).IsCurrentRowEditing)

				((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoSortNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node.GetParentNodeInternal());
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCurrentControllerRow(TreeListNodeBase node)
		{

		private void UpdateNodeVisiblility(TreeListNode node, bool filterChildren)
		{
			switch (DataProvider.View.FilteringMode)
			{
			case TreeListFilteringMode.ParentBranch:
			case TreeListFilteringMode.EntireBranch:
			{
				TreeListNode rootNode = node.RootNode;
				bool flag = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoFilterNode((TreeListNodeBase)(object)rootNode);
				if (DataProvider.View.FilteringMode == TreeListFilteringMode.ParentBranch || (flag && DataProvider.View.FilteringMode == TreeListFilteringMode.EntireBranch))
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoFilterNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)rootNode);
				}
				break;
			}
			case TreeListFilteringMode.Recursive:
			{
				bool flag2 = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoFilterNode((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node);
				if (!flag2 && filterChildren)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoFilterNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node);
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoFilterNode((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node);
				if (filterChildren)
				{
					((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).DoFilterNodes((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node);
				}
				break;
			}
			if (((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).HasFilter)
			{
				((TreeListNodesInfo)NodesInfo).SetDirty(true);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanCalculateSummary(TreeListSummaryItem item, TreeListNodeBase node)
		{
			TreeListNode treeListNode = node as TreeListNode;
			if (item == null || node == null || DataProvider?.View?.DataControl == null || treeListNode == null)
			{
				return ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CanCalculateSummary(item, node);
			}
			if (!(((SummaryItemBase)item).Tag is SummaryItemBase summary) || DataProvider.View.GetActualCalculationMode(summary) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
			{
				return ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CanCalculateSummary(item, node);
			}
			if (!Selection.GetSelected(treeListNode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataProvider.View.IsMultiCellSelection)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = DataProvider.View.DataControl.ColumnsCore[((SummaryItem)item).FieldName];
			if (columnBase != null)
			{
				return DataProvider.View.IsCellSelected(treeListNode, columnBase);
			}
			return ((TreeListDataControllerBase)this).CanCalculateSummary(item, node);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem> GetSummarySelectionSummary(IEnumerable<TreeListSummaryItem> summaryItems)
		{
			List<TreeListSummaryItem> list = new List<TreeListSummaryItem>();
			int[] array = null;
			foreach (TreeListSummaryItem summaryItem in summaryItems)
			{
				if (!(((SummaryItemBase)summaryItem).Tag is SummaryItemBase summary) || DataProvider.View.GetActualCalculationMode(summary) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (DataProvider.View.GetActualCalculationMode(summary) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.SelectedRows)
				{
					list.Add(summaryItem);
				}
				else if (DataProvider.View.IsMultiCellSelection)
				{
					if (array == null)
					{
						array = DataProvider.View.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedRows();
					}
					ColumnBase columnBase = DataProvider.View.DataControl.ColumnsCore[((SummaryItem)summaryItem).FieldName];
					if (columnBase != null && CountSelectedCellsIsMoreTwo(columnBase, array))
					{
						list.Add(summaryItem);
					}
				}
				else if (DataProvider.View.GetSelectedRows().Count > 1)
				{
					list.Add(summaryItem);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal bool CountSelectedCellsIsMoreTwo(ColumnBase column, int[] selectedRows)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (int rowHandle in selectedRows)
			{
				if (DataProvider.View.IsCellSelected(rowHandle, column))
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (num == 2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateNodesStateOnFiltering(CriteriaOperator newCriteria)
		{
			if (FilterCriteria == null && newCriteria != null)
			{
				nodesStateSaved = Controller.NodesState.SaveCurrentFocus() | Controller.NodesState.SaveNodesState(supressLocker: false, TreeListNodesState.StatesToStore.IsSelected);
			}
			if (!nodesStateSaved || FilterCriteria == null || newCriteria != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			try
			{
				Controller.NodesState.RestoreNodesState(supressLocker: false, TreeListNodesState.StatesToStore.IsSelected);
				Controller.NodesState.RestoreCurrentFocus();
			}
			finally
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).UnlockUpdate();
				nodesStateSaved = false;
			}
		}

		private int CalcMaxNodeLevel(bool visibleOnly)
		{
			return Math.Max(0, GetMaxNodeLevel(RootNode, -1, visibleOnly));
		}

		private int GetMaxNodeLevel(TreeListNode rootNode, int level, bool visibleOnly)
		{
			int num = level++;
			if (visibleOnly && !((TreeListNodeBase)rootNode).IsExpanded)
			{
				return num;
			}
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)rootNode.Nodes)
			{
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)item).IsVisible)
				{
					num = Math.Max(GetMaxNodeLevel(item, level, visibleOnly), num);
				}
				else if (View.FilteringMode == TreeListFilteringMode.Nodes && item.HasVisibleChildren)
				{
					num = Math.Max(GetMaxNodeLevel(item, level - 1, visibleOnly), num);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

			});
		}

		protected internal void SetObjectIsChecked(TreeListNode node, bool? checkStatus)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName))
				{
					CloseActiveEditor();
					object obj = checkStatus;
					if (View.CheckBoxValueConverter != null && Columns[View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName] != null)
					{
						Type targetType = GetTargetType(node, Columns[View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName]);
						obj = View.CheckBoxValueConverter.ConvertBack(obj, targetType, null, null);
					}
					CurrentlyCheckingNode = node;
					if (View.ImmediateUpdateCheckBoxState || node.BeginRowEditLocker.IsLocked)
					{
						DataHelper.SetValue((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName, obj);
					}
					else
					{
						SetNodeValue(node, View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName, obj);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				CurrentlyCheckingNode = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool? GetObjectIsChecked(TreeListNode node)
		{
			return GetObjectIsChecked(node, View.CheckBoxFieldName);
		}

		protected internal bool? GetObjectIsChecked(TreeListNode node, string checkBoxFieldName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(checkBoxFieldName))
			{
				return node?.IsChecked;
			}
			try
			{
				object obj = View.GetNodeValue(node, checkBoxFieldName);
				if (obj == DBNull.Value)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				if (View.CheckBoxValueConverter != null && Columns[checkBoxFieldName] != null)
				{
					return (bool?)View.CheckBoxValueConverter.Convert(obj, typeof(bool?), null, null);
				}
				return (bool?)obj;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (View.IsDesignTime)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ex is InvalidCastException)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException("CheckBoxFieldName should correspond to a NullableBoolean or Boolean field in a data source.");
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private Type GetTargetType(TreeListNode node, DataColumnInfo columnInfo)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = columnInfo.PropertyDescriptor;
			UnitypeDataPropertyDescriptor val = (UnitypeDataPropertyDescriptor)(object)((propertyDescriptor is UnitypeDataPropertyDescriptor) ? propertyDescriptor : null);
			if (val != null && ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content != null)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = val.GetPropertyDescriptor(((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 != null)
				{
					propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptor2;
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptor.PropertyType;
		}

		protected override object GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(int controllerRow, string columnName)
		{
			if (view == null || !view.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction || controllerRow != view.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				return GetRowValue(controllerRow, columnName);
			}
			RowData rowData = view.GetRowData(view.FocusedRowHandle);
			GridColumnData cellDataByColumn = rowData.GetCellDataByColumn(view.ColumnsCore[columnName]);
			if (cellDataByColumn != null)
			{
				CellEditorBase editor = cellDataByColumn.Editor;
				if (((editor != null) ? ((InplaceEditorBase)editor).Edit : null) == null)
				{
					return ((EditableDataObject)cellDataByColumn).Value;
				}
				return ((InplaceEditorBase)cellDataByColumn.Editor).Edit.EditValue;
			}
			return GetRowValue(controllerRow, columnName);
		}

		internal void UpdateColumnsUnboundTypeIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!shouldUpdateColumnsUnboundType || !Controller.IsLoaded || View.DisplayMemberBindingClient == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			shouldUpdateColumnsUnboundType = false;
			lockReloadNodesOnEndUpdate++;
			try
			{
				View.DisplayMemberBindingClient.UpdateSimpleBinding();
				View.DisplayMemberBindingClient.UpdateColumns();
			}
			finally
			{
				lockReloadNodesOnEndUpdate--;
			}
		}

		internal void TryRepopulateColumns()
		{
			if (isRepopulateColumnsNeeded && Controller.IsLoaded)
			{
				bool flag = autoPopulateColumns && ShouldTryRepopulateColumns();
				Controller.RePopulateColumns();
				if (flag && View.DataControl != null)
				{
					View.DataControl.PopulateColumns();
				}
				isRepopulateColumnsNeeded = false;
			}
		}

		internal void ScheduleRepopulateColumnsIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!DataHelper.IsLoaded)
			{
				isRepopulateColumnsNeeded = true;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldTryRepopulateColumns()
		{
			if (View.GetColumns().Any())
			{
				if (((CollectionBase)(object)Columns).Count == 1)
				{
					return Columns[0].PropertyDescriptor is SimpleListPropertyDescriptor;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal void ExpandToLevel(int maxLevel)
		{
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).BeginUpdateCore();
			((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).SaveFocusState();
			try
			{
				NodeHelpers.DoForDescendants((TreeListNodeBase)(object)RootNode, (Func<TreeListNodeBase, bool>)delegate(TreeListNodeBase node)
				{
					if (maxLevel >= 0 && ((TreeListNode)(object)node).Level > maxLevel)
					{
						return false;
					}
					node.IsExpanded = true;
					return true;
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).RestoreFocusState();
				((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).EndUpdateCore();
			}
		}

		int? IDataProvider.CustomNodeSort(TreeListNodeBase node1Base, TreeListNodeBase node2Base, object value1, object value2, DataColumnInfo column, ColumnSortOrder sortOrder)
		{
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ColumnBase columnBase = View.ColumnsCore[column.Name];
			TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)(object)node1Base;
			TreeListNode treeListNode2 = (TreeListNode)(object)node2Base;
			TreeListCustomColumnSortEventArgs e = new TreeListCustomColumnSortEventArgs(columnBase, treeListNode, treeListNode2, value1, value2);
			View.RaiseCustomColumnSort(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return e.Result;
			}
			ICommand<NodeSortArgs> customColumnSortCommand = View.CustomColumnSortCommand;
			if (customColumnSortCommand == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArgsMutator.SetNodeSortArgs(sortCommandArgs, columnBase.FieldName, treeListNode.GetContent(), treeListNode2.GetContent(), treeListNode, treeListNode2, value1, value2, ToSortOrder(columnBase.SortOrder));
			customColumnSortCommand.Execute(sortCommandArgs);
			int? result = sortCommandArgs.Result;
			ArgsMutator.ClearNodeSortArgs(sortCommandArgs);
			return result;
		}

		private static DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder ToSortOrder(ColumnSortOrder columnSortOrder)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)columnSortOrder switch
			{
				1 => DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder.Ascending, 
				2 => DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder.Descending, 
				0 => DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder.None, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		object IDataProvider.CustomSummary(TreeListNodeBase node, object totalValue, SummaryItem summaryItem, CustomSummaryProcess process, object fieldValue, out bool isTotalValueReady)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		}

		private object CustomSummary(TreeListNode node, SummaryItemBase summaryItem, object totalValue, bool isTotalSummary, object fieldValue, CustomSummaryProcess process, out bool isTotalValueReady)
		{
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = false;
			object result = null;
			if (view.HasCustomSummaryEvent)
			{
				if (customSummaryEventArgs == null)
				{
					customSummaryEventArgs = new TreeListCustomSummaryEventArgs(node, summaryItem, process, fieldValue, isTotalSummary);
				}
				else
				{
					customSummaryEventArgs.SetArgs(node, summaryItem, process, fieldValue, isTotalSummary);
				}
				customSummaryEventArgs.TotalValue = totalValue;
				view.RaiseCustomSummary(customSummaryEventArgs);
				result = customSummaryEventArgs.TotalValue;
				flag = customSummaryEventArgs.IsTotalValueReady;
				customSummaryEventArgs.ClearArgs();
			}
			if (View.HasCustomSummaryCommand)
			{
				DataControlBase.SetSummaryItem(summaryItem, customSummaryArgsItem);
				ArgsMutator.SetNodeSummaryArgs(customSummaryArgs, node.GetContent(), node, customSummaryArgsItem, fieldValue, isTotalSummary, totalValue, DataControlBase.ToSummaryProcess(process));
				view.CustomSummaryCommand.Execute(customSummaryArgs);
				result = customSummaryArgs.TotalValue;
				flag = customSummaryArgs.TotalValueReady;
				ArgsMutator.ClearSummaryItem(customSummaryArgsItem);
				ArgsMutator.ClearNodeSummaryArgs(customSummaryArgs);
			}
			isTotalValueReady = flag;
			return result;
		}

		internal virtual ComplexColumnInfoCollection GetComplexColumns()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ComplexColumnInfoCollection res = new ComplexColumnInfoCollection();
			Action<string> action = delegate(string fieldName)
			{
				if (GridDataProviderBase.IsComplexFieldName(fieldName) && Columns[fieldName] == null)
				{
					res.Add(fieldName);
				}
			};
			foreach (ColumnBase column in View.GetColumns())
			{
				if (!column.IsAutoGenerated && !column.IsUnbound)
				{
					action(column.FieldName);
					action(column.SortFieldName);
				}
			}
			action(View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName);
			action(View.ActualIsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName);
			action(View.ActualExpandStateFieldName);
			action(View.KeyFieldName);
			action(View.ParentFieldName);
			return res;
		}

		object IDataProvider.GetCustomUnboundData(TreeListNodeBase node, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			return GetCustomUnboundData(node, propertyName, value);
		}

		internal virtual object GetCustomUnboundData(TreeListNodeBase node, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			if (GridControl.IsConditionalFormattingServiceColumn(propertyName))
			{
				return value;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = View.ColumnsCore[propertyName];
			if (columnBase == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (columnBase.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator == null)
			{
				return View.RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(node, propertyName, value, isGetAction: true);
			}
			int rowHandleByNode = GetRowHandleByNode((TreeListNode)(object)node);
			if (rowHandleByNode == int.MinValue)
			{
				return View.RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(node, propertyName, value, isGetAction: true);
			}
			return columnBase.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator.GetValue(rowHandleByNode, -1);
		}

		void IDataProvider.SetCustomUnboundData(TreeListNodeBase node, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			SetCustomUnboundData(node, propertyName, value);
		}

		internal virtual void SetCustomUnboundData(TreeListNodeBase node, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = View.ColumnsCore[propertyName];
			if (columnBase?.Binding != null)
			{
				int rowHandleByNode = GetRowHandleByNode((TreeListNode)(object)node);
				if (rowHandleByNode != int.MinValue)
				{
					columnBase.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator.SetValue(rowHandleByNode, value);
					return;
				}
			}
			View.RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(node, propertyName, value, isGetAction: false);
		}

			{

			}
			return (DataColumnFilterMode)2;
		}

		{

		private void CollectNodes(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, IList<TreeListNode> list, Func<TreeListNode, bool> shouldCollectChildren, Func<TreeListNode, bool> shouldProcessNode)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)
			{
				if (shouldProcessNode(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				if (shouldCollectChildren(item))
				{
					CollectNodes(item.Nodes, list, shouldCollectChildren, shouldProcessNode);
				}
			}
		}
