	public class TreeListNodesState
	{
		[Flags]
		public enum StatesToStore
		{
			IsExpanded = 0,
			IsChecked = 1,
			IsSelected = 2,
			All = 3
		}

		protected struct TreeListNodeState
		{
			public bool IsExpanded;

			public bool? IsChecked;

			public bool IsSelected;

			public object SelectedObject;
		}

		private Locker currentFocusLocker = new Locker();

		private Locker nodesStateLocker = new Locker();

		protected string KeyProperty => View.DataControl?.ActualRestoreStateKeyFieldName;

		protected TreeListDataProvider DataProvider { get; private set; }

		protected TreeListView View => DataProvider.View;

		protected Dictionary<object, TreeListNodeState> NodesState { get; private set; }

		public object FocusedRow { get; private set; }

		public TreeListNode FocusedNode { get; private set; }

		public int FocusedRowHandle { get; private set; }

		public TreeListNodesState(TreeListDataProvider provider)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataProvider = provider;
			NodesState = new Dictionary<object, TreeListNodeState>();
		}

		public void ClearState()
		{
			ClearNodesState();
			ClearCurrentFocus();
		}

		public void CancelCurrentNodesState()
		{
			nodesStateLocker.Unlock();
			currentFocusLocker.Unlock();
			ClearState();
		}

		protected void ClearNodesState()
		{
			NodesState.Clear();
		}

		protected void ClearCurrentFocus()
		{
			FocusedRow = null;
			FocusedNode = null;
			FocusedRowHandle = int.MinValue;
		}

		internal void LockSaveNodesState()
		{
			currentFocusLocker.Lock();
			nodesStateLocker.Lock();
		}

		internal void UnlockSaveNodesState()
		{
			currentFocusLocker.Unlock();
			nodesStateLocker.Unlock();
		}

		public bool SaveCurrentFocus(bool supressLocker = false)
		{
			if (supressLocker || !currentFocusLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				SaveCurrentFocusCore();
				if (!supressLocker)
				{
					currentFocusLocker.Lock();
				}
				return true;
			}
			currentFocusLocker.Lock();
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveCurrentFocusCore()
		{
			if (!View.FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked && (View.DataControl == null || View.DataControl.IsSelectionInitialized))
			{
				FocusedNode = View.FocusedNode;
				TreeListNode focusedNode = FocusedNode;
				FocusedRow = ((focusedNode != null) ? ((TreeListNodeBase)focusedNode).Content : null);
				FocusedRowHandle = View.FocusedRowHandle;
			}
		}

		public void RestoreCurrentFocus()
		{
			currentFocusLocker.Unlock();
			currentFocusLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				RestoreCurrentFocusCore();
			});
		}

		protected virtual void RestoreCurrentFocusCore()
		{
			if (View.FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked || (View.DataControl != null && !View.DataControl.IsSelectionInitialized))
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (View.DataControl != null)
			{
				View.DataControl.CurrentItemChangedLocker.Lock();
				obj = View.DataControl.CurrentItem;
			}
			View.ScrollIntoViewLocker.Lock();
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				if (FocusedRow != null && DataProvider.IsReady)
				{
					TreeListNode treeListNode = ((FocusedNode.Controller == DataProvider.Controller) ? FocusedNode : DataProvider.FindNodeByValue(FocusedRow)) ?? DataProvider.FindVisibleNode(FocusedRowHandle);
					if (View.FocusedNode != treeListNode)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						DataProvider.View.DataControl?.CancelRowEditIfNeeded();
					}
					View.FocusedNode = treeListNode;
					View.SetFocusedRowHandle(DataProvider.GetRowHandleByNode(View.FocusedNode));
					if (View.DataControl != null && View.DataControl.AllowUpdateCurrentItem())
					{
						DataControlBase dataControl = View.DataControl;
						TreeListNode focusedNode = View.FocusedNode;
						dataControl.SetCurrentItemCore((focusedNode != null) ? ((TreeListNodeBase)focusedNode).Content : null);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (View.DataControl != null)
				{
					View.DataControl.CurrentItemChangedLocker.Unlock();
					if (!object.Equals(obj, View.DataControl.CurrentItem))
					{
						View.DataControl.RaiseCurrentItemChanged(obj, View.DataControl.CurrentItem);
					}
				}
				View.ScrollIntoViewLocker.Unlock();
				ClearCurrentFocus();
				if (flag)
				{
					DataProvider.ResetCurrentPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool SaveNodesState(bool supressLocker = false, StatesToStore statesToStore = StatesToStore.All)
		{
			if (supressLocker || !nodesStateLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				SaveNodesStateCore(statesToStore);
				if (!supressLocker)
				{
					nodesStateLocker.Lock();
				}
				return true;
			}
			nodesStateLocker.Lock();
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual object GetKey(TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(KeyProperty))
			{
				return DataProvider.DataHelper.GetValue(((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content, KeyProperty);
			}
			return ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveNodesStateCore(StatesToStore statesToStore)
		{
			ClearNodesState();
			bool flag = (statesToStore & StatesToStore.IsExpanded) == 0;
			bool flag2 = (statesToStore & StatesToStore.IsChecked) != 0;
			bool flag3 = (statesToStore & StatesToStore.IsSelected) != 0;
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(DataProvider.Nodes))
			{
				object key = GetKey(item);
				if (key != null && !NodesState.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					TreeListNodeState value = default(TreeListNodeState);
					if (flag)
					{
						value.IsExpanded = ((TreeListNodeBase)item).IsExpanded;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						value.IsChecked = item.IsChecked;
					}
					if (flag3)
					{
						value.IsSelected = DataProvider.Selection.GetSelected(((TreeListNodeBase)item).RowHandle);
						value.SelectedObject = DataProvider.Selection.GetSelectedObject(((TreeListNodeBase)item).RowHandle);
					}
					NodesState.Add(key, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RestoreNodesState(bool supressLocker = false, StatesToStore statesToStore = StatesToStore.All)
		{
			if (supressLocker)
			{
				RestoreNodesStateCore(statesToStore);
				return;
			}
			nodesStateLocker.Unlock();
			nodesStateLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				RestoreNodesStateCore(statesToStore);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void RestoreNodesStateCore(StatesToStore statesToStore)
		{
			if (NodesState.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataProvider.Selection.BeginSelection();
			bool flag = (statesToStore & StatesToStore.IsExpanded) == 0;
			bool flag2 = (statesToStore & StatesToStore.IsChecked) != 0;
			bool flag3 = (statesToStore & StatesToStore.IsSelected) != 0;
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (IEnumerable<TreeListNode>)new TreeListNodeIterator(DataProvider.Nodes))
			{
				object key = GetKey(item);
				if (key != null && NodesState.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					if (flag && ((TreeListNodeBase)item).IsExpanded != value.IsExpanded)
					{
						item.SetNodeExpanded(value.IsExpanded);
					}
					if (flag2 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.ActualCheckBoxFieldName))
					{
						item.IsChecked = value.IsChecked;
					}
					if (flag3)
					{
						DataProvider.TreeListSelection.SetSelected(item, value.IsSelected, value.SelectedObject);
					}
				}
			}
			DataProvider.Selection.EndSelection();
			ClearNodesState();
		}

		internal void UpdateNodeExpandState(TreeListNode node, bool isExpanded)
		{
			if (NodesState.Count != 0)
			{
				object key = GetKey(node);
				if (key != null && NodesState.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value.IsExpanded = isExpanded;
					NodesState[key] = value;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TreeListScrollNodesInfo : TreeListNodesInfo
	{
		private int scrollIndex;

		private int visibleIndex;

		private int summaryRowCount;

		private Dictionary<int, object> visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap;

		private Dictionary<int, int> visibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap;

		internal bool ShowNodeSummaryFootersForPrinting = true;

		internal bool ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore;

		protected TreeListDataController Controller => (TreeListDataController)(object)((TreeListNodesInfo)this).Controller;

		protected TreeListView View => Controller.DataProvider.View;

		internal bool HasInvisibleSummaryFooters { get; private set; }

		protected bool ShowNodeSummaryFooters
		{
			get
			{
				if (ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore)
				{
					return ShowNodeSummaryFootersForPrinting;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsBottomNewItemRowVisible => View.NewItemRowPosition == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom;

		protected Dictionary<int, object> VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap => visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap ?? (visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap = new Dictionary<int, object>());

		public int SummaryRowCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore && !ShowNodeSummaryFootersForPrinting)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return summaryRowCount;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryRowCount = value;
			}
		}

		protected Dictionary<int, int> VisibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap => visibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap ?? (visibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap = new Dictionary<int, int>());

		public TreeListScrollNodesInfo(TreeListDataController controller, bool allNodes = false)
			: base((TreeListDataControllerBase)(object)controller, allNodes)
		{
		}

		public void UpdateNodeFooterDisplayMode()
		{
			ShowNodeSummaryFootersCore = View.ShowNodeFooters;
		}

		protected override void ClearVisibleIndicies()
		{
			((TreeListNodesInfo)this).ClearVisibleIndicies();
			HasInvisibleSummaryFooters = false;
			visibleIndexToScrollIndexMap = null;
			visibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap = null;
			scrollIndex = 0;
			visibleIndex = 0;
			SummaryRowCount = 0;
		}

		protected override void OnVisibleIndexAssigned(TreeListNodeBase node)
		{
			if (!ShowNodeSummaryFooters)
			{
				return;
			}
			TreeListNode treeListNode = (TreeListNode)(object)node;
			VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[scrollIndex] = visibleIndex;
			scrollIndex++;
			visibleIndex++;
			if (!treeListNode.IsLastVisible || ((((TreeListNodeBase)treeListNode).IsExpanded || base.allNodes) && treeListNode.HasVisibleChildren))
			{
				return;
			}
			VisibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap[treeListNode.VisibleIndexCore] = SummaryRowCount;
			if (CanShowNodeFooter(treeListNode))
			{
				VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[scrollIndex] = new GroupSummaryRowKey(new RowHandle(treeListNode.RowHandleCore), treeListNode.Level);
				SummaryRowCount++;
				scrollIndex++;
			}
			TreeListNode parentNode = treeListNode.ParentNode;
			while (parentNode != null && parentNode.IsLastVisible)
			{
				if (CanShowNodeFooter(parentNode))
				{
					VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[scrollIndex] = new GroupSummaryRowKey(new RowHandle(parentNode.RowHandleCore), parentNode.Level);
					SummaryRowCount++;
					scrollIndex++;
				}
				parentNode = parentNode.ParentNode;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanShowNodeFooter(TreeListNode node)
		{
			bool flag = View.RaiseShowingNodeFooter(node.ParentNode);
			if (!HasInvisibleSummaryFooters && !flag)
			{
				HasInvisibleSummaryFooters = true;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public virtual object GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex)
		{
			if (!ShowNodeSummaryFooters)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			if (!VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap.TryGetValue(scrollIndex, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public virtual int GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndexSafe(int scrollIndex)
		{
			if (!ShowNodeSummaryFooters || scrollIndex >= VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap.Count)
			{
				return scrollIndex;
			}
			for (int num = scrollIndex; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[num];
				if (obj is int)
				{
					return (int)obj;
				}
			}
			return scrollIndex;
		}

		public virtual int GetScrollIndexByVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (!ShowNodeSummaryFooters)
			{
				return visibleIndex;
			}
			return visibleIndex + GetSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(visibleIndex);
		}

		protected int GetSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, int> item in VisibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap)
			{
				if (visibleIndex > num && visibleIndex <= item.Key)
				{
					return item.Value;
				}
				num = item.Key;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected override void OnCacheCreated()
		{
			((TreeListNodesInfo)this).OnCacheCreated();
			if (ShowNodeSummaryFooters && IsBottomNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				VisibleIndexToScrollIndexMap[scrollIndex] = visibleIndex;
				VisibleIndexToSummaryRowCountMap[visibleIndex] = SummaryRowCount;
			}
			if (Controller.DataProvider.VisibleItems != null)
			{
				Controller.DataProvider.UpdateVisibleItems();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXTreeListFilterHelper : TreeListFilterHelper
	{
		public TreeListDataController Controller => (TreeListDataController)(object)((TreeListFilterHelper)this).Controller;

		public DXTreeListFilterHelper(TreeListDataController controller)
			: base((TreeListDataControllerBase)(object)controller)
		{
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>> GetUniqueColumnValuesWithCounts(string propertyName, ColumnValuesArguments args, bool isDisplayText)
		{
			DataColumnInfo val = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).Columns[propertyName];
			if (val == null)
			{
				return EmptyArray<Counted<object>>.Instance.ToReadOnlyCollection();
			}
			if (!((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).IsReady)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<object> columnValues = GetColumnValues(args, val, isDisplayText);
			ValueComparer valueComparer = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).ValueComparer;
			return DXGridDataControllerFilterHelper.GetUniqueValues(GetListSource(), columnValues, valueComparer);
		}

		private IEnumerable<object> GetColumnValues(ColumnValuesArguments args, DataColumnInfo column, bool isDisplayText)
		{
			return ((TreeListFilterHelper)this).GetColumnValues(column, args.Filter, args.IgnoreAppliedFilter, args.RoundDateTime, isDisplayText, args.ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering);
		}

		public object GetSummaryValue(string propertyName, SummaryItemType summaryType, ColumnValuesArguments args, bool ignoreNulls = true)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataColumnInfo val = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).Columns[propertyName];
			IEnumerable<object> columnValues = GetColumnValues(args, val, isDisplayText: false);
			return DXGridDataControllerFilterHelper.GetSummaryValue(GetListSource(), summaryType, ignoreNulls, columnValues, val.Type);
		}

		private object GetListSource()
		{
			TreeListDataHelperBase dataHelper = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)Controller).DataHelper;
			TreeListDataHelperBase obj = ((dataHelper is TreeListBoundDataHelper) ? dataHelper : null);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((TreeListBoundDataHelper)obj).ListSource;
		}
	}

				else if (base.IsNewItemRow && View != null && !View.TreeListViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowEditing)
				{
					View.AddNewNodeCore(View.TreeListDataProvider.RootNode)?.UpdateNodeChecked(value);

				SetCheckStateCore(value);

		static TreeListRowData()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TreeListRowData);
			IsExpandedPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsExpanded", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsExpandedProperty = IsExpandedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsButtonVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsButtonVisibleProperty = IsButtonVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsImageVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsImageVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsImageVisibleProperty = IsImageVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsCheckBoxVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsCheckBoxVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsCheckBoxVisibleProperty = IsCheckBoxVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IndentsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Indents", typeof(List<TreeListIndentType>), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IndentsProperty = IndentsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			RowMarginPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("RowMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			RowMarginProperty = RowMarginPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			RowLevelPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("RowLevel", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(0));
			RowLevelProperty = RowLevelPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IndentSelectionStatePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IndentSelectionState", typeof(SelectionState), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(SelectionState.None));
			IndentSelectionStateProperty = IndentSelectionStatePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowTreeIndentAsCellPartPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ShowTreeIndentAsCellPart", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			ShowTreeIndentAsCellPartProperty = ShowTreeIndentAsCellPartPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			LoadingPanelStatePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("LoadingPanelState", typeof(LoadingPanelState), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(LoadingPanelState.Hidden, OnLoadingPanelStateChanged));
			LoadingPanelStateProperty = LoadingPanelStatePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public TreeListRowData(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder)
			: base(treeBuilder)
		{
		}

		private void SetCheckStateCore(bool? value)
		{
			if (IsChecked != value)
			{
				isChecked = value;
				NotifyPropertyChanged("IsChecked");
			}
		}

		private static void OnLoadingPanelStateChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			((TreeListRowData)(object)sender).UpdateRowMarginContent();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateData()
		{
			base.UpdateData();
			if (base.Row != null)
			{
				IsButtonVisible = CanShowExpandButton();
				IsExpanded = ((TreeListNodeBase)Node).IsExpanded;
				LoadingPanelState = Node.GetLoadingState();
				UpdateNodeImage();
				IsChecked = Node.IsChecked;
				IsCheckBoxEnabled = Node.IsCheckBoxEnabled;
			}
			else if (base.IsNewItemRow)
			{
				UpdateNodeImage();
				SetCheckStateCore(null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateNodeImage()
		{
			Image = GetImageSource();
		}

		protected override void AssignFromCore(NodeContainer nodeContainer, RowNode rowNode)
		{
			base.AssignFromCore(nodeContainer, rowNode);
			UpdateRowState();
		}

		internal override void AssignFrom(RowsContainer parentRowsContainer, NodeContainer parentNodeContainer, RowNode rowNode, bool forceUpdate)
		{
			base.AssignFrom(parentRowsContainer, parentNodeContainer, rowNode, forceUpdate);
			UpdateRowMarginControlContent();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRowMarginControlContent()
		{
			if (View != null && View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft)
			{
				UpdateRowMarginContent();
			}
		}

		internal void SetRowMarginControlClient(IRowMarginControl rowMarginControl)
		{
			rowMarginControlClient = rowMarginControl;
		}

		protected void UpdateRowMarginContent()
		{
			if (rowMarginControlClient != null)
			{
				rowMarginControlClient.Update();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateRowState()
		{
			if (Node != null)
			{
				IsExpanded = ((TreeListNodeBase)Node).IsExpanded;
				LoadingPanelState = Node.GetLoadingState();
			}
			IsButtonVisible = CanShowExpandButton();
			IsImageVisible = View.ShowNodeImages;
			IsCheckBoxVisible = View.ShowCheckboxes;
			RowLevel = Level;
			RowMargin = new Thickness((double)Level * View.RowIndent, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			Indents = ((View.TreeLineStyle == TreeListLineStyle.None) ? null : CalcNodeIndents());
			UpdateShowTreeIndentAsCellPart();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateIsSelected(bool forceIsSelected)
		{
			base.UpdateIsSelected(forceIsSelected);
			if (!base.IsDirty)
			{
				UpdateNodeImage();
			}
			UpdateIndentSelectionState();
		}

		protected virtual bool CanShowExpandButton()
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (Node == null || (!View.ShowRootIndent && Node.ActualLevel == 0) || base.IsNewItemRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (View.ShowExpandButtons && Node.IsTogglable)
			{
				return (int)Node.IsExpandButtonVisible != 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal ImageSource GetImageSource()
		{
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (View.NodeImageSelector != null)
			{
				ImageSource imageSource = (View.NodeImageSelector.CanSelect(this) ? View.NodeImageSelector.Select(this) : null);
				if (imageSource != null)
				{
					return imageSource;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.ImageFieldName))
			{
				try
				{
					object obj = View.GetNodeValue(Node, View.ImageFieldName);
					if (obj == null && Node != null && ((TreeListNodeBase)Node).Content != null)
					{
						obj = TryGetValueInternal(((TreeListNodeBase)Node).Content, View.ImageFieldName);
					}
					if (obj != null)
					{
						if (obj is ImageSource result)
						{
							return result;
						}
						if (obj is byte[] array)
						{
							return new BytesToImageSourceConverter().Convert((object)array, (Type)null, (object)null, (CultureInfo)null) as ImageSource;
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (Node != null)
			{
				return Node.Image;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object TryGetValueInternal(object obj, string propertyName)
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj)[propertyName]?.GetValue(obj);
		}

		protected internal override bool GetShowBottomLine()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual List<TreeListIndentType> CalcNodeIndents()
		{
			List<TreeListIndentType> list = new List<TreeListIndentType>();
			TreeListUtils.CalcNodeIndents(Node, list, View.ShowRootIndent);
			return list;
		}

		protected override void UpdateNextRowLevel()
		{
			if (View.TreeListDataProvider.NodesInfo.HasInvisibleSummaryFooters && Node.IsLastVisible)
			{
				base.NextRowLevel = TreeListNodeSummaryRowData.CalcActualNextRowLevel(parentNodeContainer, node);
			}
			else
			{
				base.UpdateNextRowLevel();
			}
		}

		protected internal override double GetRowIndent(bool isFirstColumn)
		{
			if (isFirstColumn)
			{
				return GetLeftIndent();
			}
			return base.GetRowIndent(isFirstColumn);
		}

		protected override bool HasTreeColumn()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				return View.GetTreeColumn() != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override double GetTreeColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && View.IsTreeColumn(column))
			{
				return GetTreeColumnOffset();
			}
			return base.GetTreeColumnOffset(column);
		}

		protected internal override double GetTreeColumnOffset()
		{
			return (double)(((Node != null) ? Node.ActualLevel : Level) + View.ServiceIndentsCount) * View.RowIndent;
		}

		protected internal override double GetRowLeftMargin(GridColumnData data)
		{
			if (data.Column.ParentBand == null && data.VisibleIndex != data.Column.ActualVisibleIndex && data.VisibleIndex == 0 && View.FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count == 0 && View.ViewBehavior.GetActualColumnFixed(data.Column) == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return GetLeftIndent();
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetLeftIndent()
		{
			if (View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (double)(View.TreeListDataProvider.MaxVisibleLevel - ((Node != null) ? Node.ActualLevel : Level)) * View.RowIndent;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateIndentSelectionState()
		{
			UpdateShowTreeIndentAsCellPart();
			IndentSelectionState = CalcIndentSelectionState();
		}

		protected void UpdateShowTreeIndentAsCellPart()
		{
			ShowTreeIndentAsCellPart = View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && !View.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight;
		}

		protected virtual SelectionState CalcIndentSelectionState()
		{
			if (View == null || View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl || View.ExtendRowMarginControlHeight)
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return GetTreeColumnCellData()?.SelectionState ?? SelectionState.None;
		}

		protected EditGridCellData GetTreeColumnCellData()
		{
			return base.CellDataCache.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<ColumnBase, GridColumnData> c) => View.IsTreeColumn(c.Key)).Value as EditGridCellData;
		}

		internal override bool ScheduleUpdateRow(string propertyName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && propertyName == View.ImageFieldName && View.ShowNodeImages)
			{
				UpdateNodeImage();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public class TreeListNodeSummaryRowData : GroupSummaryRowData

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IndentsProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IndentsPropertyKey;

		{

			}

				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(IndentsPropertyKey, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected TreeListSummaryRowNode SummaryRowNode => (TreeListSummaryRowNode)base.DataRowNode;

		protected TreeListView TreeListView => (TreeListView)base.View;

		protected TreeListDataProvider DataProvider => TreeListView.TreeListDataProvider;

		protected override bool UpdateImmediatelyCore => !base.View.GetAllowGroupSummaryCascadeUpdate;

		public override double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return base.TableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent * (double)(Level + TreeListView.ServiceIndentsCount);
			}
		}

		static TreeListNodeSummaryRowData()
		{
			IndentsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Indents", typeof(List<TreeListIndentType>), typeof(TreeListNodeSummaryRowData), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IndentsProperty = IndentsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			GroupSummaryRowData.IsFooterMarginControlVisiblePropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TreeListNodeSummaryRowData), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
		}

		public TreeListNodeSummaryRowData(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, RowHandle rowHandle)
			: base(treeBuilder, rowHandle)
		{
		}

		protected internal override double GetTreeColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (base.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && base.View.IsTreeColumn(column))
			{
				return (double)(Level + TreeListView.ServiceIndentsCount) * TreeListView.RowIndent;
			}
			return base.GetTreeColumnOffset(column);
		}

		protected override void UpdateContentOffset()
		{
		}

		internal override void UpdateLineLevel()
		{
		}

		protected override void AssignFromCore(NodeContainer nodeContainer, RowNode rowNode)
		{
			base.AssignFromCore(nodeContainer, rowNode);
			base.NextRowLevel = int.MinValue;
			Indents = ((TreeListView.TreeLineStyle == TreeListLineStyle.None) ? null : CalcIndents());
		}

		protected virtual List<TreeListIndentType> CalcIndents()
		{
			List<TreeListIndentType> list = new List<TreeListIndentType>();
			if (TreeListView.GetRowData(RowHandle.Value) is TreeListRowData treeListRowData)
			{
				list.AddRange(treeListRowData.Indents);
			}
			else
			{
				TreeListUtils.CalcNodeIndents(TreeListView.GetNodeByRowHandle(RowHandle.Value), list, TreeListView.ShowRootIndent);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				list[list.Count - 1] = TreeListIndentType.None;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void UpdateNextRowLevel()
		{
			if (RowHandle != null && base.View != null)
			{
				if (DataProvider.NodesInfo.HasInvisibleSummaryFooters)
				{
					base.NextRowLevel = CalcActualNextRowLevel(parentNodeContainer, SummaryRowNode);
				}
				else
				{
					base.NextRowLevel = Level - 1;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override NotImplementedRowDataReusingStrategy CreateReusingStrategy(Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
		{
			return new TreeListNodeSummaryRowDataReusingStrategy(this);
		}

		protected override bool CanExtractGridGroupSummaryItem(SummaryItemBase summary)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal static int CalcActualNextRowLevel(NodeContainer container, RowNode currentNode)
		{
			int num = container.Items.IndexOf(currentNode);
			if (num + 1 < container.Items.Count)
			{
				DataRowNode dataRowNode = (DataRowNode)container.Items[num + 1];
				if (dataRowNode is TreeListSummaryRowNode treeListSummaryRowNode)
				{
					return treeListSummaryRowNode.Level;
				}
				return dataRowNode.Level;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal override void UpdateClientSummary()
		{
			base.UpdateClientSummary();
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.IsFooterMarginControlVisible = (((!TreeListView.TreeListViewBehavior.AllowTreeIndentScrolling || TreeListView.VisibleColumnsCore.Count != 0) && TreeListView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? true : false);
				UpdateVerticalSeparatorVisibility();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateClientVerticalLineVisibility()
		{
			UpdateVerticalSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVerticalSeparatorVisibility()
		{
			foreach (GridColumnData cellDatum in base.CellData)
			{
				GridGroupSummaryColumnData gridGroupSummaryColumnData = SafeGetGroupSummaryColumnData(cellDatum.Column);
				if (gridGroupSummaryColumnData != null)
				{
					gridGroupSummaryColumnData.ShowVerticalSeparator = base.View.ShowGroupFooterSummaryItemVerticalSeparator(cellDatum.Column);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public static class TreeListUtils
	{
		public static void CalcNodeIndents(TreeListNode node, List<TreeListIndentType> indents, bool showRootIndent)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			indents.Clear();
			int actualLevel = node.ActualLevel;
			int num = ((!showRootIndent) ? 1 : 0);
			TreeListNode visibleParent = node.VisibleParent;
			for (int num2 = actualLevel; num2 >= num; num2--)
			{
				TreeListIndentType item;
				if (num2 == actualLevel)
				{
					item = ((actualLevel == 0 && node.IsFirstVisible && node.IsLastVisible) ? TreeListIndentType.Root : ((actualLevel == 0 && node.IsFirstVisible) ? TreeListIndentType.First : ((!node.IsLastVisible) ? TreeListIndentType.Middle : TreeListIndentType.Last)));
				}
				else
				{
					item = ((!visibleParent.IsLastVisible) ? TreeListIndentType.Line : TreeListIndentType.None);
					visibleParent = visibleParent.VisibleParent;
				}
				indents.Add(item);
			}
			indents.Reverse();
		}
	}

	public class TreeListDataIterator : DataIteratorBase
	{
		private TreeListView view => (TreeListView)viewBase;

		public TreeListDataIterator(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected internal override RowNode GetRowNodeForCurrentLevel(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int index, int startVisibleIndex, bool isFixedNode, ref bool shouldBreak)
		{
			object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = view.TreeListDataProvider.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(index);
			if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey groupSummaryRowKey && GetSummaryNodeForCurrentNode(nodeContainer, groupSummaryRowKey.RowHandle, index) is TreeListSummaryRowNode treeListSummaryRowNode)
			{
				DataRowNode dataRowNode = GetDataRowNode(treeListSummaryRowNode.RowHandle.Value);
				if (dataRowNode != null)
				{
					dataRowNode.summaryNode = treeListSummaryRowNode;
				}
				return treeListSummaryRowNode;
			}
			DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues = DataIteratorBase.CreateValuesContainer(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, (int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex);
			return GetRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, startVisibleIndex, controllerValues);
		}

		private DataRowNode GetDataRowNode(int rowHandle)
		{
			DataRowNode value = null;
			if (viewBase.Nodes.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override RowNode GetSummaryNodeForCurrentNode(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, RowHandle rowHandle, int index)
		{
			DataRowNode groupSummaryRowNode = nodeContainer.treeBuilder.GetGroupSummaryRowNode(rowHandle.Value);
			if (groupSummaryRowNode != null)
			{
				return groupSummaryRowNode;
			}
			return CreateSummaryNode(nodeContainer, rowHandle);
		}

		protected virtual RowNode CreateSummaryNode(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, RowHandle rowHandle)
		{
			DataRowNode dataRowNode = CreateSummaryNodeCore(nodeContainer, rowHandle);
			if (dataRowNode != null)
			{
				nodeContainer.treeBuilder.AddGroupSummaryRowNode(rowHandle.Value, dataRowNode);
			}
			return dataRowNode;
		}

		protected virtual DataRowNode CreateSummaryNodeCore(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, RowHandle rowHandle)
		{
			return new TreeListSummaryRowNode(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, DataIteratorBase.CreateValuesContainer(nodeContainer.treeBuilder, rowHandle));
		}
	}

					lookUp.IsPopupAutoWidth = IsPopupAutoWidth;
				});
				((BaseEditSettings)this).SetValueFromSettings(AutoPopulateColumnsProperty, (Action)delegate
				{
					lookUp.AutoPopulateColumns = AutoPopulateColumns;
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public class LookUpEditStrategy : LookUpEditStrategyBase, ISelectorEditStrategy, IEditStrategy
	{
		private readonly Locker PopupSizeChangeLocker = new Locker();

		private LookUpEdit Editor => ((TextEditStrategy)this).Editor as LookUpEdit;

		internal GridControlVisualClientOwner VisualClient => ((LookUpEditStrategyBase)this).VisualClient as GridControlVisualClientOwner;

		protected override bool IsLockedByValueChanging
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((EditStrategyBase)this).IsLockedByValueChanging)
				{
					return PopupSizeChangeLocker.IsLocked;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public LookUpEditStrategy(LookUpEdit editor)
			: base((LookUpEditBase)(object)editor)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


		public virtual bool AllowPopupProcessGestures(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (!VisualClient.IsSearchControlFocused)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (key == Key.Escape)
			{
				return !VisualClient.IsSearchTextEmpty;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void SetInitialPopupSize()
		{
			PopupSizeChangeLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				Editor.SetInitialPopupSizeInternal();
			});
		}

		public override void ApplyToEdit(BaseEdit editor)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((BaseLookUpStyleSettings)this).ApplyToEdit(editor);
			LookUpEdit isTextEditable = (LookUpEdit)(object)editor;
			LookUpEditBasePropertyProvider val = (LookUpEditBasePropertyProvider)ActualPropertyProvider.GetProperties((DependencyObject)(object)editor);
			((ButtonEditPropertyProvider)val).SetIsTextEditable((ButtonEdit)(object)isTextEditable);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SyncValues(LookUpEditBase editor, GridControl grid)
		{
			if (LookUpEditHelper.GetIsServerMode(editor))
			{
				if (((BaseLookUpStyleSettings)this).GetSelectionMode(editor) == System.Windows.Controls.SelectionMode.Single)
				{
					grid.View.SelectRowByValue(editor.ValueMember, LookUpEditHelper.GetEditValue((ISelectorEdit)(object)editor));
				}
				else
				{
					grid.View.SelectRowsByValues(editor.ValueMember, (IEnumerable<object>)LookUpEditHelper.GetEditValue((ISelectorEdit)(object)editor));
				}
			}
			else if (((BaseLookUpStyleSettings)this).GetSelectionMode(editor) == System.Windows.Controls.SelectionMode.Single)
			{
				object selectedItem = LookUpEditHelper.GetSelectedItem((ISelectorEdit)(object)editor);
				if (selectedItem != null)
				{
					grid.SetCurrentItemCore(selectedItem);
				}
				else if (grid.AllowInitiallyFocusedRow)
				{
					grid.View.FocusedRowHandle = grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(0);
				}
			}
			else if (LookUpEditHelper.GetIsInTokenMode(editor))
			{
				Unselect(grid);
				selectedItemsLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					List<object> items2 = LookUpEditHelper.GetSelectedItems(editor).Cast<object>().ToList();
					grid.ResetSelectedItems(items2);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				List<object> items = LookUpEditHelper.GetSelectedItems(editor).Cast<object>().ToList();
				grid.ResetSelectedItems(items);
			}
		}

		private void Unselect(GridControl grid)
		{
			DataViewBase view = grid.View;
			int[] selectedRowHandlesCore = grid.View.GetSelectedRowHandlesCore();
			foreach (int rowHandle in selectedRowHandlesCore)
			{
				view.DataControl.UnselectItem(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected override bool GetIncrementalFiltering()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

			}
		}

			}
		}

		private bool IsInAutoFilterRowEditing
		{
			get
			{
				if (((VisualClientOwner)this).IsLoaded && View.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483645)
				{
					return View.ActiveEditor != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsInnerPopupOpened
		{
			get
			{
				if (((VisualClientOwner)this).IsLoaded)
				{
					if (!View.IsContextMenuOpened)
					{
						return View.IsColumnFilterOpened;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSearchControlFocused
		{
			get
			{
				if (SearchControl != null)
				{
					return ((UIElement)(object)SearchControl).IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSearchTextEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (SearchControl == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				SearchControl.DoValidate();
				return string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchControl.SearchText);
			}
		}

		private bool IsServerMode => LookUpEditHelper.GetIsServerMode((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor);

		private IList<object> TotalSelectedItems { get; set; }

		private bool SelectionChangedManually { get; set; }

		protected override void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				Grid.MouseLeftButtonUp += GridMouseUp;
				Grid.View.FocusedRowHandleChanged += FocusedRowChanged;
				Grid.CurrentItemChanged += GridOnCurrentItemChanged;
				Grid.SelectionChanged += GridSelectionChanged;
				((VisualClientOwner)this).SubscribeEvents();
			}
		}

		protected override void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				Grid.MouseLeftButtonUp -= GridMouseUp;
				Grid.View.FocusedRowHandleChanged -= FocusedRowChanged;
				Grid.CurrentItemChanged -= GridOnCurrentItemChanged;
				Grid.SelectionChanged -= GridSelectionChanged;
				((VisualClientOwner)this).UnsubscribeEvents();
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearInnerEditor(FrameworkElement editor)
		{
			if (Grid != null && IsServerMode && IsInitializedFromCode())
			{
				Grid.ItemsSource = null;
			}
			((VisualClientOwner)this).ClearInnerEditor(editor);
		}

		private void GridOnCurrentItemChanged(object sender, CurrentItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (LookUpEditHelper.GetIsAsyncServerMode((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor) && !selectionChangedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				SelectionChangedManually = true;
			}
		}

		private void GridSelectionChanged(object sender, GridSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Grid == null || LookUpEditHelper.GetIsSingleSelection((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<object> list = null;
			List<object> list2 = null;
			if (!Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(e.ControllerRow))
			{
				if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Add)
				{
					list = new List<object> { GetRowKey(e.ControllerRow) };
					TotalSelectedItems = TotalSelectedItems.Union(CustomItem.FilterCustomItems((IEnumerable<object>)list)).ToList();
				}
				else if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Remove)
				{
					list2 = new List<object> { GetRowKey(e.ControllerRow) };
					TotalSelectedItems = TotalSelectedItems.Except(CustomItem.FilterCustomItems((IEnumerable<object>)list2)).ToList();
				}
				else if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Refresh)
				{
					if (LookUpEditHelper.GetIsInTokenMode((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor) && StyleSettings.IsSelectionUpdatingOnSyncValues)
					{
						TotalSelectedItems = LookUpEditHelper.GetSelectedItems((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor).Cast<object>().ToList();
					}
					else
					{
						List<object> totalSelectedItems = (from x in Grid.GetSelectedRowHandles()
							where !Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(x)
							select x).Select(GetRowKey).ToList();
						TotalSelectedItems = totalSelectedItems;
					}
				}
			}
			LookUpEditHelper.RaisePopupContentSelectionChangedEvent((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor, (IList)list2, (IList)list);
		}

		public override bool IsClosePopupWithCancelGesture(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (!IsInnerPopupOpened)
			{
				return ((VisualClientOwner)this).IsClosePopupWithCancelGesture(key, modifiers);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsClosePopupWithAcceptGesture(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			if (!IsInAutoFilterRowEditing && !IsInnerPopupOpened)
			{
				return ((VisualClientOwner)this).IsClosePopupWithAcceptGesture(key, modifiers);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void FocusedRowChanged(object sender, FocusedRowHandleChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((FrameworkElement)(object)Editor).IsLoaded && Grid != null)
			{
				LookUpEditHelper.RaisePopupContentSelectionChangedEvent((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor, (IList)new List<object> { null }, (IList)new List<object> { Grid.CurrentItem });
			}
		}

		private void GridMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Released && Grid != null && Grid.View != null)
			{
				int rowHandleByMouseEventArgs = Grid.View.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e);
				if (IsDataRowRowHandle(rowHandleByMouseEventArgs) && LookUpEditHelper.GetClosePopupOnMouseUp((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor))
				{
					((PopupBaseEdit)Editor).ClosePopup();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsDataRowRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid == null || Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowHandle != int.MinValue && rowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				return rowHandle != -2147483645;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void InnerEditorMouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((FrameworkElement)(object)Editor).IsLoaded || Grid == null || IsDragging(sender) || !CalcAllowItemHighlighting((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor) || Grid.View.IsColumnChooserVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(Grid);
			if (lastMousePosition != position)
			{
				int rowHandleByMouseEventArgs = Grid.View.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e);
				if (IsDataRowRowHandle(rowHandleByMouseEventArgs) && !Grid.View.IsEditing)
				{
					SetFocusedRowHandleInternal(rowHandleByMouseEventArgs);
				}
			}
			lastMousePosition = position;
			((VisualClientOwner)this).InnerEditorMouseMove(sender, e);
		}

		private bool CalcAllowItemHighlighting(LookUpEditBase editor)
		{
			if (!LookUpEditHelper.GetIsAllowItemHighlighting(editor))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return LookUpEditHelper.GetClosePopupOnMouseUp((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor);
		}

		private bool IsDragging(object sender)
		{
			DependencyObject topLevelVisual = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)(sender as FrameworkElement));
			if (topLevelVisual == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DragManager.GetIsDragging(topLevelVisual);
		}

		private void SetFocusedRowHandleInternal(int rowHandle)
		{
			View.ScrollIntoViewLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				Grid.View.SetFocusedRowHandle(rowHandle);
			});
		}

		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		public override void PopupClosed()
		{
			((VisualClientOwner)this).PopupClosed();
			CleanSearchText();
			LookUpEditHelper.FocusEditCore((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor);
		}

		public override void PopupContentLoaded()
		{
			((VisualClientOwner)this).PopupContentLoaded();
			((VisualClientOwner)this).SyncProperties(true);
		}

		public override void SyncProperties(bool syncDataSource)
		{
			if (!ShouldSyncProperties)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (syncDataSource)
			{
				SetupDataSource();
			}
			((VisualClientOwner)this).SyncValues(false);
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (((VisualClientOwner)this).IsLoaded)
				{
					Grid.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			});
			SyncSelectedItems(syncDataSource);
		}

		private void SetupDataSource()
		{
			object popupContentItemsSource = ((ISelectorEdit)Editor).GetPopupContentItemsSource();
			if (Grid.ItemsSource != popupContentItemsSource && IsInitializedFromCode())
			{
				Grid.ItemsSource = popupContentItemsSource;
			}
			WeakReference weakReference = Grid.GetValue(LookUpEditBase.ItemsSourceProperty) as WeakReference;
			if (Editor.AutoPopulateColumns && (weakReference == null || weakReference.Target != ((LookUpEditBase)Editor).ItemsSource))
			{
				Grid.PopulateColumns();
				Grid.SetValue(LookUpEditBase.ItemsSourceProperty, new WeakReference(((LookUpEditBase)Editor).ItemsSource));
			}
			SelectionChangedManually = false;
		}

		private bool IsInitializedFromCode()
		{
			BaseValueSource baseValueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(Grid, DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty).BaseValueSource;
			if (baseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				return baseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Local;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessPreviewKeyDownInternal(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!((VisualClientOwner)this).IsLoaded)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (View != null)
			{
				if (View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() && View.DataControl != null && View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == 1 && e.Key == Key.Down && ModifierKeysHelper.NoModifiers(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) && !View.IsRowSelected(View.FocusedRowHandle))
				{
					View.DataControl.SelectItem(View.FocusedRowHandle);
					e.Handled = true;
					return true;
				}
				if (!IsNavigationKey(e.Key))
				{
					View.ViewBehavior.ProcessPreviewKeyDown(e);
					if (!e.Handled)
					{
						View.ProcessKeyDown(e);
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return e.Handled;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessKeyDownInternal(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!((PopupBaseEdit)Editor).IsPopupOpen && !CanClosePopup(e) && OpenPopupAndReraiseTextInput(e))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (View != null && !View.IsContextMenuOpened && !View.IsColumnFilterOpened && IsDataRowRowHandle(View.FocusedRowHandle) && e.Key == Key.Return && ((PopupBaseEdit)Editor).IsPopupOpen)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				((PopupBaseEdit)Editor).ClosePopup();
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanClosePopup(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Return && e.Key != Key.Escape)
			{
				return e.Key == Key.F4;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool OpenPopupAndReraiseTextInput(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((ButtonEditPropertyProvider)PropertyProvider).IsTextEditable || !PropertyProvider.ImmediatePopup || e.Key == Key.Tab || e.Key == Key.LeftShift || e.Key == Key.RightShift || e.Key == Key.System || e.Key == Key.LeftCtrl || e.Key == Key.RightCtrl || e.Key == Key.NumLock || e.Key == Key.Capital || e.Key == Key.Capital)
			{
				return false;
			}
			((PopupBaseEdit)Editor).ShowPopup();
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsNavigationKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key != Key.Right && key != Key.Left && key != Key.Tab && key != Key.Home)
			{
				return key == Key.End;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object GetSelectedItem()
		{
			if (!((VisualClientOwner)this).IsLoaded || Grid == null || Grid.View == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetRowKey(Grid.View.FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		private object GetRowKey(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!IsServerMode)
			{
				return Grid.GetRow(rowHandle);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((LookUpEditBase)Editor).ValueMember))
			{
				return Grid.DataController.GetValueEx(rowHandle, ((LookUpEditBase)Editor).ValueMember);
			}
			return Grid.DataController.GetRowKey(rowHandle);
		}

		public override void SyncValues(bool resetTotals = false)
		{
			((VisualClientOwner)this).SyncValues(resetTotals);
			if (!((VisualClientOwner)this).IsLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!SelectionChangedManually)
			{
				selectionChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					StyleSettings.SyncValues((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor, Grid);
				});
			}
			SyncSelectedItems(resetTotals);
		}

		protected override void BeforeProcessKeyDownInternal()
		{
			SelectionChangedManually = false;
		}

		private void SyncSelectedItems(bool updateTotals)
		{
			if (!updateTotals)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!LookUpEditHelper.GetIsSingleSelection((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor))
			{
				IEnumerable enumerable = LookUpEditHelper.GetEditValue((ISelectorEdit)(object)Editor) as IEnumerable;
				IItemsProvider2 provider = ((ISelectorEdit)Editor).ItemsProvider;
				TotalSelectedItems = ((enumerable != null) ? new List<object>(from object x in enumerable
					select provider.GetItem(x, ((LookUpEditStrategyBase)Editor.EditStrategy).CurrentDataViewHandle)) : new List<object>());
			}
			else
			{
				TotalSelectedItems = new List<object>();
			}
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement FindEditor()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(LookUpEditHelper.GetPopupContentOwner((PopupBaseEdit)(object)Editor).Child, "PART_GridControl");
		}

		protected override void SetupEditor()
		{
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				InitializeSearchPanel();
				Grid.SetValue(TextBlockService.EnableTextHighlightingProperty, false);
				Grid.ShowBorder = false;
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.NavigationStyleProperty, GridViewNavigationStyle.Row);
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItemProperty, false);
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.ShowColumnHeadersProperty, StyleSettings.ShowColumnHeaders);
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.ShowTotalSummaryProperty, StyleSettings.ShowTotalSummary);
				UpdateViewProperty(GridViewBase.ShowGroupPanelProperty, StyleSettings.ShowGroupPanel);
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.AllowSortingProperty, StyleSettings.AllowSorting);
				UpdateViewProperty(GridViewBase.AllowGroupingProperty, StyleSettings.AllowGrouping);
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.AllowColumnFilteringProperty, StyleSettings.AllowColumnFiltering);
				UpdateViewProperty(GridViewBase.SearchPanelPositionProperty, SearchPanelPosition.OverGroupPanel);
				UpdateViewProperty(DataViewBase.SearchPanelHorizontalAlignmentProperty, System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left);
				UpdateProperty(Grid, DataControlBase.SelectionModeProperty, (!LookUpEditHelper.GetIsSingleSelection((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor)) ? MultiSelectMode.Row : MultiSelectMode.None);
				UpdateProperty(Grid, DXSerializer.EnabledProperty, false);
				SyncSelectedItems(updateTotals: true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeSearchPanel()
		{
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ec: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (Grid != null && Grid.View != null)
			{
				Grid.View.ShowSearchPanelMode = (StyleSettings.ShowSearchPanel ? ShowSearchPanelMode.Always : ShowSearchPanelMode.Never);
				CreateColumnProvider();
				Grid.View.SearchPanelFindFilter = PropertyProvider.FilterCondition;
				Grid.View.SearchPanelFindMode = PropertyProvider.FindMode;
				Grid.View.ShowSearchPanelFindButton = (int)((ActualPropertyProvider)PropertyProvider).GetFindButtonPlacement() > 0;
				Grid.View.SearchPanelImmediateMRUPopup = Grid.View.SearchPanelImmediateMRUPopup.HasValue && Grid.View.SearchPanelImmediateMRUPopup.Value;
				if ((int)Grid.View.SearchPanelFindMode == 1 && Grid.View.SearchControl != null)
				{
					Grid.View.SearchControl.SearchControlPropertyProvider.FindCommand.Execute(null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CleanSearchText()
		{
			if (LookUpEditHelper.HasPopupContent((PopupBaseEdit)(object)Editor) && Grid != null && Grid.View != null && Grid.View.SearchString != null)
			{
				GridControlColumnProviderBase columnProvider = GridControlColumnProviderBase.GetColumnProvider(Grid);
				if (columnProvider != null)
				{
					Grid.View.SetCurrentValue(DataViewBase.SearchStringProperty, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void CreateColumnProvider()
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (GridControlColumnProviderBase.GetColumnProvider(Grid) == null)
			{
				GridControlColumnProvider gridControlColumnProvider = new GridControlColumnProvider
				{
					AllowColumnsHighlighting = true,
					FilterByColumnsMode = PropertyProvider.FilterByColumnsMode,
					IsSearchLookUpMode = true
				};
				if ((int)PropertyProvider.FilterByColumnsMode == 1)
				{
					gridControlColumnProvider.CustomColumns = new ObservableCollection<string>(LookUpEditHelper.GetHighlightedColumns((LookUpEditBase)(object)Editor));
				}
				GridControlColumnProviderBase.SetColumnProvider(Grid, gridControlColumnProvider);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateViewProperty(DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			UpdateViewProperty(Grid.View, property, value);
		}

		private void UpdateViewProperty(DependencyObject obj, DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			UpdateProperty(obj, property, value);
		}

		private void UpdateProperty(DependencyObject obj, DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(obj, property);
			if (valueSource.BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Unknown || valueSource.BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				obj.SetValue(property, value);
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetSelectedItems()
		{
			return TotalSelectedItems ?? new List<object>();
		}
	}

	public class ClipboardValueInfoCollection : ClipboardItemInfoCollectionBase<ColumnBase, ClipboardValueInfo>
	{
		public static readonly ClipboardValueInfoCollection Empty = new ClipboardValueInfoCollection();

		private int rowHandleCore;

		private IEnumerable<ClipboardCellInfo> rowInfoCore;

		private IEnumerable<ColumnBase> selectedColumnsCore;

		private DataViewBase viewCore;

		public ClipboardValueInfo this[ColumnBase column]
		{
			get
			{
				if (column == null || base.itemsInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				base.itemsInfo.TryGetValue(column, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		protected ClipboardValueInfoCollection()
		{
			base.itemsInfo = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, ClipboardValueInfo>();
		}

		public ClipboardValueInfoCollection(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle, IEnumerable<ColumnBase> selectedColumns, IEnumerable<ClipboardCellInfo> rowInfo)
		{
			rowInfoCore = rowInfo;
			rowHandleCore = rowHandle;
			selectedColumnsCore = selectedColumns;
			viewCore = view;
			base.itemsInfo = CreateValuesInfo();
		}

		private ClipboardValueInfo CreateValueInfo(int rowHandle, ColumnBase col, ClipboardCellInfo cellInfo)
		{
			ClipboardValueInfo result = null;
			if (col != null)
			{
				result = new ClipboardValueInfo(viewCore, col, rowHandle, cellInfo);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Dictionary<ColumnBase, ClipboardValueInfo> CreateValuesInfo()
		{
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, ClipboardValueInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, ClipboardValueInfo>();
			for (int i = 0; i < rowInfoCore.Count(); i++)
			{
				ColumnBase key = selectedColumnsCore.ElementAt(i);
				dictionary.Add(key, CreateValueInfo(rowHandleCore, selectedColumnsCore.ElementAt(i), rowInfoCore.ElementAt(i)));
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override ClipboardValueInfo GetValueByName(string name)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = base.itemsInfo.Keys.FirstOrDefault((ColumnBase x) => x.FieldName == name);
			if (columnBase != null)
			{
				return base.itemsInfo[columnBase];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ClipboardValueInfo : ClipboardInfoBase
	{
		public static readonly ClipboardValueInfo Empty = new ClipboardValueInfo();

		private DataViewBase viewCore;

		public ColumnBase Column { get; }

		protected ClipboardValueInfo()
		{
		}

		protected ClipboardValueInfo(ClipboardValueInfo other)
			: base((ClipboardInfoBase)(object)other)
		{
			Column = other.Column;
		}

		public ClipboardValueInfo(DataViewBase view, ColumnBase gridColumn, int rowHandle, ClipboardCellInfo rowInfo)
			: base(rowHandle, rowInfo)
		{
			viewCore = view;
			Column = gridColumn;
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayValueText(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (viewCore == null)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			return GetDisplayValueTextCore(value);
		}

		private string GetDisplayValueTextCore(object value)
		{
			if (base.rowHandleCore < 0)
			{
				IEnumerable<object> enumerable = ((viewCore.DataProviderBase.GroupSummaryCore.Count > 0) ? viewCore.DataProviderBase.GroupSummaryCore.Select((SummaryItemBase x, int i) => viewCore.DataControl.GetGroupSummaryValue(base.rowHandleCore, i)) : null);
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					SummaryItemBase summaryItemBase = viewCore.DataProviderBase.GroupSummaryCore.FirstOrDefault((SummaryItemBase x) => x.FieldName == Column.FieldName);
					if (summaryItemBase != null)
					{
						return viewCore.GetGroupSummaryTextValues(Column, base.rowHandleCore, groupFooter: false).TextSource;
					}
				}
				return ((ClipboardInfoBase)this).GetDisplayValueText(value);
			}
			return viewCore.GetColumnDisplayText(value, Column, base.rowHandleCore);
		}
	}
	public class ClipboardHeaderInfoCollection : ClipboardItemInfoCollectionBase<object, ClipboardHeaderInfo>
	{
		public static readonly ClipboardHeaderInfoCollection Empty = new ClipboardHeaderInfoCollection();

		private int rowHandleCore;

		private IEnumerable<ClipboardCellInfo> rowInfoCore;

		private IEnumerable<BandBase> selectedBandsCore;

		private IEnumerable<ColumnBase> selectedColumnsCore;

		public ClipboardHeaderInfo this[ColumnBase column]
		{
			get
			{
				if (column == null || base.itemsInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				base.itemsInfo.TryGetValue(column, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		public ClipboardHeaderInfo this[BandBase band]
		{
			get
			{
				if (band == null || base.itemsInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				base.itemsInfo.TryGetValue(band, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		protected ClipboardHeaderInfoCollection()
		{
			base.itemsInfo = new Dictionary<object, ClipboardHeaderInfo>();
		}

		public ClipboardHeaderInfoCollection(int rowHandle, IEnumerable<ClipboardBandCellInfo> rowInfo)
		{
			rowInfoCore = (IEnumerable<ClipboardCellInfo>)rowInfo;
			rowHandleCore = rowHandle;
			IEnumerable<BandBase> enumerable = from x in rowInfo
				where x.Column is BandBase
				select x.Column as BandBase;
			selectedBandsCore = enumerable;
			base.itemsInfo = CreateHeadersInfo();
		}

		public ClipboardHeaderInfoCollection(int rowHandle, IEnumerable<ColumnBase> selectedColumns, IEnumerable<ClipboardCellInfo> rowInfo)
		{
			rowInfoCore = rowInfo;
			rowHandleCore = rowHandle;
			selectedColumnsCore = selectedColumns;
			base.itemsInfo = CreateValuesInfo();
		}

		private ClipboardHeaderInfo CreateHeaderInfo(int rowHandle, BandBase band, ClipboardCellInfo cellInfo)
		{
			ClipboardHeaderInfo result = null;

	internal class ExcelFormattingConverter
	{
		private const string DefaultXlFontName = "Calibri";

		private const float DefaultXlFontSize = 11f;

		public static XlFont ConvertFont(DXFont font, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, bool useFontColorAuto = true)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XlFont val = new XlFont();
			((XlFontBase)val).Bold = font.Bold;
			((XlFontBase)val).StrikeThrough = font.Strikeout;
			((XlFontBase)val).Underline = (XlUnderlineType)(font.Underline ? 1 : 0);
			((XlFontBase)val).Italic = font.Italic;
			val.FontFamily = (XlFontFamily)2;
			((XlFontBase)val).Name = GetFontName(font);
			((XlFontBase)val).Size = GetFontSize(font);
			GetShemeStyle(val);
			val.Color = GetFontColor(foreColor, useFontColorAuto);
			return val;
		}

		private static void GetShemeStyle(XlFont font)
		{
			((XlFontBase)font).SchemeStyle = (XlFontSchemeStyles)(((XlFontBase)font).Name == "Calibri");
		}

		private static float GetFontSize(DXFont font)
		{
			if (!((double)Math.Abs(font.Size) < 0.01))
			{
				return font.Size;
			}
			return 11f;
		}

		private static string GetFontName(DXFont font)
		{
			return font.Name;
		}

		private static XlColor GetFontColor(System.Drawing.Color foreColor, bool useFontColorAuto)
		{
			XlColor val = XlColor.op_Implicit(foreColor);
			XlColor result = (useFontColorAuto ? XlColor.Auto : XlColor.FromTheme((XlThemeColor)1, 0.0));
			if (!object.Equals(val, XlColor.Empty))
			{
				return val;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static XlFont GetXlFont(StringBlock block)
		{
			XlFont val = XlFont.CustomFont(block.Font.Name, (double)block.FontSettings.Size, XlColor.op_Implicit(block.FontSettings.Color));
			((XlFontBase)val).StrikeThrough = (block.FontSettings.Style & DXFontStyle.Strikeout) != 0;
			((XlFontBase)val).Bold = (block.FontSettings.Style & DXFontStyle.Bold) != 0;
			((XlFontBase)val).Italic = (block.FontSettings.Style & DXFontStyle.Italic) != 0;
			((XlFontBase)val).Underline = (XlUnderlineType)(((block.FontSettings.Style & DXFontStyle.Underline) != DXFontStyle.Regular) ? 1 : 0);
			return val;
		}
	}

		private string GetFormatString()
		{
			if (Column.ActualEditSettings == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			BaseEditSettings actualEditSettings = Column.ActualEditSettings;
			string formatStringByMask = GetFormatStringByMask((TextEditSettings)(object)((actualEditSettings is TextEditSettings) ? actualEditSettings : null));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(formatStringByMask))
			{
				if (string.Equals(formatStringByMask, "P"))
				{
					return "0.00\\%";
				}
				return formatStringByMask;
			}
			return GetFormatStringByDisplayFormat(Column.ActualEditSettings.DisplayFormat);
		}

		private string GetFormatStringByMask(TextEditSettings settings)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (settings != null)
			{
				bool flag = (int)settings.MaskType == 1 || (int)settings.MaskType == 2 || (int)settings.MaskType == 9 || (int)settings.MaskType == 12;
				if (settings.MaskUseAsDisplayFormat && flag)
				{
					return settings.Mask;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetFormatStringByDisplayFormat(string displayFormat)
		{
			string pattern = "{0:.*}";
			if (!Regex.IsMatch(displayFormat, pattern))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = displayFormat.IndexOf(':') + 1;
			int num2 = displayFormat.IndexOf('}') - 1;
			return displayFormat.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1);
		}

		internal static XlCellAlignment GetReportAlignment(System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment actualAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XlCellAlignment val = new XlCellAlignment();
			switch (actualAlignment)
			{
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center:
				val.HorizontalAlignment = (XlHorizontalAlignment)2;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				val.HorizontalAlignment = (XlHorizontalAlignment)1;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				val.HorizontalAlignment = (XlHorizontalAlignment)3;
				break;
			case System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
				val.HorizontalAlignment = (XlHorizontalAlignment)0;
				break;
			}
			val.VerticalAlignment = (XlVerticalAlignment)1;
			return val;
		}

	public class BandedColumnWrapper : ColumnWrapper, IBandedGridColumn, IColumn
	{
		private int columnIndex;

		private int columnRowIndex;

		private bool autoFillDown;

		public virtual bool AutoFillDown => autoFillDown;

		public int Id => 0;

		public virtual int ColVIndex => columnIndex;

		public virtual int ColIndex => columnIndex;

		public virtual int RowIndex => columnRowIndex;

		public virtual int RowCount => 1;

		public BandedColumnWrapper(ColumnBase column, int logicalPosition, int totalRowCount)
			: base(column, logicalPosition)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				columnIndex = GetColumnIndex(column);
				columnRowIndex = GetColumnRowIndex(column);
				autoFillDown = GetAutoFillDown(column, columnRowIndex, totalRowCount);
			}
		}

		public override int GetColumnGroupLevel()
		{
			return base.Column.ParentBand.Level + 1;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ((object)base.Column).GetHashCode();
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IColumn> GetAllColumns()
		{
			return new List<IColumn>();
		}

		private int GetColumnIndex(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column.BandRow == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return column.BandRow.Columns.Where((ColumnBase c) => c.AllowPrinting).ToList().IndexOf(base.Column);
		}

		private int GetColumnRowIndex(ColumnBase column)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (column.ParentBand == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in column.ParentBand.ActualRows)
			{
				if (actualRow.Columns.Count((ColumnBase c) => c.AllowPrinting) > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (actualRow.Columns.Contains(column))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool GetAutoFillDown(ColumnBase column, int rowIndex, int totalRowCount)
		{
			if (column.ParentBand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = -1;
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in column.ParentBand.ActualRows)
			{
				if (actualRow.Columns.Count((ColumnBase c) => c.AllowPrinting) > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (rowIndex < num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return totalRowCount - rowIndex > 1;
		}
	}

		protected virtual void CreatePrintableColumnList()
		{
			bandsAndColumns = new List<IBandedGridColumn>();
			columns = new List<IBandedGridColumn>();
			if (band.PrintableBands.Count() > 0)

				foreach (BandBase printableBand in band.PrintableBands)
				{
					bandsAndColumns.Add((IBandedGridColumn)(object)new BandWrapper(printableBand, printableBand.exportIndex, totalRowCount));
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					if (column.AllowPrinting)
					{
						BandedColumnWrapper item = new BandedColumnWrapper(column, column.exportIndex, totalRowCount);

		}

		}

		}
