	public abstract class ClipboardSelectionProvider<TCol, TRow> where TCol : ColumnWrapper where TRow : IRowBase
	{
		protected DataViewBase View { get; private set; }

		protected DataControlBase DataControl => View.DataControl;

		public ClipboardSelectionProvider(DataViewBase view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public string GetRowCellDisplayText(int rowHandle, string columnName)
		{
			if ((View.IsMultiRowSelection && View.IsRowSelected(rowHandle)) || IsCellSelected(rowHandle, DataControl.ColumnsCore[columnName]))
			{
				return DataControl.GetCellDisplayText(rowHandle, columnName);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public IEnumerable<ColumnWrapper> GetSelectedColumns()
		{
			return GetSelectedColumnsList();
		}

		public int GetSelectedCellsCount()
		{
			return GetSelectedCellsCountCore(null);
		}

		private Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> GetSelectedCells(int rowHandle)
		{
			return View.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedObject(rowHandle) as Dictionary<ColumnBase, int>;
		}

		public bool IsCellSelected(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!View.IsMultiCellSelection)
			{
				return View.IsRowSelected(rowHandle);
			}
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> selectedCells = GetSelectedCells(rowHandle);
			if (selectedCells == null || !selectedCells.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual int GetSelectedCellsCountCore(IGroupRow<TRow> groupRow)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = GetSelectedRowsCount();
			int count = GetSelectedColumnsList().Count;
			return count * num;
		}

		private IList<TCol> GetColumnsMultiCell()
		{
			int[] selectedRowHandles = View.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
			IList<TCol> columns = GetColumns(DataControl.ColumnsCore);
			SortedList<int, TCol> sortedList = new SortedList<int, TCol>();
			HashSet<BaseColumn> hashSet = new HashSet<BaseColumn>();
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedRowHandles.Length; i++)
			{
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> selectedCells = GetSelectedCells(selectedRowHandles[i]);
				if (selectedCells == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase key in GetSelectedCells(selectedRowHandles[i]).Keys)
				{
					if (IsColumnVisible(key) && !hashSet.Contains(key))
					{
						sortedList.Add(key.ActualVisibleIndex, DataViewExportHelperBase<TCol, TRow>.CreateColumn(key, key.ActualVisibleIndex));
						hashSet.Add(key);
					}
				}
				if (sortedList.Count == columns.Count)
				{
					return sortedList.Values;
				}
			}
			if (sortedList.Values.Count != 0 || selectedRowHandles.Length == 0)
			{
				return sortedList.Values;
			}
			if (selectedRowHandles.Max() < 0)
			{
				columns = GetColumns(DataControl.ColumnsCore, isGroupColumn: true);
				foreach (TCol item in columns)
				{
					if (IsColumnVisible(item.Column) && !hashSet.Contains(item.Column) && item.Column.GroupIndexCore != -1 && !sortedList.ContainsKey(item.Column.ActualVisibleIndex))
					{
						sortedList.Add(item.Column.ActualVisibleIndex, item);
						hashSet.Add(item.Column);
					}
				}
				return sortedList.Values;
			}
			return new List<TCol>();
		}

		protected virtual bool IsColumnVisible(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column.ParentBand != null && !column.ParentBand.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return column.Visible;
		}

		public IList<TCol> GetSelectedColumnsList()
		{
			if (View.IsMultiCellSelection)
			{
				return GetColumnsMultiCell();
			}
			return GetColumns(View.VisibleColumnsCore);
		}

		public abstract IEnumerable<TRow> GetSelectedRows();

		public abstract int GetSelectedRowsCount();

		public abstract IList<TCol> GetColumns(IEnumerable collection, bool isGroupColumn = false);
	}
	public class GridViewClipboardSelectionProvider : ClipboardSelectionProvider<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>
	{
		private GridViewClipboardHelper helper;

		protected new TableView View => base.View as TableView;

		public GridViewClipboardSelectionProvider(GridViewClipboardHelper helper)
			: base(helper.View)
		{
			this.helper = helper;
		}

		public override IList<ColumnWrapper> GetColumns(IEnumerable collection, bool isGroupColumn = false)
		{
			List<ColumnWrapper> list = new List<ColumnWrapper>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GridColumn item in collection)
			{
				if (CanAddColumn(item, isGroupColumn))
				{
					list.Add(DataViewExportHelperBase<ColumnWrapper, RowBaseWrapper>.CreateColumn(item, num++));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override int GetSelectedRowsCount()
		{
			return View.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles().Length;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<RowBaseWrapper> GetSelectedRows()
		{
			int[] selectedRowHandles = View.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
			Array.Sort(selectedRowHandles, (int i1, int i2) => View.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(i1).CompareTo(View.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(i2)));
			return selectedRowHandles.Select((int i) => helper.GetRowByRowHandle(i));
		}

		private bool CanAddColumn(GridColumn gridColumn, bool isGroupColumn)
		{
			bool result = isGroupColumn || View.ShowGroupedColumns || gridColumn.GroupIndex == -1;
			if (gridColumn == View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn && View.ShowCheckBoxSelectorColumn)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public static class AppearanceHelper
	{
		private class ConditionalFormattingProperties
		{
			public const int DefaultFontSize = 11;

			public double FontSize { get; set; }

			public FontWeight FontWeight { get; set; }

			public System.Windows.FontStyle FontStyle { get; set; }

			public System.Windows.Media.Brush Background { get; set; }

			public System.Windows.Media.Brush Foreground { get; set; }

			public TextDecorationCollection TextDecor { get; set; }

			public ConditionalFormattingProperties()
			{
				FontSize = 11.0;
				FontWeight = FontWeights.Normal;
				FontStyle = FontStyles.Normal;
				Background = null;
				Foreground = null;
				TextDecor = null;
			}
		}

		private static XlCellFormatting DefaultFormatting => new XlCellFormatting
		{
			Font = new XlFont(),
			Fill = null,
			Alignment = new XlCellAlignment()
		};

		public static System.Drawing.Color BrushToColor(System.Windows.Media.Brush br)
		{
			if (br == null)
			{
				return System.Drawing.Color.Empty;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = (System.Windows.Media.Color)br.GetValue(SolidColorBrush.ColorProperty);
			byte a = color.A;
			byte g = color.G;
			byte r = color.R;
			byte b = color.B;
			return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(a, r, g, b);
		}

		private static IFormatInfoProvider CreateFormatInfoProvider(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle)
		{
			return (IFormatInfoProvider)(object)new DataTreeBuilderFormatInfoProvider<DataControlBase>(dataControl, (DataControlBase x) => x.DataView.VisualDataTreeBuilder, (DataControlBase x, string fieldName) => x.GetCellValue(rowHandle, fieldName));
		}

		private static FormatValueProvider CalcCondition(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return FormatInfoProviderExtensions.GetValueProvider(CreateFormatInfoProvider(dataControl, rowHandle), fieldName);
		}

		private static ConditionalFormattingProperties GetValues(IList<FormatConditionBaseInfo> conditions, DataViewBase view, int rowHandle, string fieldName, ConditionalFormattingProperties oldProp)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ce: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (conditions != null && conditions.Count > 0)
			{
				ConditionalFormattingProperties conditionalFormattingProperties = oldProp ?? new ConditionalFormattingProperties();
				{
					foreach (FormatConditionBaseInfo condition in conditions)
					{
						FormatValueProvider val = CalcCondition(view.DataControl, rowHandle, condition.ActualFieldName);
						double num = condition.CoerceFontSize(11.0, val);
						FontWeight fontWeight = condition.CoerceFontWeight(FontWeights.Normal, val);
						System.Windows.FontStyle fontStyle = condition.CoerceFontStyle(FontStyles.Normal, val);
						conditionalFormattingProperties.FontSize = ((num != 11.0) ? num : conditionalFormattingProperties.FontSize);
						conditionalFormattingProperties.FontWeight = ((fontWeight != FontWeights.Normal) ? fontWeight : conditionalFormattingProperties.FontWeight);
						conditionalFormattingProperties.FontStyle = ((fontStyle != FontStyles.Normal) ? fontStyle : conditionalFormattingProperties.FontStyle);
						conditionalFormattingProperties.Background = condition.CoerceBackground((System.Windows.Media.Brush)null, val) ?? conditionalFormattingProperties.Background;
						conditionalFormattingProperties.Foreground = condition.CoerceForeground((System.Windows.Media.Brush)null, val) ?? conditionalFormattingProperties.Foreground;
						conditionalFormattingProperties.TextDecor = condition.CoerceTextDecorations((TextDecorationCollection)null, val) ?? conditionalFormattingProperties.TextDecor;
					}
					return conditionalFormattingProperties;
				}
			}
			return oldProp;
		}

		public static XlCellFormatting GetCellAppearance(int rowHandle, ColumnBase col, DataViewBase view, FormatConditionCollection formatConditions)
		{
			if (view.DataControl != null && view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				return DefaultFormatting;
			}
			ConditionalFormattingProperties conditionalFormattingProperties = null;
			if (view.ViewBehavior != null && view.ViewBehavior.IsAlternateRow(rowHandle))
			{
				conditionalFormattingProperties = new ConditionalFormattingProperties();
				conditionalFormattingProperties.Background = view.ViewBehavior.ActualAlternateRowBackground;
			}
			conditionalFormattingProperties = GetValues(formatConditions.GetInfoByFieldName(string.Empty), view, rowHandle, col.FieldName, conditionalFormattingProperties);
			conditionalFormattingProperties = GetValues(formatConditions.GetInfoByFieldName(col.FieldName), view, rowHandle, col.FieldName, conditionalFormattingProperties);
			if (conditionalFormattingProperties != null)
			{
				return GetCellFormatting(conditionalFormattingProperties);
			}
			return DefaultFormatting;
		}

		private static XlFill SetFill(System.Windows.Media.Brush background)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XlFill val = new XlFill();
			if (background == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XlColor foreColor = (val.BackColor = XlColor.op_Implicit(BrushToColor(background)));
			val.ForeColor = foreColor;
			val.PatternType = (XlPatternType)1;
			return val;
		}

		private static XlCellFormatting GetCellFormatting(ConditionalFormattingProperties properties)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XlCellFormatting val = new XlCellFormatting();
			((XlFormatting)val).Font = new XlFont
			{
				Bold = (properties.FontWeight == FontWeights.Bold),
				Size = properties.FontSize,
				Italic = (properties.FontStyle == FontStyles.Italic)
			};
			if (properties.Foreground != null)
			{
				((XlFormatting)val).Font.Color = XlColor.op_Implicit(BrushToColor(properties.Foreground));
			}
			if (properties.TextDecor != null)
			{
				foreach (TextDecoration item in properties.TextDecor)
				{
					switch (item.Location)
					{
					case TextDecorationLocation.Strikethrough:
						((XlFontBase)((XlFormatting)val).Font).StrikeThrough = true;
						break;
					case TextDecorationLocation.Underline:
						((XlFontBase)((XlFormatting)val).Font).Underline = (XlUnderlineType)1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			((XlFormatting)val).Fill = SetFill(properties.Background);
			((XlFormatting)val).Alignment = new XlCellAlignment();
			return val;
		}
	}

		private SummaryItemExportWrapper CreateGroupSummaryItemWrapper(SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string summaryFieldName = GetSummaryFieldName(item, SummaryItemBase.ColumnSummaryType.Group);
			string exportToColumn = GetExportToColumn(summaryFieldName, item.ActualShowInColumn);
			string displayFormat = GetDisplayFormat(item, SummaryItemBase.ColumnSummaryType.Group);
			return new SummaryItemExportWrapper(summaryFieldName, exportToColumn, item.SummaryType, displayFormat, null, (int rowHandle) => Grid.GetGroupSummaryValue(rowHandle, (GridSummaryItem)item))
			{
				IsGroupFooterSummary = IsGroupFooterSummary(item),
				Tag = item
			};
		}

		public override bool RaiseCustomSummaryExists(ISummaryItemEx item, int groupLevel, int groupRowHandle, bool isGroupSummary)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SummaryItemExportWrapper summaryItemExportWrapper = (SummaryItemExportWrapper)(object)item;
			CustomSummaryExistEventArgs e = new CustomSummaryExistEventArgs(groupRowHandle, groupLevel, summaryItemExportWrapper.Tag);
			Grid.RaiseCustomSummaryExists(Grid, e);
			return e.Exists;
		}

		public override int RaiseMergeEvent(int row1, int row2, TCol col)
		{
			bool? flag = View.RaiseCellMerge(col.Column, row1, row2, checkValues: false);
			if (flag.HasValue)
			{
				if (!flag.Value)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return 3;
		}

		public override bool GetAllowMerge(TCol col)
		{
			if (col.Column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!col.Column.AllowCellMerge.HasValue)
			{
				return View.AllowCellMerge;
			}
			return col.Column.AllowCellMerge.Value;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<TRow> GetAllRows()
		{
			for (int visibleIndex = 0; visibleIndex < DataProvider.VisibleCount; visibleIndex++)
			{
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndex = Grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
				if (Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndex) <= 0 || View.GetFixedRowPosition(rowHandleByVisibleIndex) != FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					yield return GetRowByRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		internal TRow GetRowByRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return (TRow)(RowBaseWrapper)(object)CreateGroupRow(rowHandle);
			}
			return CreateDataRow(rowHandle);
		}

		private IGroupRow<RowBaseWrapper> CreateGroupRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			int rowLevelByRowHandle = Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			string groupRowDisplayText = View.GetGroupRowDisplayText(rowHandle);
			bool isExpanded = Grid.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandle);
			IEnumerable<TRow> childRows = GetChildRows(rowHandle);
			return new GroupRowWrapper(rowHandle, rowLevelByRowHandle, -1, groupRowDisplayText, isExpanded, childRows, View, groupFooterSummary);
		}

		private IEnumerable<TRow> GetChildRows(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(groupRowHandle))
			{
				int childCount = Grid.GetChildRowCount(groupRowHandle);
				for (int childIndex = 0; childIndex < childCount; childIndex++)
				{
					int childRowHandle = Grid.GetChildRowHandle(groupRowHandle, childIndex);
					yield return GetRowByRowHandle(childRowHandle);
				}
			}
		}

		private TRow CreateDataRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			return new DataRowWrapper(rowHandle, Grid.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(rowHandle), Grid.GetListIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle)) as TRow;
		}

		public override object RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(TCol col, int listSourceRow, object value)
		{
			GridColumnDataEventArgs e = new GridColumnDataEventArgs(Grid, col.Column as GridColumn, listSourceRow, value, isGetAction: true);
			Grid.RaiseCustomUnboundColumnData(e);
			return e.Value;
		}
	}

		private int CalcFixedRowsCount()
		{
			int i = 0;
			if (View.TotalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Top)
			{
				Dictionary<string, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, int>();
				foreach (ISummaryItemEx item in GridFooterSummaryItemCollection)
				{
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(((ISummaryItem)item).FieldName))
					{
						dictionary.Add(((ISummaryItem)item).FieldName, 0);
					}
					int num = dictionary[((ISummaryItem)item).FieldName] + 1;
					dictionary[((ISummaryItem)item).FieldName] = num;
					if (num > i)
					{
						i = num;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!View.HasFixedRows)
			{
				return i;
			}
			for (; i < DataProvider.VisibleCount && View.GetFixedRowByVisibleIndex(i) == FixedRowPosition.Top; i++)
			{
			}
			return i;
		}

		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private string GetFixedTotalSummaryItemFieldName(GridSummaryItemAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (visibleColumns.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return alignment switch
			{
				GridSummaryItemAlignment.Left => visibleColumns.First().FieldName, 
				GridSummaryItemAlignment.Right => visibleColumns.Last().FieldName, 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private IEnumerable<ColumnBase> GetPrintableColumns(IEnumerable<BandBase> bands)
		{
			IEnumerable<ColumnBase> enumerable = Enumerable.Empty<ColumnBase>();
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Concat(GetPrintableColumns(band.PrintableBands));
				enumerable = enumerable.Concat((from column in band.ActualRows.SelectMany((BandRow row) => row.Columns)
					where column.AllowPrinting
					select column).Cast<ColumnBase>());
			}
			return enumerable;
		}

					if (formatRule.IsValid)

		protected virtual int AddBandInfo(ClipboardBandLayoutInfo bandLayoutInfo, BandBase band)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown

			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = band.HeaderCaption.ToString();
			XlCellFormatting val = new XlCellFormatting
			{
				Alignment = ColumnWrapper.GetReportAlignment(band.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignment)
			};
			ClipboardBandCellInfo val2 = new ClipboardBandCellInfo(0, 1, (object)text, text, val, false)
			{
				BandIndex = band.index,
				Column = band
			};
			int level = band.Level;
			int bandPanelRowWidth = bandLayoutInfo.GetBandPanelRowWidth(level, true);
			int bandPanelRowWidth2 = bandLayoutInfo.GetBandPanelRowWidth(level, false);

					}
				}
			}
			else

				val2.Width = AddBandColumnsInfo(bandLayoutInfo, band, level);
				val2.Height = totalBandRowCount - level;
			}
			if (bandPanelRowWidth2 < bandPanelRowWidth)
			{

			}
			bandLayoutInfo.AddBandPanelCell(level, val2);
			return val2.Width;
		}

	public class GridViewExportHelper<TCol, TRow> : GridViewExportHelperBase<TCol, TRow>, IDisposable where TCol : ColumnWrapper where TRow : RowBaseWrapper
	{
		private readonly ItemsGenerationStrategyBase itemsGenerationStrategy;

		protected readonly int columnPanelRowCount;

		private bool allowPartialGrouping;

		public GridViewExportHelper(TableView view, ExportTarget target)
			: base(view, target)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			itemsGenerationStrategy = view.CreateItemsGenerationStrategy();
			itemsGenerationStrategy.StoreOriginalRowHandles = false;
			columnPanelRowCount = CalcColumnRowCount();
			GenerateAll();
		}

		private void GenerateAll()
		{
			base.Grid.LockUpdateLayout = true;
			if (base.View.AllowPartialGrouping)
			{
				base.Grid.DisableAllowPartialGrouping();
				allowPartialGrouping = true;
			}
			itemsGenerationStrategy.GenerateAll();
		}

		private void ClearAll()
		{
			if (allowPartialGrouping)
			{
				allowPartialGrouping = false;
				base.Grid.UpdateAllowPartialGrouping();
			}
			itemsGenerationStrategy.ClearAll();
			base.Grid.LockUpdateLayout = false;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			ClearAll();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ISummaryItemEx> GetGroupHeaderSummary()
		{
			return Enumerable.Empty<ISummaryItemEx>();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ISummaryItemEx> GetGroupFooterSummary()
		{
			IEnumerable<ISummaryItemEx> groupHeaderSummaryCore = GetGroupHeaderSummaryCore();
			IEnumerable<ISummaryItemEx> second = (base.PrintGroupFooters ? GetGroupFooterSummaryCore() : Enumerable.Empty<ISummaryItemEx>());
			return groupHeaderSummaryCore.Concat(second);
		}
	}

	public static class GridReportHelper
	{
		public static object GetSource(TableView view)
		{
			if (view.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (view.DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				return new AsyncServerModeItemsSourceWrapper(view);
			}
			if (view.DataProviderBase.IsServerMode)
			{
				if (view.DataProviderBase.IsICollectionView)
				{
					return new CollectionViewItemsSourceWrapper(view);
				}
				return new ServerModeItemsSourceWrapper(view);
			}
			if (view.DataProviderBase.DataSource is DataTable)
			{
				return view.DataProviderBase.DataSource;
			}
			if (view.DataProviderBase.DataController.DataSource is ITypedList)
			{
				return view.DataProviderBase.DataController.DataSource;
			}
			return view.DataProviderBase.DataSource;
		}
	}

		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginFillList(IServiceProvider servProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListMutex.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			return BeginFillListCore(servProvider, token);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginFillListCore(IServiceProvider servProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			base.IsFilled = false;
			Clear();
			CriteriaOperator reportFilter = GetReportFilter(servProvider);
			CommandApply commandApplyFilter = Server.Apply(reportFilter, (ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor[]>)null, 0, (ICollection<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor>)null, (ICollection<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor>)null, new DictionaryEntry[0]);
			CommandGetAllFilteredAndSortedRows allFilteredAndSortedRows = Server.GetAllFilteredAndSortedRows(new DictionaryEntry[0]);
			Result = new ReportsAsyncResult(View, Server, commandApplyFilter, allFilteredAndSortedRows);
			Result.Start(token);
			return Result;
		}

		public async Task FillAsync(IServiceProvider servProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListMutex.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			try
			{
				await Task.Factory.FromAsync(BeginFillListCore(servProvider, token), delegate
				{
					EndFillListCore();
				}).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListMutex.ReleaseMutex();
			}
		}

		private void EndFillListCore()
		{
			AddRange(Result.Rows);
			base.IsFilled = true;
		}

		public void EndFillList(IAsyncResult result, CancellationToken token)
		{
			try
			{
				EndFillListCore();
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListMutex.ReleaseMutex();
			}
		}

		public void FillList(IServiceProvider servProvider)
		{
			CancellationToken token = default(CancellationToken);
			IAsyncResult result = BeginFillList(servProvider, token);
			EndFillList(result, token);
		}

		}

		public string GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)

	public class ReportsAsyncResult : IAsyncResult
	{
		private readonly CommandApply CommandApplyFilter;

		private readonly CommandGetAllFilteredAndSortedRows CommandGetRows;

		private readonly IAsyncListServer Server;

		private readonly DataViewBase View;

		private bool completed;

		private CancellationToken token;

		public IList<object> Rows { get; private set; }

		public object AsyncState
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public WaitHandle AsyncWaitHandle
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public bool CompletedSynchronously
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public bool IsCompleted => completed;

		public ReportsAsyncResult(DataViewBase view, IAsyncListServer server, CommandApply commandApplyFilter, CommandGetAllFilteredAndSortedRows commandGetRows)
		{
			View = view;
			Server = server;
			CommandApplyFilter = commandApplyFilter;
			CommandGetRows = commandGetRows;
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			try
			{
				Rows = ApplyAsyncCommand();
			}
			finally
			{
				completed = true;
			}
		}

		internal void Start(CancellationToken token)
		{
			this.token = token;
			Start();
		}

		private IList<object> ApplyAsyncCommand()
		{
			ProgressControl.MakeAsyncOperation(View, delegate(Func<bool> checkIsCancelledFromUI)
			{
				while (!Server.WaitFor((Command)(object)CommandApplyFilter))
				{
					if (checkIsCancelledFromUI() || token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						Server.Cancel((Command)(object)CommandApplyFilter);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!((Command)CommandApplyFilter).IsCanceled)
				{
					while (!Server.WaitFor((Command)(object)CommandGetRows))
					{
						if (checkIsCancelledFromUI() || token.IsCancellationRequested)
						{
							Server.Cancel((Command)(object)CommandGetRows);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			});
			if (!((Command)CommandGetRows).IsCanceled)
			{
				return CommandGetRows.Rows.Cast<object>().ToList();
			}
			return new List<object>();
		}
	}

		public string GetGroupRowHeader()
		{
			if (view.PrintGroupSummaryDisplayMode == GroupSummaryDisplayMode.AlignByColumns && (Grid.BandsLayout == null || (Grid.BandsLayout != null && !view.AllowBandMultiRow)))
			{
				GridColumn column = view.VisibleColumns.FirstOrDefault();
				if (column != null)
				{
					IEnumerable<ISummaryItemEx> enumerable = groupSummaryItems.Where((ISummaryItemEx item) => ((ISummaryItem)item).FieldName == column.FieldName && !item.AlignByColumnInFooter);
					if (enumerable == null || !enumerable.Any())
					{
						return groupValue;
					}
					string arg = enumerable.Select((ISummaryItemEx item) => string.Format(((ISummaryItem)item).DisplayFormat, item.GetSummaryValueByGroupId(base.LogicalPosition))).Aggregate((string l, string r) => l + ", " + r);
					return $"{groupValue}, {arg}";
				}
			}
			return groupValue;
		}

		public IEnumerable<RowBaseWrapper> GetAllRows()
		{
			return childRows;
		}

		public IEnumerable<RowBaseWrapper> GetSelectedRows()
		{
			return new List<RowBaseWrapper>();
		}

		public bool IsTreeListGroupRow()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public string GetGroupedColumnFieldName()
		{
			int num = GetRowLevel();
			return (num < view.GroupCount) ? ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)view.SortInfo)[num].FieldName : string.Empty;
		}
	}

		public static SparklineInfo CreateInstance(SparklineEditSettings editSettings)

	public abstract class GridPrintingDataTreeBuilderBase : PrintingDataTreeBuilder
	{
		private readonly IList<SummaryItemBase> groupSummaries;

		internal GroupRowData reusingGroupRowData;

		private Dictionary<SummaryItemBase, object> totalSummary;

		private Dictionary<int, int> OriginalRowHandles;

		private ItemsGenerationStrategyBase itemsGenerationStrategy;

		internal DataTemplate PrintGroupRowTemplate { get; private set; }

		public new GridViewBase View => base.View as GridViewBase;

		protected GridDataProvider GridDataProvider => (GridDataProvider)View.DataProviderBase;

		internal ItemsGenerationStrategyBase ItemsGenerationStrategy
		{
			get
			{
				if (itemsGenerationStrategy == null)
				{
					itemsGenerationStrategy = CreateItemsGenerationStrategy();
				}
				return itemsGenerationStrategy;
			}
		}

		public override int VisibleCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!View.ShouldDisplayLoadingRow)
				{
					return base.VisibleCount;
				}
				return base.VisibleCount - 1;
			}
		}

		public GridPrintingDataTreeBuilderBase(GridViewBase view, double pageWidth, BandsLayoutBase bandsLayout, ItemsGenerationStrategyBase itemsGenerationStrategy, MasterDetailPrintInfo masterDetailPrintInfo = null)
			: base(view, pageWidth, bandsLayout, masterDetailPrintInfo)
		{
			this.itemsGenerationStrategy = itemsGenerationStrategy;
			PrintGroupRowTemplate = View.PrintGroupRowTemplate;
			groupSummaries = TreeBuilderPrintingHelper.CloneGroupSummaries(View.Grid.GroupSummary);
			reusingGroupRowData = new GroupRowData(this);
		}

		private ItemsGenerationStrategyBase CreateItemsGenerationStrategy()
		{
			return View.CreateItemsGenerationStrategy();
		}

		public int GetOriginalRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!View.PrintSelectedRowsOnly || OriginalRowHandles == null)
			{
				return rowHandle;
			}
			int value = 0;
			if (OriginalRowHandles.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return rowHandle;
		}

		protected override PrintRowInfoBase GetHeaderFooterPrintInfo()
		{
			PrintRowInfoBase printRowInfoBase = CreateBasePrintRowInfo();
			int detailLevel = GetDetailLevel();
			double headerFooterLeftIndent = GetHeaderFooterLeftIndent();
			printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentMargin = new Thickness(printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentMargin.Left + headerFooterLeftIndent, printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentMargin.Top, printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentMargin.Right, printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentMargin.Bottom);
			printRowInfoBase.IsPrintHeaderBottomIndentVisible = !IsPrintFooters() && detailLevel > 0 && View.Grid.VisibleRowCount == 0;
			if (detailLevel > 0)
			{
				printRowInfoBase.IsPrintFooterBottomIndentVisible = IsPrintFooter() && !IsPrintFixedFooter();
				printRowInfoBase.IsPrintFixedFooterBottomIndentVisible = IsPrintFixedFooter();
			}
			return printRowInfoBase;
		}

		protected override double GetHeaderFooterLeftIndent()
		{
			return (double)(GetDetailLevel() + base.MasterDetailPrintInfo.DetailGroupLevel) * View.PrintRowIndentWidth;
		}

		protected override PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfo()
		{
			PrintRowInfoBase printRowInfoBase = CreateBasePrintRowInfoObject();
			printRowInfoBase.PrintGroupRowStyle = View.PrintGroupRowStyle;
			printRowInfoBase.PrintFixedFooterStyle = View.PrintFixedTotalSummaryStyle;
			printRowInfoBase.PrintRowIndentStyle = View.PrintRowIndentStyle;
			printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness());
			printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndentMargin = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
			printRowInfoBase.PrintDataIndent = 0.0;
			printRowInfoBase.TotalHeaderWidth = base.TotalHeaderWidth;
			printRowInfoBase.PrintCellStyle = View.PrintCellStyle;
			return printRowInfoBase;
		}

		protected abstract PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfoObject();

		protected void ClonePrintRowInfoProperties(PrintRowInfoBase actualInfo, PrintRowInfoBase basePrintRowInfo)
		{
			actualInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle;
			actualInfo.PrintGroupRowStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintGroupRowStyle;
			actualInfo.PrintFixedFooterStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintFixedFooterStyle;
			actualInfo.PrintRowIndentStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintRowIndentStyle;
			actualInfo.PrintCellStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCellStyle;
		}

		protected override bool IsPrintTotalSummary()
		{
			return View.PrintTotalSummary;
		}

		protected override bool IsPrintFixedTotalSummary()
		{
			return View.PrintFixedTotalSummary;
		}

		protected bool IsPrintFooter(TableView view)
		{
			if (view.ShouldPrintTotalSummary)
			{
				return base.PrintFooterTemplate != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsPrintFixedFooter(TableView view)
		{
			if (view.ShouldPrintFixedTotalSummary)
			{
				return base.PrintFixedFooterTemplate != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override ColumnBase GetGroupColumnByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return GetGroupRowNodePrintInfo(node).GroupColumn;
		}

		internal override object GetGroupValueByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return GetGroupRowNodePrintInfo(node).GroupValue;
		}

		internal override string GetGroupRowDisplayTextByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return GetGroupRowNodePrintInfo(node).GroupDisplayText;
		}

		internal override string GetGroupRowHeaderCaptionByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return GetGroupRowNodePrintInfo(node).GroupColumnHeaderCaption.ToString();
		}

		internal static GroupRowNodePrintInfo GetGroupRowNodePrintInfo(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return (GroupRowNodePrintInfo)node.PrintInfo;
		}

		internal override IList<SummaryItemBase> GetGroupSummaries()
		{
			return groupSummaries;
		}

		internal override object GetRowValue(RowData rowData)
		{
			return ItemsGenerationStrategy.GetRowValue(rowData);
		}

		internal override object GetCellValue(RowData rowData, string fieldName)
		{
			return ItemsGenerationStrategy.GetCellValue(rowData, fieldName);
		}

		internal override bool TryGetGroupSummaryValue(RowData rowData, SummaryItemBase item, out object value)
		{
			return GetGroupRowNodePrintInfo(rowData.DataRowNode).GroupSummaryValues.TryGetValue(item, out value);
		}

		protected abstract bool IsGeneratedControl(GridControl grid);

		protected override string GetTotalSummaryText(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return ItemsGenerationStrategy.GetTotalSummaryText(column);
		}

		protected override string GetFixedLeftTotalSummaryText()
		{
			return ItemsGenerationStrategy.GetFixedTotalSummaryLeftText();
		}

		protected override string GetFixedRightTotalSummaryText()
		{
			return ItemsGenerationStrategy.GetFixedTotalSummaryRightText();
		}

		public override void GenerateAllItems()
		{
			GridControl grid = View.Grid;
			try
			{
				if (!IsGeneratedControl(grid))
				{
					grid.LockUpdateLayout = true;
				}
				ItemsGenerationStrategy.PrepareDataControllerAndPerformPrintingAction(delegate
				{
					GenerateAllItemsAndCalcPrintInfo();
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!IsGeneratedControl(grid))
				{
					grid.LockUpdateLayout = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAllItemsAndCalcPrintInfo()
		{
			View.layoutUpdatedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				GridDataProvider.VisibleIndicesProvider.ShowGroupSummaryFooterInternal = GetPrintGroupFooters();
				GridDataProvider.VisibleIndicesProvider.InvalidateCache();
				try
				{
					base.RootNodeContainer.ReGenerateItemsCore(0, View.Grid.VisibleRowCount + (GetPrintGroupFooters() ? View.CalcGroupSummaryVisibleRowCount() : 0));
					UpdateTotalSummary(base.HeadersData);
					CalcNodesPrintInfo();
					StoreTotalSummary();
				}
				finally
				{
					GridDataProvider.VisibleIndicesProvider.InvalidateCache();
					GridDataProvider.VisibleIndicesProvider.ShowGroupSummaryFooterInternal = true;
				}
			});
		}

		protected abstract bool GetPrintGroupFooters();

		internal override object GetWpfRow(RowData rowData, int listSourceRowIndex)
		{
			return GridDataProvider.GetWpfRowByListIndex(rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo.ListIndex);
		}

		private void CalcNodesPrintInfo()
		{
			OriginalRowHandles = ItemsGenerationStrategy.With((ItemsGenerationStrategyBase strategy) => strategy as ItemsGenerationServerStrategy).With((ItemsGenerationServerStrategy info) => info.OriginalRowHandles);
			VirtualItemsEnumerator virtualItemsEnumerator = new VirtualItemsEnumerator(base.RootNodeContainer);
			List<DataRowNode> list = new List<DataRowNode>();
			UpdateContainerPrintInfo(base.RootNodeContainer);
			DataRowNode dataRowNode = null;
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> mergeValueCounters = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, int>();
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)virtualItemsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				DataRowNode dataRowNode2 = virtualItemsEnumerator.Current as DataRowNode;
				ProcessNode(dataRowNode2);
				GroupNode groupNode = dataRowNode2 as GroupNode;
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo = ((groupNode != null) ? CreateGroupRowNodePrintInfo(dataRowNode2) : CreateRowNodePrintInfo(dataRowNode2, mergeValueCounters));
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.RowPosition = ((DataNodeContainer)virtualItemsEnumerator.CurrentContainer).GetRowPosition(dataRowNode2);
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.ListIndex = GridDataProvider.GetListIndexByRowHandle(dataRowNode2.RowHandle.Value);
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.PrevRowHandle = dataRowNode?.RowHandle.Value ?? int.MinValue;
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.PrevRowPosition = dataRowNode?.PrintInfo.RowPosition ?? RowPosition.Middle;
				dataRowNode2.PrintInfo.IsSelected = View.IsRowSelected(dataRowNode2.RowHandle.Value);
				if (groupNode != null)
				{
					UpdateContainerPrintInfo(groupNode.NodesContainer);
					foreach (DataRowNode item in list)
					{
						item.PrintInfo.NextNodeLevel = dataRowNode2.Level;
					}
					list.Clear();
				}
				list.Add(dataRowNode2);
				if (dataRowNode != null)
				{
					dataRowNode.PrintInfo.NextRowHandle = dataRowNode2.RowHandle.Value;
				}
				dataRowNode = dataRowNode2;
			}
			if (dataRowNode != null)
			{
				dataRowNode.PrintInfo.NextRowHandle = int.MinValue;
				dataRowNode.PrintInfo.IsLast = true;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ProcessNode(DataRowNode node);

		private void UpdateContainerPrintInfo(DataNodeContainer container)
		{
			container.PrintInfo = new NodeContainerPrintInfo
			{
				IsGroupRowsContainer = container.IsGroupRowsContainer
			};
		}

		protected virtual RowNodePrintInfo CreateRowNodePrintInfo(DataRowNode node, Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> mergeValueCounters)
		{
			return new RowNodePrintInfo();
		}

		private void StoreTotalSummary()
		{
			if (View.ViewBehavior.GetServiceSummaries().Any())
			{
				totalSummary = ((IEnumerable)View.Grid.DataController.TotalSummary).Cast<SummaryItem>().ToDictionary((SummaryItem x) => (SummaryItemBase)((SummaryItemBase)x).Key, (SummaryItem x) => x.SummaryValue);
			}
		}

		internal override object GetServiceTotalSummaryValue(ServiceSummaryItem item)
		{
			object result = null;
			totalSummary.Do(delegate(Dictionary<SummaryItemBase, object> x)
			{
				x.TryGetValue(item, out result);
			});
			return result;
		}

		private GroupRowNodePrintInfo CreateGroupRowNodePrintInfo(DataRowNode node)
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = (GridColumn)View.GetColumnBySortLevel(node.Level);
			Dictionary<SummaryItemBase, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<SummaryItemBase, object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<GridSummaryItem>)(object)View.Grid.GroupSummary).Count; i++)
			{
				object value = null;
				if (GridDataProvider.TryGetGroupSummaryValue(node.RowHandle.Value, ((Collection<GridSummaryItem>)(object)View.Grid.GroupSummary)[i], out value))
				{
					dictionary[groupSummaries[i]] = value;
				}
			}
			return new GroupRowNodePrintInfo
			{
				GroupColumn = gridColumn,
				GroupColumnHeaderCaption = gridColumn.HeaderCaption,
				GroupValue = View.GetGroupDisplayValue(node.RowHandle.Value),
				GroupDisplayText = View.GetGroupRowDisplayText(node.RowHandle.Value),
				GroupSummaryValues = dictionary
			};
		}

		internal override void OnRootNodeDispose()
		{
			base.OnRootNodeDispose();
			ItemsGenerationStrategy.Clear();
		}

		internal override object[] GetGroupValuesByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return View.GetGroupDisplayValues(node.RowHandle.Value);
		}

		internal override string[] GetGroupRowHeadersCaptionsByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return View.GetGroupRowHeadersCaptions(node.RowHandle.Value);
		}
	}
	public class ItemsGenerationSimpleStrategy : ItemsGenerationStrategyBase
	{
		private Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> TotalSummaries { get; set; }

		private string FixedLeftSummaryText { get; set; }

		private string FixedRightSummaryText { get; set; }

		public override bool RequireFullExpand => false;

		private GridDataProvider GridDataProvider => base.DataProvider as GridDataProvider;

		public override string GetTotalSummaryText(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!TotalSummaries.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return TotalSummaries[column] ?? string.Empty;
		}

		public override string GetFixedTotalSummaryLeftText()
		{
			return FixedLeftSummaryText;
		}

		public override string GetFixedTotalSummaryRightText()
		{
			return FixedRightSummaryText;
		}

		private void StoreTotalSummary()
		{
			TotalSummaries = GetTotalSummaries();
			FixedLeftSummaryText = base.View.DataControl.viewCore.GetFixedSummariesLeftString();
			FixedRightSummaryText = base.View.DataControl.viewCore.GetFixedSummariesRightString();
		}

		protected virtual Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> GetTotalSummaries()
		{
			return base.View.DataControl.ColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>().ToDictionary((ColumnBase c) => c, (ColumnBase c) => c.TotalSummaryText);
		}

		public ItemsGenerationSimpleStrategy(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			StoreTotalSummary();
		}

		public override object GetRowValue(RowData rowData)
		{
			return GetValueCore(rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo.ListIndex, (int index) => base.DataProvider.GetRowByListIndex(index));
		}

		public override object GetCellValue(RowData rowData, string fieldName)
		{
			if (TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(fieldName))
			{
				return rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo.IsSelected;
			}
			if (GridDataProvider == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetValueCore(rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo.ListIndex, (int index) => GridDataProvider.GetRowValueByListIndex(index, fieldName));
		}

		private object GetValueCore(int listIndex, Func<int, object> valueAccessor)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (GridDataProvider == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			InfiniteSourceBase infiniteSource = GridDataProvider.InfiniteSource;
			Action action = delegate
			{
				result = valueAccessor(listIndex);
			};
			if (infiniteSource == null || listIndex != ((VirtualSourceBase)infiniteSource).Count - 1)
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				GridDataProvider.DoActionWithLockedItemFetch(action);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class ItemsGenerationPrintAllGroupsStrategy : ItemsGenerationSimpleStrategy
	{
		private IClassicRowKeeper keeper;

		public override bool RequireFullExpand => true;

		public ItemsGenerationPrintAllGroupsStrategy(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateAllCore()
		{
			keeper = ((DataController)base.DataProvider.DataController).CreateControllerRowsKeeper();
			((DataController)base.DataProvider.DataController).SaveRowState(keeper);
			base.DataProvider.ExpandAll();
		}

		protected override void ClearAllCore()
		{
			base.DataProvider.CollapseAll();
			((DataController)base.DataProvider.DataController).RestoreRowState(keeper);
			((IDisposable)keeper).Dispose();
			keeper = null;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> GetTotalSummaries()
		{
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, string>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in base.View.DataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (item.TotalSummariesCore.Any((SummaryItemBase x) => base.View.GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows))
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					foreach (GridTotalSummaryData totalSummary in item.TotalSummaries)
					{
						if (base.View.GetActualCalculationMode(totalSummary.Item) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows)
						{
							if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
							{
								stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
							}
							stringBuilder.Append(ColumnBase.GetSummaryText(totalSummary));
						}
					}
					dictionary.Add(item, stringBuilder.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(item, item.TotalSummaryText);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ItemsGenerationServerStrategy : ItemsGenerationStrategyBase
	{
		private BaseGridController oldController;

		private new GridDataProvider DataProvider => (GridDataProvider)base.DataProvider;

		internal Dictionary<int, int> OriginalRowHandles { get; set; }

		public override bool RequireFullExpand => true;

		private GridServerModeDataControllerPrintInfo Info { get; set; }

		protected virtual IList GetAllFilteredAndSortedRows()
		{
			if (!base.View.PrintSelectedRowsOnly)
			{
				return FetchAllFilteredAndSortedRows();
			}
			PrintSelectedRowsResult selectedRowsInfo = PrintSelectedRowsHelper.GetSelectedRowsInfo(DataProvider, base.View, GetPrintSelectedRowsOnlyAllRows());
			if (base.StoreOriginalRowHandles)
			{
				OriginalRowHandles = selectedRowsInfo.OriginalRowHandles;
			}
			return selectedRowsInfo.SelectedRows;
		}

		protected virtual IList GetPrintSelectedRowsOnlyAllRows()
		{
			return new List<object>();
		}

		protected abstract IList FetchAllFilteredAndSortedRows();

		public ItemsGenerationServerStrategy(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateAllCore()
		{
			oldController = DataProvider.DataController;
			base.View.DataControl.dataResetLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				IList allFilteredAndSortedRows = GetAllFilteredAndSortedRows();
				Info = DataProvider.SubstituteDataControllerForPrinting(allFilteredAndSortedRows, base.View.PrintAllGroupsCore, OriginalRowHandles);
			});
		}

		public override string GetTotalSummaryText(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (Info == null || !Info.Summaries.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Info.Summaries[column] ?? string.Empty;
		}

	internal class PrintSelectedRowsHelper
	{
		private class TypedListWrapper : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ITypedList
		{
			private IList SourceList { get; set; }

			private ITypedList TypedList { get; set; }

			bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => SourceList.IsSynchronized;

			object ICollection.SyncRoot => SourceList.SyncRoot;

			object IList.this[int index]

				get

					return SourceList[index];
				}
				set
				{
					SourceList[index] = value;
				}
			}

			bool IList.IsFixedSize => SourceList.IsFixedSize;

			bool IList.IsReadOnly => SourceList.IsReadOnly;

			public TypedListWrapper(IList sourceList, ITypedList sourceTypedList)
			{
				SourceList = sourceList;
				TypedList = sourceTypedList;
			}

			int IList.Add(object value)
			{
				return SourceList.Add(value);
			}

			void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
			{
				SourceList.Insert(index, value);
			}

			void IList.Remove(object value)
			{
				SourceList.Remove(value);
			}

			void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
			{
				SourceList.RemoveAt(index);
			}

			void IList.Clear()
			{
				SourceList.Clear();
			}

			int IList.IndexOf(object value)
			{
				return SourceList.IndexOf(value);
			}

			bool IList.Contains(object value)
			{
				return SourceList.Contains(value);
			}

			void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
			{
				SourceList.CopyTo(array, index);
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return SourceList.GetEnumerator();
			}

			PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				return TypedList.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
			}

			string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				return TypedList.GetListName(listAccessors);
			}
		}

		private DataProviderBase DataProvider;

		private DataViewBase View;

		private Dictionary<int, object> results = new Dictionary<int, object>();

		private IList allRows = new List<object>();

		private Dictionary<int, int> OriginalRowHandles;

		private DataControlBase RootDataControl => View.DataControl;

		protected DataController DataController => (DataController)(object)DataProvider.DataController;

		private PrintSelectedRowsHelper(DataProviderBase dataProvider, DataViewBase view, IList allRows)
		{
			DataProvider = dataProvider;
			View = view;
			this.allRows = allRows;
			OriginalRowHandles = new Dictionary<int, int>();
		}

		public static PrintSelectedRowsResult GetSelectedRowsInfo(DataProviderBase dataProvider, DataViewBase view, IList allRows)
		{
			return new PrintSelectedRowsHelper(dataProvider, view, allRows).GetRows();
		}

		private PrintSelectedRowsResult GetRows()
		{
			return new PrintSelectedRowsResult(GetRowsCore(), OriginalRowHandles);
		}

		private IList GetRowsCore()
		{
			if (!View.IsMultiSelection)
			{
				AddRow(View.FocusedRowHandle);
				return ExtractListSource(results.Values.ToList());
			}
			int[] masterDetailSelectedRows = GetMasterDetailSelectedRows(View.DataControl);
			foreach (int rowHandle in masterDetailSelectedRows)
			{
				AddRow(rowHandle);
			}
			if (allRows != null)
			{
				return ExtractListSource(GetServerModeRows());
			}
			return ExtractListSource(results.Values.ToList());
		}

		private IList ExtractListSource(IList source)
		{
			if (((DataControllerBase)DataController).ListSource is ITypedList)
			{
				return new TypedListWrapper(source, (ITypedList)((DataControllerBase)DataController).ListSource);
			}
			return GetListSourceCore(source);
		}

		private IList GetListSourceCore(IList source)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object obj = ((((DataControllerBase)DataController).ListSource is IListWrapper) ? ((IListWrapper)((DataControllerBase)DataController).ListSource).WrappedListType : ((DataControllerBase)DataController).ListSource.GetType());
			Type listItemType = DataBrowserHelperBase.GetListItemType(obj);
			if (listItemType == null)
			{
				return source;
			}
			Type type = typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(listItemType);
			IList list = Activator.CreateInstance(type) as IList;
			foreach (object item in source)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private int[] GetMasterDetailSelectedRows(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			DataProviderBase dataProviderBase = dataControl.DataProviderBase;
			List<int> list = GetMasterRows(dataControl).ToList();
			int[] normalizedSelectedRowsEx = ((DataController)dataProviderBase.DataController).Selection.GetNormalizedSelectedRowsEx(false);
			for (int i = 0; i < normalizedSelectedRowsEx.Length; i++)
			{
				if (list.Contains(normalizedSelectedRowsEx[i]))
				{
					list.Remove(normalizedSelectedRowsEx[i]);
				}
			}
			((DataController)dataProviderBase.DataController).Selection.BeginSelection();
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				((DataController)dataProviderBase.DataController).Selection.SetSelected(item, true);
			}
			int[] normalizedSelectedRowsEx2 = ((DataController)dataProviderBase.DataController).Selection.GetNormalizedSelectedRowsEx(false);
			foreach (int item2 in list)
			{
				((DataController)dataProviderBase.DataController).Selection.SetSelected(item2, false);
			}
			((DataController)dataProviderBase.DataController).Selection.CancelSelection();
			return normalizedSelectedRowsEx2;
		}

		private int[] GetMasterRows(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			List<int> result = new List<int>();
			dataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dc)
			{
				UpadteDetailContainsSelectedElements(dataControl, dc, ref result);
			}, delegate(DataControlBase dc)
			{
				UpadteDetailContainsSelectedElements(dataControl, dc, ref result);
			});
			return result.Distinct().ToArray();
		}

		private void UpadteDetailContainsSelectedElements(DataControlBase masterGrid, DataControlBase detailGrid, ref List<int> result)
		{
			if (detailGrid.GetMasterGridCore() == masterGrid && GetMasterDetailSelectedRows(detailGrid).Length != 0)
			{
				result.Add(detailGrid.GetMasterRowHandleInternal());
			}
		}

		private IList GetServerModeRows()
		{
			allRows.Clear();
			OriginalRowHandles.Clear();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, object> result in results)
			{
				OriginalRowHandles.Add(allRows.Count, result.Key);
				allRows.Add(result.Value);
			}
			return allRows;
		}

		private void AddRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (View.DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				if (!View.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
				{
					object row = ((allRows == null || rowHandle > allRows.Count - 1) ? DataController.GetListSourceRow(rowHandle) : allRows[rowHandle]);
					AddRowToPrintList(rowHandle, row);
				}
				else
				{
					AddGroupRowData(rowHandle);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddRowToPrintList(int rowHandle, object row)
		{
			if (!results.ContainsKey(rowHandle))
			{
				OriginalRowHandles.Add(results.Count, rowHandle);
				results.Add(rowHandle, row);
			}
		}

		private void AddGroupRowData(int rowHandle)
		{
			GroupRowInfo groupRowInfoByHandle = DataController.GroupInfo.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(rowHandle);
			int childCount = DataController.GroupInfo.GetChildCount(groupRowInfoByHandle);
			for (int i = 0; i < childCount; i++)
			{
				int childRow = DataController.GroupInfo.GetChildRow(groupRowInfoByHandle, i);
				if (View.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(childRow))
				{
					AddGroupRowData(childRow);
					continue;
				}
				object obj = ((allRows == null || childRow > allRows.Count - 1) ? DataController.GetListSourceRow(childRow) : allRows[childRow]);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					AddRowToPrintList(childRow, obj);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder : GridPrintingDataTreeBuilderBase
	{
		private bool PrintAutoCardWidth;

		private int PrintMaximumCardColumns;

		private Thickness PrintCardMargin;

		public List<DataRowNode> AllNodes;

		public new CardView View => base.View as CardView;

		protected new CardViewPrintRowInfo basePrintRowInfo => (CardViewPrintRowInfo)base.basePrintRowInfo;

		public CardViewPrintingDataTreeBuilder(CardView view, double pageWidth, ItemsGenerationStrategyBase itemsGenerationStrategy)
			: base(view, pageWidth, null, itemsGenerationStrategy)
		{
			PrintAutoCardWidth = view.PrintAutoCardWidth;
			PrintMaximumCardColumns = view.PrintMaximumCardColumns;
			PrintCardMargin = view.PrintCardMargin;
		}

		internal override void UpdateRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			double num = base.TotalHeaderWidth;
			bool isPrevGroupRowCollapsed = false;
			Thickness printDataIndentBorderThickness = default(Thickness);
			bool isGroupBottomBorderVisible = true;
			if (rowData is GroupRowData)
			{
				num -= View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)((GroupRowData)rowData).Level;
				RowNodePrintInfo printInfo = rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo;
				if (View.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(printInfo.PrevRowHandle))
				{
					isPrevGroupRowCollapsed = true;
				}
				if (View.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(printInfo.NextRowHandle))
				{
					if (printInfo.NextNodeLevel <= rowData.Level)
					{
						printDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					}
				}
				else if (printInfo.NextRowHandle == int.MinValue && IsPrintFooters())
				{
					printDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					isGroupBottomBorderVisible = false;
				}
			}
			double num2 = View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)((rowData is GroupRowData) ? rowData.Level : Math.Max(0, rowData.Level - 1));
			CardViewPrintRowInfo cardViewPrintRowInfo = CardViewPrintingHelper.GetPrintCardInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData);
			if (cardViewPrintRowInfo == null)
			{
				cardViewPrintRowInfo = new CardViewPrintRowInfo();
				CardViewPrintingHelper.SetPrintCardInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, cardViewPrintRowInfo);
			}
			ClonePrintRowInfoProperties(cardViewPrintRowInfo, basePrintRowInfo);
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.TotalHeaderWidth = num;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.IsPrevGroupRowCollapsed = isPrevGroupRowCollapsed;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardsRowWidth = base.TotalHeaderWidth;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardTemplate = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCardTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardRowIndentTemplate = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCardRowIndentTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardContentTemplate = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCardContentTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardHeaderTemplate = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCardHeaderTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardViewItemTemplate = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCardViewItemTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardMargin = basePrintRowInfo.PrintCardMargin;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintAutoCardWidth = basePrintRowInfo.PrintAutoCardWidth;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintMaximumCardColumns = basePrintRowInfo.PrintMaximumCardColumns;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintDataIndent = num2;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardWidth = GetPrintCardWidth(num2);
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintDataIndentBorderThickness = printDataIndentBorderThickness;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyle;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.IsGroupBottomBorderVisible = isGroupBottomBorderVisible;
		}

		protected override PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfoObject()
		{
			return new CardViewPrintRowInfo();
		}

		protected override PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfo()
		{
			CardViewPrintRowInfo cardViewPrintRowInfo = (CardViewPrintRowInfo)base.CreateBasePrintRowInfo();
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardsRowWidth = base.TotalHeaderWidth;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardTemplate = View.PrintCardTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardRowIndentTemplate = View.PrintCardRowIndentTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardContentTemplate = View.PrintCardContentTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardHeaderTemplate = View.PrintCardHeaderTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardViewItemTemplate = View.PrintCardViewItemTemplate;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.FixedTotalSummaryTopBorderVisible = !IsPrintFooter();
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintCardMargin = View.PrintCardMargin;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintAutoCardWidth = View.PrintAutoCardWidth;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintMaximumCardColumns = View.PrintMaximumCardColumns;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyle = View.PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyle;
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.TotalSummaries = GetTotalSummaries(cardViewPrintRowInfo);
			cardViewPrintRowInfo.TotalSummaryPosition = (View.PrintTotalSummary ? View.TotalSummaryPosition : TotalSummaryPosition.None);
			return cardViewPrintRowInfo;
		}

		private double GetPrintCardWidth(double dataIndentWidth)
		{
			if (!PrintAutoCardWidth)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = base.TotalHeaderWidth - dataIndentWidth;
			for (int i = 0; i < PrintMaximumCardColumns; i++)
			{
				Thickness actualPrintCardMargin = CardViewPrintingHelper.GetActualPrintCardMargin(PrintCardMargin, i == 0);
				num -= actualPrintCardMargin.Left + actualPrintCardMargin.Right;
			}
			return Math.Ceiling(num / (double)PrintMaximumCardColumns) - 1.0;
		}

		private List<PrintTotalSummaryItem> GetTotalSummaries(CardViewPrintRowInfo actualInfo)
		{
			List<PrintTotalSummaryItem> list = new List<PrintTotalSummaryItem>();
			List<Tuple<Style, string>> list2 = new List<Tuple<Style, string>>();
			foreach (GridColumn visibleColumn in View.VisibleColumns)
			{
				string[] array = GetTotalSummaryText(visibleColumn).Split(new string[1] { Environment.NewLine }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text in array2)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
					{
						list2.Add(new Tuple<Style, string>(visibleColumn.ActualPrintTotalSummaryStyle, text));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
			{
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(new PrintTotalSummaryItem
					{
						TotalSummaryText = "  /",
						PrintTotalSummaryStyle = actualInfo.PrintTotalSummarySeparatorStyle
					});
				}
				list.Add(new PrintTotalSummaryItem
				{
					TotalSummaryText = ((list.Count > 0) ? "  " : "") + list2[j].Item2,
					PrintTotalSummaryStyle = list2[j].Item1
				});
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void UpdateTotalSummary(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData)
		{
			CardViewPrintRowInfo printCardInfo = CardViewPrintingHelper.GetPrintCardInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData);
			printCardInfo.TotalSummaries = GetTotalSummaries(printCardInfo);
			printCardInfo.TotalSummaryPosition = (View.PrintTotalSummary ? View.TotalSummaryPosition : TotalSummaryPosition.None);
		}

		protected override bool GetPrintGroupFooters()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ProcessNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			if (AllNodes == null)
			{
				AllNodes = new List<DataRowNode>();
			}
			AllNodes.Add(node);
		}

		protected override double GetHeaderFooterLeftIndent()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override void SetHeadersPrintRowInfo(HeadersData headersData, PrintRowInfoBase printRowInfo)
		{
			CardViewPrintingHelper.SetPrintCardInfo((DependencyObject)(object)headersData, (CardViewPrintRowInfo)printRowInfo);
		}

		public override IDataNode CreateMasterDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode rowNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override IDataNode CreateDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode rowNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index)
		{
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GridCardViewPrintingNode(container, rowNode, this, parentNode, index);
		}

		public override IDataNode CreateGroupPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode groupNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return (IDataNode)(object)new CardViewGroupPrintingNode(container, (GroupNode)groupNode, this, parentNode, index, pageSize);
		}

		protected override bool IsGeneratedControl(GridControl grid)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override void UpdateGroupRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			GroupRowData groupRowData = (GroupRowData)rowData;
			if (!(groupRowData is GroupSummaryRowData))
			{
				TreeBuilderPrintingHelper.UpdatePrintGroupRowInfo(CardViewPrintingHelper.GetPrintCardInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData), groupRowData, GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default, GroupSummaryDisplayMode.Default, GetGroupRowText(groupRowData), 0);
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetGroupRowText(GroupRowData rowData)

	public abstract class PrintingDataTreeBuilder : PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase
	{
		private MasterDetailPrintInfo masterDetailPrintInfo;

		public ITableView PrintView => base.View as ITableView;

		protected BandsLayoutBase BandsLayout { get; private set; }

		protected PrintRowInfoBase basePrintRowInfo { get; set; }

		public override bool SupportsMasterDetail => false;

		protected internal MasterDetailPrintInfo MasterDetailPrintInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (masterDetailPrintInfo == null)
				{
					masterDetailPrintInfo = GetDefaultMasterDetailPrintInfo();
				}
				return masterDetailPrintInfo;
			}
			protected set
			{
				masterDetailPrintInfo = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual MasterDetailPrintInfo GetDefaultMasterDetailPrintInfo()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public PrintingDataTreeBuilder(DataViewBase view, double totalHeaderWidth, BandsLayoutBase bandsLayout, MasterDetailPrintInfo masterDetailPrintInfo = null)
			: base(view, totalHeaderWidth)
		{
			BandsLayout = bandsLayout;
			MasterDetailPrintInfo = masterDetailPrintInfo;
			basePrintRowInfo = GetHeaderFooterPrintInfo();
			SetHeadersPrintRowInfo(base.HeadersData, basePrintRowInfo);
			UpdateBandData();
			base.HeadersData.UpdateCellData();
			UpdateIsTotalSummaryLeftBorderVisible();
		}

		protected abstract double GetHeaderFooterLeftIndent();

		protected abstract void SetHeadersPrintRowInfo(HeadersData headersData, PrintRowInfoBase printRowInfo);

		private void UpdateIsTotalSummaryLeftBorderVisible()
		{
			if (BandsLayout == null)
			{
				List<KeyValuePair<ColumnBase, GridColumnData>> list = base.HeadersData.CellDataCache.ToList();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					UpdateIsLeftTotalSummaryBorderVisible(list[i].Key, base.HeadersData, GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)list[i].Value));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBandData()
		{
			if (BandsLayout != null)
			{
				SetCloneBandPrintInfo(base.View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.PrintableBands, BandsLayout.VisibleBands);
			}
		}

		private void SetCloneBandPrintInfo(IEnumerable<BandBase> sourceBands, List<BandBase> cloneBands)
		{
			List<BandBase> list = sourceBands.ToList();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SetCloneBandPrintInfo(list[i], cloneBands[i]);
			}
		}

		private void SetCloneBandPrintInfo(BandBase source, BandBase clone)
		{
			PrintCellInfo value = new PrintCellInfo(isLast: false, null, null, GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintColumnWidth((DependencyObject)(object)clone), source.HeaderCaption, source.ActualPrintBandHeaderStyle, null, basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible, 0, source.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignment, clone.HasTopElement, !clone.HasRightSibling, GetPrintableHeaderImage(clone), clone.ImageAlignment);
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)clone, value);
			PrintBandInfo value2 = new PrintBandInfo(source);
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintBandInfo((DependencyObject)(object)clone, value2);
			SetCloneBandPrintInfo(source.PrintableBands, clone.VisibleBands);
		}

		protected virtual PrintRowInfoBase GetHeaderFooterPrintInfo()
		{
			return CreateBasePrintRowInfo();
		}

		protected abstract PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfo();

		protected internal virtual int GetActualRowLevel(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData)
		{
			return rowData.Level;
		}

		internal override void UpdateColumnData(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, GridColumnData cellData, ColumnBase column)
		{
			base.UpdateColumnData(rowData, cellData, column);
			PrintCellInfo basePrintCellInfo = GetBasePrintCellInfo(cellData, column);
			PrintCellInfo printCellInfo = null;
			if ((IsFirstColumn(cellData.Column) && base.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) || base.View.IsTreeColumn(cellData.Column))
			{
				printCellInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)cellData);
				double num = basePrintCellInfo.PrintColumnWidth - base.View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)GetActualRowLevel(rowData);
				if (printCellInfo == null)
				{
					printCellInfo = new PrintCellInfo(basePrintCellInfo.IsLast, basePrintCellInfo.TotalSummaryText, basePrintCellInfo.PrintTotalSummaryStyle, num, basePrintCellInfo.HeaderCaption, basePrintCellInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle, basePrintCellInfo.PrintCellStyle, basePrintCellInfo.IsColumnHeaderVisible, horizontalHeaderContentAlignment: basePrintCellInfo.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignment, detailLevel: GetDetailLevel(), hasTopElement: basePrintCellInfo.HasTopElement, isRight: basePrintCellInfo.IsRight, headerImage: basePrintCellInfo.HeaderImage, imageAlignment: basePrintCellInfo.ImageAlignment)
					{
						HorizontalTotalSummaryContentAlignment = basePrintCellInfo.HorizontalTotalSummaryContentAlignment
					};
				}
				else
				{
					printCellInfo.PrintColumnWidth = num;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				printCellInfo = basePrintCellInfo;
			}
			UpdatePrintCellThickness(rowData, cellData, printCellInfo);
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)cellData, printCellInfo);
			if (GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintFixedFooterTextLeft((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData) == null)
			{
				GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintFixedFooterTextLeft((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData, GetFixedLeftTotalSummaryText());
			}
			if (GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintFixedFooterTextRight((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData) == null)
			{
				GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintFixedFooterTextRight((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData, GetFixedRightTotalSummaryText());
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdatePrintCellThickness(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, GridColumnData cellData, PrintCellInfo actualPrintCellInfo)
		{
			actualPrintCellInfo.PrintCellThickness = (actualPrintCellInfo.IsRight ? new Thickness(GetBorderThickness(), 0.0, GetBorderThickness(), GetBorderThickness()) : new Thickness(GetBorderThickness(), 0.0, 0.0, GetBorderThickness()));
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTotalSummary(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData)
		{
			foreach (GridColumnData cellDatum in base.HeadersData.CellData)
			{
				PrintCellInfo printCellInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)cellDatum);
				printCellInfo.TotalSummaryText = GetTotalSummaryText(cellDatum.Column);
				UpdateIsLeftTotalSummaryBorderVisible(cellDatum.Column, base.HeadersData, printCellInfo);
			}
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintFixedFooterTextLeft((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData, GetFixedLeftTotalSummaryText());
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintFixedFooterTextRight((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData, GetFixedRightTotalSummaryText());
		}

		protected virtual string GetFixedLeftTotalSummaryText()
		{
			return base.View.GetFixedSummariesLeftString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetFixedRightTotalSummaryText()
		{
			return base.View.GetFixedSummariesRightString();
		}

		private bool IsFirstColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (BandsLayout != null)
			{
				return !GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintHasLeftSibling((DependencyObject)(object)column);
			}
			return column == GetVisibleColumns().First();
		}

		private bool IsLastColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return column == GetVisibleColumns().Last();
		}

		private bool IsRightColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (BandsLayout != null)
			{
				return !GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintHasRightSibling((DependencyObject)(object)column);
			}
			return IsLastColumn(column);
		}

		private void UpdateIsLeftTotalSummaryBorderVisible(ColumnBase column, ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, PrintCellInfo printCellInfo)
		{
			if (column.IsFirst || !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(GetTotalSummaryText(column)))
			{
				printCellInfo.IsTotalSummaryLeftBorderVisible = true;
				return;
			}
			int prevVisibleIndex = column.ActualVisibleIndex - 1;
			GridColumnData gridColumnData = rowData.CellDataCache.Values.FirstOrDefault((GridColumnData cd) => cd.VisibleIndex == prevVisibleIndex);
			if (gridColumnData == null || gridColumnData.Column == null)
			{
				printCellInfo.IsTotalSummaryLeftBorderVisible = true;
			}
			else
			{
				printCellInfo.IsTotalSummaryLeftBorderVisible = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(GetTotalSummaryText(gridColumnData.Column));
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetTotalSummaryText(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return column.TotalSummaryText;
		}

		protected PrintCellInfo GetBasePrintCellInfo(ColumnBase column)
		{
			PrintCellInfo printCellInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)base.HeadersData.GetCellDataByColumn(column, updateNewCellData: false, addToCache: true));
			if (printCellInfo != null)
			{
				return printCellInfo;
			}
			return new PrintCellInfo(IsLastColumn(column), " ", column.ActualPrintTotalSummaryStyle, GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintColumnWidth((DependencyObject)(object)column), column.HeaderCaption, column.ActualPrintColumnHeaderStyle, column.ActualPrintCellStyle, basePrintRowInfo != null && basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible, GetDetailLevel(), column.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignment, (basePrintRowInfo != null && basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintBandHeadersVisible) || column.HasTopElement, IsRightColumn(column), GetPrintableHeaderImage(column), column.ImageAlignment)
			{
				HorizontalTotalSummaryContentAlignment = column.ActualHorizontalContentAlignment
			};
		}

		private ImageSource GetPrintableHeaderImage(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (PrintView == null || !PrintView.AllowPrintColumnHeaderImage)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return column.Image;
		}

		private PrintCellInfo GetBasePrintCellInfo(GridColumnData cellData, ColumnBase column)
		{
			return GetBasePrintCellInfo(column);
		}

		internal override ColumnBase GetGroupColumnByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override object GetGroupValueByNode(DataRowNode node)

			return null;
		}

		internal override IList<SummaryItemBase> GetGroupSummaries()
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override bool TryGetGroupSummaryValue(RowData rowData, SummaryItemBase item, out object value)
		{
			value = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal override string GetGroupRowDisplayTextByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override string GetGroupRowHeaderCaptionByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal override GroupTextHighlightingProperties GetGroupHighlightingPropertiesByNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected bool IsPrintFooters()
		{
			if (!IsPrintFooter())
			{
				return IsPrintFixedFooter();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsPrintFooter()
		{
			if (IsPrintTotalSummary() && base.View.TotalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return base.PrintFooterTemplate != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsPrintFixedFooter()
		{
			if (IsPrintFixedTotalSummary() && base.View.ShowFixedTotalSummary)
			{
				return base.PrintFixedFooterTemplate != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsPrintTotalSummary();

		protected abstract bool IsPrintFixedTotalSummary();

		protected virtual int GetDetailLevel()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public abstract IDataNode CreateMasterDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode rowNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize);

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> GetPrintableColumns()
		{
			if (BandsLayout != null)

				return BandsLayout.GetVisibleColumns();

			return base.GetPrintableColumns();
		}
