	public class GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder : GridPrintingDataTreeBuilderBase, ISupportMasterDetailPrinting
	{
		private readonly bool AllowPartialGrouping;

		private Dictionary<DataControlDetailDescriptor, IDescriptorAndDataControlBase> cache = new Dictionary<DataControlDetailDescriptor, IDescriptorAndDataControlBase>();

		private int prevRowHandle = int.MinValue;

		private bool IsPrevMaserRowExpanded;

		protected new PrintRowInfo basePrintRowInfo => (PrintRowInfo)base.basePrintRowInfo;

		internal DataTemplate PrintGroupFooterTemplate { get; private set; }

		public new TableView View => base.View as TableView;

		protected new GridDataProvider GridDataProvider => View.GridDataProvider;

		public GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder(TableView view, double totalHeaderWidth, ItemsGenerationStrategyBase itemsGenerationStrategy, BandsLayoutBase bandsLayout, MasterDetailPrintInfo masterDetailPrintInfo = null)
			: base(view, totalHeaderWidth, bandsLayout, itemsGenerationStrategy, masterDetailPrintInfo)
		{
			AllowPartialGrouping = view.AllowPartialGrouping;
			PrintGroupFooterTemplate = View.PrintGroupFooterTemplate;
		}

		protected override PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfo()
		{
			PrintRowInfo printRowInfo = (PrintRowInfo)base.CreateBasePrintRowInfo();
			printRowInfo.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel();
			printRowInfo.BandsLayout = base.BandsLayout;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintTopDetailRowVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintBottomDetailIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintDetailTopIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintDetailBottomIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.PrintDataTopIndentBorderThickness = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintBottomLastDetailIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.PrintTopRowIndentMargin = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
			printRowInfo.PrintTopRowWidth = base.TotalHeaderWidth;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintHeaderBottomIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintFooterBottomIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintFixedFooterBottomIndentVisible = false;
			printRowInfo.PrintColumnHeaderStyle = View.PrintColumnHeaderStyle;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible = View.PrintColumnHeaders && View.ShowColumnHeaders;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintBandHeadersVisible = View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null && View.ShowBandsPanel && View.PrintBandHeaders;
			TableView tableView = ((View.Grid.GetMasterGrid() != null) ? (View.Grid.GetMasterGrid().View as TableView) : null);
			printRowInfo.DetailTopIndent = tableView?.PrintDetailTopIndent ?? View.PrintDetailTopIndent;
			printRowInfo.DetailBottomIndent = tableView?.PrintDetailBottomIndent ?? View.PrintDetailBottomIndent;
			return printRowInfo;
		}

		protected override PrintRowInfoBase CreateBasePrintRowInfoObject()
		{
			return new PrintRowInfo();
		}

		protected override MasterDetailPrintInfo GetDefaultMasterDetailPrintInfo()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new MasterDetailPrintInfo(View.AllowPrintDetails, View.AllowPrintEmptyDetails, View.PrintAllDetails, 0, this);
		}

		public IDescriptorAndDataControlBase GetDescriptorAndGridControl(DataControlDetailDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			if (!cache.TryGetValue(descriptor, out var value))
			{
				value = new DescriptorAndGridControl(descriptor);
				cache.Add(descriptor, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public bool IsGeneratedControl(DataControlBase grid)
		{
			foreach (IDescriptorAndDataControlBase value in cache.Values)
			{
				if (value.Grid == grid)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void SetHeadersPrintRowInfo(HeadersData headersData, PrintRowInfoBase printRowInfo)
		{
			GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)headersData, (PrintRowInfo)printRowInfo);
		}

		protected override bool IsGeneratedControl(GridControl grid)
		{
			return base.MasterDetailPrintInfo.RootPrintingDataTreeBuilder.IsGeneratedControl(grid);
		}

		internal override void UpdateRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			double num = base.TotalHeaderWidth;
			if (rowData is GroupRowData)
			{
				num -= View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)((GroupRowData)rowData).Level;
			}
			Thickness printDataIndentBorderThickness = default(Thickness);
			RowNodePrintInfo printInfo = rowData.DataRowNode.PrintInfo;
			double borderThickness = GetBorderThickness();
			double num2 = (double)(GetDetailLevel() + base.MasterDetailPrintInfo.DetailGroupLevel) * View.PrintRowIndentWidth;
			bool flag = IsMasterRowExpanded(rowData.RowHandle.Value);
			double printDataIndent;
			Thickness printDataIndentMargin;
			if (printInfo.RowPosition == RowPosition.Bottom || printInfo.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single)
			{
				bool flag2 = flag || (printInfo.NextRowHandle == int.MinValue && !IsPrintFooters());
				printDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, flag2 ? 0.0 : borderThickness);
				int nextNodeLevel = printInfo.NextNodeLevel;
				printDataIndent = View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)(rowData.Level - nextNodeLevel);
				printDataIndentMargin = new Thickness(num2 + (double)nextNodeLevel * View.PrintRowIndentWidth, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				printDataIndentBorderThickness = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
				printDataIndent = View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)rowData.Level;
				printDataIndentMargin = new Thickness(num2, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (!IsPrintFooters() || (printInfo.RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom && printInfo.RowPosition != RowPosition.Single))
			{
				if (GetAllowPrintDetailsValue())
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					else if (printInfo.NextRowHandle != int.MinValue && !View.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(printInfo.NextRowHandle) && (printInfo.RowPosition == RowPosition.Bottom || printInfo.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single))
					{
						flag3 = GetDetailLevel() > 0 && base.MasterDetailPrintInfo.PrintDetailType == PrintDetailType.Last;
					}
				}
				if (!flag3 && GetDetailLevel() > 0 && printInfo.NextRowHandle == int.MinValue)
				{
					flag4 = !(rowData is GroupSummaryRowData) || !IsPrintFooters();
				}
			}
			if (!flag3 && !flag4 && flag)
			{
				flag3 = true;
			}
			Thickness printDataTopIndentBorderThickness = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
			Thickness printTopRowIndentMargin = FillControl.EmptyThickness;
			double num3 = basePrintRowInfo.PrintTopRowWidth;
			bool isPrintTopDetailRowVisible = false;
			if (GetAllowPrintDetailsValue() && IsPrevMaserRowExpanded)
			{
				isPrintTopDetailRowVisible = true;
				printDataTopIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, borderThickness);
				double num4 = View.PrintRowIndentWidth * (double)rowData.Level;
				printTopRowIndentMargin = new Thickness(num2 + num4, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				num3 -= num4;
			}
			if (prevRowHandle == int.MinValue || printInfo.PrevRowHandle == prevRowHandle)
			{
				prevRowHandle = rowData.RowHandle.Value;
				IsPrevMaserRowExpanded = flag;
			}
			if (rowData is GroupSummaryRowData && printInfo.NextNodeLevel < rowData.Level)
			{
				printDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, borderThickness);
			}
			bool flag5 = false;
			bool showIndentRowBreak = false;
			if (AllowPartialGrouping)
			{
				VisibleIndexCollection visibleIndexes = ((DataController)View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).GetVisibleIndexes();
				flag5 = visibleIndexes.IsSingleGroupRow(rowData.RowHandle.Value) || View.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(printInfo.NextRowHandle) || visibleIndexes.IsSingleGroupRow(printInfo.NextRowHandle);
				if (flag5 && printInfo.RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom && printInfo.RowPosition != RowPosition.Single && View.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(printInfo.NextRowHandle) && printInfo.NextNodeLevel < rowData.Level && !flag)
				{
					showIndentRowBreak = true;
					printDataIndentBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, borderThickness);
				}
			}
			PrintRowInfo printRowInfo = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData);
			if (printRowInfo == null)
			{
				printRowInfo = new PrintRowInfo();
				GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, printRowInfo);
			}
			ClonePrintRowInfoProperties(printRowInfo, basePrintRowInfo);
			printRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible = basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintColumnHeadersVisible;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintBandHeadersVisible = basePrintRowInfo.IsPrintBandHeadersVisible;
			printRowInfo.PrintDataIndentBorderThickness = printDataIndentBorderThickness;
			printRowInfo.PrintDataIndentMargin = printDataIndentMargin;
			printRowInfo.PrintDataIndent = printDataIndent;
			printRowInfo.TotalHeaderWidth = num;
			printRowInfo.ShowRowBreak = flag5;
			printRowInfo.ShowIndentRowBreak = showIndentRowBreak;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintBottomDetailIndentVisible = flag3;
			printRowInfo.PrintDataTopIndentBorderThickness = printDataTopIndentBorderThickness;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintTopDetailRowVisible = isPrintTopDetailRowVisible;
			printRowInfo.IsPrintBottomLastDetailIndentVisible = flag4;
			printRowInfo.PrintTopRowIndentMargin = printTopRowIndentMargin;
			printRowInfo.PrintTopRowWidth = num3;
			printRowInfo.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel();
			printRowInfo.PrintRowDataBottomIndentControlStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintRowDataBottomIndentControlStyle;
			printRowInfo.PrintRowDataBottomLastIndentControlStyle = basePrintRowInfo.PrintRowDataBottomLastIndentControlStyle;
			printRowInfo.DetailTopIndent = basePrintRowInfo.DetailTopIndent;
			printRowInfo.DetailBottomIndent = basePrintRowInfo.DetailBottomIndent;
			printRowInfo.BandsLayout = basePrintRowInfo.BandsLayout;
		}

		private bool IsMasterRowExpanded(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == int.MinValue || rowHandle < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!GetAllowPrintDetailsValue())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetPrintAllDetailsValue() && View.Grid.DetailDescriptor != null)
			{
				return IsFakeDetailExpanded(rowHandle);
			}
			if (!MasterDetailPrintHelper.IsMasterRowExpanded(this, rowHandle))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(GetOriginalRowHandle(rowHandle));
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDataControl();
			if (dataControlBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsMasterRowExpandedCore(dataControlBase, rowHandle);
		}

		private bool IsMasterRowExpandedCore(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle)
		{
			if (MasterDetailPrintHelper.IsDetailContainsRows(this, rowHandle, dataControl))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!GetAllowPrintEmptyDetailsValue())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(dataControl.viewCore is TableView tableView))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsGridHeaderFooterVisible(tableView);
		}

		private bool IsFakeDetailExpanded(int rowHandle)
		{
			List<IDescriptorAndDataControlBase> descriptors = new List<IDescriptorAndDataControlBase>();
			View.Grid.MasterDetailProvider.GetDetailDescriptors(this, base.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value).ForEach(delegate(DataControlDetailDescriptor descr)
			{
				descriptors.Add(base.MasterDetailPrintInfo.RootPrintingDataTreeBuilder.GetDescriptorAndGridControl(descr));
			});
			foreach (IDescriptorAndDataControlBase item in descriptors)
			{
				DataControlBase dataControlBase = MasterDetailPrintHelper.FindDetailDataControl(this, base.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value, (DataControlDetailDescriptor)item.Descriptor);
				if (dataControlBase == null || !((TableView)dataControlBase.viewCore).PrintSelectedRowsOnly)
				{
					dataControlBase = item.GetDetailGridControl(this);
				}
				if (IsMasterRowExpandedCore(dataControlBase, rowHandle))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void UpdateGroupRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			GroupRowData groupRowData = (GroupRowData)rowData;
			if (groupRowData is GroupSummaryRowData)
			{
				UpdatePrintGroupSummaryInfo(groupRowData);
			}
			else
			{
				TreeBuilderPrintingHelper.UpdatePrintGroupRowInfo(GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintRowInfo((DependencyObject)(object)rowData), groupRowData, View.GroupSummaryDisplayMode, View.PrintGroupSummaryDisplayMode, GetGroupRowText(groupRowData), GetDetailLevel());
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePrintGroupSummaryInfo(GroupRowData groupRowData)
		{
			foreach (GridGroupSummaryColumnData fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum in groupRowData.FixedNoneGroupSummaryData)
			{
				double printColumnWidth = GridPrintingHelper.GetPrintCellInfo((DependencyObject)(object)groupRowData.GetCellDataByColumn(fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum.Column)).PrintColumnWidth;
				string groupFooterText = ((EditableDataObject)fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum).Value.ToString();
				Style printGroupFooterStyle = View.PrintGroupFooterStyle;
				bool isRight = !fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum.Column.HasRightSibling;
				PrintGroupSummaryInfo value = new PrintGroupSummaryInfo(printColumnWidth, groupFooterText, printGroupFooterStyle, isRight);
				GridPrintingHelper.SetPrintGroupSummaryInfo((DependencyObject)(object)fixedNoneGroupSummaryDatum, value);
			}
		}

		{
			return TreeBuilderPrintingHelper.GetGroupRowText(rowData, View.GroupSummaryDisplayMode, View.PrintGroupSummaryDisplayMode, "({0})", useFirstIndent: true);
		}

		{
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GridDetailPrintingNode(container, rowNode, this, node, index);
		}

		public override IDataNode CreateGroupPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode groupNode, IDataNode node, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			if (!(groupNode is GroupSummaryRowNode))
			{
				return (IDataNode)(object)new GridGroupPrintingNode(container, (GroupNode)groupNode, this, node, index, pageSize);
			}
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GridGroupSummaryPrintingNode(container, (GroupNode)groupNode, this, node, index, pageSize);
		}

		public override IDataNode CreateMasterDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode rowNode, IDataNode node, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GridMasterDetailPrintingNode(container, rowNode, this, node, index, pageSize);
		}

		protected override RowNodePrintInfo CreateRowNodePrintInfo(DataRowNode node, Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> mergeValueCounters)
		{
			RowNodePrintInfo rowNodePrintInfo = base.CreateRowNodePrintInfo(node, mergeValueCounters);
			if (View.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				rowNodePrintInfo.MergeValues = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, int>();
				foreach (ColumnBase visibleColumn in GetVisibleColumns())
				{
					int? mergeValue = GetMergeValue(visibleColumn, node.RowHandle.Value, mergeValueCounters);
					if (mergeValue.HasValue)
					{
						rowNodePrintInfo.MergeValues[visibleColumn] = mergeValue.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			return rowNodePrintInfo;
		}

		private int? GetMergeValue(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle, Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> mergeValueCounters)
		{
			if (!View.IsMergedCell(rowHandle, column))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = View.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			if (!View.IsPrevRowCellMerged(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore, column, checkRowData: false) && mergeValueCounters.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				mergeValueCounters[column]++;
			}
			if (mergeValueCounters.TryGetValue(column, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			mergeValueCounters[column] = 0;
			return 0;
		}

		protected override bool GetPrintGroupFooters()
		{
			return View.PrintGroupFooters;
		}

		protected override void ProcessNode(DataRowNode node)
		{
		}
	}

			: base(treeBuilder, parent, index)

			this.nodeContainer = nodeContainer;
		}

		protected abstract bool GetIsDetailContainerCore();

		protected override IDataNode GetChildCore(int index)
		{
			RowNode rowNode = nodeContainer.Items[index];
			return DataTreeBuilder.CreateRowElement(!IsDetailContainerCore, () => CreateGroupChildNode(rowNode, index), () => CreateChildNode(nodeContainer, rowNode, (IDataNode)(object)this, index));
		}

		protected abstract IDataNode CreateGroupChildNode(RowNode rowNode, int index);

		protected abstract IDataNode CreateChildNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode rowNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index);

		protected override bool CanGetChildCore(int index)
		{
			if (0 <= index && index < nodeContainer.Items.Count && (!(nodeContainer.Items[index] is DataRowNode dataRowNode) || dataRowNode.RowHandle.Value != -2147483647))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

				return base.GetChildCore(index - 1);

			if (isFixedHeaderVisible)

			}
			return base.CanGetChildCore(index);

	public class GridRootPrintingNode : GridContainerPrintingNodeBase, IRootDataNode, IDataNode, IDisposable
	{
		protected override bool IsDetailContainerCore => false;

		public GridRootPrintingNode(PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase treeBuilder, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
			: base(null, treeBuilder, null, -1, pageSize)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanGetChildCore(int index)
		{
			return index < 1;
		}

		protected override IDataNode GetChildCore(int index)
		{
			return (IDataNode)(object)new GridGroupRootPrintingNode(base.TreeBuilder, (IDataNode)(object)this, pageSize);
		}

		private int GetMasterRowsCount()
		{
			VirtualItemsEnumerator virtualItemsEnumerator = new VirtualItemsEnumerator(base.TreeBuilder.RootNodeContainer);
			int num = 0;
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)virtualItemsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetExpandedDetailsRowsCount()
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int result = 0;
			if (!(base.TreeBuilder is GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder gridPrintingDataTreeBuilder))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (!EnumExtensions.ToBoolean(gridPrintingDataTreeBuilder.View.AllowPrintDetails, true))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return GetExpandedDetailsRowsCountCore(gridPrintingDataTreeBuilder.View.Grid);
		}

		private int GetExpandedDetailsRowsCountCore(DataControlBase grid)
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < grid.VisibleRowCount; i++)
			{
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i);
				if (!grid.MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
				{
					continue;
				}
				RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = grid.MasterDetailProvider.GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				DataControlBase dataControlBase = readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDataControl();
				if (dataControlBase != null && dataControlBase.DataView is TableView)
				{
					num += dataControlBase.VisibleRowCount;
					if (EnumExtensions.ToBoolean(((TableView)dataControlBase.DataView).AllowPrintDetails, true))
					{
						num += GetExpandedDetailsRowsCountCore(dataControlBase);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool IsPrintAllDetails()
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(base.TreeBuilder is GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder gridPrintingDataTreeBuilder))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EnumExtensions.ToBoolean(gridPrintingDataTreeBuilder.View.PrintAllDetails, false);
		}

		int IRootDataNode.GetTotalDetailCount()
		{
			if (IsPrintAllDetails())
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int masterRowsCount = GetMasterRowsCount();
			int expandedDetailsRowsCount = GetExpandedDetailsRowsCount();
			return masterRowsCount + expandedDetailsRowsCount;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			base.TreeBuilder.OnRootNodeDispose();
		}
	}

		public static RowViewInfo GetFooter(PrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (treeBuilder.PrintView.PrintTotalSummary && treeBuilder.View.TotalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Bottom && treeBuilder.PrintFooterTemplate != null)
			{
				return new RowViewInfo(treeBuilder.PrintFooterTemplate, (object)treeBuilder.HeadersData);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static RowViewInfo GetFixedFooter(PrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder)
		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				return new RowViewInfo(treeBuilder.PrintFixedFooterTemplate, (object)treeBuilder.HeadersData);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static RowViewInfo GetFirstPageHeader(PrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsFirstPageHeaderVisible(treeBuilder))
			{
				return new RowViewInfo(treeBuilder.PrintFooterTemplate, (object)treeBuilder.HeadersData);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool IsFirstPageHeaderVisible(PrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder)
		{
			if (treeBuilder.PrintView.PrintTotalSummary && treeBuilder.View.TotalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Top)
			{
				return treeBuilder.PrintFooterTemplate != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

	public class DescriptorAndGridControl : IDescriptorAndDataControlBase
	{
		private DataControlDetailDescriptor descriptor;

		private BindingBase itemsSourceBinding;

		private GridControl grid;

		private int currentRowHandle = int.MinValue;

		public DataControlBase Grid => grid;

		public DetailDescriptorBase Descriptor => descriptor;

		internal DescriptorAndGridControl(DataControlDetailDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			this.descriptor = descriptor;
		}

		private void InitializeGrid(DataControlDetailInfo detailInfo, PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase treeBuilder)
		{
			if (detailInfo.DataControl == null)
			{
				detailInfo.UpdateDataControl(addToClones: false);
			}
			itemsSourceBinding = descriptor.GetItemsSourceBinding();
			grid = (GridControl)descriptor.DataControl.CloneDetailForPrint(treeBuilder.View.MasterRootNodeContainer, treeBuilder.View.MasterRootRowsContainer);
			descriptor.PopulateColumnsIfNeeded(detailInfo.DataControl.DataProviderBase);
			descriptor.DataControl.CopyToDetail(grid);
			grid.LockUpdateLayout = true;
		}

		private void UpdateClonedDetail(DataControlDetailInfo detailInfo, PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase treeBuilder)
		{
			grid.DataContext = treeBuilder.ReusingRowData.Row;
			grid.DataControlParent = detailInfo;
			if (itemsSourceBinding != null)
			{
				grid.SetBinding(DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty, itemsSourceBinding);
			}
			grid.PopulateColumnsIfNeeded(grid.GridDataProvider);
			grid.UpdateTotalSummary();
			grid.View.UpdateColumnsViewInfo();
		}

		public DataControlBase GetDetailGridControl(PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase treeBuilder)
		{
			if (treeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value == currentRowHandle)
			{
				return grid;
			}
			currentRowHandle = treeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value;
			MasterDetailProvider masterDetailProvider = (MasterDetailProvider)treeBuilder.View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider;
			DataControlDetailInfo dataControlDetailInfo = masterDetailProvider.GetRowDetailInfoCore(currentRowHandle, createNewIfNotExist: false)?.GetActualDetailInfo(descriptor);
			if (dataControlDetailInfo == null)
			{
				dataControlDetailInfo = CreateRowDetailInfo(treeBuilder, currentRowHandle, descriptor);
			}
			if (grid == null)
			{
				InitializeGrid(dataControlDetailInfo, treeBuilder);
			}
			UpdateClonedDetail(dataControlDetailInfo, treeBuilder);
			return grid;
		}

		private DataControlDetailInfo CreateRowDetailInfo(PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase treeBuilder, int rowHandle, DataControlDetailDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			RowDetailContainer rowDetailContainer = new RowDetailContainer(treeBuilder.View.DataControl, treeBuilder.View.DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(rowHandle));
			return (DataControlDetailInfo)(rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo = (DataControlDetailInfo)descriptor.CreateRowDetailInfo(rowDetailContainer));
		}
	}

	public class GridMasterDetailPrintingNode : GridContainerPrintingNodeBase, IVisualGroupNode, IGroupNode, IDataNode
	{
		private readonly RowNode rowNode;

		private readonly NodeContainer parentContainer;

		private DataControlBase detailDataControl;

		private List<DataControlBase> details;

		private bool printStub;

		protected internal new GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder TreeBuilder => base.TreeBuilder as GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder;

		GroupUnion IGroupNode.Union => (GroupUnion)2;

		bool IGroupNode.RepeatHeaderEveryPage => true;

		public GridMasterDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer parentContainer, RowNode rowNode, GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, IDataNode parent, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
			: base(treeBuilder.RootNodeContainer, treeBuilder, parent, index, pageSize)
		{
			this.rowNode = rowNode;
			this.parentContainer = parentContainer;
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualGroupNode.GetFooter(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool GetIsDetailContainerCore()
		{
			return printStub;
		}

		protected void UpdateReusingRowData()
		{
			TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.AssignFromInternal(null, parentContainer, rowNode, forceUpdate: true);
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualGroupNode.GetHeader(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			UpdateReusingRowData();
			return CreateRowElement(TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData, TreeBuilder.PrintRowTemplate);
		}

		protected override bool CanGetChildCore(int index)
		{
			if (!TreeBuilder.GetAllowPrintDetailsValue() || index > GetPrintDeailsLimit())
			{
				return false;
			}
			UpdateReusingRowData();
			if (details == null && TreeBuilder.GetPrintAllDetailsValue())
			{
				ActualizeDetails();
			}
			if (!TreeBuilder.GetPrintAllDetailsValue())
			{
				if (!IsMasterRowExpanded())
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						printStub = true;
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (details == null)
				{
					ActualizeDetails();
				}
				int originalRowHandle = TreeBuilder.GetOriginalRowHandle(TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value);
				RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = TreeBuilder.View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(originalRowHandle);
				detailDataControl = readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDataControl();
				if (detailDataControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (MasterDetailPrintHelper.IsDetailContainsRows(TreeBuilder, TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value, detailDataControl))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return CanPrintEmptyDetails(detailDataControl);
			}
			if (details.Count == 0)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					printStub = true;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (TreeBuilder.View.PrintSelectedRowsOnly)
			{
				foreach (DataControlBase detail in details)
				{
					if (MasterDetailPrintHelper.IsDetailContainsRows(TreeBuilder, TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value, detail))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ActualizeDetails()
		{
			List<IDescriptorAndDataControlBase> descriptors = new List<IDescriptorAndDataControlBase>();
			TreeBuilder.View.Grid.MasterDetailProvider.GetDetailDescriptors(TreeBuilder, TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value).ForEach(delegate(DataControlDetailDescriptor descr)
			{
				descriptors.Add(TreeBuilder.MasterDetailPrintInfo.RootPrintingDataTreeBuilder.GetDescriptorAndGridControl(descr));
			});
			details = new List<DataControlBase>();
			foreach (IDescriptorAndDataControlBase item in descriptors)
			{
				DataControlBase dataControlBase = MasterDetailPrintHelper.FindDetailDataControl(TreeBuilder, TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value, (DataControlDetailDescriptor)item.Descriptor);
				if (dataControlBase == null || !((TableView)dataControlBase.viewCore).PrintSelectedRowsOnly)
				{
					dataControlBase = item.GetDetailGridControl(TreeBuilder);
				}
				if (MasterDetailPrintHelper.IsDetailContainsRows(TreeBuilder, TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value, dataControlBase) || CanPrintEmptyDetails(dataControlBase))
				{
					details.Add(dataControlBase);
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetPrintDeailsLimit()
		{
			if (details == null || !TreeBuilder.GetPrintAllDetailsValue())
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return details.Count - 1;
		}

		private bool IsMasterRowExpanded()
		{
			return MasterDetailPrintHelper.IsMasterRowExpanded(TreeBuilder, TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.RowHandle.Value);
		}

		private bool CanPrintEmptyDetails(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (!TreeBuilder.GetAllowPrintEmptyDetailsValue())
			{
				return false;
			}
			TableView view = (TableView)((GridControl)dataControl).View;
			return TreeBuilder.IsGridHeaderFooterVisible(view);
		}

		protected override IDataNode GetChildCore(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0 && printStub)
			{
				return (IDataNode)(object)new StubNode(TreeBuilder, (IDataNode)(object)this, 0);
			}
			UpdateReusingRowData();
			if (!TreeBuilder.GetPrintAllDetailsValue())
			{
				return GetDetailPrintNode((TableView)detailDataControl.viewCore, PrintDetailType.Last);
			}
			return GetDetailPrintNode((TableView)details[index].DataView, (index != details.Count - 1) ? PrintDetailType.None : PrintDetailType.Last);
		}

		private IDataNode GetDetailPrintNode(TableView view, PrintDetailType printDetailType)
		{
			double totalIndent = 0.0;
			DataControlBase originationDataControl = TreeBuilder.View.DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl();
			originationDataControl.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate
			{
				totalIndent += view.PrintRowIndentWidth;
			});
			totalIndent += (double)TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData.Level * view.PrintRowIndentWidth;
			IRootDataNode val = GridPrintingHelper.CreatePrintingTreeNode(view, new System.Windows.Size(pageSize.Width - totalIndent, pageSize.Height), PrintLayoutAssigner.Printing, MasterDetailPrintHelper.GetInheritedPrintInfo(view, TreeBuilder, printDetailType));
			return ((IDataNode)val).GetChild(-1);
		}
	}
	public class GridDetailPrintingNode : GridPrintingNodeBase, IVisualDetailNode, IDataNode
	{
		protected readonly RowNode rowNode;

		private readonly NodeContainer parentContainer;

		protected override bool IsDetailContainerCore => false;

		public GridDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer parentContainer, RowNode rowNode, PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase treeBuilder, IDataNode parent, int index)
			: base(treeBuilder, parent, index)
		{
			this.rowNode = rowNode;
			this.parentContainer = parentContainer;
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualDetailNode.GetDetail(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			PrintingNodeHelper.UpdateRowData(base.TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData, parentContainer, rowNode);
			return CreateRowElement(base.TreeBuilder.ReusingRowData, base.TreeBuilder.PrintRowTemplate);
		}

		protected override IDataNode GetChildCore(int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override bool CanGetChildCore(int index)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class GridGroupPrintingNode : GridContainerPrintingNodeBase, IVisualGroupNode, IGroupNode, IDataNode
	{
		protected readonly GroupNode groupNode;

		protected readonly NodeContainer parentContainer;

		protected internal GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder GridTreeBuilder => base.TreeBuilder as GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder;

		GroupUnion IGroupNode.Union => (GroupUnion)2;

		bool IGroupNode.RepeatHeaderEveryPage => true;

		public GridGroupPrintingNode(NodeContainer parentContainer, GroupNode groupNode, GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, IDataNode parent, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
			: base(groupNode.NodesContainer, treeBuilder, parent, index, pageSize)
		{
			this.groupNode = groupNode;
			this.parentContainer = parentContainer;
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualGroupNode.GetFooter(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			return null;
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualGroupNode.GetHeader(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			GridTreeBuilder.reusingGroupRowData.AssignFromInternal(null, parentContainer, groupNode, forceUpdate: true);
			return CreateRowElement(GridTreeBuilder.reusingGroupRowData, GridTreeBuilder.PrintGroupRowTemplate);
		}

		protected override bool CanGetChildCore(int index)
		{
			if (0 <= index && index < nodeContainer.Items.Count && (!(nodeContainer.Items[index] is DataRowNode dataRowNode) || dataRowNode.RowHandle.Value != -2147483647))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class GridGroupSummaryPrintingNode : GridGroupPrintingNode, IVisualGroupNode, IGroupNode, IDataNode
	{
		private GroupSummaryRowNode SummaryRowNode => groupNode as GroupSummaryRowNode;

		public GridGroupSummaryPrintingNode(NodeContainer parentContainer, GroupNode groupNode, GridPrintingDataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, IDataNode parent, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize)

		}

			return CreateRowElement(groupSummaryRowData, base.GridTreeBuilder.PrintGroupFooterTemplate);
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualGroupNode.GetHeader(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool CanGetChildCore(int index)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.GroupRowLayout
{
	public interface IGroupPanelItemOwner
	{
		void Connect(Column column);

		void Disconnect(Column column);
	}
	public interface IGroupPanelItem
	{
		IGroupPanelItemOwner Parent { get; set; }

		int Index { get; set; }

		void OnItemOwnerReplaced(IGroupPanelItemOwner oldValue);
	}
	public class GroupPanelVisualItemOwner : IGroupPanelItemOwner
	{
		private readonly System.Windows.Controls.Panel panelCore;

		public System.Windows.Controls.Panel Panel => panelCore;

		private UIElementCollection Children => Panel.Children;

		public GroupPanelVisualItemOwner(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel)
		{
			panelCore = panel;
		}

		void IGroupPanelItemOwner.Connect(Column column)
		{
			Children.Add(column.Element);
		}

		void IGroupPanelItemOwner.Disconnect(Column column)
		{
			Children.Remove(column.Element);
		}
	}
	public abstract class GroupPanelItemContainer<T> : IGroupPanelItem, IGroupPanelItemOwner, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : IGroupPanelItem
	{
		private SortedList<int, T> children = new SortedList<int, T>();

		private IGroupPanelItemOwner ownerCore;

		public int Count => children.Count;

		public IGroupPanelItemOwner Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return ownerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ownerCore != value)
				{
					IGroupPanelItemOwner oldValue = ownerCore;
					ownerCore = value;
					OnItemOwnerReplaced(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Index { get; set; }

		public void Add(T child, int index)
		{
			child.Index = index;
			children.Add(child.Index, child);
			child.Parent = this;
		}

		public void Remove(int index)
		{
			T val = Get(index);
			if (children != null)
			{
				val.Index = 0;
				children.Remove(index);
				val.Parent = null;
			}
		}

		public T Get(int index)
		{
			T value = default(T);
			children.TryGetValue(index, out value);
			return value;
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumeratorCore();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumeratorCore();
		}

		private IEnumerator<T> GetEnumeratorCore()
		{
			return children.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void OnItemOwnerReplaced(IGroupPanelItemOwner oldValue)
		{
			foreach (T item in (IEnumerable<T>)this)
			{
				IGroupPanelItem groupPanelItem = item;
				groupPanelItem.OnItemOwnerReplaced(oldValue);
			}
		}

		void IGroupPanelItemOwner.Connect(Column column)
		{
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				Parent.Connect(column);
			}
		}

		void IGroupPanelItemOwner.Disconnect(Column column)
		{
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				Parent.Disconnect(column);
			}
		}
	}
	public class GroupContainer : GroupPanelItemContainer<Group>
	{
		public Column Get(IndexDefinition index)
		{
			return GetLayer(index).Return((Layer l) => l.Get(index.Column), () => (Column)null);
		}

		public void Add(Column column, IndexDefinition index)
		{
			GetLayer(index).Do(delegate(Layer l)
			{
				l.Add(column, index.Column);
			});
		}

		public void Remove(IndexDefinition index)
		{
			GetLayer(index).Do(delegate(Layer l)
			{
				l.Remove(index.Column);
			});
		}

		private Layer GetLayer(IndexDefinition index)
		{
			return Get(index.Group).Return((Group g) => g.Get(index.Layer), () => (Layer)null);
		}
	}
	public class Group : GroupPanelItemContainer<Layer>
	{
		public bool DockToRight { get; set; }
	}
	public class Layer : GroupPanelItemContainer<Column>
	{
		public void Add(UIElement element, int index)
		{
			Add(new Column(element), index);
		}
	}
	public class Column : IGroupPanelItem
	{
		private readonly UIElement elementCore;

		private IGroupPanelItemOwner ownerCore;

		public UIElement Element => elementCore;

		public IGroupPanelItemOwner Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return ownerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ownerCore != value)
				{
					IGroupPanelItemOwner oldValue = ownerCore;
					ownerCore = value;
					OnItemOwnerReplaced(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Index { get; set; }

		public Column(UIElement element)
		{
			elementCore = element;
		}

		public void OnItemOwnerReplaced(IGroupPanelItemOwner oldValue)
		{
			oldValue?.Disconnect(this);
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				Parent.Connect(this);
			}
		}
	}
	public struct IndexDefinition
	{
		private readonly int group;

		private readonly int layer;

		private readonly int column;

		public int Group => group;

		public int Layer => layer;

		public int Column => column;

		public IndexDefinition(int group, int layer, int column)
		{
			this.group = group;
			this.layer = layer;
			this.column = column;
		}
	}
}

	public class FixedLeftDivTableViewHitTestAcceptor : TableViewHitTestAcceptorBase
	{

	public class BaseGridColumnData : BaseFilterData
	{
		private readonly GridControl grid;

		protected DataProviderBase DataProvider => grid.DataProviderBase;

		protected GridControl Grid => grid;

		protected DataViewBase View => Grid.DataView;

		public override int GroupCount => Grid.ActualGroupCount;

		public override int SortCount => Grid.ActualSortInfo.Count;

		public BaseGridColumnData(GridControl grid)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
		}

		protected override void OnFillColumns()
		{
			foreach (GridColumn item in (Collection<GridColumn>)(object)Grid.Columns)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val = DataProvider.Columns[item.FieldName];
				if (val != null)
				{
					GridDataColumnInfo gridDataColumnInfo = CreateColumnInfo(item);
					if (((BaseGridColumnInfo)gridDataColumnInfo).Required)
					{
						((BaseFilterData)this).Columns[((BaseFilterData)this).GetKey(val)] = (BaseGridColumnInfo)(object)gridDataColumnInfo;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual GridDataColumnInfo CreateColumnInfo(GridColumn column)
		{
			return new GridDataColumnInfo(this, column);
		}

		public override int GetSortIndex(object column)
		{
			GridColumn gridColumn = column as GridColumn;
			return Grid.ActualSortInfo.IndexOf(grid.ActualSortInfo[gridColumn.FieldName]);
		}

		protected internal void RaiseCustomSort(CustomColumnSortEventArgs e)
		{
			Grid.RaiseCustomColumnSort(e);
		}

		internal ICommand<RowSortArgs> GetCustomSortCommand()
		{
			return Grid.GetCustomColumnSortCommand();
		}

		protected internal void RaiseCustomGroup(CustomColumnSortEventArgs e)
		{
			Grid.RaiseCustomColumnGroup(e);
		}

		internal ICommand<RowSortArgs> GetCustomGroupCommand()
		{
			return Grid.GetCustomColumnGroupCommand();
		}

		protected internal string GetColumnDisplayText(int listSourceRowIndex, GridColumn column, object value)
		{
			object displayObject = View.GetDisplayObject(value, column);
			return Grid.RaiseCustomDisplayText(null, listSourceRowIndex, column, value, (displayObject != null) ? displayObject.ToString() : string.Empty);
		}

		internal object GetRowByListSourceIndex(int listSourceIndex)
		{
			return grid.GetRowByListIndex(listSourceIndex);
		}
	}

	public class GridDataColumnInfo : BaseGridColumnInfo
	{
		private readonly CustomColumnSortEventArgs sortArgs;

		private readonly RowSortArgs sortCommandArgs;

		protected BaseGridColumnData Data => ((BaseGridColumnInfo)this).Data as BaseGridColumnData;

		protected CustomColumnSortEventArgs SortArgs => sortArgs;

		public GridColumn Column => ((BaseGridColumnInfo)this).Column as GridColumn;

		public GridDataColumnInfo(BaseGridColumnData data, GridColumn column)
			: base((BaseFilterData)(object)data, (object)column)
		{
			sortArgs = new CustomColumnSortEventArgs(column, -1, -1, null, null, (ColumnSortOrder)1);
			sortCommandArgs = ArgsMutator.CreateRowSortArgs(data.GetRowByListSourceIndex);
		}

		public override string GetDisplayText(int listSourceIndex, object val)
		{
			return Data.GetColumnDisplayText(listSourceIndex, Column, val);
		}

		protected override int? RaiseCustomGroup(int listSourceRow1, int listSourceRow2, object value1, object value2, ColumnSortOrder columnSortOrder)
		{
			SortArgs.SetArgs(listSourceRow1, listSourceRow2, value1, value2, (ColumnSortOrder)0);
			Data.RaiseCustomGroup(SortArgs);
			int? result = SortArgs.GetSortResult();
			if (!result.HasValue)
			{
				ICommand<RowSortArgs> customGroupCommand = Data.GetCustomGroupCommand();
				if (customGroupCommand != null)
				{
					ArgsMutator.SetRowSortArgs(sortCommandArgs, Column.FieldName, listSourceRow1, listSourceRow2, value1, value2, ToSortOrder((ColumnSortOrder)0));
					customGroupCommand.Execute(sortCommandArgs);
					result = sortCommandArgs.Result;
					ArgsMutator.ClearRowSortArgs(sortCommandArgs);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder ToSortOrder(ColumnSortOrder columnSortOrder)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)columnSortOrder switch
			{
				1 => DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder.Ascending, 
				2 => DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder.Descending, 
				0 => DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.SortOrder.None, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		protected override int? RaiseCustomSort(int listSourceRow1, int listSourceRow2, object value1, object value2, ColumnSortOrder sortOrder)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SortArgs.SetArgs(listSourceRow1, listSourceRow2, value1, value2, sortOrder);
			Data.RaiseCustomSort(SortArgs);
			int? result = SortArgs.GetSortResult();
			if (!result.HasValue)
			{
				ICommand<RowSortArgs> customSortCommand = Data.GetCustomSortCommand();
				if (customSortCommand != null)
				{
					ArgsMutator.SetRowSortArgs(sortCommandArgs, Column.FieldName, listSourceRow1, listSourceRow2, value1, value2, ToSortOrder(sortOrder));
					customSortCommand.Execute(sortCommandArgs);
					result = sortCommandArgs.Result;
					ArgsMutator.ClearRowSortArgs(sortCommandArgs);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

				if (((BaseGridColumnInfo)this).Required)

				if ((int)((BaseGridColumnInfo)this).GroupInterval != 0 && (int)((BaseGridColumnInfo)this).GroupInterval != 1)

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.Filtering

	public static class DateColumnFilterInfoHelper
	{
		public static ColumnFilterInfoBase CreateDateColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
		{
			bool flag = DateFiltersHelper.IsDateColumn(column.FieldType);
			if (CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyColumnFilterPopup && flag)
			{
				DataControlBase ownerControl = column.OwnerControl;
				if (ownerControl != null && ownerControl.IsWcfSource())
				{
					return new DateCompactColumnFilterInfo(column);
				}
			}
			switch (column.FilterPopupMode)
			{
			case FilterPopupMode.DateAlt:
				return new DateAltColumnFilterInfo(column);
			case FilterPopupMode.Date:
				return new DateColumnFilterInfo(column);
			case FilterPopupMode.DateCompact:
				return new DateCompactColumnFilterInfo(column);
			case FilterPopupMode.DateSmart:
				return new DateSmartColumnFilterInfo(column);
			case FilterPopupMode.Excel:
				if (!flag || column.ColumnFilterMode != ColumnFilterMode.Value)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo(column);
			case FilterPopupMode.Default:
				if (!flag)
				{
					return null;
				}
				switch (column.View?.ColumnFilterPopupMode ?? ColumnFilterPopupMode.Default)
				{
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.Disabled:
					return new DisabledFilterInfo(column);
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.Default:
					if (!CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyColumnFilterPopup)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return new DateSmartColumnFilterInfo(column);
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.Excel:
					if (column.ColumnFilterMode != ColumnFilterMode.Value)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return new ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo(column);
				default:
					return null;
				}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DateFilterCache
	{
		private class DTDescriptor : CriteriaCompilerDescriptor
		{
			private readonly string PropertyName;

			public override Type ObjectType => typeof(DateTime);

			public DTDescriptor(string propertyName)
			{
				PropertyName = propertyName;
			}

			public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression MakePropertyAccess(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression baseExpression, string propertyPath)
			{
				if (propertyPath == PropertyName)
				{
					return baseExpression;
				}
				return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(null);
			}
		}

		private readonly DataControlBase grid;

		private readonly ColumnBase column;

		private object[] values;

		public DateFilterCache(DataControlBase grid, ColumnBase column)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
			this.column = column;
		}

		public bool IsFilterVisibleForColumn(FilterData filter)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				values = grid.GetUniqueColumnValues(column, includeFilteredOut: true, roundDateTime: false, filter.Criteria);
			}
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0 || AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(values[0]))
			{
				return true;
			}
			Func<DateTime, bool> predicate = CompileToPredicate(filter);
			return values.AsParallel().Any((object x) => x is DateTime && predicate((DateTime)x));
		}

		public void UpdateValuesForColumn(object[] values)
		{
			this.values = values;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			values = null;
		}

		private Func<DateTime, bool> CompileToPredicate(FilterData filter)
		{
			if (filter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CriteriaCompiler.ToPredicate<DateTime>(filter.Criteria, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)new DTDescriptor(column.FieldName));
		}
	}
	public class FilterData : IEquatable<FilterData>
	{
		public static FilterData Null => new FilterData(string.Empty, null, string.Empty, FilterDateType.None);

		public string Caption { get; private set; }

		public CriteriaOperator Criteria { get; private set; }

		public string Tooltip { get; private set; }

		public FilterDateType FilterType { get; private set; }

		public FilterData(string caption, CriteriaOperator criteria, string tooltip, FilterDateType filterType)
		{
			Caption = caption;
			Criteria = criteria;
			Tooltip = tooltip;
			FilterType = filterType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is FilterData other))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public bool Equals(FilterData other)
		{
			if (Caption == other.Caption && CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(Criteria, other.Criteria) && Tooltip == other.Tooltip)
			{
				return FilterType == other.FilterType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return FilterType.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class FilterFactory
	{
		private class FilterNames
		{
			private static readonly Dictionary<FilterDateType, GridControlStringId> TypeToStringIdMap;

			private static readonly Dictionary<FilterDateType, string> TypeToNameMap;

			private readonly DataControlBase grid;

			private DataViewBase View => grid.viewCore;

			public string this[FilterDateType type] => GetName(type);

			static FilterNames()
			{
				TypeToStringIdMap = new Dictionary<FilterDateType, GridControlStringId>
				{
					{

						GridControlStringId.DateFiltering_BeyondThisYearFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.Earlier,
						GridControlStringId.DateFiltering_EarlierFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.ThisMonth,
						GridControlStringId.DateFiltering_ThisMonthFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.ThisWeek,
						GridControlStringId.DateFiltering_ThisWeekFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.Beyond,
						GridControlStringId.DateFiltering_BeyondFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.Empty,
						GridControlStringId.DateFiltering_EmptyFilterName
					}
				};
				TypeToNameMap = new Dictionary<FilterDateType, string>
				{
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAgo6,
						DateFiltersHelper.SixMonthsAgoFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAgo5,
						DateFiltersHelper.FiveMonthsAgoFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAgo4,
						DateFiltersHelper.FourMonthsAgoFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAgo3,
						DateFiltersHelper.ThreeMonthsAgoFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAgo2,
						DateFiltersHelper.TwoMonthsAgoFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAgo1,
						DateFiltersHelper.MonthAgoFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAfter1,
						DateFiltersHelper.MonthAfterFilterName
					},
					{
						FilterDateType.MonthAfter2,
						DateFiltersHelper.TwoMonthsAfterFilterName
					}
				};
			}

			public FilterNames(DataControlBase grid)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)grid, "grid");
				this.grid = grid;
			}

			public string GetName(FilterDateType type)
			{
				if (View == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (TypeToNameMap.ContainsKey(type))
				{
					return TypeToNameMap[type];
				}
				if (!TypeToStringIdMap.ContainsKey(type))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				GridControlStringId id = TypeToStringIdMap[type];
				string localizedString = View.GetLocalizedString(id);
				TypeToNameMap[type] = localizedString;
				return localizedString;
			}
		}

		private readonly DataControlBase grid;

		private readonly string fieldName;

		private readonly OperandProperty property;

		private readonly FilterNames filterNamesMap;

		public FilterFactory(DataControlBase grid, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)grid, "grid");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldName, "fieldName");
			this.grid = grid;
			this.fieldName = fieldName;
			property = new OperandProperty(fieldName);
			filterNamesMap = new FilterNames(grid);
		}

		public FilterData CreateNoneData()
		{
			string name = GetName(FilterDateType.None);
			return new FilterData(name, null, string.Empty, FilterDateType.None);
		}

		public FilterData CreateEmptyData()
		{
			return CreateFilter(FilterDateType.Empty);
		}

		public FilterData CreateSpecificDateData()
		{
			string name = GetName(FilterDateType.SpecificDate);
			return new FilterData(name, null, string.Empty, FilterDateType.SpecificDate);
		}

		public FilterData CreateFilter(FilterDateType type)
		{
			string name = GetName(type);
			CriteriaOperator criteria = GetCriteria(type);
			string tooltip = GetTooltip(type, criteria);
			return new FilterData(name, criteria, tooltip, type);
		}

		private string GetName(FilterDateType type)
		{
			return filterNamesMap[type];
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetCriteria(FilterDateType type)
		{
			if (type == FilterDateType.None)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FilterDateType[1] { type }.ToCriteria(fieldName);
		}

		private string GetTooltip(FilterDateType type, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (!type.IsFilterValid())
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = criteria.ExpandDates();
			CriteriaOperatorInfo infoFromCriteriaOperator = grid.GetInfoFromCriteriaOperator(criteriaOperator);
			return infoFromCriteriaOperator.FilterText;
		}
	}
	public static class FilterFactoryExtensions
	{
		public static FilterData[] CreateFilters(this FilterFactory factory, params FilterDateType[] filters)
		{
			return filters.Select((FilterDateType x) => factory.CreateFilter(x)).ToArray();

		{
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(view, HitTestFilterCallback, HitTestResultCallback, new PointHitTestParameters(point));
			return hitTestResult;
		}

		private HitTestResultBehavior HitTestResultCallback(HitTestResult result)
		{
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
		}

		private HitTestFilterBehavior HitTestFilterCallback(DependencyObject potentialHitTestTarget)
		{
			if (potentialHitTestTarget is FrameworkElement && !((FrameworkElement)potentialHitTestTarget).IsVisible)
			{
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
			}
			if (potentialHitTestTarget is BaseGridHeader)
			{
				hitTestResult = (BaseGridHeader)potentialHitTestTarget;
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Stop;
			}
			return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
		}

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserDropTarget : IDropTarget
	{
		private readonly ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView view;

		private readonly ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel viewModel;

		private Popup dragAdorner;

		private IExtendedColumnChooserColumnHeader specificHeader;

		protected internal UIElement DragIndicator
		{
			get
			{
				if (dragAdorner == null || !(dragAdorner.Child is StackPanel))
				{
					return null;
				}
				StackPanel stackPanel = (StackPanel)dragAdorner.Child;
				if (stackPanel.Children == null || stackPanel.Children.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return stackPanel.Children[0];
			}
		}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserDropTarget(ExtendedColumnChooserTreeListView view, ExtendedColumnChooserViewModel viewModel)
		{
			this.view = view;
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
		}

		public void OnDragOver(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			UpdateDragAdorner(source, pt);
			view.StartUpdateScrollPosition();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateDragAdorner(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(source is BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader))
			{
				DestroyDragAdorner();
				return;
			}
			BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader2 = ExtendedColumnChooserHitTestHelper.FindHeaderElement(view, pt);
			if (baseGridHeader2 == null)
			{
				DestroyDragAdorner();
				return;
			}
			DropPosition? val = viewModel.DragDropManager.ProcessDrag(baseGridHeader.BaseColumn, baseGridHeader2.BaseColumn, GetOffset(baseGridHeader2, pt), GetHeaderPresenterType(baseGridHeader));
			if (!val.HasValue)
			{
				DestroyDragAdorner();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateDragAdornerCore(baseGridHeader2, pt, val.Value);
			}
		}

		public void Drop(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			ProcessDrop(source, pt);
			view.EndUpdateScrollPosition();
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessDrop(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (source is BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader)
			{
				BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader2 = ExtendedColumnChooserHitTestHelper.FindHeaderElement(view, pt);
				if (baseGridHeader2 == null)
				{
					HideColumn(baseGridHeader);
				}
				else
				{
					viewModel.DragDropManager.ProcessDrop(baseGridHeader.BaseColumn, baseGridHeader2.BaseColumn, GetOffset(baseGridHeader2, pt), GetHeaderPresenterType(baseGridHeader));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void HideColumn(BaseGridHeader columnHeader)
		{
			viewModel.HideColumn(columnHeader.BaseColumn);
		}

		protected virtual HeaderPresenterType GetHeaderPresenterType(BaseGridHeader columnHeader)
		{
			if (BaseGridHeader.GetExtendedColumnChooserView(columnHeader) == null)
			{
				return GetCompatableHeaderPresenterType(columnHeader);
			}
			return HeaderPresenterType.Headers;
		}

		protected virtual HeaderPresenterType GetCompatableHeaderPresenterType(BaseGridHeader columnHeader)
		{
			if (!(columnHeader.BaseColumn is GridColumn gridColumn))
			{
				return ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(columnHeader);
			}
			if (gridColumn.OwnerControl != null && gridColumn.OwnerControl.DataControlOwner != null && gridColumn.OwnerControl.DataControlOwner.CanGroupColumn(gridColumn))
			{
				return ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(columnHeader);
			}
			return HeaderPresenterType.Headers;
		}

		private double GetOffset(BaseGridHeader columnHeader, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)columnHeader, (UIElement)view);
			pt = new System.Windows.Point(pt.X - relativeElementRect.Left, pt.Y - relativeElementRect.Top);
			return pt.Y / columnHeader.ActualHeight;
		}

		private void UpdateDragAdornerCore(BaseGridHeader headerElement, System.Windows.Point pt, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (specificHeader != null)
			{
				specificHeader.IsDragOver = false;
			}
			if ((int)position == 3)
			{
				DestroyDragAdorner();
				specificHeader = headerElement as IExtendedColumnChooserColumnHeader;
				if (specificHeader != null)
				{
					specificHeader.IsDragOver = (int)position == 3;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (dragAdorner == null)
				{
					CreateDragIndicatorAdorner(headerElement);
				}
				UpdatePopupLocation(headerElement, pt, position);
			}
		}

		private void CreateDragIndicatorAdorner(BaseGridHeader sourceElement)
		{
			StackPanel stackPanel = new StackPanel
			{
				Margin = new Thickness(20.0, 20.0, 20.0, 0.0)
			};
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = TemplateHelper.CreateBindedContentPresenter((object)sourceElement, ExtendedColumnChooserGridColumnHeader.DropMarkerTemplateProperty.Name, (object)null);
			contentPresenter.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			double value = (stackPanel.Height = sourceElement.RenderSize.Height);
			DataViewBase.SetColumnHeaderDragIndicatorSize(contentPresenter, value);
			BaseGridHeader.SetDropPlaceOrientation(contentPresenter, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal);
			stackPanel.Children.Add(contentPresenter);
			dragAdorner = new Popup
			{
				AllowsTransparency = true,
				PlacementTarget = view,
				Placement = PlacementMode.Relative,
				Child = stackPanel
			};
			PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(dragAdorner, true);
		}

		private void UpdatePopupLocation(BaseGridHeader sourceElement, System.Windows.Point location, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)sourceElement, (UIElement)view);
			dragAdorner.VerticalOffset = (((int)position == 1) ? relativeElementRect.Top : relativeElementRect.Bottom);
			dragAdorner.HorizontalOffset = relativeElementRect.Left;
		}

		public void OnDragLeave()
		{
			DestroyDragAdorner();
			view.StartUpdateScrollPosition();
		}

		protected virtual void DestroyDragAdorner()
		{
			if (specificHeader != null)
			{
				specificHeader.IsDragOver = false;
			}
			specificHeader = null;
			if (dragAdorner != null)
			{
				PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(dragAdorner, false);
				dragAdorner = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ClipboardPasteHelperBase<TCol, TRow> : IClipboardPasteHelper<TCol, TRow>, IClipboardPasteHelperBase where TCol : ColumnWrapper where TRow : class, IRowBase
	{
		public class GridPasteRowValues : Dictionary<ColumnBase, object>
		{
			public object this[string fieldName] => ObjectByFieldName(fieldName);

			private object ObjectByFieldName(string fieldName)
			{
				using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						KeyValuePair<ColumnBase, object> current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Key.FieldName == fieldName)
						{
							return current.Value;
						}
					}
				}
				throw new KeyNotFoundException();
			}
		}

		protected int dataRowCountCore;

		protected int rowCountCore;

		protected ITableView TableView;

		private int setRowCellValueInc;

		private bool simulateAppendMode;

		private int initialRowHandle = int.MinValue;

		private object[] OriginalCellValues;

		private int countCells;

		protected DataViewBase ViewBase
		{
			get
			{
				if (TableView == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TableView.ViewBase;
			}
		}

		protected DataControlBase DataControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (TableView == null || TableView.ViewBase == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TableView.ViewBase.DataControl;
			}
		}

		public PasteMode PasteMode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!simulateAppendMode)
				{
					return TableView.ActualPasteMode;
				}
				return (PasteMode)1;
			}
		}

		public bool IsPastingInProgress { get; private set; }

		public bool IsCancelPending => false;

		private int InitialRowHandle
		{
			get
			{
				if (initialRowHandle == int.MinValue)
				{
					SetInitialRowHandle();
				}
				return initialRowHandle;
			}
			set
			{
				initialRowHandle = value;
			}
		}

		protected abstract TRow CreateRow(int rowHandle);

		protected abstract void SetRowHandle(TRow row, int rowHandle);

		public ClipboardPasteHelperBase(ITableView view)
		{
			TableView = view;
		}

		public virtual void BeginUpdate(IClipboardData data = null)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			setRowCellValueInc = 0;
			IsPastingInProgress = true;
			simulateAppendMode = (int)TableView.ActualPasteMode == 3 && ViewBase.IsNewItemRowFocused;
			SetInitialRowHandle();
		}

		private void SetInitialRowHandle()
		{
			InitialRowHandle = (DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(ViewBase.FocusedRowHandle) ? DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetChildRowHandle(ViewBase.FocusedRowHandle, 0) : ViewBase.FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		public virtual void EndUpdate()
		{
			setRowCellValueInc = 0;
			IsPastingInProgress = false;
			simulateAppendMode = false;
			InitialRowHandle = int.MinValue;
		}

		private object GetOriginalCellValues(int idx)
		{
			if (OriginalCellValues == null || OriginalCellValues.Length <= idx)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return OriginalCellValues[idx];
		}

		public void ConvertIClipboardRowValue(TCol targetColumn, IClipboardRow row, int i)
		{
			if (i == 0)
			{
				OriginalCellValues = new object[row.Cells.Length];
				Array.Copy(row.Cells, OriginalCellValues, row.Cells.Length);
			}
			BaseEditSettings editSettings = targetColumn.Column.EditSettings;
			if (editSettings is LookUpEditSettingsBase)
			{
				if (!ClipboardEditSettingsConverter.TryConvertByRepItemLookUpEditBase((IColumn)(object)targetColumn, (LookUpEditSettingsBase)(object)((editSettings is LookUpEditSettingsBase) ? editSettings : null), row, i))
				{
					row.Cells[i] = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClipboardEditSettingsConverter.ConvertIClipboardRowValue((IColumn)(object)targetColumn, targetColumn.Column.EditSettings, row, i);
			}
		}

		public virtual TRow GetAppendRow(int clipboardRowPosition, TRow startRow)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable<TCol> GetGroupsColumn(TRow startRow)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public TRow GetStartRow()
		{
			setRowCellValueInc = 0;
			return CreateRow(InitialRowHandle);
		}

		public IEnumerable<TCol> GetTargetColumns(int clipboardColumnCount, TRow startRow)
		{
			int columnIndex = ((DataControl.CurrentColumn != null) ? DataControl.CurrentColumn.ActualVisibleIndex : 0);
			return from x in ViewBase.VisibleColumnsCore
				where x.ActualVisibleIndex >= columnIndex
				select new ColumnWrapper(x, x.ActualVisibleIndex) as TCol;
		}

		public virtual TRow GetUpdateRow(int clipboardRowPosition, TRow startRow)
		{
			return CreateRow(((IRowBase)startRow).LogicalPosition + clipboardRowPosition);
		}

		private string GetTextCaption(string header)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(header))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return header.Replace('\r', ' ').Replace("\n", "");
		}

		public bool IsCaptionRows(IClipboardRow row, IEnumerable<TCol> targetColumns)
		{
			if (row == null || targetColumns == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < row.Cells.Length && i < targetColumns.Count(); i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(targetColumns.ElementAt(i).Header, row.Cells[i]) && !object.Equals(GetTextCaption(targetColumns.ElementAt(i).Header), row.Cells[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsValidRow(IClipboardRow row, IEnumerable<TCol> targetColumns, int pasteRowIndex)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			bool isValid = true;
			Type[] cellTypes = row.GetCellTypes();
			for (int i = 0; i < cellTypes.Length && i < targetColumns.Count(); i++)
			{
				if (row.Cells[i] == null && GetOriginalCellValues(i) != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetOriginalCellValues(i).ToString()))
				{
					isValid = false;
					stringBuilder.AppendLine($"Value [{GetOriginalCellValues(i)}] is invalid for <{targetColumns.ElementAt(i).FieldName}>");
				}
				else if (!ClipboardEditSettingsConverter.CanConvert(cellTypes[i], targetColumns.ElementAt(i).ColumnType, row.Cells[i]))
				{
					isValid = false;
					stringBuilder.AppendLine($"Type [{cellTypes[i]}] is invalid for <{targetColumns.ElementAt(i).FieldName}> of type [{targetColumns.ElementAt(i).ColumnType}].");
				}
			}
			int rowHandle = (ViewBase.IsNewItemRowHandle(InitialRowHandle) ? InitialRowHandle : (InitialRowHandle + pasteRowIndex));
			ClipboardRowPastingEventArgs e = new ClipboardRowPastingEventArgs(row, targetColumns.Select((TCol val) => val.Column).ToArray(), stringBuilder.ToString(), isValid, rowHandle, OriginalCellValues, dataRowCountCore, rowCountCore);
			TableView.RaiseClipboardRowPasting(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		public void SelectPastedRows(List<TRow> updatedRows, IEnumerable<TCol> targetColumns, int clipboardColumnCount)
		{
			if (updatedRows.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!ViewBase.IsMultiSelection)
			{
				ViewBase.SelectRowCore(DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowHandleByListIndex(((IRowBase)updatedRows.Last()).LogicalPosition));
				return;
			}
			ViewBase.ClearSelectionCore();
			ViewBase.BeginSelectionCore();
			try
			{
				if (ViewBase.IsMultiCellSelection)
				{
					ColumnBase column = targetColumns.ElementAt(0).Column;
					{
						foreach (TRow updatedRow in updatedRows)
						{
							int index = column.ActualVisibleIndex + Math.Min(targetColumns.Count(), clipboardColumnCount) - 1;
							TableView.SelectCells(((IRowBase)updatedRow).LogicalPosition, column, ((IRowBase)updatedRow).LogicalPosition, ViewBase.VisibleColumnsCore[index]);
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				foreach (TRow updatedRow2 in updatedRows)
				{
					ViewBase.SelectRowCore(((IRowBase)updatedRow2).LogicalPosition);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ViewBase.EndSelectionCore();
			}
		}

		public void SetRowCellValue(TRow rowBase, TCol col, object rowCellValue, RowPasteMode rowPasteMode)
		{
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00e1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ClipboardRowCellValuePastingEventArgs e = new ClipboardRowCellValuePastingEventArgs(((IRowBase)rowBase).LogicalPosition, col.Column, rowCellValue, GetOriginalCellValues(setRowCellValueInc));
			setRowCellValueInc++;
			TableView.RaiseClipboardRowCellValuePasting(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = (int)PasteMode == 1;
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = !e.Column.ReadOnly && e.Column.GetAllowEditing();
				if (flag)
				{
					CellEditor cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn = DataControl.viewCore.GetCellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn(e.RowHandle, e.Column);
					flag = cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn == null || (!cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn.GetIsReadOnly() && ((UIElement)(object)cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn).IsEnabled);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				DataControl.SetCellValueCore(e.RowHandle, e.Column.FieldName, e.Value);
				if (e.RowHandle == -2147483647 && (int)PasteMode == 1 && countCells == setRowCellValueInc)
				{
					ViewBase.ErrorWatch.RemoveNewItemRowHandle();
					ViewBase.CommitEditingInternal();
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetRowCellValueFromGroupColumn(TRow rowBase, TCol groupColumn, TRow startRow)
		{
			DataControl.SetCellValueCore(((IRowBase)rowBase).LogicalPosition, groupColumn.Column.FieldName, DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetGroupRowValue(((IRowBase)startRow).LogicalPosition, groupColumn.Column));
		}

		public void UpdateRowAfterPaste(TRow rowBase)
		{
			bool flag = ((IRowBase)rowBase).LogicalPosition == -2147483647;
			ViewBase.UpdateFocusedRowData();
			if (flag)
			{
				SetRowHandle(rowBase, ViewBase.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
		}

		public TRow TryGetPasteRow(IClipboardRow row, IEnumerable<TCol> targetColumns, int pasteRowColumnCount, int pasteRowIndex, out PasteRow<TCol> pasteRow)
		{
			countCells = 0;
			GridPasteRowValues gridPasteRowValues = new GridPasteRowValues();
			for (int i = 0; i < pasteRowColumnCount && i < targetColumns.Count(); i++)
			{
				gridPasteRowValues.Add(targetColumns.ElementAt(i).Column, (row.Cells.Count() > i) ? row.Cells[i] : null);
			}
			if (!IsValidRow(row, targetColumns, pasteRowIndex))
			{
				pasteRow = null;
				return null;
			}
			List<PasteCellValue<TCol>> list = new List<PasteCellValue<TCol>>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ColumnBase, object> item in gridPasteRowValues)
			{
				countCells++;
				list.Add(new PasteCellValue<TCol>
				{
					Column = targetColumns.First((TCol e) => e.Column == item.Key),
					Value = item.Value
				});
			}
			pasteRow = new PasteRow<TCol>((IEnumerable<PasteCellValue<TCol>>)list);
			return GetNewRow(pasteRowIndex, this);
		}

		bool IClipboardPasteHelperBase.ClipboardContainsData(ClipboardSourceType sourceType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)sourceType)
			{
			case 0:
				if (!SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.ContainsData("Biff8"))
				{
					return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.GetData("Biff8") is MemoryStream;
				}
				return true;
			case 1:
				if (SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.ContainsData(System.Windows.DataFormats.CommaSeparatedValue))
				{
					return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.CommaSeparatedValue) is MemoryStream;
				}
				return false;
			case 2:
				return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.ContainsData("XML Spreadsheet");
			case 3:
				return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.ContainsData(System.Windows.DataFormats.UnicodeText);
			case 4:
				return SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.ContainsData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				0 => SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.GetData("Biff8"), 
				1 => SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.CommaSeparatedValue), 
				2 => SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.GetData("XML Spreadsheet"),

				4 => SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text), 
				_ => null,

	internal static class ClipboardEditSettingsConverter
	{
		private static bool TypeOrUnderlyingTypeEquals(Type checkType, Type matchType)
		{
			if (!(checkType == matchType))
			{
				return Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(checkType) == matchType;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CanChangeType(Type to, object rowCellValue)
		{
			try
			{
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(to);
				if (underlyingType != null)
				{
					if (rowCellValue == null)
					{
						return true;
					}
					to = underlyingType;
				}
				if (to.IsEnum && rowCellValue != null)
				{
					object obj = Enum.Parse(to, rowCellValue.ToString());
					if (obj != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (!to.IsEnum && (rowCellValue == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(rowCellValue.ToString())))
				{
					return true;
				}
				Convert.ChangeType(rowCellValue, to);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CanConvert(Type from, Type to, object rowCellValue)
		{
			if (from == to)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (to.IsAssignableFrom(from))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CanChangeType(to, rowCellValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (from == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<MemberInfo> source = from m in @from.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public)
				where m.ReturnType == to && (m.Name == "op_Implicit" || m.Name == "op_Explicit")
				select m;
			return source.Count() > 0;
		}

		public static void ConvertIClipboardRowValue(IColumn iColumn, BaseEditSettings editSettings, IClipboardRow clipboardRow, int i)
		{
			Type[] cellTypes = clipboardRow.GetCellTypes();
			if (i < cellTypes.Length && !(iColumn.ColumnType == cellTypes[i]))
			{
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(iColumn.ColumnType);
				if ((!(underlyingType != null) || clipboardRow.Cells[i] == null || !underlyingType.IsEnum || !underlyingType.IsEnumDefined(clipboardRow.Cells[i])) && !(cellTypes[i] == null) && (!(cellTypes[i] == typeof(string)) || !TryConvertByRepItemCheckEdit(iColumn, (CheckEditSettings)(object)((editSettings is CheckEditSettings) ? editSettings : null), clipboardRow, i)) && iColumn.ColumnType != typeof(string) && (clipboardRow.Cells[i] == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(clipboardRow.Cells[i].ToString())))
				{
					clipboardRow.Cells[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private static object GetValueByDisplayText(LookUpEditSettingsBase editSetting, object displayTextObject)
		{
			if (displayTextObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = displayTextObject.ToString();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = editSetting.ItemsSource as IEnumerable;
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				if (!(editSetting.ItemsSource is IListSource listSource))
				{
					return null;
				}
				enumerable = listSource.GetList();
				if (enumerable == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (enumerable is IListServer || enumerable is IAsyncListServer)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				object valueFromItem = editSetting.GetValueFromItem(item);
				string displayTextFromEditor = ((BaseEditSettings)editSetting).GetDisplayTextFromEditor(valueFromItem);
				if (displayTextFromEditor == text)
				{
					return valueFromItem;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool TryConvertByRepItemLookUpEditBase(IColumn columnImplementer, LookUpEditSettingsBase editSettings, IClipboardRow clipboardRow, int i)
		{
			if (editSettings == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(editSettings.ValueMember) && TypeOrUnderlyingTypeEquals(columnImplementer.ColumnType, (clipboardRow.Cells[i] != null) ? clipboardRow.Cells[i].GetType() : null) && ((BaseEditSettings)editSettings).NullText != null && ((BaseEditSettings)editSettings).NullText != clipboardRow.Cells[i] as string)
			{
				return true;
			}
			object valueByDisplayText = GetValueByDisplayText(editSettings, clipboardRow.Cells[i]);
			if (valueByDisplayText != null && (TypeOrUnderlyingTypeEquals(columnImplementer.ColumnType, valueByDisplayText.GetType()) || columnImplementer.ColumnType.IsAssignableFrom(valueByDisplayText.GetType())))
			{
				clipboardRow.Cells[i] = valueByDisplayText;
				return true;
			}
			if (clipboardRow.Cells[i] is string && ((BaseEditSettings)editSettings).NullText == (string)clipboardRow.Cells[i])
			{
				clipboardRow.Cells[i] = null;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryConvertByRepItemCheckEdit(IColumn columnImplementer, CheckEditSettings editSettings, IClipboardRow clipboardRow, int i)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CheckEditSettings val = editSettings;
			if (editSettings == null)
			{
				if (columnImplementer == null || (int)columnImplementer.ColEditType != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				val = new CheckEditSettings();
			}
			if (clipboardRow.Cells[i] == null || clipboardRow.Cells[i].Equals(((BaseEditSettings)val).GetDisplayText((object)null, false)))
			{
				clipboardRow.Cells[i] = null;
				return true;
			}
			if (clipboardRow.Cells[i].Equals(((BaseEditSettings)val).GetDisplayText((object)true, false)))
			{
				clipboardRow.Cells[i] = true;
				return true;
			}
			if (clipboardRow.Cells[i].Equals(((BaseEditSettings)val).GetDisplayText((object)false, false)))
			{
				clipboardRow.Cells[i] = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
