		public abstract class ClipboardDataProviderBase : IClipboardDataProvider, IClipboardFormatted
		{
			protected IEnumerable<GridCell> Cells { get; private set; }

			protected ClipboardController Owner { get; private set; }

			public ClipboardDataProviderBase(IEnumerable<GridCell> cells, ClipboardController owner)
			{
				Cells = cells;
				Owner = owner;
			}

			public virtual object GetObjectFromClipboard()
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				int num = int.MinValue;
				foreach (GridCell cell in Cells)
				{
					if (num != cell.RowHandle)
					{
						num = cell.RowHandle;
						list.Add(num);
					}
				}
				return Owner.GetSelectedData(list);
			}

			public abstract string GetTextFromClipboard();

			int IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedCellsCount(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (Cells == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return Cells.Count();
			}

			IEnumerable<ColumnBase> IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedColumns(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (Cells == null)
				{
					return new List<ColumnBase>();
				}
				return Cells.Select((GridCell x) => x.ColumnCore).Distinct().ToList();
			}

			IEnumerable<int> IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedRows(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (Cells == null)
				{
					return new List<int>();
				}
				return Cells.Select((GridCell x) => x.RowHandle).Distinct().ToList();
			}

			bool IClipboardFormatted.IsSelect(int rowHanle, ColumnBase column, DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (column == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Cells.FirstOrDefault((GridCell x) => x.RowHandle == rowHanle && (x.RowHandle < 0 || x.ColumnCore.FieldName == column.FieldName)) != null;
			}
		}

		private class CellDetailHelper : IComparable<CellDetailHelper>, IComparable
		{
			private List<GridCell> _cells;

			public int VisibleIndex { get; set; }

			public List<GridCell> Cells
			{
				get
				{
					return _cells;
				}
				set
				{
					_cells = value;
				}
			}

			public DataViewBase View { get; set; }

			public StringBuilder GetString(bool withoutTabs, Dictionary<DataViewBase, ViewInfo> levelInfo, List<GridColumn> columns)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				if (Cells == null || Cells.Count == 0)
				{
					return stringBuilder;
				}
				GridCell cell = Cells.First();
				DataViewBase dataViewBase = ((cell.Column != null) ? cell.Column.View : cell.View);
				ViewInfo viewInfo = levelInfo[dataViewBase.IsRootView ? dataViewBase : dataViewBase.OriginationView];
				int num = viewInfo.DetailLevel + viewInfo.GroupLevel;
				bool flag = IsGroupRow(cell);
				if (flag)
				{
					num -= viewInfo.GroupLevel - ((GridControl)dataViewBase.DataControl).GetRowLevelByRowHandle(cell.RowHandle);
				}
				if (num > 0 && !withoutTabs)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('\t', num);
				}
				List<GridColumn> list = columns.Where((GridColumn x) => x.View == ((cell.Column != null) ? cell.Column.View : cell.View)).ToList();
				if (flag)
				{
					GridViewBase gridViewBase = dataViewBase as GridViewBase;
					stringBuilder.Append(gridViewBase.GetGroupRowDisplayText(cell.RowHandle));
				}
				else
				{
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < Cells.Count; num2++)
					{
						GridCell gridCell = Cells[num2];
						if (num2 == 0 && list[0] != cell.Column)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append('\t', list.IndexOf(cell.Column));
						}
						GridViewBase gridViewBase2 = gridCell.Column.View as GridViewBase;
						stringBuilder.Append(gridViewBase2.GetTextForClipboard(gridCell.RowHandle, gridViewBase2.VisibleColumns.IndexOf(gridCell.Column)));
						if (num2 != Cells.Count - 1)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append('\t');
						}
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder;
			}

			private bool IsGroupRow(GridCell cell)
			{
				return ((cell.Column != null) ? (cell.Column.View.DataControl as GridControl) : (cell.View.DataControl as GridControl))?.IsGroupRowHandle(cell.RowHandle) ?? false;
			}

			public int CompareTo(object obj)
			{
				return CompareTo(obj as CellDetailHelper);
			}

			public int CompareTo(CellDetailHelper other)
			{
				return VisibleIndex.CompareTo(other.VisibleIndex);
			}
		}

		internal string GetTextInRows(IEnumerable<GridCell> gridCells)
		{
			if (gridCells.Count() == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			List<CellDetailHelper> list = Init(gridCells);
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				CellDetailHelper cellDetailHelper = list[i];
				if (cellDetailHelper.View.ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders && ColumnsText != null && cellDetailHelper.View != dataViewBase)
				{
					StringBuilder value = null;
					dataViewBase = cellDetailHelper.View;
					ColumnsText.TryGetValue(dataViewBase as GridViewBase, out value);
					if (value != null)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(value);
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(cellDetailHelper.GetString(list.Count == 1 && list[0].View.IsRootView, LevelInfo, Columns));
				if (i != list.Count - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
				}
			}
			ColumnsText = null;
			LevelInfo = null;
			Columns = null;
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal Dictionary<object, StringBuilder> GetCopyTextRowInCells(IEnumerable<GridCell> gridCells)
		{
			Dictionary<object, StringBuilder> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, StringBuilder>();
			if (gridCells.Count() == 0)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			List<CellDetailHelper> list = Init(gridCells);
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				CellDetailHelper cellDetailHelper = list[i];
				if (cellDetailHelper.View.ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders && ColumnsText != null && cellDetailHelper.View != dataViewBase)
				{
					StringBuilder value = null;
					dataViewBase = cellDetailHelper.View;
					ColumnsText.TryGetValue(dataViewBase as GridViewBase, out value);
					if (value != null)
					{
						string text = value.ToString();
						if (text.EndsWith(Environment.NewLine))
						{
							dictionary.Add(cellDetailHelper.View, new StringBuilder(text.Substring(0, text.Length - Environment.NewLine.Length)));
						}
						else
						{
							dictionary.Add(cellDetailHelper.View, value);
						}
					}
				}
				dictionary.Add(cellDetailHelper.VisibleIndex, cellDetailHelper.GetString(list.Count == 1 && list[0].View.IsRootView, LevelInfo, Columns));
			}
			ColumnsText = null;
			LevelInfo = null;
			Columns = null;
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override string GetTextInRowsCore(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> actualRows, StringBuilder sb, List<DataControlBase> printableDataControls, int countCopyRows)
		{
			cellCopyHelper = new Dictionary<object, StringBuilder>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> actualRow in actualRows)
			{
				if (sb.Length > 0)
				{
					sb.Append(Environment.NewLine);
				}
				RowsClipboardController.AppendIndent(sb, actualRow, printableDataControls);
				actualRow.Key.DataView.GetDataRowText(sb, actualRow.Value);
			}
			if (countCopyRows == 0 && View.ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders)
			{
				GetHeadersText(sb);
			}
			cellCopyHelper = null;
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		private List<CellDetailHelper> Init(IEnumerable<GridCell> gridCells)
		{
			Dictionary<int, CellDetailHelper> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, CellDetailHelper>();
			LevelInfo = new Dictionary<DataViewBase, ViewInfo>();
			Dictionary<GridColumn, int> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<GridColumn, int>();
			foreach (GridCell gridCell in gridCells)
			{
				DataViewBase dataViewBase = ((gridCell.Column != null) ? gridCell.Column.View : gridCell.View);
				int commonVisibleIndex = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(gridCell.RowHandle);
				CellDetailHelper cellDetailHelper;
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(commonVisibleIndex))
				{
					cellDetailHelper = dictionary[commonVisibleIndex];
				}
				else
				{
					cellDetailHelper = new CellDetailHelper
					{
						VisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex,
						Cells = new List<GridCell>(),
						View = dataViewBase
					};
					dictionary.Add(commonVisibleIndex, cellDetailHelper);
				}
				if (!(dataViewBase.DataControl is GridControl gridControl))
				{
					break;
				}
				cellDetailHelper.Cells.Add(gridCell);
				DataViewBase key = (dataViewBase.IsRootView ? dataViewBase : dataViewBase.OriginationView);
				if (gridControl.IsGroupRowHandle(gridCell.RowHandle))
				{
					if (LevelInfo.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						ViewInfo viewInfo = LevelInfo[key];
						viewInfo.GroupLevel = Math.Max(viewInfo.GroupLevel, gridControl.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(gridCell.RowHandle) + 1);
						viewInfo.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevels(dataViewBase);
					}
					else
					{
						LevelInfo.Add(key, new ViewInfo
						{
							GroupLevel = gridControl.GetRowLevelByRowHandle(gridCell.RowHandle) + 1,
							DetailLevel = GetDetailLevels(dataViewBase)
						});
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (!LevelInfo.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					LevelInfo.Add(key, new ViewInfo
					{
						GroupLevel = 0,
						DetailLevel = GetDetailLevels(dataViewBase)
					});
				}
				if (!dictionary2.ContainsKey(gridCell.Column))
				{
					dictionary2.Add(gridCell.Column, GetDetailLevels(gridCell.Column.View));
				}
			}
			Columns = (from x in dictionary2
				orderby x.Value, x.Key.ActualVisibleIndex
				select x.Key).ToList();
			ColumnsText = GetColumnHeadersText(Columns);
			List<CellDetailHelper> list = dictionary.Values.ToList();
			list.Sort();
			return list;
		}

		private Dictionary<GridViewBase, StringBuilder> GetColumnHeadersText(List<GridColumn> columns)
		{
			if (columns.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<GridViewBase, StringBuilder> dictionary = new Dictionary<GridViewBase, StringBuilder>();
			foreach (GridColumn column in columns)
			{
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey((GridViewBase)column.View))
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					ViewInfo viewInfo = LevelInfo[column.View.IsRootView ? column.View : column.View.OriginationView];
					int num = viewInfo.DetailLevel + viewInfo.GroupLevel;
					if (num > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\t', num);
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(column.View.GetTextForClipboard(int.MinValue, (column.View as GridViewBase).VisibleColumns.IndexOf(column)) + "\t");
					dictionary.Add((GridViewBase)column.View, stringBuilder);
				}
				else
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = dictionary[(GridViewBase)column.View];
					stringBuilder2.Append(column.View.GetTextForClipboard(int.MinValue, (column.View as GridViewBase).VisibleColumns.IndexOf(column)) + "\t");
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<GridViewBase, StringBuilder> item in dictionary)
			{
				item.Value.Remove(item.Value.Length - 1, 1);
				item.Value.Append(Environment.NewLine);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private int GetDetailLevels(DataViewBase view)
		{
			int level = -1;
			view.DataControl.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				level++;
				if (dataControl is GridControl gridControl)
				{
					GridControl masterGrid = gridControl.GetMasterGrid();
				}
			});
			return level;
		}

		protected override bool CanAddRowToSelectedData(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle)
		{
			GridViewBase gridViewBase = (GridViewBase)dataControl.DataView;
			return !gridViewBase.IsGroupRow(gridViewBase.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandle), 1);
		}

		protected override int GetCountCopyRows(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows)
		{
			if (View.DataProviderBase.IsServerMode && View.ClipboardCopyMaxRowCountInServerMode != -1)
			{
				return Math.Min(View.ClipboardCopyMaxRowCountInServerMode, rows.Count());
			}
			return base.GetCountCopyRows(rows);
		}

		protected virtual CopyingToClipboardEventArgs CreateCellsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(IEnumerable<GridCell> cells)
		{
			return new CopyingToClipboardEventArgs(View, cells);
		}

		protected override CopyingToClipboardEventArgsBase CreateRowsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(IEnumerable<int> rows)
		{
			return new CopyingToClipboardEventArgs(View, rows);
		}
	}
	public class CellComparer : IComparer<CellBase>
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		public CellComparer(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public int Compare(CellBase x, CellBase y)
		{
			int num = Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(view.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(x.RowHandleCore), view.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(y.RowHandleCore));
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(x.ColumnCore.ActualVisibleIndex, y.ColumnCore.ActualVisibleIndex);
		}
	}

	public class CardViewBehavior : DataViewBehavior
	{
		private DispatcherTimer scrollTimer;

		private static UseCardLightweightTemplates? DefaultUseLightweightTemplates;

		internal bool canChangeUseLightweightTemplates = true;

		private MouseMoveSelectionCardBase mouseMoveSelection;

		protected override DispatcherTimer ScrollTimer
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return scrollTimer;
			}
		}

		private CardView CardView => (CardView)base.View;

		internal override double HorizontalViewportCore => CardView.CardsPanelViewPort;

		protected override bool AllowPerPixelScrolling
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return CardView.ScrollMode == ScrollMode.Pixel;
			}
		}

		private UseCardLightweightTemplates ActualUseLightweightTemplates => CardView.UseLightweightTemplates ?? ((CardView)base.View.RootView).UseLightweightTemplates ?? DefaultUseLightweightTemplates ?? UseCardLightweightTemplates.GroupRow;

		private MouseMoveSelectionCardBase MouseMoveSelection
		{
			get
			{
				return mouseMoveSelection ?? MouseMoveSelectionCardNone.Instance;
			}
			set
			{
				mouseMoveSelection = value;
			}
		}

		private bool IsRowModeSelection => base.View.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.Row;

		protected override bool HasRowTemplateSelector
		{
			protected internal get
			{
				return CardView.CardTemplateSelector != null;
			}
		}

		public CardViewBehavior(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			scrollTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
			scrollTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(10.0);
			scrollTimer.Tick += OnScrollTimer_Tick;
		}

		protected internal override RowData CreateRowDataCore(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, bool updateDataOnly)
		{
			return new CardData(treeBuilder);
		}

		protected internal override bool OnVisibleColumnsAssigned(bool changed)
		{
			return changed;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateCellData(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData)
		{
			rowData.ReuseCellDataNotVirtualized((ColumnsRowDataBase x) => x.CellData, delegate(ColumnsRowDataBase x, IList val)
			{
				x.CellData = (IList<GridColumnData>)val;
			}, base.View.VisibleColumnsCore);
		}

		internal override void UpdateSecondaryScrollInfoCore(double secondaryOffset, bool allowUpdateViewportVisibleColumns)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = SizeHelperBase.GetDefineSizeHelper(CardView.Orientation).CreatePoint(0.0, secondaryOffset);
			base.View.DataPresenter.ContentElement.Margin = new Thickness(point.X, point.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		internal override GridViewNavigationBase CreateRowNavigation()
		{
			return new CardViewRowNavigation(CardView);
		}

		internal override GridViewNavigationBase CreateCellNavigation()
		{
			return new CardViewCellNavigation(CardView);
		}

		protected internal override double GetFixedExtent()
		{
			return CardView.CardsPanelMaxSize;
		}

		protected internal override void GetDataRowText(StringBuilder sb, int rowHandle)
		{
			CardView.GetDataRowTextCore(sb, rowHandle);
		}

		internal static DependencyProperty RegisterUseLightweightTemplatesProperty(Type ownerType)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.Register("UseLightweightTemplates", typeof(UseCardLightweightTemplates?), ownerType, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CardViewBehavior)((CardView)d).ViewBehavior).OnUseLightweightTemplatesChanged();
			}));
		}

		private void ForbidChangeUseLightweightTemplatesProperty()
		{
			canChangeUseLightweightTemplates = false;
		}

		internal bool UseLightweightTemplatesHasFlag(UseCardLightweightTemplates flag)
		{
			return ActualUseLightweightTemplates.HasFlag(flag);
		}

		internal FrameworkElement CreateElement(Func<FrameworkElement> lightweightDelegate, Func<FrameworkElement> ordinaryDelegate, UseCardLightweightTemplates flag)
		{
			if (canChangeUseLightweightTemplates)
			{
				ForbidChangeUseLightweightTemplatesProperty();
			}
			if (UseLightweightTemplatesHasFlag(flag))
			{
				return lightweightDelegate();
			}
			return ordinaryDelegate();
		}

		private void OnUseLightweightTemplatesChanged()
		{
			if (!canChangeUseLightweightTemplates && !DataViewBase.DisableOptimizedModeVerification)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't change the UseLightweightTemplates property after the GridControl has been initialized.");
			}
			base.View.UpdateColumnsAppearance();
		}

		public virtual void OnScrollTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.View == null || base.View.ScrollContentPresenter == null || double.IsNaN(LastMousePosition.X) || double.IsNaN(LastMousePosition.Y))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			DragScroll();
			if (MouseMoveSelection.CanScrollVertically)
			{
				double num3 = base.View.DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Viewport / 20.0;
				if (LastMousePosition.Y < 0.0)
				{
					num = 0.0 - num3;
				}
				if (LastMousePosition.Y > base.View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight)
				{
					num = num3;
				}
			}
			if (MouseMoveSelection.CanScrollHorizontally)
			{
				double num4 = base.View.DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport / 20.0;
				if (LastMousePosition.X < 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 0.0 - num4;
				}
				if (LastMousePosition.X > base.View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth)
				{
					num2 = num4;
				}
			}
			if (num2 != 0.0)
			{
				ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(num2);
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				ChangeVerticalOffsetBy(num);
			}
			if (num != 0.0 || num2 != 0.0)
			{
				base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					MouseMoveSelection.UpdateSelection(base.View);
				});
			}
		}

		private void DragScroll()
		{
			if (DragDropScroller.IsDragging(base.View))
			{
				if (LastMousePosition.X < 0.0)
				{
					ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(-1.0);
				}
				if (LastMousePosition.X > base.View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth)
				{
					ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(1.0);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnViewMouseLeave()
		{
			MouseMoveSelection.CaptureMouse(base.View);
		}

		internal override void OnViewMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			LastMousePosition = e.GetPosition(base.View.ScrollContentPresenter);
			base.View.CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				MouseMoveSelection.UpdateSelection(base.View);
			});
		}

		internal override void ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			StopSelection();
		}

		internal override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp()
		{
			StopSelection();
		}

		internal override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
			if (!base.View.IsEditing && Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Released)
			{
				MouseMoveSelection = GetMouseMoveSelection(hitInfo);
				MouseMoveSelection.OnMouseDown(base.View, hitInfo);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void StopSelection()
		{
			MouseMoveSelection.OnMouseUp(base.View);
			MouseMoveSelection = null;
			MouseMoveSelection.ReleaseMouseCapture(base.View);
		}

		protected virtual MouseMoveSelectionCardBase GetMouseMoveSelection(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!base.View.AllowMouseMoveSelection)
			{
				return MouseMoveSelectionCardNone.Instance;
			}
			if (base.View.ShowSelectionRectangle && IsRowModeSelection && (hitInfo.IsDataArea || hitInfo.InRow))
			{
				return MouseMoveSelectionRectangleCard.Instance;
			}
			return MouseMoveSelectionCardNone.Instance;
		}
	}
	internal class CellAnimationConnector : GridAnimationConnectorBase<LightweightCellEditor>
	{
		private DataBarFormatInfo activeDataBarFormatInfoCore;

		private Locker bindingLocker = new Locker();

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BackgroundColorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValuePositionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IconOpacityProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IconProperty;

		public RenderBorderContext BackgroundBorder { get; set; }

		public LightweightCellEditor Cell { get; set; }

		public ConditionalFormatContentRenderHelper<LightweightCellEditor> RenderHelper { get; set; }

		private DataBarFormatInfo ActiveDataBarFormatInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return activeDataBarFormatInfoCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(activeDataBarFormatInfoCore, value))
				{
					activeDataBarFormatInfoCore = value;
					OnActiveDataBarFormatInfoChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private RenderImageContext RenderImage => RenderHelper.With((ConditionalFormatContentRenderHelper<LightweightCellEditor> x) => x.IconImage);

		public System.Windows.Media.Color BackgroundColor
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)GetValue(BackgroundColorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BackgroundColorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ValuePosition
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ValuePositionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValuePositionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double IconOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(IconOpacityProperty);

			set

				SetValue(IconOpacityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ImageSource Icon
		{
			get
			{
				return (ImageSource)GetValue(IconProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IconProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override LightweightCellEditor Owner => Cell;

		static CellAnimationConnector()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<CellAnimationConnector>.New().Register<System.Windows.Media.Color>("BackgroundColor", ref BackgroundColorProperty, Colors.Transparent, (Action<CellAnimationConnector, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnBackgroundColorChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<double>("ValuePosition", ref ValuePositionProperty, 0.0, (Action<CellAnimationConnector, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnValuePositionChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("IconOpacity", ref IconOpacityProperty, 0.0, (Action<CellAnimationConnector, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnIconOpacityChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ImageSource>("Icon", ref IconProperty, (ImageSource)null, (Action<CellAnimationConnector, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnIconChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		private static void OnBackgroundColorChanged(CellAnimationConnector sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			OnBindedValueChanged(sender, delegate
			{
				sender.UpdateBackground((System.Windows.Media.Color)args.NewValue);
			});
		}

		private static void OnValuePositionChanged(CellAnimationConnector sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			OnBindedValueChanged(sender, delegate
			{
				sender.UpdateDataBar((double)args.NewValue);
			});
		}

		private static void OnIconOpacityChanged(CellAnimationConnector sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			OnBindedValueChanged(sender, delegate
			{
				sender.UpdateIconOpacity((double)args.NewValue);
			});
		}

		private static void OnIconChanged(CellAnimationConnector sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			OnBindedValueChanged(sender, delegate
			{
				sender.UpdateIcon((ImageSource)args.NewValue);
			});
		}

		private static void OnBindedValueChanged(CellAnimationConnector sender, Action updateAction)
		{
			sender.bindingLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(updateAction);
		}

		protected override void UpdateConnection()
		{
			base.UpdateConnection();
			ConnectBackground();
			InitActiveDataBarFormatInfo();
			ConnectDataBar();
			ConnectIconOpacity();
			ConnectIcon();
		}

		private void ConnectBackground()
		{
			if (BackgroundBorder != null && ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)1))
			{
				SetAnimationElementInitialValue(AnimationElement.BackgroundProperty, BackgroundBorder.Background ?? new SolidColorBrush());
				SetBinding(this, BackgroundColorProperty, GridAnimationConnectorBase<LightweightCellEditor>.CreateOneWayBinding(SolidColorBrush.ColorProperty, base.ConnectedElement.Background));
			}
		}

		private void ConnectDataBar()
		{
			if (ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)4))
			{
				if (ActiveDataBarFormatInfo != null)
				{
					base.ConnectedElement.ValuePosition = ActiveDataBarFormatInfo.ValuePosition;
				}
				SetBinding(this, ValuePositionProperty, GridAnimationConnectorBase<LightweightCellEditor>.CreateOneWayBinding(AnimationElement.ValuePositionProperty, base.ConnectedElement));
			}
		}

		private void ConnectIconOpacity()
		{
			if (ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)8))
			{
				if (RenderImage != null && ((FrameworkRenderElementContext)RenderImage).Opacity.HasValue)
				{
					base.ConnectedElement.IconOpacity = ((FrameworkRenderElementContext)RenderImage).Opacity.Value;
				}
				SetBinding(this, IconOpacityProperty, GridAnimationConnectorBase<LightweightCellEditor>.CreateOneWayBinding(AnimationElement.IconOpacityProperty, base.ConnectedElement));
			}
		}

		private void ConnectIcon()
		{
			if (ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)512))
			{
				if (ActiveDataBarFormatInfo != null)
				{
					base.ConnectedElement.Icon = ActiveDataBarFormatInfo.Icon;
				}
				SetBinding(this, IconProperty, GridAnimationConnectorBase<LightweightCellEditor>.CreateOneWayBinding(AnimationElement.IconProperty, base.ConnectedElement));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBackground(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			BackgroundBorder.Do(delegate(RenderBorderContext x)
			{
				x.Background = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			});
		}

		private void UpdateDataBar(double valuePosition)
		{
			if (ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)4))
			{
				ActiveDataBarFormatInfo = DataBarFormatInfo.ModifyValuePosition(ActiveDataBarFormatInfo, valuePosition);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIconOpacity(double? opacity)
		{
			if (ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)8))
			{
				RenderImage.Do(delegate(RenderImageContext x)
				{
					((FrameworkRenderElementContext)x).Opacity = opacity;
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIcon(ImageSource icon)
		{
			ActiveDataBarFormatInfo = DataBarFormatInfo.AddIcon(ActiveDataBarFormatInfo, icon, VerticalAlignment.Center);
		}

		private void InitActiveDataBarFormatInfo()
		{
			if (ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)4) || ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)512) || ShouldSyncProperty((AnimationMask)8))
			{
				ActiveDataBarFormatInfo = RenderHelper.With((ConditionalFormatContentRenderHelper<LightweightCellEditor> x) => x.DataBarFormatInfo);
			}
		}

		private void OnActiveDataBarFormatInfoChanged()
		{
			Cell.Do(delegate(IConditionalFormattingClient<LightweightCellEditor> x)
			{
				x.UpdateDataBarFormatInfo(ActiveDataBarFormatInfo);
			});
		}

		protected override void DoBindingOperation(Action bindingOperation)
		{
			bindingLocker.DoLockedAction(bindingOperation);
		}

		protected override void UpdateAppearanceCore()
		{
			if (Cell != null)
			{
				Cell.CellData.Do(delegate(EditGridCellData x)
				{
					x.ResetAnimationFormatInfoProvider();
				});
				Cell.OnDataChanged();
			}
		}

		public override void OnAnimationSeriesEnd()
		{
			UpdateIconOpacity(null);
		}
	}

	{

		public override void Text(IEdmPropertyInfo property, bool multiline)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!multiline)
			{
				((EditorsGeneratorBase)this).Text(property, multiline);
				return;
			}
			int maxLength = EditorsGeneratorBase.GetMaxLength(property);
			if (maxLength > 0)
			{
				GenerateEditor(property, null, Initializer.Default, null, null);
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateEditor(property, null, Initializer.Default, null, null);
			}
		}

		public override void LookUp(IEdmPropertyInfo property, string itemsSource, string displayMember, ForeignKeyInfo foreignKeyInfo)
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemsSource))
			{
				base.GenerateEditor(property, null, ((EditorsGeneratorBase)this).LookUpInitializer(property, itemsSource, displayMember, foreignKeyInfo), null, displayMember);
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateEditor(property, typeof(LookUpEditSettings), ((EditorsGeneratorBase)this).LookUpInitializer(property, itemsSource, displayMember, foreignKeyInfo), null, null);
			}
		}

		protected override Initializer LookUpInitializer(IEdmPropertyInfo property, string itemsSource, string displayMember, ForeignKeyInfo foreignKeyInfo)
		{
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemsSource))
			{
				return new Initializer((Action<IModelItem, IModelItem>)null, (Action<IModelItem>)delegate(IModelItem container)
				{
					ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(container.Properties[ColumnBase.ReadOnlyProperty.Name], (object)true);
				});
			}
			return new Initializer((Action<IModelItem, IModelItem>)delegate(IModelItem container, IModelItem edit)
			{
				ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(edit.Properties[LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemsSourceProperty.Name], (object)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(itemsSource));
				ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(edit.Properties[LookUpEditSettingsBase.DisplayMemberProperty.Name], (object)displayMember);
			}, (Action<IModelItem>)null);
		}

		{
		}

		protected override Initializer ImageInitializer(IEdmPropertyInfo property, bool readOnly)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return Initializer.Default;
		}

		protected override void GenerateEditor(IEdmPropertyInfo property, Type editType, Initializer initializer, object resourceKey, string displayMember)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GenerateColumnWrapper generateColumnWrapper = new GenerateColumnWrapper(BandWrapper.GetNextPropertyIndex(), property.PropertyType, this, (PropertyDescriptor)property.ContextObject)
			{
				EditorResourceKey = resourceKey,
				Initializer = initializer
			};
			FillColumnWrapperProperties(generateColumnWrapper, property, displayMember);
			ColumnWrapperCollection.Add(generateColumnWrapper);
		}

		private void FillColumnWrapperProperties(GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper, IEdmPropertyInfo property, string displayMember)
		{
			wrapper.SetScaffSmartProperty = true;
			AttributesApplier.ApplyBaseAttributes(property, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				string text = x + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayMember) ? null : ("." + displayMember));
				wrapper.FieldName = text;
				if (text != x)
				{
					wrapper.Properties[BaseColumn.HeaderProperty] = SplitStringHelper.SplitPascalCaseString(x);
				}
			}, (Action<string>)null, (Action<string>)null, (Action<string>)null, (Action)null, (Action<bool?>)null, (Action)delegate
			{
				wrapper.Visible = false;
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				wrapper.Visible = false;
			}, (Action)null);
		}

		private void FillEditSettingsWrapperProperties(IEdmPropertyInfo property, GenerateColumnWrapper columnWrapper, Type editType)
		{

			{
				wrapper.EditSettingsType = x;
			});
			columnWrapper.EditSettingsWrapper = wrapper;

			{

			}, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				wrapper.Properties[BaseEditSettings.DisplayFormatProperty] = x;
			}, (Action)null);
		}

	internal abstract class GridAnimationConnectorBase<T> : DependencyObject, IAnimationConnector where T : FrameworkElement, IConditionalFormattingClient<T>
	{
		private AnimationElement connectedElementCore;

		private Locker formattingHelperLocker;

		public AnimationElement ConnectedElement
		{
			get
			{
				return connectedElementCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (connectedElementCore != value)
				{
					connectedElementCore = value;
					Connect(connectedElementCore);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract T Owner { get; }

		private void Connect(AnimationElement element)
		{
			LockConditionalAppearance();
			UpdateConnection();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateConnection()
		{
			ConnectOwnerProperty((AnimationMask)2, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty);
			ConnectOwnerProperty((AnimationMask)16, TextBlock.FontSizeProperty);
			ConnectOwnerProperty((AnimationMask)32, TextBlock.FontStyleProperty);
			ConnectOwnerProperty((AnimationMask)64, TextBlock.FontFamilyProperty);
			ConnectOwnerProperty((AnimationMask)128, TextBlock.FontStretchProperty);
			ConnectOwnerProperty((AnimationMask)256, TextBlock.FontWeightProperty);
		}

		protected void ConnectOwnerProperty(AnimationMask mask, DependencyProperty ownerProperty)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Owner != null && ShouldSyncProperty(mask))
			{
				DependencyProperty animationElementPropertyByMask = GetAnimationElementPropertyByMask(mask);
				if (animationElementPropertyByMask != null)
				{
					SetAnimationElementInitialValue(animationElementPropertyByMask, Owner.GetValue(ownerProperty));
					SetBinding(Owner, ownerProperty, CreateOneWayBinding(animationElementPropertyByMask, ConnectedElement));
				}
			}
		}

		protected static System.Windows.Data.Binding CreateOneWayBinding(DependencyProperty dp, object source)
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding(dp.Name);
			binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
			binding.UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged;
			binding.Source = source;
			return binding;
		}

		protected void SetAnimationElementInitialValue(DependencyProperty animationElementProperty, object value)
		{
			object obj = value;
			if (obj is Freezable)
			{
				obj = ((Freezable)obj).CloneCurrentValue();
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)ConnectedElement).SetValue(animationElementProperty, obj);
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSyncProperty(AnimationMask mask)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (ConnectedElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Owner != null && ((IConditionalFormattingClient<T>)Owner).IsSelected && ((int)mask == 1 || (int)mask == 2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((Enum)ConnectedElement.Mask).HasFlag((Enum)(object)mask);
		}

		private DependencyProperty GetAnimationElementPropertyByMask(AnimationMask mask)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)mask <= 16)
			{
				if ((int)mask == 1)
				{
					return AnimationElement.BackgroundProperty;
				}
				if ((int)mask == 2)
				{
					return AnimationElement.ForegroundProperty;
				}
				if ((int)mask == 16)
				{
					return AnimationElement.FontSizeProperty;
				}
			}
			else if ((int)mask <= 64)
			{
				if ((int)mask == 32)
				{
					return AnimationElement.FontStyleProperty;
				}
				if ((int)mask == 64)
				{
					return AnimationElement.FontFamilyProperty;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if ((int)mask == 128)
				{
					return AnimationElement.FontStretchProperty;
				}
				if ((int)mask == 256)
				{
					return AnimationElement.FontWeightProperty;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Disconnect()
		{
			ClearConnectionBindings();
		}

		protected virtual void ClearConnectionBindings()
		{
			ClearAllBindings(this);
			ClearBinding(Owner, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty);
			ClearBinding(Owner, TextBlock.FontSizeProperty);
			ClearBinding(Owner, TextBlock.FontStyleProperty);
			ClearBinding(Owner, TextBlock.FontFamilyProperty);
			ClearBinding(Owner, TextBlock.FontStretchProperty);
			ClearBinding(Owner, TextBlock.FontWeightProperty);
		}

		public void UpdateAppearance()
		{
			UnlockConditionalAppearance();
			UpdateConditionalAppearanceMask();
			UpdateAppearanceCore();
		}

		private void LockConditionalAppearance()
		{
			formattingHelperLocker = GetConditionalFormattingHelper().With((ConditionalFormattingHelper<T> y) => y.Locker).With((Locker z) => z.LockOnce());
		}

		private void UnlockConditionalAppearance()
		{
			formattingHelperLocker.Do(delegate(Locker x)
			{
				x.Unlock();
			});
			formattingHelperLocker = null;
		}

		private void UpdateConditionalAppearanceMask()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ConnectedElement != null)
			{
				GetConditionalFormattingHelper()?.AddMaskFlags(ConditionalFormattingMaskHelper.AnimationMaskToConditionalFormatMask(ConnectedElement.Mask));
			}
		}

		private ConditionalFormattingHelper<T> GetConditionalFormattingHelper()
		{
			return Owner.With((IConditionalFormattingClient<T> x) => x.FormattingHelper);
		}

		protected void SetBinding(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty dp, BindingBase binding)
		{
			DoBindingOperation(delegate
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, dp, binding);
			});
		}

		protected void ClearBinding(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				DoBindingOperation(delegate
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearBinding(target, dp);
				});
			}
		}

		private void ClearAllBindings(DependencyObject target)
		{
			DoBindingOperation(delegate
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(target);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void DoBindingOperation(Action bindingOperation)
		{
			bindingOperation();
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateAppearanceCore();

		public virtual void OnAnimationSeriesEnd()
		{
		}
	}

		public static object GetDesignTimeSource(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object itemsSource = dataControl.ItemsSource;
			if (CanUseItemsSource(itemsSource))
			{
				return itemsSource;
			}
			if (IsDesignTimeDataSource(itemsSource))
			{
				dataControl.DesignTimeShowSampleData = false;
			}
			if (dataControl.DesignTimeShowSampleData)
			{
				return new GridDesignTimeDataSource(dataControl.DesignTimeDataObjectType, dataControl.DesignTimeDataSourceRowCount, dataControl.DesignTimeUseDistinctSampleValues, itemsSource, GetDesignTimePropertyInfo(dataControl));
			}
			return itemsSource;
		}

		private static bool CanUseItemsSource(object itemsSource)
		{
			if (!(itemsSource is IEnumerable))
			{
				return itemsSource is Array;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsDesignTimeDataSource(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type.FullName == "MS.Internal.Data.CollectionViewProxy")
			{
				return type.GetProperty("ProxiedView").GetValue(value, null) is IDesignTimeDataSource;
			}
			return value is IDesignTimeDataSource;
		}

		public static GridColumnHeader[] GetColumnHeaderElements(DataControlBase dataControl, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!column.Visible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<GridColumnHeader> list = new List<GridColumnHeader>();
			bool flag = column is GridColumn && ((GridColumn)column).IsGrouped;
			if (flag)
			{
				GridColumnHeader headerElementFromPanel = GetHeaderElementFromPanel(dataControl, column, ((GridViewBase)dataControl.DataView).GroupPanel);
				if (headerElementFromPanel != null)
				{
					list.Add(headerElementFromPanel);
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = dataControl.DataView is GridViewBase && ((GridViewBase)dataControl.DataView).ShowGroupedColumns;
			if (!flag || flag2)
			{
				GridColumnHeader headerElementFromPanel2 = GetHeaderElementFromPanel(dataControl, column, dataControl.DataView.HeadersPanel);
				if (headerElementFromPanel2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(headerElementFromPanel2);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static BandHeaderControl GetBandHeaderElement(DataControlBase dataControl, BandBase band)
		{
			if (dataControl == null || !band.Visible || dataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (DependencyObject item in new VisualTreeEnumerable(dataControl.BandsLayoutCore.GetBandsContainerControl()))
			{
				if (item is BandHeaderControl bandHeaderControl && bandHeaderControl.DataContext == band && FrameworkElementExtensions.IsVisible((FrameworkElement)bandHeaderControl))
				{
					return bandHeaderControl;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static GridColumnHeader GetHeaderElementFromPanel(DataControlBase dataControl, ColumnBase column, FrameworkElement rootPanel)
		{
			if (rootPanel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (DependencyObject item in new VisualTreeEnumerable(rootPanel))
			{
				if (item is GridColumnHeader gridColumnHeader && gridColumnHeader.DataContext == column && FrameworkElementExtensions.IsVisible((FrameworkElement)gridColumnHeader))
				{
					return gridColumnHeader;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

	public abstract class MouseMoveSelectionCardBase
	{
		public abstract bool CanScrollHorizontally { get; }

		public abstract bool CanScrollVertically { get; }

		public abstract bool AllowNavigation { get; }

		public abstract void OnMouseDown(DataViewBase cardView, IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo);

		public abstract void UpdateSelection(DataViewBase cardView);

		public abstract void OnMouseUp(DataViewBase cardView);

		public abstract void CaptureMouse(DataViewBase cardView);

		public virtual void ReleaseMouseCapture(DataViewBase cardView)
		{
			DataViewBase rootView = cardView.RootView;
			if (MouseHelper.Captured == rootView)
			{
				MouseHelper.ReleaseCapture((UIElement)rootView);
			}
		}
	}

	public class MouseMoveSelectionRectangleCard : MouseMoveSelectionCardBase
	{
		public static readonly MouseMoveSelectionRectangleCard Instance = new MouseMoveSelectionRectangleCard();

		private SelectionRectangleCardViewHelper helper = new SelectionRectangleCardViewHelper();

		private bool isFirst;

		private System.Windows.Point startPointFirst;

		public override bool CanScrollHorizontally => true;

		public override bool CanScrollVertically => true;

		public override bool AllowNavigation => false;

		public override void OnMouseDown(DataViewBase cardView, IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			isFirst = true;
			cardView.SelectionAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(cardView, hitInfo.RowHandle, null);
			cardView.ScrollTimer.Start();
			helper.OnMouseDown(cardView);
			startPointFirst = helper.StartPoint;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionCore(DataViewBase cardView, IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			CaptureMouse(cardView);
			cardView.SelectionStrategy.SelectRowRange(rowHandles);
			cardView.SelectionOldCell = new SelectionAnchorCell(cardView, (rowHandles.Count() > 0) ? rowHandles.Min() : 0, null);
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(DataViewBase cardView)
		{
			if (isFirst)
			{
				System.Windows.Point transformPoint = helper.GetTransformPoint(cardView, cardView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition);
				if (Math.Abs(startPointFirst.X - transformPoint.X) <= SystemParameters.MinimumVerticalDragDistance && Math.Abs(startPointFirst.Y - transformPoint.Y) <= SystemParameters.MinimumHorizontalDragDistance)
				{
					helper.OnMouseDown(cardView);
					return;
				}
				isFirst = false;
			}
			int value = cardView.GetViewAndVisibleIndex(cardView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y).Value;
			if (value < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			CaptureMouse(cardView);
			if (helper.StartPoint == helper.GetTransformPoint(cardView, cardView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition))
			{
				return;
			}
			helper.UpdateSelection(cardView, cardView.ViewBehavior);
			CardView cardView2 = (CardView)cardView;
			List<CardRowInfo> cardRowInfoCollection = cardView2.CardRowInfoCollection;
			Rect rect = new Rect(helper.StartPoint, helper.EndPoint);
			System.Windows.Point minTransformPoint = SelectionRectangleHelper.GetMinTransformPoint(cardView, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point maxTransformPoint = SelectionRectangleHelper.GetMaxTransformPoint(cardView);
			cardView.BeginSelectionCore();
			HashSet<int> hashSet = new HashSet<int>(cardView.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles());
			foreach (CardRowInfo item in cardRowInfoCollection)
			{
				foreach (IItem element in item.Elements)
				{
					if (!element.IsRowVisible)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Rect rectangleFromElement = GetRectangleFromElement(element.Element, cardView);
					if (!(rectangleFromElement.X + rectangleFromElement.Width <= minTransformPoint.X) && !(rectangleFromElement.X > maxTransformPoint.X) && !(rectangleFromElement.Y + rectangleFromElement.Height <= minTransformPoint.Y) && !(rectangleFromElement.Y > maxTransformPoint.Y))
					{
						Rect rect2 = Rect.Intersect(rect, rectangleFromElement);
						if (rect2.Width > 0.0 || rect2.Height > 0.0)
						{
							hashSet.Add(DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(element.Element).Value);
						}
						else
						{
							hashSet.Remove(DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(element.Element).Value);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateSelectionCore(cardView, hashSet);
			cardView.EndSelectionCore();
		}

		public override void OnMouseUp(DataViewBase cardView)
		{
			cardView.ScrollTimer.Stop();
			helper.OnMouseUp(cardView);
		}

		public override void CaptureMouse(DataViewBase cardView)
		{
			if (MouseHelper.Captured != cardView)
			{
				if (cardView.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					MouseHelper.Capture((UIElement)cardView);
				}
				else
				{
					cardView.StopSelection();
				}
			}
		}

		private Rect GetRectangleFromElement(FrameworkElement element, DataViewBase cardView)
		{
			System.Windows.Point location = element.TransformToAncestor(cardView.DataControl).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			return new Rect(location, element.RenderSize);
		}
	}
	public class SelectionRectangleCardViewHelper : SelectionRectangleHelper
	{
		private class StartPointInfo
		{
			private readonly int _numberRow;

			private readonly double _verticalOffset;

			private readonly double _horizontalOffset;

			public int NumberRow => _numberRow;

			public double VerticalOffset => _verticalOffset;

			public double HorizontalOffset => _horizontalOffset;

			public StartPointInfo(int numberRow, double verticalOffset, double horizontalOffset)
			{
				_numberRow = numberRow;
				_verticalOffset = verticalOffset;
				_horizontalOffset = horizontalOffset;
			}
		}

		private StartPointInfo startClickPoint;

		private double scrollOffsetVertical;

		private double scrollOffsetHorizontal;

		public override void OnMouseDown(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle = 0, ColumnBase column = null)
		{
			CardView cardView = view as CardView;
			startPointView = (endPointView = GetTransformPoint(view, view.ViewBehavior));
			if (cardView.CardRowInfoCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			double num2 = cardView.GetRowOffset;
			double verticalOffset = 0.0;
			double horizontalOffset = 0.0;
			IScrollInfo dataPresenter = view.DataPresenter;
			CardLayout cardLayout = cardView.CardLayout;
			if (cardLayout != CardLayout.Rows)
			{
				if (cardLayout == CardLayout.Columns)
				{
					do
					{
						num++;
						num2 += cardView.CardRowInfoCollection[num].Size.Width;
					}
					while (num2 < view.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X && num < cardView.CardRowInfoCollection.Count - 1);
					horizontalOffset = view.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X - (num2 - cardView.CardRowInfoCollection[num].Size.Width);
					num += (int)dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				do
				{
					num++;
					num2 += cardView.CardRowInfoCollection[num].Size.Height;
				}
				while (num2 < view.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y && num < cardView.CardRowInfoCollection.Count - 1);
				verticalOffset = view.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y - (num2 - cardView.CardRowInfoCollection[num].Size.Height);
				num += (int)dataPresenter.VerticalOffset;
			}
			startClickPoint = new StartPointInfo(num, verticalOffset, horizontalOffset);
			UpdateSelectionRect(view);
			scrollOffsetVertical = dataPresenter.VerticalOffset;
			scrollOffsetHorizontal = dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset;
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(DataViewBase view, DataViewBehavior behavior, double indicatorWidth = 0.0)
		{
			CardView cardView = (CardView)view;
			if (cardView.CardRowInfoCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point minTransformPoint = SelectionRectangleHelper.GetMinTransformPoint(view, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point maxTransformPoint = SelectionRectangleHelper.GetMaxTransformPoint(view);
			endPointView = GetTransformPoint(view, behavior);
			IScrollInfo dataPresenter = view.DataPresenter;
			switch (cardView.CardLayout)
			{
			case CardLayout.Rows:
				if (startClickPoint.NumberRow >= (int)dataPresenter.VerticalOffset && (double)startClickPoint.NumberRow < dataPresenter.VerticalOffset + dataPresenter.ViewportHeight)
				{
					double num2 = cardView.GetRowOffset;
					for (int j = 0; j < cardView.CardRowInfoCollection.Count && startClickPoint.NumberRow > (int)dataPresenter.VerticalOffset + j; j++)
					{
						num2 += cardView.CardRowInfoCollection[j].Size.Height;
					}
					System.Windows.Point transformPoint2 = GetTransformPoint(view, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, num2 + startClickPoint.VerticalOffset));
					startPointView.Y = transformPoint2.Y;
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag2 = dataPresenter.VerticalOffset > scrollOffsetVertical;
					startPointView.Y = (flag2 ? minTransformPoint.Y : maxTransformPoint.Y);
				}
				break;
			case CardLayout.Columns:
				if (startClickPoint.NumberRow >= (int)dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset && (double)startClickPoint.NumberRow < dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset + dataPresenter.ViewportWidth)
				{
					double num = cardView.GetRowOffset;
					for (int i = 0; i < cardView.CardRowInfoCollection.Count && startClickPoint.NumberRow > (int)dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset + i; i++)
					{
						num += cardView.CardRowInfoCollection[i].Size.Width;
					}
					System.Windows.Point transformPoint = GetTransformPoint(view, new System.Windows.Point(num + startClickPoint.HorizontalOffset, 0.0));
					startPointView.X = transformPoint.X;
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag = dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset > scrollOffsetHorizontal;
					startPointView.X = (flag ? minTransformPoint.X : maxTransformPoint.X);
				}
				break;
			}
			ValidateAndUpdateRectangle(minTransformPoint, maxTransformPoint, view);
		}
	}

	public class ScrollBarAttachedBehavior
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty UpdateThumbOrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("UpdateThumbOrientation", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation?), typeof(ScrollBarAttachedBehavior), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnUpdateThumbOrientationChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScrollBarAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ScrollBarAttachedBehavior", typeof(ScrollBarAttachedBehavior), typeof(ScrollBarAttachedBehavior), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private Thumb thumb;

		private SizeHelperBase sizeHelper;

		private Rect oldRect;

		public static System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? GetUpdateThumbOrientation(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (System.Windows.Controls.Orientation?)obj.GetValue(UpdateThumbOrientationProperty);
		}

		public static void SetUpdateThumbOrientation(DependencyObject obj, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(UpdateThumbOrientationProperty, value);
		}

		public static ScrollBarAttachedBehavior GetScrollBarAttachedBehavior(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (ScrollBarAttachedBehavior)obj.GetValue(ScrollBarAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		public static void SetScrollBarAttachedBehavior(DependencyObject obj, ScrollBarAttachedBehavior value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ScrollBarAttachedBehaviorProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnUpdateThumbOrientationChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Thumb)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Orientation? updateThumbOrientation = GetUpdateThumbOrientation(d);
				if (updateThumbOrientation.HasValue)
				{
					SetScrollBarAttachedBehavior(d, new ScrollBarAttachedBehavior((Thumb)d, updateThumbOrientation.Value));
					return;
				}
				ScrollBarAttachedBehavior scrollBarAttachedBehavior = GetScrollBarAttachedBehavior(d);
				scrollBarAttachedBehavior.Release();
				SetScrollBarAttachedBehavior(d, null);
			}
		}

		public ScrollBarAttachedBehavior(Thumb thumb, System.Windows.Controls.Orientation orientation)
		{
			this.thumb = thumb;
			sizeHelper = SizeHelperBase.GetDefineSizeHelper(orientation);
			this.thumb.LayoutUpdated += thumb_LayoutUpdated;
		}

		private void thumb_LayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!thumb.IsDragging || !(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(thumb) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)thumb, (UIElement)frameworkElement);
			if (!(oldRect == relativeElementRect) && sizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(relativeElementRect.TopLeft) != 0.0 && Math.Round(sizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(relativeElementRect.BottomRight)) != sizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(new System.Windows.Point(frameworkElement.ActualWidth, frameworkElement.ActualHeight)))
			{
				oldRect = relativeElementRect;
				FieldInfo field = typeof(Thumb).GetField("_originThumbPoint", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.GetField);
				System.Windows.Point point = (System.Windows.Point)field.GetValue(thumb);
				System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(thumb);
				if (!(Math.Abs(sizeHelper.GetSecondaryPoint(point) - sizeHelper.GetSecondaryPoint(position)) > 150.0))
				{
					field.SetValue(thumb, sizeHelper.CreatePoint(sizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(position), sizeHelper.GetSecondaryPoint(point)));
				}
			}
		}

		private void Release()
		{
			thumb.LayoutUpdated -= thumb_LayoutUpdated;
			thumb = null;
		}
	}

	public class AddRowsToSelectionAction : SelectionActionBase
	{
		private readonly int startCommonVisibleIndex;

		public AddRowsToSelectionAction(GridViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			GridDataViewBase gridDataViewBase = view.GlobalSelectionAnchor.View;
			startCommonVisibleIndex = gridDataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(view.GlobalSelectionAnchor.RowHandle);
		}

		public override void Execute()
		{
			if (base.FocusedView.GetActualSelectionMode() != MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				int commonVisibleIndex = base.FocusedView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(base.FocusedView.FocusedRowHandle);
				if (view.IsPagingMode)
				{
					base.FocusedView.SelectionStrategy.SelectMasterDetailRange(startCommonVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					base.FocusedView.SelectionStrategy.SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRange(startCommonVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CellMergeSelectionStrategy : SelectionStrategyCell
	{
		public CellMergeSelectionStrategy(TableView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle)
		{
			return SelectionState.None;
		}

		protected override bool CanSelectCell(int rowHandle)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override SelectionState GetCellSelectionStateCore(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!view.IsMergedCell(rowHandle, column))
			{
				return base.GetCellSelectionStateCore(rowHandle, isFocused, isSelected, column);
			}
			if (!isFocused)
			{
				if (!isSelected)
				{
					return SelectionState.CellMerge;
				}
				return SelectionState.Selected;
			}
			if (view.IsEditing)
			{
				return SelectionState.CellMerge;
			}
			if (!isSelected)
			{
				return SelectionState.CellMerge;
			}
			return SelectionState.FocusedAndSelected;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SelectionStrategyCellBase : MultiSelectionStrategyBase
	{
		private Locker updateSelectionBoundsLocker = new Locker();

		protected int oldRowHandle;

		protected ColumnBase oldColumn;

		protected CellBase selectionAnchor;

		private bool shouldProcessMouseDown;

		protected System.Drawing.Rectangle oldSelectionRectangle;

		protected DataViewBase DataView => view;

		protected ColumnBase CurrentColumn => view.DataControl.CurrentColumn;

		protected SelectionAnchorCell SelectionMasterAnchor
		{
			get
			{
				return view.RootView.SelectionStrategy.selectionMasterAnchorCore;
			}
			set
			{
				view.RootView.SelectionStrategy.selectionMasterAnchorCore = value;
			}
		}

		private bool HasDetailRootViews
		{
			get
			{
				DataViewBase rootView = view.RootView;
				if (rootView != null && rootView.DataControl != null)
				{
					return rootView.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public SelectionStrategyCellBase(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


		public override bool IsRowSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			return view.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelected(rowHandle);
		}

		public override SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			if (rowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
				{
					return SelectionState.None;
				}
				return SelectionState.Focused;
			}
			if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return SelectionState.Selected;
		}

		protected override SelectionState GetCellSelectionStateCore(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!isFocused)
			{
				if (!isSelected)
				{
					return SelectionState.None;
				}
				return SelectionState.Selected;
			}
			if (view.IsEditing)
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			if (!isSelected)
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return SelectionState.FocusedAndSelected;
		}

		public override int[] GetSelectedRows()
		{
			return view.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedRows();
		}

		public override void BeginSelection()
		{
			view.DataProviderBase.Selection.BeginSelection();
		}

		public override void EndSelection()
		{
			view.DataProviderBase.Selection.EndSelection();
		}

		public override void OnFocusedRowHandleChanged(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			UpdateSelectionBounds();
		}

		public override void OnFocusedColumnChanged()
		{
			UpdateSelectionBounds();
		}

		public override void SelectCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			SelectCellCore(rowHandle, column, useSelectionCount: false);
		}

		public override void SelectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				if (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanSelectRow(rowHandle))
				{
					view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, selected: true, new Dictionary<ColumnBase, int>());
				}
			}
			else if (view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				SetCellsSelection(rowHandle, view.VisibleColumnsCore[0], rowHandle, view.VisibleColumnsCore[view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1], setSelected: true);
			}
		}

		public override void UnselectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				if (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanUnselectRow(rowHandle))
				{
					view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, selected: false);
				}
			}
			else if (view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				SetCellsSelection(rowHandle, view.VisibleColumnsCore[0], rowHandle, view.VisibleColumnsCore[view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1], setSelected: false);
			}
		}

		internal override void SelectAllMasterDetail()
		{
			base.DataControl.GetRootDataControl().UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.BeginSelection();
				detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.ClearSelection();
				for (int i = 0; i < detail.VisibleRowCount; i++)
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectRow(detail.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i));
				}
				detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.EndSelection();
			});
		}

		public override void SelectAll()
		{
			if (view.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount != 0 && view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				BeginSelection();
				ClearSelectionCore();
				for (int i = 0; i < view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount; i++)
				{
					SelectRow(view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i));
				}
				EndSelection();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void SelectCellCore(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, bool useSelectionCount)
		{
			if (column == null || rowHandle == int.MinValue || (view is ITableView tableView && view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked && !tableView.RaiseCanSelectCell(rowHandle, column)))
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> dictionary = GetSelectedCells(rowHandle, view) ?? new Dictionary<ColumnBase, int>();
			if (dictionary.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				if (useSelectionCount)
				{
					dictionary[column]++;
				}
				return;
			}
			dictionary[column] = 0;
			view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetActuallyChanged();
			if (GetSelectedCells(rowHandle, view) == null)
			{
				SetCellSelection(rowHandle, dictionary);
			}
			else
			{
				RefreshSelectionForce(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		public override void UnselectCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			UnselectCellCore(rowHandle, column, useSelectionCount: false);
		}

		protected internal override void UnselectCellCore(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, bool useSelectionCount)
		{
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> selectedCells = GetSelectedCells(rowHandle, view);
			if (selectedCells == null || !selectedCells.ContainsKey(column) || (view is ITableView tableView && view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked && !tableView.RaiseCanUnselectCell(rowHandle, column)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (useSelectionCount && selectedCells[column] != 0)
			{
				selectedCells[column]--;
				return;
			}
			selectedCells.Remove(column);
			view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetActuallyChanged();
			if (selectedCells.Count == 0)
			{
				view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, selected: false);
			}
			else
			{
				RefreshSelectionForce(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshSelectionForce(int rowHandle)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!view.DataProviderBase.Selection.IsSelectionLocked)
			{
				SelectionChangedEventArgs e = new SelectionChangedEventArgs(CollectionChangeAction.Refresh, rowHandle);
				view.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			}
		}

		private CellBase[] GetSelectedCellsCore(DataViewBase view)
		{
			List<CellBase> list = new List<CellBase>();
			foreach (int item in from r in view.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedRows()
				orderby view.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(r)
				select r)
			{
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> selectedCells = GetSelectedCells(item, view);
				if (selectedCells == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (view.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(item) && selectedCells.Count == 0)
				{
					list.Add(CreateCell(item, null, view));
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase item2 in selectedCells.Keys.OrderBy((ColumnBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex))
				{
					if (item2.Visible)
					{
						list.Add(CreateCell(item, item2));
					}
				}
			}
			return Enumerable.ToArray(list);
		}

		public override CellBase[] GetSelectedCells()
		{
			if (view.IsRootView || !view.DataControl.IsOriginationDataControl())
			{
				return GetSelectedCellsCore(view);
			}
			List<CellBase> list = new List<CellBase>();
			foreach (DataControlBase detailClone in view.DataControl.DetailClones)
			{
				list.AddRange(GetSelectedCellsCore(detailClone.DataView));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal override CellBase[] GetDetailsSelectedCells()
		{
			int commonVisibleIndex = view.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(0));
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(view.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount - 1);
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = view;
			if (view.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider is MasterDetailProvider)
			{
				RowDetailInfoBase rowDetailInfoBase = ((MasterDetailProvider)view.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider).GetRowDetailInfoCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, createNewIfNotExist: false);
				while (rowDetailInfoBase != null && rowDetailInfoBase.IsExpanded)
				{
					DataViewBase dataViewBase2 = rowDetailInfoBase.FindFirstDetailView();
					if (dataViewBase2 != null)
					{
						rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = dataViewBase2.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(dataViewBase2.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount - 1);
						dataViewBase = dataViewBase2;
						if (!(dataViewBase2.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider is MasterDetailProvider))
						{
							break;
						}
						rowDetailInfoBase = ((MasterDetailProvider)dataViewBase2.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider).GetRowDetailInfoCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, createNewIfNotExist: false);
					}
					else
					{
						rowDetailInfoBase = null;
					}
				}
			}
			int commonVisibleIndex2 = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			DataControlBase dataControl = view.RootView.DataControl;
			List<CellBase> list = new List<CellBase>();
			for (int i = commonVisibleIndex; i <= commonVisibleIndex2; i++)
			{
				KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = dataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(i);
				if (keyValuePair.Key == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DataViewBase key = keyValuePair.Key;
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 = key.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(keyValuePair.Value);
				if (!key.SelectionStrategy.IsRowSelected(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!key.SelectionStrategy.IsCellSelection())
				{
					if (!(key.SelectionStrategy is SelectionStrategyRowBase))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (key.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2))
					{
						list.Add(CreateCell(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, null, key));
						continue;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < key.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; j++)
					{
						list.Add(CreateCell(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, key.VisibleColumnsCore[j], key));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(key.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedObject(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2) is Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> dictionary))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (key.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2) && dictionary.Count == 0)
					{
						list.Add(CreateCell(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, null, key));
						continue;
					}
					foreach (ColumnBase item in dictionary.Keys.OrderBy((ColumnBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex))
					{
						if (item.Visible)
						{
							list.Add(CreateCell(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, item));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return Enumerable.ToArray(list);
		}

		public override void ClearSelection()
		{
			if (view.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ITableView tableView = view as ITableView;
			if (view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked && tableView != null && tableView.CanRaiseCanUnselectCell() && view.DataControl != null)
			{
				int[] selectedRowHandles = view.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
				int[] array = selectedRowHandles;
				foreach (int rowHandle in array)
				{
					UnselectRow(rowHandle);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		protected void ClearSelectionCore()
		{
			view.SelectionStrategy.DoMasterDetailSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				view.DataControl.ClearMasterDetailSelection();
			}, range: false);
		}

		public override void SetCellsSelection(int startRowHandle, ColumnBase startColumn, int endRowHandle, ColumnBase endColumn, bool setSelected)
		{
			SetCellsSelectionCore(startRowHandle, startColumn.ActualVisibleIndex, endRowHandle, endColumn.ActualVisibleIndex, setSelected, useSelectionCount: false);
		}

		protected void SetCellsSelectionCore(int startRowHandle, int startColumnIndex, int endRowHandle, int endColumnIndex, bool setSelected, bool useSelectionCount)
		{
			BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				DataView.ViewBehavior.IterateCells(startRowHandle, startColumnIndex, endRowHandle, endColumnIndex, delegate(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
				{
					if (setSelected)
					{
						SelectCellCore(rowHandle, column, useSelectionCount);
					}
					else
					{
						UnselectCellCore(rowHandle, column, useSelectionCount);
					}
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSelection();
			}
		}

			{
				if (CurrentColumn != hitInfo.Column)

					return view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
