			updateSelectionBoundsLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected internal override void OnBeforeProcessMouseDown()
		{
			if (!view.IsEditing)
			{
				shouldProcessMouseDown = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (view.IsEditing && !shouldProcessMouseDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			shouldProcessMouseDown = false;
			ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = (ITableViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
			if (!IsValidRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle) || (oldRowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle && oldColumn == CurrentColumn && !IsElementFocused(tableViewHitInfo) && !IsCellSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn) && ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && (oldRowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle || ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers)))
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForce();
				return;
			}
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForce();
			}
			if (CurrentColumn != null && IsCellSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn) && Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginSelection();
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				ClearSelectionCore();
			}
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
				{
					OnInvertSelectionCore(tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator);
				}
				else if (view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle) || tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					SelectRow(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectCell(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn);
				}
			}
			else if (SelectionMasterAnchor != null)
			{
				int rowVisibleIndex = SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex;
				int commonVisibleIndex = view.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				double num = ((TableViewBehavior)SelectionMasterAnchor.View.ViewBehavior).FixedLeftColumnsWidth();
				KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = view.RootView.DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(commonVisibleIndex);
				if (keyValuePair.Key == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num2 = ((TableViewBehavior)keyValuePair.Key.ViewBehavior).FixedLeftColumnsWidth();
				double num3 = ((SelectionMasterAnchor.CoordinateX > num) ? SelectionMasterAnchor.OffsetX : 0.0);
				double num4 = ((((TableViewBehavior)view.RootView.ViewBehavior).LastMousePosition.X > num2) ? view.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset : 0.0);
				double startX = SelectionMasterAnchor.CoordinateX + num3;
				double endX = ((TableViewBehavior)view.RootView.ViewBehavior).LastMousePosition.X + num4;
				if (!tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					SelectMasterDetailRangeCell(rowVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex, startX, endX, view.RootView.DataControl, useSelectionCount: true, selectOtherStrategy: true);
				}
				else
				{
					if (rowVisibleIndex < 0 || commonVisibleIndex < 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					int num5 = Math.Min(rowVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex);
					int num6 = Math.Max(rowVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex);
					DataControlBase dataControl = view.RootView.DataControl;
					for (int i = num5; i <= num6; i++)
					{
						KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair2 = dataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(i);
						if (keyValuePair2.Key != null && keyValuePair2.Key.SelectionStrategy != null && keyValuePair2.Key.DataControl != null && keyValuePair2.Value >= 0)
						{
							keyValuePair2.Key.SelectionStrategy.SelectRow(keyValuePair2.Key.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(keyValuePair2.Value));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			EndSelection();
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionBounds()
		{
			if (!updateSelectionBoundsLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForce();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectionBoundsForce()
		{
			if (view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				selectionAnchor = ((IsValidRowHandle(view.FocusedRowHandle) && CurrentColumn != null) ? CreateCell(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn) : null);
				oldSelectionRectangle = System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty;
				oldRowHandle = view.FocusedRowHandle;
				oldColumn = CurrentColumn;
				ResetSelectionMasterAnchor();
			}
		}

		protected bool IsValidRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle != int.MinValue && rowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				return rowHandle != -2147483645;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> GetLastCommonIndex()
		{
			DataViewBase rootView = view.RootView;
			if (rootView == null || rootView.DataControl == null || rootView.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			rootView.GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out dataViewBase, out visibleIndex);
			if (dataViewBase == null || dataViewBase.DataControl == null)
			{
				return default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			}
			return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(dataViewBase, dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(dataViewBase.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex)));
		}

		public override void UpdateSelectionRect(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (SelectionMasterAnchor == null || column?.View?.DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (SelectionMasterAnchor.IsLastRow ? (SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex + 1) : SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex);
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = view.RootView.DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(num);
			int num2 = column.View.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandle);
			double num3 = ((TableViewBehavior)SelectionMasterAnchor.View.ViewBehavior).FixedLeftColumnsWidth();
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair2 = view.RootView.DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(num2);
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (keyValuePair2.Key == null || num2 < 0)
			{
				flag2 = false;
				if (keyValuePair.Key == null || keyValuePair.Value < 0 || (!HasDetailRootViews && SelectionMasterAnchor.IsLastRow))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					num = SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex;
				}
				keyValuePair2 = GetLastCommonIndex();
				if (keyValuePair2.Key == null)
				{
					if (keyValuePair.Key == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					keyValuePair2 = keyValuePair;
				}
				num2 = keyValuePair2.Value;
			}
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				num = SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					keyValuePair = GetLastCommonIndex();
					if (keyValuePair.Key == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					num = keyValuePair.Value;
				}
			}
			double num4 = ((TableViewBehavior)keyValuePair2.Key.ViewBehavior).FixedLeftColumnsWidth();
			double num5 = ((SelectionMasterAnchor.CoordinateX > num3) ? SelectionMasterAnchor.OffsetX : 0.0);
			double num6 = ((((TableViewBehavior)column.View.RootView.ViewBehavior).LastMousePosition.X > num4) ? column.View.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset : 0.0);
			double startX = SelectionMasterAnchor.CoordinateX + num5;
			double endX = ((TableViewBehavior)column.View.RootView.ViewBehavior).LastMousePosition.X + num6;
			SelectMasterDetailRangeCell(flag ? (num + 1) : num, flag ? int.MinValue : num2, startX, endX, view.RootView.DataControl, useSelectionCount: true, selectOtherStrategy: true, SelectionMasterAnchor.IsLastRow);
		}

		public override void OnBeforeProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
