			updateSelectionBoundsLocker.Lock();
			oldRowHandle = view.FocusedRowHandle;
			oldColumn = CurrentColumn;
		}

		public override void OnAfterProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Next && e.Key != Key.Prior && e.Key != Key.F3)
			{
				OnNavigationComplete(e.Key == Key.Tab);
			}
		}

		public override void OnNavigationComplete(bool isTabPressed)
		{
			OnNavigationCompleteCore(isTabPressed);
			updateSelectionBoundsLocker.Unlock();
		}

		private void OnNavigationCompleteCore(bool isTabPressed)
		{
			if (oldRowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle && oldColumn == CurrentColumn)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			SelectionStrategyCellBase selectionStrategyCellBase = null;
			if (view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				dataViewBase = view;
				selectionStrategyCellBase = this;
			}
			else
			{
				dataViewBase = view.FocusedView;
				selectionStrategyCellBase = dataViewBase.SelectionStrategy as SelectionStrategyCellBase;
			}
			if (!IsValidRowHandle(dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				SelectionMasterAnchor = null;
				return;
			}
			BeginSelection();
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) || isTabPressed))
			{
				ClearSelectionCore();
			}
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) || isTabPressed)
			{
				if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
				{
					if (selectionStrategyCellBase != null && dataViewBase.DataControl != null)
					{
						selectionStrategyCellBase.SelectCell(dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle, dataViewBase.DataControl.CurrentColumn);
					}
					else if (dataViewBase.SelectionStrategy != null)
					{
						dataViewBase.SelectionStrategy.SelectRow(dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle);
					}
				}
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForce();
			}
			else
			{
				if (dataViewBase != view || SelectionMasterAnchor == null)
				{
					ResetSelectionMasterAnchor(dataViewBase);
				}
				int rowVisibleIndex = SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex;
				int commonVisibleIndex = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle);
				double startX = SelectionMasterAnchor.CoordinateX + SelectionMasterAnchor.OffsetX;
				double selectedColumnOffset = ((ITableView)dataViewBase).TableViewBehavior.GetSelectedColumnOffset(dataViewBase.VisibleColumnsCore[dataViewBase.NavigationIndex]);
				SelectMasterDetailRangeCell(rowVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex, startX, selectedColumnOffset, dataViewBase.RootView.DataControl, useSelectionCount: true, selectOtherStrategy: true);
			}
			EndSelection();
		}

		protected void SelectAnchorRange(int rowHandle1, int colIndex1, int rowHandle2, int colIndex2)
		{
			if (rowHandle1 > rowHandle2)
			{
				int num = rowHandle1;
				rowHandle1 = rowHandle2;
				rowHandle2 = num;
			}
			if (colIndex1 > colIndex2)
			{
				int num2 = colIndex1;
				colIndex1 = colIndex2;
				colIndex2 = num2;
			}
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rect = new System.Drawing.Rectangle(colIndex1, rowHandle1, colIndex2 - colIndex1 + 1, rowHandle2 - rowHandle1 + 1);
			if (!oldSelectionRectangle.IsEmpty && oldSelectionRectangle.IntersectsWith(rect))
			{
				SetCellsSelectionCore(oldSelectionRectangle.Top, oldSelectionRectangle.Left, oldSelectionRectangle.Bottom - 1, oldSelectionRectangle.Right - 1, setSelected: false, useSelectionCount: true);
			}
			oldSelectionRectangle = rect;
			SetCellsSelectionCore(rowHandle1, colIndex1, rowHandle2, colIndex2, setSelected: true, useSelectionCount: true);
		}

		public override void OnInvertSelection()
		{
			OnInvertSelectionCore(invertSelectionForEntireRow: false);
		}

		protected void OnInvertSelectionCore(bool invertSelectionForEntireRow)
		{
			if (!IsValidRowHandle(view.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle) || invertSelectionForEntireRow)
			{
				if (IsRowSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle))
				{
					UnselectRow(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectRow(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
			}
			else if (IsCellSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn))
			{
				UnselectCell(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectCell(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn);
			}
		}

		public override bool UpdateBorderForFocusedElementCore()
		{
			if (view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle) && (!IsRowSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle) || view.ShowFocusedRectangle))
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnGroupRow();
				return true;
			}
			if (view.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647 || view.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483645)
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
				return true;
			}
			if (CurrentColumn != null && (!IsCellSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn) || view.ShowFocusedRectangle))
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract CellBase CreateCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, DataViewBase view = null);

		protected override object GetSelection()
		{
			Dictionary<int, List<ColumnBase>> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, List<ColumnBase>>();
			int[] selectedRows = view.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedRows();
			foreach (int num in selectedRows)
			{
				dictionary[num] = new List<ColumnBase>();
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> selectedCells = GetSelectedCells(num, view);
				if (selectedCells == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase key in selectedCells.Keys)
				{
					dictionary[num].Add(key);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState(object oldSelection)
		{
			Dictionary<int, List<ColumnBase>> selection = (Dictionary<int, List<ColumnBase>>)oldSelection;
			foreach (int rowHandle in selection.Keys)
			{
				view.UpdateRowDataByRowHandle(rowHandle, delegate(RowData rowData)
				{
					Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> selectedCells = GetSelectedCells(rowHandle, view);
					rowData.UpdateIsSelected(!DataView.ActualAllowCellMerge && (selectedCells != null || IsRowSelected(rowHandle)));
					foreach (ColumnBase item in selection[rowHandle])
					{
						if (rowData.CellDataCache.ContainsKey(item))
						{
							((GridCellData)rowData.CellDataCache[item]).UpdateIsSelected(rowHandle, selectedCells?.Keys.Contains(item) ?? false);
						}
					}
				});
			}
			if (DataView.ActualAllowCellMerge && DataView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell)
			{
				DataView.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
				(DataView as ITableView)?.TableViewBehavior.MergingTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsCellSelection()
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void ResetSelectionMasterAnchor()
		{
			ResetSelectionMasterAnchor(view);
		}

		protected internal override void ResetSelectionMasterAnchorInternal()
		{
			base.ResetSelectionMasterAnchorInternal();
			ResetSelectionMasterAnchor();
		}

		private void ResetSelectionMasterAnchor(DataViewBase currentView)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = currentView.DataControl.CurrentColumn ?? ((currentView.VisibleColumnsCore.Count > 0) ? currentView.VisibleColumnsCore[0] : null);
			if (columnBase != null)
			{
				int rowHandle = ((!currentView.IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds()) ? ((ITableView)currentView).TableViewBehavior.GetTopRowHandle() : currentView.FocusedRowHandle);
				int commonVisibleIndex = currentView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandle);
				double num = ((currentView.RootDataPresenter != null) ? currentView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset : 0.0);
				double coordinateX = ((ITableView)currentView).TableViewBehavior.GetSelectedColumnOffset(columnBase) - num;
				double x = ((TableViewBehavior)currentView.RootView.ViewBehavior).LastMousePosition.X;
				ColumnBase columnByCoordinateWithOffset = ((ITableView)currentView).TableViewBehavior.GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(x);
				if (columnByCoordinateWithOffset == columnBase)
				{
					coordinateX = x;
				}
				base.OldMasterRectangle = null;
				SelectionMasterAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(currentView, rowHandle, columnBase)
				{
					OffsetX = num,
					CoordinateX = coordinateX,
					RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex
				};
			}
		}

		public override void UnselectCellsByColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			List<CellBase> list = (from x in GetSelectedCells()
				where x.ColumnCore == column
				select x).ToList();
			BeginSelection();
			foreach (CellBase item in list)
			{
				UnselectCell(item.RowHandleCore, column);
			}
			EndSelection();
		}

		protected internal override void UnselectCellsOnColumnsClear()
		{
			ClearSelection();
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyCell : SelectionStrategyCellBase
	{
		protected TableView TableView => base.DataView as TableView;

		public SelectionStrategyCell(TableView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void CopyToClipboard()
		{
			TableView.CopySelectedCellsToClipboard();
		}

		protected override CellBase CreateCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, DataViewBase view = null)
		{
			return ((ITableView)TableView).CreateGridCell(rowHandle, column, view);
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			base.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(originalSource);
			if (base.SelectionMasterAnchor == null || !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = ((ITableView)TableView.RootView).CalcHitInfo(originalSource);
				int commonVisibleIndex = TableView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(tableViewHitInfo.RowHandle);
				double x = ((ITableView)TableView.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
				double offset = TableView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
				if (tableViewHitInfo.InRow || tableViewHitInfo.IsDataArea || tableViewHitInfo.IsRowCell || tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					base.OldMasterRectangle = null;
					base.SelectionMasterAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(TableView, tableViewHitInfo.RowHandle, tableViewHitInfo.Column)
					{
						OffsetX = offset,
						CoordinateX = x,
						RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex,
						IsLastRow = (tableViewHitInfo.RowHandle == int.MinValue)
					};
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyCellRectangle : SelectionStrategyCell
	{
		private ITableViewHitInfo hitInfo;

		public SelectionStrategyCellRectangle(TableView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			base.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(originalSource);
			hitInfo = ((ITableView)base.TableView.RootView).CalcHitInfo(originalSource);
			Tuple<int, ColumnBase> actualRowAndColumn = SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper.GetActualRowAndColumn(hitInfo, (hitInfo.Column != null) ? hitInfo.Column.View : view);
			if (actualRowAndColumn != null)
			{
				SetOldRowAndColumn(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = (ITableViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
			bool flag = tableViewHitInfo.InRow || tableViewHitInfo.IsDataArea || tableViewHitInfo.IsRowCell || tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator;
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = ((hitInfo.Column != null) ? hitInfo.Column.View : view);
			Tuple<int, ColumnBase> actualRowAndColumn = SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper.GetActualRowAndColumn((ITableViewHitInfo)hitInfo, dataViewBase);
			if (actualRowAndColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (actualRowAndColumn.Item1 == dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle && actualRowAndColumn.Item2 == base.CurrentColumn)
			{
				flag2 = Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed;
				if (!flag2)
				{
					base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDownCore(hitInfo);
					hitInfo = null;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (dataViewBase.IsEditing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsValidRowHandle(actualRowAndColumn.Item1))
			{
				if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
				{
					ClearSelectionCore();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (base.SelectionMasterAnchor == null)
			{
				int commonVisibleIndex = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(actualRowAndColumn.Item1);
				double x = ((ITableView)dataViewBase.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
				double offset = dataViewBase.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
				base.SelectionMasterAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(dataViewBase, actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2)
				{
					OffsetX = offset,
					CoordinateX = x,
					RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex
				};
			}
			if (base.SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex == dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(actualRowAndColumn.Item1) && base.SelectionMasterAnchor.ColumnCore == actualRowAndColumn.Item2 && actualRowAndColumn.Item2 != null && !IsElementFocused(tableViewHitInfo) && !IsCellSelected(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2) && ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && !flag2 && (base.SelectionMasterAnchor.RowVisibleIndex == dataViewBase.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(actualRowAndColumn.Item1) || ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers)))
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForceCore(tableViewHitInfo, actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
				return;
			}
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && flag)
			{
				UpdateSelectionBoundsForceCore(tableViewHitInfo, actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
			}
			if (actualRowAndColumn.Item2 != null && IsCellSelected(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2) && Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginSelection();
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				if (CanClearSelesction(hitInfo))
				{
					ClearSelectionCore();
				}
				if (flag2 && tableViewHitInfo != null && !tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					SelectCell(dataViewBase.FocusedRowHandle, base.CurrentColumn);
				}
			}
			if (tableViewHitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
			{
				SelectRow(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			}
			EndSelection();
		}

		private bool CanClearSelesction(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.IsDataArea)
			{
				return hitInfo.InRow;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectionBoundsForceCore(ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo, int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			selectionAnchor = ((IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle) && column != null) ? CreateCell(rowHandle, column) : null);
			oldSelectionRectangle = System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty;
			oldRowHandle = rowHandle;
			oldColumn = column;
			int rowHandle2 = ((hitInfo.RowHandle != int.MinValue) ? hitInfo.RowHandle : rowHandle);
			int commonVisibleIndex = base.TableView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandle2);
			double offset = base.TableView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
			double x = ((ITableView)base.TableView.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
			base.OldMasterRectangle = null;
			base.SelectionMasterAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(base.TableView, rowHandle2, hitInfo.Column)
			{
				OffsetX = offset,
				CoordinateX = x,
				RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex,
				IsLastRow = (hitInfo.RowHandle == int.MinValue)
			};
		}

		public override void UpdateSelectionRect(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (hitInfo == null)
			{
				base.UpdateSelectionRect(rowHandle, column);
				return;
			}
			if (base.SelectionMasterAnchor == null)
			{
				Tuple<int, ColumnBase> actualRowAndColumn = SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper.GetActualRowAndColumn(hitInfo, (hitInfo.Column != null) ? hitInfo.Column.View : view);
				if (actualRowAndColumn == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				selectionAnchor = CreateCell(actualRowAndColumn.Item1, actualRowAndColumn.Item2);
				oldSelectionRectangle = System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty;
				int commonVisibleIndex = base.TableView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				double offset = base.TableView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
				double x = ((ITableView)base.TableView.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
				base.OldMasterRectangle = null;
				base.SelectionMasterAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(base.TableView, hitInfo.RowHandle, hitInfo.Column)
				{
					OffsetX = offset,
					CoordinateX = x,
					RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex
				};
			}
			base.UpdateSelectionRect(rowHandle, column);
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyRow : SelectionStrategyRowBase
	{
		private int oldFocusedRowHandle = int.MinValue;

		protected bool IsRightMouseButtonPressed => Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed;

		protected SelectionActionBase SelectionAction
		{
			get
			{
				return RootView.GlobalSelectionAction;
			}
			set
			{
				RootView.SetSelectionAction(value);
			}
		}

		protected GridViewBase GridView => (GridViewBase)view;

		protected GridViewBase RootView => (GridViewBase)view.RootView;

		protected GridControl Grid => (GridControl)base.DataControl;

		protected int GroupRowCount => ((DataController)base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupRowCount;

		protected bool IsAllItemsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetAllItemsSelected().HasValue)
				{
					return GetAllItemsSelected().Value;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsAllItemsUnselected => base.SelectedRowCount == 0;

		protected bool IsOneDataRowSelected
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SelectedRowCount == 1)
				{
					return !Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(GetSelectedRows()[0]);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public SelectionStrategyRow(GridViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void SelectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (CanSelectRowRecursively(rowHandle))
			{
				SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectRowCore(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		public override void UnselectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (CanSelectRowRecursively(rowHandle))
			{
				UnselectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				UnselectRowCore(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		public override void ClearSelection()
		{
			if (view.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked && view.CanRaiseCanUnselectRow() && view.DataControl != null && view.DataControl.DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				int[] selectedRowHandles = view.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
				int[] array = selectedRowHandles;
				foreach (int rowHandle in array)
				{
					UnselectRow(rowHandle);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		public override bool IsRowSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			return view.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelected(rowHandle);
		}

		public override SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			if (rowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle && view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				return SelectionState.Focused;
			}
			return SelectionState.Selected;
		}

		protected override SelectionState GetCellSelectionStateCore(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return base.GetCellSelectionStateCore(rowHandle, isFocused, isSelected, column);
		}

		public override int[] GetSelectedRows()
		{
			return view.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedRows();
		}

		public override void OnAssignedToGrid()
		{
			base.OnAssignedToGrid();
			GridView.SetSelectionAnchor();
		}

		protected override void OnAssignedToGridCore()
		{
			if (base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.Selection.Count != 0)
			{
				UpdateSelection();
			}
			else if (view.IsRootView)
			{
				SetFocusedRowSelected();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSelection()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectionChangedEventArgs e = new SelectionChangedEventArgs(CollectionChangeAction.Refresh, int.MinValue);
			GridView.OnSelectionChanged(e);
		}

		public override void SetFocusedRowSelected()
		{
			base.DataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
			if (base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == 0 && (base.DataControl.SelectedItems == null || base.DataControl.SelectedItems.Count == 0))
			{
				return;
			}
			ISelectionController selection = view.DataProviderBase.Selection;
			selection.BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				selection.Clear();
				selection.SetSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle, selected: true);
				selection.SetActuallyChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				selection.EndSelection();
			}
		}

		public override void BeginSelection()
		{
			base.BeginSelection();
			view.DataProviderBase.Selection.BeginSelection();
		}

		public override void EndSelection()
		{
			if (view.DataProviderBase.Selection.IsSelectionLocked)
			{
				view.DataProviderBase.Selection.EndSelection();
			}
			base.EndSelection();
		}

		public override void BeginRangeSelection()
		{
			base.BeginRangeSelection();
			BeginRangeSelectionCore();
		}

		public override void EndRangeSelection()
		{
			base.EndRangeSelection();
			EndRangeSelectionCore();
		}

		public override void OnFocusedRowHandleChanged(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (CanExecuteSelectionActionOnFocusedRowHandleChanged())
			{
				ExecuteSelectionAction();
			}
			else
			{
				GridView.SetSelectionAnchor();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanExecuteSelectionActionOnFocusedRowHandleChanged()
		{
			if (SelectionAction != null)
			{
				return SelectionAction.CanFocusChangeDeleteAction;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void ExecuteSelectionAction()
		{
			GridView.ExecuteSelectionAction();
		}

		public override void SelectRowForce()
		{
			if (base.IsExtendedMode)
			{
				SelectionAction = new OnlyThisSelectionAction(GridView);
			}
		}

		public sealed override void OnInvertSelection()
		{
			InvertSelectionForRow(view.FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		protected void InvertSelectionForRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			SetIsRowSelectedInternal(rowHandle, !IsRowSelected(rowHandle));
		}

		protected virtual void SetIsRowSelectedInternal(int rowHandle, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (CanSelectRowRecursively(rowHandle))
			{
				if (isSelected)
				{
					SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				}
				else if (IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
				{
					UnselectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				}
			}
			else if (isSelected)
			{
				if (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanSelectRow(rowHandle))
				{
					view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, isSelected);
				}
			}
			else if (!view.CanSelectLocker.IsLocked || view.RaiseCanUnselectRow(rowHandle))
			{
				view.DataProviderBase.Selection.SetSelected(rowHandle, isSelected);
			}
		}

		public override bool UpdateBorderForFocusedElementCore()
		{
			if (view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle) && (!IsRowSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle) || view.ShowFocusedRectangle))
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnGroupRow();
				return true;
			}
			if (view.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647 || view.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483645)
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
				return true;
			}
			if (!IsRowSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle) || view.ShowFocusedRectangle)
			{
				if (RootView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell)
				{
					view.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
				}
				else
				{
					view.SetFocusedRectangleOnRow();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void CopyToClipboard()
		{
			int[] array = GetSelectedRows();
			if (array.Length == 0 && !view.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle)
			{
				array = new int[1] { view.FocusedRowHandle };
			}
			GridView.DataControl.CopyRowsToClipboard(array);
		}

		public override void CopyMasterDetailToClipboard()
		{
			Grid.CopyAllSelectedItemsToClipboard();
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldProcessMouseClick(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (Grid.AllowRecursiveSelectionForCollapsedGroups && IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) && RootView.IsExpandButton(hitInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hitInfo.RowHandle != int.MinValue)
			{
				if (base.IsMultipleMode)
				{
					return !RootView.IsExpandButton(hitInfo);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			IDataViewHitInfo dataViewHitInfo = view.RootView.CalcHitInfoCore(originalSource);
			SelectionAction = null;
			if (!ShouldProcessMouseClick(dataViewHitInfo) || base.IsMultipleMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dataViewHitInfo.RowHandle == -2147483645)
			{
				view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
				return;
			}
			int rowHandleByTreeElement = GridView.GetRowHandleByTreeElement(originalSource);
			if (!CanInvertSelection(dataViewHitInfo))
			{
				SelectRowOnLMouseDown(rowHandleByTreeElement, originalSource);
			}
		}

		public override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!base.HasValidationError && ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo) && (!IsRightMouseButtonPressed || (base.IsMultipleMode && !IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle))))
			{
				int rowHandle = hitInfo.RowHandle;
				if (CanInvertSelection(hitInfo))
				{
					InvertSelectionOnClick(hitInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InvertSelectionOnClick(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
			if (CanInvertSelectionOnLMouseDown(hitInfo))
			{
				InvertSelectionForRow(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectionAction = new InvertSelectionOnMouseUpAction(GridView);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanInvertSelectionOnLMouseDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (view.IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) && !base.IsControlPressed)
			{
				return base.IsShiftPressed;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SelectRowOnLMouseDown(int rowHandle, DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			bool flag = RootView.ViewBehavior.IsRowIndicator(originalSource) && !IsRightMouseButtonPressed;
			if (CanSelectRowOnLMouseDown(rowHandle, flag))
			{
				SelectRowOnLMouseDown(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				CreateMouseSelectionActions(rowHandle, flag);
			}
		}

		public override void CreateMouseSelectionActions(int rowHandle, bool isIndicatorPressed)
		{
			if (((GridViewBase)view).GlobalSelectionAnchor == null && view.RootView.FocusedView != null)
			{
				((GridViewBase)view.RootView.FocusedView).SetSelectionAnchor();
			}
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
				SelectionAction = new AddRowsToSelectionAction(GridView);
				return;
			}
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				SelectionAction = new AddOneRowToSelectionAction(GridView);
				return;
			}
			switch (rowHandle)
			{
			case -2147483647:
				view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
				SelectionAction = new OnlyThisSelectionAction(GridView);
				return;
			case -2147483645:
				view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
				return;
			}
			if (view.IsRowSelected(rowHandle) && !isIndicatorPressed)
			{
				if (GridView.GetSelectedRowHandlesCore().Length > 1)
				{
					SelectionAction = new OnlyThisSelectionMouseUpAction(GridView);
				}
				else
				{
					view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
				}
				return;
			}
			SelectionAction = new OnlyThisSelectionAction(GridView);
			if (GridView.GetSelectedRowHandlesCore().Length > 1)
			{
				view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = true;
			}
		}

		private bool CanSelectRowOnLMouseDown(int rowHandle, bool isIndicatorPressed)
		{
			if (base.IsControlPressed || rowHandle != view.FocusedRowHandle || !view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !view.IsRowSelected(rowHandle) || isIndicatorPressed;
		}

		private void SelectRowOnLMouseDown(int rowHandle)
		{
			BeginRangeSelection();
			try
			{
				ClearMasterDetailSelection();
				GridView.SetSelectionAnchor();
				if (rowHandle != -2147483645 && rowHandle != -2147483647)
				{
					SelectRow(rowHandle);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (view.FocusedRowHandle != GridView.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e))
			{
				SelectionAction = null;
			}
			else if (SelectionAction != null && !SelectionAction.CanFocusChangeDeleteAction)
			{
				ExecuteSelectionAction();
			}
		}

		public override void OnBeforeProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			oldFocusedRowHandle = view.FocusedRowHandle;
			GetKeyboardSelectionAction(GridView, e).Do(delegate(SelectionActionBase action)
			{
				SelectionAction = action;
			});
		}

		internal static SelectionActionBase GetKeyboardSelectionAction(GridViewBase view, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsNavigationKey(e))
			{
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
				{
					return new AddRowsToSelectionAction(view);
				}
				if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
				{
					return new OnlyThisSelectionAction(view);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void OnAfterProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Next && e.Key != Key.Prior)
			{
				OnNavigationComplete(e.Key == Key.Tab);
			}
		}

		protected static bool IsNavigationKey(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Up && e.Key != Key.Down && e.Key != Key.Prior && e.Key != Key.Next && e.Key != Key.Right && e.Key != Key.Left && e.Key != Key.Tab && e.Key != Key.Home)
			{
				return e.Key == Key.End;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnNavigationComplete(bool IsTabPressed)
		{
			if (oldFocusedRowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				SelectionAction = null;
			}
		}

		public override void OnNavigationCanceled()
		{
			SelectionAction = null;
		}

		protected override void SelectAllCore()
		{
			BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				ClearSelection();
				if (GridView != null && GridView.IsPagingMode)
				{
					for (int i = GridView.FirstVisibleIndexOnPage; i <= GridView.LastVisibleIndexOnPage; i++)
					{
						SelectRow(Grid.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndex(i));
					}
					return;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < TotalRowCount; j++)
				{
					int controllerRow = base.DataProviderBase.GetControllerRow(j);
					SelectRow(controllerRow);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSelection();
			}
		}

		protected bool OnAfterMouseLeftButtonCore(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (base.HasValidationError || IsRightMouseButtonPressed || !ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowHandle = hitInfo.RowHandle;
			if (CanInvertSelection(hitInfo))
			{
				InvertSelectionOnClick(hitInfo);
				return !view.IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void SelectRowRecursively(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				SelectAllItems(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectRowCore(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		internal override void UnselectRowRecursively(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				UnselectAllItems(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				UnselectRowCore(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SelectAllItems(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				IterateChildren(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
				{
					SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				});
				SelectRowCore(groupRowHandle);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void UnselectAllItems(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				IterateChildren(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
				{
					UnselectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				});
				UnselectRowCore(groupRowHandle);
			});
		}

		protected void IterateChildren(int groupRowHandle, Action<int> action)
		{
			GroupRowInfo groupRowInfoByHandle = Grid.DataController.GroupInfo.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(groupRowHandle);
			if (groupRowInfoByHandle == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Grid.DataController.GroupInfo.IsLastLevel(groupRowInfoByHandle))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < groupRowInfoByHandle.ChildControllerRowCount; i++)
				{
					action(Grid.GetChildRowHandle(groupRowHandle, i));
				}
				return;
			}
			List<GroupRowInfo> list = new List<GroupRowInfo>();
			Grid.DataController.GroupInfo.GetChildrenGroups(groupRowInfoByHandle, (IList<GroupRowInfo>)list);
			foreach (GroupRowInfo item in list)
			{
				action(item.Handle);
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanSelectRowRecursively(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid.AllowRecursiveSelectionForCollapsedGroups && Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return !Grid.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyCheckBoxRow : SelectionStrategyRow
	{
		internal Locker CheckBoxSelectionChangedLocker = new Locker();

		private Locker UpdateGroupRowsLocker = new Locker();

		private SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper helper;

		private TableView View => (TableView)view;

		protected override int TotalRowCount => base.DataRowCount + base.GroupRowCount;

		internal override bool CanSelectRowRecursively(int rowHandle)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public SelectionStrategyCheckBoxRow(TableView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			helper = new SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper(this);
		}

		public override bool? GetAllItemsSelected(int rowHandle, out bool isSelectEnabled, out bool isUnselectEnabled)
		{
			return AreAllDescendantsSelected(rowHandle, out isSelectEnabled, out isUnselectEnabled);
		}

		private int GetRootGroupHandle(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			return ((DataController)base.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo.GetGroupRowInfoByHandle(groupRowHandle).RootGroup.Handle;
		}

		private void DoLockedSelectionAction(Action action)
		{
			UpdateGroupRowsLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				DoSelectionAction(delegate
				{
					action();
				});
			});
		}

		private bool IsRowSelectedOrUnselected(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			return e.Action != CollectionChangeAction.Refresh;
		}

		private bool IsDataRowSelectedOrUnselected(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(e.ControllerRow))
			{
				return IsRowSelectedOrUnselected(e);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsDataRowCheckBox(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			return hitInfo.Column == View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn;
		}

		private bool IsGroupRowPressed(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			return base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(hitInfo.RowHandle);
		}

		protected override bool ShouldProcessMouseClick(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo.RowHandle == -2147483645)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (View.RetainSelectionOnClickOutsideCheckBoxSelector)
			{
				return IsDataRowCheckBox(hitInfo);
			}
			if (IsGroupRowPressed(hitInfo) && !base.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo);
		}

		protected override bool CanInvertSelection(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (base.CanInvertSelection(hitInfo))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsDataRowCheckBox(hitInfo))
			{
				return !base.IsShiftPressed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanInvertSelectionOnLMouseDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (IsDataRowCheckBox(hitInfo))
			{
				if (!base.IsShiftPressed)
				{
					return base.IsControlPressed;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanInvertSelectionOnLMouseDown(hitInfo);
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			View.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
			base.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(originalSource);
		}

		protected override void SelectAllRows()
		{
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				SelectDataRows();
				SelectGroupRows();
			});
		}

		protected void SelectGroupRows()
		{
			GroupRowInfoCollection groupInfo = ((DataController)base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.GroupRowCount; i++)
			{
				SelectRowCore(((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)groupInfo)[i].Handle);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAssignedToGridCore()
		{
			UpdateSelection();
		}

		public override void SetFocusedRowSelected()
		{
			ClearSelectedItems();
		}

		public override void SelectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
		}

		protected override void SelectAllItems(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			DoLockedSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				IterateChildren(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
				{
					SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				});
				UpdateGroupRow(groupRowHandle, true);
			});
			CheckRowSelectionifNotLocked(groupRowHandle);
		}

		private void CheckRowSelectionifNotLocked(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			if (!UpdateGroupRowsLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				CheckRowSelection(GetRootGroupHandle(groupRowHandle));
			}
		}

		public override void UnselectRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			UnselectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
		}

		protected override void UnselectAllItems(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			DoLockedSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				IterateChildren(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
				{
					UnselectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				});
				UpdateGroupRow(groupRowHandle, false);
			});
			CheckRowSelectionifNotLocked(groupRowHandle);
		}

		public override void SelectAll()
		{
			SelectAllRows();
		}

		protected override bool ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace())
			{
				if (base.DataControl.CurrentColumn != View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
				{
					return base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(View.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void SetIsRowSelectedInternal(int rowHandle, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (isSelected)
			{
				SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				helper.AddSelected(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				UnselectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
				helper.RemoveSelected(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecuteSelectionActionOnFocusedRowHandleChanged()
		{
			if (base.CanExecuteSelectionActionOnFocusedRowHandleChanged())
			{
				if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(View.FocusedRowHandle))
				{
					return !ModifierKeysHelper.NoModifiers(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers());
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void SelectRange(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle)
		{
			HashSet<int> rootGroups = new HashSet<int>();
			DoLockedSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				SelectRangeCore(startRowHandle, endRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
				{
					if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
					{
						if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandle))
						{
							return;
						}
						SelectRowRecursively(rowHandle);
					}
					else
					{
						SelectRowCore(rowHandle);
					}
					int parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(rowHandle);
					if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(parentRowHandle))
					{
						rootGroups.Add(GetRootGroupHandle(parentRowHandle));
					}
				});
				UpdateGroupRowsSelection((IEnumerable<int>)rootGroups);
			});
		}

		public override void SelectOnlyThisRange(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle)
		{
			DoLockedSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				base.DataControl.UnselectAll();
				SetGroupRowsSelection(isSelected: false);
				SelectRange(startRowHandle, endRowHandle);
				if (view != null && view.ShowSelectionRectangle)
				{
					helper.SelectRowRange(startRowHandle, endRowHandle);
				}
			});
		}

		public override bool? GetAllItemsSelected(out bool isSelectedEnabled, out bool isUnselectEnabled)
		{
			isSelectedEnabled = true;
			isUnselectEnabled = true;
			if (view != null && (view.CanRaiseCanSelectRow() || view.CanRaiseCanUnselectRow()))
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				for (int i = 1; i <= base.GroupRowCount; i++)
				{
					num4 = (view.RaiseCanSelectRow(-i) ? (num4 + 1) : num4);
					if (view.IsRowSelected(-i))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < base.DataRowCount; j++)
				{
					if (view.RaiseCanSelectRow(j))
					{
						num4++;
					}
					else
					{
						num2++;
					}
					num3 = (view.RaiseCanUnselectRow(-j) ? num3 : num3++);
					if (view.IsRowSelected(j))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				isUnselectEnabled = num3 != base.DataRowCount;
				isSelectedEnabled = num2 != base.DataRowCount;
				return SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(num, num4);
			}
			return SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(base.SelectedRowCount, TotalRowCount);
		}

		public override bool? GetAllItemsSelected()
		{
			bool isSelectedEnabled = true;
			bool isUnselectEnabled = true;
			return GetAllItemsSelected(out isSelectedEnabled, out isUnselectEnabled);
		}

		public override void SelectRowRange(IEnumerable<int> selectedRowsHandles)
		{
			if (!view.ShowSelectionRectangle)
			{
				base.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
				return;
			}
			if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
				return;
			}
			BeginRangeSelection();
			helper.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
			EndRangeSelection();
		}

		public override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!view.ShowSelectionRectangle || IsDataRowCheckBox(hitInfo))
			{
				base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
			}
			else if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
			}
			else if (!base.HasValidationError && !base.IsRightMouseButtonPressed && ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo) && !view.IsEditing)
			{
				ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = hitInfo as ITableViewHitInfo;
				BeginRangeSelection();
				if (hitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
				}
				else if (ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo))
				{
					helper.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo, base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonCore, base.DataControl);
				}
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool? AreAllChildrenSelected(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			if (base.IsAllItemsUnselected)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsAllItemsSelected)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int childRowCount = base.Grid.GetChildRowCount(groupRowHandle);
			int selectedChildrenCount = 0;
			IterateChildren(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
			{
				if (View.IsRowSelected(rowHandle) || !View.RaiseCanSelectRow(rowHandle))
				{
					selectedChildrenCount++;
				}
			});
			return SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(selectedChildrenCount, childRowCount);
		}

		private bool? HasOneSelectedChild(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			if (!View.CanRaiseCanSelectRow())
			{
				int childRowCount = base.Grid.GetChildRowCount(groupRowHandle);
				if (childRowCount == 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return null;
			}
			return AreAllChildrenSelected(groupRowHandle);
		}

		private bool? AreAllDescendantsSelected(int groupRowHandle, out bool isSelectEnabled, out bool isUnselectEnabled)
		{
			isSelectEnabled = true;
			isUnselectEnabled = true;
			int rowCount = 0;
			if (view != null && view.CanRaiseCanSelectRow())
			{
				rowCount = GetDescendantsCanSelectedCount(groupRowHandle, out isSelectEnabled, out isUnselectEnabled);
			}
			if (base.IsAllItemsUnselected)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsAllItemsSelected)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.IsOneDataRowSelected)
			{
				return AreAllDescendantsSelected(groupRowHandle, base.Grid.GetSelectedRowHandles()[0]);
			}
			if (view != null && view.CanRaiseCanSelectRow())
			{
				return SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(GetSelectedDescendantsCount(groupRowHandle), rowCount);
			}
			return SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(GetSelectedDescendantsCount(groupRowHandle), GetDescendantsCount(groupRowHandle));
		}

		private bool? AreAllDescendantsSelected(int groupRowHandle, int selectedRowHandle)
		{
			int parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(selectedRowHandle);
			if (parentRowHandle == groupRowHandle)
			{
				return HasOneSelectedChild(groupRowHandle);
			}
			do
			{
				parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(parentRowHandle);
				if (!base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(parentRowHandle))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			while (parentRowHandle != groupRowHandle);
			return AreAllDescendantsSelected(AreAllChildrenSelected(groupRowHandle), hasSelectedDescendant: true);
		}

		private int GetDescendantsCount(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			return GetDescendantsCount(groupRowHandle, (int dataRowHandle) => true);
		}

		private int GetDescendantsCanSelectedCount(int groupRowHandle, out bool isSelectEnabled, out bool isUnselectEnabled)
		{
			bool isEnabledCalc = false;
			int total = 0;
			int totalUnselected = 0;
			int descendantsCount = GetDescendantsCount(groupRowHandle, delegate(int dataRowHandle)
			{
				total++;
				bool flag = view.RaiseCanSelectRow(dataRowHandle);
				isEnabledCalc |= flag;
				if (!view.RaiseCanUnselectRow(dataRowHandle))
				{
					totalUnselected++;
				}
				return flag;
			});
			isSelectEnabled = isEnabledCalc;
			isUnselectEnabled = total != totalUnselected;
			return descendantsCount;
		}

		private int GetSelectedDescendantsCount(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			return GetDescendantsCount(groupRowHandle, (int dataRowHandle) => View.IsRowSelected(dataRowHandle));
		}

		private int GetDescendantsCount(int groupRowHandle, Func<int, bool> dataRowFilter)
		{
			int childrenCount = 0;
			IterateDescendants(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
			{
				if (!base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle) && dataRowFilter(rowHandle))
				{
					childrenCount++;
				}
			});
			return childrenCount;
		}

		private void IterateDescendants(int groupRowHandle, Action<int> action)
		{
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>(new List<int> { groupRowHandle });
			while (stack.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = stack.Pop();
				if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(num))
				{
					PushChildren(stack, num);
				}
				action(num);
			}
		}

		private void PushChildren(Stack<int> rowHandles, int groupRowHandle)
		{
			IterateChildren(groupRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
			{
				rowHandles.Push(rowHandle);
			});
		}

		public override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckBoxSelectionChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateGroupRowsSelection(e);
				base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
				UpdateCheckBoxes(e);
			});
			if (CheckBoxSelectionChangedLocker.IsLocked && IsRowSelectedOrUnselected(e))
			{
				RaiseSelectionChanged(e);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGroupRowsSelection(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Grid.GroupCount != 0 && !UpdateGroupRowsLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				if (base.IsOneDataRowSelected)
				{
					UpdateGroupRowsSelection(base.Grid.GetSelectedRowHandles()[0]);
				}
				else if (IsDataRowSelectedOrUnselected(e))
				{
					UpdateGroupRowSelection(base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(e.ControllerRow), e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Add);
				}
				else if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Refresh)
				{
					UpdateGroupRowsSelection();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGroupRowsSelection(int selectedRowHandle)
		{
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				SetGroupRowsSelection(isSelected: false);
				int parentRowHandle = base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(selectedRowHandle);
				bool? isSelected = HasOneSelectedChild(parentRowHandle);
				UpdateGroupRow(parentRowHandle, isSelected);
				UpdateGroupRowSelection(base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(parentRowHandle), hasSelectedDescendant: true);
			});
		}

		private void UpdateGroupRowSelection(int groupRowHandle, bool hasSelectedDescendant)
		{
			if (base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(groupRowHandle))
			{
				bool? allChildrenSelected = AreAllChildrenSelected(groupRowHandle);
				bool? isSelected = AreAllDescendantsSelected(allChildrenSelected, hasSelectedDescendant);
				UpdateGroupRow(groupRowHandle, isSelected);
				UpdateGroupRowSelection(base.Grid.GetParentRowHandle(groupRowHandle), !isSelected.HasValue || isSelected.Value);
			}
		}

		private bool? AreAllDescendantsSelected(bool? allChildrenSelected, bool hasSelectedDescendant)
		{
			if (allChildrenSelected.HasValue && allChildrenSelected.Value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!allChildrenSelected.HasValue || hasSelectedDescendant)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateGroupRowsSelection()
		{
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				if (base.IsAllItemsUnselected)
				{
					SetGroupRowsSelection(isSelected: false);
				}
				else if (base.IsAllItemsSelected)
				{
					SetGroupRowsSelection(isSelected: true);
				}
				else
				{
					IEnumerable<int> groupRowHandles = from groupInfo in (IEnumerable<GroupRowInfo>)base.Grid.DataController.GroupInfo
						where groupInfo.Level == 0
						select groupInfo.Handle;
					UpdateGroupRowsSelection(groupRowHandles);
				}
			});
		}

		private void UpdateGroupRowsSelection(IEnumerable<int> groupRowHandles)
		{
			foreach (int groupRowHandle in groupRowHandles)
			{
				CheckRowSelection(groupRowHandle);
			}
		}

		private void SetGroupRowsSelection(bool isSelected)
		{
			foreach (GroupRowInfo item in (Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)base.Grid.DataController.GroupInfo)
			{
				UpdateGroupRow(item.Handle, isSelected);
			}
		}

		private bool? CheckRowSelection(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!base.Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return View.IsRowSelected(rowHandle);
			}
			bool hasSelectedDescendant = false;
			int selectedChildrenCount = 0;
			int total = 0;
			IterateChildren(rowHandle, delegate(int childRowHandle)
			{
				bool? flag2 = CheckRowSelection(childRowHandle);
				if (flag2.HasValue && flag2.Value)
				{
					selectedChildrenCount++;
				}
				if (!flag2.HasValue || flag2.Value)
				{
					hasSelectedDescendant = true;
				}
				if (view != null && view.RaiseCanSelectRow(childRowHandle))
				{
					total++;
				}
			});
			int rowCount = ((view != null && view.CanRaiseCanSelectRow()) ? total : base.Grid.GetChildRowCount(rowHandle));
			bool? allChildrenSelected = SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(selectedChildrenCount, rowCount);
			bool? flag = AreAllDescendantsSelected(allChildrenSelected, hasSelectedDescendant);
			UpdateGroupRow(rowHandle, flag);
			return flag;
		}

		private void UpdateCheckBoxes(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			View.UpdateCellDataValues(View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn);
		}

		private void UpdateGroupRow(int groupRowHandle, bool? isSelected)
		{
			if (isSelected.HasValue && isSelected.Value)
			{
				SelectRowCore(groupRowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				UnselectRowCore(groupRowHandle);
			}
			View.UpdateRowDataByRowHandle(groupRowHandle, delegate(RowData rowData)
			{
				if (rowData is GroupRowData groupRowData)
				{
					groupRowData.SetAllItemsSelected(isSelected);
				}
			});
		}

		internal override void SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRange(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(startCommonVisibleIndex);
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(endCommonVisibleIndex);
			SelectOnlyThisRange(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2);
			if (view != null && view.ShowSelectionRectangle)
			{
				helper.SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRange(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TableViewSelectionStrategyNone : SelectionStrategyNone
	{
		private int oldFocusedRowHandle = int.MinValue;

		protected SelectionActionBase SelectionAction
		{
			get
			{
				return RootView.GlobalSelectionAction;
			}
			set
			{
				RootView.SetSelectionAction(value);
			}
		}

		protected GridViewBase GridView => (GridViewBase)view;

		protected GridViewBase RootView => (GridViewBase)view.RootView;

		private GridControl Grid => (GridControl)view.DataControl;

		public TableViewSelectionStrategyNone(GridViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnAssignedToGrid()
		{
			base.OnAssignedToGrid();
			GridView.SetSelectionAnchor();
		}

		protected virtual bool CanExecuteSelectionActionOnFocusedRowHandleChanged()
		{
			if (SelectionAction != null)
			{
				return SelectionAction.CanFocusChangeDeleteAction;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnFocusedRowHandleChanged(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (CanExecuteSelectionActionOnFocusedRowHandleChanged())
			{
				GridView.ExecuteSelectionAction();
			}
			else
			{
				GridView.SetSelectionAnchor();
			}
		}

		public override void CopyMasterDetailToClipboard()
		{
			Grid.CopyAllSelectedItemsToClipboard();
		}

		public override void OnBeforeProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			oldFocusedRowHandle = view.FocusedRowHandle;
			SelectionStrategyRow.GetKeyboardSelectionAction(GridView, e).Do(delegate(SelectionActionBase action)
			{
				SelectionAction = action;
			});
		}

		public override void OnAfterProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key != Key.Next && e.Key != Key.Prior)
			{
				OnNavigationComplete(e.Key == Key.Tab);
			}
		}

		public override void OnNavigationComplete(bool IsTabPressed)
		{
			if (oldFocusedRowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				SelectionAction = null;
			}
		}

		public override void OnNavigationCanceled()
		{
			SelectionAction = null;
		}
	}
	public class SelectionStrategyRowRange : SelectionStrategyRow
	{
		private readonly SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper helper;

		private HashSet<int> selectedOldRowHandle = new HashSet<int>();

		private List<int> selectedRowHandle = new List<int>();

		public SelectionStrategyRowRange(GridViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			helper = new SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper(this);
		}

		public override void SelectRowRange(IEnumerable<int> selectedRowsHandles)
		{
			if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
				return;
			}
			BeginRangeSelection();
			helper.SelectRowRange(selectedRowsHandles);
			EndRangeSelection();
		}

		protected override bool ShouldProcessMouseClick(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				return base.ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo);
			}
			if (base.Grid.AllowRecursiveSelectionForCollapsedGroups && IsRowSelected(hitInfo.RowHandle) && base.RootView.IsExpandButton(hitInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hitInfo.RowHandle != int.MinValue || hitInfo.IsDataArea)
			{
				if (base.IsMultipleMode)
				{
					return !base.RootView.IsExpandButton(hitInfo);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
			}
			else if (!base.HasValidationError && !base.IsRightMouseButtonPressed && ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo) && !view.IsEditing)
			{
				ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = hitInfo as ITableViewHitInfo;
				BeginRangeSelection();
				if (hitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo != null && tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)
				{
					base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
				}
				else if (ShouldProcessMouseClick(hitInfo))
				{
					helper.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo, base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonCore, base.DataControl);
				}
				helper.OldRowHandleWithShift = ((base.IsShiftPressed && !base.IsControlPressed) ? new int?(hitInfo.RowHandle) : ((int?)null));
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		public override void ClearSelection()
		{
			base.ClearSelection();
			helper.OldRowHandleWithShift = null;
		}
	}
	internal class CheckBoxColumnTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		private readonly DataTemplate emptyTemplate;

		public CheckBoxColumnTemplateSelector()
		{
			emptyTemplate = CreateEmptyTemplate();
		}

		private static DataTemplate CreateEmptyTemplate()
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = new DataTemplate();
			dataTemplate.Seal();
			return dataTemplate;
		}

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (!IsAdditionalRowCellData(item as GridCellData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return emptyTemplate;
		}

		private bool IsAdditionalRowCellData(GridCellData data)
		{
			return data.With((GridCellData x) => x.RowData).With((RowData y) => y.RowHandle).Return((RowHandle z) => z.Value, () => int.MinValue) == -2147483647;
		}
	}
	internal class CardViewCellNavigation : GridViewRowNavigationBase
	{
		protected CardView CardView => (CardView)base.View;

		protected System.Windows.Controls.Orientation Orientation => CardView.Orientation;

		public CardViewCellNavigation(CardView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical && ShouldCollapseRow())
			{
				CardView.CollapseFocusedRow();
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MoveLeftCell();
			}
		}

		public override void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical && ShouldExpandRow())
			{
				CardView.ExpandFocusedRow();
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MoveRightCell();
			}
		}

		public override void OnUp(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal && ShouldExpandRow())
			{
				CardView.ExpandFocusedRow();
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MoveUpCell();
			}
		}

		public override void OnDown()
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal && ShouldCollapseRow())
			{
				CardView.CollapseFocusedRow();
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MoveDownCell();
			}
		}

		public override void OnTab(bool isShiftPressed)
		{
			TabNavigation(isShiftPressed);
		}

		protected override bool ShouldCollapseRow()
		{
			if (base.View.CurrentCell == null)
			{
				return base.ShouldCollapseRow();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldExpandRow()
		{
			if (base.View.CurrentCell == null)
			{
				return base.ShouldExpandRow();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void SetRowFocus(DependencyObject row, bool focus)
		{
			SetRowFocusOnCell(row, focus);
			base.SetRowFocus(row, focus);
		}

		protected internal override void ClearAllStates()
		{
			ClearAllCellsStates();
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessMouse(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			DependencyObject cell = DataViewBase.FindParentCell(originalSource);
			base.ProcessMouse(originalSource);
			ProcessMouseOnCell(cell);
		}

		public override bool GetIsFocusedCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (base.View.FocusedRowHandle == rowHandle)
			{
				return base.View.DataControl.CurrentColumn == column;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class CardViewRowNavigation : GridViewRowNavigationBase
	{
		protected CardView CardView => (CardView)base.View;

		protected System.Windows.Controls.Orientation Orientation => CardView.Orientation;

		public CardViewRowNavigation(CardView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				if (ShouldCollapseRow())
				{
					CardView.CollapseFocusedRow();
				}
				else
				{
					CardView.MovePrevColumnCard();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MovePrevRowCard();
			}
		}

		public override void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				if (ShouldExpandRow())
				{
					CardView.ExpandFocusedRow();
				}
				else
				{
					CardView.MoveNextColumnCard();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MoveNextRowCard();
			}
		}

		public override void OnUp(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				CardView.MovePrevRowCard();
			}
			else if (ShouldExpandRow())
			{
				CardView.ExpandFocusedRow();
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MovePrevColumnCard();
			}
		}

		public override void OnDown()
		{
			if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				CardView.MoveNextRowCard();
			}
			else if (ShouldCollapseRow())
			{
				CardView.CollapseFocusedRow();
			}
			else if (base.View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				CardView.MovePrevRow();
			}
			else
			{
				CardView.MoveNextColumnCard();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExpandRowWithAnimationAction : IContinousAction, IAction
	{
		private enum ExpandState
		{
			Expanding,
			Collapsing
		}

		private const double AnimationEndLagTime = 50.0;

		private GridDataPresenterBase dataPresenter;

		private GroupNode groupNode;

		private ExpandState expandState;

		private bool isDone;

		private bool inProgress;

		private Storyboard storyboard;

		private bool recursive;

		private bool postponeForceComplete;

		protected FrameworkElement GroupRowElement { get; private set; }

		private SizeHelperBase SizeHelper => SizeHelperBase.GetDefineSizeHelper(View.OrientationCore);

		private GridViewBase View => groupNode.GridView;

		private GridControl Grid => groupNode.Grid;

		private GroupRowData groupRowData => GroupRowElement.DataContext as GroupRowData;

		private RowsContainer LogicalItemsContainer => groupRowData.RowsContainer;

		private System.Windows.Size RenderSize => ((IItemsContainer)LogicalItemsContainer).RenderSize;

		private DependencyObject AnimationTarget => groupRowData.RowsContainer;

		bool IContinousAction.IsDone => isDone;

		public ExpandRowWithAnimationAction(DataPresenterBase dataPresenter, GroupNode groupNode, bool recursive)
		{
			this.dataPresenter = (GridDataPresenterBase)dataPresenter;
			this.groupNode = groupNode;
			this.recursive = recursive;
			GroupRowElement = View.GetRowElementByRowHandle(groupNode.RowHandle.Value);
		}

		private void OnCollapsed()
		{
			groupNode.IsCollapsing = false;
			ChangeGroupExpanded();
			isDone = true;
			SetVisibleSize(ExpandHelper.DefaultVisibleSize);
			Grid.OnGroupRowCollapsed(groupNode.RowHandle.Value);
			View.UpdateRowData(delegate(RowData rowData)
			{
				rowData.EnsureRowLoaded();
			});
		}

		private void OnExpanded()
		{
			groupNode.CanGenerateItems = true;
			groupNode.IsExpanding = false;
			groupNode.ResumeUpdateState();
			groupNode.IsExpanded = true;
			View.VisualDataTreeBuilder.SynchronizeMasterNode();
			isDone = true;
			SetVisibleSize(ExpandHelper.DefaultVisibleSize);
			View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)dataPresenter.ClearInvisibleItems);
			Grid.RaiseGroupRowExpanded(groupNode.RowHandle.Value);
		}

		private void ExecuteCore()
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = RectHelper.BottomRight(LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)GroupRowElement, (UIElement)dataPresenter));
			double itemsContainerDefineSize = GetItemsContainerDefineSize();
			double val = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(dataPresenter.LastConstraint) - SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(point);
			val = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(val, itemsContainerDefineSize));
			System.Windows.Size visibleSize = SizeHelper.CreateSize(val, SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(ExpandHelper.DefaultVisibleSize));
			SetVisibleSize(visibleSize);
			double speedRatio = ((val == 0.0) ? 10000.0 : (ExpandHelper.GetExpandSpeed((DependencyObject)View) / val));
			if (expandState == ExpandState.Expanding)
			{
				BeginAnimation(GetStoryboard(ExpandHelper.ExpandStoryboardProperty), speedRatio);
			}
			else
			{
				BeginAnimation(GetStoryboard(ExpandHelper.CollapseStoryboardProperty), speedRatio);
			}
			if (postponeForceComplete)
			{
				ForceComplete(delayedCollapse: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisibleSize(System.Windows.Size value)
		{
			ExpandHelper.SetVisibleSize((DependencyObject)LogicalItemsContainer, value);
		}

		protected virtual void SetAnimationProgress(double animationProgress)
		{
			LogicalItemsContainer.AnimationProgress = animationProgress;
		}

		private Storyboard GetStoryboard(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			object value = View.GetValue(property);
			return (Storyboard)value;
		}

		private double GetItemsContainerDefineSize()
		{
			return SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(RenderSize);
		}

		private void BeginAnimation(Storyboard initialStoryboard, double speedRatio)
		{
			if (initialStoryboard != null)
			{
				storyboard = initialStoryboard.Clone();
				Storyboard.SetTarget(storyboard, AnimationTarget);
				storyboard.SpeedRatio = speedRatio;
				storyboard.Completed += OnStoryboardCompleted;
				storyboard.Begin();
			}
		}

		private void OnStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ForceComplete(delayedCollapse: true);
		}

		private void ForceComplete(bool delayedCollapse)
		{
			storyboard.Completed -= OnStoryboardCompleted;
			if (!isDone)
			{
				if (expandState == ExpandState.Expanding)
				{
					SetAnimationProgress(1.0);
					storyboard.Stop();
					OnExpanded();
				}
				else if (delayedCollapse)
				{
					DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
					dispatcherTimer.Tick += timer_Tick;
					dispatcherTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50.0);
					dispatcherTimer.Start();
				}
				else
				{
					ForceCompleteCollapseAnimation();
				}
			}
		}

		private void timer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((DispatcherTimer)sender).Tick -= timer_Tick;
			if (!isDone)
			{
				ForceCompleteCollapseAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void ForceCompleteCollapseAnimation()
		{
			storyboard.Stop();
			OnCollapsed();
		}

		void IContinousAction.ForceComplete()
		{
			if (storyboard == null)
			{
				postponeForceComplete = true;
			}
			else
			{
				ForceComplete(delayedCollapse: false);
			}
		}

		void IContinousAction.Prepare()
		{
			if (groupNode.IsExpanded)
			{
				if (!Grid.RaiseGroupRowCollapsing(groupNode.RowHandle.Value))
				{
					isDone = true;
					return;
				}
				groupNode.IsCollapsing = true;
				expandState = ExpandState.Collapsing;
				groupNode.CanGenerateItems = false;
				dataPresenter.CollapseBufferSize = GetItemsContainerDefineSize();
			}
			else if (!Grid.RaiseGroupRowExpanding(groupNode.RowHandle.Value))
			{
				isDone = true;
			}
			else
			{
				groupNode.IsExpanding = true;
				View.VisualDataTreeBuilder.SynchronizeMasterNode();
				expandState = ExpandState.Expanding;
				groupNode.SupressUpdateState();
				ChangeGroupExpanded();
				groupNode.CanGenerateItems = true;
			}
		}

		private void ChangeGroupExpanded()
		{
			Grid.ChangeGroupExpandedCore(groupNode.RowHandle.Value, recursive);
		}

		void IAction.Execute()
		{
			if (!inProgress)
			{
				inProgress = true;
				dataPresenter.CollapseBufferSize = 0.0;
				View.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, new ThreadStart(ExecuteCore));
			}
		}
	}
	public class GroupPanelDropTarget : ColumnHeaderDropTargetBase
	{
		private readonly bool mouseOverTargetPanel;

		protected override int DropIndexCorrection => 0;

		private DependencyObject GroupIndicatorDragDrop { get; set; }

		private GridViewBase GridViewCore => GridView as GridViewBase;

		private bool IsMergeGrouping
		{
			get
			{
				if (GridViewCore != null)
				{
					if (GridViewCore.IsDesignTime)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return GridViewCore.IsMergedGroupingCore();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public GroupPanelDropTarget(System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel, bool mouseOverTargetPanel)
			: base(panel)
		{
			this.mouseOverTargetPanel = mouseOverTargetPanel;
		}

		protected override bool DenyDropIfGroupingIsNotAllowed(HeaderPresenterType sourceType)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsLastVisibleColumn(ColumnBase sourceColumn)
		{
			if (sourceColumn.View != null && !sourceColumn.View.ShowGroupedColumnsCore)
			{
				return sourceColumn.View.IsLastVisibleColumn(sourceColumn);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (sourceColumn.GroupIndexCore < 0 && IsLastVisibleColumn(sourceColumn))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement dragIndicator = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator;
			if (dragIndicator != null)
			{
				bool flag = GridViewCore != null && GridViewCore.MergedGroupingMode == MergedGroupingMode.CtrlKeyPressed;
				BaseGridHeader.SetIsGroupPanel(dragIndicator, flag && dropIndex != 0);
			}
			SetCanGroupMergeState();
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount == 1 && sourceColumn.GroupIndexCore >= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsSelfGroup(sourceColumn, dropIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsSelfMergeGroup(sourceColumn, dropIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override int GetVisibleIndex(DependencyObject obj, bool useVisibleIndexCorrection)
		{
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex(obj) - ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex(obj);
		}

		protected override IList GetColumnsCollection(ColumnBase sourceColumn)
		{
			return sourceColumn.View.DataControl.ColumnsCore;
		}

		protected override DataViewBase GetViewForDrop(UIElement source)
		{
			return ((BaseGridColumnHeader)source).GridView;
		}

		protected override int GetDropIndexFromDragSource(UIElement element, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			BaseGridColumnHeader baseGridColumnHeader = (BaseGridColumnHeader)element;
			if (baseGridColumnHeader.GridView.DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl() != base.Grid)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!mouseOverTargetPanel)
			{
				return ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount;
			}
			return ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetDropIndexFromDragSource(element, pt);
		}

		protected override void MoveColumnTo(UIElement source, int dropIndex)
		{
			if (!IsMergeGrouping)
			{
				base.MoveColumnTo(source, dropIndex);
				return;
			}
			if (dropIndex == ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount)
			{
				MoveColumnToGroupMerge(source, dropIndex, MergeGroupPosition.Left);
				return;
			}
			MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition = CalcMergeGroupPosition(dropIndex);
			MoveColumnToGroupMerge(source, dropIndex, mergeGroupPosition);
		}

		private bool IsSelfGroupCore(GridColumn gridColumn)
		{
			if (IsMergeGrouping)
			{
				return gridColumn.MergeWithPreviousGroup;
			}
			return !gridColumn.MergeWithPreviousGroup;
		}

		private bool IsSelfGroup(ColumnBase sourceColumn, int dropIndex)
		{
			if (!(sourceColumn is GridColumn { IsGrouped: not false } gridColumn))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (gridColumn.GroupIndex == dropIndex)
			{
				return IsSelfGroupCore(gridColumn);
			}
			if (dropIndex == gridColumn.GroupIndex + 1)
			{
				if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount == gridColumn.GroupIndex + 1)
				{
					return IsSelfGroupCore(gridColumn);
				}
				if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount > gridColumn.GroupIndex + 1 && GridView.SortInfoCore != null && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)GridView.SortInfoCore).Count > gridColumn.GroupIndex + 1)
				{
					GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)GridView.SortInfoCore)[gridColumn.GroupIndex + 1];
					if (gridSortInfo.IsGrouped)
					{
						if (IsMergeGrouping)
						{
							return gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup;
						}
						return !gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsSelfMergeGroup(ColumnBase sourceColumn, int dropIndex)
		{
			if (!(sourceColumn is GridColumn { IsGrouped: not false }))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsMergeGrouping)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CalcMergeGroupPosition(dropIndex) switch
			{
				MergeGroupPosition.Left => dropIndex == sourceColumn.GroupIndexCore + 1, 
				MergeGroupPosition.Right => dropIndex == sourceColumn.GroupIndexCore, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetCorrectLastMousePosition()
		{
			if (GridView != null && GridView.RootView != null && GridView.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter != null && ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).AdornableElement != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point result = GridView.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.TransformToVisual(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).AdornableElement).Transform(GridView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition);
				result.X = Math.Max(result.X, 0.0);
				return result;
			}
			return GridView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition;
		}

		private MergeGroupPosition CalcMergeGroupPosition(int index)
		{
			if (!(Math.Ceiling(((index > 0) ? ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetLocationDragIndicator(index - 1, true) : ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetLocationDragIndicator(index, false)).X) <= GetCorrectLastMousePosition().X))
			{
				return MergeGroupPosition.Left;
			}
			return MergeGroupPosition.Right;
		}

		protected override void UpdateDragAdornerLocation(int headerIndex)
		{
			System.Windows.Point locationDragIndicator = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetLocationDragIndicator(headerIndex, false);
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount > 0 && headerIndex < ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount && headerIndex > 0 && IsMergeGrouping && Math.Ceiling(locationDragIndicator.X) > GetCorrectLastMousePosition().X)
			{
				locationDragIndicator = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetLocationDragIndicator(headerIndex - 1, true);
			}
			((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).UpdatePopupLocation(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(locationDragIndicator));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (IsMergeGrouping && Math.Ceiling(point.X) > GetCorrectLastMousePosition().X)
			{
				point.X -= 2.0;
			}
			return base.CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(point);
		}

		protected override void UpdateIndicator(DependencyObject element, UIElement uiElement)
		{
			GroupIndicatorDragDrop = element;
			SetCanGroupMergeState();
		}

		private void SetCanGroupMergeState()
		{
			if (GridViewCore != null && GroupIndicatorDragDrop != null)
			{
				bool value = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).ChildrenCount != 0 && GridViewCore.IsMergedGroupingCore();
				BaseGridHeader.SetCanGroupMergeState(GroupIndicatorDragDrop, value);
			}
		}
	}
