		}
	}
	public class ObservableCollectionCoreWithRemoveSafe<T> : ObservableCollectionCore<T>
	{
		private readonly LazyValue<List<T>> postponedRemoveListValue = (LazyValue<List<T>>)(object)new LazyValue<List<List<T>>>((Func<List<List<T>>>)(object)(Func<List<T>>)(() => new List<T>()));

		private readonly Locker collectionChangedLocker = new Locker();

		protected override void BaseOnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Locker val = collectionChangedLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				base.BaseOnCollectionChanged(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (((LazyValue<List<List<T>>>)(object)postponedRemoveListValue).Loaded)
			{
				T[] array = ((LazyValue<List<List<T>>>)(object)postponedRemoveListValue).Value.ToArray();
				foreach (T item in array)
				{
					((Collection<T>)(object)this).Remove(item);
				}
				((LazyValue<List<List<T>>>)(object)postponedRemoveListValue).Value.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveSafe(T item)
		{
			if (((Collection<T>)(object)this).IndexOf(item) >= 0)
			{
				if (collectionChangedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					((LazyValue<List<List<T>>>)(object)postponedRemoveListValue).Value.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					((Collection<T>)(object)this).Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public enum FetchingProgress
	{
		None,
		FetchingChildrenDisabled,
		FetchingStarted,
		FetchingChildrenFailed,
		FetchingHasChildrenFailed,
		FetchingEnded,
		Fetched
	}
	internal enum LoadingPanelState
	{
		Hidden,
		Loading,
		Failed
	}
	public static class TreeListNodeExtensions
	{
		public static void SetNodeExpanded(this TreeListNode node, bool expanded)
		{
			if (((TreeListNodeBase)node).IsExpanded != expanded && !node.ExpandItemsLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				node.ChangedExpandedInternal(expanded);
			}
		}

		internal static object GetContent(this TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((TreeListNodeBase)node).Content;
		}

		internal static LoadingPanelState GetLoadingState(this TreeListNode node)
		{
			return node.ChildrenFetchingProgress switch
			{
				FetchingProgress.None => LoadingPanelState.Hidden, 
				FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenDisabled => LoadingPanelState.Hidden, 
				FetchingProgress.FetchingStarted => LoadingPanelState.Loading, 
				FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenFailed => LoadingPanelState.Failed, 
				FetchingProgress.FetchingHasChildrenFailed => LoadingPanelState.Failed, 
				FetchingProgress.FetchingEnded => LoadingPanelState.Loading, 
				FetchingProgress.Fetched => LoadingPanelState.Hidden, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("FetchingProgress"), 
			};
		}

		internal static bool CanFetchChildren(this TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (node.ChildrenFetchingProgress != FetchingProgress.Fetched)
			{
				return node.ChildrenFetchingProgress != FetchingProgress.FetchingStarted;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool FetchingChildrenNotComplete(this TreeListNode node)
		{
			return new FetchingProgress[3]
			{
				FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenDisabled,
				FetchingProgress.FetchingStarted,
				FetchingProgress.FetchingChildrenFailed
			}.Contains(node.ChildrenFetchingProgress);
		}
	}
	internal class NodeStateBindingManager
	{
		public enum NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget
		{
			ExpandState,
			IsCheckBoxEnabledState
		}

		public static void UpdateObjectState(TreeListNode node, string fieldName, bool value, bool userTwoWayBinding)
		{
			if (!node.isNodeStateBindingUpdating && IsTwoWayBinding(node, fieldName, userTwoWayBinding))
			{
				node.Controller.SetValueCore(node, fieldName, value);
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateNodeState(TreeListNode node, string fieldName, NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget target)
		{
			switch (target)
			{
			case NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.ExpandState:
				UpdateNodeState(node, fieldName, delegate(TreeListNode n, bool value)
				{
					n.SetNodeExpanded(value);
				});
				break;
			case NodeStateBindingUpdateTarget.IsCheckBoxEnabledState:
				UpdateNodeState(node, fieldName, delegate(TreeListNode n, bool value)
				{
					n.IsCheckBoxEnabled = value;
				});
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public static bool UseBindingEvaluator(TreeListNode node, string nodeStateFieldName, System.Windows.Data.Binding nodeStateBinding)
		{
			if (node.Controller.IsUnboundMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (nodeStateBinding == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeStateFieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeStateFieldName) && IsSimpleBinding(nodeStateBinding, node))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsTwoWayBinding(TreeListNode node, string fieldName, bool userTwoWayBinding)
		{
			if (((TreeListDataControllerBase)node.Controller).Columns[fieldName] == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !((TreeListDataControllerBase)node.Controller).Columns[fieldName].ReadOnly && userTwoWayBinding;
		}

		private static void UpdateNodeState(TreeListNode node, string fieldName, Action<TreeListNode, bool> updateAction)
		{
			if (node.isNodeStateBindingUpdating)
			{
				return;
			}
			node.isNodeStateBindingUpdating = true;
			try
			{
				object value = ((TreeListDataControllerBase)node.Controller).GetValue((TreeListNodeBase)(object)node, fieldName);
				if (value != null && value != DBNull.Value)
				{
					bool arg = (bool)Convert.ChangeType(value, typeof(bool));
					updateAction(node, arg);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				node.isNodeStateBindingUpdating = false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsSimpleBinding(System.Windows.Data.Binding nodeStateBinding, TreeListNode node)
		{
			if (nodeStateBinding.Path == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!SimpleBindingProcessor.IsFieldValid(nodeStateBinding.Path.Path) || nodeStateBinding.Converter != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SimpleBindingProcessor.ValidateBindingProperties(nodeStateBinding) && ((TreeListDataControllerBase)node.Controller).IsReady && ((TreeListDataControllerBase)node.Controller).Columns[nodeStateBinding.Path.Path] != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class NodeStateBindingEvaluator : DependencyObject
	{
		private static readonly DependencyProperty StateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("State", typeof(bool), typeof(NodeStateBindingEvaluator), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NodeStateBindingEvaluator)d).UpdateNodeState();
		}));

		private bool updating;

		protected Action<TreeListNode, bool> UpdateAction { get; private set; }

		protected TreeListNode Node { get; private set; }

		protected System.Windows.Data.Binding Binding { get; private set; }

		public bool IsTwoWayBinding => Binding.Mode == BindingMode.TwoWay;

		public bool State
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(StateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public NodeStateBindingEvaluator(TreeListNode node, System.Windows.Data.Binding expandStateBinding, Action<TreeListNode, bool> updateAction)
		{
			UpdateAction = updateAction;
			Node = node;
			Binding = expandStateBinding;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, StateProperty, Binding);
		}

		public void Release()
		{
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, StateProperty);
			Binding = null;
		}

		public void UpdateNodeState()
		{
			if (updating)
			{
				return;
			}
			updating = true;
			try
			{
				UpdateAction(Node, State);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				updating = false;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateObjectState(bool value)
		{
			if (!updating)
			{
				State = value;
			}
		}
	}
}

	public class FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer : NestedGridElementAutomationPeerBase<FilteringPanelControl>, IValueProvider
	{
		protected FilteringPanelControl FilteringPanelControl { get; private set; }

		string IValueProvider.Value => ((object)FilteringPanelControl?.Context?.Filter)?.ToString();

		bool IValueProvider.IsReadOnly => false;

		public FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer(FilteringPanelControl element)
			: base(element)
		{
			FilteringPanelControl = element;
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			return "FilteringPanel";
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return typeof(FilteringPanelControl).Name;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return "FilteringPanel";
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			return (from x in VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)base.Owner, false)
				select CreatePeerCore(x) into x
				where x != null
				select x).ToList();
		}

		private AutomationPeer CreatePeerCore(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (obj is CheckEdit && ((FrameworkElement)(CheckEdit)obj).Name == "cbFilterEnable" && ((UIElement)(CheckEdit)obj).IsVisible)
			{
				AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(obj, "FilterCheckBox");
				return UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)((obj is CheckEdit) ? obj : null));
			}
			if (obj is System.Windows.Controls.Button)
			{
				System.Windows.Controls.Button button = obj as System.Windows.Controls.Button;
				if (button.IsVisible)
				{
					switch (button.Name)
					{
					case "buttonClearFilter":
						AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(obj, "ClearButton");
						return new NonFocusableButtonAutomationPeer(obj as System.Windows.Controls.Button);
					case "buttonCollapse":
						AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(obj, "CollapseButton");
						return new NonFocusableButtonAutomationPeer(obj as System.Windows.Controls.Button);
					case "buttonExpand":
						AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(obj, "ExpandButton");
						return new NonFocusableButtonAutomationPeer(obj as System.Windows.Controls.Button);
					case "buttonEditFilter":
						AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(obj, "EditFilterButton");
						return new NonFocusableButtonAutomationPeer(obj as System.Windows.Controls.Button);
					}
				}
			}
			if (obj is ToggleButton)
			{
				ToggleButton toggleButton = obj as ToggleButton;
				if (toggleButton.Name == "buttonMRU" && toggleButton.IsVisible)
				{
					AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(toggleButton, "MRUFilterList");
					return UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(obj as ToggleButton);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Value)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override bool IsContentElementCore()
		{
			return false;
		}

		void IValueProvider.SetValue(string value)
		{
			FilteringPanelControl.Context.Filter = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(value, new object[0]);
		}
	}

		protected bool? IsControl { get; set; }

			: base(owner)

			Owner = owner;
			IsContent = false;
			IsControl = true;
			SupportedPatterns = new HashSet<PatternInterface>();
		}

		protected void RegisterSupportedPatterns(params PatternInterface[] patterns)
		{
			foreach (PatternInterface item in patterns)
			{
				SupportedPatterns.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (!SupportedPatterns.Contains(patternInterface))
			{
				return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
			}
			return this;
		}

		protected override bool IsContentElementCore()
		{
			return IsContent ?? base.IsContentElementCore();
		}

		protected override bool IsControlElementCore()
		{
			return IsControl ?? base.IsControlElementCore();
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return Name ?? base.GetNameCore();
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			return AutomationId ?? base.GetAutomationIdCore();
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType ?? base.GetAutomationControlTypeCore();
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return typeof(T).Name;
		}

		protected override bool IsKeyboardFocusableCore()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
		}

		protected override bool HasKeyboardFocusCore()
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

			}

		public FilterCellContentPresenterAutomationPeer(FilterCellContentPresenter owner)
			: base(owner)
		{

				base.AutomationId = owner.Column.FieldName;
			}
			RegisterSupportedPatterns(PatternInterface.Value);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> children = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (base.Owner == null || base.Owner.Column == null)
			{
				return children;
			}
			if (base.Owner.Column.ShowCriteriaInAutoFilterRow != false)
			{
				VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)base.Owner, false).OfType<FilterCriteriaControl>().FirstOrDefault()
					.Do(delegate(FilterCriteriaControl x)

						children.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(x));
					});
			}
			VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)base.Owner, false).OfType<FilterRowCellEditor>().FirstOrDefault()
				.Do(delegate(FilterRowCellEditor x)
				{
					children.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)x));
				});
			return children;
		}

		{
			if (base.Owner == null || base.Owner.Column == null)
			{
				return base.AutomationId;
			}

			string arg2 = $"{base.Owner.Column.AutoFilterValue}";
			string fieldName = base.Owner.Column.FieldName;
			return string.Format(GridControlLocalizer.GetString(GridControlStringId.AutoFilterCellPeerName), fieldName, arg, arg2);
		}

		{
			if (base.Owner != null && base.Owner.Column != null)
			{
				base.Owner.Column.SetAutoFilterValue(value);
			}
		}

	public class GroupFooterAutomationPeer : GridControlVirtualElementAutomationPeerBase
	{

		private string name;

		protected int RowHandle { get; set; }

		protected DataViewBase View => base.DataControl.viewCore;

		public GroupFooterAutomationPeer(int rowHandle, DataControlBase dataControl, string name)
			: base(dataControl)
		{
			this.name = name;
			RowHandle = rowHandle;
			summaryPeers = new Dictionary<int, GroupFooterSummaryAutomationPeer>();
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			for (int i = 0; i < View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				if (HasSummaries(View.VisibleColumnsCore[i]))
				{
					list.Add(GetGroupFooterSummaryPeer(i));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual bool HasSummaries(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return column.GroupSummariesCore.Count > 0;
		}

		protected AutomationPeer GetGroupFooterSummaryPeer(int columnIndex)
		{
			GroupFooterSummaryAutomationPeer value = null;
			if (!summaryPeers.TryGetValue(columnIndex, out value))
			{
				value = new GroupFooterSummaryAutomationPeer(base.DataControl, RowHandle, columnIndex);
				summaryPeers[columnIndex] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return name;
		}

		protected internal override FrameworkElement GetFrameworkElement()
		{
			return View.GetFooterRowElementByRowHandleCore(RowHandle);
		}
	}

	public class SearchPanelAutomationPeer : DataControlAutomationPeerBase, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.DataControl.DataView.ActualShowSearchPanel)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return "SearchPanel";
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			return "SearchPanel";
		}

		protected override bool IsContentElementCore()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsControlElementCore()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}

			base.DataControl.DataView.ShowSearchPanel(moveFocusInSearchPanel: false);
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()

			base.DataControl.DataView.HideSearchPanel();

	public class ColumnHeaderAutomationPeer : ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase, IDockProvider, IInvokeProvider
	{
		public new GridControl DataControl => base.DataControl as GridControl;

		public new GridColumn Column => base.Column as GridColumn;

		public DockPosition DockPosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (Column == null || !Column.IsGrouped)
				{
					return DockPosition.None;
				}
				return DockPosition.Top;
			}
		}

		public ColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(GridControl gridControl, GridColumnHeader header)
			: base(gridControl, header)
		{
		}

		public ColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(GridControl gridControl, GridColumn column)
			: base(gridControl, column)
		{
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Dock || patternInterface == PatternInterface.Invoke)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = base.GetChildrenCore();
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.ColumnHeader ?? GetFrameworkElement();
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
				}
				list.Add(new DXContextMenuAutomationPeer(frameworkElement));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected bool ShouldDockItem(DockPosition dockPosition)
		{
			if (dockPosition != DockPosition.Top && dockPosition != DockPosition.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return dockPosition != DockPosition;
		}

		public void SetDockPosition(DockPosition dockPosition)
		{
			if (ShouldDockItem(dockPosition))
			{
				if (dockPosition == DockPosition.Top)
				{
					DataControl.GroupBy(Column);
				}
				else
				{
					DataControl.UngroupBy(Column);
				}
			}
		}

		void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
		{
			DataControl.View.OnColumnHeaderClick(Column);
		}
	}
	public class DataPanelAutomationPeer : DataControlAutomationPeerBase
	{
		protected ITableView View => base.DataControl.With((DataControlBase x) => x.DataView) as ITableView;

		public DataPanelAutomationPeer(DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(dataControl, dataControl.viewCore.DataPresenter)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return "DataPanel";
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			string automationIdCore = base.GetAutomationIdCore();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdCore))
			{
				return automationIdCore;
			}
			return "DataPanel";
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null || base.DataControl.AutomationPeer == null)
			{
				return new List<AutomationPeer>();
			}
			List<AutomationPeer> rowPeers = base.DataControl.AutomationPeer.GetRowPeers();
			if (View != null && View is TableView && ((TableView)View).ActualNewItemRowPosition != NewItemRowPosition.None)
			{
				rowPeers.Add(base.DataControl.AutomationPeer.GetRowPeer(-2147483647));
			}
			return rowPeers;
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}
	}

	public static class GridControlAutomationPeerHelper
	{
		public static FrameworkElement GetFooterPanelUIElement(FrameworkElement root)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTree(root, "PART_FootersPanel") ?? DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTree(root, "PART_FooterItemsControlBorder");
			return (FrameworkElement)dependencyObject;
		}

		public static FrameworkElement GetSearchPanelUIElement(FrameworkElement root)
		{
			return (FrameworkElement)DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTree(root, "part_SearchControlContainer");
		}

		public static AutomationPeer FindCellPeer(CellEditor cell)
		{
			return (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(cell.View.DataControl)?.GetChildren().FirstOrDefault((AutomationPeer x) => x is DataPanelAutomationPeer)?.GetChildren().FirstOrDefault((AutomationPeer x) => (x as GridRowAutomationPeer).RowHandle == cell.RowHandle) as GridRowAutomationPeer)?.GetChildren().FirstOrDefault((AutomationPeer x) => (object)((GridCellAutomationPeer)x).GetFrameworkElement() == cell);
		}

		public static string GetRowErrorMessage(Func<DataViewBase> getView, Func<int> getRowHandle)
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = getView();
			int num = getRowHandle();
			if (dataViewBase == null || num < 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int rowErrorsCount = dataViewBase.GetRowErrorsCount(num);
			if (rowErrorsCount <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Format(EditorLocalizer.GetString((EditorStringId)19), rowErrorsCount);
		}
	}
	public class GridCellAutomationPeer : GridControlVirtualElementAutomationPeerBase, IGridItemProvider, IValueProvider, ISelectionItemProvider
	{
		protected TableView TableView => base.DataControl.DataView as TableView;

		protected bool IsNew => TableView?.IsNewItemRowHandle(RowHandle) ?? false;

		protected bool IsNewRowEditing => TableView?.GridDataProvider.IsNewItemRowEditing ?? false;

		protected int RowHandle { get; set; }

		protected int ColumnIndex { get; set; }

		protected internal ColumnBase Column
		{
			get
			{
				if (ColumnIndex >= base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore[ColumnIndex];
			}
		}

		bool IValueProvider.IsReadOnly => Column?.ReadOnly ?? false;

		string IValueProvider.Value => GetValueCore();

		int IGridItemProvider.Column => ColumnIndex;

		int IGridItemProvider.ColumnSpan => 1;

		IRawElementProviderSimple IGridItemProvider.ContainingGrid => base.DataControl.AutomationPeer;

		int IGridItemProvider.Row => base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(RowHandle);

		int IGridItemProvider.RowSpan => 1;

		bool ISelectionItemProvider.IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.Cell)
				{
					return base.DataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.IsCellSelected(RowHandle, Column);
				}
				if (base.DataControl.DataView.FocusedRowHandle == RowHandle)
				{
					return base.DataControl.CurrentColumn == Column;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		IRawElementProviderSimple ISelectionItemProvider.SelectionContainer => base.DataControl.AutomationPeer;

		public GridCellAutomationPeer(int rowHandle, int columnIndex, DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(dataControl)
		{
			RowHandle = rowHandle;
			ColumnIndex = columnIndex;
		}

		protected internal override FrameworkElement GetFrameworkElement()
		{
			if (base.DataControl is TreeViewControl)
			{
				return base.DataControl.viewCore.GetRowElementByRowHandle(RowHandle);
			}
			return base.DataControl.viewCore.GetCellElementByRowHandleAndColumn(RowHandle, Column);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			return AutomationChildrenIteratorHelper.GetChildren(GetFrameworkElement());
		}

		protected override bool HasKeyboardFocusCore()
		{
			if (base.DataControl.DataView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell && base.DataControl.DataView.FocusedRowHandle == RowHandle)
			{
				return base.DataControl.CurrentColumn == Column;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsKeyboardFocusableCore()
		{
			return base.DataControl.DataView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			base.DataControl.CurrentColumn = Column;
			base.DataControl.DataView.SetFocusedRowHandle(RowHandle);
			base.DataControl.DataView.Focus();
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Value)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (!IsNew && patternInterface == PatternInterface.GridItem)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.SelectionItem)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			string automationIdCore = base.GetAutomationIdCore();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdCore))
			{
				return automationIdCore;
			}
			return Column?.FieldName;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			if (base.DataControl is TreeViewControl)
			{
				return GetValueCore();
			}
			int num = ((ColumnIndex < base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore.Count) ? ColumnIndex : (-1));
			if (ClearAutomationEventsHelper.UITestingEnabled)
			{
				return $"Column{num}";
			}
			return string.Format(GridControlLocalizer.GetString(GridControlStringId.CellPeerName), (RowHandle == -2147483647) ? "." : RowHandle.ToString(), num, GetValueCore());
		}

		protected virtual string GetValueCore()
		{
			ColumnBase column = Column;
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.DataControl.DataView.GetColumnDisplayText(base.DataControl.GetCellValue(RowHandle, column.FieldName), column, RowHandle);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Custom;
		}

		protected override string GetLocalizedControlTypeCore()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		void IValueProvider.SetValue(string value)
		{
			ColumnBase column = Column;
			if (column != null && !column.ReadOnly)
			{
				if (IsNew && !IsNewRowEditing)
				{
					TableView.GridDataProvider.AddNewRow();
				}
				base.DataControl.SetCellValueCore(RowHandle, Column.FieldName, value);
			}
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.AddToSelection()
		{
			base.DataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectCell(RowHandle, Column);
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.RemoveFromSelection()
		{
			base.DataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.UnselectCell(RowHandle, Column);
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.Select()
		{
			base.DataControl.CurrentColumn = Column;
			base.DataControl.DataView.SetFocusedRowHandle(RowHandle);
			if (base.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.Cell)
			{
				base.DataControl.BeginSelection();
				base.DataControl.UnselectAll();
				base.DataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectCell(RowHandle, Column);
				base.DataControl.EndSelection();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class GridDataControlAutomationPeer : DataControlAutomationPeer
	{
		private HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase headerPanelPeer;

		private DataPanelAutomationPeer dataPanelPeer;

		private SearchPanelAutomationPeer searchPanelPeer;

		private FooterPanelAutomationPeer footerPanelPeer;

		private AutoFilterRowControlAutomationPeer autoFilterRowPeer;

		private FilterPanelControlAutomationPeer filterPanelPeer;

		private FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer filteringPanelPeer;

		private bool isDataPanelPeerChildrenCacheDirty;

		protected ITableView TableView => base.DataControl.With((DataControlBase x) => x.DataView) as ITableView;

		public HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase HeaderPanelPeer => headerPanelPeer;

		public SearchPanelAutomationPeer SearchPanelPeer => searchPanelPeer;

		public AutoFilterRowControlAutomationPeer AutoFilterRowPeer => autoFilterRowPeer;

		public FilterPanelControlAutomationPeer FilterPanelPeer => filterPanelPeer;

		public FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer FilteringPanelPeer => filteringPanelPeer;

		public DataPanelAutomationPeer DataPanelPeer
		{
			get
			{
				if (isDataPanelPeerChildrenCacheDirty && dataPanelPeer != null)
				{
					dataPanelPeer.ResetChildrenCachePlatformIndependent();
					isDataPanelPeerChildrenCacheDirty = false;
				}
				return dataPanelPeer;
			}
		}

		public FooterPanelAutomationPeer FooterPanelPeer => footerPanelPeer;

		protected abstract HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase CreateHeaderPeer();

		public GridDataControlAutomationPeer(DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(dataControl)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ResetDataPanelPeer()
		{
			isDataPanelPeerChildrenCacheDirty = true;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetPeers()
		{
			dataPanelPeer = null;
			headerPanelPeer = null;
			footerPanelPeer = null;
			autoFilterRowPeer = null;
			filterPanelPeer = null;
			filteringPanelPeer = null;
		}

		protected internal override void ResetHeadersChildrenCache()
		{
			if (HeaderPanelPeer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<AutomationPeer> children = HeaderPanelPeer.GetChildren();
			foreach (AutomationPeer item in children)
			{
				item.ResetChildrenCache();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ResetDataPanelPeerCache()
		{
			if (isDataPanelPeerChildrenCacheDirty)
			{
				ResetChildrenCache();
				if (DataPanelPeer != null)
				{
					DataPanelPeer.ResetChildrenCachePlatformIndependent();
					isDataPanelPeerChildrenCacheDirty = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ResetDataPanelChildrenForce()
		{
			if (DataPanelPeer != null)
			{
				DataPanelPeer.ResetChildrenCachePlatformIndependent();
			}
		}

		protected virtual AutoFilterRowControlAutomationPeer CreateAutoFilterRowPeer()
		{
			if (DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTreeByType(base.DataControl, typeof(AutoFilterRowControl)) is AutoFilterRowControl element)
			{
				return UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(element) as AutoFilterRowControlAutomationPeer;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual DataPanelAutomationPeer CreateDataPanelPeer()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTreeByType(base.DataControl, typeof(DataPresenter)) as UIElement;
			if (base.DataControl.DataView is CardView)
			{
				uIElement = DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTreeByType(base.DataControl, typeof(CardDataPresenter)) as UIElement;
			}
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (DataPanelAutomationPeer)UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(uIElement);
		}

		protected virtual FilterPanelControlAutomationPeer CreateFilterPanelPeer()
		{
			return VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)base.DataControl, false).OfType<FilterPanelControl>().FirstOrDefault()
				.With((FilterPanelControl x) => (FilterPanelControlAutomationPeer)UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)x));
		}

		protected virtual FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer CreateFilteringPanelPeer()
		{
			return VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)base.DataControl, false).OfType<FilteringPanelControl>().FirstOrDefault()
				.With((FilteringPanelControl x) => (FilteringPanelControlAutomationPeer)UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(x));
		}

		protected virtual SearchPanelAutomationPeer CreateSearchPanelPeer()
		{
			FrameworkElement searchPanelUIElement = GridControlAutomationPeerHelper.GetSearchPanelUIElement(base.DataControl);
			if (searchPanelUIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new SearchPanelAutomationPeer(base.DataControl, searchPanelUIElement);
		}

		protected virtual FooterPanelAutomationPeer CreateFooterPeer()
		{
			FrameworkElement footerPanelUIElement = GridControlAutomationPeerHelper.GetFooterPanelUIElement(base.DataControl);
			if (footerPanelUIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FooterPanelAutomationPeer(base.DataControl, footerPanelUIElement);
		}

		private void AddChild(List<AutomationPeer> children, AutomationPeer peer)
		{
			peer.Do(delegate
			{
				children.Add(peer);
			});
		}

		private void AddChild(List<AutomationPeer> children, Func<bool> condition, Func<AutomationPeer> peerCreator, Action onConditionFailed = null)
		{
			if (condition())
			{
				AddChild(children, peerCreator());
			}
			else
			{
				onConditionFailed?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			AddChild(list, () => base.DataControl.DataView.ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Never, () => searchPanelPeer ?? (searchPanelPeer = CreateSearchPanelPeer()));
			AddChild(list, () => base.DataControl.DataView.ShowColumnHeaders, () => headerPanelPeer ?? (headerPanelPeer = CreateHeaderPeer()));
			AddChild(list, () => TableView != null && TableView.ShowAutoFilterRow, () => autoFilterRowPeer ?? (autoFilterRowPeer = CreateAutoFilterRowPeer()), delegate
			{
				autoFilterRowPeer = null;
			});
			AddChild(list, dataPanelPeer = CreateDataPanelPeer());
			AddChild(list, () => base.DataControl.DataView.ShowTotalSummary, () => footerPanelPeer ?? (footerPanelPeer = CreateFooterPeer()), delegate
			{
				footerPanelPeer = null;
			});
			AddChild(list, () => base.DataControl.DataView.ActualShowFilterPanel, () => filterPanelPeer ?? (filterPanelPeer = CreateFilterPanelPeer()), delegate
			{
				filterPanelPeer = null;
			});
			AddChild(list, () => base.DataControl.DataView.ActualShowFilterPanel, () => filteringPanelPeer ?? (filteringPanelPeer = CreateFilteringPanelPeer()), delegate
			{
				filteringPanelPeer = null;
			});
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override AutomationPeer GetCellPeer(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, bool force = false)
		{
			if (!(GetRowPeer(rowHandle) is GridRowAutomationPeer gridRowAutomationPeer))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return gridRowAutomationPeer.GetCellPeer(column.ActualVisibleIndex, force);
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			switch (patternInterface)
			{
			case PatternInterface.Grid:
				return this;
			case PatternInterface.Scroll:
				if (base.DataControl.DataView.DataPresenter != null)
				{
					FrameworkElement scrollOwner = ((IScrollInfo)base.DataControl.DataView.DataPresenter).ScrollOwner;
					if (scrollOwner != null)
					{
						return UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(scrollOwner) as IScrollProvider;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}
	}
	public class GridControlAutomationPeer : GridDataControlAutomationPeer, IGridProvider
	{
		public GridControl GridControl => base.DataControl as GridControl;

		public new HeaderPanelAutomationPeer HeaderPanelPeer => (HeaderPanelAutomationPeer)base.HeaderPanelPeer;

		protected override string ControlName => "GridControl";

		public GridControlAutomationPeer(GridControl gridControl)
			: base(gridControl)
		{
			gridControl.AutomationPeer = this;
		}

		protected override HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase CreateHeaderPeer()
		{
			return new HeaderPanelAutomationPeer(GridControl);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.DataGrid;
		}

		protected internal override AutomationPeer CreateRowPeer(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (GridControl.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return new GridGroupRowAutomationPeer(rowHandle, GridControl);
			}
			if (GridControl.View is TreeListView)
			{
				return new TreeListRowAutomationPeer(rowHandle, GridControl);
			}
			if (GridControl.View is TableView)
			{
				return new GridRowAutomationPeer(rowHandle, GridControl);
			}
			return new CardRowAutomationPeer(rowHandle, GridControl);
		}

		protected internal override AutomationPeer GetGroupFooterAutomationPeer(int rowHandle)
		{
			AutomationPeer value = null;
			if (!GridControl.LogicalPeerCache.GroupFooterRows.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				value = CreateGroupFooterAutomationPeer(rowHandle);
				GridControl.LogicalPeerCache.GroupFooterRows[rowHandle] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual AutomationPeer CreateGroupFooterAutomationPeer(int rowHandle)
		{
			return new GroupFooterAutomationPeer(rowHandle, GridControl, "GroupFooterRow");
		}
	}
	public class GridGroupRowAutomationPeer : GridRowAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		protected new GridControl DataControl => base.DataControl as GridControl;

		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!DataControl.IsGroupRowExpanded(base.RowHandle))
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public GridGroupRowAutomationPeer(int rowHandle, GridControl grid)
			: base(rowHandle, grid)
		{
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
		{
			DataControl.CollapseGroupRow(base.RowHandle);
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
		{
			DataControl.ExpandGroupRow(base.RowHandle);
		}

		protected override void Invoke()
		{
			DataControl.ChangeGroupExpanded(DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(base.RowHandle));
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			if (base.UIAutomationPeer != null)
			{
				return base.UIAutomationPeer.GetChildren();
			}
			return new List<AutomationPeer>();
		}

		protected internal override GridCellAutomationPeer GetCellPeer(int columnIndex, bool force = false)
		{
			if (!force)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.GetCellPeer(columnIndex, force);
		}

		protected override object GetBoundObject()
		{
			return DataControl.DataView.GetGroupDisplayValue(base.RowHandle);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected override bool HasKeyboardFocusCore()
		{
			return DataControl.DataView.FocusedRowHandle == base.RowHandle;
		}
	}
	public class GridRowAutomationPeer : GridControlVirtualElementAutomationPeerBase, IInvokeProvider, IScrollItemProvider, ISelectionItemProvider
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<int, GridCellAutomationPeer> cellPeers;

		protected TableView TableView => base.DataControl?.DataView as TableView;

		protected bool IsNew => TableView?.IsNewItemRowHandle(RowHandle) ?? false;

		protected bool IsNewRowEditing => TableView?.GridDataProvider.IsNewItemRowEditing ?? false;

		protected internal NewItemRowPosition NewItemRowPosition => TableView?.NewItemRowPosition ?? NewItemRowPosition.None;

		protected internal int RowHandle { get; set; }

		bool ISelectionItemProvider.IsSelected => base.DataControl.DataView.IsRowSelected(RowHandle);

		IRawElementProviderSimple ISelectionItemProvider.SelectionContainer => ProviderFromPeer(base.DataControl.AutomationPeer);

		public GridRowAutomationPeer(int rowHandle, DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(dataControl)
		{
			RowHandle = rowHandle;
			cellPeers = new Dictionary<int, GridCellAutomationPeer>();
		}

		protected internal override FrameworkElement GetFrameworkElement()
		{
			return base.DataControl.viewCore.GetRowElementByRowHandle(RowHandle);
		}

		protected override bool HasKeyboardFocusCore()
		{
			if (base.DataControl.DataView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
			{
				return base.DataControl.DataView.FocusedRowHandle == RowHandle;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsKeyboardFocusableCore()
		{
			return base.DataControl.DataView.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			base.DataControl.DataView.FocusedRowHandle = RowHandle;
			base.DataControl.DataView.Focus();
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>(base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(GetCellPeer(i));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal virtual GridCellAutomationPeer GetCellPeer(int columnIndex, bool force = false)
		{
			GridCellAutomationPeer value = null;
			if (!cellPeers.TryGetValue(columnIndex, out value))
			{
				value = new GridCellAutomationPeer(RowHandle, columnIndex, base.DataControl);
				cellPeers[columnIndex] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.Invoke => this, 
				PatternInterface.ScrollItem => this, 
				PatternInterface.SelectionItem => this, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			if (IsNew)
			{
				return "NewItemRow";
			}
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			object boundObject = GetBoundObject();
			if (boundObject == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return boundObject.ToString();
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			if (IsNew)
			{
				return "NewItemRow";
			}
			if (ClearAutomationEventsHelper.UITestingEnabled)
			{
				return $"Row{Convert.ToString(RowHandle)}";
			}
			return base.GetAutomationIdCore();
		}

		protected virtual object GetBoundObject()
		{
			return base.DataControl.GetRow(RowHandle);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.DataItem;
		}

		void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
		{
			Invoke();
		}

		protected virtual void Invoke()
		{
			if (IsNew && IsNewRowEditing)
			{
				if (TableView.CommitEditingInternal())
				{
					TableView.MoveFirstNavigationIndexCore(isTabNavigation: false);
					if (TableView.IsBottomNewItemRowFocused)
					{
						TableView.ScrollIntoView(TableView.FocusedRowHandle);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.DataControl.viewCore.SetFocusedRowHandle(RowHandle);
			}
		}

		void IScrollItemProvider.ScrollIntoView()
		{
			base.DataControl.viewCore.SetFocusedRowHandle(RowHandle);
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.AddToSelection()
		{
			base.DataControl.DataView.SelectRowCore(RowHandle);
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.RemoveFromSelection()
		{
			base.DataControl.DataView.UnselectRowCore(RowHandle);
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.Select()
		{
			base.DataControl.DataView.SetFocusedRowHandle(RowHandle);
			if (base.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.Row)
			{
				base.DataControl.BeginSelection();
				base.DataControl.UnselectAll();
				base.DataControl.DataView.SelectRowCore(RowHandle);
				base.DataControl.EndSelection();
			}
			else if (base.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				base.DataControl.DataView.SelectRowCore(RowHandle);
			}
		}
	}

	public class HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase : DataControlAutomationPeerBase
	{
		private Dictionary<int, ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase> headerPeers;

		protected Dictionary<int, ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase> HeaderPeers => headerPeers;

		public HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase(DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(dataControl, dataControl)
		{
			headerPeers = new Dictionary<int, ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase>();
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore)
			{
				if (!headerPeers.TryGetValue(item.ActualVisibleIndex, out var _))
				{
					headerPeers[item.ActualVisibleIndex] = new ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase(base.DataControl, item);
				}
				list.Add(headerPeers[item.ActualVisibleIndex]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override AutomationPeer CreatePeerCore(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is ScrollViewer)
			{
				return CreateHeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeer((ScrollViewer)obj);
			}
			if (obj is GridColumnHeader)
			{
				return CreateColumnHeaderAutomationPeer((GridColumnHeader)obj);
			}
			return base.CreatePeerCore(obj);
		}

		protected virtual ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase CreateColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(GridColumnHeader columnHeader)
		{
			return new ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase(base.DataControl, columnHeader);
		}

		protected virtual HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeerBase CreateHeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeer(ScrollViewer viewer)
		{
			return new HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeerBase(base.DataControl, viewer);
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return typeof(ItemsControlBase).Name;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return "HeaderPanel";
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}
	}
	public class HeaderPanelAutomationPeer : HeaderPanelAutomationPeerBase
	{
		protected new GridControl DataControl => base.DataControl as GridControl;

		public HeaderPanelAutomationPeer(GridControl gridControl)
			: base(gridControl)
		{
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> children = GetUIChildrenCore(DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTree(DataControl, "groupPanelItemsControl"));
			if (children == null)
			{
				children = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in DataControl.View.VisibleColumnsCore)
			{
				if (!base.HeaderPeers.TryGetValue(item.ActualVisibleIndex, out var _))
				{
					base.HeaderPeers[item.ActualVisibleIndex] = new ColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(DataControl, (GridColumn)item);
				}
				children.Add(base.HeaderPeers[item.ActualVisibleIndex]);
			}
			(DataControlAutomationPeerBase.FindObjectInVisualTree(DataControl, "PART_GroupPanel") as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				children.Add(new DXContextMenuAutomationPeer(x));
			});
			return children;
		}

		protected override ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase CreateColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(GridColumnHeader columnHeader)
		{
			return new ColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(DataControl, columnHeader);
		}

		protected override HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeerBase CreateHeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeer(ScrollViewer viewer)
		{
			return new HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeer(DataControl, viewer);
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			return "HeaderPanel";
		}

		protected override bool IsContentElementCore()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Header;
		}
	}
	public class HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeerBase : ScrollViewerAutomationPeer, IAutomationPeerCreator
	{
		private DataControlBase dataControl;

		protected DataControlBase DataControl => dataControl;

		public HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeerBase(DataControlBase dataControl, ScrollViewer viewer)
			: base(viewer)
		{
			this.dataControl = dataControl;
		}

		protected virtual AutomationPeer CreatePeerCore(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is GridColumnHeader)
			{
				return CreateColumnHeaderAutomationPeer((GridColumnHeader)obj);
			}
			return DataControlAutomationPeerBase.CreatePeerDefault(obj);
		}

		protected virtual ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase CreateColumnHeaderAutomationPeer(GridColumnHeader header)
		{
			return new ColumnHeaderAutomationPeerBase(DataControl, header);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			return DataControlAutomationPeerBase.GetUIChildrenCore(base.Owner, this);
		}

		AutomationPeer IAutomationPeerCreator.CreatePeer(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			AutomationPeer peer = DataControl.PeerCache.GetPeer(obj);
			if (peer != null)
			{
				return peer;
			}
			peer = CreatePeerCore(obj);
			DataControl.PeerCache.AddPeer(obj, peer, checkShouldAdd: true);
			return peer;
		}
	}

	{

		{
			if (!(peer is DataControlAutomationPeerBase) && !(peer is HeaderPanelScrollViewerAutomationPeer))

	public class TotalSummaryAutomationPeer : NestedGridElementAutomationPeerBase<GridTotalSummary>, IValueProvider
	{
		public IColumnInfo ColumnInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner == null || !(base.Owner.DataContext is GridColumnData))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (IColumnInfo)(object)((GridColumnData)base.Owner.DataContext).Column;
			}
		}

		string IValueProvider.Value => (ColumnInfo as GridColumn).With((GridColumn x) => x.TotalSummaryText);

		bool IValueProvider.IsReadOnly => true;

			: base(summary)

			base.AutomationId = ColumnInfo.Return((IColumnInfo x) => x.FieldName, () => GetAutomationIdCore());
			base.IsContent = true;
			base.AutomationControlType = System.Windows.Automation.Peers.AutomationControlType.Text;
			RegisterSupportedPatterns(PatternInterface.Value);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			return new List<AutomationPeer>
			{
				new DXContextMenuAutomationPeer(base.Owner)
			};
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			return ((IValueProvider)this).Value;
		}

		void IValueProvider.SetValue(string value)
		{
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.Automation.Native
{
	internal static class AutomationChildrenIteratorHelper
	{
		public static List<AutomationPeer> GetChildren(UIElement element)
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> peers = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (element == null)
			{
				return peers;
			}
			IterateCore(element, delegate(AutomationPeer peer)
			{
				peers.Add(peer);
				return false;
			});
			return peers;
		}

		private static bool IterateCore(DependencyObject parent, Func<AutomationPeer, bool> callback)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
				for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
					AutomationPeer arg;
					flag = ((!(child is UIElement) || (arg = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)child)) == null) ? IterateCore(child, callback) : callback(arg));
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
}

	public class ScrollBarHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AllowSetScrollHeightProperty;

		static ScrollBarHelper()
		{
			AllowSetScrollHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("AllowSetScrollHeight", typeof(bool), typeof(ScrollBarHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
		}

		public static void SetAllowSetScrollHeight(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(AllowSetScrollHeightProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetAllowSetScrollHeight(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(AllowSetScrollHeightProperty);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.Core.Native
{
	internal class GridViewDataDependentEntityProvider : DataDependentEntityProviderBase
	{
		private readonly GridViewBase gridView;

		public GridViewDataDependentEntityProvider(GridViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
			gridView = view;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<DataDependentEntityInfo> GetDataDependentEntityInfo()
		{
			BaseGridController val = gridView.DataProviderBase?.DataController;
			if (val == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<DataDependentEntityInfo>();
			}
			return base.GetDataDependentEntityInfo().Concat(DataDependentEntityProviderBase.GetSummaryDataDependentEntityInfo((IEnumerable<SummaryItem>)((DataController)val).TotalSummary, (SummaryItem summaryItem) => new DataDependentEntity().AddTotalSummary(summaryItem))).Concat(DataDependentEntityProviderBase.GetSummaryDataDependentEntityInfo((IEnumerable<SummaryItem>)((DataController)val).GroupSummary, (SummaryItem summaryItem) => new DataDependentEntity().AddGroupSummary(summaryItem)))
				.Concat(DataDependentEntityProviderBase.GetSortingDataDependentEntityInfo(((DataController)val).SortInfo.ToArray(), gridView.DataControl.ActualGroupCountCore));
		}
	}
	internal class TreeListViewDataDependentEntityProvider : DataDependentEntityProviderBase
	{
		private readonly TreeListView treeListView;

		public TreeListViewDataDependentEntityProvider(TreeListView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			treeListView = view;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<DataDependentEntityInfo> GetDataDependentEntityInfo()
		{
			TreeListDataController treeListDataController = treeListView.TreeListDataProvider?.Controller;
			if (treeListDataController == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<DataDependentEntityInfo>();
			}
			return base.GetDataDependentEntityInfo().Concat(DataDependentEntityProviderBase.GetSummaryDataDependentEntityInfo((IEnumerable<SummaryItem>)((TreeListDataControllerBase)treeListDataController).TotalSummary, (SummaryItem summaryItem) => new DataDependentEntity().AddTotalSummary(summaryItem))).Concat(DataDependentEntityProviderBase.GetSortingDataDependentEntityInfo((IList<DataColumnSortInfo>)(object)((IEnumerable<TreeListDataColumnSortInfo>)((TreeListDataControllerBase)treeListDataController).SortInfo).ToArray()))
				.Concat(new DataDependentEntityInfo(treeListView.IsCheckBoxEnabledFieldName.Yield(), new DataDependentEntity().Update(null, null, null, null, null, null, null, true), isFixed: false).Yield())
				.Concat(new DataDependentEntityInfo(treeListView.ExpandStateFieldName.Yield(), new DataDependentEntity().Update(null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, true), isFixed: false).Yield());
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.Internal
{
	internal class AutoFilterRowVisibilityConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public Visibility TrueValue;

		public Visibility FalseValue = Visibility.Collapsed;

		public AutoFilterRowPosition Position { get; set; }

		public AutoFilterHeaderState InHeaderState { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || !(values[0] is bool) || !(bool)values[0])
			{
				return FalseValue;
			}
			if (Position == AutoFilterRowPosition.Cell)
			{
				return ((AutoFilterRowPosition)values[1] == Position) ? TrueValue : FalseValue;
			}
			if (values.Length == 3)
			{
				return ((AutoFilterRowPosition)values[1] == Position && (AutoFilterHeaderState)values[2] == InHeaderState) ? TrueValue : FalseValue;
			}
			return FalseValue;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	internal class StateToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public AutoFilterHeaderState TrueState { get; set; }

		public AutoFilterHeaderState FalseState { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is AutoFilterHeaderState))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (AutoFilterHeaderState)value == TrueState;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is bool))
			{
				return FalseState;
			}
			return ((bool)value) ? TrueState : FalseState;
		}
	}
	public class StringToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString());
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class StringToBoolConverterExtension : MarkupExtension
	{
		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return new StringToBoolConverter();
		}
	}
	public class TotalSummaryPositionToRowConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public int TopRow { get; set; }

		public int BottomRow { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is TotalSummaryPosition))
			{
				return BottomRow;
			}
			return ((TotalSummaryPosition)value == TotalSummaryPosition.Top) ? TopRow : BottomRow;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	public class TotalSummaryPositionToVisibilityConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public TotalSummaryPosition? VisiblePosition { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return (!(value is TotalSummaryPosition) || ((!VisiblePosition.HasValue || (TotalSummaryPosition)value != VisiblePosition.Value) && (VisiblePosition.HasValue || (TotalSummaryPosition)value == TotalSummaryPosition.None))) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	public class TotalSummaryPositionToBooleanConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter

			return this;
		}
	}

		}

	public class TotalSummaryPanelBorderThicknessConverterBase : MarkupExtension
	{
		private static readonly object thicknessForNestedViewInBottom = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);

		private static readonly object thicknessForTotalSummaryInTop = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);

		private static readonly object thicknessForTotalSummaryInBottom = new Thickness(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);

		protected object ConvertCore(params object[] values)
		{
			if (values == null || !(values[0] is TotalSummaryPosition))
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			TotalSummaryPosition totalSummaryPosition = (TotalSummaryPosition)values[0];
			if (totalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Top)
			{
				return thicknessForTotalSummaryInTop;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (values.Length == 2 && values[1] is bool)
			{
				flag = (bool)values[1];
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return thicknessForNestedViewInBottom;
			}
			return thicknessForTotalSummaryInBottom;
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	public class TotalSummaryPositionToMarginConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public Thickness TopMargin { get; set; }

		public Thickness BottomMargin { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is TotalSummaryPosition && (TotalSummaryPosition)value == TotalSummaryPosition.Top)
			{
				return TopMargin;
			}
			return BottomMargin;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	internal static class TotalSummaryHelper
	{
		public static bool? GetShowTotalSummary(object value)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				return (bool)value;
			}
			if (value is TotalSummaryPosition)
			{
				return (TotalSummaryPosition)value != TotalSummaryPosition.None;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AutoComplete.Native
{
	public class AutoCompleteGridWrapper : SelectorWrapper
	{
		private bool IsOwnerSourceSet;

		private GridControl Grid => (GridControl)((SelectorWrapper)this).Selector;

		public override object SelectedItem => Grid.SelectedItem;

		private SelectionEventMode SelectionEventMode { get; set; }

		private bool ClosePopupOnClick { get; set; }

		public AutoSuggestEdit OwnerEdit => (AutoSuggestEdit)BaseEdit.GetOwnerEdit((DependencyObject)Grid);

		private AutoSuggestEditPropertyProvider PropertyProvider => (AutoSuggestEditPropertyProvider)ActualPropertyProvider.GetProperties((DependencyObject)(object)OwnerEdit);

		public AutoCompleteGridWrapper(DataControlBase element)
			: base((FrameworkElement)element)
		{
		}

		public override void SyncWithOwnerEdit(bool syncDataSource)
		{
		}

		public override void SyncValuesWithOwnerEdit(bool resetTotals)
		{
		}

		public override bool ProcessPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (OwnerEdit == null || ((BaseEdit)OwnerEdit).IsReadOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ModifierKeys keyboardModifiers = ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e);
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsAltPressed(keyboardModifiers))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (e.Key == Key.System)
			{
				key = e.SystemKey;
			}
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Up:
				e.Handled = true;
				Grid.DataView.MovePrevRow();
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				e.Handled = true;
				Grid.DataView.MoveNextRow();
				break;
			case Key.Next:
				e.Handled = true;
				Grid.DataView.MoveNextPage();
				break;
			case Key.Prior:
				e.Handled = true;
				Grid.DataView.MovePrevPage();
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool ProcessKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			return e.Handled;
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetSelectedItems()
		{
			return Grid.SelectedItems;
		}

		public override void SetupEditor()
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)Grid, DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty))
			{
				Grid.SetBinding(DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ItemsSource")
				{
					Source = OwnerEdit
				});
				IsOwnerSourceSet = true;
			}
			Grid.DataView.NavigationStyle = GridViewNavigationStyle.Row;
			Grid.SelectionMode = MultiSelectMode.None;
			SelectionEventMode = PropertyProvider.SelectionEventMode;
			ClosePopupOnClick = PropertyProvider.ClosePopupOnClick;
			Grid.MouseDown += ((SelectorWrapper)this).NotifyMouseDown;
			Grid.MouseUp += ((SelectorWrapper)this).NotifyMouseUp;
			Grid.View.FocusedRowHandleChanged += ViewOnFocusedRowHandleChanged;
			SelectorWrapper.SetSelectorWrapper((DependencyObject)Grid, (SelectorWrapper)(object)this);
		}

		private void ViewOnFocusedRowHandleChanged(object sender, FocusedRowHandleChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SelectorWrapper)this).PostPopupValue = Grid.SelectedItem != null;
		}

		public override void NotifyMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public override void NotifyMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Released)
			{
				int rowHandleByMouseEventArgs = Grid.View.GetRowHandleByMouseEventArgs(e);
				if (IsDataRowRowHandle(rowHandleByMouseEventArgs) && ClosePopupOnClick)
				{
					((PopupBaseEdit)OwnerEdit).ClosePopup();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ClearEditor()
		{
			Grid.MouseDown -= ((SelectorWrapper)this).NotifyMouseDown;
			Grid.MouseUp -= ((SelectorWrapper)this).NotifyMouseUp;
			Grid.View.FocusedRowHandleChanged -= ViewOnFocusedRowHandleChanged;
			Grid.SetCurrentValue(DataControlBase.SelectedItemProperty, null);
			if (IsOwnerSourceSet)
			{
				Grid.SetCurrentValue(DataControlBase.ItemsSourceProperty, null);
				IsOwnerSourceSet = false;
			}
			SelectorWrapper.SetSelectorWrapper((DependencyObject)Grid, (SelectorWrapper)null);
		}

		private bool IsDataRowRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (Grid.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowHandle != int.MinValue && rowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				return rowHandle != -2147483645;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Editors
{
	public class AutoSuggestGridStyleSettings : AutoSuggestEditStyleSettings
	{
		public override void ApplyToEdit(BaseEdit editor)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((PopupBaseEditStyleSettings)this).ApplyToEdit(editor);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Register(typeof(GridControl));
			AutoSuggestEdit val = (AutoSuggestEdit)editor;
			if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)val, PopupBaseEdit.PopupContentTemplateProperty))
			{
				AutoCompleteEditThemeKeyExtension obj = new AutoCompleteEditThemeKeyExtension
				{
					ResourceKey = AutoCompleteEditGridThemeKeys.PopupContentTemplate
				};
				((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = CommonThemeHelper.GetEditorThemeName((DependencyObject)(object)editor);
				object obj2 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)editor).TryFindResource((object)obj);
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)editor).SetCurrentValue(PopupBaseEdit.PopupContentTemplateProperty, obj2);
				}
			}
		}
	}
